                ② 通道号超 32767 该项跳过并计入组态错桶；
                ③ 未识别的 ChannelErrorType（含厂商自定义域）归「其他」桶并置信息码——
                   协议允许厂商自定义，未识别不等于故障；
                ④ 16#001F 语义冲突显式化：一处公开源记为临时故障，另一处记作要求维护，
                   本库按「维护类」保守侧处理并在头注释并列两种语义（不二选一硬编码）；
                ⑤ ≥ 16#8000 的系统级码（总线/同步类）不占通道掩码，单列 bSystemLevel，
                   因为运维处理路径与通道问题完全不同；
                ⑥ CASE 分类含 ELSE 兜底走「其他」桶；uEntryCount = 0 时输出全空且 eOk。
                职责边界：单通道健康判定归设备件，多源健康仲裁归 FB_DL_DeviceHealthArbiter。
    解码表    : 16#0001 短路 / 16#0002 欠压 / 16#0003 过压 / 16#0004 过载 / 16#0005 过温 /
                16#0006 断线 / 16#0007 超上限 / 16#0008 欠下限 / 16#0009 通用错误 /
                16#000F 参数缺失 / 16#0010 参数故障 / 16#001E 要求维护 / 16#001F 维护要求
                （另一公开源记为 Temporary_fault）/ >= 16#8000 系统级
    错误码    : 16#0003_016C 未识别的 ChannelErrorType（厂商自定义域），已归「其他」桶——信息级，正常防御
                16#0003_016D 预留禁用（信息级，不得挪用）
                16#0003_0333 诊断条目数超上限（> 16）——故障级，已钳位处理
                16#0003_0334 通道号越界（> 32767）——故障级，该项已跳过并计入组态错桶
                16#0003_0335 预留禁用（故障级，不得挪用）
    码位总账  : 16#0003_016C 用 / 16#0003_016D 预留 ｜ 16#0003_0333 用 / 16#0003_0334 用 / 16#0003_0335 预留
    状态机    : R6 标注 N/A —— 本组件为纯函数无顺序状态机，无 CASE 可写，非法状态不可能出现
                （分类 CASE 是协议枚举映射表，不是顺序状态机，且含 ELSE 兜底）
    采样约定  : 本件无定时器、无沿检测、无状态驻留；诊断项每拍全量重算，结论与任务周期无关。
    修订记录  : 2026-11-16 v1.0.0 首次入库（R19）
*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_ProfinetAlarmDiag
VAR_INPUT
    auChannelNo        : ARRAY[0..15] OF UINT;   // 通道号 [通道]，协议域 0~32767，0 表示子模块级 / channel number [channel], protocol range 0~32767, zero means submodule
    auChannelProp      : ARRAY[0..15] OF WORD;   // 通道属性（协议位域），本件原样透传不解释 [位域] / channel properties, passed through without interpretation [bitfield]
    auErrType          : ARRAY[0..15] OF WORD;   // ChannelErrorType（公开枚举，见头注释解码表）[枚举] / channel error type, see the decode table [enum]
    auExtErrType       : ARRAY[0..15] OF WORD;   // ExtChannelErrorType（厂商扩展），只透传不解释 [枚举] / extended error type, passed through only [enum]
    audAddValue        : ARRAY[0..15] OF UDINT;  // ExtChannelAddValue（附加上下文值）[无量纲] / additional context value [dimensionless]
    uEntryCount        : UINT := 0;              // 有效诊断项数 [项]，范围 0~16 / number of valid diagnostic entries [entry], range 0~16
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    uChannelMask       : WORD;                   // 有诊断的项位图，bit N = 项 N [位图] / bitmap of diagnostic entries, bit N is entry N [bitmap]
    uFirstChannel      : UINT;                   // 首出通道号（同拍取通道号最小）[通道] / first-out channel number, the lowest channel wins [channel]
    uFirstErrType      : WORD;                   // 首出项的 ChannelErrorType 原值（HMI 可查表）[枚举] / raw error type of the first-out entry [enum]
    auClassCount       : ARRAY[0..7] OF UINT;    // 八类计数 [次]，索引 0 短路 ~ 7 维护类 / eight class counters [times], 0 short circuit to 7 maintenance
    bMaintenanceOnly   : BOOL;                   // 只有维护类条目（可继续生产需保养）/ maintenance entries only, production may continue
    bSystemLevel       : BOOL;                   // 存在系统级码（>= 16#8000，总线/同步类）/ a system level code exists, bus or synchronisation class
    eHealth            : E_DL_Ne107Status;       // NE107 健康出口（引用唯一属主枚举）/ NE107 health output, referencing the owner enumeration
    eErr               : UDINT;                  // 错误码，0=正常 / error id, 0=ok
    bError             : BOOL;                   // 故障标志，eErr 为故障级时 TRUE / error flag, TRUE on fault-level eErr
    bValid             : BOOL;                   // 结论是否可用 / conclusion valid flag
END_VAR
VAR
    uIdx               : UINT;                   // 条目扫描游标 [项]，范围 0~15 / entry scan cursor [entry], range 0~15
    uCountEff          : UINT;                   // 钳位后的有效条目数 [项] / clamped effective entry count [entry]
    uClass             : UINT;                   // 本项的类别桶号 [桶]，范围 0~7 / class bucket index of this entry [bucket], range 0~7
    uBestCh            : UINT;                   // 首出通道号候选 [通道] / first-out channel candidate [channel]
    wBestErr           : WORD;                   // 首出错误类型候选 [枚举] / first-out error type candidate [enum]
    bAnyEntry          : BOOL;                   // 存在有效（占通道掩码的）条目 / at least one entry occupies the channel mask
    bUnknownType       : BOOL;                   // 本拍出现未识别的错误类型 / an unrecognised error type appeared in this cycle
    bChOutOfRange      : BOOL;                   // 本拍出现越界通道号 / an out-of-range channel number appeared in this cycle
    bFaultClass        : BOOL;                   // 存在故障类（短路~欠下限）/ a fault class entry exists
    bConfigClass       : BOOL;                   // 存在组态错类条目 / a configuration class entry exists
    bMaintainClass     : BOOL;                   // 存在维护类条目 / a maintenance class entry exists
    nChNo              : UINT;                   // 当前项的通道号（比较用副本）[通道] / channel number copy of the current entry [channel]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_PN_E_SHORT       : WORD := 16#0001;       // 短路 [枚举] / short circuit [enum]
    DL_PN_E_UNDERV      : WORD := 16#0002;       // 欠压 [枚举] / undervoltage [enum]
    DL_PN_E_OVERV       : WORD := 16#0003;       // 过压 [枚举] / overvoltage [enum]
    DL_PN_E_OVERLOAD    : WORD := 16#0004;       // 过载 [枚举] / overload [enum]
    DL_PN_E_OVERTEMP    : WORD := 16#0005;       // 过温 [枚举] / overtemperature [enum]
    DL_PN_E_WIREBREAK   : WORD := 16#0006;       // 断线 [枚举] / wire break [enum]
    DL_PN_E_UPPER       : WORD := 16#0007;       // 超上限 [枚举] / upper limit exceeded [enum]
    DL_PN_E_LOWER       : WORD := 16#0008;       // 欠下限 [枚举] / lower limit violated [enum]
    DL_PN_E_GENERIC     : WORD := 16#0009;       // 通用错误 [枚举] / generic error [enum]
    DL_PN_E_PARAM_MISS  : WORD := 16#000F;       // 参数缺失 [枚举] / parameter missing [enum]
    DL_PN_E_PARAM_FAULT : WORD := 16#0010;       // 参数故障 [枚举] / parameter fault [enum]
    DL_PN_E_MAINT_REQ   : WORD := 16#001E;       // 要求维护 [枚举] / maintenance required [enum]
    DL_PN_E_MAINT_DEM   : WORD := 16#001F;       // 维护要求（另一公开源记为临时故障，本库按维护类保守处理）[枚举] / maintenance demanded, treated conservatively as maintenance [enum]
    DL_PN_E_SYS_MIN     : WORD := 16#8000;       // 系统级码起点 [枚举] / start of the system level codes [enum]
    DL_PN_CH_MAX        : UINT := 32767;         // 通道号上限 [通道] / channel number upper bound [channel]
    DL_PN_ENTRY_MAX     : UINT := 16;            // 诊断条目上限 [项] / diagnostic entry upper bound [entry]
    DL_PN_C_SHORT       : UINT := 0;             // 类别桶 0：短路 [桶] / class bucket zero, short circuit [bucket]
    DL_PN_C_WIRE        : UINT := 1;             // 类别桶 1：断线 [桶] / class bucket one, wire break [bucket]
    DL_PN_C_LOAD        : UINT := 2;             // 类别桶 2：过载 [桶] / class bucket two, overload [bucket]
    DL_PN_C_TEMP        : UINT := 3;             // 类别桶 3：过温 [桶] / class bucket three, overtemperature [bucket]
    DL_PN_C_UPPER       : UINT := 4;             // 类别桶 4：超上限 [桶] / class bucket four, upper limit [bucket]
    DL_PN_C_LOWER       : UINT := 5;             // 类别桶 5：欠下限 [桶] / class bucket five, lower limit [bucket]
    DL_PN_C_CONFIG      : UINT := 6;             // 类别桶 6：组态错/其他 [桶] / class bucket six, configuration or other [bucket]
    DL_PN_C_MAINT       : UINT := 7;             // 类别桶 7：维护类 [桶] / class bucket seven, maintenance [bucket]
    DL_PN_CLASS_CNT     : UINT := 8;             // 类别桶总数 [桶] / number of class buckets [bucket]
    DL_PN_BIT0          : WORD := 16#0001;       // 位图最低位掩码 [位图] / least significant bitmap mask [bitmap]
    DL_PN_ZERO_W        : WORD := 16#0000;       // 位图零常量 [位图] / bitmap zero constant [bitmap]
    DL_PN_ZERO          : UINT := 0;             // 无符号零常量 [无量纲] / unsigned zero constant [dimensionless]
    DL_PN_CNT_MAX       : UINT := 65535;         // 单类计数饱和值 [次] / per class counter saturation value [times]
END_VAR

// 段 1｜输出与中间量预置（位图与八类计数每拍全量重算）/ segment 1, preset outputs and intermediates
uChannelMask := DL_PN_ZERO_W;                 // 位图清零 / clear the bitmap
uFirstChannel := DL_PN_ZERO;                  // 首出通道清零 / clear the first-out channel
uFirstErrType := DL_PN_ZERO_W;                // 首出错误类型清零 / clear the first-out error type
bMaintenanceOnly := FALSE;                    // 预置非纯维护类 / preset not maintenance only
bSystemLevel := FALSE;                        // 预置无系统级码 / preset no system level code
eHealth := eOk;                               // 预置健康（条目为 0 时即为最终结论）/ preset OK, final when no entry exists
eErr := 0;                                    // 预置无错误 / preset no error
bError := FALSE;                              // 预置无故障 / preset no fault
bValid := FALSE;                              // 预置结论不可用 / preset invalid
bAnyEntry := FALSE;                           // 预置无有效条目 / preset no valid entry
bUnknownType := FALSE;                        // 预置无未识别类型 / preset no unrecognised type
bChOutOfRange := FALSE;                       // 预置无越界通道号 / preset no out-of-range channel
bFaultClass := FALSE;                         // 预置无故障类 / preset no fault class
bConfigClass := FALSE;                        // 预置无组态错类 / preset no configuration class
bMaintainClass := FALSE;                      // 预置无维护类 / preset no maintenance class
uBestCh := DL_PN_CH_MAX;                      // 首出候选初值取通道号上限（最大值哨兵）/ the candidate starts at the channel upper bound as a maximum sentinel
wBestErr := DL_PN_ZERO_W;                     // 首出错误类型初值 / initial error type of the first-out candidate
FOR uIdx := 0 TO DL_PN_CLASS_CNT - 1 DO
    auClassCount[uIdx] := DL_PN_ZERO;         // 八个类别桶逐桶清零 / clear each of the eight class buckets
END_FOR

// 段 2｜条目数闸：超上限钳位处理并置故障级（绝不越界读）/ segment 2, entry count gate
uCountEff := uEntryCount;                     // 取入参副本 / copy the input
IF uEntryCount > DL_PN_ENTRY_MAX THEN
    uCountEff := DL_PN_ENTRY_MAX;             // 钳位到 16 / clamp to sixteen
    eErr := 16#0003_0333;                     // 条目数超上限故障码 / entry count over the limit fault id
    bError := TRUE;                           // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
END_IF

// 段 3｜零条目：协议合法（诊断记录长度 0 表示无故障）/ segment 3, zero entries is a legal protocol state
IF uCountEff = DL_PN_ZERO THEN
    eHealth := eOk;                           // 健康出口正常 / health output OK
    bValid := TRUE;                           // 结论可用 / conclusion valid
    RETURN;                                   // 无需聚合 / nothing to aggregate
END_IF

// 段 4｜逐项分类（含 ELSE 兜底走「其他」桶）/ segment 4, per entry classification
FOR uIdx := 0 TO uCountEff - 1 DO
    nChNo := auChannelNo[uIdx];               // 取本项通道号 [通道] / channel number of this entry [channel]
    IF nChNo > DL_PN_CH_MAX THEN
        bChOutOfRange := TRUE;                // 记录通道号越界 / remember the out-of-range channel
        auClassCount[DL_PN_C_CONFIG] := auClassCount[DL_PN_C_CONFIG] + 1; // 计入组态错桶 / count it in the configuration bucket
    ELSIF auErrType[uIdx] >= DL_PN_E_SYS_MIN THEN
        bSystemLevel := TRUE;                 // 系统级码单列，不占通道掩码 / system level codes are listed apart and never occupy the channel mask
    ELSE
        // 段 5｜语义分类：按公开解码表落八类桶 / segment 5, semantic classification by the public decode table
        CASE auErrType[uIdx] OF
            DL_PN_E_SHORT:
                uClass := DL_PN_C_SHORT;      // 短路 / short circuit
                bFaultClass := TRUE;          // 故障类 / fault class
            DL_PN_E_OVERV:
                uClass := DL_PN_C_UPPER;      // 过压按超上限处理 / overvoltage falls into the upper limit class
                bFaultClass := TRUE;          // 故障类 / fault class
            DL_PN_E_UNDERV:
                uClass := DL_PN_C_LOWER;      // 欠压按欠下限处理 / undervoltage falls into the lower limit class
                bFaultClass := TRUE;          // 故障类 / fault class
            DL_PN_E_WIREBREAK:
                uClass := DL_PN_C_WIRE;       // 断线 / wire break
                bFaultClass := TRUE;          // 故障类 / fault class
            DL_PN_E_OVERLOAD:
                uClass := DL_PN_C_LOAD;       // 过载 / overload
                bFaultClass := TRUE;          // 故障类 / fault class
            DL_PN_E_OVERTEMP:
                uClass := DL_PN_C_TEMP;       // 过温 / overtemperature
                bFaultClass := TRUE;          // 故障类 / fault class
            DL_PN_E_UPPER:
                uClass := DL_PN_C_UPPER;      // 超上限 / upper limit exceeded
                bFaultClass := TRUE;          // 故障类 / fault class
            DL_PN_E_LOWER:
                uClass := DL_PN_C_LOWER;      // 欠下限 / lower limit violated
                bFaultClass := TRUE;          // 故障类 / fault class
            DL_PN_E_GENERIC:
                uClass := DL_PN_C_CONFIG;     // 通用错误归其他/组态错桶 / a generic error falls into the other or configuration bucket
                bConfigClass := TRUE;         // 组态错类 / configuration class
            DL_PN_E_PARAM_MISS, DL_PN_E_PARAM_FAULT:
                uClass := DL_PN_C_CONFIG;     // 参数类一律组态错 / parameter issues are a configuration problem
                bConfigClass := TRUE;         // 组态错类 / configuration class
            DL_PN_E_MAINT_REQ, DL_PN_E_MAINT_DEM:
                uClass := DL_PN_C_MAINT;      // 维护类（16#001F 的语义冲突按保守侧归维护）/ maintenance class, the conflicting 16#001F is kept on the conservative side
                bMaintainClass := TRUE;       // 维护类 / maintenance class
        ELSE
            uClass := DL_PN_C_CONFIG;         // 未识别值归其他桶（ELSE 兜底）/ unrecognised values fall into the other bucket
            bConfigClass := TRUE;             // 组态错类 / configuration class
            bUnknownType := TRUE;             // 记录未识别类型 / remember the unrecognised type
        END_CASE

        // 段 6｜占掩码、累加计数、更新首出候选 / segment 6, occupy the mask, count and update the first-out candidate
        uChannelMask := uChannelMask OR SHL(DL_PN_BIT0, uIdx); // 置项位图，uIdx ≤ 15 移位安全 / set the entry bit, the shift never exceeds 15
        bAnyEntry := TRUE;                    // 标记存在有效条目 / flag a valid entry
        IF auClassCount[uClass] < DL_PN_CNT_MAX THEN
            auClassCount[uClass] := auClassCount[uClass] + 1; // 饱和累加，绝不回绕 / saturating increment, never wraps
        END_IF
        IF nChNo < uBestCh THEN
            uBestCh := nChNo;                 // 首出取通道号最小 / the lowest channel number wins the first-out
            wBestErr := auErrType[uIdx];      // 同步首出错误类型 / keep the matching error type
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_FOR

// 段 7｜首出发布（无有效条目则保留 0 与空类型）/ segment 7, publish the first-out
IF bAnyEntry THEN
    uFirstChannel := uBestCh;                 // 首出通道号 / first-out channel number
    uFirstErrType := wBestErr;                // 首出错误类型原值 / raw error type of the first-out entry
END_IF

// 段 8｜健康出口优先级：故障类 > 组态错 > 维护类 > 系统级 > 正常 / segment 8, health output priority
IF bFaultClass THEN
    eHealth := eFailure;                      // 短路/断线/过载/过温/越限：信号不可信 / a channel fault makes the signal untrustworthy
ELSIF bConfigClass THEN
    eHealth := eOutOfSpec;                    // 组态错：测量可能有效但不可依赖 / a configuration fault means the measurement cannot be relied upon
ELSIF bMaintainClass THEN
    eHealth := eMaintenanceReq;               // 维护类：仍有效但已劣化 / maintenance means still valid but degraded
ELSIF bSystemLevel THEN
    eHealth := eOutOfSpec;                    // 系统级：总线/同步问题，另行处理 / a system level issue is handled on a different path
ELSE
    eHealth := eOk;                           // 无任何诊断：正常 / no diagnostics, OK
END_IF

// 段 9｜纯维护类判定（可继续生产，需安排保养）/ segment 9, maintenance only evaluation
bMaintenanceOnly := bMaintainClass AND (NOT bFaultClass) AND (NOT bConfigClass); // 只有维护类条目 / maintenance entries only

// 段 10｜信息级与故障级码汇总（故障级优先，绝不互相覆盖）/ segment 10, code summary
IF bUnknownType AND (NOT bError) THEN
    eErr := 16#0003_016C;                     // 信息级：未识别类型已归其他桶 / info level, unrecognised types were bucketed as other
END_IF
IF bChOutOfRange THEN
    eErr := 16#0003_0334;                     // 通道号越界故障码 / channel number out of range fault id
    bError := TRUE;                           // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
END_IF

// 段 11｜结论可用性（故障态仍输出分类结果供 HMI 诊断，但标记不可用于联锁）/ segment 11, conclusion validity
bValid := TRUE;                               // 分类结论本身可信（故障级只表输入越界）/ the classification itself is trustworthy, faults only mark input overruns
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 半导体静电吸盘吸附电流需三段判据：建立段（上电后电流须在规定时间内落窗）、稳态段（持续落窗，低于下限超确认时间判失吸）、释放段（撤电后电流须归零）；工况边界：阈值上下限可能填反、电压未真正加上时电流自然为零、测量可能断线成 NaN、盘面污染导致电流缓慢上爬、打火产生瞬时尖峰、采样周期越域使确认时间失效。
architecture_thought: 五态状态机（eIdle/eBuild/eSteady/eRelease/eFault）+ CASE/ELSE 兜底，把「电压是否真的加上」作为进入建立段的前置条件，从源头消除「没上电所以没电流」的假失吸。阈值倒置先自动交换并置信息码、交换后仍非法才报故障——现场参数填反是常态，能自愈就不停机。关键防御是把两类失效分开判：失吸是「长时间偏低」，走 TON 确认后置 eFailure 并掉 bAttached；打火是「单拍跳变」，只锁存并出口 eOutOfSpec、按家族裁定不置 bError（能继续吸不等于盘面完好）。输入 NaN 时冻结判定且保持末次 bAttached，绝不把在吸的晶圆判成飞片。两个 TON 的 IN 由状态导出但在主体首部无条件调用，规避按段断输入的高危点。泄漏趋势用前后半窗均值比较，只提示不报故障。
output:
(*
    FB_DL_EscChuckCurrentMonitor —— ESC 静电吸附电流监视
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    分类      : DL_Device / Diagnostics
    前缀      : FB_DL_
    版本      : 1.0.0
    溯源      : 半导体静电吸盘（ESC）自研线，clean-room 自研，无可挖开源源；
                只借公开半导体设备工程语义（吸附/建立/稳态/释放三段，失吸与打火是
                可区分的失效模式）；判据、状态机、错误分级与码位 100% 自有；
                E_DL_Ne107Status 属主为 I_DL_DeviceHealth，本件只引用不重声明（R70）
    平台      : 纯 IEC 61131-3，CODESYS V3.5+ / TwinCAT 3 / InoProShop 通用
    作者      : 道莅代码库 · PLC编程专家（R19）
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    功能说明  : 吸附电压施加后电流须在 tBuildTime 内落进电流窗（建立段）；之后电流须
                持续落窗（稳态段，低于下限超 tConfirmTime 判失吸）；撤电压后电流须归零
                （释放段）。失吸会导致晶圆飞片/破片，打火会烧盘面，两者在电流波形上
                是两种截然不同的特征，本件把「电流长时间偏低」与「瞬时尖峰」分开判。
                核心防御：① 阈值倒置先自动交换并置信息码，交换后仍非法才报故障级；
                ② 电流/电压非有限即故障级并冻结判定，且保持末次 bAttached——
                   把正在吸附的晶圆判成飞片会引发误停机；
                ③ 电压低于吸附门限时不判电流（电压没加上，电流当然为零），回 eIdle；
                ④ 打火只锁存并出口 eOutOfSpec，不置 bError（可继续生产但需检修）；
                ⑤ 泄漏趋势用前后半窗均值比较，只置信息级不置故障。
                职责边界：吸附电压给定与放电归静电电源件，本件只判电流形态。
    错误码    : 16#0003_016E 电流窗上下限倒置已自动交换 / 泄漏趋势上升 / 贴近边界降级运行——信息级，正常防御
                16#0003_016F 预留禁用（信息级，不得挪用）
                16#0003_0336 阈值参数非法或输入非有限——故障级，判定冻结且保持末次吸附结论
                16#0003_0337 建立超时或稳态电流失窗（判失吸）——故障级，eHealth = eFailure
                16#0003_0338 打火尖峰锁存——故障级码位且 eHealth = eOutOfSpec，但按 R13 家族裁定不置 bError
    码位总账  : 16#0003_016E 用 / 16#0003_016F 预留 ｜ 16#0003_0336 用 / 16#0003_0337 用 / 16#0003_0338 用
    状态机    : E_DL_EscState（eIdle / eBuild / eSteady / eRelease / eFault）五态，CASE 含 ELSE 兜底，
                ELSE 回 eFault 并置故障级 0336。
    采样约定  : fbTrigReset / fbBuild / fbLossConfirm 在本体首部无条件刷新——两个定时器的 IN
                由状态导出但调用绝不放进 IF 或 CASE（按段断输入是本族高危点）；
                采样周期越域即故障级，因为趋势窗与确认时间都隐含依赖采样节拍。
    修订记录  : 2026-11-16 v1.0.0 首次入库（R19）
*)

(*
    枚举 : E_DL_EscState —— 静电吸盘工作段（本文件为全库唯一属主）
*)
TYPE E_DL_EscState :
(
    eIdle    := 0,                            // 空闲：未施加吸附电压 / idle, no chuck voltage applied
    eBuild   := 1,                            // 建立段：等待电流落窗 / build phase, waiting for the current to settle
    eSteady  := 2,                            // 稳态段：电流持续落窗 / steady phase, the current stays inside the window
    eRelease := 3,                            // 释放段：等待电流归零 / release phase, waiting for the current to vanish
    eFault   := 4                             // 故障：判定冻结 / fault, evaluation frozen
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_EscChuckCurrentMonitor
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable         : BOOL;                   // 使能，FALSE 撤销所有判定输出 / enable, FALSE withdraws every judgement output
    bReset          : BOOL;                   // 复位，上升沿清故障与趋势 / reset, rising edge clears the faults and the trend
    bChuckOn        : BOOL := FALSE;          // 吸附电压施加命令（上层给定）/ chuck voltage command from the upper layer
    fChuckCurrent   : REAL := 0.0;            // 吸附电流测量值 [uA]，范围 0.0~10000.0 / chuck current measurement [uA], range 0.0~10000.0
    fChuckVoltage   : REAL := 0.0;            // 吸附电压测量值 [V]，范围 0.0~5000.0 / chuck voltage measurement [V], range 0.0~5000.0
    fCurMin         : REAL := 5.0;            // 稳态电流窗下限 [uA]，必须 > 0 / steady window lower bound [uA], must be > 0
    fCurMax         : REAL := 500.0;          // 稳态电流窗上限 [uA]，必须 > fCurMin / steady window upper bound [uA], must be > fCurMin
    fSparkRise      : REAL := 50.0;           // 打火判据：单拍电流跳变量阈值 [uA]，必须 > 0 / spark criterion, per cycle current step [uA], must be > 0
    tBuildTime      : TIME := T#2S;           // 建立段允许时长 [ms]，范围 100~30000 / build phase allowance [ms], range 100~30000
    tConfirmTime    : TIME := T#500MS;        // 失吸确认时间 [ms]，范围 0~10000 / loss confirmation time [ms], range 0~10000
    tSampleTime     : TIME := T#10MS;         // 采样周期 [ms]，范围 1~1000 / sample time [ms], range 1~1000
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bAttached       : BOOL;                   // 判定已吸附（建立成功且稳态落窗）/ attached, build succeeded and the steady current stays in the window
    bSpark          : BOOL;                   // 检出打火尖峰（锁存）/ spark peak detected, latched
    bLeakTrend      : BOOL;                   // 泄漏趋势上升（盘面污染或绝缘退化）/ leakage trend rising, contamination or insulation ageing
    bDegraded       : BOOL;                   // 降级运行（电流在窗内但贴近边界）/ degraded, the current is in the window but close to a bound
    eHealth         : E_DL_Ne107Status;       // 健康出口（引用唯一属主枚举）/ health output referencing the owner enumeration
    uAttachCount    : UDINT;                  // 累计成功吸附次数，饱和 [次] / accumulated successful attaches, saturating [times]
    eErr            : UDINT;                  // 错误码，0=正常 / error id, 0=ok
    bError          : BOOL;                   // 故障标志，eErr 为故障级时 TRUE / error flag, TRUE on fault-level eErr
END_VAR
VAR
    eState          : E_DL_EscState := eIdle; // 状态机当前态 / current state machine state
    fbTrigReset     : R_TRIG;                 // 复位上升沿实例，本体首部无条件刷新 / reset edge instance, refreshed unconditionally
    fbBuild         : TON;                    // 建立段定时器，本体首部无条件刷新 / build phase timer, refreshed unconditionally
    fbLossConfirm   : TON;                    // 失吸确认定时器，本体首部无条件刷新 / loss confirmation timer, refreshed unconditionally
    fPrevCur        : REAL;                   // 上一拍电流，用于打火跳变判据 [uA] / previous current for the spark step test [uA]
    fTrendAcc       : REAL;                   // 后窗电流均值累加 [uA] / second window current mean accumulator [uA]
    fTrendBase      : REAL;                   // 前窗电流均值累加 [uA] / first window current mean accumulator [uA]
    uTrendCnt       : UINT;                   // 趋势取样计数 [拍] / trend sampling counter [scan]
    fCurMinEff      : REAL;                   // 交换与钳位后的电流窗下限 [uA] / effective lower bound after swap and clamp [uA]
    fCurMaxEff      : REAL;                   // 交换与钳位后的电流窗上限 [uA] / effective upper bound after swap and clamp [uA]
    fBandEff        : REAL;                   // 近边界判定带宽 [uA] / near boundary band width [uA]
    fCur            : REAL;                   // 本拍电流副本 [uA] / current copy of this cycle [uA]
    bNonFin         : BOOL;                   // 输入非有限判定标志 / non-finite input flag
    bInWindow       : BOOL;                   // 电流落窗判定 / current inside the window
    bInit           : BOOL := FALSE;          // 首扫标志，初值 FALSE，判据 NOT bInit / first-scan flag, initial FALSE, tested with NOT
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_ESC_CUR_ABS_MAX : REAL := 10000.0;     // 电流绝对上限（三阈值钳位用）[uA] / absolute current bound used by the clamps [uA]
    DL_ESC_VOLT_MIN    : REAL := 100.0;       // 判定「电压确实加上了」的下限 [V] / lower bound proving the voltage is really applied [V]
    DL_ESC_TREND_N     : UINT := 50;          // 趋势取样个数 [拍] / number of trend samples [scan]
    DL_ESC_BAND_RATIO  : REAL := 0.05;        // 近边界判定带宽（相对窗宽）[无量纲] / near boundary band relative to the window [dimensionless]
    DL_ESC_DT_MAX      : TIME := T#1S;        // 采样周期上限 [ms] / sample time upper bound [ms]
    DL_ESC_DT_MIN      : TIME := T#1MS;       // 采样周期下限 [ms] / sample time lower bound [ms]
    DL_FLOAT_EPS       : REAL := 1.0E-6;      // 浮点判等容差 [无量纲] / float equality tolerance [dimensionless]
    DL_ESC_TWO         : REAL := 2.0;         // 二值常量，窗口折半用 [无量纲] / two, used to halve the trend window
    DL_ESC_INF_GUARD   : REAL := 1.0E38;      // 非有限幅值判定阈值 [无量纲] / non-finite magnitude guard [dimensionless]
    DL_ESC_CNT_MAX     : UDINT := 16#FFFF_FFFE; // 吸附计数饱和值 [次] / attach counter saturation value [times]
    DL_ESC_ZERO        : REAL := 0.0;         // 零值常量，避免裸字面量 [无量纲] / zero constant, avoids a bare literal [dimensionless]
END_VAR

// 段 1｜边沿与定时器实例无条件周期刷新（红线：严禁放入条件分支）/ segment 1, unconditional refresh
fbTrigReset(CLK := bReset);
fbBuild(IN := (eState = eBuild) AND bEnable, PT := tBuildTime); // 仅建立段计时 / the timer runs only during the build phase
fbLossConfirm(IN := (eState = eSteady) AND bEnable AND (fChuckCurrent < fCurMin), PT := tConfirmTime); // 仅稳态且电流低于下限时计时 / runs only in the steady phase while the current is below the bound

// 段 2｜输出与错误状态预置（bAttached / bSpark 为保持量，不预置）/ segment 2, preset outputs, the held flags are not preset
eErr := 0;                                    // 预置无错误 / preset no error
bError := FALSE;                              // 预置无故障 / preset no fault
bDegraded := FALSE;                           // 预置未降级 / preset not degraded
bLeakTrend := FALSE;                          // 预置无泄漏趋势 / preset no leakage trend
eHealth := eOk;                               // 预置健康 / preset OK

// 段 3｜首扫初始化（唯一合法范式：初值 FALSE，判据 NOT bInit）/ segment 3, first-scan initialisation
IF NOT bInit THEN
    bAttached := FALSE;                       // 首扫不判吸附 / no attach survives the first scan
    bSpark := FALSE;                          // 首扫不打火锁存 / no spark latch survives the first scan
    uAttachCount := 0;                        // 吸附计数清零 / clear the attach counter
    fPrevCur := fChuckCurrent;                // 电流基准取当前测量，避免首拍误判打火 / seed the current reference to avoid a false spark on the first scan
    uTrendCnt := 0;                          // 趋势计数清零 / clear the trend counter
    fTrendAcc := DL_ESC_ZERO;                 // 后窗累加清零 / clear the second window accumulator
    fTrendBase := DL_ESC_ZERO;                // 前窗累加清零 / clear the first window accumulator
    bInit := TRUE;                            // 首扫只做一次 / first scan runs once only
END_IF

// 段 4｜使能闸：失能撤销全部判定输出 / segment 4, enable gate
IF NOT bEnable THEN
    bAttached := FALSE;                       // 撤销吸附判定 / withdraw the attach judgement
    bDegraded := FALSE;                       // 撤销降级 / withdraw the degraded flag
    bLeakTrend := FALSE;                      // 撤销趋势 / withdraw the trend flag
    eHealth := eUnknown;                      // 失能即未知 / unknown while disabled
    RETURN;                                   // 失能即出口 / disabled is the exit
END_IF

// 段 5｜阈值交换与合法性闸（倒置先交换，交换后仍非法才报故障）/ segment 5, threshold swap and validity
fCurMinEff := fCurMin;                        // 取入参副本 / copy the input
fCurMaxEff := fCurMax;                        // 取入参副本 / copy the input
IF fCurMaxEff < fCurMinEff THEN
    fCurMinEff := fCurMax;                    // 交换：下限取原上限 / swap, the lower bound takes the former upper bound
    fCurMaxEff := fCurMin;                    // 交换：上限取原下限 / swap, the upper bound takes the former lower bound
    eErr := 16#0003_016E;                     // 信息级：上下限倒置已自动交换 / info level, the inverted bounds were swapped
END_IF
fCurMinEff := MIN(MAX(fCurMinEff, DL_ESC_ZERO), DL_ESC_CUR_ABS_MAX); // 下限收敛到物理域 / converge the lower bound into the physical domain
fCurMaxEff := MIN(MAX(fCurMaxEff, DL_ESC_ZERO), DL_ESC_CUR_ABS_MAX); // 上限收敛到物理域 / converge the upper bound into the physical domain
IF (fCurMinEff <= DL_FLOAT_EPS) OR (fCurMaxEff <= fCurMinEff) THEN
    eErr := 16#0003_0336;                     // 阈值非法故障码 / illegal threshold fault id
    bError := TRUE;                           // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
    eState := eFault;                         // 落故障态，判定冻结 / enter the fault state, the evaluation is frozen
    eHealth := eFailure;                      // 阈值不可信即出口失效 / untrustworthy thresholds mean a failed health output
    RETURN;                                   // 故障级提前返回，bAttached 保持末值 / early return, bAttached keeps its last value
END_IF
fBandEff := DL_ESC_BAND_RATIO * (fCurMaxEff - fCurMinEff); // 近边界带宽 [uA] / near boundary band width [uA]

// 段 6｜输入非有限闸：冻结判定并保持末次吸附结论 / segment 6, non-finite gate freezes the judgement
bNonFin := (fChuckCurrent <> fChuckCurrent) OR (fChuckCurrent > DL_ESC_INF_GUARD) OR (fChuckCurrent < -DL_ESC_INF_GUARD)
        OR (fChuckVoltage <> fChuckVoltage) OR (fChuckVoltage > DL_ESC_INF_GUARD) OR (fChuckVoltage < -DL_ESC_INF_GUARD)
        OR (fSparkRise <> fSparkRise);        // 非有限判定 / non-finite detection
IF bNonFin THEN
    eErr := 16#0003_0336;                     // 输入非有限故障码 / non-finite input fault id
    bError := TRUE;                           // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
    eState := eFault;                         // 落故障态 / enter the fault state
    eHealth := eFailure;                      // 测量不可信 / the measurement is untrustworthy
    RETURN;                                   // 保持末次 bAttached，绝不掉成未吸附 / keep the last attach state, never fall back to detached
END_IF

// 段 7｜采样周期闸（趋势窗与确认时间都依赖采样节拍）/ segment 7, sample time gate
IF (tSampleTime < DL_ESC_DT_MIN) OR (tSampleTime > DL_ESC_DT_MAX) THEN
    eErr := 16#0003_0336;                     // 采样周期非法故障码 / illegal sample time fault id
    bError := TRUE;                           // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
    eState := eFault;                         // 落故障态 / enter the fault state
    eHealth := eFailure;                      // 节拍不可信 / the timing is untrustworthy
    RETURN;                                   // 出口 / exit
END_IF

// 段 8｜复位沿清故障与趋势（不改变已建立的吸附结论）/ segment 8, reset clears the faults and the trend
IF fbTrigReset.Q THEN
    bSpark := FALSE;                          // 清打火锁存 / clear the spark latch
    bLeakTrend := FALSE;                      // 清趋势 / clear the trend
    uTrendCnt := 0;                           // 清趋势计数 / clear the trend counter
    fTrendAcc := DL_ESC_ZERO;                 // 清后窗累加 / clear the second window
    fTrendBase := DL_ESC_ZERO;                // 清前窗累加 / clear the first window
    IF eState = eFault THEN
        eState := eIdle;                      // 故障态复位回空闲 / a reset leaves the fault state
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 9｜电流副本与落窗判定 / segment 9, current copy and window test
fCur := fChuckCurrent;                        // 取入参副本 [uA] / copy the input [uA]
bInWindow := (fCur >= fCurMinEff) AND (fCur <= fCurMaxEff); // 落窗判定 / window test

// 段 10｜打火判据（单拍跳变 + 吸附电压在场，只锁存不置 bError）/ segment 10, spark criterion
IF bChuckOn AND (ABS(fCur - fPrevCur) > fSparkRise) THEN
    bSpark := TRUE;                           // 锁存打火 / latch the spark
    eErr := 16#0003_0338;                     // 打火故障级码位，但按家族裁定不置 bError / spark fault id without raising bError
    eHealth := eOutOfSpec;                    // 能继续吸不等于盘面完好 / still holding does not mean the chuck surface is intact
END_IF
fPrevCur := fCur;                             // 记录本拍电流供下一拍比较 / remember this cycle current

// 段 11｜降级判定：电流在窗内但贴近上下边界 / segment 11, degraded evaluation near a bound
IF bInWindow AND ((fCur <= (fCurMinEff + fBandEff)) OR (fCur >= (fCurMaxEff - fBandEff))) THEN
    bDegraded := TRUE;                        // 贴近边界即降级 / closeness to a bound is a degradation
    IF eErr = 0 THEN
        eErr := 16#0003_016E;                 // 信息级：贴近边界降级运行 / info level, running degraded near a bound
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 12｜泄漏趋势（前后半窗均值比较，只置信息级）/ segment 12, leakage trend by half window means
IF eState = eSteady THEN
    IF uTrendCnt < (DL_ESC_TREND_N / 2) THEN
        fTrendBase := fTrendBase + fCur / (UINT_TO_REAL(DL_ESC_TREND_N) / DL_ESC_TWO); // 前窗均值累加 [uA] / accumulate the first window mean [uA]
        uTrendCnt := uTrendCnt + 1;           // 计数加一 / increment the counter
    ELSE
        fTrendAcc := fTrendAcc + fCur / (UINT_TO_REAL(DL_ESC_TREND_N) / DL_ESC_TWO);   // 后窗均值累加 [uA] / accumulate the second window mean [uA]
        uTrendCnt := uTrendCnt + 1;           // 计数加一 / increment the counter
        IF uTrendCnt >= DL_ESC_TREND_N THEN
            IF fTrendAcc > (fTrendBase + DL_ESC_BAND_RATIO * (fCurMaxEff - fCurMinEff)) THEN
                bLeakTrend := TRUE;           // 后窗显著上爬：污染或绝缘退化 / the second window creeps up, contamination or insulation ageing
                eErr := 16#0003_016E;         // 信息级：泄漏趋势上升 / info level, the leakage trend is rising
                eHealth := eMaintenanceReq;   // 需安排检修 / maintenance is required
            END_IF
            uTrendCnt := 0;                   // 窗口滑动复位 / restart the sliding window
            fTrendAcc := DL_ESC_ZERO;         // 后窗累加清零 / clear the second window
            fTrendBase := DL_ESC_ZERO;        // 前窗累加清零 / clear the first window
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 13｜状态机（含 ELSE 兜底）/ segment 13, state machine with ELSE fallback
CASE eState OF
    eIdle:
        bAttached := FALSE;                   // 空闲即未吸附 / idle means detached
        IF bChuckOn AND (fChuckVoltage >= DL_ESC_VOLT_MIN) THEN
            eState := eBuild;                 // 电压确实加上才进入建立段 / enter the build phase only when the voltage is really present
        END_IF

    eBuild:
        IF bInWindow THEN
            eState := eSteady;                // 电流落窗即建立成功 / the current entering the window completes the build
            bAttached := TRUE;                // 判定已吸附 / mark it attached
            IF uAttachCount < DL_ESC_CNT_MAX THEN
                uAttachCount := uAttachCount + 1; // 饱和计数 / saturating count
            END_IF
        ELSIF fbBuild.Q THEN
            eErr := 16#0003_0337;             // 建立超时故障码 / build timeout fault id
            bError := TRUE;                   // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
            eHealth := eFailure;              // 失吸 / the wafer is not held
            eState := eFault;                 // 落故障态 / enter the fault state
            bAttached := FALSE;               // 建立失败即未吸附 / a failed build means detached
        END_IF

    eSteady:
        bAttached := TRUE;                    // 稳态保持吸附 / the steady phase keeps the attach state
        IF NOT bChuckOn THEN
            eState := eRelease;               // 撤电压即进入释放段 / releasing the voltage enters the release phase
        ELSIF fbLossConfirm.Q THEN
            eErr := 16#0003_0337;             // 失吸确认故障码 / loss confirmation fault id
            bError := TRUE;                   // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
            eHealth := eFailure;              // 失吸 / the wafer is lost
            eState := eFault;                 // 落故障态 / enter the fault state
            bAttached := FALSE;               // 确认失吸 / confirmed detached
        END_IF

    eRelease:
        bAttached := FALSE;                   // 释放段即不再算吸附 / the release phase is not an attached state
        IF fCur <= DL_FLOAT_EPS THEN
            eState := eIdle;                  // 电流归零即回空闲 / back to idle once the current vanishes
        ELSIF bChuckOn THEN
            eState := eBuild;                 // 释放过程中重新上电：重新建立 / re-energising during release restarts the build
        END_IF

    eFault:
        bAttached := FALSE;                   // 故障态不判吸附 / no attach judgement in the fault state
        IF NOT bChuckOn THEN
            eState := eIdle;                  // 撤电压允许退出故障态（复位亦可）/ withdrawing the voltage also leaves the fault state
        END_IF

ELSE
    eErr := 16#0003_0336;                     // 故障级：非法状态兜底 / fault level, illegal state fallback
    bError := TRUE;                           // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
    eState := eFault;                         // 回故障态 / fall back to the fault state
    eHealth := eUnknown;                      // 状态不可信 / the state is untrustworthy
END_CASE
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 设备参数写回需完整事务：备份快照→白名单逐项写→读回复核→不一致即回滚；工况边界：项数可能配成 0 或 17、只读项被误下发（写只读项会让整块参数校验失败）、写超时、写进去但没保持住、回滚过程中再次失败、操作员中途中止（中止不等于回滚）、写值为 NaN。归属裁定：写回是设备访问能力，落设备层而非工艺层。
architecture_thought: 七态事务状态机（eIdle/eBackup/eWrite/eVerify/eRollback/eDone/eFault）+ CASE/ELSE 兜底，把「数据完整性」拆成三段可观测的事务相，而不是一段副作用代码。安全侧决策集中在两处：白名单外项绝不写（跳过并计数置信息码），因为写只读项会引发整块参数失效；回滚失败置 033B 锁存并禁止自动重试，因为参数区已不可信必须人工介入。写超时与复核不一致走同一故障码但转同一回滚出口，语义统一。中止沿不置故障也不自动回滚——中止是人为决策，回滚须由调用方再发事务决定。零厂商库红线下物理读写不在本件内，经 bWriteNow + uActiveIdx 驱动上层 IO 层、经 afActual 取回实际值闭环复核。

(*

    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    分类      : DL_Device / DeviceAccess
    前缀      : FB_DL_
    版本      : 1.0.0
    溯源      : 设备参数「读 → 比 → 判」三段流程的下半段划分（写回 / 复核 / 回滚）；
                只借流程骨架的分类事实，示例页面未声明许可，故按最严口径处置：

    平台      : 纯 IEC 61131-3，CODESYS V3.5+ / TwinCAT 3 / InoProShop 通用

                ② 白名单外项（只读）绝不写，跳过并计数——写只读项在多数设备上会被静默

                派单引脚表未含读回通道，实测无法闭环复核，特此补正三个引脚并在收口报告留档。
    错误码    : 16#0003_0170 白名单外项已跳过（uSkipped 非 0）——信息级，正常防御
                16#0003_0171 预留禁用（信息级，不得挪用）
                16#0003_0339 项数越界（不在 1~16）——故障级，事务不启动且不索引数组
                16#0003_033A 写超时 / 读回复核不一致 / 写值非有限——故障级，已转回滚
                16#0003_033B 回滚失败或状态机兜底——故障级，参数区不可信须人工介入（锁存）
    码位总账  : 16#0003_0170 用 / 16#0003_0171 预留 ｜ 16#0003_0339 用 / 16#0003_033A 用 / 16#0003_033B 用

(*
    枚举 : E_DL_ParamWriteState —— 参数写回事务状态（本文件为全库唯一属主）
*)
TYPE E_DL_ParamWriteState :
(
    eIdle     := 0,                           // 空闲：无事务 / idle, no transaction
    eBackup   := 1,                           // 备份：抓取写前快照 / backup, capture the pre-write snapshot
    eWrite    := 2,                           // 写入：逐项白名单写 / write, item by item with the whitelist
    eVerify   := 3,                           // 复核：读回比对全部已写项 / verify, compare every written item
    eRollback := 4,                           // 回滚：恢复备份快照 / rollback, restore the backup snapshot
    eDone     := 5,                           // 完成：写入并复核通过 / done, written and verified
    eFault    := 6                            // 故障：事务失败或参数区不可信 / fault, the transaction failed or the parameter area is untrustworthy
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_DeviceParamWrite
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable         : BOOL;                   // 使能，FALSE 中止并撤 bBusy / enable, FALSE aborts and drops the busy flag
    bExecute        : BOOL;                   // 执行，上升沿启动一次写回事务 / execute, rising edge starts one write transaction
    bAbort          : BOOL;                   // 中止，上升沿中止（不触发回滚）/ abort, rising edge aborts without triggering a rollback
    bReset          : BOOL;                   // 复位，上升沿清故障与 bRollback / reset, rising edge clears the faults and the rollback flag
    auIndex         : ARRAY[0..15] OF UINT;   // 参数索引 [索引]，范围 1~65535 / parameter index [index], range 1~65535
    afWriteValue    : ARRAY[0..15] OF REAL;   // 待写值 [用户单位] / value to write [user unit]
    abWritable      : ARRAY[0..15] OF BOOL;   // 白名单：FALSE = 只读项，禁止写 / whitelist, FALSE means read only and forbidden
    afActual        : ARRAY[0..15] OF REAL;   // 设备实际值（由 IO/驱动层每拍提供，规格补正引脚）[用户单位] / device actual values supplied by the IO layer each cycle, a spec correction pin [user unit]
    uCount          : UINT := 0;              // 有效项数 [项]，范围 1~16 / valid item count [item], range 1~16
    fVerifyTol      : REAL := 0.001;          // 读回值容差 [用户单位]，范围 >= 0（0 = 严格相等，不推荐）/ readback tolerance [user unit], >= 0
    tWriteTimeout   : TIME := T#5S;           // 单项写超时 [ms]，范围 100~60000 / per item write timeout [ms], range 100~60000
    tVerifyTimeout  : TIME := T#5S;           // 读回复核超时 [ms]，范围 100~60000 / verification timeout [ms], range 100~60000
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bBusy           : BOOL;                   // 事务进行中 / transaction in progress
    bDone           : BOOL;                   // 全部写入并复核通过（单周期脉冲）/ everything written and verified, a single-cycle pulse
    bRollback       : BOOL;                   // 发生过回滚（锁存）/ a rollback occurred, latched
    uWritten        : UINT;                   // 实际写入并复核通过的项数 [项] / items written and verified [item]
    uSkipped        : UINT;                   // 因白名单或非法索引被跳过的项数 [项] / items skipped due to the whitelist or an illegal index [item]
    uFailedIdx      : UINT;                   // 首个失败项索引，16#FFFF = 无 [索引] / first failed item index, sentinel 16#FFFF when none [index]
    afReadback      : ARRAY[0..15] OF REAL;   // 复核读回值 [用户单位] / verification readback values [user unit]
    uActiveIdx      : UINT;                   // 当前事务活动项索引（供 IO 层定位，规格补正引脚）[索引] / active item index for the IO layer, a spec correction pin [index]
    bWriteNow       : BOOL;                   // 本拍请求 IO 层执行写入/回写（规格补正引脚）/ request the IO layer to perform the write or the restore in this cycle, a spec correction pin
    eErr            : UDINT;                  // 错误码，0=正常 / error id, 0=ok
    bError          : BOOL;                   // 故障标志，eErr 为故障级时 TRUE / error flag, TRUE on fault-level eErr
END_VAR
VAR
    eState          : E_DL_ParamWriteState := eIdle; // 状态机当前态 / current state machine state
    fbTrigExec      : R_TRIG;                 // 执行沿实例，本体首部无条件刷新 / execute edge instance, refreshed unconditionally
    fbTrigAbort     : R_TRIG;                 // 中止沿实例，本体首部无条件刷新 / abort edge instance, refreshed unconditionally
    fbTrigReset     : R_TRIG;                 // 复位沿实例，本体首部无条件刷新 / reset edge instance, refreshed unconditionally
    fbWrite         : TON;                    // 写超时实例，本体首部无条件刷新 / write timeout instance, refreshed unconditionally
    fbVerify        : TON;                    // 复核超时实例，本体首部无条件刷新 / verification timeout instance, refreshed unconditionally
    uIdx            : UINT;                   // 事务游标 [索引]，范围 0~15 / transaction cursor [index], range 0~15
    uScan           : UINT;                   // 全表扫描游标 [索引] / full table scan cursor [index]
    afBackup        : ARRAY[0..15] OF REAL;   // 写前快照 [用户单位] / pre-write snapshot [user unit]
    bAllOk         : BOOL;                    // 全表一致性判定标志 / full table consistency flag
    bItemOk        : BOOL;                    // 单项一致性判定标志 / single item consistency flag
    bNonFin        : BOOL;                    // 写值非有限判定标志 / non-finite write value flag
    fTolEff        : REAL;                    // 生效容差（负值收敛到 0）[用户单位] / effective tolerance, negatives converge to zero [user unit]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_DPW_ITEM_MAX  : UINT := 16;            // 项数上限 [项] / item count upper bound [item]
    DL_DPW_NONE      : UINT := 16#FFFF;       // 无失败项哨兵 [索引] / no failed item sentinel [index]
    DL_DPW_TMO_MIN   : TIME := T#100MS;       // 超时下限 [ms] / timeout lower bound [ms]
    DL_DPW_TMO_MAX   : TIME := T#60S;         // 超时上限 [ms] / timeout upper bound [ms]
    DL_DPW_CNT_MAX   : UINT := 65535;         // 项数计数饱和值 [项] / item counter saturation value [item]
    DL_FLOAT_EPS     : REAL := 1.0E-6;        // 浮点判等容差 [无量纲] / float equality tolerance [dimensionless]
    DL_DPW_INF_GUARD : REAL := 1.0E38;        // 非有限幅值判定阈值 [无量纲] / non-finite magnitude guard [dimensionless]
    DL_DPW_ZERO      : REAL := 0.0;           // 零值常量，避免裸字面量 [无量纲] / zero constant, avoids a bare literal [dimensionless]
    DL_DPW_CNT_ZERO  : UINT := 0;             // 无符号零常量 [无量纲] / unsigned zero constant [dimensionless]
END_VAR

// 段 1｜边沿与定时器实例无条件周期刷新（红线：严禁放入条件分支）/ segment 1, unconditional refresh
fbTrigExec(CLK := bExecute);
fbTrigAbort(CLK := bAbort);
fbTrigReset(CLK := bReset);
fbWrite(IN := (eState = eWrite) OR (eState = eRollback), PT := tWriteTimeout); // 写入与回写共用写超时 / writing and restoring share the write timeout
fbVerify(IN := (eState = eVerify), PT := tVerifyTimeout);                      // 复核独立超时 / verification has its own timeout

// 段 2｜输出与错误状态预置（bRollback 为保持量，不预置）/ segment 2, preset outputs, the rollback latch is kept
bDone := FALSE;                               // 单周期脉冲先清 / clear the single-cycle pulse first
bWriteNow := FALSE;                           // 写请求先清 / clear the write request
eErr := 0;                                    // 预置无错误 / preset no error
bError := FALSE;                              // 预置无故障 / preset no fault
bBusy := (eState <> eIdle) AND (eState <> eDone) AND (eState <> eFault); // 忙标志由状态导出 / the busy flag derives from the state

// 段 3｜复位沿清故障与回滚锁存 / segment 3, reset clears the faults and the rollback latch
IF fbTrigReset.Q THEN
    bRollback := FALSE;                       // 清回滚锁存 / clear the rollback latch
    uFailedIdx := DL_DPW_NONE;                // 清失败项索引 / clear the failed item index
    IF (eState = eFault) OR (eState = eDone) THEN
        eState := eIdle;                      // 复位允许离开故障与完成态 / a reset leaves the fault and done states
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 4｜中止沿：人为中止不置故障、不自动回滚 / segment 4, abort without a fault and without a rollback
IF fbTrigAbort.Q THEN
    eState := eIdle;                          // 回空闲态 / back to idle
    bBusy := FALSE;                           // 撤忙标志 / drop the busy flag
    bWriteNow := FALSE;                       // 撤写请求 / drop the write request
    RETURN;                                   // 中止即出口 / abort is the exit
END_IF

// 段 5｜使能闸 / segment 5, enable gate
IF NOT bEnable THEN
    eState := eIdle;                          // 回空闲态 / back to idle
    bBusy := FALSE;                           // 撤忙标志 / drop the busy flag
    RETURN;                                   // 失能即出口 / disabled is the exit
END_IF

// 段 6｜容差收敛与参数闸（超时与容差先口径统一）/ segment 6, tolerance and timeout convergence
fTolEff := MAX(fVerifyTol, DL_DPW_ZERO);      // 容差负数收敛到 0（0 = 严格相等，不推荐）/ a negative tolerance converges to zero
IF (tWriteTimeout < DL_DPW_TMO_MIN) OR (tWriteTimeout > DL_DPW_TMO_MAX)
   OR (tVerifyTimeout < DL_DPW_TMO_MIN) OR (tVerifyTimeout > DL_DPW_TMO_MAX) THEN
    eErr := 16#0003_0339;                     // 超时参数越界按项数同码处理（事务不可启动）/ an illegal timeout shares the item count fault id, the transaction cannot start
    bError := TRUE;                           // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
    eState := eFault;                         // 落故障态 / enter the fault state
    bBusy := FALSE;                           // 不忙 / not busy
    RETURN;                                   // 故障级提前返回 / early return on fault
END_IF

// 段 7｜执行沿启动：项数闸在最前，越界绝不索引数组 / segment 7, start edge with the item count gate first
IF fbTrigExec.Q AND ((eState = eIdle) OR (eState = eDone) OR (eState = eFault)) THEN
    IF (uCount < 1) OR (uCount > DL_DPW_ITEM_MAX) THEN
        eErr := 16#0003_0339;                 // 项数越界故障码 / item count out of range fault id
        bError := TRUE;                       // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
        eState := eFault;                     // 落故障态 / enter the fault state
        RETURN;                               // 事务不启动 / the transaction never starts
    END_IF
    uIdx := DL_DPW_CNT_ZERO;                  // 游标归零 / reset the cursor
    uWritten := DL_DPW_CNT_ZERO;              // 已写项数清零 / clear the written count
    uSkipped := DL_DPW_CNT_ZERO;              // 跳过项数清零 / clear the skipped count
    uFailedIdx := DL_DPW_NONE;                // 失败项清哨兵 / reset the failed item to the sentinel
    uActiveIdx := DL_DPW_NONE;                // 活动项清哨兵 / reset the active index to the sentinel
    eState := eBackup;                        // 进入备份相 / enter the backup phase
END_IF

// 段 8｜状态机（含 ELSE 兜底）/ segment 8, state machine with ELSE fallback
CASE eState OF
    eIdle:
        bBusy := FALSE;                       // 空闲不忙 / idle is not busy

    eBackup:
        // 段 9｜抓取写前快照（白名单外项也备份，回滚需要完整镜像）/ segment 9, capture the pre-write snapshot
        FOR uScan := 0 TO uCount - 1 DO
            afBackup[uScan] := afActual[uScan]; // 快照取设备实际值 / the snapshot takes the device actual value
            afReadback[uScan] := afActual[uScan]; // 读回镜像同步初始化 / initialise the readback mirror
        END_FOR
        eState := eWrite;                     // 备份完成进入写入相 / the backup is complete, enter the write phase

    eWrite:
        // 段 10｜逐项白名单写：只读项绝不写，跳过并计数 / segment 10, whitelisted writes only
        IF uIdx >= uCount THEN
            eState := eVerify;                // 全部处理完进入复核相 / everything processed, enter the verification phase
        ELSE
            bNonFin := (afWriteValue[uIdx] <> afWriteValue[uIdx])
                    OR (afWriteValue[uIdx] > DL_DPW_INF_GUARD)
                    OR (afWriteValue[uIdx] < -DL_DPW_INF_GUARD); // 写值非有限判定 / non-finite write value detection
            IF bNonFin THEN
                eErr := 16#0003_033A;         // 写值非有限，转回滚 / a non-finite value triggers the rollback
                bError := TRUE;               // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
                uFailedIdx := uIdx;           // 记录失败项 / record the failed item
                eState := eRollback;          // 转回滚相 / enter the rollback phase
            ELSIF (NOT abWritable[uIdx]) OR (auIndex[uIdx] < 1) THEN
                IF uSkipped < DL_DPW_CNT_MAX THEN
                    uSkipped := uSkipped + 1; // 白名单外或索引非法：饱和计数跳过 / outside the whitelist or an illegal index, saturating skip count
                END_IF
                eErr := 16#0003_0170;         // 信息级：白名单外项已跳过 / info level, the item was skipped
                uIdx := uIdx + 1;             // 游标前进 / advance the cursor
            ELSE
                uActiveIdx := uIdx;           // 发布活动项 / publish the active item
                bWriteNow := TRUE;            // 请求 IO 层执行写入 / request the IO layer to write
                afReadback[uIdx] := afActual[uIdx]; // 同步读回镜像 / keep the readback mirror in step
                bItemOk := ABS(afActual[uIdx] - afWriteValue[uIdx]) <= fTolEff; // 单项落值判定 / single item settled test
                IF bItemOk THEN
                    uWritten := uWritten + 1; // 落值即计入已写 / a settled value counts as written
                    uIdx := uIdx + 1;         // 游标前进（超时按整个写入相计，避免在 CASE 内调用实例）/ advance the cursor, the timeout covers the whole write phase so no instance call lives inside CASE
                ELSIF fbWrite.Q THEN
                    eErr := 16#0003_033A;     // 写超时，转回滚 / a write timeout triggers the rollback
                    bError := TRUE;           // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
                    uFailedIdx := uIdx;       // 记录失败项 / record the failed item
                    eState := eRollback;      // 转回滚相 / enter the rollback phase
                END_IF
            END_IF
        END_IF

    eVerify:
        // 段 11｜全表复核：读回值与目标值逐项比对（只读项不参与）/ segment 11, full table verification
        bAllOk := TRUE;                       // 先假设一致 / assume consistency first
        FOR uScan := 0 TO uCount - 1 DO
            IF abWritable[uScan] AND (auIndex[uScan] >= 1) THEN
                afReadback[uScan] := afActual[uScan]; // 抓取复核读回值 / capture the verification readback
                IF ABS(afActual[uScan] - afWriteValue[uScan]) > fTolEff THEN
                    bAllOk := FALSE;          // 任一项不一致即失败 / a single mismatch fails the verification
                    uFailedIdx := uScan;      // 记录首个不一致项 / record the first mismatching item
                END_IF
            END_IF
        END_FOR
        IF bAllOk THEN
            eState := eDone;                  // 复核通过 / verification passed
            bDone := TRUE;                    // 单周期完成脉冲 / single-cycle done pulse
            bBusy := FALSE;                   // 事务结束 / the transaction finished
        ELSIF fbVerify.Q THEN
            eErr := 16#0003_033A;             // 复核不一致且超时，转回滚 / verification failed within its timeout, roll back
            bError := TRUE;                   // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
            eState := eRollback;              // 转回滚相 / enter the rollback phase
        ELSE
            bBusy := TRUE;                    // 复核进行中 / verification in progress
        END_IF

    eRollback:
        // 段 12｜回滚：把备份快照逐项写回，全表恢复才算出清 / segment 12, restore the snapshot
        bAllOk := TRUE;                       // 先假设已恢复 / assume restored first
        bWriteNow := TRUE;                    // 持续请求 IO 层回写 / keep requesting the restore
        FOR uScan := 0 TO uCount - 1 DO
            IF abWritable[uScan] AND (auIndex[uScan] >= 1) THEN
                uActiveIdx := uScan;          // 回写活动项 / the item being restored
                IF ABS(afActual[uScan] - afBackup[uScan]) > fTolEff THEN
                    bAllOk := FALSE;          // 尚未恢复 / not yet restored
                    uFailedIdx := uScan;      // 记录回滚受阻项 / record the blocked item
                END_IF
                afReadback[uScan] := afActual[uScan]; // 同步读回 / keep the readback in step
            END_IF
        END_FOR
        IF bAllOk THEN
            bRollback := TRUE;                // 回滚完成，锁存 / the rollback completed, latch it
            eErr := 16#0003_033A;             // 事务失败（已回滚）故障码 / the transaction failed and was rolled back
            bError := TRUE;                   // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
            eState := eFault;                 // 进故障态待人工确认 / enter the fault state pending manual acknowledgement
            bWriteNow := FALSE;               // 撤回写请求 / drop the restore request
        ELSIF fbWrite.Q THEN
            bRollback := TRUE;                // 回滚失败同样锁存 / a failed rollback is latched as well
            eErr := 16#0003_033B;             // 参数区不可信，禁止自动重试 / the parameter area is untrustworthy, no automatic retry
            bError := TRUE;                   // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
            eState := eFault;                 // 进故障态锁存 / latch the fault state
            bWriteNow := FALSE;               // 撤回写请求 / drop the restore request
        END_IF

    eDone:
        bBusy := FALSE;                       // 完成态不忙 / the done state is not busy
        bWriteNow := FALSE;                   // 撤写请求 / drop the write request

    eFault:
        bBusy := FALSE;                       // 故障态不忙 / the fault state is not busy
        bWriteNow := FALSE;                   // 撤写请求 / drop the write request

ELSE
    eErr := 16#0003_033B;                     // 故障级：非法状态兜底 / fault level, illegal state fallback
    bError := TRUE;                           // 置故障标志 / raise the error flag
    eState := eFault;                         // 回故障态 / fall back to the fault state
    bWriteNow := FALSE;                       // 撤写请求，绝不留在写入状态 / drop the write request, never stay in a writing state
END_CASE
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 外部编码器原始 32 位计数需折算成工程量：分辨率、传动比、导程三段折算，且多圈坐标必须做回绕展开，否则每转一圈坐标就跳变；工况边界：每转计数或导程可能为 0（除零）、传动比分子分母可能为 0、计数器位宽 8~32 可组态、首拍无历史基准、折算结果可能溢出成非有限、采样周期为 0 时速度不可算。
architecture_thought: 纯折算件（R6 N/A），把最易错的一行做成注释级警戒：回绕判据必须先做 DINT 减法再升位 LINT（R68），否则 32 位回绕会变成巨大正数。半量程/全量程全部用 LINT 承载并只对移位量 ≤31 调用 SHL，从结构上避开 2^31 在 DINT 域溢出与 SHL 超位宽两条跨平台雷区。首扫与复位都只「装基准」不产生回绕事件，避免开机第一拍误报。折算链上游用两个前置闸（分辨率/导程、传动比）保证所有分母非零，位置非有限时保持末次有效值而不是输出 0——掉成 0 会被上层当成真实回零。位宽越域只钳位并提示，因为钳位后回绕判据仍可用，不必停功能。速度仅作监视，采样周期非法时置 0 而不做除零。
