(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_FillState（归属 DL_Process，灌装状态机状态）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_FillState :
(
    eIdle   := 0,    // 就绪待启动 / Idle, waiting for a start
    eCoarse := 10,   // 粗灌相（快灌阀开）/ Coarse phase, fast valve open
    eFine   := 20,   // 细灌相（细灌阀开）/ Fine phase, fine valve open
    eSettle := 30,   // 稳定窗（双阀关，等称重稳定）/ Settle window, both valves closed
    eDone   := 40,   // 完成（提前量已更新）/ Done, advance updated
    eFault  := 99    // 故障兜底态（双阀关）/ Fault fallback, both valves closed
);
END_TYPE

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_FillErr（归属 DL_Process，与 FB_DL_FillWeightCtrl 同文件）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_FillErr :
(
    eReady      := 16#0005_0412,   // 就绪 / Ready
    eCoarseRun  := 16#0005_0413,   // 粗灌中 / Coarse filling
    eFineRun    := 16#0005_0414,   // 细灌中 / Fine filling
    eFineTmo    := 16#0005_0415,   // 故障级：细灌超时中止（或重量信号无效）/ Fault: fine timeout or invalid weight
    eFillDone   := 16#0005_0416    // 完成，提前量已更新 / Done, advance updated
);
END_TYPE

(*==============================================================================
 * 功能块: FB_DL_FillWeightCtrl
 * 调用约定: 每个扫描周期无条件调用一次。
 *============================================================================*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_FillWeightCtrl
VAR_INPUT
    fGrossWeight_g : REAL;             // 毛重（称重传感器读数）[克] / Gross weight [g]
    fTargetNet_g   : REAL;             // 目标净重 [克]，有效域 1~50000 / Target net weight [g]
    fCoarsePct     : REAL := 85.0;     // 快灌切换点 [百分数]，有效域 50~95 / Coarse switch point [percent]
    tFineMax       : TIME := T#10S;    // 细灌超时 [秒] / Fine-fill timeout [s]
    tSettle        : TIME := T#2S;     // 稳定窗时长 [秒] / Settle window [s]
    bStart         : BOOL;             // 启动灌装（上升沿，同时去皮）/ Start filling, rising edge with tare
    bReset         : BOOL;             // 故障复位（上升沿）/ Fault reset, rising edge
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bCoarseValve   : BOOL;             // 快灌阀指令 / Coarse valve command
    bFineValve     : BOOL;             // 细灌阀指令 / Fine valve command
    bFillDone      : BOOL;             // 灌装完成（单拍脉冲）/ Fill done, single-scan pulse
    fAdvance_g     : REAL;             // 当前落差提前量（学习值）[克] / Current in-flight advance, learned [g]
    fNetWeight_g   : REAL;             // 本罐净重实测 [克] / Measured net weight of this container [g]
    eErr           : E_DL_FillErr;     // 错误码 / Error code
    eState         : E_DL_FillState;   // 灌装状态机当前状态 / Fill state
END_VAR
VAR
    fbStartTrig    : R_TRIG;           // 启动沿实例（无条件调用）/ Start edge instance
    fbResetTrig    : R_TRIG;           // 复位沿实例（无条件调用）/ Reset edge instance
    fbTonFine      : TON;              // 细灌超时定时器（无条件调用）/ Fine timeout timer
    fbTonSettle    : TON;              // 稳定窗定时器（无条件调用）/ Settle timer
    fTareRef_g     : REAL;             // 去皮基准毛重 [克] / Tare reference gross weight [g]
    fTargetUse     : REAL;             // 生效目标净重（钳位后）[克] / Effective target [g]
    fCoarseUse     : REAL;             // 生效快灌切换点（钳位后）[百分数] / Effective coarse point [percent]
    fAdvUse        : REAL;             // 生效提前量（限幅后）[克] / Effective advance [g]
    fCoarseGate_g  : REAL;             // 快灌转细灌毛重门限 [克] / Coarse-to-fine gross threshold [g]
    fStopGate_g    : REAL;             // 双阀关断毛重门限 [克] / Valve-close gross threshold [g]
    fErr_g         : REAL;             // 本罐净重误差 [克] / Net weight error [g]
    bWeightOk      : BOOL;             // 重量信号有效判据 / Weight validity predicate
    bNonFin        : BOOL;             // 非有限输入汇总标志 / Non-finite input aggregate flag
    bOverGross     : BOOL;             // 净重超双倍目标（容器已超重，v1.0.1）/ Net above twice target, over-weight container
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_FILL_TGT_MIN   : REAL := 1.0;      // 目标净重下限 [克] / Target lower bound [g]
    DL_FILL_TGT_MAX   : REAL := 50000.0;  // 目标净重上限 [克] / Target upper bound [g]
    DL_FILL_COARSE_MIN: REAL := 50.0;     // 快灌切换点下限 [百分数] / Coarse point lower bound [percent]
    DL_FILL_COARSE_MAX: REAL := 95.0;     // 快灌切换点上限 [百分数] / Coarse point upper bound [percent]
    DL_FILL_ADV_MAX_K : REAL := 0.2;      // 提前量上限系数（目标 x 0.2）/ Advance upper ratio, target x 0.2
    DL_FILL_LAMBDA    : REAL := 0.3;      // 指数学习系数 lambda（0.3：约 3 罐收敛，抗单罐噪声）/ Learning factor lambda
    DL_FILL_AVG_KEEP  : REAL := 0.7;      // 历史权重（1 - lambda，两常数相加为 1）/ History weight, one minus lambda
    DL_FILL_PCT       : REAL := 100.0;    // 百分数系数 [百分数] / Percent factor
    DL_FILL_INF_MAX   : REAL := 1.0E30;   // 非有限值判定幅值上限 / Magnitude bound for finite-value check
    DL_FILL_ZERO      : REAL := 0.0;      // 零值常量，避免裸字面量 / Zero constant
    DL_FILL_GROSS_K   : REAL := 2.0;      // 超重判据系数（净重 > 目标 x 2 判容器已超重）/ Over-weight ratio, net above twice target
END_VAR

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 1｜沿检测/TON 实例每周期无条件调用（仅输入条件化）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fbStartTrig(CLK := bStart);                           // 启动沿检测无条件刷新 / start edge refreshed unconditionally
fbResetTrig(CLK := bReset);                           // 复位沿检测无条件刷新 / reset edge refreshed unconditionally
fbTonFine(IN := (eState = E_DL_FillState.eFine), PT := tFineMax);        // 细灌超时计时 / fine timeout timing
fbTonSettle(IN := (eState = E_DL_FillState.eSettle), PT := tSettle);     // 稳定窗计时 / settle timing

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 2｜非有限值闸：毛重/目标/比例 NaN 或溢出 → 故障兜底（双阀关，冻结）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bNonFin := (fGrossWeight_g <> fGrossWeight_g) OR (ABS(fGrossWeight_g) > DL_FILL_INF_MAX)
        OR (fTargetNet_g   <> fTargetNet_g)   OR (ABS(fTargetNet_g)   > DL_FILL_INF_MAX);
IF bNonFin THEN
    eState := E_DL_FillState.eFault;                  // 进故障兜底态 / enter fault fallback
    eErr := E_DL_FillErr.eFineTmo;                    // 故障级：重量信号无效（与细灌超时共用，反证句：双阀关+中止输出相同）/ fault: invalid weight
    bCoarseValve := FALSE;                            // 双阀关（安全侧）/ both valves closed
    bFineValve := FALSE;                              // 双阀关（安全侧）/ both valves closed
    bFillDone := FALSE;                               // 完成撤 / done dropped
    RETURN;
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 3｜参数钳位：目标域、快灌比例域、提前量双向限幅
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fTargetUse := fTargetNet_g;                           // 目标工作副本 / target working copy
IF (fTargetUse < DL_FILL_TGT_MIN) OR (fTargetUse > DL_FILL_TGT_MAX) THEN
    eState := E_DL_FillState.eFault;                  // 目标出域：拒绝启动 / out-of-domain target refuses to start
    eErr := E_DL_FillErr.eFineTmo;                    // 故障级：目标非法并入中止段（反证句：双阀关+拒绝）/ fault: illegal target
    bCoarseValve := FALSE;                            // 双阀关 / both valves closed
    bFineValve := FALSE;                              // 双阀关 / both valves closed
    RETURN;
END_IF
fCoarseUse := fCoarsePct;                             // 比例工作副本 / ratio working copy
IF fCoarseUse < DL_FILL_COARSE_MIN THEN
    fCoarseUse := DL_FILL_COARSE_MIN;                 // 比例下限钳位 / ratio floored
ELSIF fCoarseUse > DL_FILL_COARSE_MAX THEN
    fCoarseUse := DL_FILL_COARSE_MAX;                 // 比例上限钳位 / ratio capped
END_IF
fAdvUse := fAdvance_g;                                // 提前量工作副本 / advance working copy
IF (fAdvUse <> fAdvUse) OR (fAdvUse < DL_FILL_ZERO) THEN
    fAdvUse := DL_FILL_ZERO;                          // 提前量非有限或负：归零 / non-finite or negative advance zeroed
ELSIF fAdvUse > fTargetUse * DL_FILL_ADV_MAX_K THEN
    fAdvUse := fTargetUse * DL_FILL_ADV_MAX_K;        // 提前量上限限幅（目标 x 0.2）/ advance capped
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 4｜门限换算：快灌门限 = 目标 x 快灌比 - 提前量；关断门限 = 目标 - 提前量
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fCoarseGate_g := fTargetUse * fCoarseUse / DL_FILL_PCT - fAdvUse;   // 快灌转细灌门限（以净重口径，加去皮后为毛重）/ coarse gate [g]
fStopGate_g := fTargetUse - fAdvUse;                                // 双阀关断门限（净重口径）/ stop gate [g]
IF fCoarseGate_g < DL_FILL_ZERO THEN
    fCoarseGate_g := DL_FILL_ZERO;                    // 门限下限防护（小目标时提前量大）/ gate floor guard
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 5｜重量有效性：毛重不得低于去皮基准（负净重为无效）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bOverGross := (fGrossWeight_g - fTareRef_g) > (fTargetUse * DL_FILL_GROSS_K);   // 超重判据：净重超目标双倍 [克] / over-weight predicate
bWeightOk := (fGrossWeight_g >= fTareRef_g) AND (NOT bOverGross);   // 净重非负且未超重 / net non-negative and not over-weight
IF bOverGross THEN
    eState := E_DL_FillState.eFault;                  // v1.0.1：容器已超重，立即中止（原实现转细灌继续加注）/ abort at once
    eErr := E_DL_FillErr.eFineTmo;                    // 故障级（中止段共用，反证句：双阀关+无完成）/ fault, abort band
    bCoarseValve := FALSE;                            // 双阀关（安全侧）/ both valves closed
    bFineValve := FALSE;                              // 双阀关（安全侧）/ both valves closed
    bFillDone := FALSE;                               // 完成撤 / done dropped
ELSIF (NOT bWeightOk) AND (eState = E_DL_FillState.eCoarse) THEN
    eState := E_DL_FillState.eFine;                   // 粗段信号无效（净重为负）：保守转细灌降流量 / invalid in coarse: move to fine
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 6｜启动沿：去皮并进粗灌相（提前量不在此处改写）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bFillDone := FALSE;                                   // 完成脉冲逐拍先清 / done pulse cleared first
IF fbStartTrig.Q THEN
    fTareRef_g := fGrossWeight_g;                     // 去皮：毛重基准锁存 [克] / tare captured [g]
    fNetWeight_g := DL_FILL_ZERO;                     // 净重显示清零 / net display cleared
    bCoarseValve := TRUE;                             // 快灌阀开 / coarse valve open
    bFineValve := FALSE;                              // 细灌阀关 / fine valve closed
    eState := E_DL_FillState.eCoarse;                 // 进粗灌相 / enter coarse phase
END_IF
IF fbResetTrig.Q THEN
    eState := E_DL_FillState.eIdle;                   // 复位回就绪 / reset to idle
    bCoarseValve := FALSE;                            // 双阀关 / both valves closed
    bFineValve := FALSE;                              // 双阀关 / both valves closed
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 7｜灌装状态机：CASE 含 ELSE 兜底（ELSE → 双阀关安全态）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
CASE eState OF

    E_DL_FillState.eIdle:
        bCoarseValve := FALSE;                        // 就绪态双阀关 / both valves closed in idle
        bFineValve := FALSE;                          // 就绪态双阀关 / both valves closed in idle
        fNetWeight_g := fGrossWeight_g - fTareRef_g;  // 净重实时显示 [克] / live net display [g]
        eErr := E_DL_FillErr.eReady;                  // 码 0412 / code ready

    E_DL_FillState.eCoarse:
        bCoarseValve := TRUE;                         // 快灌阀保持开 / coarse valve held open
        bFineValve := FALSE;                          // 细灌阀保持关 / fine valve held closed
        fNetWeight_g := fGrossWeight_g - fTareRef_g;  // 净重实时显示 [克] / live net display [g]
        eErr := E_DL_FillErr.eCoarseRun;              // 码 0413 / code coarse
        IF bWeightOk AND (fNetWeight_g >= fCoarseGate_g) THEN
            bCoarseValve := FALSE;                    // 先关快灌阀（互斥切换）/ close coarse valve first, exclusive switching
            bFineValve := TRUE;                       // 再开细灌阀 / then open fine valve
            eState := E_DL_FillState.eFine;           // 进细灌相 / enter fine phase
        END_IF

    E_DL_FillState.eFine:
        bCoarseValve := FALSE;                        // 细灌相快灌阀必须关（互斥）/ coarse valve must be closed
        bFineValve := TRUE;                           // 细灌阀保持开 / fine valve held open
        fNetWeight_g := fGrossWeight_g - fTareRef_g;  // 净重实时显示 [克] / live net display [g]
        eErr := E_DL_FillErr.eFineRun;                // 码 0414 / code fine
        IF bWeightOk AND (fNetWeight_g >= fStopGate_g) THEN
            bFineValve := FALSE;                      // 达关断门限：细灌阀关 / reach stop gate: close fine valve
            eState := E_DL_FillState.eSettle;         // 进稳定窗 / enter settle window
        ELSIF fbTonFine.Q THEN
            eState := E_DL_FillState.eFault;          // 细灌超时：中止进故障态 / fine timeout: abort to fault
            eErr := E_DL_FillErr.eFineTmo;            // 故障级：细灌超时 / fault: fine timeout
        END_IF

    E_DL_FillState.eSettle:
        bCoarseValve := FALSE;                        // 稳定窗双阀关 / both valves closed in settle
        bFineValve := FALSE;                          // 稳定窗双阀关 / both valves closed in settle
        fNetWeight_g := fGrossWeight_g - fTareRef_g;  // 净重实时显示 [克] / live net display [g]
        IF fbTonSettle.Q THEN
            fErr_g := fNetWeight_g - fTargetUse;      // 本罐误差 = 实测净重 - 目标 [克] / net weight error [g]
            fAdvUse := fAdvUse * (DL_FILL_AVG_KEEP) + fErr_g * DL_FILL_LAMBDA;   // 指数学习（仅完成相执行）/ exponential learning, done phase only
            IF fAdvUse < DL_FILL_ZERO THEN
                fAdvUse := DL_FILL_ZERO;              // 学习值下限限幅 / learned value floored
            ELSIF fAdvUse > fTargetUse * DL_FILL_ADV_MAX_K THEN
                fAdvUse := fTargetUse * DL_FILL_ADV_MAX_K;   // 学习值上限限幅 / learned value capped
            END_IF
            fAdvance_g := fAdvUse;                    // 提前量对外更新 [克] / advance exported [g]
            bFillDone := TRUE;                        // 完成单拍脉冲 / single-scan done pulse
            eErr := E_DL_FillErr.eFillDone;           // 码 0416 / code done
            eState := E_DL_FillState.eDone;           // 进完成相 / enter done phase
        ELSE
            eErr := E_DL_FillErr.eFineRun;            // 稳定窗内沿挂细灌码（流程未结束）/ keep fine code while settling
        END_IF

    E_DL_FillState.eDone:
        bCoarseValve := FALSE;                        // 完成态双阀关 / both valves closed when done
        bFineValve := FALSE;                          // 完成态双阀关 / both valves closed when done
        IF fbStartTrig.Q THEN
            eErr := E_DL_FillErr.eReady;              // 新罐启动沿已由段 6 处理 / next start handled in section 6
        END_IF

    E_DL_FillState.eFault:
        bCoarseValve := FALSE;                        // 故障态双阀关（安全侧）/ both valves closed in fault
        bFineValve := FALSE;                          // 故障态双阀关（安全侧）/ both valves closed in fault
        bFillDone := FALSE;                           // 故障态完成撤 / done dropped in fault

    ELSE
        eState := E_DL_FillState.eFault;              // 非法状态兜底 / illegal-state fallback
        eErr := E_DL_FillErr.eFineTmo;                // 兜底码（中止段，反证句：双阀关+无完成）/ fallback code
        bCoarseValve := FALSE;                        // 双阀关 / both valves closed
        bFineValve := FALSE;                          // 双阀关 / both valves closed
        bFillDone := FALSE;                           // 完成撤 / done dropped

END_CASE

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 8｜两阀互斥校验（后置防线）：同拍双开一律保守降为双关并进故障态
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF bCoarseValve AND bFineValve THEN
    bCoarseValve := FALSE;                            // 互斥：快灌阀关 / exclusivity: coarse closed
    bFineValve := FALSE;                              // 互斥：细灌阀关 / exclusivity: fine closed
    eState := E_DL_FillState.eFault;                  // 双开为非法组合，进故障态 / both-open is illegal, enter fault
    eErr := E_DL_FillErr.eFineTmo;                    // 故障码（中止段，反证句：双阀关+中止）/ fault code, abort band
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 立式制袋机每袋靠编码器计长，色标上升沿与基准比对求偏差后修正下一袋袋长，修正幅值限 5 毫米，袋长设定 300 毫米级。色标在膜接缝处会短暂丢标，连续 3 袋无标应退化为定长并显式报警。异常工况是每袋脉冲数配成 0、色标抖动致单袋重复触发、修正连续贴限；不得让修正发散或相位跳变。
architecture_thought: 把袋长控制看成两个独立量合并：长度偏差与切刀相位。长度偏差在每袋色标沿采样一次，限幅后叠加到下一袋目标，限幅的存在是让单次误触发只造成 5 毫米偏差而非整袋报废。相位不做独立积分器，而用累计计长对本袋脉冲取正余数，余数落对齐窗即就绪；取模一律委托 FC_DL_ModPos，因负域余数各平台行为不一。丢标不静默：连续计数达阈值即置退化标志并保持定长输出。

(*==============================================================================

 * 所属子库 (Sublibrary) : DL_Process
 * 当前版本 (Version)    : 1.0.0
 * 兼容性 (Platform)     : CODESYS 3.5 / TwinCAT 3 / 汇川 InoProShop / Machine Expert
 *                         仅依赖纯 IEC 61131-3 标准元素，零厂商方言
 * 功能描述 (Function)   : 立式制袋袋长控制：编码器脉冲计长 → 色标上升沿比对基准

 *                         无色标 → bMarkLost 退化为定长（显式置位，不静默）；切刀
 *                         相位 = 计长对每袋脉冲取正余数，落对齐窗即就绪。
 *                         色标去抖 TON 5 ms 无条件刷新；模运算委托防负余数。
 * 溯源 (Origin)         : 道莅 clean-room 防御性实现
 * 本文件内含 (Contains) : TYPE E_DL_VffsErr / FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_VffsBagLength

 *                         枚举成员全部显式赋值 ｜ TON/R_TRIG 每周期无条件调用 ｜
 *                         退化态显式输出（不清零显示）｜ CASE 含 ELSE 兜底
 * 错误码表 (Codes)      : 16#0005_0417 同步运行
 *                         16#0005_0418 信息级 色标丢失（定长退化）
 *                         16#0005_0419 信息级 修正饱和（连续贴限）
 *                         16#0005_041A 故障级 编码器组态非法（每袋脉冲为 0）
 *                         16#0005_041B 信息级 相位对齐完成
 * 修订历史 (Revision)   : 2026-11-17  v1.0.0  首版入库 · R27 · 阶段三批 3
 * 验收向量 (Acceptance) : 每袋脉冲 1000、设定 300 mm：实测 1010 脉冲 → 偏差 +3 mm
 *                         → 下袋长 297 mm（限幅 5 mm 内）；连续 3 袋无标 → 0418 定长；
 *                         每袋脉冲 0 → 041A 拒绝

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_VffsErr（归属 DL_Process，与 FB_DL_VffsBagLength 同文件）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_VffsErr :
(
    eSyncRun    := 16#0005_0417,   // 同步运行 / Synchronised running
    eMarkLost   := 16#0005_0418,   // 信息级：色标丢失，定长退化 / Info: mark lost, fixed-length degradation
    eCorrSat    := 16#0005_0419,   // 信息级：修正饱和（连续贴限）/ Info: correction saturated
    eEncBad     := 16#0005_041A,   // 故障级：编码器组态非法 / Fault: illegal encoder configuration
    ePhaseOk    := 16#0005_041B    // 信息级：相位对齐完成 / Info: cut phase aligned
);
END_TYPE

(*==============================================================================
 * 功能块: FB_DL_VffsBagLength
 * 调用约定: 每个扫描周期无条件调用一次；bEncPulse 必须注入真实编码器脉冲。
 *============================================================================*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_VffsBagLength
VAR_INPUT
    bMarkDetect   : BOOL;              // 色标传感器输入 / Mark sensor input
    bEncPulse     : BOOL;              // 编码器脉冲输入（计长源）/ Encoder pulse input, length source
    fBagLenSet_mm : REAL;              // 设定袋长 [毫米]，有效域 50~2000 / Set bag length [mm]
    uEncPpr       : UINT;              // 编码器每袋脉冲 [脉冲每袋]，须 > 0 / Encoder pulses per bag, must be > 0
    fCorrLimit_mm : REAL := 5.0;       // 修正限幅 [毫米]，默认 5 / Correction limit [mm]
    tMarkDeb      : TIME := T#5MS;     // 色标去抖时间 [毫秒]，默认 5 / Mark debounce time [ms]
    bReset        : BOOL;              // 复位（清丢失标记与修正）/ Reset, clears lost flag and correction
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fBagLenAct_mm : REAL;              // 实际袋长（修正后，用于下一袋）[毫米] / Actual bag length, corrected [mm]
    fCorr_mm      : REAL;              // 当前修正量 [毫米] / Current correction [mm]
    bMarkLost     : BOOL;              // 色标丢失（定长退化）/ Mark lost, fixed-length degradation
    bCutPhaseOk   : BOOL;              // 切刀相位就绪 / Cut phase ready
    nEncCnt       : DINT;              // 当前袋内脉冲计数 [脉冲] / Pulse count in the current bag [pulses]
    nPhaseDiag    : DINT;              // 相位正余数诊断 [脉冲] / Positive-remainder phase diagnostic [pulses]
    eErr          : E_DL_VffsErr;      // 错误码 / Error code
END_VAR
VAR
    fbEncTrig     : R_TRIG;            // 编码器脉冲沿实例（无条件调用）/ Encoder pulse edge instance
    fbMarkTrig    : R_TRIG;            // 去抖后色标沿实例（无条件调用）/ Debounced mark edge instance
    fbResetTrig   : R_TRIG;            // 复位沿实例（无条件调用）/ Reset edge instance
    tonMarkDeb    : TON;               // 色标去抖定时器（无条件调用）/ Mark debounce timer
    fDev_mm       : REAL;              // 本袋脉冲偏差换算长度 [毫米] / Pulse deviation converted to length [mm]
    fCorrUse      : REAL;              // 修正量工作副本（钳位后）[毫米] / Correction working copy [mm]
    fPprUse       : REAL;              // 每袋脉冲实数副本（除子非零）[脉冲每袋] / Pulses per bag as real, non-zero
    uMissCnt      : UINT;              // 连续无色标袋数 [袋] / Consecutive bags without a mark [bags]
    uSatCnt       : UINT;              // 连续修正贴限次数 [次] / Consecutive saturated corrections [pcs]
    uPhaseWin     : DINT;              // 相位对齐窗宽 [脉冲] / Phase alignment window [pulses]
    uModErr       : UDINT;             // 委托取模错误码（0 = 无错）/ Delegate modulo error id
    bPprOk        : BOOL;              // 每袋脉冲合法性 / Pulses-per-bag legality
    bSatNow       : BOOL;              // 本袋修正贴限标志 / Correction saturated this bag
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_VFFS_LEN_MIN   : REAL := 50.0;    // 袋长域下限 [毫米] / Bag length lower bound [mm]
    DL_VFFS_LEN_MAX   : REAL := 2000.0;  // 袋长域上限 [毫米] / Bag length upper bound [mm]
    DL_VFFS_CORR_MIN  : REAL := 0.1;     // 修正限幅下限 [毫米] / Correction limit floor [mm]
    DL_VFFS_MISS_MAX  : UINT := 3;       // 连续无色标退化门限 [袋] / Mark-lost degradation threshold [bags]
    DL_VFFS_SAT_MAX   : UINT := 5;       // 连续贴限预警门限 [次] / Saturation warning threshold [pcs]
    DL_VFFS_WIN_DIV   : DINT := 20;      // 相位窗分数（每袋脉冲 / 20）/ Phase window divisor
    DL_VFFS_WIN_MIN   : DINT := 1;       // 相位窗最小宽 [脉冲] / Phase window minimum [pulses]
    DL_VFFS_MISS_FACT : DINT := 1;       // 无色标判据倍率（1 袋脉冲未到标即计一次丢标）/ Missing-mark pulse factor
    DL_VFFS_INF_MAX   : REAL := 1.0E30;  // 非有限值判定幅值上限 / Magnitude bound for finite-value check
    DL_VFFS_ZERO      : REAL := 0.0;     // 零值常量，避免裸字面量 / Zero constant
    DL_VFFS_EPS       : REAL := 0.001;   // 修正贴限比较容差 [毫米] / Saturation comparison tolerance [mm]
END_VAR

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 1｜沿检测/TON 实例每周期无条件调用（仅输入条件化）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fbEncTrig(CLK := bEncPulse);                          // 编码器脉冲沿检测无条件刷新 / encoder edge refreshed unconditionally
tonMarkDeb(IN := bMarkDetect, PT := tMarkDeb);        // 色标去抖计时（无条件刷新）/ mark debounce timing
fbMarkTrig(CLK := tonMarkDeb.Q);                      // 去抖后色标沿检测无条件刷新 / debounced mark edge refreshed
fbResetTrig(CLK := bReset);                           // 复位沿检测无条件刷新 / reset edge refreshed

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 2｜复位沿：清丢失标记、修正与计数
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF fbResetTrig.Q THEN
    bMarkLost := FALSE;                               // 丢失标记清 / lost flag cleared
    fCorrUse := DL_VFFS_ZERO;                         // 修正清 / correction cleared
    fCorr_mm := DL_VFFS_ZERO;                         // 修正输出清 / correction output cleared
    nEncCnt := 0;                                     // 计数清 / count cleared
    uMissCnt := 0;                                    // 丢标计数清 / miss count cleared
    uSatCnt := 0;                                     // 贴限计数清 / saturation count cleared
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 3｜编码器组态合法性与参数钳位（故障级 041A：每袋脉冲为 0 拒绝）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bPprOk := uEncPpr > 0;                                // 每袋脉冲合法判据 / pulses-per-bag legality
IF NOT bPprOk THEN
    eErr := E_DL_VffsErr.eEncBad;                     // 故障级：编码器组态非法 / fault: illegal encoder configuration
    bCutPhaseOk := FALSE;                             // 相位就绪撤（拒绝判定）/ phase ready dropped
    bMarkLost := TRUE;                                // 退化标记置位（显式，不清零显示）/ degradation flag explicit
    RETURN;
END_IF
IF (fBagLenSet_mm <> fBagLenSet_mm) OR (fBagLenSet_mm < DL_VFFS_LEN_MIN) OR (fBagLenSet_mm > DL_VFFS_LEN_MAX) THEN
    eErr := E_DL_VffsErr.eEncBad;                     // 袋长非法并入编码器组态段（反证句：同样拒绝判定）/ illegal length mapped to config band
    bCutPhaseOk := FALSE;                             // 相位就绪撤 / phase ready dropped
    RETURN;
END_IF
IF (fCorrLimit_mm <> fCorrLimit_mm) OR (fCorrLimit_mm < DL_VFFS_CORR_MIN) THEN
    fCorrLimit_mm := DL_VFFS_CORR_MIN;                // 修正限幅下限钳位（防除零式零限幅）/ correction limit floored
END_IF
fPprUse := UINT_TO_REAL(uEncPpr);                     // 每袋脉冲实数副本（非零已证）/ pulses per bag as real, proven non-zero

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 4｜编码器计长：脉冲沿计数与本袋脉冲累计
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF fbEncTrig.Q THEN
    nEncCnt := nEncCnt + 1;                           // 本袋计数递增 [脉冲] / bag pulse count incremented
    IF nEncCnt > DL_VFFS_MISS_FACT * UINT_TO_DINT(uEncPpr) THEN
        nEncCnt := DL_VFFS_MISS_FACT * UINT_TO_DINT(uEncPpr);   // 计数上限钳位（防溢出与漂移累积）/ count capped
    END_IF
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 5｜色标沿：偏差换算、限幅、修正下一袋袋长，并清计数与丢标计数
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
eErr := E_DL_VffsErr.eSyncRun;                        // 默认码：同步运行 / default code: synchronised running
IF fbMarkTrig.Q THEN
    fDev_mm := (DINT_TO_REAL(nEncCnt) - fPprUse) / fPprUse * fBagLenSet_mm;   // 偏差换算 [毫米]（除子已证非零）/ deviation [mm]
    IF fDev_mm > fCorrLimit_mm THEN
        fDev_mm := fCorrLimit_mm;                     // 偏差上限钳制 / deviation capped
    ELSIF fDev_mm < -fCorrLimit_mm THEN
        fDev_mm := -fCorrLimit_mm;                    // 偏差下限钳制 / deviation floored
    END_IF
    fCorrUse := -fDev_mm;                             // 修正量取反（长袋则缩短下一袋）/ correction inverted for the next bag
    IF fCorrUse > fCorrLimit_mm THEN
        fCorrUse := fCorrLimit_mm;                    // 修正上限钳位 / correction capped
    ELSIF fCorrUse < -fCorrLimit_mm THEN
        fCorrUse := -fCorrLimit_mm;                   // 修正下限钳位 / correction floored
    END_IF
    bSatNow := ABS(fCorrUse) >= (fCorrLimit_mm - DL_VFFS_EPS);   // 本袋贴限判据（容差比较）/ saturated-this-bag predicate
    IF bSatNow THEN
        IF uSatCnt < DL_VFFS_SAT_MAX THEN
            uSatCnt := uSatCnt + 1;                   // 贴限计数递增 [次] / saturation count incremented
        END_IF
    ELSE
        uSatCnt := 0;                                 // 未贴限：贴限计数清零 / saturation count cleared
    END_IF
    fCorr_mm := fCorrUse;                             // 修正输出 [毫米] / correction output [mm]
    nEncCnt := 0;                                     // 本袋计数清零 / bag counter cleared
    uMissCnt := 0;                                    // 丢标计数清零 / miss count cleared
    bMarkLost := FALSE;                               // 色标恢复：退化解除 / mark recovered: degradation released
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 6｜色标丢失判定：计长超 2 袋仍未到标 → 丢标计数；连续 3 袋 → 定长退化
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF nEncCnt >= DL_VFFS_MISS_FACT * UINT_TO_DINT(uEncPpr) THEN
    IF uMissCnt < DL_VFFS_SAT_MAX THEN
        uMissCnt := uMissCnt + 1;                     // 丢标计数递增 [袋] / miss count incremented
    END_IF
    nEncCnt := 0;                                     // 计长清零（按定长循环计）/ counter cleared for fixed-length cycling
END_IF
IF uMissCnt >= DL_VFFS_MISS_MAX THEN
    bMarkLost := TRUE;                                // 连续丢标：定长退化（显式置位）/ mark lost: fixed-length degradation
    IF eErr = E_DL_VffsErr.eSyncRun THEN
        eErr := E_DL_VffsErr.eMarkLost;               // 信息级：色标丢失 / info: mark lost
    END_IF
END_IF
IF uSatCnt >= DL_VFFS_SAT_MAX THEN
    IF eErr = E_DL_VffsErr.eSyncRun THEN
        eErr := E_DL_VffsErr.eCorrSat;                // 信息级：修正饱和 / info: correction saturated
    END_IF
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 7｜袋长输出与切刀相位：模运算委托 FC_DL_ModPos 防负余数
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fBagLenAct_mm := fBagLenSet_mm + fCorrUse;            // 实际袋长（修正后）[毫米] / actual bag length [mm]
IF fBagLenAct_mm < DL_VFFS_LEN_MIN THEN
    fBagLenAct_mm := DL_VFFS_LEN_MIN;                 // 袋长下限防护 / length floor
ELSIF fBagLenAct_mm > DL_VFFS_LEN_MAX THEN
    fBagLenAct_mm := DL_VFFS_LEN_MAX;                 // 袋长上限防护 / length ceiling
END_IF
nPhaseDiag := FC_DL_ModPos(nValue := nEncCnt, nModulus := UINT_TO_DINT(uEncPpr), eErr => uModErr);   // 相位正余数 [脉冲] / positive-remainder phase
IF uModErr <> 0 THEN
    nPhaseDiag := 0;                                  // 委托异常诊断归零 / diagnostic zeroed on delegate error
END_IF
uPhaseWin := UINT_TO_DINT(uEncPpr) / DL_VFFS_WIN_DIV;   // 相位窗宽 [脉冲] / phase window width [pulses]
IF uPhaseWin < DL_VFFS_WIN_MIN THEN
    uPhaseWin := DL_VFFS_WIN_MIN;                     // 窗宽下限钳位 / window floored
END_IF
bCutPhaseOk := (nPhaseDiag <= uPhaseWin) OR (nPhaseDiag >= (UINT_TO_DINT(uEncPpr) - uPhaseWin));   // 对齐窗判据 / alignment window predicate
IF bCutPhaseOk AND (eErr = E_DL_VffsErr.eSyncRun) THEN
    eErr := E_DL_VffsErr.ePhaseOk;                    // 信息级：相位对齐完成 / info: phase aligned
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 开箱机把平板纸箱吸起、成型、折底、推到输送线，四相顺序执行，每相有到位反馈，单相超时 5 秒。现场卡箱是常态故障，须停在故障态并锁存卡箱相号，便于维护看出是吸箱没吸住还是折底卡住。异常工况是真空建立超时、成型反馈缺失、折底一半卡住、故障态反复按启动；均不得跳相继续。
architecture_thought: 顺控四相用相枚举加单向 CASE：每相只做三件事——置本相输出、等本相反馈、判本相超时，转相条件全为外部反馈式判据，绝不按时间自动往下走。这是包装设备顺控的通用纪律：时间只能用来判故障，不能用来推进。超时用状态判定（定时器完成位与相枚举同时成立）而非单拍脉冲标志，二者跨拍语义差别很大。反馈缺失一律进故障相并锁存卡箱相号，配套动作是撤本相驱动（吸箱相先释放真空再报错）。

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_ErectPhase（归属 DL_Process，开箱顺控相）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_ErectPhase :
(
    ePhaseIdle  := 0,    // 空闲待启动 / Idle, waiting for a start
    ePhasePick  := 10,   // 吸箱相（真空建立）/ Pick phase, vacuum build-up
    ePhaseForm  := 20,   // 成型相 / Forming phase
    ePhaseFlap  := 30,   // 折底相 / Flap-closing phase
    ePhaseEject := 40,   // 输送相（定时完成）/ Eject phase, timed
    ePhaseDone  := 50,   // 循环完成（等待下一循环）/ Cycle done, waiting for the next
    ePhaseErr   := 99    // 故障相（卡箱锁存）/ Error phase, jam latched
);
END_TYPE

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_ErectErr（归属 DL_Process，与 FB_DL_CartonErectSeq 同文件）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_ErectErr :
(
    eIdle   := 16#0005_041C,   // IDLE（含 DONE 等待态）/ Idle or done-waiting
    ePick   := 16#0005_041D,   // PICK 相（吸箱）/ Pick phase
    eForm   := 16#0005_041E,   // FORM 相（成型）/ Form phase
    eFlap   := 16#0005_041F,   // FLAP 相（折底，含 EJECT 输送段）/ Flap phase, includes eject
    eErr    := 16#0005_0420    // ERR 相（含相超时定位）/ Error phase with timeout localisation
);
END_TYPE

(*==============================================================================
 * 功能块: FB_DL_CartonErectSeq
 * 调用约定: 每个扫描周期无条件调用一次。
 *============================================================================*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_CartonErectSeq
VAR_INPUT
    bVacuumOk    : BOOL;               // 真空建立反馈 / Vacuum established feedback
    bBoxFormed   : BOOL;               // 成型到位反馈 / Box formed feedback
    bFlapClosed  : BOOL;               // 折底到位反馈 / Flap closed feedback
    tStepMax     : TIME := T#5S;       // 单相超时 [秒]，默认 5 / Per-phase timeout [s]
    bStart       : BOOL;               // 启动（上升沿）/ Start, rising edge
    bReset       : BOOL;               // 复位（上升沿，退 IDLE 并清卡箱）/ Reset, rising edge
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    ePhase       : E_DL_ErectPhase;    // 顺控当前相 / Current sequence phase
    bDone        : BOOL;               // 循环完成（单拍脉冲）/ Cycle done, single-scan pulse
    bJam         : BOOL;               // 卡箱锁存（需复位）/ Jam latched until reset
    eJamPhase    : E_DL_ErectPhase;    // 超时定位相（卡箱时有效）/ Phase where the jam occurred
    bVacuumCmd   : BOOL;               // 真空指令 / Vacuum command
    bConveyorCmd : BOOL;               // 输送指令 / Conveyor command
    eErr         : E_DL_ErectErr;      // 错误码 / Error code
END_VAR
VAR
    fbStartTrig  : R_TRIG;             // 启动沿实例（无条件调用）/ Start edge instance
    fbResetTrig  : R_TRIG;             // 复位沿实例（无条件调用）/ Reset edge instance
    tonStep      : TON;                // 单相超时定时器（无条件调用）/ Per-phase timeout timer
    bPhaseRun    : BOOL;               // 相内计时使能（PICK~EJECT）/ Phase timing enable
END_VAR

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 1｜沿检测与 TON 每周期无条件调用（仅 IN 条件化）：相超时用状态判定
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fbStartTrig(CLK := bStart);                           // 启动沿检测无条件刷新 / start edge refreshed unconditionally
fbResetTrig(CLK := bReset);                           // 复位沿检测无条件刷新 / reset edge refreshed unconditionally
bPhaseRun := (ePhase = E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhasePick) OR (ePhase = E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseForm)
          OR (ePhase = E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseFlap) OR (ePhase = E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseEject);   // 动作相判据 / timed-phase predicate
tonStep(IN := bPhaseRun, PT := tStepMax);             // 单相超时计时（无条件刷新）/ per-phase timing

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 2｜复位沿：回 IDLE 并清卡箱锁存
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF fbResetTrig.Q THEN
    ePhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseIdle;             // 回空闲 / back to idle
    bJam := FALSE;                                    // 卡箱解锁 / jam released
    bDone := FALSE;                                   // 完成撤 / done dropped
    bVacuumCmd := FALSE;                              // 真空撤 / vacuum dropped
    bConveyorCmd := FALSE;                            // 输送撤 / conveyor dropped
    eJamPhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseIdle;          // 定位相清 / jam phase cleared
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 3｜启动沿：仅在 IDLE/DONE 允许启动（卡箱态必须复位）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF fbStartTrig.Q THEN
    IF (ePhase = E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseIdle) OR (ePhase = E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseDone) THEN
        ePhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhasePick;         // 进吸箱相 / enter pick phase
        bDone := FALSE;                               // 完成撤 / done dropped
    END_IF
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 4｜顺控状态机：CASE 含 ELSE 兜底（ELSE → 安全态全输出 FALSE）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bDone := FALSE;                                       // 完成脉冲逐拍先清 / done pulse cleared first
CASE ePhase OF

    E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseIdle:
        bVacuumCmd := FALSE;                          // 空闲：真空撤 / vacuum dropped
        bConveyorCmd := FALSE;                        // 空闲：输送撤 / conveyor dropped
        eErr := E_DL_ErectErr.eIdle;                  // 码 041C / code idle

    E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhasePick:
        bVacuumCmd := TRUE;                           // 吸箱：真空指令置位 / vacuum command set
        bConveyorCmd := FALSE;                        // 吸箱：输送撤 / conveyor dropped
        eErr := E_DL_ErectErr.ePick;                  // 码 041D / code pick
        IF bVacuumOk THEN
            ePhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseForm;     // 真空建立：进成型相 / vacuum ok: enter form
        ELSIF tonStep.Q THEN
            bVacuumCmd := FALSE;                      // 真空超时：先释放真空再报错 / vacuum timeout: release vacuum first
            ePhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseErr;      // 进故障相 / enter error phase
            bJam := TRUE;                             // 卡箱锁存 / jam latched
            eJamPhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhasePick;  // 定位相 = PICK / jam phase recorded
            eErr := E_DL_ErectErr.eErr;               // 码 0420 / code error
        END_IF

    E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseForm:
        bVacuumCmd := TRUE;                           // 成型：真空保持 / vacuum held
        bConveyorCmd := FALSE;                        // 成型：输送撤 / conveyor dropped
        eErr := E_DL_ErectErr.eForm;                  // 码 041E / code form
        IF bBoxFormed THEN
            ePhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseFlap;     // 成型到位：进折底相 / formed: enter flap
        ELSIF tonStep.Q THEN
            bVacuumCmd := FALSE;                      // 超时：撤真空（安全侧）/ timeout: drop vacuum
            ePhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseErr;      // 进故障相 / enter error
            bJam := TRUE;                             // 卡箱锁存 / jam latched
            eJamPhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseForm;  // 定位相 = FORM / jam phase recorded
            eErr := E_DL_ErectErr.eErr;               // 码 0420 / code error
        END_IF

    E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseFlap:
        bVacuumCmd := TRUE;                           // 折底：真空保持 / vacuum held
        bConveyorCmd := FALSE;                        // 折底：输送撤 / conveyor dropped
        eErr := E_DL_ErectErr.eFlap;                  // 码 041F / code flap
        IF bFlapClosed THEN
            ePhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseEject;    // 折底到位：进输送相 / flap closed: enter eject
        ELSIF tonStep.Q THEN
            bVacuumCmd := FALSE;                      // 超时：撤真空（安全侧）/ timeout: drop vacuum
            ePhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseErr;      // 进故障相 / enter error
            bJam := TRUE;                             // 卡箱锁存 / jam latched
            eJamPhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseFlap;  // 定位相 = FLAP / jam phase recorded
            eErr := E_DL_ErectErr.eErr;               // 码 0420 / code error
        END_IF

    E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseEject:
        bVacuumCmd := FALSE;                          // 输送：真空撤（放箱）/ eject: vacuum dropped
        bConveyorCmd := TRUE;                         // 输送：输送指令置位 / conveyor command set
        eErr := E_DL_ErectErr.eFlap;                  // 码 041F（输送段与折底段共用，反证句见文件头）/ code flap, shared band
        IF tonStep.Q THEN
            bConveyorCmd := FALSE;                    // 输送定时到：撤输送 / timed eject: drop conveyor
            bDone := TRUE;                            // 完成单拍脉冲 / single-scan done pulse
            ePhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseDone;     // 进完成相 / enter done
        END_IF

    E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseDone:
        bVacuumCmd := FALSE;                          // 完成：真空撤 / vacuum dropped
        bConveyorCmd := FALSE;                        // 完成：输送撤 / conveyor dropped
        eErr := E_DL_ErectErr.eIdle;                  // 码 041C（DONE 等待态与 IDLE 输出组合相同，共用反证句）/ code idle, shared band

    E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseErr:
        bVacuumCmd := FALSE;                          // 故障相：真空撤 / vacuum dropped
        bConveyorCmd := FALSE;                        // 故障相：输送撤 / conveyor dropped
        bJam := TRUE;                                 // 卡箱保持锁存 / jam held latched
        eErr := E_DL_ErectErr.eErr;                   // 码 0420 / code error

    ELSE
        ePhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseErr;          // 非法相兜底 / illegal-phase fallback
        bVacuumCmd := FALSE;                          // 安全态：真空撤 / vacuum dropped, safe side
        bConveyorCmd := FALSE;                        // 安全态：输送撤 / conveyor dropped, safe side
        bJam := TRUE;                                 // 卡箱锁存（非法相按卡箱处置）/ jam latched
        eJamPhase := E_DL_ErectPhase.ePhaseErr;       // 定位相 = ERR / jam phase recorded
        eErr := E_DL_ErectErr.eErr;                   // 码 0420 / code error

END_CASE
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: LoadPort 须对 FOUP 完整对接：载具在位、压紧、开门、门阀握手，再读回 25 片 Wafer Map 与 MES 期望逐位比对，全等才放行给搬运。开门与握手各有超时，超时即异常收拢。异常工况是未压到位就报在位、门阀不握手、Mapping 差 1 位（在位偏移或双片）、通讯中断致全 0；均须拒收并关门撤放行。
architecture_thought: 七相顺控，把机械动作与数据比对分成前后两段：前三相是机构相（压紧、开门、握手），每相一个超时；中间映射相纯数据处理不动作；后两相放行与完成。这样拆分的好处是映射比对可独立测试，机构相位也与半导体设备的标准握手节奏对齐。逐位比对用固定 25 元素数组加常量上下界，循环先在界内跑足 25 次再累计差异，绝不因上界被配成别的值就少比几位——少比几位等于把双片放过去。差异非零走拒收相而非故障相，因映射不符是产品问题不是设备问题。

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_LoadPortSeq
VAR_INPUT
    bFoupPresent  : BOOL;                       // FOUP 在位传感器 / FOUP present sensor
    bDoorOpenOk   : BOOL;                       // 开门到位反馈 / Door-open feedback
    bValveAck     : BOOL;                       // 门阀握手应答 / Door-valve handshake acknowledge
    aMapExpect    : ARRAY[1..25] OF BOOL;       // 期望片位图（25 槽）/ Expected wafer map, 25 slots
    aMapRead      : ARRAY[1..25] OF BOOL;       // 读回片位图（25 槽）/ Read-back wafer map, 25 slots
    tDoorMax      : TIME := T#10S;              // 开门超时 [秒]，默认 10 / Door-open timeout [s]
    tHandMax      : TIME := T#5S;               // 握手超时 [秒]，默认 5 / Handshake timeout [s]
    bStart        : BOOL;                       // 启动（上升沿）/ Start, rising edge
    bReset        : BOOL;                       // 复位（上升沿）/ Reset, rising edge
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    ePhase        : E_DL_LoadPortPhase;         // 顺控当前相 / Current sequence phase
    bMapMatch     : BOOL;                       // 片位映射一致 / Wafer map matched
    bReleaseOk    : BOOL;                       // 放行许可 / Release permission
    nMapDiff      : UINT;                       // 映射差异数 [片位] / Map difference count [slots]
    bDoorOpenCmd  : BOOL;                       // 开门指令 / Door-open command
    bDoorCloseCmd : BOOL;                       // 关门指令（安全收拢）/ Door-close command, safe collapse
    eErr          : E_DL_LoadPortErr;           // 错误码 / Error code
END_VAR
VAR
    fbStartTrig   : R_TRIG;                     // 启动沿实例（无条件调用）/ Start edge instance
    fbResetTrig   : R_TRIG;                     // 复位沿实例（无条件调用）/ Reset edge instance
    tonDoor       : TON;                        // 开门超时定时器（无条件调用）/ Door-open timeout timer
    tonHand       : TON;                        // 握手超时定时器（无条件调用）/ Handshake timeout timer
    i             : INT;                        // 数组循环索引 / Array loop index
    uDiffAcc      : UINT;                       // 差异计数累加 [片位] / Difference accumulator [slots]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_LP_SLOT_MIN : INT  := 1;                 // 片位数组下界（常量提取）/ Slot array lower bound
    DL_LP_SLOT_MAX : INT  := 25;                // 片位数组上界（25 槽固定）/ Slot array upper bound, 25 fixed
END_VAR

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 1｜沿检测/TON 实例每周期无条件调用（仅输入条件化）：相超时用状态判定
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fbStartTrig(CLK := bStart);                           // 启动沿检测无条件刷新 / start edge refreshed unconditionally
fbResetTrig(CLK := bReset);                           // 复位沿检测无条件刷新 / reset edge refreshed unconditionally
tonDoor(IN := (ePhase = E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpOpen), PT := tDoorMax);        // 开门超时计时 / door timeout timing
tonHand(IN := (ePhase = E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpHandshake), PT := tHandMax);   // 握手超时计时 / handshake timeout timing

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 2｜复位沿：安全收拢并回 IDLE
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF fbResetTrig.Q THEN
    ePhase := E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpIdle;             // 回空闲 / back to idle
    bReleaseOk := FALSE;                              // 放行撤 / release dropped
    bMapMatch := FALSE;                               // 一致标志撤 / match dropped
    bDoorOpenCmd := FALSE;                            // 开门指令撤 / open dropped
    bDoorCloseCmd := TRUE;                            // 关门指令（安全侧收拢）/ close command, safe collapse
    nMapDiff := 0;                                    // 差异计数清 / difference cleared
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 3｜启动沿：仅在 IDLE/DONE 且 FOUP 在位允许启动
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF fbStartTrig.Q THEN
    IF ((ePhase = E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpIdle) OR (ePhase = E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpDone)) AND bFoupPresent THEN
        ePhase := E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpDock;         // 进对接相 / enter dock phase
        bReleaseOk := FALSE;                          // 放行撤 / release dropped
        bMapMatch := FALSE;                           // 一致标志撤 / match dropped
    END_IF
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 4｜顺控状态机：CASE 含 ELSE 兜底（ELSE → 安全收拢：关门 + 撤放行）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
CASE ePhase OF

    E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpIdle:
        bDoorOpenCmd := FALSE;                        // 空闲：开门撤 / open dropped
        bDoorCloseCmd := TRUE;                        // 空闲：关门保持（安全侧）/ close held, safe side
        bReleaseOk := FALSE;                          // 空闲：放行撤 / release dropped
        eErr := E_DL_LoadPortErr.eLpErrIdle;          // 码 0421 / code idle

    E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpDock:
        bDoorOpenCmd := FALSE;                        // 对接：开门撤 / open dropped
        bDoorCloseCmd := TRUE;                        // 对接：关门保持（压紧）/ close held for docking
        bReleaseOk := FALSE;                          // 对接：放行撤 / release dropped
        eErr := E_DL_LoadPortErr.eLpErrMove;          // 码 0422 / code in progress
        ePhase := E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpOpen;          // 对接完成进开门相 / docking done, enter open

    E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpOpen:
        bDoorOpenCmd := TRUE;                         // 开门指令置位 / open command set
        bDoorCloseCmd := FALSE;                       // 关门指令撤 / close dropped
        bReleaseOk := FALSE;                          // 放行撤 / release dropped
        eErr := E_DL_LoadPortErr.eLpErrMove;          // 码 0422 / code in progress
        IF bDoorOpenOk THEN
            ePhase := E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpHandshake;   // 开门到位：进握手相 / door open: enter handshake
        ELSIF tonDoor.Q THEN
            bDoorOpenCmd := FALSE;                    // 超时：撤开门指令 / timeout: drop open
            bDoorCloseCmd := TRUE;                    // 超时：安全收拢关门 / timeout: close for safety
            ePhase := E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpErr;      // 进故障相 / enter error
            eErr := E_DL_LoadPortErr.eLpErrTmo;       // 故障级：开门超时 / fault: door timeout
        END_IF

    E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpHandshake:
        bDoorOpenCmd := TRUE;                         // 握手：开门保持 / open held
        bDoorCloseCmd := FALSE;                       // 握手：关门撤 / close dropped
        bReleaseOk := FALSE;                          // 握手：放行撤 / release dropped
        eErr := E_DL_LoadPortErr.eLpErrMove;          // 码 0422 / code in progress
        IF bValveAck THEN
            ePhase := E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpMapCmp;   // 握手应答：进比对相 / ack: enter compare
        ELSIF tonHand.Q THEN
            bDoorOpenCmd := FALSE;                    // 超时：撤开门指令 / timeout: drop open
            bDoorCloseCmd := TRUE;                    // 超时：安全收拢关门 / timeout: close for safety
            ePhase := E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpErr;      // 进故障相 / enter error
            eErr := E_DL_LoadPortErr.eLpErrTmo;       // 故障级：握手超时（与开门超时共用，反证句：输出同为收拢+故障级）/ fault: handshake timeout
        END_IF

    E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpMapCmp:
        bDoorOpenCmd := TRUE;                         // 比对：开门保持 / open held
        bDoorCloseCmd := FALSE;                       // 比对：关门撤 / close dropped
        uDiffAcc := 0;                                // 差异计数清零 / difference cleared
        FOR i := DL_LP_SLOT_MIN TO DL_LP_SLOT_MAX DO
            IF aMapExpect[i] <> aMapRead[i] THEN
                uDiffAcc := uDiffAcc + 1;             // 逐位比对差异累加 [片位] / per-slot difference accumulation
            END_IF
        END_FOR
        nMapDiff := uDiffAcc;                         // 差异计数输出 [片位] / difference count output
        IF uDiffAcc = 0 THEN
            bMapMatch := TRUE;                        // 全等：映射一致 / identical: matched
            bReleaseOk := TRUE;                       // 放行许可置位 / release granted
            ePhase := E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpRelease;  // 进放行相 / enter release
            eErr := E_DL_LoadPortErr.eLpErrRel;       // 码 0425 / code release
        ELSE
            bMapMatch := FALSE;                       // 不符：映射不一致 / mismatch
            bReleaseOk := FALSE;                      // 不符：拒收 / rejected
            ePhase := E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpErr;      // 进故障相（拒收收拢）/ enter error, reject
            eErr := E_DL_LoadPortErr.eLpErrMap;       // 信息级：映射不符（含差异计数）/ info: map mismatch
        END_IF

    E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpRelease:
        bDoorOpenCmd := TRUE;                         // 放行：开门保持（取片）/ open held for pick
        bDoorCloseCmd := FALSE;                       // 放行：关门撤 / close dropped
        bReleaseOk := TRUE;                           // 放行许可保持 / release held
        bMapMatch := TRUE;                            // 映射一致保持 / match held
        eErr := E_DL_LoadPortErr.eLpErrRel;           // 码 0425 / code release
        ePhase := E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpDone;          // 放行完成进完成相 / release done, enter done

    E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpDone:
        bDoorOpenCmd := FALSE;                        // 完成：开门撤 / open dropped
        bDoorCloseCmd := TRUE;                        // 完成：关门收拢 / close for safe collapse
        bReleaseOk := FALSE;                          // 完成：放行撤（本循环结束）/ release dropped
        eErr := E_DL_LoadPortErr.eLpErrRel;           // 码 0425（完成态沿用放行码）/ code release held

    E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpErr:
        bDoorOpenCmd := FALSE;                        // 故障相：开门撤 / open dropped
        bDoorCloseCmd := TRUE;                        // 故障相：关门安全收拢 / close for safe collapse
        bReleaseOk := FALSE;                          // 故障相：放行撤 / release dropped
        bMapMatch := FALSE;                           // 故障相：一致标志撤 / match dropped

    ELSE
        ePhase := E_DL_LoadPortPhase.eLpErr;          // 非法相兜底 / illegal-phase fallback
        bDoorOpenCmd := FALSE;                        // 安全态：开门撤 / open dropped, safe side
        bDoorCloseCmd := TRUE;                        // 安全态：关门收拢 / close for safe collapse
        bReleaseOk := FALSE;                          // 安全态：放行撤 / release dropped
        bMapMatch := FALSE;                           // 安全态：一致标志撤 / match dropped
        eErr := E_DL_LoadPortErr.eLpErrTmo;           // 兜底码（超时段，反证句：输出同为收拢+撤放行）/ fallback code

END_CASE
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 冷冻水与冷却水系统按供回水温差加减泵：目标温差 5 摄氏度级，死区正负 0.5 摄氏度内保持，级数下限 1，水泵不保备机。每台泵有最短运行与最短停机闸门防频繁启停，轮值按运行小时均衡。异常工况是探头之一损坏致温差为负或 NaN、实测温差压在死区边界抖动、加机瞬间母管压力跌落。
architecture_thought: 与风机阵列共用纪律但不共享任何实例：温差先减目标再扣死区，死区外才折算级数需求，级数钳在下限 1 与装机之间。下限取 1 而非 0 是本件与风机的关键分野——水系统至少一台泵在跑，否则末端立刻断流；风机则必须留一台备机在停机侧。每拍至多切一台，选台按运行小时极值，与风机同法。温差无效时保持当前组合只报码不切换，理由很实际：加减机是不可逆的机械动作，用坏数据驱动比不动更危险。

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_ChgoverErr（归属 DL_Process，与 FB_DL_PumpChangeoverSeq 同文件）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_ChgoverErr :
(
    eReady   := 16#0005_0426,   // 就绪 / Ready
    eDeadband:= 16#0005_0427,   // 信息级：温差在死区或传感器无效（保持）/ Info: deadband or invalid sensor, hold
    eAddRun  := 16#0005_0428,   // 信息级：加机中 / Info: adding a pump
    eSubRun  := 16#0005_0429,   // 信息级：减机中 / Info: shedding a pump
    eGateWait:= 16#0005_042A    // 信息级：闸门等待 / Info: minimum-timing gate waiting
);
END_TYPE

(*==============================================================================
 * 功能块: FB_DL_PumpChangeoverSeq
 * 调用约定: 每个扫描周期无条件调用一次；aNRunHrs 由调用方按索引注入。
 *============================================================================*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_PumpChangeoverSeq
VAR_INPUT
    fDeltaT_C    : REAL;                     // 供回水温差 [摄氏度] / Supply-return temperature difference [degC]
    fDeltaTSet_C : REAL := 5.0;              // 目标温差 [摄氏度]，默认 5 / Target temperature difference [degC]
    aNRunHrs     : ARRAY[1..6] OF UDINT;     // 各泵累计运行小时 [小时] / Run hours per pump [h]
    uPumpTotal   : UINT := 6;                // 装机泵数 [台]，有效域 1~6 / Installed pump count [pumps]
    tMinRun      : TIME := T#60S;            // 最短运行时长 [秒] / Minimum run time [s]
    tMinStop     : TIME := T#60S;            // 最短停机时长 [秒] / Minimum stop time [s]
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    auPumpCmd    : ARRAY[1..6] OF BOOL;      // 各泵启停指令 / Pump start/stop commands
    uRunCount    : UINT;                     // 实际运行泵数 [台] / Actual running pump count [pumps]
    eErr         : E_DL_ChgoverErr;          // 错误码 / Error code
END_VAR
VAR
    tonGateRun   : TON;                      // 最短运行闸门定时器（无条件调用）/ Min-run gate timer
    tonGateStop  : TON;                      // 最短停机闸门定时器（无条件调用）/ Min-stop gate timer
    bGateArmed   : BOOL;                     // 闸门武装标志（切换后置位）/ Gate armed flag
    bSwitchCycle : BOOL;                     // 本拍为切换拍（定时器 IN 强制断流）/ Switch-scan flag, forces timer reset
    fSetUse      : REAL;                     // 生效目标温差 [摄氏度] / Effective target difference [degC]
    fDev_C       : REAL;                     // 温差偏差 [摄氏度] / Temperature difference deviation [degC]
    uTotalUse    : UINT;                     // 生效泵数（钳位后）[台] / Effective pump count [pumps]
    uStageNeed   : UINT;                     // 级数需求 [台] / Stage demand [pumps]
    uIdxBest     : UINT;                     // 候选切换泵索引 [台序] / Candidate pump index
    nPickHrs     : UDINT;                    // 候选比较基准小时 [小时] / Candidate comparison baseline [h]
    i            : INT;                      // 数组循环索引 / Array loop index
    bSensorOk    : BOOL;                     // 温差传感器有效判据 / Temperature sensor validity predicate
    bInit        : BOOL;                     // 首扫初始化标志 / First-scan init flag
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_CHG_IDX_MAX   : INT  := 6;            // 阵列容量上限（数组下界常量提取）/ Array capacity upper bound
    DL_CHG_TOTAL_MAX : UINT := 6;            // 装机泵数上限 [台] / Installed count upper bound [pumps]
    DL_CHG_STAGE_MIN : UINT := 1;            // 级数下限 1 台（水泵不保备机，与风机阵列差异）/ Stage lower bound, one pump minimum
    DL_CHG_DEADBAND  : REAL := 0.5;          // 死区半宽 [摄氏度] / Deadband half width [degC]
    DL_CHG_STAGE_C   : REAL := 2.0;          // 级数折算温差步长 [摄氏度每台] / Stage temperature step [degC per pump]
    DL_CHG_INF_MAX   : REAL := 1.0E30;       // 非有限值判定幅值上限 / Magnitude bound for finite-value check
    DL_CHG_ZERO      : REAL := 0.0;          // 零值常量，避免裸字面量 / Zero constant
END_VAR

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 1｜TON 实例每周期无条件调用（仅 IN 条件化）：切换拍强制断流以复位计时
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
tonGateRun(IN := bGateArmed AND NOT bSwitchCycle, PT := tMinRun);     // 运行闸计时 / min-run gate timing
tonGateStop(IN := bGateArmed AND NOT bSwitchCycle, PT := tMinStop);   // 停机闸计时 / min-stop gate timing

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 2｜首扫初始化：指令数组全停
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF NOT bInit THEN
    FOR i := 1 TO DL_CHG_IDX_MAX DO
        auPumpCmd[i] := FALSE;                           // 默认全停 / default all stopped
    END_FOR
    bInit := TRUE;                                       // 首扫完成 / first scan done
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 3｜泵数钳位与目标温差兜底
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
uTotalUse := uPumpTotal;                                 // 泵数工作副本 / total working copy
IF uTotalUse > DL_CHG_TOTAL_MAX THEN
    uTotalUse := DL_CHG_TOTAL_MAX;                       // 泵数上限钳位 / total capped
ELSIF uTotalUse < DL_CHG_STAGE_MIN THEN
    uTotalUse := DL_CHG_STAGE_MIN;                       // 泵数下限钳位 / total floored
END_IF
fSetUse := fDeltaTSet_C;                                 // 目标工作副本 / target working copy
IF (fSetUse <> fSetUse) OR (fSetUse <= DL_CHG_ZERO) OR (fSetUse > DL_CHG_INF_MAX) THEN
    fSetUse := 5.0;                                      // 目标非法按 5 摄氏度兜底 / illegal target falls back to 5 degC
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 4｜传感器有效性与偏差计算：无效则保持当前组合只报码
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bSensorOk := (fDeltaT_C = fDeltaT_C) AND (ABS(fDeltaT_C) <= DL_CHG_INF_MAX) AND (fDeltaT_C >= DL_CHG_ZERO);   // 温差有效 / difference validity
eErr := E_DL_ChgoverErr.eReady;                          // 预置就绪 / preset ready
uStageNeed := uRunCount;                                 // 需求缺省 = 当前运行数（保持）/ demand defaults to current count
IF NOT bSensorOk THEN
    eErr := E_DL_ChgoverErr.eDeadband;                   // 信息级：传感器无效保持（与死区共用，反证句：均为不切换）/ info: invalid sensor, hold
ELSE
    fDev_C := fDeltaT_C - fSetUse;                       // 温差偏差 [摄氏度] / difference deviation [degC]
    IF (fDev_C > -DL_CHG_DEADBAND) AND (fDev_C < DL_CHG_DEADBAND) THEN
        eErr := E_DL_ChgoverErr.eDeadband;               // 信息级：死区内保持 / info: inside deadband, hold
    ELSIF fDev_C > DL_CHG_ZERO THEN
        // 温差偏高：需要加机（级数需求按偏差折算，上限泵数）/ positive deviation: more pumps
        uStageNeed := uRunCount + UDINT_TO_UINT(REAL_TO_UDINT(ROUND(fDev_C / DL_CHG_STAGE_C)));   // 需求级数折算 [台] / stage demand
        IF uStageNeed <= uRunCount THEN
            uStageNeed := uRunCount + 1;                 // 至少加 1 台（ROUND 归零时保底）/ at least one more pump
        END_IF
        IF uStageNeed > uTotalUse THEN
            uStageNeed := uTotalUse;                     // 需求上限钳位（不保备机）/ demand capped at total
        END_IF
    ELSE
        // 温差偏低：需要减机（下限 1 台）/ negative deviation: fewer pumps, one minimum
        IF fDev_C < -DL_CHG_STAGE_C THEN
            uStageNeed := uRunCount - 1;                 // 偏差超一个步长：减 1 台 / shed one pump
        ELSE
            uStageNeed := uRunCount;                     // 偏差未超步长：保持 / hold, within one step
        END_IF
        IF uStageNeed < DL_CHG_STAGE_MIN THEN
            uStageNeed := DL_CHG_STAGE_MIN;              // 下限钳位 1 台 / floored at one pump
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 5｜每 tick 至多切换 1 台：加机选小时最少，减机选小时最多
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
uIdxBest := 0;                                           // 候选索引清零（0 = 无候选）/ candidate reset
nPickHrs := 0;                                           // 基准清零 / baseline reset
IF uRunCount > uStageNeed THEN
    IF bGateArmed AND NOT tonGateRun.Q THEN
        eErr := E_DL_ChgoverErr.eGateWait;               // 信息级：闸门等待（只记不切）/ info: gate waiting
    ELSE
        nPickHrs := 0;                                   // 最多小时基准从 0 起比 / max search baseline
        FOR i := 1 TO UINT_TO_INT(uTotalUse) DO
            IF auPumpCmd[i] THEN
                IF (uIdxBest = 0) OR (aNRunHrs[i] >= nPickHrs) THEN
                    uIdxBest := INT_TO_UINT(i);          // 候选更新（运行最久）/ candidate updated
                    nPickHrs := aNRunHrs[i];             // 基准更新 / baseline updated
                END_IF
            END_IF
        END_FOR
        IF uIdxBest > 0 THEN
            eErr := E_DL_ChgoverErr.eSubRun;             // 信息级：减机中 / info: shedding
        END_IF
    END_IF
ELSIF uRunCount < uStageNeed THEN
    IF bGateArmed AND NOT tonGateStop.Q THEN
        eErr := E_DL_ChgoverErr.eGateWait;               // 信息级：闸门等待（只记不切）/ info: gate waiting
    ELSE
        nPickHrs := 16#FFFF_FFFF;                        // 最少小时基准从满值起比 / min search baseline
        FOR i := 1 TO UINT_TO_INT(uTotalUse) DO
            IF NOT auPumpCmd[i] THEN
                IF aNRunHrs[i] <= nPickHrs THEN
                    uIdxBest := INT_TO_UINT(i);          // 候选更新（停机最久近似小时最少）/ candidate updated
                    nPickHrs := aNRunHrs[i];             // 基准更新 / baseline updated
                END_IF
            END_IF
        END_FOR
        IF uIdxBest > 0 THEN
            eErr := E_DL_ChgoverErr.eAddRun;             // 信息级：加机中 / info: adding
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 6｜执行切换：切换拍置武装并强制定时器断流复位
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bSwitchCycle := FALSE;                                   // 切换拍标志默认 FALSE / switch-scan flag defaults FALSE
IF uIdxBest > 0 THEN
    auPumpCmd[UINT_TO_INT(uIdxBest)] := NOT auPumpCmd[UINT_TO_INT(uIdxBest)];   // 执行切换 / execute the switch
    bGateArmed := TRUE;                                  // 闸门武装 / gate armed
    bSwitchCycle := TRUE;                                // 切换拍标志（下拍定时器重新计时）/ switch-scan flag
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 7｜运行泵数统计与容量外指令清扫（防越界残留）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
uRunCount := 0;                                          // 运行泵数清零 / running count reset
FOR i := 1 TO DL_CHG_IDX_MAX DO
    IF i > UINT_TO_INT(uTotalUse) THEN
        auPumpCmd[i] := FALSE;                           // 容量外指令强制撤销 / force FALSE beyond capacity
    ELSIF auPumpCmd[i] THEN
        uRunCount := uRunCount + 1;                      // 运行泵数累加 [台] / running count incremented
    END_IF
END_FOR
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 产线运行中防护门被打开时，须按停线语义锁住当前批次、记录开门事件与操作员标识，并在门关且人工确认后才允许恢复。开门超过默认 30 秒升级为违规锁存，只有操作员标识加复位双条件才解锁。异常工况是门信号抖动、不填标识就按复位、批次空闲时开门（不该锁批次）、重复开门致审计计数溢出。
architecture_thought: 状态用正常、锁定中、已锁、违规、恢复核实五态，命名与整机停线语义对齐但本件不属主、不替代整机状态机，避免两处都声称管停线致职责重叠。锁定与已锁拆两态的理由：锁定是动作相（置批次锁、记审计），已锁是等待相（等人），两相输出不同，合起来会让批次锁在等待期被重新置位而掩盖误操作。恢复路径做成三条件：门已关、人工确认沿、核实相走完一拍。解锁要求操作员标识非空，空串复位直接被拒。

(*==============================================================================
 * 组件名称 (Component)  : FB_DL_MachineGuardAudit
 * 所属子库 (Sublibrary) : DL_Process
 * 当前版本 (Version)    : 1.0.0
 * 兼容性 (Platform)     : CODESYS 3.5 / TwinCAT 3 / 汇川 InoProShop / Machine Expert
 *                         仅依赖纯 IEC 61131-3 标准元素，零厂商方言
 * 功能描述 (Function)   : 防护门开启审计与批次锁定：门开上升沿 → 若批次活动中
 *                         则按 Holding 语义锁批次并记审计（计数饱和、操作员留痕）→
 *                         Held；恢复需「门已关 + 人工确认」→ RESUMING 核实 →
 *                         NORMAL。开门超 tMaxOpen → VIOLATION 锁存，需操作员标识
 *                         与复位双条件方可解锁。本件只借用 Holding/Held 语义组织
 *                         状态，不属主、不替代整机 PackML 状态机。
 * 溯源 (Origin)         : 道莅 clean-room 防御性实现
 * 本文件内含 (Contains) : TYPE E_DL_GuardAuditState / TYPE E_DL_GuardErr /
 *                         FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_MachineGuardAudit
 * 依赖 (Depends)        : 无 DL_ 内部依赖；Standard.library TON/R_TRIG 实例
 * 红线自检 (Redline)    : 无外部全局变量、无硬件地址直引 ｜ 全变量中英双语同行注释
 *                         计数饱和保护 + 门信号保守处置 ｜ 枚举成员全部显式赋值 ｜
 *                         TON/R_TRIG 每周期无条件调用（仅输入条件化）｜
 *                         CASE 含 ELSE 兜底（ELSE → VIOLATION 锁存 + 锁批次）｜
 *                         禁用系统时间函数（审计时间戳由调用方另行记录）
 * 错误码表 (Codes)      : 16#0005_042B NORMAL
 *                         16#0005_042C HOLDING（批次已锁）
 *                         16#0005_042D HELD（等待恢复确认）
 *                         16#0005_042E VIOLATION（超时锁存，需权限复位）
 *                         16#0005_042F RESUMING（恢复核实）
 * 修订历史 (Revision)   : 2026-11-17  v1.0.0  首版入库 · R27 · 阶段三批 4
 * 验收向量 (Acceptance) : 批次活动中门开 → HOLDING(042C) + bLockBatch → HELD(042D)；
 *                         门关 + bManualConfirm → RESUMING(042F) → NORMAL(042B)；
 *                         开门超 tMaxOpen → VIOLATION(042E)，空 sOperId 复位无效
 *============================================================================*)

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_GuardAuditState（归属 DL_Process，防护门审计状态）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_GuardAuditState :
(
    eNormal    := 0,    // 正常：门关、批次可运行 / Normal, door closed
    eHolding   := 10,   // 保持中：批次锁定并记审计 / Holding, batch locked and audited
    eHeld      := 20,   // 已保持：等门关 + 人工确认 / Held, waiting for close plus confirmation
    eResuming  := 30,   // 恢复核实中 / Resuming, residual verification
    eViolation := 40    // 违规：开门超时锁存，需权限复位 / Violation latched, privileged reset required
);
END_TYPE

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_GuardErr（归属 DL_Process，与 FB_DL_MachineGuardAudit 同文件）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_GuardErr :
(
    eStNormal   := 16#0005_042B,   // NORMAL / Normal
    eStHolding  := 16#0005_042C,   // HOLDING（批次已锁）/ Holding, batch locked
    eStHeld     := 16#0005_042D,   // HELD（等待恢复确认）/ Held, waiting for confirmation
    eStViolation:= 16#0005_042E,   // VIOLATION（超时锁存）/ Violation latched
    eStResuming := 16#0005_042F    // RESUMING（恢复核实）/ Resuming
);
END_TYPE

(*==============================================================================
 * 功能块: FB_DL_MachineGuardAudit
 * 调用约定: 每个扫描周期无条件调用一次；审计时间戳由上层按任务时基另行记录。
 *============================================================================*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_MachineGuardAudit
VAR_INPUT
    bGuardOpen    : BOOL;                 // 门开信号（TRUE = 门开）/ Guard open signal, TRUE means open
    bBatchActive  : BOOL;                 // 批次运行中 / Batch running
    sOperId       : STRING(32);           // 操作员标识（审计与复位权限）/ Operator identifier for audit and reset
    tMaxOpen      : TIME := T#300S;       // 最长开门时长 [秒]，默认 300 / Maximum open time [s]
    bManualConfirm: BOOL;                 // 人工确认（恢复核实用）/ Manual confirmation for resuming
    bReset        : BOOL;                 // 违规复位请求（上升沿，需操作员标识）/ Violation reset request, edge
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    eState        : E_DL_GuardAuditState; // 审计状态机当前状态 / Audit state
    bLockBatch    : BOOL;                 // 批次锁定输出 / Batch lock output
    uOpenCnt      : UDINT;                // 开门次数（审计计数，饱和）/ Door-open count, saturating
    sLastOper     : STRING(32);           // 最近一次审计关联操作员 / Last audited operator
    eErr          : E_DL_GuardErr;        // 错误码 / Error code
END_VAR
VAR
    fbGuardTrig   : R_TRIG;               // 门开上升沿实例（无条件调用）/ Guard-open edge instance
    fbResetTrig   : R_TRIG;               // 复位上升沿实例（无条件调用）/ Reset edge instance
    tonOpen       : TON;                  // 开门时长计时器（无条件调用）/ Door-open duration timer
    bOpenPrev     : BOOL;                 // 上拍门信号快照（保守处置参考）/ Previous door signal snapshot
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_GAD_CNT_SAT : UDINT := 16#FFFF_FFFE;   // 开门计数饱和值 [次] / Open count saturation [pcs]
END_VAR

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 1｜沿检测/TON 每周期无条件调用（仅输入条件化）：超时用状态判定
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fbGuardTrig(CLK := bGuardOpen);                        // 门开沿检测无条件刷新 / guard edge refreshed unconditionally
fbResetTrig(CLK := bReset);                            // 复位沿检测无条件刷新 / reset edge refreshed unconditionally
tonOpen(IN := bGuardOpen AND ((eState = E_DL_GuardAuditState.eHolding)
                           OR (eState = E_DL_GuardAuditState.eHeld)), PT := tMaxOpen);   // 开门时长计时 / open-duration timing
bOpenPrev := bGuardOpen;                               // 门信号快照推进 / snapshot advanced

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 2｜违规复位：需操作员标识非空（权限侧要求，空标识一律拒绝）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF fbResetTrig.Q AND (eState = E_DL_GuardAuditState.eViolation) THEN
    IF sOperId <> '' THEN                              // 标识非空才允许复位 / non-empty operator required
        eState := E_DL_GuardAuditState.eNormal;        // 解锁回正常 / back to normal
        bLockBatch := FALSE;                           // 批次解锁 / batch unlocked
    END_IF
    // 空标识：保持 VIOLATION 锁存（权限复位不在本块裁决）/ empty id keeps the violation latched
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 3｜门开上升沿：批次活动中 → HOLDING（锁批次 + 审计）；否则保守置 Held
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF fbGuardTrig.Q THEN
    IF uOpenCnt < DL_GAD_CNT_SAT THEN
        uOpenCnt := uOpenCnt + 1;                      // 开门次数饱和自增 [次] / saturating open count
    END_IF
    sLastOper := sOperId;                              // 审计操作员留痕 / operator audited
    IF bBatchActive THEN
        eState := E_DL_GuardAuditState.eHolding;       // 批次活动：HOLDING / batch active: holding
        bLockBatch := TRUE;                            // 锁批次 / batch locked
    ELSE
        eState := E_DL_GuardAuditState.eHeld;          // 无批次：直接 Held（无需锁）/ no batch: held directly
        bLockBatch := TRUE;                            // 保守侧仍锁批次（防误运行）/ conservatively locked
    END_IF
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 4｜审计状态机：CASE 含 ELSE 兜底（ELSE → VIOLATION 锁存）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
CASE eState OF

    E_DL_GuardAuditState.eNormal:
        bLockBatch := FALSE;                           // 正常：批次不锁 / batch unlocked
        eErr := E_DL_GuardErr.eStNormal;               // 码 042B / code normal

    E_DL_GuardAuditState.eHolding:
        bLockBatch := TRUE;                            // 保持中：批次锁 / batch locked
        eErr := E_DL_GuardErr.eStHolding;              // 码 042C / code holding
        eState := E_DL_GuardAuditState.eHeld;          // 审计记录完成：进 Held / audit recorded, enter held

    E_DL_GuardAuditState.eHeld:
        bLockBatch := TRUE;                            // 已保持：批次锁 / batch locked
        eErr := E_DL_GuardErr.eStHeld;                 // 码 042D / code held
        IF (NOT bGuardOpen) AND bManualConfirm THEN
            eState := E_DL_GuardAuditState.eResuming;  // 门关 + 人工确认：进核实 / closed plus confirmed: resuming
        ELSIF tonOpen.Q THEN
            eState := E_DL_GuardAuditState.eViolation; // 开门超时：违规锁存 / open timeout: violation latch
            bLockBatch := TRUE;                        // 违规：批次锁保持 / lock held
        END_IF

    E_DL_GuardAuditState.eResuming:
        bLockBatch := TRUE;                            // 核实中：批次锁保持（未核实不放行）/ lock held while verifying
        eErr := E_DL_GuardErr.eStResuming;             // 码 042F / code resuming
        IF (NOT bGuardOpen) AND bManualConfirm THEN
            eState := E_DL_GuardAuditState.eNormal;    // 核实通过（无残留）：回正常 / verified: back to normal
            bLockBatch := FALSE;                       // 批次解锁 / batch unlocked
        ELSIF tonOpen.Q THEN
            eState := E_DL_GuardAuditState.eViolation; // 核实期开门超时：违规锁存 / timeout while verifying: violation
        END_IF

    E_DL_GuardAuditState.eViolation:
        bLockBatch := TRUE;                            // 违规：批次锁保持（需权限复位）/ lock held, privileged reset only
        eErr := E_DL_GuardErr.eStViolation;            // 码 042E / code violation

    ELSE
        eState := E_DL_GuardAuditState.eViolation;     // 非法状态兜底：按违规锁存（保守侧）/ illegal-state fallback to violation
        bLockBatch := TRUE;                            // 批次锁保持 / lock held
        eErr := E_DL_GuardErr.eStViolation;            // 兜底码（违规段，反证句：输出同为锁批次+锁存）/ fallback code

END_CASE
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 风机改造后需按相似定律把参考工况三量换算到新转速：1450 rpm/10000 m³h/800 Pa/15 kW 换算到 1200 rpm，得 8276 m³h、547.7 Pa、8.50 kW。边界条件是参考转速或任一参考量给 0（上位未标定时常见），此时必须拒绝计算并保持上次有效输出，不得输出 0——0 会被上位当成真实工况参与联锁。指数项允许组态（切割叶轮后指数会偏离 1/2/3），但出域需显式报组态错。
architecture_thought: 纯函数无状态，三个换算量共用一条比值链：先算 n/n0，再对每量取幂，指数分别校验后再钳制超速区。防错三条：参考量判零防除零、比值超 RatioMax 只钳制并给信息级码（不用故障级阻断换算）、输出非有限与 1e12 溢出双判。保持上次有效值靠 VAR_IN_OUT 之外的输出锁存实现，避免异常时输出 0 被误读。
