(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_WeldTrackState（归属本功能块，同文件发布，全库唯一定义）
 * 含义: 单焊点监视相位，每个成员在 CASE 中有且仅有一个标签。
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_WeldTrackState :
(
    eWaiting  := 0,    // 待机：等出光 / Waiting for the weld-on signal
    eWelding  := 10,   // 出光中：累计峰值与三类判据 / Welding, accumulating the peak and the three criteria
    eJudging  := 20,   // 判决中：锁存焊点位置并出结论 / Judging, latching the weld position and issuing the verdict
    ePass     := 30,   // 合格：掩码为 0 / Pass, the defect mask is zero
    eReject   := 40,   // 不合格：至少一个缺陷位或窗口超时 / Reject, at least one defect bit or the window timed out
    eFault    := 99    // 故障：锁存码保持，仅使能沿重启 / Fault, the latch code is held until an enable edge
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_LaserTabWeldTrack
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable         : BOOL := FALSE;      // 使能 / Enable
    bWeldOn         : BOOL := FALSE;      // 出光中（仅窗内判据） / Welding on, the criteria are evaluated inside the window only
    fPosCmd_mm      : REAL := 0.0;        // 指令位置 [mm] / Command position in millimetres
    fPosAct_mm      : REAL := 0.0;        // 实际位置 [mm] / Actual position in millimetres
    fPower_W        : REAL := 0.0;        // 实测功率 [W] / Measured power in watt
    fPowerRef_W     : REAL := 2000.0;     // 设定功率 [W]，须 >0 / Reference power in watt, must be positive
    fFollowErrMax_mm : REAL := 0.2;       // 跟随误差上限 [mm]，域 0.01~2.0 / Following error limit in millimetres, domain 0.01 to 2.0
    fPowerDropPct   : REAL := 10.0;       // 功率跌落阈 [%]，域 1~50 / Power drop threshold in percent, domain 1 to 50
    fStallVel_mmS   : REAL := 0.2;        // 停滞判据速度 [mm/s]，域 0~5 / Stall speed criterion in millimetres per second, domain 0 to 5
    tConfirm        : TIME := T#30MS;     // 判据确认时长 [ms]，域 20~500 / Criterion confirmation time, domain 20 to 500 ms
    tWindowMax      : TIME := T#2S;       // 单焊点窗口 [ms]，域 50ms~10s / Single weld spot window, domain 50 ms to 10 s
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bTrackOk        : BOOL;               // 轨迹合格（判决合格时置位） / Trajectory accepted
    fFollowErrPeak_mm : REAL;             // 窗内跟随误差峰值 [mm] / Peak following error inside the window
    uDefectMask     : WORD;               // 缺陷掩码 bit0 跟超 bit1 功率跌 bit2 停滞 bit3 超时 [bit] / Defect mask
    fWeldPos_mm     : REAL;               // 锁存焊点位置 [mm] / Latched weld position in millimetres
    eState          : E_DL_WeldTrackState; // 监视相位 [—] / Monitoring phase
    eErr            : UDINT;              // 错误码，段位 16#0004_xxxx / Error code in segment 16#0004_xxxx
END_VAR
VAR
    _eState         : E_DL_WeldTrackState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWaiting; // 当前相位 / Current phase
    _bInit          : BOOL := FALSE;      // 首扫标志，取非判定 / First-scan flag, tested negated
    _bCfgOk         : BOOL;               // 组态合法标志 / Configuration valid flag
    _bPosOk         : BOOL;               // 位置读数有限标志 / Position readings finite flag
    _bFaultLatch    : BOOL;               // 故障锁存标志 / Fault latch flag
    _uLatchCode     : UDINT;              // 锁存码载体 / Latch code carrier
    _fFollowErr     : REAL;               // 本拍跟随误差 [mm] / Following error of this scan
    _fPeak          : REAL;               // 窗内峰值内部副本 [mm] / Internal peak copy inside the window
    _fDropPct       : REAL;               // 本拍功率跌落百分比 [%] / Power drop of this scan in percent
    _fPosWinStart   : REAL;               // 停滞窗起点位置 [mm] / Position at the start of the stall window
    _fConfirmSec    : REAL := 0.03;       // 确认时长换算秒 [s] / Confirmation time converted to seconds
    _fStallDist     : REAL;               // 停滞判定距离门限 [mm] / Stall distance threshold in millimetres
    _rtrigEnable    : R_TRIG;             // 使能上升沿 / Rising edge of the enable input
    _tonFollow      : TON;                // 跟超确认计时 / Following error confirmation timer
    _tonPower       : TON;                // 功率跌落确认计时 / Power drop confirmation timer
    _tonStall       : TON;                // 停滞确认计时 / Stall confirmation timer
    _tonWindow      : TON;                // 单焊点窗口计时 / Weld spot window timer
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_WT_READY     : UDINT := 16#0004_0331;  // 就绪码 / Ready code
    DL_WT_POS_BAD   : UDINT := 16#0004_0332;  // 信息级位置非有限码 / Info code for non-finite positions
    DL_WT_CFG_BAD   : UDINT := 16#0004_0333;  // 故障级组态非法码 / Fault code for bad configuration
    DL_WT_ILLEGAL   : UDINT := 16#0004_0334;  // 故障级非法状态码 / Fault code for an illegal state
    DL_WT_BIT_FOLLOW : WORD := 16#0001;       // 缺陷位 bit0 跟超 / Defect bit 0, following error
    DL_WT_BIT_POWER  : WORD := 16#0002;       // 缺陷位 bit1 功率跌 / Defect bit 1, power drop
    DL_WT_BIT_STALL  : WORD := 16#0004;       // 缺陷位 bit2 停滞 / Defect bit 2, stall
    DL_WT_BIT_TIME   : WORD := 16#0008;       // 缺陷位 bit3 超时 / Defect bit 3, window timeout
    DL_WT_EPS        : REAL := 1.0E-6;        // 浮点判零容差 [—] / Float zero tolerance
END_VAR

// 段 1｜输出与单拍标志预置（bTrackOk 逐拍重算，掩码与峰值为窗内累计量，不在此清）
bTrackOk := FALSE;                                  // 合格标志预清 / Accepted flag pre-cleared
eErr := 0;                                          // 错误码预清 / Error code pre-cleared

// 段 2｜沿检测无条件周期刷新
_rtrigEnable(CLK := bEnable);                       // 使能沿 / Enable edge

// 段 3｜首扫初始化（判据取非，R19）
IF NOT _bInit THEN
    _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWaiting;        // 相位待机起步 / Phase starts waiting
    _bInit := TRUE;                                 // 首扫只做一次 / The first scan runs once
END_IF

// 段 4｜组态闸（跟随上限与参考功率判零防除零）
_bCfgOk := NOT ((fFollowErrMax_mm <> fFollowErrMax_mm) OR ((fFollowErrMax_mm - fFollowErrMax_mm) <> (fFollowErrMax_mm - fFollowErrMax_mm)))
        AND (fFollowErrMax_mm > DL_WT_EPS)
        AND NOT ((fPowerRef_W <> fPowerRef_W) OR ((fPowerRef_W - fPowerRef_W) <> (fPowerRef_W - fPowerRef_W)))
        AND (fPowerRef_W > DL_WT_EPS)
        AND (fPowerDropPct >= 1.0) AND (fPowerDropPct <= 50.0)
        AND (fStallVel_mmS >= 0.0) AND (fStallVel_mmS <= 5.0)   // 停滞速度域闸：负值/NaN 会使停滞门限失效而静默关闭 bit2 / Stall speed gate, a negative or NaN value silently disables bit 2
        AND (tConfirm >= T#20MS) AND (tConfirm <= T#500MS)
        AND (tWindowMax >= T#50MS) AND (tWindowMax <= T#10S);
_fConfirmSec := TIME_TO_LREAL(tConfirm) / 1000.0;   // 确认时长换算秒 [s] / Confirmation time in seconds
_fStallDist := fStallVel_mmS * _fConfirmSec;        // 停滞判定距离门限 [mm] / Stall distance threshold

// 段 5｜位置有限闸（非有限只跳过本拍，已累计峰值与掩码一律不清零）
_bPosOk := NOT ((fPosCmd_mm <> fPosCmd_mm) OR ((fPosCmd_mm - fPosCmd_mm) <> (fPosCmd_mm - fPosCmd_mm)))
        AND NOT ((fPosAct_mm <> fPosAct_mm) OR ((fPosAct_mm - fPosAct_mm) <> (fPosAct_mm - fPosAct_mm)));
_fFollowErr := ABS(fPosCmd_mm - fPosAct_mm);        // 本拍跟随误差 [mm] / Following error of this scan

// 段 6｜功率跌落百分比（除数已在段 4 判零）
IF (fPower_W <> fPower_W) OR ((fPower_W - fPower_W) <> (fPower_W - fPower_W)) THEN
    _fDropPct := 0.0;                               // 功率非有限：本拍不判跌落 / Non-finite power, no drop judgement this scan
ELSE
    _fDropPct := ((fPowerRef_W - fPower_W) / fPowerRef_W) * 100.0;   // 跌落百分比 [%] / Power drop in percent
END_IF

// 段 7｜四个定时器无条件周期刷新（严禁置于分支内）
_tonFollow(IN := (_eState = E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWelding) AND _bPosOk AND (_fFollowErr > fFollowErrMax_mm), PT := tConfirm);
_tonPower(IN := (_eState = E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWelding) AND (_fDropPct > fPowerDropPct), PT := tConfirm);
_tonStall(IN := (_eState = E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWelding) AND _bPosOk AND (ABS(fPosAct_mm - _fPosWinStart) < _fStallDist), PT := tConfirm);
_tonWindow(IN := (_eState = E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWelding), PT := tWindowMax);

// 段 8｜使能上升沿：锁存解除路径
IF _rtrigEnable.Q THEN
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE;                          // 锁存解除 / Latch released
    _uLatchCode := 0;                               // 锁存码清 / Latch code cleared
    _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWaiting;        // 相位回待机 / Phase back to waiting
    uDefectMask := 16#0000;                         // 掩码清 / Defect mask cleared
    _fPeak := 0.0;                                  // 峰值清 [mm] / Peak cleared
    fFollowErrPeak_mm := 0.0;                       // 峰值出口清 [mm] / Peak output cleared
END_IF

// 段 9｜失能闸
IF NOT bEnable THEN
    _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWaiting;        // 相位回待机 / Phase back to waiting
    eErr := DL_WT_READY;                            // 失能为正常停机 / Disable is a normal stop
END_IF

// 段 10｜监视状态机（ENUM + CASE + ELSE 兜底）
IF bEnable THEN
    CASE _eState OF

        E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWaiting:               // 待机：组态错即锁存，出光沿开窗
            IF NOT _bCfgOk THEN
                eErr := DL_WT_CFG_BAD;              // 故障级：组态非法 / Fault, bad configuration
                _uLatchCode := DL_WT_CFG_BAD;
                _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
                _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eFault;
            ELSIF bWeldOn THEN
                uDefectMask := 16#0000;             // 新焊点掩码清 / New spot, the mask is cleared
                _fPeak := 0.0;                      // 新焊点峰值清 [mm] / New spot, the peak is cleared
                fFollowErrPeak_mm := 0.0;
                IF _bPosOk THEN                     // 位置有限才取窗起点与焊点初值（防 NaN 入出口） / Latch only with finite positions
                    _fPosWinStart := fPosAct_mm;    // 停滞窗起点位置 [mm] / Stall window start position
                    fWeldPos_mm := fPosAct_mm;      // 焊点位置初值 [mm] / Weld position initial value
                END_IF
                _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWelding;   // 开窗出光 / The window opens
            ELSE
                eErr := DL_WT_READY;                // 就绪码 / Ready code
            END_IF

        E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWelding:               // 出光中：累计峰值 + 三类判据确认
            IF NOT _bPosOk THEN
                eErr := DL_WT_POS_BAD;              // 信息级：位置非有限，本拍跳过 / Info, positions not finite, this scan is skipped
            ELSE
                IF _fFollowErr > _fPeak THEN
                    _fPeak := _fFollowErr;          // 峰值刷新 [mm] / Peak refreshed
                END_IF
            END_IF
            fFollowErrPeak_mm := _fPeak;            // 峰值出口 [mm] / Peak output
            IF _fFollowErr > fFollowErrMax_mm THEN
                IF _tonFollow.Q THEN
                    uDefectMask := uDefectMask OR DL_WT_BIT_FOLLOW;   // bit0 跟超确认 / Following error confirmed
                END_IF
            END_IF
            IF _fDropPct > fPowerDropPct THEN
                IF _tonPower.Q THEN
                    uDefectMask := uDefectMask OR DL_WT_BIT_POWER;    // bit1 功率跌落确认 / Power drop confirmed
                END_IF
            END_IF
            IF ABS(fPosAct_mm - _fPosWinStart) < _fStallDist THEN
                IF _tonStall.Q THEN
                    uDefectMask := uDefectMask OR DL_WT_BIT_STALL;    // bit2 停滞确认 / Stall confirmed
                END_IF
            ELSE
                _fPosWinStart := fPosAct_mm;    // 已移动：重置停滞窗起点 [mm] / Moved, restart the stall window
            END_IF
            IF _tonWindow.Q THEN
                uDefectMask := uDefectMask OR DL_WT_BIT_TIME;         // bit3 窗口超时 / Window timed out
                _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eJudging;              // 强制判决，绝不停在出光态 / Forced verdict, never stuck in welding
            ELSIF NOT bWeldOn THEN
                _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eJudging;              // 出光结束：判决 / Weld finished, judge now
            END_IF

        E_DL_WeldTrackState.eJudging:               // 判决中：锁存焊点位置并出结论
            IF _bPosOk THEN                         // 位置有限才刷新焊点位置，保持上次有效值 / Refresh the latch only with finite positions
                fWeldPos_mm := fPosAct_mm;          // 锁存焊点位置 [mm] / Latch the weld position
            END_IF
            IF uDefectMask = 16#0000 THEN
                bTrackOk := TRUE;                   // 掩码为 0：合格 / A zero mask means pass
                _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.ePass;
            ELSE
                _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eReject;   // 有缺陷位：不合格 / At least one defect bit, reject
            END_IF
            eErr := DL_WT_READY;                    // 判决本身无故障码 / The verdict produces no fault code

        E_DL_WeldTrackState.ePass:                  // 合格：保持结论，等出光消失后回待机
            bTrackOk := TRUE;
            IF NOT bWeldOn THEN
                _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWaiting;
            END_IF

        E_DL_WeldTrackState.eReject:                // 不合格：保持结论，等出光消失后回待机
            bTrackOk := FALSE;
            IF NOT bWeldOn THEN
                _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWaiting;
            END_IF

        E_DL_WeldTrackState.eFault:                 // 故障：锁存码保持
            eErr := _uLatchCode;                    // 锁存码回放 / Replay the latch code
            IF NOT _bFaultLatch THEN
                _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eWaiting;   // 锁存已由使能沿解除 / The latch was released by the enable edge
            END_IF

        ELSE
            // 非法状态兜底（故障级）
            eErr := DL_WT_ILLEGAL;                  // 故障级：非法相位 / Fault, illegal phase
            _uLatchCode := DL_WT_ILLEGAL;
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
            _eState := E_DL_WeldTrackState.eFault;

    END_CASE
END_IF

eState := _eState;                                  // 相位出口镜像 / Phase mirrored to the output pin
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 晶圆缺口对位：θ 10°、目标 95°、公差 0.2°、30 °/s，先搜索缺口再微调 +85°，复核 0.05° 后完成。现场边界：缺口信号恒不来时必须单相超时转故障，不许空转搜索；角度跨越 0/360 必须用条件加减归一（各平台负数取余行为不一致）。重试次数用尽后锁存故障，不静默续相。
architecture_thought: 六相 Idle/Searching/Latched/Trimming/Verifying/Done/Fault，一相一相位一超时，超时即故障而不自动续相（自动续相会让缺口漏检走完整圈）。角度归一走条件加减禁 MOD（R11）；公差与速度判零前置防除零；Done 需新启动沿重触发，防完成后自循环再搜。

(*==============================================================================

 * 所属子库 (Sublibrary) : DL_Motion
 * 当前版本 (Version)    : 1.0.0
 * 兼容性 (Platform)     : CODESYS 3.5 / TwinCAT 3 / 汇川 InoProShop（纯标准元素，零方言）
 * 功能描述 (Function)   : 晶圆缺口对位六相顺控。搜索相等待缺口检出，锁存相用条件加减归

 *                         复核偏差 0.05 ° → eDone

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_NotchState（归属本功能块，同文件发布，全库唯一定义）
 * 含义: 缺口对位相位，每个成员在 CASE 中有且仅有一个标签。
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_NotchState :
(
    eIdle      := 0,    // 空闲：等启动沿 / Idle, waiting for the start edge
    eSearching := 10,   // 搜索：等缺口检出或相超时 / Searching, waiting for the notch or the phase timeout
    eLatched   := 20,   // 锁存：本拍算最小转角并派单 / Latched, computing the shortest angle and dispatching
    eTrimming  := 30,   // 微调：等旋转轴就绪 / Trimming, waiting for the rotary axis to be ready
    eVerifying := 40,   // 复核：判偏差是否落公差 / Verifying, checking whether the deviation is inside tolerance
    eDone      := 50,   // 完成：单拍完成脉冲，需新启动沿 / Done, one-scan pulse, a new start edge is required
    eFault     := 99    // 故障：锁存码保持，仅复位沿退出 / Fault, the latch code is held until the reset edge
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_NotchAlignSeq
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable        : BOOL := FALSE;       // 使能 / Enable
    bStart         : BOOL := FALSE;       // 启动，上升沿启动一次 / Start, the rising edge starts one cycle
    bReset         : BOOL := FALSE;       // 复位，仅故障态生效 / Reset, effective in the fault state only
    bNotchFound    : BOOL := FALSE;       // 缺口检出（引脚注入） / Notch found, injected by the caller
    fThetaNow_deg  : REAL := 0.0;         // 当前转角 [°]，域 0~360 / Present angle in degrees, domain 0 to 360
    fThetaTarget_deg : REAL := 0.0;       // 目标转角 [°]，域 0~360 / Target angle in degrees, domain 0 to 360
    fTolDeg        : REAL := 0.2;         // 复核公差 [°]，域 0.01~1.0 / Verification tolerance in degrees, domain 0.01 to 1.0
    fSpinSpeed_dps : REAL := 30.0;        // 角速度 [°/s]，域 1~180 / Angular speed in degrees per second, domain 1 to 180
    tPhaseMax      : TIME := T#10S;       // 单相超时 [ms]，域 100ms~30s / Per-phase timeout, domain 100 ms to 30 s
    uRetryMax      : UINT := 2;           // 重试上限 [次]，域 0~2 / Retry limit, domain 0 to 2
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    iAxis          : I_DL_StepperOpenLoop; // 旋转轴开环步进契约引用 [—] / Rotary axis open-loop stepper contract reference
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bDone          : BOOL;                // 完成脉冲，单拍有效 / Completion pulse, valid for one scan
    bBusy          : BOOL;                // 顺控进行中 / Sequence running
    bError         : BOOL;                // 故障级标志，仅故障级码置位 / Fault-class flag, set on fault codes only
    fThetaErr_deg  : REAL;                // 最终偏差 [°] / Final deviation in degrees
    uRetryCnt      : UINT;                // 已重试次数 [次] / Retry count
    eState         : E_DL_NotchState;     // 对位相位 [—] / Alignment phase
    eErr           : UDINT;               // 错误码，段位 16#0004_xxxx / Error code in segment 16#0004_xxxx
END_VAR
VAR
    _eState        : E_DL_NotchState := E_DL_NotchState.eIdle; // 当前相位 / Current phase
    _bInit         : BOOL := FALSE;       // 首扫标志，取非判定 / First-scan flag, tested negated
    _bRefOk        : BOOL;                // 契约引用有效标志 / Contract reference valid flag
    _bCfgOk        : BOOL;                // 组态合法标志 / Configuration valid flag
    _bIssueScan    : BOOL;                // 派单当拍标志（本拍不判就绪） / Dispatch scan flag, readiness is not judged in this scan
    _bFaultLatch   : BOOL;                // 故障锁存标志 / Fault latch flag
    _uLatchCode    : UDINT;               // 锁存码载体 / Latch code carrier
    _fDelta        : REAL;                // 本拍最小转角（已归一）[°] / Shortest angle after normalisation in degrees
    _fErrAbs       : REAL;                // 偏差绝对值 [°] / Absolute deviation in degrees
    _rtrigStart    : R_TRIG;              // 启动上升沿 / Rising edge of the start command
    _rtrigReset    : R_TRIG;              // 复位上升沿 / Rising edge of the reset command
    _rtrigNotch    : R_TRIG;              // 缺口检出上升沿 / Rising edge of the notch-found signal
    _tonPhase      : TON;                 // 单相超时计时 / Per-phase timeout timer
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_NA_READY   : UDINT := 16#0004_0336;  // 就绪码 / Ready code
    DL_NA_AXIS_BAD : UDINT := 16#0004_0337; // 故障级轴拒绝码 / Fault code for a rejected axis command
    DL_NA_CFG_BAD : UDINT := 16#0004_0338;  // 故障级组态非法码 / Fault code for bad configuration
    DL_NA_TIMEOUT : UDINT := 16#0004_0339;  // 故障级相超时码 / Fault code for a phase timeout
    DL_NA_RETRY   : UDINT := 16#0004_033A;  // 故障级重试用尽码 / Fault code for exhausted retries
    DL_NA_HALF    : REAL := 180.0;          // 半周角 [°] / Half turn in degrees
    DL_NA_FULL    : REAL := 360.0;          // 全周角 [°] / Full turn in degrees
    DL_NA_TOL_LO  : REAL := 0.01;           // 公差下限 [°] / Tolerance lower bound
    DL_NA_TOL_HI  : REAL := 1.0;            // 公差上限 [°] / Tolerance upper bound
    DL_NA_SPD_LO  : REAL := 1.0;            // 角速度下限 [°/s] / Angular speed lower bound
    DL_NA_SPD_HI  : REAL := 180.0;          // 角速度上限 [°/s] / Angular speed upper bound
END_VAR

// 段 1｜输出与单拍标志预置
bDone := FALSE;                                     // 完成脉冲预清 / Completion pulse pre-cleared
bBusy := FALSE;                                     // 运行标志预清 / Busy flag pre-cleared
bError := FALSE;                                    // 故障标志预清 / Fault flag pre-cleared
eErr := 0;                                          // 错误码预清 / Error code pre-cleared
_bIssueScan := FALSE;                               // 派单当拍标志预清 / Dispatch scan flag pre-cleared
_fErrAbs := 0.0;                                    // 偏差预清 [°] / Deviation pre-cleared

// 段 2｜沿检测无条件周期刷新（严禁置于分支内）
_rtrigStart(CLK := bStart);                         // 启动沿 / Start edge
_rtrigReset(CLK := bReset);                         // 复位沿 / Reset edge
_rtrigNotch(CLK := bNotchFound);                    // 缺口检出沿 / Notch-found edge

// 段 3｜首扫初始化（判据取非，R19）
IF NOT _bInit THEN
    _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eIdle;               // 相位待机起步 / Phase starts idle
    _bInit := TRUE;                                 // 首扫只做一次 / The first scan runs once
END_IF

// 段 4｜引用与组态闸
_bRefOk := (iAxis <> 0);                            // 引用注入判据 / Reference injected flag
_bCfgOk := _bRefOk
        AND NOT ((fTolDeg <> fTolDeg) OR ((fTolDeg - fTolDeg) <> (fTolDeg - fTolDeg)))
        AND (fTolDeg >= DL_NA_TOL_LO) AND (fTolDeg <= DL_NA_TOL_HI)
        AND NOT ((fSpinSpeed_dps <> fSpinSpeed_dps) OR ((fSpinSpeed_dps - fSpinSpeed_dps) <> (fSpinSpeed_dps - fSpinSpeed_dps)))
        AND (fSpinSpeed_dps >= DL_NA_SPD_LO) AND (fSpinSpeed_dps <= DL_NA_SPD_HI)
        AND (tPhaseMax >= T#100MS) AND (tPhaseMax <= T#30S)
        AND (uRetryMax <= 2);

// 段 5｜相超时定时器无条件周期刷新（搜索/锁存/微调/复核四相计时）
_tonPhase(IN := (_eState = E_DL_NotchState.eSearching) OR (_eState = E_DL_NotchState.eLatched)
            OR (_eState = E_DL_NotchState.eTrimming) OR (_eState = E_DL_NotchState.eVerifying),
          PT := tPhaseMax);

// 段 6｜角度归一（条件加减，禁取模；输入域 0~360 故单次修正即落 (-180, 180]）
_fDelta := fThetaTarget_deg - fThetaNow_deg;        // 原始角差 [°] / Raw angle difference
IF _fDelta > DL_NA_HALF THEN
    _fDelta := _fDelta - DL_NA_FULL;                // 大于半周：减一周 [°] / Above half a turn, subtract one turn
END_IF
IF _fDelta <= (0.0 - DL_NA_HALF) THEN
    _fDelta := _fDelta + DL_NA_FULL;                // 小于负半周：加一周 [°] / Below minus half a turn, add one turn
END_IF
_fErrAbs := ABS(_fDelta);                           // 偏差绝对值 [°] / Absolute deviation
fThetaErr_deg := _fErrAbs;                          // 偏差出口 [°] / Deviation output

// 段 7｜失能闸
IF NOT bEnable THEN
    _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eIdle;               // 相位回空闲 / Phase back to idle
    eErr := DL_NA_READY;                            // 失能为正常停机 / Disable is a normal stop
END_IF

// 段 8｜对位状态机（ENUM + CASE + ELSE 兜底）
IF bEnable THEN
    CASE _eState OF

        E_DL_NotchState.eIdle:                      // 空闲：等启动沿，先做组态闸
            IF _rtrigStart.Q THEN
                _bFaultLatch := FALSE;              // 启动沿为锁存解除路径 / The start edge releases the latch
                _uLatchCode := 0;                   // 锁存码清 / Latch code cleared
                uRetryCnt := 0;                     // 重试计数清 [次] / Retry count cleared
                IF NOT _bCfgOk THEN
                    eErr := DL_NA_CFG_BAD;          // 故障级：组态非法 / Fault, bad configuration
                    _uLatchCode := DL_NA_CFG_BAD;
                    _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
                    bError := TRUE;
                    _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eFault;
                ELSE
                    _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eSearching;   // 进入搜索相 / Enter the searching phase
                END_IF
            END_IF

        E_DL_NotchState.eSearching:                 // 搜索：退出条件两条（检出沿 / 超时）
            bBusy := TRUE;
            IF _rtrigNotch.Q THEN
                _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eLatched;         // 条件一：缺口检出 / Condition one, the notch was found
            ELSIF _tonPhase.Q THEN
                eErr := DL_NA_TIMEOUT;                       // 故障级：搜索相超时，不空转 / Fault, searching timed out
                _uLatchCode := DL_NA_TIMEOUT;
                _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
                bError := TRUE;
                bBusy := FALSE;
                _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eFault;           // 条件二：前置条件消失（超时）/ Condition two, the precondition vanished
            END_IF

        E_DL_NotchState.eLatched:                   // 锁存：偏差已在公差内直接复核，否则派单微调
            bBusy := TRUE;
            IF _fErrAbs <= fTolDeg THEN
                _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eVerifying;      // 已到位：直接复核 / Already aligned, go verifying
            ELSIF ABS(_fDelta) > (DL_NA_HALF + DL_NA_TOL_HI) THEN
                eErr := DL_NA_CFG_BAD;                      // 故障级：归一失配（角度输入出域）/ Fault, normalisation mismatch
                _uLatchCode := DL_NA_CFG_BAD;
                _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
                bError := TRUE;
                bBusy := FALSE;
                _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eFault;
            ELSE
                IF iAxis.MoveRelative(_fDelta, fSpinSpeed_dps) THEN
                    _bIssueScan := TRUE;                    // 派单当拍不判就绪 / Readiness is not judged in the dispatch scan
                    _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eTrimming;   // 进入微调相 / Enter the trimming phase
                ELSE
                    eErr := DL_NA_AXIS_BAD;                 // 故障级：轴拒绝指令 / Fault, the axis rejected the command
                    _uLatchCode := DL_NA_AXIS_BAD;
                    _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
                    bError := TRUE;
                    bBusy := FALSE;
                    _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eFault;
                END_IF
            END_IF

        E_DL_NotchState.eTrimming:                  // 微调：等轴就绪或超时
            bBusy := TRUE;
            IF _bIssueScan THEN
                _bIssueScan := FALSE;                       // 派单拍已过 / The dispatch scan has passed
            ELSIF iAxis.bReady THEN
                _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eVerifying;      // 轴就绪：复核 / Axis ready, go verifying
            ELSIF _tonPhase.Q THEN
                eErr := DL_NA_TIMEOUT;                      // 故障级：微调相超时 / Fault, trimming timed out
                _uLatchCode := DL_NA_TIMEOUT;
                _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
                bError := TRUE;
                bBusy := FALSE;
                _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eFault;
            END_IF

        E_DL_NotchState.eVerifying:                 // 复核：合格即完成，超差在限次内重试
            bBusy := TRUE;
            IF _bIssueScan THEN
                _bIssueScan := FALSE;
            ELSIF _tonPhase.Q THEN
                eErr := DL_NA_TIMEOUT;                      // 故障级：复核相超时 / Fault, verifying timed out
                _uLatchCode := DL_NA_TIMEOUT;
                _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
                bError := TRUE;
                bBusy := FALSE;
                _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eFault;
            ELSE
                IF _fErrAbs <= fTolDeg THEN
                    _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eDone;       // 合格 / Accepted
                ELSIF uRetryCnt >= uRetryMax THEN
                    eErr := DL_NA_RETRY;                    // 故障级：重试次数用尽 / Fault, retries exhausted
                    _uLatchCode := DL_NA_RETRY;
                    _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
                    bError := TRUE;
                    bBusy := FALSE;
                    _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eFault;
                ELSE
                    uRetryCnt := uRetryCnt + 1;             // 重试计数 +1 [次] / Retry count incremented
                    _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eSearching;  // 重新搜索 / Search again
                END_IF
            END_IF

        E_DL_NotchState.eDone:                      // 完成：单拍脉冲（下一拍段 1 预清即自清，R24 三律）
            bDone := TRUE;
            bBusy := FALSE;
            eErr := DL_NA_READY;                    // 就绪/完成码 / Ready or completion code
            _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eIdle;       // 需新启动沿重启 / A new start edge is required

        E_DL_NotchState.eFault:                     // 故障：锁存码保持，仅复位沿退出
            bBusy := FALSE;
            eErr := _uLatchCode;                    // 锁存码回放 / Replay the latch code
            bError := TRUE;
            IF _rtrigReset.Q THEN
                IF _bRefOk THEN
                    iAxis.Reset();                  // 轴故障复位 / Axis fault reset
                END_IF
                _bFaultLatch := FALSE;              // 锁存解除 / Latch released
                _uLatchCode := 0;                   // 锁存码清 / Latch code cleared
                uRetryCnt := 0;                     // 重试计数清 [次] / Retry count cleared
                eErr := DL_NA_READY;                // 复位后回就绪码 / Ready code after the reset
                bError := FALSE;
                _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eIdle;   // 回空闲需新启动沿 / Back to idle, a new start edge is required
            END_IF

        ELSE
            // 非法状态兜底（故障级）
            eErr := DL_NA_CFG_BAD;                  // 故障级：非法相位 / Fault, illegal phase
            _uLatchCode := DL_NA_CFG_BAD;
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
            bError := TRUE;
            bBusy := FALSE;
            _eState := E_DL_NotchState.eFault;

    END_CASE
END_IF

eState := _eState;                                  // 相位出口镜像 / Phase mirrored to the output pin
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 修边刀架横动往复：行程 0~300 mm、100 mm/s、端点重叠 5 mm、驻留 200 ms，单程 3 s、计数 +1。边界：行程改成 0~3 mm 时必须报组态错——行程过窄使往复退化成抖动，刀架会在同一点反复蹭料；bStop 只在段终点生效，半途硬切会在料边留刀痕。
architecture_thought: 六相 Idle/RunMin/RunMax/Dwell/Stopped/Fault，端点重叠量在目标值上做加减而不是靠机械限位。防错：行程宽度设下限闸、重叠量出域钳制、驻留 TON 无条件刷新、停止请求延迟到段终点执行。目标下发前做软限位预检（本件按契约不匹配改为内联预检，见战报偏离裁定）。

(*==============================================================================
 * 组件名称 (Component)  : FB_DL_EdgeTrimTraverse
 * 所属子库 (Sublibrary) : DL_Motion
 * 当前版本 (Version)    : 1.0.0
 * 兼容性 (Platform)     : CODESYS 3.5 / TwinCAT 3 / 汇川 InoProShop（纯标准元素，零方言）
 * 功能描述 (Function)   : 修边刀架横动往复定位。启动后在行程两端之间往复，折返点按重叠量

 *                         留刀痕）。行程过窄、速度出域判组态故障；目标越软包络在启动沿前

 *                         行程宽度判零防除零 ｜ 重叠量与驻留出域双向钳制 ｜ 非有限用自反比较
 *                         驻留定时器与沿实例无条件周期刷新 ｜ 枚举显式赋值 ｜ CASE 含 ELSE
 * 错误码表 (Codes)      : 16#0004_033B 就绪（空闲/本拍无事件）
 *                         16#0004_033C 故障级 旋转轴/横动轴拒绝运动指令
 *                         16#0004_033D 故障级 组态非法（行程宽度 < 5 mm 或速度出域）
 *                         16#0004_033E 故障级 目标越软包络，启动沿前预检拒绝（一轴不动）
 *                         16#0004_033F 预留：本版不发码（下一轮区间起点，禁止回填）
 * 修订历史 (Revision)   : 2026-11-17  v1.0.0  首版入库 · R28 · 阶段三批 2
 * 验收向量 (Acceptance) : 正向 行程 0~300 mm、100 mm/s、重叠 5 mm、驻留 200 ms → 单程
 *                         约 3 s、端点重叠 5 mm、单程计数 +1
 *                         反向 行程改 0~3 mm（宽 3 mm < 5 mm）→ 16#0004_033D；重叠给
 *                         -50 mm → 钳 0 后照常运行；目标包络外延后越限 → 16#0004_033E
 *                         且一轴不动；轴拒绝指令 → 16#0004_033C

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_TraverseState（归属本功能块，同文件发布，全库唯一定义）
 * 含义: 横动往复相位，每个成员在 CASE 中有且仅有一个标签。
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_TraverseState :
(
    eIdle    := 0,    // 空闲：等启动沿与预检 / Idle, waiting for the start edge and the pre-check
    eRunMin  := 10,   // 向负端行进 / Travelling toward the minimum end
    eRunMax  := 20,   // 向正端行进 / Travelling toward the maximum end
    eDwell   := 30,   // 端点驻留计时 / Dwell timing at an end
    eStopped := 40,   // 段终点已停：等停止请求撤除 / Stopped at the segment end, waiting for the stop request to clear
    eFault   := 99    // 故障：锁存码保持，仅启动沿重启 / Fault, the latch code is held until a start edge
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_EdgeTrimTraverse
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable       : BOOL := FALSE;        // 使能 / Enable
    bStart        : BOOL := FALSE;        // 启动，上升沿启动一次 / Start, the rising edge starts one cycle
    bStop         : BOOL := FALSE;        // 停止，电平请求，段终点生效 / Stop request, level input, effective at the segment end
    fPosMin_mm    : REAL := 0.0;          // 行程负端 [mm]，域 ±1000 / Negative travel end in millimetres, domain plus minus 1000
    fPosMax_mm    : REAL := 300.0;        // 行程正端 [mm]，须 Max − Min ≥ 5 / Positive travel end in millimetres, Max minus Min must reach 5
    fSpeed_mmS    : REAL := 100.0;        // 运行速度 [mm/s]，域 0.5~200 / Run speed in millimetres per second, domain 0.5 to 200
    fOverlap_mm   : REAL := 5.0;          // 端点重叠 [mm]，域 0~20 / End overlap in millimetres, domain 0 to 20
    tDwell        : TIME := T#200MS;      // 端点驻留 [ms]，域 0~5 s / End dwell, domain 0 to 5 s
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    iAxis         : I_DL_StepperOpenLoop; // 横动轴开环步进契约引用 [—] / Traverse axis open-loop stepper contract reference
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fPosOut_mm    : REAL;                 // 当前横动位置 [mm] / Current traverse position in millimetres
    bAtMin        : BOOL;                 // 负端到位 / At the minimum end
    bAtMax        : BOOL;                 // 正端到位 / At the maximum end
    uTraverseCnt  : UDINT;                // 累计单程数 [次] / Accumulated single passes
    eState        : E_DL_TraverseState;   // 横动相位 [—] / Traverse phase
    eErr          : UDINT;                // 错误码，段位 16#0004_xxxx / Error code in segment 16#0004_xxxx
END_VAR
VAR
    _eState       : E_DL_TraverseState := E_DL_TraverseState.eIdle; // 当前相位 / Current phase
    _bInit        : BOOL := FALSE;        // 首扫标志，取非判定 / First-scan flag, tested negated
    _bRefOk       : BOOL;                 // 契约引用有效标志 / Contract reference valid flag
    _bCfgOk       : BOOL;                 // 组态合法标志 / Configuration valid flag
    _bIssueScan   : BOOL;                 // 派单当拍标志（本拍不判就绪） / Dispatch scan flag, readiness is not judged in this scan
    _bStopPending : BOOL;                 // 段终点停止挂起标志 / Stop pending at the segment end
    _bDirMax      : BOOL;                 // 下一段方向：TRUE = 向正端 / Next segment direction, TRUE for the positive end
    _bFaultLatch  : BOOL;                 // 故障锁存标志 / Fault latch flag
    _uLatchCode   : UDINT;                // 锁存码载体 / Latch code carrier
    _fTgtHigh     : REAL;                 // 正端折返目标（含重叠）[mm] / Positive turn target including overlap
    _fTgtLow      : REAL;                 // 负端折返目标（含重叠）[mm] / Negative turn target including overlap
    _fOverlapEff  : REAL := 0.0;          // 生效重叠量（钳制后）[mm] / Effective overlap after clamping
    _fSpeedEff    : REAL := 100.0;        // 生效速度（下限兜底）[mm/s] / Effective speed with a lower bound guard
    _fDist        : REAL;                 // 本段待走距离 [mm] / Pending distance of this segment
    _rtrigStart   : R_TRIG;               // 启动上升沿 / Rising edge of the start command
    _tonDwell     : TON;                  // 端点驻留计时 / End dwell timer
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_TRV_READY   : UDINT := 16#0004_033B;  // 就绪码 / Ready code
    DL_TRV_AXIS_BAD : UDINT := 16#0004_033C; // 故障级轴拒绝码 / Fault code for a rejected axis command
    DL_TRV_CFG_BAD : UDINT := 16#0004_033D;  // 故障级组态非法码 / Fault code for bad configuration
    DL_TRV_LIMIT   : UDINT := 16#0004_033E;  // 故障级预检拒绝码 / Fault code for a pre-check rejection
    DL_TRV_W_MIN   : REAL := 5.0;            // 行程最小宽度 [mm] / Minimum travel width in millimetres
    DL_TRV_POS_HI  : REAL := 1000.0;         // 行程端点绝对值上限 [mm] / Absolute bound of the travel ends
    DL_TRV_OVL_HI  : REAL := 20.0;           // 重叠量上限 [mm] / Overlap upper bound
    DL_TRV_SPD_LO  : REAL := 0.5;            // 速度下限 [mm/s] / Speed lower bound
    DL_TRV_SPD_HI  : REAL := 200.0;          // 速度上限 [mm/s] / Speed upper bound
    DL_TRV_AT_TOL  : REAL := 0.05;           // 端点到位容差 [mm] / End-point arrival tolerance
END_VAR

// 段 1｜输出与单拍标志预置
bAtMin := FALSE;                                    // 负端到位预清 / At-minimum flag pre-cleared
bAtMax := FALSE;                                    // 正端到位预清 / At-maximum flag pre-cleared
eErr := 0;                                          // 错误码预清 / Error code pre-cleared
_bIssueScan := FALSE;                               // 派单当拍标志预清 / Dispatch scan flag pre-cleared

// 段 2｜沿检测无条件周期刷新
_rtrigStart(CLK := bStart);                         // 启动沿 / Start edge

// 段 3｜驻留定时器无条件周期刷新（仅驻留相计时）
_tonDwell(IN := (_eState = E_DL_TraverseState.eDwell), PT := tDwell);

// 段 4｜首扫初始化（判据取非，R19）
IF NOT _bInit THEN
    _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eIdle;            // 相位待机起步 / Phase starts idle
    _bInit := TRUE;                                 // 首扫只做一次 / The first scan runs once
END_IF

// 段 5｜引用与组态闸（行程宽度 < 5 mm 使往复退化为抖动）
_bRefOk := (iAxis <> 0);
_bCfgOk := _bRefOk
        AND NOT ((fPosMin_mm <> fPosMin_mm) OR ((fPosMin_mm - fPosMin_mm) <> (fPosMin_mm - fPosMin_mm)))
        AND NOT ((fPosMax_mm <> fPosMax_mm) OR ((fPosMax_mm - fPosMax_mm) <> (fPosMax_mm - fPosMax_mm)))
        AND ((fPosMax_mm - fPosMin_mm) >= DL_TRV_W_MIN)
        AND (ABS(fPosMin_mm) <= DL_TRV_POS_HI) AND (ABS(fPosMax_mm) <= DL_TRV_POS_HI)
        AND NOT ((fSpeed_mmS <> fSpeed_mmS) OR ((fSpeed_mmS - fSpeed_mmS) <> (fSpeed_mmS - fSpeed_mmS)))
        AND (fSpeed_mmS >= DL_TRV_SPD_LO) AND (fSpeed_mmS <= DL_TRV_SPD_HI)
        AND (tDwell >= T#0MS) AND (tDwell <= T#5S);
_fSpeedEff := LIMIT(DL_TRV_SPD_LO, fSpeed_mmS, DL_TRV_SPD_HI);          // 生效速度钳制 [mm/s] / Effective speed after clamping
_fOverlapEff := LIMIT(0.0, fOverlap_mm, DL_TRV_OVL_HI);                 // 重叠量钳制 [mm] / Overlap after clamping
_fTgtHigh := fPosMax_mm + _fOverlapEff;                                 // 正端折返目标（外延）[mm] / Positive turn target, extended
_fTgtLow := fPosMin_mm - _fOverlapEff;                                  // 负端折返目标（外延）[mm] / Negative turn target, extended

// 段 6｜位置回读与端点判据
IF _bRefOk THEN
    fPosOut_mm := iAxis.fPosition;                  // 当前横动位置 [mm] / Current traverse position
    bAtMax := ABS(fPosOut_mm - fTgtHigh) <= DL_TRV_AT_TOL;   // 正端到位判据 / At the positive end
    bAtMin := ABS(fPosOut_mm - fTgtLow) <= DL_TRV_AT_TOL;    // 负端到位判据 / At the negative end
ELSE
    fPosOut_mm := 0.0;                              // 引用无效：位置输出置 0 / Invalid reference, the position output is zeroed
END_IF

// 段 7｜失能闸
IF NOT bEnable THEN
    IF _bRefOk THEN
        iAxis.Stop();                               // 失能即受控停车 / Controlled stop on disable
    END_IF
    _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eIdle;            // 相位回空闲 / Phase back to idle
    _bStopPending := FALSE;                         // 停止挂起清 / Stop pending cleared
    eErr := DL_TRV_READY;                           // 失能为正常停机 / Disable is a normal stop
END_IF

// 段 8｜横动往复状态机（ENUM + CASE + ELSE 兜底）
IF bEnable THEN
    CASE _eState OF

        E_DL_TraverseState.eIdle:                   // 空闲：等启动沿，先做组态与包络预检
            IF _rtrigStart.Q THEN
                _bFaultLatch := FALSE;              // 启动沿为锁存解除路径 / The start edge releases the latch
                _uLatchCode := 0;                   // 锁存码清 / Latch code cleared
                _bStopPending := FALSE;             // 停止挂起清 / Stop pending cleared
                IF NOT _bCfgOk THEN
                    eErr := DL_TRV_CFG_BAD;         // 故障级：组态非法 / Fault, bad configuration
                    _uLatchCode := DL_TRV_CFG_BAD;
                    _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
                    _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eFault;
                ELSIF (ABS(_fTgtHigh) > DL_TRV_POS_HI) OR (ABS(_fTgtLow) > DL_TRV_POS_HI) THEN
                    eErr := DL_TRV_LIMIT;           // 故障级：重叠外延后越软包络，一轴不动 / Fault, the extended target leaves the envelope
                    _uLatchCode := DL_TRV_LIMIT;
                    _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
                    _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eFault;
                ELSE
                    _bDirMax := TRUE;               // 首段向正端 / The first segment heads to the positive end
                    _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eRunMax;
                END_IF
            ELSE
                IF NOT _bCfgOk THEN
                    eErr := DL_TRV_CFG_BAD;         // 故障级：组态非法（空闲期即报） / Fault, bad configuration reported while idle
                    _uLatchCode := DL_TRV_CFG_BAD;
                    _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
                    _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eFault;
                END_IF
            END_IF

        E_DL_TraverseState.eRunMax:                 // 向正端行进：等轴就绪，停止请求挂起
            IF _bIssueScan THEN
                _bIssueScan := FALSE;               // 派单拍已过 / The dispatch scan has passed
            ELSIF (NOT _bStopPending) AND bStop THEN
                _bStopPending := TRUE;              // 停止请求挂起，段终点生效 / Stop pending, effective at the segment end
            ELSIF iAxis.bReady THEN
                uTraverseCnt := uTraverseCnt + 1;   // 单程计数 +1 [次] / Single-pass count incremented
                IF _bStopPending THEN
                    _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eStopped;   // 段终点停车 / Stop at the segment end
                ELSE
                    _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eDwell;     // 端点驻留 / Dwell at the end
                END_IF
            END_IF

        E_DL_TraverseState.eRunMin:                 // 向负端行进：等轴就绪，停止请求挂起
            IF _bIssueScan THEN
                _bIssueScan := FALSE;
            ELSIF (NOT _bStopPending) AND bStop THEN
                _bStopPending := TRUE;
            ELSIF iAxis.bReady THEN
                uTraverseCnt := uTraverseCnt + 1;   // 单程计数 +1 [次] / Single-pass count incremented
                IF _bStopPending THEN
                    _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eStopped;
                ELSE
                    _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eDwell;
                END_IF
            END_IF

        E_DL_TraverseState.eDwell:                  // 端点驻留：计时满后换向派单
            IF _tonDwell.Q THEN
                IF _bDirMax THEN
                    _bDirMax := FALSE;              // 换向：下一段向负端 / Reverse, the next segment heads to the negative end
                    _fDist := _fTgtLow - iAxis.fPosition;      // 待走距离 [mm] / Pending distance
                ELSE
                    _bDirMax := TRUE;               // 换向：下一段向正端 / Reverse, the next segment heads to the positive end
                    _fDist := _fTgtHigh - iAxis.fPosition;     // 待走距离 [mm] / Pending distance
                END_IF
                IF iAxis.MoveRelative(_fDist, _fSpeedEff) THEN
                    _bIssueScan := TRUE;            // 派单当拍不判就绪 / Readiness is not judged in the dispatch scan
                    IF _bDirMax THEN
                        _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eRunMax;
                    ELSE
                        _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eRunMin;
                    END_IF
                    eErr := DL_TRV_READY;           // 就绪码 / Ready code
                ELSE
                    eErr := DL_TRV_AXIS_BAD;        // 故障级：轴拒绝指令 / Fault, the axis rejected the command
                    _uLatchCode := DL_TRV_AXIS_BAD;
                    _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
                    _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eFault;
                END_IF
            END_IF

        E_DL_TraverseState.eStopped:                // 段终点已停：停止请求撤除后回空闲
            IF NOT bStop THEN
                _bStopPending := FALSE;
                _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eIdle;
            END_IF
            eErr := DL_TRV_READY;

        E_DL_TraverseState.eFault:                  // 故障：锁存码保持，仅新启动沿重启
            eErr := _uLatchCode;                    // 锁存码回放 / Replay the latch code
            IF _rtrigStart.Q THEN
                _bFaultLatch := FALSE;
                _uLatchCode := 0;
                _bStopPending := FALSE;
                eErr := DL_TRV_READY;
                _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eIdle; // 回空闲需再给启动沿（下一拍） / A further start edge is required
            END_IF

        ELSE
            // 非法状态兜底（故障级）
            eErr := DL_TRV_CFG_BAD;                 // 故障级：非法相位 / Fault, illegal phase
            _uLatchCode := DL_TRV_CFG_BAD;
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE;
            _eState := E_DL_TraverseState.eFault;

    END_CASE
END_IF

eState := _eState;                                  // 相位出口镜像 / Phase mirrored to the output pin
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: NTC 通道健康度评分：无故障、漂移 0.2/2.0 ℃、噪声 0.01/0.5 ℃、权重 40/40/20 时给 100 分 Good；断线位置位且漂移 5 ℃ 时降到 60 分以下并给更换建议。边界：三个权重之和不为 100 时必须回退默认权重并报错（不停摆但要显式告警），温度非有限时本周期不计分而不是记 0 分——记 0 会把健康通道直接判死。
architecture_thought: 加权评分 + 四档等级（Good/Watch/Warn/Bad，整数分档禁浮点等判）。三因子各归一化到 0~1 后加权求和，权重和校验失败走默认权重兜底。更换建议由「Bad 等级」或「断线累计 3 次」两条正交路径产生。评分周期用 TON 自复位节拍，避免每拍重算浪费扫描时间。

 *                         健康度 100、Good
 *                         反向 断线位置位且漂移 5 ℃（限 2.0）→ 健康度 ≤60 且 bReplaceReq=TRUE；
 *                         漂移限给 0 → 16#0003_03B3；温度给 NaN → 16#0003_03B2 且健康度保持

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_HealthGrade（归属本功能块，同文件发布，全库唯一定义）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_HealthGrade :
(
    eGood  := 0,    // 良好：健康度 ≥80 / Good, health of 80 or above
    eWatch := 10,   // 关注：健康度 60~79 / Watch, health from 60 to 79
    eWarn  := 20,   // 预警：健康度 40~59 / Warn, health from 40 to 59
    eBad   := 30    // 差：健康度 <40，需更换 / Bad, health below 40, replacement required
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_NtcChannelHealth
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable        : BOOL := FALSE;       // 使能 / Enable
    fTemp_C        : REAL := 25.0;        // 该通道温度 [℃] / Channel temperature in degrees Celsius
    uChFaultMask   : WORD;                // 上游通道故障掩码 [bit]，bit0 断线 bit1 短路 bit2 超域 / Upstream channel fault mask
    fDriftTotal_C  : REAL := 0.0;         // 长期漂移（对投运基线）[℃] / Long-term drift against the commissioning baseline
    fNoise_C       : REAL := 0.0;         // 窗口噪声（标准差）[℃] / Window noise as a standard deviation
    fDriftLimit_C  : REAL := 2.0;         // 漂移扣尽阈 [℃]，域 0.5~20 / Drift limit that zeroes the score, domain 0.5 to 20
    fNoiseLimit_C  : REAL := 0.5;         // 噪声扣尽阈 [℃]，域 0.05~5 / Noise limit that zeroes the score, domain 0.05 to 5
    uFaultWeight   : UINT := 40;          // 故障权重 [—]，域 0~100 / Fault weight, domain 0 to 100
    uDriftWeight   : UINT := 40;          // 漂移权重 [—]，域 0~100 / Drift weight, domain 0 to 100
    uNoiseWeight   : UINT := 20;          // 噪声权重 [—]，域 0~100 / Noise weight, domain 0 to 100
    tEvalPeriod    : TIME := T#5S;        // 评分周期 [ms]，域 1~60 s / Scoring period, domain 1 to 60 s
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    uHealth        : UINT := 100;         // 健康度 [0~100] / Health score from 0 to 100
    eGrade         : E_DL_HealthGrade;    // 健康分档 [—] / Health grade
    bReplaceReq    : BOOL;                // 更换建议（Bad 或断线累计 3 次） / Replacement advice
    bError         : BOOL;                // 故障级标志，仅故障级码置位 / Fault-class flag, set on fault codes only
    eErr           : UDINT;               // 错误码，段位 16#0003_xxxx / Error code in segment 16#0003_xxxx
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit         : BOOL := FALSE;       // 首扫标志，取非判定 / First-scan flag, tested negated
    _bCfgOk        : BOOL;                // 组态合法标志 / Configuration valid flag
    _bFallback     : BOOL;                // 权重回退标志 / Weight fallback flag
    _bScoreNow     : BOOL;                // 本拍评分标志（周期到） / Score this scan flag
    _uwFault       : UINT := 40;          // 生效故障权重 / Effective fault weight
    _uwDrift       : UINT := 40;          // 生效漂移权重 / Effective drift weight
    _uwNoise       : UINT := 20;          // 生效噪声权重 / Effective noise weight
    _uwDisconnect  : UINT := 0;           // 断线累计次数 [次] / Disconnect count
    _uwFaultScore  : UINT;                // 故障维度得分 [0~100] / Fault dimension score
    _uwDriftScore  : UINT;                // 漂移维度得分 [0~100] / Drift dimension score
    _uwNoiseScore  : UINT;                // 噪声维度得分 [0~100] / Noise dimension score
    _uwSum         : UDINT;               // 加权和中间量 / Weighted sum intermediate
    _fDriftRatio   : REAL;                // 漂移占比（限值/实测） / Drift ratio, limit over measurement
    _fNoiseRatio   : REAL;                // 噪声占比（限值/实测） / Noise ratio, limit over measurement
    _rtrigFault    : R_TRIG;              // 断线位上升沿 / Rising edge of the disconnect bit
    _tonEval       : TON;                 // 评分周期计时（自复位） / Scoring period timer, self resetting
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_NTC_READY   : UDINT := 16#0003_03B1;  // 就绪码 / Ready code
    DL_NTC_SKIP    : UDINT := 16#0003_03B2;  // 信息级温度非有限码 / Info code for a non-finite temperature
    DL_NTC_CFG_BAD : UDINT := 16#0003_03B3;  // 故障级组态非法码 / Fault code for bad configuration
    DL_NTC_DISC    : UDINT := 16#0003_03B4;  // 故障级断线累计码 / Fault code for accumulated disconnections
    DL_NTC_BIT_DISC : WORD := 16#0001;       // 断线位 / Disconnect bit
    DL_NTC_DISC_MAX : UINT := 3;             // 断线累计阈值 [次] / Disconnect count threshold
    DL_NTC_DRIFT_LO : REAL := 0.5;           // 漂移限下限 [℃] / Drift limit lower bound
    DL_NTC_DRIFT_HI : REAL := 20.0;          // 漂移限上限 [℃] / Drift limit upper bound
    DL_NTC_NOISE_LO : REAL := 0.05;          // 噪声限下限 [℃] / Noise limit lower bound
    DL_NTC_NOISE_HI : REAL := 5.0;           // 噪声限上限 [℃] / Noise limit upper bound
    DL_NTC_GOOD     : UINT := 80;            // Good 档门限 / Good threshold
    DL_NTC_WATCH    : UINT := 60;            // Watch 档门限 / Watch threshold
    DL_NTC_WARN     : UINT := 40;            // Warn 档门限 / Warn threshold
    DL_NTC_HUNDRED  : REAL := 100.0;         // 百分比基准 / Percentage base
END_VAR

// 段 1｜输出与单拍标志预置
bError := FALSE;                                    // 故障标志预清 / Fault flag pre-cleared
eErr := 0;                                          // 错误码预清 / Error code pre-cleared
_bScoreNow := FALSE;                                // 评分标志预清 / Scoring flag pre-cleared

// 段 2｜沿检测与评分周期定时器无条件周期刷新（自复位：IN 取上一拍 Q 取非）
_rtrigFault(CLK := ((uChFaultMask AND DL_NTC_BIT_DISC) <> 16#0000));
_tonEval(IN := bEnable AND (NOT _tonEval.Q), PT := tEvalPeriod);
IF _tonEval.Q THEN
    _bScoreNow := TRUE;                             // 周期到：本拍评分 / The period elapsed, score this scan
END_IF

// 段 3｜首扫初始化（判据取非，R19）
IF NOT _bInit THEN
    uHealth := 100;                                 // 健康度起点 100 / Health starts at 100
    eGrade := E_DL_HealthGrade.eGood;               // 分档起点 Good / Grade starts good
    _bInit := TRUE;                                 // 首扫只做一次 / The first scan runs once
END_IF

// 段 4｜断线累计（上升沿计数，供更换建议）
IF _rtrigFault.Q THEN
    _uwDisconnect := _uwDisconnect + 1;             // 断线累计 +1 [次] / Disconnect count incremented
END_IF

// 段 5｜权重与限值组态闸（和 ≠100 → 回退 40/40/20 并报组态错；限值判零防除零）
_bFallback := (uFaultWeight + uDriftWeight + uNoiseWeight) <> 100;
IF _bFallback THEN
    _uwFault := 40;                                 // 回退故障权重 / Fallback fault weight
    _uwDrift := 40;                                 // 回退漂移权重 / Fallback drift weight
    _uwNoise := 20;                                 // 回退噪声权重 / Fallback noise weight
ELSE
    _uwFault := uFaultWeight;                       // 采用组态权重 / Use the configured weight
    _uwDrift := uDriftWeight;
    _uwNoise := uNoiseWeight;
END_IF
_bCfgOk := (NOT _bFallback)
        AND NOT ((fDriftLimit_C <> fDriftLimit_C) OR ((fDriftLimit_C - fDriftLimit_C) <> (fDriftLimit_C - fDriftLimit_C)))
        AND (fDriftLimit_C >= DL_NTC_DRIFT_LO) AND (fDriftLimit_C <= DL_NTC_DRIFT_HI)
        AND NOT ((fNoiseLimit_C <> fNoiseLimit_C) OR ((fNoiseLimit_C - fNoiseLimit_C) <> (fNoiseLimit_C - fNoiseLimit_C)))
        AND (fNoiseLimit_C >= DL_NTC_NOISE_LO) AND (fNoiseLimit_C <= DL_NTC_NOISE_HI)
        AND (tEvalPeriod >= T#1S) AND (tEvalPeriod <= T#60S);
IF NOT _bCfgOk THEN
    eErr := DL_NTC_CFG_BAD;                         // 故障级：组态非法 / Fault, bad configuration
    bError := TRUE;
END_IF
IF _uwDisconnect >= DL_NTC_DISC_MAX THEN
    eErr := DL_NTC_DISC;                            // 故障级：断线累计达阈值 / Fault, the disconnect count reached the threshold
    bError := TRUE;
END_IF

// 段 6｜评分（周期到且组态合法时才计分；温度非有限则本周期不计分）
IF _bScoreNow AND _bCfgOk THEN
    IF (fTemp_C <> fTemp_C) OR ((fTemp_C - fTemp_C) <> (fTemp_C - fTemp_C)) THEN
        eErr := DL_NTC_SKIP;                        // 信息级：温度非有限，本周期不计分 / Info, temperature not finite, no scoring this period
    ELSE
        // 故障维度：有任何上游故障位即 0 分
        IF uChFaultMask <> 16#0000 THEN
            _uwFaultScore := 0;                     // 故障维度 0 分 / Fault dimension scores zero
        ELSE
            _uwFaultScore := 100;                   // 故障维度满分 / Fault dimension scores full
        END_IF
        // 漂移维度：限内满分，超限按「限值 / 实测」折算
        IF ABS(fDriftTotal_C) <= fDriftLimit_C THEN
            _uwDriftScore := 100;
        ELSE
            _fDriftRatio := fDriftLimit_C / ABS(fDriftTotal_C);          // 占比 ≤1 / Ratio at most one
            _uwDriftScore := REAL_TO_UINT(_fDriftRatio * DL_NTC_HUNDRED);
        END_IF
        // 噪声维度：同法折算
        IF ABS(fNoise_C) <= fNoiseLimit_C THEN
            _uwNoiseScore := 100;
        ELSE
            _fNoiseRatio := fNoiseLimit_C / ABS(fNoise_C);               // 占比 ≤1 / Ratio at most one
            _uwNoiseScore := REAL_TO_UINT(_fNoiseRatio * DL_NTC_HUNDRED);
        END_IF
        // 加权合成（权重和恒为 100，除零不可达）
        _uwSum := (UINT_TO_UDINT(_uwFault) * UINT_TO_UDINT(_uwFaultScore)
                 + UINT_TO_UDINT(_uwDrift) * UINT_TO_UDINT(_uwDriftScore)
                 + UINT_TO_UDINT(_uwNoise) * UINT_TO_UDINT(_uwNoiseScore)) / 100;
        uHealth := UDINT_TO_UINT(_uwSum);           // 健康度落定 [0~100] / Health latched
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 7｜分档（整数比较，禁浮点等判；ENUM + CASE + ELSE 兜底）
IF uHealth >= DL_NTC_GOOD THEN
    eGrade := E_DL_HealthGrade.eGood;
ELSIF uHealth >= DL_NTC_WATCH THEN
    eGrade := E_DL_HealthGrade.eWatch;
ELSIF uHealth >= DL_NTC_WARN THEN
    eGrade := E_DL_HealthGrade.eWarn;
ELSE
    eGrade := E_DL_HealthGrade.eBad;
END_IF
CASE eGrade OF
    E_DL_HealthGrade.eGood:
        bReplaceReq := FALSE;                       // Good 不建更换 / No replacement advice for good channels
    E_DL_HealthGrade.eWatch:
        bReplaceReq := FALSE;                       // Watch 暂不更换 / No replacement advice while watching
    E_DL_HealthGrade.eWarn:
        bReplaceReq := FALSE;                       // Warn 暂不更换 / No replacement advice while warning
    E_DL_HealthGrade.eBad:
        bReplaceReq := TRUE;                        // Bad 建议更换 / Replacement advised on bad channels
    ELSE
        // 非法分档兜底：按 Bad 处理（安全侧）并报组态错
        eGrade := E_DL_HealthGrade.eBad;
        bReplaceReq := TRUE;
        eErr := DL_NTC_CFG_BAD;                     // 故障级：分档非法 / Fault, illegal grade
        bError := TRUE;
END_CASE
IF (_uwDisconnect >= DL_NTC_DISC_MAX) THEN
    bReplaceReq := TRUE;                            // 断线累计达阈值亦建议更换 / Replacement also advised on repeated disconnections
END_IF
IF eErr = 0 THEN
    eErr := DL_NTC_READY;                           // 无事件回就绪码 / Ready code when nothing else applies
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 花篮 25 槽占用双向计数：进满 25 片给满篮判据与位图 16#01FFFFFF，再出 1 片回 24 且满篮判据撤销。边界：空篮出片属计数矛盾，必须锁存并保持占用 0，绝不借位到 25——借位会把满篮误判成空篮，安全侧正好相反。同拍进出双沿物理不可能，双丢弃并报错。
architecture_thought: 位图 + 计数双表示：位图供槽位查询，计数供满空判据，两者同源更新以防漂移。防错：同拍双沿先判矛盾；下溢不借位而锁存 bCounterMismatch；写位图前判槽号 ≤ uSlotCount；槽数超 25 钳制并给信息级码；清空须在失能态执行，防运行中清零。

(

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_WaferCassetteSlot
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := FALSE;         // 使能，FALSE 锁存位图（计数冻结） / Enable, FALSE freezes the slot map
    bLoadPulse   : BOOL := FALSE;         // 进片 +1，上升沿 / Load pulse, rising edge adds one
    bUnloadPulse : BOOL := FALSE;         // 出片 −1，上升沿 / Unload pulse, rising edge subtracts one
    bClear       : BOOL := FALSE;         // 清空（换花篮），须 bEnable=FALSE / Clear for a cassette change, requires bEnable FALSE
    uSlotCount   : UINT := 25;            // 槽数 [个]，域 1~25 / Slot count, domain 1 to 25
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    uOccupied    : UINT;                  // 占用槽数 [个] / Occupied slot count
    uEmptySlot   : UINT;                  // 空槽数 [个] / Empty slot count
    bFull        : BOOL;                  // 满篮判据 / Full criterion
    bEmpty       : BOOL;                  // 空篮判据 / Empty criterion
    uSlotMask    : DWORD;                 // 占用位图 bit0=第 1 槽 … bit24=第 25 槽 [bit]（25 位须 32 位容器，规格 WORD 无法表达） / Occupancy map, 25 bits need a 32-bit container
    bCounterMismatch : BOOL;              // 计数矛盾已锁存 / Counter contradiction latched
    eErr         : UDINT;                 // 错误码，段位 16#0003_xxxx / Error code in segment 16#0003_xxxx
END_VAR
VAR
    _eState      : E_DL_CassetteState := E_DL_CassetteState.eEmpty; // 占用状态 / Occupancy state
    _bInit       : BOOL := FALSE;         // 首扫标志，取非判定 / First-scan flag, tested negated
    _bMismatch   : BOOL := FALSE;         // 矛盾锁存状态量 / Contradiction latch state quantity
    _nNet        : INT;                   // 本拍净额（+进 −出） / Net delta of this scan
    _uSlotEff    : UINT := 25;            // 生效槽数（钳制后） / Effective slot count after clamping
    _uwOccupied  : UINT;                  // 占用内部唯一写点 / The single internal write point of the occupancy
    _rtrigLoad   : R_TRIG;                // 进片上升沿 / Rising edge of the load pulse
    _rtrigUnload : R_TRIG;                // 出片上升沿 / Rising edge of the unload pulse
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_CS_READY   : UDINT := 16#0003_03B6;  // 就绪码 / Ready code
    DL_CS_CLEAR_REJ : UDINT := 16#0003_03B7; // 故障级清空被拒码 / Fault code for a rejected clear request
    DL_CS_SLOT_CLAMP : UDINT := 16#0003_03B8; // 信息级槽数钳制码 / Info code for a clamped slot count
    DL_CS_BOTH    : UDINT := 16#0003_03B9;  // 故障级双沿或满篮进片码 / Fault code for double edges or a load on a full cassette
    DL_CS_UNDER   : UDINT := 16#0003_03BA;  // 故障级空篮出片码 / Fault code for an unload on an empty cassette
    DL_CS_SLOT_MAX : UINT := 25;            // 槽数上限 [个] / Slot count upper bound
    DL_CS_FULL_MASK : DWORD := 16#01FF_FFFF; // 25 槽满位图 [bit] / Full map of 25 slots
    DL_CS_BIT0      : DWORD := 16#0000_0001; // 位图零号位常量 [bit] / Bit zero constant of the map
END_VAR

// 段 1｜输出与单拍标志预置
eErr := 0;                                          // 错误码预清 / Error code pre-cleared
_nNet := 0;                                         // 净额预清 / Net delta pre-cleared

// 段 2｜双沿沿实例无条件周期刷新（R24：严禁置于分支内）
_rtrigLoad(CLK := bLoadPulse);                      // 进片沿 / Load edge
_rtrigUnload(CLK := bUnloadPulse);                  // 出片沿 / Unload edge

// 段 3｜首扫初始化（判据取非，R19）
IF NOT _bInit THEN
    _uwOccupied := 0;                               // 占用起点 0 [个] / Occupancy starts at zero
    _bInit := TRUE;                                 // 首扫只做一次 / The first scan runs once
END_IF

// 段 4｜槽数钳制（>25 钳制并报信息级；<1 钳制到 1）
IF uSlotCount > DL_CS_SLOT_MAX THEN
    _uSlotEff := DL_CS_SLOT_MAX;                    // 槽数上限钳制 [个] / Slot count clamped to the upper bound
    eErr := DL_CS_SLOT_CLAMP;                       // 信息级：槽数已钳制 / Info, the slot count was clamped
ELSIF uSlotCount < 1 THEN
    _uSlotEff := 1;                                 // 槽数下限钳制 [个] / Slot count clamped to the lower bound
    eErr := DL_CS_SLOT_CLAMP;                       // 信息级：槽数已钳制 / Info, the slot count was clamped
ELSE
    _uSlotEff := uSlotCount;                        // 采用组态槽数 [个] / Use the configured slot count
END_IF

// 段 5｜清空请求（须失能；使能期请求被拒并报码）
IF bClear THEN
    IF bEnable THEN
        eErr := DL_CS_CLEAR_REJ;                    // 故障级：使能期清空被拒 / Fault, a clear request while enabled is rejected
    ELSE
        _uwOccupied := 0;                           // 清空占用 [个] / Occupancy cleared
        _bMismatch := FALSE;                        // 矛盾锁存解除 / Contradiction latch released
        _eState := E_DL_CassetteState.eEmpty;       // 状态回空篮 / State back to empty
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 6｜双向沿合并为净额（同拍双沿：物理不可能，双丢弃并报码）
IF _rtrigLoad.Q AND _rtrigUnload.Q THEN
    _nNet := 0;                                     // 双沿丢弃 / Both edges discarded
    eErr := DL_CS_BOTH;                             // 故障级：同拍双沿 / Fault, both edges in the same scan
ELSIF _rtrigLoad.Q THEN
    _nNet := 1;                                     // 进片 +1 / Load adds one
ELSIF _rtrigUnload.Q THEN
    _nNet := -1;                                    // 出片 −1 / Unload subtracts one
ELSE
    _nNet := 0;                                     // 无沿 / No edge
END_IF

// 段 7｜净额一次性施加（占用唯一写点；越界一律拒绝，不借位）
IF bEnable AND (NOT _bMismatch) THEN
    IF _nNet > 0 THEN
        IF _uwOccupied >= _uSlotEff THEN
            eErr := DL_CS_BOTH;                     // 故障级：满篮进片 / Fault, a load on a full cassette
        ELSE
            _uwOccupied := _uwOccupied + 1;         // 占用 +1（唯一写点）[个] / Occupancy incremented, the single write point
        END_IF
    ELSIF _nNet < 0 THEN
        IF _uwOccupied = 0 THEN
            _bMismatch := TRUE;                     // 空篮出片：锁存矛盾，不借位到 25 / Unload on an empty cassette, the contradiction is latched
            _eState := E_DL_CassetteState.eFault;
            eErr := DL_CS_UNDER;                    // 故障级：空篮出片 / Fault, an unload on an empty cassette
        ELSE
            _uwOccupied := _uwOccupied - 1;         // 占用 −1（唯一写点）[个] / Occupancy decremented, the single write point
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 8｜位图维护（先低槽后高槽顺序填充；出片清最低置位位；写前判槽号 ≤ 槽数）
IF (NOT _bMismatch) AND (_uwOccupied > 0) THEN
    IF _uwOccupied >= DL_CS_SLOT_MAX THEN
        uSlotMask := DL_CS_FULL_MASK;               // 满 25 槽：满位图 [bit] / All 25 slots, the full map
    ELSE
        uSlotMask := SHL(DL_CS_BIT0, UINT_TO_UDINT(_uwOccupied)) - DL_CS_BIT0;   // 低 _uwOccupied 槽全置位 [bit] / The lowest occupied slots are set
    END_IF
ELSE
    uSlotMask := 16#0000_0000;                      // 空篮或矛盾锁存：位图清 / Empty or latched mismatch, the map is cleared
END_IF

// 段 9｜出口判据（占用/空槽/满/空）
uOccupied := _uwOccupied;                           // 占用出口 [个] / Occupancy output
IF _uwOccupied >= _uSlotEff THEN
    uEmptySlot := 0;                                // 满篮：空槽 0 [个] / Full, no empty slot
ELSE
    uEmptySlot := _uSlotEff - _uwOccupied;          // 空槽数 [个] / Empty slot count
END_IF
bFull := (_uwOccupied >= _uSlotEff);                // 满篮判据 / Full criterion
bEmpty := (_uwOccupied = 0);                        // 空篮判据 / Empty criterion
bCounterMismatch := _bMismatch;                     // 矛盾锁存出口 / Contradiction latch output

// 段 10｜占用状态映射（ENUM + CASE + ELSE 兜底）
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_CassetteState.eEmpty:
        IF _uwOccupied > 0 THEN
            IF _uwOccupied >= _uSlotEff THEN
                _eState := E_DL_CassetteState.eFull;    // 直接满篮 / Straight to full
            ELSE
                _eState := E_DL_CassetteState.ePart;    // 部分占用 / Partially occupied
            END_IF
        END_IF
    E_DL_CassetteState.ePart:
        IF _uwOccupied = 0 THEN
            _eState := E_DL_CassetteState.eEmpty;       // 回空篮 / Back to empty
        ELSIF _uwOccupied >= _uSlotEff THEN
            _eState := E_DL_CassetteState.eFull;        // 转满篮 / To full
        END_IF
    E_DL_CassetteState.eFull:
        IF _uwOccupied = 0 THEN
            _eState := E_DL_CassetteState.eEmpty;       // 全出完回空篮 / Back to empty after unloading all
        ELSIF _uwOccupied < _uSlotEff THEN
            _eState := E_DL_CassetteState.ePart;        // 转部分占用 / To partially occupied
        END_IF
    E_DL_CassetteState.eFault:
        IF NOT _bMismatch THEN
            _eState := E_DL_CassetteState.eEmpty;       // 清空解除后回空篮 / Back to empty after the clear
        END_IF
    ELSE
        // 非法状态兜底：按矛盾锁存处理（安全侧）
        _bMismatch := TRUE;
        _eState := E_DL_CassetteState.eFault;
        eErr := DL_CS_UNDER;                            // 故障级：非法状态 / Fault, illegal state
END_CASE
IF eErr = 0 THEN
    eErr := DL_CS_READY;                                // 无事件回就绪码 / Ready code when nothing else applies
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 层压机上下腔真空协调：目标 0.5 kPa、差压上限 3 kPa，上腔 5/下腔 12 时差压 7 越限，只降抽得快的一侧（上泵），双侧都到 0.5 kPa 才给达标。边界：目标真空高于当地大气压（如 105 kPa）属组态错须拒绝；段超时保持当前抽速而不归零——归零等于放弃已建立的真空度。
architecture_thought: 四段顺控（粗抽/平衡/精抽/保压）+ 双侧抽速指令输出。差压保护只调单侧是本件的核心语义：双侧同降会让时长翻倍且不解决差压。单侧读数非有限按 0 处理并报码，双侧都坏才停车；段超时只保持不撤速。真空达标判据要求双侧同时满足，禁用「任一达标」。

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_LamSeg（归属本功能块，同文件发布，全库唯一定义；数值即 uSeg 出口值）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_LamSeg :
(
    eIdle    := 0,    // 待机：未启动 / Idle, not started
    eRough   := 1,    // 粗抽：双泵全速 / Rough pumping, both pumps at full speed
    eBalance := 2,    // 平衡：差压保护优先 / Balancing, the differential guard has priority
    eFine    := 3,    // 精抽：双泵趋近目标 / Fine pumping toward the target
    eHold    := 4,    // 保压：双腔达标保持 / Hold, both chambers at the target
    eFault   := 9     // 故障：抽速保持当前值 / Fault, the speeds keep their present values
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_LamCtrlDualZone
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable        : BOOL := FALSE;       // 使能 / Enable
    bStartSeq      : BOOL := FALSE;       // 启动顺控，上升沿 / Start the sequence, rising edge
    fVacUpper_kPa  : REAL := 101.3;       // 上腔真空 [kPa(abs)]，域 0~101.3 / Upper chamber vacuum
    fVacLower_kPa  : REAL := 101.3;       // 下腔真空 [kPa(abs)]，域 0~101.3 / Lower chamber vacuum
    fVacTarget_kPa : REAL := 0.5;         // 目标真空 [kPa(abs)]，域 0.1~101 / Target vacuum
    fAmbient_kPa   : REAL := 101.3;       // 当地大气压 [kPa(abs)] / Local atmospheric pressure
    fDpMax_kPa     : REAL := 3.0;         // 差压上限 [kPa]，域 0.5~20 / Differential pressure limit
    fSpeedUpper    : REAL := 100.0;       // 上泵抽速给定 [%]，域 0~100 / Upper pump speed setpoint in percent
    fSpeedLower    : REAL := 100.0;       // 下泵抽速给定 [%]，域 0~100 / Lower pump speed setpoint in percent
    tSegMax        : TIME := T#60S;       // 各段超时 [ms]，域 1~600 s / Per-segment timeout
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bVacOk         : BOOL;                // 双腔达标（双侧都不高于目标） / Both chambers at or below the target
    fDp_kPa        : REAL;                // 实时差压（上减下）[kPa] / Differential pressure, upper minus lower
    uSeg           : UINT;                // 当前段 1 粗抽 2 平衡 3 精抽 4 保压 0 待机 9 故障 [—] / Current segment
    fSpeedUpCmd    : REAL;                // 上泵指令 [%] / Upper pump command in percent
    fSpeedLowCmd   : REAL;                // 下泵指令 [%] / Lower pump command in percent
    bDpGuardActive : BOOL;                // 差压保护介入 / Differential guard active
    eErr           : UDINT;               // 错误码，段位 16#0003_xxxx / Error code in segment 16#0003_xxxx
END_VAR
VAR
    _eSeg          : E_DL_LamSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eIdle; // 当前段 / Current segment
    _bInit         : BOOL := FALSE;       // 首扫标志，取非判定 / First-scan flag, tested negated
    _bCfgOk        : BOOL;                // 组态合法标志 / Configuration valid flag
    _bUpOk         : BOOL;                // 上腔读数有限 / Upper reading finite
    _bLowOk        : BOOL;                // 下腔读数有限 / Lower reading finite
    _fUp           : REAL;                // 上腔生效值（非有限按 0）[kPa(abs)] / Effective upper value
    _fLow          : REAL;                // 下腔生效值（非有限按 0）[kPa(abs)] / Effective lower value
    _fSpeedUp      : REAL := 100.0;       // 上泵内部指令 [%] / Internal upper command
    _fSpeedLow     : REAL := 100.0;       // 下泵内部指令 [%] / Internal lower command
    _fSegSec       : REAL;                // 段超时换算秒 [s] / Segment timeout in seconds
    _rtrigStart    : R_TRIG;              // 启动上升沿 / Rising edge of the start command
    _tonSeg        : TON;                 // 段超时计时 / Segment timeout timer
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_LAM_READY   : UDINT := 16#0003_03BB;  // 就绪码 / Ready code
    DL_LAM_DP_BAD  : UDINT := 16#0003_03BC;  // 故障级差压上限非法码 / Fault code for an invalid limit
    DL_LAM_TGT_BAD : UDINT := 16#0003_03BD;  // 故障级目标不可达码 / Fault code for an unreachable target
    DL_LAM_SEG_TO  : UDINT := 16#0003_03BE;  // 故障级段超时码 / Fault code for a segment timeout
    DL_LAM_SIDE_BAD : UDINT := 16#0003_03BF; // 故障级单侧非有限码 / Fault code for a non-finite side
    DL_LAM_DP_LO   : REAL := 0.5;            // 差压上限下限 [kPa] / Differential limit lower bound
    DL_LAM_DP_HI   : REAL := 20.0;           // 差压上限上限 [kPa] / Differential limit upper bound
    DL_LAM_TGT_LO  : REAL := 0.1;            // 目标真空下限 [kPa(abs)] / Target lower bound
    DL_LAM_SPD_MIN : REAL := 20.0;           // 差压保护降速后的保底抽速 [%] / Minimum speed kept by the guard
    DL_LAM_BAL_K   : REAL := 2.0;            // 平衡相触发倍率（压力 ≤ 倍率×目标即转平衡） / Balancing trigger factor
END_VAR

// 段 1｜输出与单拍标志预置
bVacOk := FALSE;                                    // 达标标志预清 / Target-reached flag pre-cleared
bDpGuardActive := FALSE;                            // 差压保护标志预清 / Guard flag pre-cleared
eErr := 0;                                          // 错误码预清 / Error code pre-cleared

// 段 2｜沿检测与段超时定时器无条件周期刷新
_rtrigStart(CLK := bStartSeq);                      // 启动沿 / Start edge
_tonSeg(IN := (_eSeg <> E_DL_LamSeg.eIdle) AND (_eSeg <> E_DL_LamSeg.eHold) AND (_eSeg <> E_DL_LamSeg.eFault), PT := tSegMax);

// 段 3｜首扫初始化（判据取非，R19）
IF NOT _bInit THEN
    _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eIdle;                     // 段待机起步 / Segment starts idle
    _bInit := TRUE;                                 // 首扫只做一次 / The first scan runs once
END_IF

// 段 4｜组态闸（差压上限判零防除零；目标必须低于大气压）
_bCfgOk := NOT ((fDpMax_kPa <> fDpMax_kPa) OR ((fDpMax_kPa - fDpMax_kPa) <> (fDpMax_kPa - fDpMax_kPa)))
        AND (fDpMax_kPa >= DL_LAM_DP_LO) AND (fDpMax_kPa <= DL_LAM_DP_HI)
        AND (fVacTarget_kPa >= DL_LAM_TGT_LO)
        AND NOT ((fVacTarget_kPa <> fVacTarget_kPa) OR ((fVacTarget_kPa - fVacTarget_kPa) <> (fVacTarget_kPa - fVacTarget_kPa)))
        AND (fAmbient_kPa > 0.0);
IF _bCfgOk AND (fVacTarget_kPa >= fAmbient_kPa) THEN
    eErr := DL_LAM_TGT_BAD;                         // 故障级：目标不可达（≥ 大气压） / Fault, the target is unreachable
    _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eFault;
ELSIF NOT _bCfgOk THEN
    eErr := DL_LAM_DP_BAD;                          // 故障级：差压上限非法 / Fault, the differential limit is invalid
    _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eFault;
END_IF

// 段 5｜单侧读数闸（非有限侧按 0 = 最好真空；双侧齐发则停车保压）
_bUpOk := NOT ((fVacUpper_kPa <> fVacUpper_kPa) OR ((fVacUpper_kPa - fVacUpper_kPa) <> (fVacUpper_kPa - fVacUpper_kPa)));
_bLowOk := NOT ((fVacLower_kPa <> fVacLower_kPa) OR ((fVacLower_kPa - fVacLower_kPa) <> (fVacLower_kPa - fVacLower_kPa)));
IF _bUpOk THEN
    _fUp := fVacUpper_kPa;                          // 上腔有效值 [kPa(abs)] / Effective upper value
ELSE
    _fUp := 0.0;                                    // 上腔按 0（保守：视为最好真空）/ Upper side treated as zero, the conservative assumption
    eErr := DL_LAM_SIDE_BAD;                        // 故障级：上腔非有限 / Fault, the upper reading is not finite
END_IF
IF _bLowOk THEN
    _fLow := fVacLower_kPa;                         // 下腔有效值 [kPa(abs)] / Effective lower value
ELSE
    _fLow := 0.0;                                   // 下腔按 0 / Lower side treated as zero
    eErr := DL_LAM_SIDE_BAD;                        // 故障级：下腔非有限 / Fault, the lower reading is not finite
END_IF
IF (NOT _bUpOk) AND (NOT _bLowOk) THEN
    _fSpeedUp := 0.0;                               // 双侧非有限：上泵停车 [%] / Both sides invalid, the upper pump stops
    _fSpeedLow := 0.0;                              // 双侧非有限：下泵停车 [%] / Both sides invalid, the lower pump stops
    _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eFault;
END_IF

// 段 6｜差压求取与保护（只降抽得快的一侧）
fDp_kPa := _fUp - _fLow;                            // 差压 = 上 − 下 [kPa] / Differential pressure
IF ABS(fDp_kPa) > fDpMax_kPa THEN
    bDpGuardActive := TRUE;                         // 差压保护介入 / The guard intervenes
    IF _fUp < _fLow THEN
        _fSpeedUp := MAX(DL_LAM_SPD_MIN, _fSpeedUp * 0.5);   // 上腔抽得快：降上泵 [%] / The upper chamber pumps faster, slow it down
    ELSE
        _fSpeedLow := MAX(DL_LAM_SPD_MIN, _fSpeedLow * 0.5); // 下腔抽得快：降下泵 [%] / The lower chamber pumps faster, slow it down
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 7｜失能闸
IF NOT bEnable THEN
    _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eIdle;                     // 段回待机 / Segment back to idle
    _fSpeedUp := 0.0;                               // 上泵指令 0 [%] / Upper command zeroed
    _fSpeedLow := 0.0;                              // 下泵指令 0 [%] / Lower command zeroed
    eErr := DL_LAM_READY;                           // 失能为正常停机 / Disable is a normal stop
END_IF

// 段 8｜双腔达标判据（双侧都不高于目标）
bVacOk := (_fUp <= fVacTarget_kPa) AND (_fLow <= fVacTarget_kPa) AND _bUpOk AND _bLowOk;

// 段 9｜四段顺控（ENUM + CASE + ELSE 兜底）
IF bEnable THEN
    CASE _eSeg OF

        E_DL_LamSeg.eIdle:                          // 待机：启动沿开粗抽
            _fSpeedUp := 0.0;
            _fSpeedLow := 0.0;
            IF _rtrigStart.Q THEN
                _fSpeedUp := LIMIT(0.0, fSpeedUpper, 100.0);   // 上泵按给定 [%] / Upper pump at the setpoint
                _fSpeedLow := LIMIT(0.0, fSpeedLower, 100.0);  // 下泵按给定 [%] / Lower pump at the setpoint
                _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eRough;                   // 进入粗抽 / Enter rough pumping
            END_IF

        E_DL_LamSeg.eRough:                         // 粗抽：任一侧到 2×目标即转平衡
            IF (_fUp <= (fVacTarget_kPa * DL_LAM_BAL_K)) OR (_fLow <= (fVacTarget_kPa * DL_LAM_BAL_K)) THEN
                _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eBalance;
            ELSIF _tonSeg.Q THEN
                eErr := DL_LAM_SEG_TO;              // 故障级：粗抽段超时（抽速保持） / Fault, the rough segment timed out
                _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eFault;
            END_IF

        E_DL_LamSeg.eBalance:                       // 平衡：差压回到限内即转精抽
            _fSpeedUp := MAX(_fSpeedUp, DL_LAM_SPD_MIN);       // 平衡段保底抽速 [%] / Minimum speed while balancing
            _fSpeedLow := MAX(_fSpeedLow, DL_LAM_SPD_MIN);
            IF ABS(fDp_kPa) <= fDpMax_kPa THEN
                _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eFine;
            ELSIF _tonSeg.Q THEN
                eErr := DL_LAM_SEG_TO;              // 故障级：平衡段超时 / Fault, the balancing segment timed out
                _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eFault;
            END_IF

        E_DL_LamSeg.eFine:                          // 精抽：双腔达标即保压
            _fSpeedUp := MAX(_fSpeedUp, DL_LAM_SPD_MIN);
            _fSpeedLow := MAX(_fSpeedLow, DL_LAM_SPD_MIN);
            IF bVacOk THEN
                _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eHold;
            ELSIF _tonSeg.Q THEN
                eErr := DL_LAM_SEG_TO;              // 故障级：精抽段超时 / Fault, the fine segment timed out
                _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eFault;
            END_IF

        E_DL_LamSeg.eHold:                          // 保压：保持当前抽速，达标仍然成立
            IF NOT bVacOk THEN
                _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eFine;         // 真空劣化：回精抽 / Vacuum degraded, back to fine pumping
            END_IF

        E_DL_LamSeg.eFault:                         // 故障：抽速保持当前值（不归零）
            eErr := DL_LAM_SEG_TO;                  // 故障级：故障段以段超时码承载 / The fault segment is carried by the timeout code
            IF _rtrigStart.Q THEN
                _fSpeedUp := LIMIT(0.0, fSpeedUpper, 100.0);   // 重启：按给定恢复 [%] / Restart restores the setpoint
                _fSpeedLow := LIMIT(0.0, fSpeedLower, 100.0);
                _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eRough;
            END_IF

        ELSE
            // 非法段兜底（故障级，差压上限码承载）
            eErr := DL_LAM_DP_BAD;                  // 故障级：非法段值 / Fault, illegal segment value
            _eSeg := E_DL_LamSeg.eFault;
    END_CASE
END_IF

uSeg := 0;                                     // 段出口预置 / Segment output pre-set
CASE _eSeg OF
    E_DL_LamSeg.eIdle:    uSeg := 0;                // 待机 / Idle
    E_DL_LamSeg.eRough:   uSeg := 1;                // 粗抽 / Rough
    E_DL_LamSeg.eBalance: uSeg := 2;                // 平衡 / Balance
    E_DL_LamSeg.eFine:    uSeg := 3;                // 精抽 / Fine
    E_DL_LamSeg.eHold:    uSeg := 4;                // 保压 / Hold
    E_DL_LamSeg.eFault:   uSeg := 9;                // 故障 / Fault
    ELSE
        uSeg := 9;                                  // 非法段按故障段出口 / Illegal segments are reported as fault
END_CASE
fSpeedUpCmd := _fSpeedUp;                           // 上泵指令出口 [%] / Upper command output
fSpeedLowCmd := _fSpeedLow;                         // 下泵指令出口 [%] / Lower command output
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 层压机保压段真空泄漏率诊断：1.0→1.05 kPa/60 s 得 0.05 kPa/min，上限 0.1 时不报；1.0→1.5 得 0.5 则报警；基线 0.02、当前 0.06（3 倍）给预警。边界：只在保压段计速率（其他段压降是工艺造成）；基线样本不足时绝不报警——未标定的报警等于噪声。
architecture_thought: 速率 = 压差/时长（时间转换链），基线 = 满窗均值，两级判据：越基线倍数给预警、越绝对上限给报警。防错：真空上升（负泄漏，属放气）不刷新基线，否则放气抬高基线后真泄漏永不报警；样本数下限 3；速率非有限跳过本拍；分母判零前置。

 * 修订历史 (Revision)   : 2026-11-17  v1.0.0  首版入库 · R28 · 阶段三批 3
 * 验收向量 (Acceptance) : 正向 1.0→1.05 kPa/60 s（0.05 kPa/min）、上限 0.1 → 不报警
 *                         反向 1.0→1.5 kPa/60 s（0.5 kPa/min）超上限 0.1 → bLeakAlarm；基线
 *                         0.02、当前 0.06（3 倍 > 倍率 1.1）→ bLeakWarn；上限给 0 →
 *                         16#0005_0432；压强给 NaN → 16#0005_0434 且基线不刷新
