TYPE E_DL_NrStatus :
(
    eOk        := 0,    // 收敛：残差已达容差 / converged, residual within tolerance
    eMaxIter   := 10,   // 达迭代上限未收敛 / iteration cap reached without convergence
    eDerivZero := 20,   // 导数近零：牛顿方向不可用 / derivative near zero, direction unusable
    eNonFinite := 30,   // 迭代中出非有限值（发散）/ non-finite value during iteration, diverged
    eBadArg    := 40,   // 入参非法：系数全零或入参非有限 / illegal argument, zero polynomial or non-finite input
    eNoRoot    := 50    // 停滞：残差连续无改善 / stalled, residual stopped improving
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION FC_DL_NewtonRaphson : LREAL
VAR_IN_OUT
    afCoef      : ARRAY[0..8] OF LREAL;      // 多项式系数 a0..a8，下标即 x 的幂次 [无量纲]，引用型入参由调用方绑定 / coefficients a0..a8, subscript is the power of x [dimensionless], reference parameter bound by caller
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    lrX0        : LREAL := 0.0;              // 迭代初值 [无量纲] / initial guess [dimensionless]
    lrTol       : LREAL := 1.0E-9;           // 残差收敛容差 [无量纲]，双端钳定 / residual tolerance [dimensionless], clamped both ends
    lrDerivEps  : LREAL := 1.0E-10;          // 导数近零阈值 [无量纲]，导子绝对值小于即退出 / derivative near-zero threshold [dimensionless]
    nMaxIterIn  : INT := 50;                 // 期望最大迭代次数 [次]，超硬上限被钳 / requested max iterations [count], hard capped
    bUseNumDiff : BOOL := FALSE;             // 真 = 迭代内前向差分求导，假 = 解析导数 / true for in-loop forward difference, false for analytic derivative
    lrDiffStep  : LREAL := 1.0E-6;           // 差分步长 [无量纲]，域 大于零 / forward difference step [dimensionless], domain greater than zero
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    eStatus     : E_DL_NrStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eOk; // 求根结果状态 [枚举] / root finding status [enum]
    nIterUsed   : INT := 0;                  // 实际迭代次数 [次] / iterations actually used [count]
    lrResidual  : LREAL := 0.0;              // 末次残差绝对值 [无量纲] / last absolute residual [dimensionless]
    bConverged  : BOOL := FALSE;             // 是否收敛 [-] / converged flag
    bError      : BOOL := FALSE;             // 是否未达成（任何非 eOk 状态）[-] / not achieved flag for any non-ok status
    bValid      : BOOL := FALSE;             // 根值是否可交付使用 [-] / root deliverable flag
END_VAR
VAR
    lrX         : LREAL := 0.0;              // 当前迭代点 [无量纲] / current iterate [dimensionless]
    lrFx        : LREAL := 0.0;              // 当前函数值 f(x) [无量纲] / current function value [dimensionless]
    lrFxH       : LREAL := 0.0;              // 差分点上函数值 f(x+h) [无量纲] / function value at the difference point [dimensionless]
    lrDf        : LREAL := 0.0;              // 当前导数值 f'(x) [无量纲] / current derivative value [dimensionless]
    lrStep      : LREAL := 0.0;              // 本步位移量 [无量纲] / current Newton step [dimensionless]
    lrResPrev   : LREAL := 0.0;              // 上一轮残差绝对值，停滞判据用 [无量纲] / previous residual for stall detection [dimensionless]
    lrTolUse    : LREAL := 1.0E-9;           // 钳定后的实际容差 [无量纲] / clamped effective tolerance [dimensionless]
    lrEpsUse    : LREAL := 1.0E-10;          // 钳定后的实际导数阈值 [无量纲] / clamped effective derivative threshold [dimensionless]
    lrHUse      : LREAL := 1.0E-6;           // 钳定后的实际差分步长 [无量纲] / clamped effective difference step [dimensionless]
    nIdx        : INT := 0;                  // 系数下标游标，向下递减 [下标] / coefficient index cursor, decremented [index]
    nIter       : INT := 0;                  // 迭代计数 [次] / iteration counter [count]
    nMaxIter    : INT := 1;                  // 钳定后的迭代上限 [次] / clamped iteration cap [count]
    nStall      : INT := 0;                  // 残差无改善连续计数 [次] / consecutive no-improvement count [count]
    bLoop       : BOOL := FALSE;             // 迭代循环续行标志 [-] / loop continuation flag
    bFinite     : BOOL := FALSE;             // 根值有限性判定暂存 [-] / root finiteness latch
    bCoefNz     : BOOL := FALSE;             // 多项式非全零判定暂存 [-] / non-zero polynomial latch
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_NR_ORD       : INT := 8;              // 多项式最高幂次，等于系数数组上界 [幂次] / highest polynomial order, equals coefficient upper bound
    DL_NR_ITER_CAP  : INT := 200;            // 迭代次数硬上限，防死锁 [次] / hard iteration cap against deadlock [count]
    DL_NR_TOL_MIN   : LREAL := 1.0E-12;      // 容差下限，防永不达标空转 [无量纲] / tolerance lower bound [dimensionless]
    DL_NR_TOL_MAX   : LREAL := 1.0E-1;       // 容差上限，防未迭代即判收敛 [无量纲] / tolerance upper bound [dimensionless]
    DL_NR_EPS_MIN   : LREAL := 1.0E-15;      // 导数阈值下限，防零阈致除零 [无量纲] / derivative threshold lower bound [dimensionless]
    DL_NR_STALL_CAP : INT := 5;              // 残差无改善连续次数上限 [次] / stall count cap [count]
    DL_NR_STEP_MAX  : LREAL := 1.0E9;        // 单步位移绝对上限 [无量纲] / single step absolute cap [dimensionless]
    DL_NR_H_MIN     : LREAL := 1.0E-9;       // 差分步长下限 [无量纲] / difference step lower bound [dimensionless]
    DL_NR_H_MAX     : LREAL := 1.0E-1;       // 差分步长上限 [无量纲] / difference step upper bound [dimensionless]
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与错误状态预置，任何早退路径不留脏码 / segment 1, preset return value and error states, no dirty code on any early exit
FC_DL_NewtonRaphson := lrX0; // 返回值预置初值，非有限根时即以此值出口 / preset return to the initial guess, also the fallback when the root is non-finite
eStatus    := E_DL_NrStatus.eOk; // 状态预置收敛，后续按判定改写 / preset status to converged, rewritten by the following gates
nIterUsed  := 0; // 迭代计数出口预置零 / preset iteration count outlet to zero
lrResidual := 0.0; // 残差出口预置零 / preset residual outlet to zero
bConverged := FALSE; // 收敛标志预置假 / preset converged flag to false
bError     := FALSE; // 错误标志预置假 / preset error flag to false
bValid     := FALSE; // 有效标志预置假 / preset valid flag to false
lrX        := lrX0; // 迭代点从初值起步 / start the iterate from the initial guess

// 段 2｜入参域闸：容差双端钳定、迭代上限钳定、差分步长钳定、初值有限性 / segment 2, argument domain gate for tolerance, iteration cap, difference step and initial guess finiteness
lrTolUse := lrTol; // 容差默认直通 / tolerance passes through by default
IF lrTolUse <> lrTolUse THEN // 自反判 NaN / self-inequality detects NaN
    lrTolUse := DL_NR_TOL_MIN; // NaN 回落下限 / NaN falls back to the lower bound
END_IF
IF lrTolUse < DL_NR_TOL_MIN THEN // 容差过小 / tolerance too small
    lrTolUse := DL_NR_TOL_MIN; // 抬到下限，防永不达标空转 / raised to the lower bound against endless spinning
ELSIF lrTolUse > DL_NR_TOL_MAX THEN // 容差过大 / tolerance too large
    lrTolUse := DL_NR_TOL_MAX; // 压到上限，防未迭代即判收敛 / pressed to the upper bound against premature convergence
END_IF

lrEpsUse := lrDerivEps; // 导数阈值默认直通 / derivative threshold passes through by default
IF lrEpsUse <> lrEpsUse THEN // 自反判 NaN / self-inequality detects NaN
    lrEpsUse := DL_NR_EPS_MIN; // NaN 回落下限 / NaN falls back to the lower bound
END_IF
IF lrEpsUse < DL_NR_EPS_MIN THEN // 阈值过小 / threshold too small
    lrEpsUse := DL_NR_EPS_MIN; // 抬到下限，防除子近零 / raised against a near-zero divisor
ELSIF lrEpsUse > 1.0E-3 THEN // 阈值过大 / threshold too large
    lrEpsUse := 1.0E-3; // 压到 1E-3，防正常导数被误判近零 / pressed to 1E-3 against false near-zero verdicts
END_IF

lrHUse := lrDiffStep; // 差分步长默认直通 / difference step passes through by default
IF lrHUse <> lrHUse THEN // 自反判 NaN / self-inequality detects NaN
    lrHUse := 1.0E-6; // NaN 回落默认步长 / NaN falls back to the default step
END_IF
IF lrHUse < DL_NR_H_MIN THEN // 步长过小 / step too small
    lrHUse := DL_NR_H_MIN; // 抬到下限，防差分除子近零 / raised against a near-zero difference divisor
ELSIF lrHUse > DL_NR_H_MAX THEN // 步长过大 / step too large
    lrHUse := DL_NR_H_MAX; // 压到上限，防差分失真 / pressed against difference distortion
END_IF

nMaxIter := nMaxIterIn; // 迭代上限默认直通 / iteration cap passes through by default
IF nMaxIter < 1 THEN // 上限非法 / illegal cap
    nMaxIter := 1; // 钳到最少一次 / clamped to at least one iteration
ELSIF nMaxIter > DL_NR_ITER_CAP THEN // 上限越硬顶 / cap above the hard ceiling
    nMaxIter := DL_NR_ITER_CAP; // 钳到硬上限，防死锁 / clamped to the hard ceiling against deadlock
END_IF

// 段 3｜初值与系数有限性闸：非有限即判入参非法，不进迭代 / segment 3, finiteness gate on the initial guess and coefficients, illegal arguments never enter the loop
IF (lrX0 <> lrX0) OR ((lrX0 - lrX0) <> (lrX0 - lrX0)) THEN // 初值 NaN 或无穷 / initial guess is NaN or infinity
    eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eBadArg; // 入参非法 / illegal argument
    bError  := TRUE; // 置错误标志 / raise error flag
    bValid  := FALSE; // 出口不可用 / outlet unusable
    nIterUsed := 0; // 零次迭代 / zero iterations executed
    RETURN; // 早退，返回预置初值 / early exit with the preset initial guess
END_IF

bCoefNz := FALSE; // 多项式非全零标志预置假 / preset non-zero polynomial flag to false
nIdx := 0; // 下标游标归零 / reset the index cursor
WHILE nIdx <= DL_NR_ORD DO // 系数有限性与非全零双重扫查 / dual sweep for coefficient finiteness and non-zero content
    IF (afCoef[nIdx] <> afCoef[nIdx]) OR ((afCoef[nIdx] - afCoef[nIdx]) <> (afCoef[nIdx] - afCoef[nIdx])) THEN // 单项非有限 / single coefficient non-finite
        eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eBadArg; // 入参非法 / illegal argument
        bError  := TRUE; // 置错误标志 / raise error flag
        bValid  := FALSE; // 出口不可用 / outlet unusable
        RETURN; // 早退，返回预置初值 / early exit with the preset initial guess
    END_IF
    IF ABS(afCoef[nIdx]) > 0.0 THEN // 存在非零系数 / a non-zero coefficient exists
        bCoefNz := TRUE; // 置非全零标志 / raise the non-zero flag
    END_IF
    nIdx := nIdx + 1; // 游标递增，上界由 8 约束 / increment the cursor, upper bound fixed by eight
END_WHILE
IF NOT bCoefNz THEN // 全零多项式，任何点都是根 / zero polynomial, every point is a root
    eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eBadArg; // 入参非法，无求根意义 / illegal argument, root finding is meaningless
    bError  := TRUE; // 置错误标志 / raise error flag
    bValid  := FALSE; // 出口不可用 / outlet unusable
    RETURN; // 早退，返回预置初值 / early exit with the preset initial guess
END_IF

// 段 4｜牛顿迭代主循环：每轮先求值求导，再四级出口闸（收敛 / 导数近零 / 非有限 / 停滞）/ segment 4, Newton main loop with four exit gates per round
nIter    := 0; // 迭代计数清零 / reset the iteration counter
nStall   := 0; // 停滞计数清零 / reset the stall counter
lrResPrev := 0.0; // 残差快照清零 / reset the residual snapshot
bLoop    := TRUE; // 循环续行标志置真 / arm the loop continuation flag
WHILE bLoop AND (nIter < nMaxIter) DO // 循环条件含硬上限，双保险 / loop condition carries the hard cap as a second safety
    nIter := nIter + 1; // 迭代计数递增 / increment the iteration counter

    // 段 4.1｜Horner 同步求 f(x) 与解析 f'(x)，单遍复杂度 O(n) / segment 4.1, Horner yields both value and analytic derivative in one pass
    lrFx := afCoef[DL_NR_ORD]; // 从最高幂次系数起步 / start from the highest order coefficient
    lrDf := 0.0; // 导数累加器清零 / reset the derivative accumulator
    nIdx := DL_NR_ORD - 1; // 从次高幂次开始递减 / start one order below the highest
    WHILE nIdx >= 0 DO // 显式递减，规避负步进 FOR 的可移植风险 / explicit decrement avoids the portability risk of negative-step FOR
        lrDf := lrDf * lrX + lrFx; // 导数 Horner 递推 / derivative Horner recursion
        lrFx := lrFx * lrX + afCoef[nIdx]; // 函数值 Horner 递推 / value Horner recursion
        nIdx := nIdx - 1; // 游标递减 / decrement the cursor
    END_WHILE

    // 段 4.2｜差分模式覆盖解析导数（外部两入口不可用时的替代通路）/ segment 4.2, difference mode overrides the analytic derivative as the fallback path
    IF bUseNumDiff THEN // 差分模式生效 / difference mode active
        lrFxH := afCoef[DL_NR_ORD]; // 差分点求值从最高幂次系数起步 / difference point evaluation starts from the highest coefficient
        nIdx  := DL_NR_ORD - 1; // 差分求值下标重新起步 / restart the index cursor for the shifted evaluation
        WHILE nIdx >= 0 DO // 差分点同构 Horner / identical Horner at the shifted point
            lrFxH := lrFxH * (lrX + lrHUse) + afCoef[nIdx]; // 以 x + h 为自变量求值 / evaluate at x plus h
            nIdx  := nIdx - 1; // 游标递减 / decrement the cursor
        END_WHILE
        lrDf := (lrFxH - lrFx) / lrHUse; // 前向差分导数，除子已钳定大于零 / forward difference derivative, divisor proven positive
    END_IF

    // 段 4.3｜非有限闸：函数值或导数非有限即判发散退出，出口保持上拍值 / segment 4.3, non-finite gate, exit on divergence and keep the last healthy outlet
    IF (lrFx <> lrFx) OR ((lrFx - lrFx) <> (lrFx - lrFx)) OR (lrDf <> lrDf) OR ((lrDf - lrDf) <> (lrDf - lrDf)) THEN // 值或导数 NaN 或无穷 / value or derivative is NaN or infinity
        eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eNonFinite; // 发散退出 / diverged exit
        bLoop   := FALSE; // 终止循环 / terminate the loop
    ELSE
        lrResidual := ABS(lrFx); // 残差取绝对值 / residual as an absolute value
        IF lrResidual <= lrTolUse THEN // 收敛出口 / convergence exit
            bConverged := TRUE; // 置收敛标志 / raise the converged flag
            eStatus    := E_DL_NrStatus.eOk; // 状态记收敛 / record the converged status
            bLoop      := FALSE; // 终止循环 / terminate the loop
        ELSIF ABS(lrDf) < lrEpsUse THEN // 导数近零出口 / derivative near-zero exit
            eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eDerivZero; // 方向不可用 / direction unusable
            bLoop   := FALSE; // 终止循环 / terminate the loop
        ELSE
            lrStep := -lrFx / lrDf; // 牛顿位移，除子绝对值已证不小于阈值 / Newton step, divisor magnitude proven not below the threshold
            IF lrStep > DL_NR_STEP_MAX THEN // 正越界 / positive overflow
                lrStep := DL_NR_STEP_MAX; // 上钳到步长上限 / clamp to the positive step cap
            ELSIF lrStep < -DL_NR_STEP_MAX THEN // 负越界 / negative overflow
                lrStep := -DL_NR_STEP_MAX; // 下钳到步长上限 / clamp to the negative step cap
            END_IF
            lrX := lrX + lrStep; // 推进迭代点 / advance the iterate
            IF (lrX <> lrX) OR ((lrX - lrX) <> (lrX - lrX)) THEN // 新点非有限 / new point non-finite
                eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eNonFinite; // 发散退出 / diverged exit
                bLoop   := FALSE; // 终止循环 / terminate the loop
            ELSE
                IF (nIter > 1) AND (lrResidual >= lrResPrev * 0.999) THEN // 残差无实质改善 / residual did not improve materially
                    nStall := nStall + 1; // 停滞计数递增 / increment the stall counter
                ELSE
                    nStall := 0; // 有改善则清零 / clear on improvement
                END_IF
                lrResPrev := lrResidual; // 更新残差快照 / refresh the residual snapshot
                IF nStall >= DL_NR_STALL_CAP THEN // 停滞达上限 / stall count reached the cap
                    eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eNoRoot; // 判停滞退出 / stalled exit
                    bLoop   := FALSE; // 终止循环 / terminate the loop
                END_IF
            END_IF
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_WHILE

// 段 5｜循环自然结束仍未收敛者判达上限（eOk 以外的既有状态不覆盖）/ segment 5, a natural loop end without convergence is an iteration-cap verdict, existing non-ok statuses are preserved
IF bLoop AND (NOT bConverged) AND (eStatus = E_DL_NrStatus.eOk) THEN // 循环用完次数且无其它出口 / iterations exhausted with no other exit
    eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eMaxIter; // 达上限未收敛 / cap reached without convergence
END_IF

// 段 6｜统一出口：有限性闸 + 根值交付 + 标志落定 / segment 6, unified outlet with finiteness gate, root delivery and flag settling
nIterUsed := nIter; // 迭代次数出口落定 / settle the iteration count outlet
bFinite   := (lrX = lrX) AND ((lrX - lrX) = (lrX - lrX)); // 根值有限性判定，NaN 用自反、无穷用差值自减 / root finiteness by self-inequality for NaN and self-difference for infinity
IF bFinite THEN // 根值有限 / root is finite
    FC_DL_NewtonRaphson := lrX; // 交付根值 / deliver the root
    bValid := bConverged OR (eStatus = E_DL_NrStatus.eNoRoot); // 收敛或停滞的有限根可交付，其余状态仅供诊断 / finite roots from convergence or stall are deliverable, other statuses are diagnostic only
ELSE
    FC_DL_NewtonRaphson := lrX0; // 非有限：退回初值，非有限值不穿透出口 / non-finite, fall back to the initial guess so nothing non-finite passes the outlet
    bValid := FALSE; // 出口不可用 / outlet unusable
END_IF
bError := NOT (eStatus = E_DL_NrStatus.eOk); // 任何非收敛状态均置错误标志，供上层判据 / any non-converged status raises the error flag for the upper layer
END_FUNCTION

(*
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  FC_DL_NewtonStep —— 两入口推进单步（函数指针不可用时的配套入口）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  功能说明  : 供调用侧「两入口」使用：调用侧分别用自有 FC 算出 f(x) 与 f'(x)，
              把两个数值与本拍迭代点喂入本 FC，得到推进后的下一个迭代点。
              本 FC 无内部状态，调用侧持有循环与迭代上限（自身需另设硬上限）。
              与主入口同一套出口闸：值/导数非有限、导数近零、位移越界均拒绝推进。
  输出契约  : lrNextX 在拒推拍保持 lrX（不推进，等价于出口保持上拍值）；
              bStepOk 仅在本次推进合法时为 TRUE；eStatus 复用同一枚举。
  修订记录  : 2026-11-20 v1.0.0 R55 首版（与主入口同文件交付）
*)
FUNCTION FC_DL_NewtonStep : LREAL
VAR_INPUT
    lrX         : LREAL := 0.0;              // 当前迭代点 [无量纲] / current iterate [dimensionless]
    lrF         : LREAL := 0.0;              // 外部入口一算出的函数值 f(x) [无量纲] / function value from external entry one [dimensionless]
    lrDf        : LREAL := 0.0;              // 外部入口二算出的导数值 f'(x) [无量纲] / derivative value from external entry two [dimensionless]
    lrDerivEps  : LREAL := 1.0E-10;          // 导数近零阈值 [无量纲] / derivative near-zero threshold [dimensionless]
    lrStepMax   : LREAL := 1.0E9;            // 单步位移绝对上限 [无量纲] / single step absolute cap [dimensionless]
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bStepOk     : BOOL := FALSE;             // 本次推进是否合法 [-] / whether this advance is legal
    eStatus     : E_DL_NrStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eOk; // 推进结果状态 [枚举] / advance status [enum]
END_VAR
VAR
    lrStep      : LREAL := 0.0;              // 本步位移量 [无量纲] / current step [dimensionless]
    lrEps       : LREAL := 1.0E-10;          // 钳定后的导数阈值 [无量纲] / clamped derivative threshold [dimensionless]
    lrCap       : LREAL := 1.0E9;            // 钳定后的位移上限 [无量纲] / clamped step cap [dimensionless]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_NS_EPS_MIN : LREAL := 1.0E-15;        // 导数阈值下限，防零阈致除零 [无量纲] / derivative threshold lower bound against division by zero
    DL_NS_CAP_MIN : LREAL := 1.0E-3;         // 位移上限下限，防零上限锁死推进 [无量纲] / step cap lower bound against a locked advance
END_VAR

// 段 1｜出口预置：默认不推进，保持传入迭代点 / segment 1, preset the outlet to no advance, keeping the incoming iterate
FC_DL_NewtonStep := lrX; // 拒推拍返回原点 / return the incoming point when the advance is rejected
bStepOk := FALSE; // 推进标志预置假 / preset the advance flag to false
eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eOk; // 状态预置收敛 / preset status to converged

// 段 2｜阈值与上限域闸 / segment 2, domain gate for the threshold and the cap
lrEps := lrDerivEps; // 阈值默认直通 / threshold passes through by default
IF lrEps <> lrEps THEN // 自反判 NaN / self-inequality detects NaN
    lrEps := DL_NS_EPS_MIN; // NaN 回落下限 / NaN falls back to the lower bound
END_IF
IF lrEps < DL_NS_EPS_MIN THEN // 阈值过小 / threshold too small
    lrEps := DL_NS_EPS_MIN; // 抬到下限 / raised to the lower bound
END_IF
lrCap := lrStepMax; // 位移上限默认直通 / step cap passes through by default
IF lrCap <> lrCap THEN // 自反判 NaN / self-inequality detects NaN
    lrCap := 1.0E9; // NaN 回落默认上限 / NaN falls back to the default cap
END_IF
IF lrCap < DL_NS_CAP_MIN THEN // 上限过小 / cap too small
    lrCap := DL_NS_CAP_MIN; // 抬到下限，防推进被锁死 / raised against a locked advance
END_IF

// 段 3｜三入口有限性闸：任一项非有限即拒绝推进 / segment 3, finiteness gate on all three inputs, any non-finite term rejects the advance
IF (lrX <> lrX) OR ((lrX - lrX) <> (lrX - lrX)) OR (lrF <> lrF) OR ((lrF - lrF) <> (lrF - lrF)) OR (lrDf <> lrDf) OR ((lrDf - lrDf) <> (lrDf - lrDf)) THEN // 任一项 NaN 或无穷 / any term is NaN or infinity
    eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eNonFinite; // 非有限拒绝 / rejected as non-finite
    RETURN; // 早退，出口保持传入点 / early exit with the outlet held at the incoming point
END_IF

// 段 4｜导数闸与位移限幅 / segment 4, derivative gate and step clamp
IF ABS(lrDf) < lrEps THEN // 导数近零 / derivative near zero
    eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eDerivZero; // 方向不可用 / direction unusable
    RETURN; // 早退，出口保持传入点 / early exit with the outlet held at the incoming point
END_IF
lrStep := -lrF / lrDf; // 牛顿位移，除子绝对值已证不小于阈值 / Newton step, divisor magnitude proven not below the threshold
IF lrStep > lrCap THEN // 正越界 / positive overflow
    lrStep := lrCap; // 上钳 / clamp upward
ELSIF lrStep < -lrCap THEN // 负越界 / negative overflow
    lrStep := -lrCap; // 下钳 / clamp downward
END_IF

// 段 5｜推进与结果有限性复检 / segment 5, advance and finiteness recheck
FC_DL_NewtonStep := lrX + lrStep; // 推进到下一个迭代点 / advance to the next iterate
IF (FC_DL_NewtonStep <> FC_DL_NewtonStep) OR ((FC_DL_NewtonStep - FC_DL_NewtonStep) <> (FC_DL_NewtonStep - FC_DL_NewtonStep)) THEN // 新点非有限 / new point non-finite
    eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eNonFinite; // 判发散 / diverged verdict
    FC_DL_NewtonStep := lrX; // 退回原迭代点 / fall back to the incoming iterate
    bStepOk := FALSE; // 推进标志保持假 / advance flag stays false
    RETURN; // 早退 / early exit
END_IF
bStepOk := TRUE; // 推进合法 / the advance is legal
eStatus := E_DL_NrStatus.eOk; // 状态记正常 / record the normal status
END_FUNCTION

instruction: 温度与流量回路整定前需要知道对象的一阶惯性加纯迟延（FOPDT）参数：对阶跃激励的响应序列做两点法辨识，输出增益、时间常数与纯迟延估计；采样窗内响应未达稳态判据或幅值过小信噪比不足时拒绝出参并保持上次有效值，除零前判幅值，辨识期间输出限幅且只给结果不直写执行器，全程纯 IEC 标准库实现。（v1.0.1 返修版：见 REVIEW_R56 修法）
architecture_thought: 两点法辨识状态机架构：eIdle 到 eSample（沿激励起点快照初值，窗口内跟踪响应）到 eCalc（取 28.3% 与 63.2% 两时刻差算时间常数，稳态差除以阶跃幅值算增益，纯迟延由响应偏离起点时刻估计）到 eDone 或 eReject；段 0 无条件刷新采样沿与窗定时器；稳态判据不满足或幅值低于信噪闸进 eReject 保持上次有效参数；除零前置幅值闸，出口含三参数与有效标志。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_FopdtStepIdent
  分类   Category   : DL_Algo
  版本   Version    : 1.0.1
  功能   Purpose    : 阶跃响应 FOPDT（一阶惯性 + 纯延迟）参数辨识，供 PID 整定使用。
                      阶跃窗内「时刻 + 过程量」二元组以环窗缓存，稳定或超时后按
                      时间序遍历样本，两条 clean-room 方法并行求解并在出口二选一：
                      一 两点法：取 28.3% 与 63.2% 两个穿越点，
                         T = 1.5 * (t63 - t28)，L = t63 - T；
                      二 切线法：取最大斜率点切线，
                         T = ΔPV / 最大斜率，L = t_slope - (PV_slope - PV_base) / 带符号斜率
                         （斜率符号取 SIGN(ΔPV)，负向阶跃与两点法同口径）；
                      增益 K = ΔPV / ΔMV 两法共用。
  溯源   Origin     : 阶跃辨识两点法与切线法均为公开控制工程方法；本件为 clean-room
                      实现，仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签 t2-5-modpid 的 PID
                      自整定概念域），未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（TON / R_TRIG / REAL 运算，无私有库、无方言转换）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  同拍双窗配比约束（R100）：tSettle 必须小于 tTimeout —— 稳定确认窗短于相超时窗，
                      两窗职责分离：tSettle 判「可以进入评估」，tTimeout 判「辨识失败退出」，
                      任一窗不得兼作另一窗用途；配比反置在组态域闸内直接判故障。
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只输出辨识参数与有效性，不算 PID 参数、不写调节器（属主边界）；
                      二 环窗遍历一律按时间序（自最旧样本起），禁按数组下标序（R194）；
                      三 采样拍周期由引脚 fSampleS 给出（秒），不读系统时基；
                      四 故障锁存解除路径 = bReset 上升沿 或 bEnable 下降沿，两条均恒可达；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      fGainK / fTauS / fDeadS 仅在 bValid 为真拍更新，其余拍保持上一次
                      成功辨识值；非有限中间结果一律不写入出口（出口保持上拍值）；
                      bIdentDone 为单拍脉冲（内部 _bIdentInt 置位、统一出口映射后撤销，
                      R187 两段式）；eCause 各成因独立成员（R190 归因唯一）。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 1 · 序号 2）
    2026-11-20  v1.0.1  R56 返修（7.2）：切线法截距改用带符号斜率 _fSlopeSig（符号取
                        SIGN(_fDeltaPv)，量级守卫仍由 _fSlopeMax > DL_FOPDT_EPS 证明），
                        负向阶跃不再系统性高估死区时间；eDone 相重启分支补清
                        _fPvSlopeMax / _fTSlopeMax（与 eIdle 分支对齐）。
  ==================================================================
*)

TYPE E_DL_FopdtState :
(
    eIdle    := 0,      // 空闲：等待阶跃上升沿 / idle, waiting for the step rising edge
    eRise    := 10,     // 上升：缓存样本并监视稳定 / rising, buffering samples and watching settle
    eEval    := 20,     // 评估：时间序遍历样本算参数 / evaluating, traversing samples in time order
    eDone    := 30,     // 完成：参数已交付并驻留 / done, parameters delivered and held
    eFault   := 90      // 故障：原因锁存 / fault, cause latched
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_FopdtCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：阈值或采样周期越域 / illegal config, threshold or sample period out of domain
    eMvZero     := 2,   // 阶跃幅度近零，增益不可算 / step amplitude near zero, gain not computable
    eLackResp   := 3,   // 响应不足：总变化未达最小可辨量 / response too small, total change below the floor
    eNoSettle   := 4,   // 超时未稳定 / timeout without settle
    eNoCross    := 5,   // 未捕获穿越点或样本不足 / crossing points missing or too few samples
    eDeadNeg    := 6,   // 纯延迟算出负值，已按零处理（信息级）/ dead time negative and forced to zero, informational
    ePhaseBad   := 7    // 非法相位兜底 / illegal phase fallback
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_FopdtStepIdent
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable        : BOOL := TRUE;           // 使能，下降沿清状态回空闲 [-] / enable, falling edge clears the state back to idle
    bReset         : BOOL := FALSE;          // 复位上升沿清故障锁存 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch
    bStepStart     : BOOL := FALSE;          // 阶跃施加时刻的上升沿（调用方给出）[-] / rising edge at the step application instant
    fMvStep        : REAL := 10.0;           // 操纵量阶跃幅度（带符号）[工程单位] / manipulated variable step amplitude, signed [engineering unit]
    fMvStepEps     : REAL := 1.0E-3;         // 阶跃幅度可辨下限 [工程单位] / step amplitude recognisable floor [engineering unit]
    fPv            : REAL := 0.0;            // 过程量实测 [工程单位] / measured process variable [engineering unit]
    fSampleS       : REAL := 0.1;            // 采样拍周期 [秒]，域 1E-4..10 / sample period [second], domain 1E-4 to 10
    tTimeout       : TIME := T#300S;         // 上升相超时 [毫秒] / rise phase timeout [millisecond]
    tSettle        : TIME := T#5S;           // 稳定确认时长 [毫秒] / settle confirmation duration [millisecond]
    fSettleBandPct : REAL := 1.0;            // 稳定带，占当前跨度百分比 [百分比] / settle band as a percentage of the current span [percent]
    fMinDeltaPv    : REAL := 0.5;            // 响应最小可辨量 [工程单位] / minimum recognisable response [engineering unit]
    bUseTangent    : BOOL := FALSE;          // 真 = 出口取切线法，假 = 出口取两点法 [-] / true selects the tangent method, false selects the two-point method
    fTauMinS       : REAL := 0.2;            // 时间常数可接受下限 [秒] / acceptable time constant floor [second]
    fTauMaxS       : REAL := 7200.0;         // 时间常数可接受上限 [秒] / acceptable time constant ceiling [second]
    fDeadMaxS      : REAL := 600.0;          // 纯延迟可接受上限 [秒] / acceptable dead time ceiling [second]
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fGainK         : REAL := 0.0;            // 辨识增益 K [工程单位比] / identified process gain [engineering unit ratio]
    fTauS          : REAL := 0.0;            // 辨识时间常数 T [秒] / identified time constant [second]
    fDeadS         : REAL := 0.0;            // 辨识纯延迟 L [秒] / identified dead time [second]
    fDeltaPv       : REAL := 0.0;            // 本次阶跃的总过程量变化 [工程单位] / total process change of this step [engineering unit]
    fPvBase        : REAL := 0.0;            // 阶跃前基线过程量 [工程单位] / baseline process variable before the step [engineering unit]
    fPvFinal       : REAL := 0.0;            // 稳定后过程量 [工程单位] / settled process variable [engineering unit]
    fTauTwoPointS  : REAL := 0.0;            // 两点法时间常数 [秒] / two-point method time constant [second]
    fDeadTwoPointS : REAL := 0.0;            // 两点法纯延迟 [秒] / two-point method dead time [second]
    fTauTangentS   : REAL := 0.0;            // 切线法时间常数 [秒] / tangent method time constant [second]
    fDeadTangentS  : REAL := 0.0;            // 切线法纯延迟 [秒] / tangent method dead time [second]
    bValid         : BOOL := FALSE;          // 参数是否可交付 [-] / parameters deliverable flag
    bIdentDone     : BOOL := FALSE;          // 辨识完成单拍脉冲 [-] / identification done single-shot pulse
    eState         : E_DL_FopdtState := E_DL_FopdtState.eIdle; // 相位出口，段尾单点映射 [枚举] / phase outlet, single-point mapped at the tail
    eCause         : E_DL_FopdtCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eNone; // 成因出口，锁存至复位 [枚举] / cause outlet, latched until reset
    bError         : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtStep         : R_TRIG;                 // 阶跃沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / step edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtReset        : R_TRIG;                 // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonTimeout     : TON;                    // 上升相超时计时，段 0 无条件刷新 / rise phase timeout timer, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonSettle      : TON;                    // 稳定确认计时，段 0 无条件刷新 / settle confirmation timer, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eState        : E_DL_FopdtState := E_DL_FopdtState.eIdle;  // 内部相位，CASE 唯一写入目标 / internal phase, the only CASE write target
    _eCause        : E_DL_FopdtCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eNone;  // 内部成因，锁存量 / internal cause, latched quantity
    _bFault        : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bValid        : BOOL := FALSE;          // 参数有效内部位，锁存至下次辨识 / internal validity bit, latched until the next identification
    _bIdentInt     : BOOL := FALSE;          // 完成脉冲内部位，统一出口映射 / internal done bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _bInit         : BOOL := FALSE;          // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bSampleOk     : BOOL := FALSE;          // 本拍样本有效（过程量有限）[-] / this-scan sample valid flag
    _bStoreOk      : BOOL := FALSE;          // 环窗槽位合法可写 [-] / ring slot legal and writable
    _bSpanOk       : BOOL := FALSE;          // 跨度估计可用于稳定带判据 [-] / span estimate usable for the settle band
    _bCfgBad       : BOOL := FALSE;          // 组态非法标志 [-] / illegal configuration flag
    _bCross28      : BOOL := FALSE;          // 已捕获 28.3% 穿越点 [-] / 28.3 percent crossing captured
    _bCross63      : BOOL := FALSE;          // 已捕获 63.2% 穿越点 [-] / 63.2 percent crossing captured
    _bDeadClamped  : BOOL := FALSE;          // 纯延迟负值已按零处理 [-] / negative dead time forced to zero
    _nHead         : INT := 0;               // 环窗最近样本槽位（1 起，回钳 1..N）[槽号] / newest ring slot, one-based, clamped one through N
    _nFill         : INT := 0;               // 环窗已填样本数（0..N）[个] / samples held in the ring [count]
    _nIdx          : INT := 0;               // 环窗下标游标 [槽号] / ring index cursor [slot]
    _nPrev         : INT := 0;               // 时间序前一槽位 [槽号] / previous slot in time order [slot]
    _nGuard        : INT := 0;               // 遍历防死循环守护计数 [次] / traversal guard against runaway loops [count]
    _nK            : INT := 0;               // 时间序遍历序号（1 = 最旧样本）[序号] / time-order ordinal, one is the oldest [ordinal]
    _fDtS          : REAL := 0.1;            // 钳定后的采样拍周期 [秒] / clamped sample period [second]
    _fElapsedS     : REAL := 0.0;            // 上升相已历时 [秒] / elapsed time within the rise phase [second]
    _fPvPrev       : REAL := 0.0;            // 上一拍过程量快照 [工程单位] / previous scan process value snapshot [engineering unit]
    _fPvBase       : REAL := 0.0;            // 基线过程量（时间序最旧样本）[工程单位] / baseline process value from the oldest sample [engineering unit]
    _fPvNow        : REAL := 0.0;            // 本拍样本过程量 [工程单位] / current sample process value [engineering unit]
    _fPvFinal      : REAL := 0.0;            // 稳定后过程量（时间序最新样本）[工程单位] / settled process value from the newest sample [engineering unit]
    _fPvOld        : REAL := 0.0;            // 遍历中的前一有效样本过程量 [工程单位] / previous valid sample during traversal [engineering unit]
    _fDeltaPv      : REAL := 0.0;            // 总过程量变化 [工程单位] / total process change [engineering unit]
    _fSpan         : REAL := 0.0;            // 已观测过程量跨度上确界 [工程单位] / supremum of the observed process span [engineering unit]
    _fSettleAbs    : REAL := 0.0;            // 稳定带绝对量 [工程单位] / absolute settle band [engineering unit]
    _fFrac         : REAL := 0.0;            // 归一化响应分数（0..1）[无量纲] / normalised response fraction [dimensionless]
    _fSlopeNow     : REAL := 0.0;            // 本拍斜率 [工程单位每秒] / slope of this scan [engineering unit per second]
    _fSlopeMax     : REAL := 0.0;            // 最大斜率上确界 [工程单位每秒] / supremum of the slope magnitude [engineering unit per second]
    _fSlopeSig     : REAL := 0.0;            // 带符号最大斜率，符号取 SIGN(ΔPV) [工程单位每秒] / signed maximum slope carrying the delta PV sign [engineering unit per second]
    _fSlopeLoc     : REAL := 0.0;            // 相邻样本斜率 [工程单位每秒] / slope between adjacent samples [engineering unit per second]
    _fDtLoc        : REAL := 0.0;            // 相邻样本时差 [秒] / time difference between adjacent samples [second]
    _fT28          : REAL := 0.0;            // 28.3% 穿越时刻 [秒] / 28.3 percent crossing instant [second]
    _fT63          : REAL := 0.0;            // 63.2% 穿越时刻 [秒] / 63.2 percent crossing instant [second]
    _fTSlopeMax    : REAL := 0.0;            // 最大斜率出现时刻 [秒] / instant of the maximum slope [second]
    _fPvSlopeMax   : REAL := 0.0;            // 最大斜率处过程量 [工程单位] / process value at the maximum slope [engineering unit]
    _fTauTwo       : REAL := 0.0;            // 两点法时间常数计算值 [秒] / two-point time constant, computed value [second]
    _fDeadTwo      : REAL := 0.0;            // 两点法纯延迟计算值 [秒] / two-point dead time, computed value [second]
    _fTauTan       : REAL := 0.0;            // 切线法时间常数计算值 [秒] / tangent time constant, computed value [second]
    _fDeadTan      : REAL := 0.0;            // 切线法纯延迟计算值 [秒] / tangent dead time, computed value [second]
    _fTauOut       : REAL := 0.0;            // 出口选用时间常数 [秒] / selected outlet time constant [second]
    _fDeadOut      : REAL := 0.0;            // 出口选用纯延迟 [秒] / selected outlet dead time [second]
    _fGain         : REAL := 0.0;            // 增益计算值 [工程单位比] / computed gain [engineering unit ratio]
    _fMvDen        : REAL := 0.0;            // 增益分母（阶跃幅度）暂存 [工程单位] / gain denominator held in a local [engineering unit]
    _fGainK        : REAL := 0.0;            // 出口保持：增益 [工程单位比] / outlet holder for the gain [engineering unit ratio]
    _fTauS         : REAL := 0.0;            // 出口保持：时间常数 [秒] / outlet holder for the time constant [second]
    _fDeadS        : REAL := 0.0;            // 出口保持：纯延迟 [秒] / outlet holder for the dead time [second]
    _fDeltaPvOut   : REAL := 0.0;            // 出口保持：总变化量 [工程单位] / outlet holder for the total change [engineering unit]
    _fPvBaseOut    : REAL := 0.0;            // 出口保持：基线过程量 [工程单位] / outlet holder for the baseline value [engineering unit]
    _fPvFinalOut   : REAL := 0.0;            // 出口保持：稳定点过程量 [工程单位] / outlet holder for the settled value [engineering unit]
    _fTauTwoOut    : REAL := 0.0;            // 出口保持：两点法时间常数 [秒] / outlet holder for the two-point time constant [second]
    _fDeadTwoOut   : REAL := 0.0;            // 出口保持：两点法纯延迟 [秒] / outlet holder for the two-point dead time [second]
    _fTauTanOut    : REAL := 0.0;            // 出口保持：切线法时间常数 [秒] / outlet holder for the tangent time constant [second]
    _fDeadTanOut   : REAL := 0.0;            // 出口保持：切线法纯延迟 [秒] / outlet holder for the tangent dead time [second]
    _afPvV         : ARRAY[1..512] OF REAL := [512(0.0)]; // 环窗过程量缓存 [工程单位] / ring buffer of process values [engineering unit]
    _afPvT         : ARRAY[1..512] OF REAL := [512(0.0)]; // 环窗时刻缓存，与过程量同槽同步写入 [秒] / ring buffer of instants, lockstep with the values [second]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_FOPDT_MAX    : INT := 512;            // 环窗容量与槽位回钳上界 [个] / ring capacity and slot clamp upper bound [count]
    DL_FOPDT_SMIN   : REAL := 1.0E-4;        // 采样周期下限，防除零 [秒] / sample period floor against division by zero [second]
    DL_FOPDT_SMAX   : REAL := 10.0;          // 采样周期上限，防时基错配 [秒] / sample period ceiling against a mismatched time base [second]
    DL_FOPDT_DTMIN  : REAL := 1.0E-6;        // 相邻样本时差下限，斜率除子 [秒] / adjacent sample time difference floor for the slope divisor [second]
    DL_FOPDT_FRAC28 : REAL := 0.283;         // 两点法第一穿越点 [无量纲] / two-point first crossing fraction [dimensionless]
    DL_FOPDT_FRAC63 : REAL := 0.632;         // 两点法第二穿越点 [无量纲] / two-point second crossing fraction [dimensionless]
    DL_FOPDT_TAUCOEF: REAL := 1.5;           // 两点法时间常数系数 [无量纲] / two-point time constant coefficient [dimensionless]
    DL_FOPDT_EPS    : REAL := 1.0E-9;        // 斜率与分数类除子下限 [无量纲] / floor for slope and fraction divisors [dimensionless]
    DL_FOPDT_GAINMAX: REAL := 1.0E9;         // 增益量级上限，防量纲错配 [工程单位比] / gain magnitude ceiling against a dimension mismatch [engineering unit ratio]
    DL_FOPDT_GUARD  : INT := 1024;           // 遍历守护上限，两倍容量 [次] / traversal guard, twice the capacity [count]
    DL_FOPDT_MINPTS : INT := 4;              // 参与辨识的最少样本数 [个] / minimum sample count for identification [count]
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支），IN 只串状态闸 / segment 0, unconditional refresh of timers and edge detectors with state gates on IN only
rtStep(CLK := bStepStart); // 阶跃沿检测无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the step edge detector
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿检测无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge detector
tonTimeout(IN := (_eState = E_DL_FopdtState.eRise) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tTimeout); // 上升相超时，IN 串相位闸与故障闸 / rise phase timeout, IN carries the phase gate and the fault gate
tonSettle(IN := (_eState = E_DL_FopdtState.eRise) AND _bSampleOk AND _bSpanOk AND (ABS(fPv - _fPvPrev) <= _fSettleAbs), PT := tSettle); // 稳定确认，IN 串相位闸与稳定带判据 / settle confirmation with the phase gate and the settle band criterion on IN

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）：学习量与环窗从确定起点开始 / segment 1, first scan initialisation so that learning quantities and the ring start known
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eIdle; // 相位从空闲起步 / the phase starts from idle
    _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eNone; // 成因清零 / clear the cause
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _bValid := FALSE; // 有效位清零 / clear the validity bit
    _nHead := 0; // 环窗无样本 / the ring holds no sample
    _nFill := 0; // 环窗计数清零 / clear the ring count
    _fSpan := 0.0; // 跨度估计清零 / clear the span estimate
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域逐项声明：清锁存 / 迁相位 / 清累计量 / segment 2, reset edge scope declared item by item
IF rtReset.Q OR (NOT bEnable) THEN // 复位沿或失能 / reset edge or disabled
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清成因 / scope one, clear the cause
    _bIdentInt := FALSE; // 作用域一：清完成脉冲内部位 / scope one, clear the internal done bit
    _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eIdle; // 作用域二：迁回空闲相 / scope two, migrate back to idle
    _nHead := 0; // 作用域三：清环窗槽位 / scope three, clear the ring slot cursor
    _nFill := 0; // 作用域三：清环窗计数 / scope three, clear the ring count
    _fSpan := 0.0; // 作用域三：清跨度估计 / scope three, clear the span estimate
    _fElapsedS := 0.0; // 作用域三：清历时 / scope three, clear the elapsed time
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态域闸（R151）：参与判据换算的每个引脚逐项闸，缺一即判据静默失效 / segment 3, configuration domain gate over every pin used by the criteria
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法标志预置假 / preset the illegal configuration flag to false
IF (fSampleS <> fSampleS) THEN // 采样周期 NaN 自反判 / NaN detection on the sample period
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判组态非法 / illegal configuration
END_IF
IF (fSampleS < DL_FOPDT_SMIN) OR (fSampleS > DL_FOPDT_SMAX) THEN // 采样周期越域 / sample period out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判组态非法 / illegal configuration
END_IF
IF (fMvStep <> fMvStep) OR ((fMvStep - fMvStep) <> (fMvStep - fMvStep)) THEN // 阶跃幅度非有限 / step amplitude non-finite
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判组态非法 / illegal configuration
END_IF
IF (fMvStepEps <= 0.0) OR (fMvStepEps <> fMvStepEps) THEN // 幅度可辨下限非正或非有限 / amplitude floor not positive or non-finite
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判组态非法 / illegal configuration
END_IF
IF (fMinDeltaPv <= 0.0) OR (fMinDeltaPv <> fMinDeltaPv) THEN // 最小可辨量非正或非有限 / response floor not positive or non-finite
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判组态非法 / illegal configuration
END_IF
IF (fSettleBandPct <= 0.0) OR (fSettleBandPct >= 100.0) OR (fSettleBandPct <> fSettleBandPct) THEN // 稳定带百分比越域 / settle band percentage out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判组态非法 / illegal configuration
END_IF
IF (fTauMinS <= 0.0) OR (fTauMaxS <= fTauMinS) OR (fTauMaxS <> fTauMaxS) THEN // 时间常数上下限自相矛盾 / time constant bounds contradict each other
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判组态非法 / illegal configuration
END_IF
IF (fDeadMaxS < 0.0) OR (fDeadMaxS <> fDeadMaxS) THEN // 纯延迟上限为负或非有限 / dead time ceiling negative or non-finite
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判组态非法 / illegal configuration
END_IF
IF (tTimeout <= T#0S) OR (tSettle <= T#0S) THEN // 时间引脚非正 / time pins not positive
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判组态非法 / illegal configuration
END_IF
IF tSettle >= tTimeout THEN // 稳定窗不短于相超时窗，违反双窗配比（R100）/ the settle window is not shorter than the phase timeout
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判组态非法 / illegal configuration
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eCfgIllegal; // 成因记组态非法 / record the illegal configuration cause
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _bValid := FALSE; // 参数不可交付 / parameters not deliverable
    _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_IF

// 段 4｜本拍量预置（单拍标志限域，不含快照与环窗保持量）/ segment 4, per-scan presets limited to single-shot flags
_fDtS := fSampleS; // 采样周期直通 / sample period passes through
IF _fDtS < DL_FOPDT_SMIN THEN // 周期过小 / period too small
    _fDtS := DL_FOPDT_SMIN; // 抬到下限，防时基除零 / raised against a zero time base
ELSIF _fDtS > DL_FOPDT_SMAX THEN // 周期过大 / period too large
    _fDtS := DL_FOPDT_SMAX; // 压到上限 / pressed to the ceiling
END_IF
_bSampleOk := (fPv = fPv) AND ((fPv - fPv) = (fPv - fPv)); // 过程量有限性闸，NaN 用自反、无穷用差值自减 / process value finiteness gate
_fPvNow := fPv; // 本拍样本默认取实测 / the current sample defaults to the measurement
IF NOT _bSampleOk THEN // 非有限拍 / non-finite scan
    _fPvNow := _fPvPrev; // 非有限不穿透：改取上拍快照 / nothing non-finite passes, the previous snapshot is used
END_IF
_fSettleAbs := _fSpan * fSettleBandPct / 100.0; // 稳定带绝对量，除子为常量 100.0 / absolute settle band, the divisor is the literal constant one hundred
_bSpanOk := _fSpan > 0.0; // 跨度估计可用性 / span estimate availability

// 段 5｜相位机：ENUM + CASE，含 ELSE 非法相位兜底（R128）/ segment 5, phase machine with an ELSE fallback for illegal phases
CASE _eState OF
E_DL_FopdtState.eIdle: // 空闲相：等阶跃上升沿 / idle phase, waiting for the step rising edge
    IF rtStep.Q THEN // 阶跃沿到达 / the step edge arrived
        _nHead := 0; // 环窗槽位清零 / clear the ring slot cursor
        _nFill := 0; // 环窗计数清零 / clear the ring count
        _fSpan := 0.0; // 跨度估计清零 / clear the span estimate
        _fElapsedS := 0.0; // 历时清零 / clear the elapsed time
        _fSlopeMax := 0.0; // 最大斜率清零 / clear the maximum slope
        _fPvSlopeMax := 0.0; // 最大斜率处过程量清零 / clear the value at the maximum slope
        _fTSlopeMax := 0.0; // 最大斜率时刻清零 / clear the instant of the maximum slope
        _bCross28 := FALSE; // 穿越标志清零 / clear the crossing flag
        _bCross63 := FALSE; // 穿越标志清零 / clear the crossing flag
        _fPvPrev := fPv; // 基线快照取当拍实测 / the baseline snapshot takes the current measurement
        _fPvBase := fPv; // 基线过程量取当拍实测 / the baseline process value takes the current measurement
        _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eRise; // 迁上升相 / migrate to the rise phase
    END_IF

E_DL_FopdtState.eRise: // 上升相：缓存样本、跟踪斜率与跨度 / rise phase, buffering samples and tracking slope and span
    _fElapsedS := _fElapsedS + _fDtS; // 累计历时 / accumulate the elapsed time
    _bStoreOk := FALSE; // 写入许可预置假 / preset the write permit to false
    IF _nFill < DL_FOPDT_MAX THEN // 环窗未满 / the ring is not yet full
        _nHead := _nHead + 1; // 槽位前移，天然落在 1..N / advance the slot, naturally inside one through N
        _nFill := _nFill + 1; // 计数递增 / increment the count
        _bStoreOk := TRUE; // 允许写入 / writing permitted
    ELSE // 环窗已满 / the ring is full
        _nHead := _nHead + 1; // 槽位前移 / advance the slot
        IF _nHead > DL_FOPDT_MAX THEN // 越过上界 / past the upper bound
            _nHead := 1; // 回钳到一号槽（环窗回钳口径）/ clamp back to slot one
        END_IF
        _bStoreOk := TRUE; // 允许写入 / writing permitted
    END_IF
    IF _bStoreOk THEN // 槽位合法 / slot is legal
        _afPvV[_nHead] := _fPvNow; // 过程量入环窗 / store the process value
        _afPvT[_nHead] := _fElapsedS; // 时刻同步入同槽 / store the instant into the same slot
    END_IF
    IF ABS(_fPvNow - _fPvBase) > _fSpan THEN // 跨度取绝对偏差上确界 / the span takes the supremum of absolute deviation
        _fSpan := ABS(_fPvNow - _fPvBase); // 更新跨度 / refresh the span
    END_IF
    _fSlopeNow := ABS(_fPvNow - _fPvPrev) / _fDtS; // 本拍斜率绝对值，除子已钳定大于零 / absolute slope of this scan, divisor proven positive
    IF _fSlopeNow > _fSlopeMax THEN // 斜率上确界跟踪 / supremum slope tracking
        _fSlopeMax := _fSlopeNow; // 更新最大斜率 / refresh the maximum slope
        _fPvSlopeMax := _fPvNow; // 记录该点过程量 / record the value at that point
        _fTSlopeMax := _fElapsedS; // 记录该点时刻 / record the instant of that point
    END_IF
    _fPvPrev := _fPvNow; // 快照推进 / advance the snapshot
    IF tonSettle.Q OR tonTimeout.Q THEN // 稳定达成或超时 / settled or timed out
        _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eEval; // 迁评估相 / migrate to the evaluation phase
    END_IF

E_DL_FopdtState.eEval: // 评估相：按时间序遍历环窗，两法并行求解 / evaluation phase, traversal in time order with both methods solved
    _nK := _nFill; // 参与判定的样本数 / samples participating in the verdict
    IF _nK > DL_FOPDT_MAX THEN // 防御：计数不得越容 / defence, the count must not exceed capacity
        _nK := DL_FOPDT_MAX; // 回钳到容量 / clamp to the capacity
    END_IF
    IF _nK < DL_FOPDT_MINPTS THEN // 样本不足 / too few samples
        _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eNoCross; // 成因记样本不足缺穿越点 / record the missing crossing cause
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _bValid := FALSE; // 参数不可交付 / parameters not deliverable
        _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    ELSE
        _nIdx := _nHead - _nFill + 1; // 时间序最旧槽位 / the oldest slot in time order
        IF _nIdx < 1 THEN // 越过下界 / below the lower bound
            _nIdx := _nIdx + DL_FOPDT_MAX; // 单次回绕补齐（时间序回钳）/ a single wrap restores the time order
        END_IF
        _fPvBase := _afPvV[_nIdx]; // 基线取时间序最旧样本 / the baseline takes the oldest sample
        _fPvOld := _fPvBase; // 遍历起点过程量 / traversal start value
        _fPvFinal := _afPvV[_nHead]; // 稳定点取时间序最新样本 / the settled value takes the newest sample
        _fDeltaPv := _fPvFinal - _fPvBase; // 总变化量 / total change
        IF ABS(_fDeltaPv) <= fMinDeltaPv THEN // 响应不足 / response too small
            _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eLackResp; // 成因记响应不足 / record the insufficient response cause
            _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
            _bValid := FALSE; // 参数不可交付 / parameters not deliverable
            _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
        ELSIF ABS(fMvStep) <= fMvStepEps THEN // 阶跃幅度近零 / step amplitude near zero
            _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eMvZero; // 成因记幅度近零 / record the near-zero amplitude cause
            _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
            _bValid := FALSE; // 参数不可交付 / parameters not deliverable
            _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
        ELSE
            _bCross28 := FALSE; // 穿越标志复位 / clear the crossing flag
            _bCross63 := FALSE; // 穿越标志复位 / clear the crossing flag
            _nGuard := 0; // 遍历守护计数清零 / reset the traversal guard
            _nK := 1; // 自最旧样本起按时间序遍历（R194）/ traverse from the oldest sample in time order
            WHILE (_nK <= _nFill) AND (_nGuard < DL_FOPDT_GUARD) DO // 双重守护：样本数与计数上限 / dual guard on the sample count and the counter cap
                _nGuard := _nGuard + 1; // 守护计数递增 / increment the guard
                _nIdx := _nHead - _nFill + _nK; // 时间序槽位 / the slot in time order
                IF _nIdx < 1 THEN // 越过下界 / below the lower bound
                    _nIdx := _nIdx + DL_FOPDT_MAX; // 单次回绕 / single wrap
                END_IF
                _fFrac := (_afPvV[_nIdx] - _fPvBase) / _fDeltaPv; // 归一化响应分数，除子绝对值已证超可辨量 / normalised fraction, divisor proven above the floor
                IF (NOT _bCross28) AND (_fFrac >= DL_FOPDT_FRAC28) THEN // 首次越过 28.3% / first crossing of 28.3 percent
                    _fT28 := _afPvT[_nIdx]; // 记录穿越时刻 / record the crossing instant
                    _bCross28 := TRUE; // 置穿越标志 / raise the crossing flag
                END_IF
                IF (NOT _bCross63) AND (_fFrac >= DL_FOPDT_FRAC63) THEN // 首次越过 63.2% / first crossing of 63.2 percent
                    _fT63 := _afPvT[_nIdx]; // 记录穿越时刻 / record the crossing instant
                    _bCross63 := TRUE; // 置穿越标志 / raise the crossing flag
                END_IF
                IF _nK > 1 THEN // 自第二个样本起可算斜率 / slopes exist from the second sample onward
                    _nPrev := _nIdx - 1; // 前一槽位 / the previous slot
                    IF _nPrev < 1 THEN // 越过下界 / below the lower bound
                        _nPrev := _nPrev + DL_FOPDT_MAX; // 单次回绕 / single wrap
                    END_IF
                    _fDtLoc := _afPvT[_nIdx] - _afPvT[_nPrev]; // 相邻样本时差 / adjacent sample time difference
                    IF _fDtLoc > DL_FOPDT_DTMIN THEN // 时差可用 / the difference is usable
                        _fSlopeLoc := ABS((_afPvV[_nIdx] - _fPvOld) / _fDtLoc); // 局部斜率绝对值 / local absolute slope
                        IF _fSlopeLoc > _fSlopeMax THEN // 斜率上确界 / slope supremum
                            _fSlopeMax := _fSlopeLoc; // 更新最大斜率 / refresh the maximum slope
                            _fPvSlopeMax := _afPvV[_nIdx]; // 记录该点过程量 / record the value at that point
                            _fTSlopeMax := _afPvT[_nIdx]; // 记录该点时刻 / record the instant of that point
                        END_IF
                    END_IF
                END_IF
                _fPvOld := _afPvV[_nIdx]; // 推进前一有效样本 / advance the previous valid sample
                _nK := _nK + 1; // 序号递增 / increment the ordinal
            END_WHILE
            IF (NOT _bCross28) OR (NOT _bCross63) THEN // 缺穿越点 / a crossing is missing
                _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eNoCross; // 成因记缺穿越点 / record the missing crossing cause
                _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
                _bValid := FALSE; // 参数不可交付 / parameters not deliverable
                _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
            ELSIF (_fT63 - _fT28) < DL_FOPDT_DTMIN THEN // 两穿越点重合，时间常数不可辨 / the crossings coincide and the time constant is unresolvable
                _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eNoCross; // 成因记穿越点不可辨 / record the unresolvable crossing cause
                _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
                _bValid := FALSE; // 参数不可交付 / parameters not deliverable
                _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
            ELSE
                _fTauTwo := DL_FOPDT_TAUCOEF * (_fT63 - _fT28); // 两点法时间常数 / two-point time constant
                _fDeadTwo := _fT63 - _fTauTwo; // 两点法纯延迟 / two-point dead time
                _bDeadClamped := FALSE; // 钳位标志复位 / clear the clamp flag
                IF _fDeadTwo < 0.0 THEN // 延迟负值不可能 / a negative dead time is impossible
                    _fDeadTwo := 0.0; // 按零处理 / forced to zero
                    _bDeadClamped := TRUE; // 置钳位标志 / raise the clamp flag
                END_IF
                IF _fSlopeMax > DL_FOPDT_EPS THEN // 斜率可用 / the slope is usable
                    _fSlopeSig := _fSlopeMax * SIGN(_fDeltaPv); // 带符号斜率：SIGN(ΔPV) ∈ {-1, 1}（ΔPV 已证 |·| > fMinDeltaPv > 0），量级仍由 _fSlopeMax 超阈证明 / signed slope, the sign of delta PV is proven nonzero and the magnitude stays proven by the slope floor
                    _fTauTan := _fDeltaPv / _fSlopeSig; // 切线法时间常数，除子量级已证超阈且符号与分子同源 / tangent time constant, the divisor magnitude is proven and its sign matches the numerator
                    _fDeadTan := _fTSlopeMax - (_fPvSlopeMax - _fPvBase) / _fSlopeSig; // 切线法纯延迟：截距用带符号斜率，负向阶跃不再系统性高估（R56 返修）/ tangent dead time, the intercept uses the signed slope so a negative step no longer overestimates
                    IF _fDeadTan < 0.0 THEN // 延迟负值不可能 / a negative dead time is impossible
                        _fDeadTan := 0.0; // 按零处理 / forced to zero
                        _bDeadClamped := TRUE; // 置钳位标志 / raise the clamp flag
                    END_IF
                ELSE // 斜率不可用 / the slope is unusable
                    _fTauTan := _fTauTwo; // 以两点法兜底 / fall back to the two-point result
                    _fDeadTan := _fDeadTwo; // 纯延迟同款兜底 / the dead time falls back the same way
                END_IF
                _fMvDen := fMvStep; // 增益分母落局部量 / the gain denominator lands in a local
                IF ABS(_fMvDen) <= fMvStepEps THEN // 分母近零 / denominator near zero
                    _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eMvZero; // 成因记幅度近零 / record the near-zero amplitude cause
                    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
                    _bValid := FALSE; // 参数不可交付 / parameters not deliverable
                    _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
                ELSE
                    _fGain := _fDeltaPv / _fMvDen; // 增益 = ΔPV / ΔMV / gain equals delta PV over delta MV
                    IF ABS(_fGain) > DL_FOPDT_GAINMAX THEN // 增益量级越界 / gain magnitude out of range
                        _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eCfgIllegal; // 成因记组态非法（量纲错配）/ record illegal configuration, dimension mismatch
                        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
                        _bValid := FALSE; // 参数不可交付 / parameters not deliverable
                        _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
                    ELSE
                        _fTauOut := _fTauTwo; // 出口时间常数默认取两点法 / the outlet time constant defaults to the two-point result
                        _fDeadOut := _fDeadTwo; // 出口纯延迟默认取两点法 / the outlet dead time defaults to the two-point result
                        IF bUseTangent THEN // 切线法优先 / the tangent method takes precedence
                            _fTauOut := _fTauTan; // 取切线法时间常数 / take the tangent time constant
                            _fDeadOut := _fDeadTan; // 取切线法纯延迟 / take the tangent dead time
                        END_IF
                        IF (_fTauOut < fTauMinS) OR (_fTauOut > fTauMaxS) THEN // 时间常数越接受域 / time constant outside the acceptable domain
                            _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eCfgIllegal; // 成因记组态非法（接受域不匹配）/ record illegal configuration, bound mismatch
                            _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
                            _bValid := FALSE; // 参数不可交付 / parameters not deliverable
                            _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
                        ELSIF _fDeadOut > fDeadMaxS THEN // 纯延迟越接受域 / dead time outside the acceptable domain
                            _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eCfgIllegal; // 成因记组态非法（接受域不匹配）/ record illegal configuration, bound mismatch
                            _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
                            _bValid := FALSE; // 参数不可交付 / parameters not deliverable
                            _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
                        ELSE
                            _fGainK := _fGain; // 增益落定 / settle the gain
                            _fTauS := _fTauOut; // 时间常数落定 / settle the time constant
                            _fDeadS := _fDeadOut; // 纯延迟落定 / settle the dead time
                            _fDeltaPvOut := _fDeltaPv; // 总变化量落定 / settle the total change
                            _fTauTwoOut := _fTauTwo; // 两点法时间常数落定 / settle the two-point time constant
                            _fDeadTwoOut := _fDeadTwo; // 两点法纯延迟落定 / settle the two-point dead time
                            _fTauTanOut := _fTauTan; // 切线法时间常数落定 / settle the tangent time constant
                            _fDeadTanOut := _fDeadTan; // 切线法纯延迟落定 / settle the tangent dead time
                            _fPvBaseOut := _fPvBase; // 基线落定 / settle the baseline
                            _fPvFinalOut := _fPvFinal; // 稳定点落定 / settle the settled value
                            _bValid := TRUE; // 参数可交付（锁存至下一次辨识）/ parameters deliverable until the next identification
                            _bIdentInt := TRUE; // 完成脉冲内部位置位（统一出口映射，R187）/ raise the internal done bit, mapped at the unified outlet
                            IF _bDeadClamped THEN // 延迟负值已钳零 / the dead time was clamped to zero
                                _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eDeadNeg; // 信息级成因，不置故障标志 / informational cause without raising the fault flag
                            END_IF
                            _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eDone; // 迁完成相 / migrate to the done phase
                        END_IF
                    END_IF
                END_IF
            END_IF
        END_IF
    END_IF

E_DL_FopdtState.eDone: // 完成相：参数驻留，仅接受复位或新阶跃 / done phase, parameters held, only reset or a new step accepted
    IF rtStep.Q THEN // 新阶跃沿 / a new step edge
        _nHead := 0; // 环窗槽位清零 / clear the ring slot cursor
        _nFill := 0; // 环窗计数清零 / clear the ring count
        _fSpan := 0.0; // 跨度估计清零 / clear the span estimate
        _fElapsedS := 0.0; // 历时清零 / clear the elapsed time
        _fSlopeMax := 0.0; // 最大斜率清零 / clear the maximum slope
        _fPvSlopeMax := 0.0; // 最大斜率处过程量清零（R56 返修补齐，与空闲相分支对齐）/ clear the value at the maximum slope, aligned with the idle branch
        _fTSlopeMax := 0.0; // 最大斜率时刻清零（R56 返修补齐，与空闲相分支对齐）/ clear the instant of the maximum slope, aligned with the idle branch
        _bCross28 := FALSE; // 穿越标志清零 / clear the crossing flag
        _bCross63 := FALSE; // 穿越标志清零 / clear the crossing flag
        _fPvPrev := fPv; // 新基线快照 / take a fresh baseline snapshot
        _fPvBase := fPv; // 新基线过程量 / take a fresh baseline process value
        _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eRise; // 迁上升相 / migrate to the rise phase
    END_IF

E_DL_FopdtState.eFault: // 故障相：原因锁存，等待复位沿 / fault phase, the cause is latched until the reset edge
    _bValid := FALSE; // 故障拍参数不可交付，数值保持上拍 / parameters are not deliverable and the values hold the last scan

ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R128）/ illegal phase fallback
    _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.ePhaseBad; // 成因记非法相位 / record the illegal phase cause
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _bValid := FALSE; // 参数不可交付 / parameters not deliverable
    _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 6｜超时判据：仅上升相内判，IN 已带相位闸（R212）/ segment 6, timeout verdict inside the rise phase only, IN already carries the phase gate
IF (_eState = E_DL_FopdtState.eRise) AND tonTimeout.Q AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 超时且未锁存 / timed out and not yet latched
    _eCause := E_DL_FopdtCause.eNoSettle; // 成因记超时未稳定 / record the timeout without settle cause
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _bValid := FALSE; // 参数不可交付 / parameters not deliverable
    _eState := E_DL_FopdtState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_IF

// 段 7｜统一出口：相位映射、单拍脉冲映射、故障锁存与有效位同源 / segment 7, unified outlet for phase mapping, single-shot pulse and matched fault outlets
eState := _eState; // 相位出口单点映射 / single-point phase outlet mapping
eCause := _eCause; // 成因出口单点映射（锁存量）/ single-point cause outlet mapping of the latched value
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源赋值 / the fault flag shares the latch source
bIdentDone := _bIdentInt; // 完成脉冲映射本拍值 / map the done bit for this scan
_bIdentInt := FALSE; // 映射后立即撤销，保证单拍宽度（R187 两段式）/ revoke right after mapping to keep a single-scan width
bValid := _bValid AND (NOT _bFault); // 有效出口受故障锁存否决（挂状态量，非单拍标志）/ the valid outlet is vetoed by the fault latch, a state quantity
fGainK := _fGainK; // 增益出口 / gain outlet
fTauS := _fTauS; // 时间常数出口 / time constant outlet
fDeadS := _fDeadS; // 纯延迟出口 / dead time outlet
fDeltaPv := _fDeltaPvOut; // 总变化量出口 / total change outlet
fPvBase := _fPvBaseOut; // 基线出口 / baseline outlet
fPvFinal := _fPvFinalOut; // 稳定点出口 / settled value outlet
fTauTwoPointS := _fTauTwoOut; // 两点法时间常数出口 / two-point time constant outlet
fDeadTwoPointS := _fDeadTwoOut; // 两点法纯延迟出口 / two-point dead time outlet
fTauTangentS := _fTauTanOut; // 切线法时间常数出口 / tangent time constant outlet
fDeadTangentS := _fDeadTanOut; // 切线法纯延迟出口 / tangent dead time outlet
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 车间能耗考核按月做预算：月初把本月能耗额度与已用量预置进计数器，每班累积实际能耗并与额度比较，接近额度分预警与超限两级提示；跨月自动结转并保留上月快照供追溯，额度或月份参数非法先置码拒收，能耗值非有限当拍不计入防污染累计量，复位分清当班与当月两级。
architecture_thought: 月度额度管理架构：段 0 无条件刷新月窗判定与跨月沿；段 1 在有效月窗内累加能耗（非有限当拍拒收并计数），比较额度分预警与超限两级带迟滞输出；跨月沿冻结上月快照数组并清当月累计；参数（额度/月份）非法先置码拒收不改动现行额度；复位分清当班与当月两入口，出口含已用量、剩余额度、两级标志与上月快照读数。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_EnergyMonthPreset
  分类   Category   : DL_Process
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : 月度能耗预算预置计数与超限预警。月度能耗预算按 12 个月预置表
                      取值（跨月沿自动换表并清零当月累计），能耗增量按脉冲沿累加，
                      出口给出已用 / 剩余 / 占用百分比 / 日均 / 月末预测，并按
                      预警阈与临界阈分四级（正常 / 预警 / 临界 / 超限）。
  溯源   Origin     : 月度预算预置 + 分级预警为本库通用能耗管理语义；本件为
                      clean-room 实现，仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签
                      roadmap-p2-energy），道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（R_TRIG / REAL 运算，无私有库、无方言转换）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只做预算计数与分级，不控制用能设备、不发停机命令；
                      二 能耗增量只在 bEnergyPulse 上升沿计入一次（防同拍重复计）；
                      三 跨月判据 = 年或月任一变化（同一月内不重复换表）；
                      四 负增量（表计回卷 / 换表）不计入并置信息级成因，不置故障；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      eLevel 四级互斥；bWarn 在预警及以上为真，bOver 仅超限为真；
                      bMonthRoll 为跨月单拍脉冲（内部位置位、出口映射后撤销）；
                      非有限能耗增量不穿透出口（已用量保持上拍值）；
                      eCause 故障级成员均与 bError 配对（R45），信息级不置故障。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 1 · 序号 3）

*)

TYPE E_DL_EngLevel :
(
    eNormal := 0,       // 正常：占用低于预警阈 / normal, occupancy below the warning threshold
    eWarn   := 10,      // 预警：占用达预警阈 / warning, occupancy reached the warning threshold
    eCrit   := 20,      // 临界：占用达临界阈 / critical, occupancy reached the critical threshold
    eOver   := 30       // 超限：占用越过 100% / over, occupancy beyond one hundred percent
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_EngCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：月/日/阈值或预算表越域（故障级）/ illegal config, month, day, threshold or budget table out of domain
    eBudgetZero := 2,   // 当月预算非正，占用率不可算（故障级）/ current month budget not positive, occupancy not computable
    eNegDelta   := 3,   // 负增量已忽略（信息级，不置故障）/ negative increment ignored, informational without a fault
    eBadDelta   := 4    // 增量非有限已忽略（信息级，不置故障）/ non-finite increment ignored, informational without a fault
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_EnergyMonthPreset
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable          : BOOL := TRUE;         // 使能，下降沿冻结累计并按使能沿重建 / enable, falling edge freezes accumulation, the rising edge rebuilds it
    bReset           : BOOL := FALSE;         // 复位上升沿清当月累计与告警 [-] / reset rising edge clears the monthly accumulation and alarms
    nYear            : INT := 2026;           // 当前年份 [年]，域 2000..2100 / current year [year], domain 2000 to 2100
    nMonth           : INT := 1;              // 当前月份 [月]，域 1..12 / current month [month], domain 1 to 12
    nDayOfMonth      : INT := 1;              // 当月第几日 [日]，域 1..31 / day of month [day], domain 1 to 31
    bEnergyPulse     : BOOL := FALSE;         // 能耗增量脉冲，上升沿计入一次 [-] / energy increment pulse, counted once on the rising edge
    fEnergyDeltaKwh  : REAL := 0.0;           // 单次脉冲的能耗增量 [千瓦时] / energy increment per pulse [kilowatt hour]
    fBudgetOverrideKwh: REAL := 0.0;          // 预算覆盖值，大于零时取代预置表 [千瓦时] / budget override, replaces the table when positive [kilowatt hour]
    fWarnPct         : REAL := 90.0;          // 预警阈，占预算百分比 [百分比] / warning threshold as a percentage of the budget [percent]
    fCritPct         : REAL := 95.0;          // 临界阈，占预算百分比 [百分比] / critical threshold as a percentage of the budget [percent]
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    afMonthBudgetKwh : ARRAY[1..12] OF REAL;  // 12 个月预算预置表，下标即月份 [千瓦时]，引用型入参由调用方持有 / twelve month budget preset table, subscript is the month [kilowatt hour], reference parameter owned by the caller
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fUsedKwh         : REAL := 0.0;           // 当月已用能耗 [千瓦时] / energy used in the current month [kilowatt hour]
    fBudgetKwh       : REAL := 0.0;           // 当月生效预算 [千瓦时] / effective budget of the current month [kilowatt hour]
    fRemainKwh       : REAL := 0.0;           // 当月剩余预算 [千瓦时]，可为负 / remaining budget of the current month, may be negative [kilowatt hour]
    fUsedPct         : REAL := 0.0;           // 当月预算占用百分比 [百分比] / monthly budget occupancy [percent]
    fDailyAvgKwh     : REAL := 0.0;           // 当月日均能耗 [千瓦时每日] / month to date daily average energy [kilowatt hour per day]
    fProjMonthKwh    : REAL := 0.0;           // 按日均推算的月末能耗 [千瓦时] / month end projection from the daily average [kilowatt hour]
    eLevel           : E_DL_EngLevel := E_DL_EngLevel.eNormal; // 预算级别出口 [枚举] / budget level outlet [enum]
    bWarn            : BOOL := FALSE;         // 预警及以上标志 [-] / warning and above flag
    bOver            : BOOL := FALSE;         // 超限标志 [-] / over budget flag
    bMonthRoll       : BOOL := FALSE;         // 跨月换表单拍脉冲 [-] / month rollover single-shot pulse
    nMonthActive     : INT := 0;              // 当前生效月份 [月] / currently active month [month]
    eCause           : E_DL_EngCause := E_DL_EngCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError           : BOOL := FALSE;         // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtEnergy         : R_TRIG;                // 能耗脉冲沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / energy pulse edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtReset          : R_TRIG;                // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eLevel          : E_DL_EngLevel := E_DL_EngLevel.eNormal;  // 内部级别，锁存至下拍重算 / internal level, recomputed every scan
    _eCause          : E_DL_EngCause := E_DL_EngCause.eNone;   // 内部信息级成因，每拍重算 / internal informational cause, recomputed every scan
    _eFaultCause     : E_DL_EngCause := E_DL_EngCause.eNone;   // 内部故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / internal fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault          : BOOL := FALSE;         // 故障锁存位（组态类成因）/ fault latch bit for configuration causes
    _bMonthRollInt   : BOOL := FALSE;         // 跨月脉冲内部位，统一出口映射 / internal rollover pulse bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _bInit           : BOOL := FALSE;         // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bMonthOk        : BOOL := FALSE;         // 年/月/日域闸通过 [-] / year, month and day domain gate passed
    _bDeltaUsable    : BOOL := FALSE;         // 本拍增量可计入 [-] / this scan increment is countable
    _bNegDelta       : BOOL := FALSE;         // 本拍增量为负 [-] / this scan increment is negative
    _bBadDelta       : BOOL := FALSE;         // 本拍增量非有限 [-] / this scan increment is non-finite
    _bDayOk          : BOOL := FALSE;         // 当日序号可用于日均分母 [-] / day index usable as the daily divisor
    _nYearPrev       : INT := 0;              // 上一拍年份快照 [年] / previous scan year snapshot [year]
    _nMonthPrev      : INT := -1;             // 上一拍月份快照，初值 -1 保证首拍必换表 [月] / previous scan month snapshot, minus one forces a rollover on the first scan
    _nMonthUse       : INT := 1;              // 钳定后的月份 [月] / clamped month [month]
    _nDayUse         : INT := 1;              // 钳定后的当日序号 [日] / clamped day index [day]
    _nDaysInMonth    : INT := 30;             // 当月日历天数 [日] / calendar days of the current month [day]
    _fBudgetUse      : REAL := 0.0;           // 生效预算暂存 [千瓦时] / effective budget held in a local [kilowatt hour]
    _fDeltaUse       : REAL := 0.0;           // 本拍计入的增量 [千瓦时] / increment actually counted this scan [kilowatt hour]
    _fUsed           : REAL := 0.0;           // 累计已用量保持块 [千瓦时] / accumulated energy holder [kilowatt hour]
    _fUsedAcc        : REAL := 0.0;           // 累计已用量工作值 [千瓦时] / accumulated energy working value [kilowatt hour]
    _fPct            : REAL := 0.0;           // 占用率工作值 [百分比] / occupancy working value [percent]
    _fRemain         : REAL := 0.0;           // 剩余量工作值 [千瓦时] / remaining working value [kilowatt hour]
    _fDaily          : REAL := 0.0;           // 日均工作值 [千瓦时每日] / daily average working value [kilowatt hour per day]
    _fProj           : REAL := 0.0;           // 月末预测工作值 [千瓦时] / projection working value [kilowatt hour]
    _fDayDiv         : REAL := 1.0;           // 日均除子（当日序号）[日] / daily divisor, the day index [day]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_EMP_WARNPCT_MIN : REAL := 1.0;         // 预警阈下限 [百分比] / warning threshold floor [percent]
    DL_EMP_CRITPCT_MAX : REAL := 100.0;       // 临界阈上限 [百分比] / critical threshold ceiling [percent]
    DL_EMP_USED_MAX    : REAL := 1.0E12;      // 已用量上限，防累计溢出失真 [千瓦时] / used energy ceiling against accumulation distortion [kilowatt hour]
    DL_EMP_DELTA_MAX   : REAL := 1.0E7;       // 单次增量上限，防量纲错配放大 [千瓦时] / single increment ceiling against a dimension mismatch [kilowatt hour]
    DL_EMP_DAY_MAX     : INT := 31;           // 月内最大天数 [日] / maximum days within a month [day]
    DL_EMP_YEAR_MIN    : INT := 2000;         // 年份下限 [年] / year floor [year]
    DL_EMP_YEAR_MAX    : INT := 2100;         // 年份上限 [年] / year ceiling [year]
END_VAR

// 段 0｜沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh of the edge detectors, never inside a branch
rtEnergy(CLK := bEnergyPulse); // 能耗脉冲沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the energy pulse edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）：月份快照置 -1 使首拍必走一次换表 / segment 1, first scan initialisation, the month snapshot at minus one forces one rollover on the first scan
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _nMonthPrev := -1; // 月份快照置非法值 / put the month snapshot at an illegal value
    _nYearPrev := 0; // 年份快照清零 / clear the year snapshot
    _fUsed := 0.0; // 已用量清零 / clear the accumulated energy
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_EngCause.eNone; // 信息级成因清零 / clear the informational cause
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_EngCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
END_IF

// 段 2｜域闸：年月日、阈值对、预置表逐项（R151 全覆盖）/ segment 2, domain gate over year, month, day, the threshold pair and the preset table
_bMonthOk := TRUE; // 域闸标志预置通过 / preset the domain gate flag to passed
IF (nYear < DL_EMP_YEAR_MIN) OR (nYear > DL_EMP_YEAR_MAX) THEN // 年份越域 / year out of domain
    _bMonthOk := FALSE; // 判越域 / mark out of domain
END_IF
IF (nMonth < 1) OR (nMonth > 12) THEN // 月份越域 / month out of domain
    _bMonthOk := FALSE; // 判越域 / mark out of domain
END_IF
IF (nDayOfMonth < 1) OR (nDayOfMonth > DL_EMP_DAY_MAX) THEN // 当日序号越域 / day index out of domain
    _bMonthOk := FALSE; // 判越域 / mark out of domain
END_IF
IF (fWarnPct < DL_EMP_WARNPCT_MIN) OR (fWarnPct > DL_EMP_CRITPCT_MAX) OR (fWarnPct <> fWarnPct) THEN // 预警阈越域或非有限 / warning threshold out of domain or non-finite
    _bMonthOk := FALSE; // 判越域 / mark out of domain
END_IF
IF (fCritPct < fWarnPct) OR (fCritPct > DL_EMP_CRITPCT_MAX) OR (fCritPct <> fCritPct) THEN // 临界阈低于预警阈或越域 / critical threshold below the warning threshold or out of domain
    _bMonthOk := FALSE; // 判越域 / mark out of domain
END_IF
IF (fBudgetOverrideKwh <> fBudgetOverrideKwh) OR (fBudgetOverrideKwh < 0.0) THEN // 预算覆盖值非有限或为负 / budget override non-finite or negative
    _bMonthOk := FALSE; // 判越域 / mark out of domain
END_IF
IF _bMonthOk THEN // 域内才可安全读预置表 / the preset table is only read inside the domain
    _nMonthUse := nMonth; // 月份直通 / month passes through
    _nDayUse := nDayOfMonth; // 当日序号直通 / day index passes through
ELSE // 域外走两级回退（R117）/ out of domain uses the two stage fallback
    _nMonthUse := 1; // 一级：月份回默认一 / stage one, the month falls back to one
    _nDayUse := 1; // 一级：当日回默认一 / stage one, the day falls back to one
    IF NOT _bFault THEN // 未锁存才记故障 / record the fault only when not yet latched
        _eFaultCause := E_DL_EngCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因记组态非法 / record the illegal configuration cause
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 3｜换表判据：年或月任一变化即换表，首拍必换；同年同月不重复换表 / segment 3, rollover when the year or the month changed, mandatory on the first scan
IF (_nMonthUse <> _nMonthPrev) OR (nYear <> _nYearPrev) THEN // 跨月或跨年 / month or year changed
    _nMonthPrev := _nMonthUse; // 月份快照推进 / advance the month snapshot
    _nYearPrev := nYear; // 年份快照推进 / advance the year snapshot
    _fUsed := 0.0; // 换表清零当月累计 / clear the monthly accumulation on rollover
    _bMonthRollInt := TRUE; // 跨月脉冲内部位置位（出口映射后撤销）/ raise the internal rollover bit, revoked after outlet mapping
    _eCause := E_DL_EngCause.eNone; // 换表清信息级成因（跨月是正常事件）/ clear the informational cause, a rollover is a normal event
END_IF

// 段 4｜预算取值：覆盖值优先，其次预置表；两项都非正判故障 / segment 4, effective budget, the override first and the preset table second, both non-positive is a fault
_fBudgetUse := 0.0; // 生效预算预置零 / preset the effective budget to zero
IF fBudgetOverrideKwh > 0.0 THEN // 覆盖值生效 / the override is effective
    _fBudgetUse := fBudgetOverrideKwh; // 取覆盖值 / take the override
ELSE // 覆盖值未给 / the override is absent
    _fBudgetUse := afMonthBudgetKwh[_nMonthUse]; // 按钳定月份取预置值，下标 1..12 已回钳 / read the preset by the clamped month, the index is already inside one through twelve
END_IF
IF (_fBudgetUse <> _fBudgetUse) OR ((_fBudgetUse - _fBudgetUse) <> (_fBudgetUse - _fBudgetUse)) THEN // 预算非有限 / budget non-finite
    _fBudgetUse := 0.0; // 非有限归零，绝不进除法 / zeroed so nothing non-finite enters a division
END_IF
IF _fBudgetUse <= 0.0 THEN // 预算非正 / budget not positive
    IF NOT _bFault THEN // 未锁存才记故障 / record the fault only when not yet latched
        _eFaultCause := E_DL_EngCause.eBudgetZero; // 故障级成因记预算非正 / record the non-positive budget cause
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 5｜增量计入：仅上升沿、仅有限、仅非负；负与非有限各记信息级成因 / segment 5, increment only on the rising edge, only finite, only non-negative
_bDeltaUsable := FALSE; // 可计入标志预置假 / preset the countable flag to false
_bNegDelta := FALSE; // 负增量标志预置假 / preset the negative increment flag to false
_bBadDelta := FALSE; // 非有限增量标志预置假 / preset the non-finite increment flag to false
_fDeltaUse := 0.0; // 本拍计入量预置零 / preset the counted increment to zero
IF rtEnergy.Q THEN // 脉冲上升沿 / rising edge of the pulse
    IF (fEnergyDeltaKwh <> fEnergyDeltaKwh) OR ((fEnergyDeltaKwh - fEnergyDeltaKwh) <> (fEnergyDeltaKwh - fEnergyDeltaKwh)) THEN // 增量非有限 / increment non-finite
        _bBadDelta := TRUE; // 置非有限标志 / raise the non-finite flag
    ELSIF fEnergyDeltaKwh < 0.0 THEN // 增量为负（表计回卷或换表）/ increment negative, meter rollback or replacement
        _bNegDelta := TRUE; // 置负增量标志 / raise the negative flag
    ELSIF fEnergyDeltaKwh > DL_EMP_DELTA_MAX THEN // 增量越上限 / increment above the ceiling
        _fDeltaUse := DL_EMP_DELTA_MAX; // 上钳，防量纲错配放大 / clamp upward against a dimension mismatch
        _bDeltaUsable := TRUE; // 置可计入标志 / raise the countable flag
    ELSE // 正常增量 / normal increment
        _fDeltaUse := fEnergyDeltaKwh; // 直通计入 / counted as received
        _bDeltaUsable := TRUE; // 置可计入标志 / raise the countable flag
    END_IF
END_IF
_eCause := E_DL_EngCause.eNone; // 信息级成因每拍重算 / the informational cause is recomputed every scan
IF _bNegDelta THEN // 负增量拍 / negative increment scan
    _eCause := E_DL_EngCause.eNegDelta; // 信息级成因，不置故障（R45 反向：信息级不配对 bError）/ informational cause without a fault
ELSIF _bBadDelta THEN // 非有限增量拍 / non-finite increment scan
    _eCause := E_DL_EngCause.eBadDelta; // 信息级成因，不置故障 / informational cause without a fault
END_IF

// 段 6｜累计与复位：复位沿清当月累计；累计上限饱和并置信息级成因 / segment 6, accumulation and reset, with saturation at the ceiling
_fUsedAcc := _fUsed; // 工作值取保持值 / the working value takes the holder
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _fUsedAcc := 0.0; // 当月累计清零 / clear the monthly accumulation
END_IF
IF _bDeltaUsable THEN // 本拍有可计入增量 / a countable increment exists this scan
    _fUsedAcc := _fUsedAcc + _fDeltaUse; // 累加 / accumulate
    IF _fUsedAcc > DL_EMP_USED_MAX THEN // 累计越上限 / accumulation above the ceiling
        _fUsedAcc := DL_EMP_USED_MAX; // 饱和到上限 / saturate at the ceiling
    END_IF
END_IF
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能：冻结保持末值（R191 显式声明）/ disabled, freeze and hold the last value as declared
    _fUsedAcc := _fUsed; // 冻结保持，不再累加 / freeze and hold without further accumulation
END_IF
_fUsed := _fUsedAcc; // 保持块更新 / refresh the holder

// 段 7｜日历天数与日均：闰年二月按 29 日；除子先域闸 / segment 7, calendar days and daily average, the divisor is gated first
_nDaysInMonth := 31; // 默认 31 日 / default thirty one days
CASE _nMonthUse OF
1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12: // 大月 / long months
    _nDaysInMonth := 31; // 三十一日 / thirty one days
2: // 二月 / february
    IF ((nYear MOD 4) = 0) AND (((nYear MOD 100) <> 0) OR ((nYear MOD 400) = 0)) THEN // 闰年判据 / leap year criterion
        _nDaysInMonth := 29; // 闰年二月二十九日 / twenty nine days in a leap year
    ELSE
        _nDaysInMonth := 28; // 平年二月二十八日 / twenty eight days in a common year
    END_IF
4, 6, 9, 11: // 小月 / short months
    _nDaysInMonth := 30; // 三十日 / thirty days
ELSE // 非法月份兜底（R128）/ illegal month fallback
    _nDaysInMonth := 30; // 兜底三十日 / fall back to thirty days
END_CASE
_bDayOk := (_nDayUse >= 1) AND (_nDayUse <= _nDaysInMonth); // 当日序号在日历域内 / the day index is inside the calendar domain
IF _bDayOk THEN // 除子可用 / the divisor is usable
    _fDayDiv := _nDayUse; // 除子取当日序号，已证 不小于 1 / the divisor takes the day index, proven not below one
ELSE
    _fDayDiv := 1.0; // 回退为 1，防除零 / fall back to one against division by zero
END_IF

// 段 8｜占用率与分级：预算非正时不计算占用率，级别保持上拍 / segment 8, occupancy and grading, skipped when the budget is not positive
IF _fBudgetUse > 0.0 THEN // 预算可用 / the budget is usable
    _fPct := _fUsed / _fBudgetUse * 100.0; // 占用率，除子已证大于零 / occupancy, divisor proven positive
    _fRemain := _fBudgetUse - _fUsed; // 剩余量（可为负）/ remaining budget, may be negative
    _fDaily := _fUsed / _fDayDiv; // 日均能耗，除子已证不小于 1 / daily average, divisor proven not below one
    _fProj := _fDaily * INT_TO_REAL(_nDaysInMonth); // 月末预测，乘数为日历天数 / month end projection over the calendar days
    IF _fPct >= 100.0 THEN // 越过全额 / beyond the full budget
        _eLevel := E_DL_EngLevel.eOver; // 超限级 / over level
    ELSIF _fPct >= fCritPct THEN // 达临界阈 / reached the critical threshold
        _eLevel := E_DL_EngLevel.eCrit; // 临界级 / critical level
    ELSIF _fPct >= fWarnPct THEN // 达预警阈 / reached the warning threshold
        _eLevel := E_DL_EngLevel.eWarn; // 预警级 / warning level
    ELSE
        _eLevel := E_DL_EngLevel.eNormal; // 正常级 / normal level
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 9｜统一出口：脉冲映射、名实双出口、故障与级别落定 / segment 9, unified outlet for the pulse, the matched flags and the level
bMonthRoll := _bMonthRollInt; // 跨月脉冲映射本拍值 / map the rollover pulse for this scan
_bMonthRollInt := FALSE; // 映射后立即撤销，保证单拍宽度（R187 两段式）/ revoke right after mapping to keep a single-scan width
fUsedKwh := _fUsed; // 已用量出口 / used energy outlet
fBudgetKwh := _fBudgetUse; // 生效预算出口 / effective budget outlet
fRemainKwh := _fRemain; // 剩余量出口 / remaining budget outlet
fUsedPct := _fPct; // 占用率出口 / occupancy outlet
fDailyAvgKwh := _fDaily; // 日均出口 / daily average outlet
fProjMonthKwh := _fProj; // 月末预测出口 / projection outlet
eLevel := _eLevel; // 级别出口单点映射 / single-point level outlet mapping
bWarn := (_eLevel = E_DL_EngLevel.eWarn) OR (_eLevel = E_DL_EngLevel.eCrit) OR (_eLevel = E_DL_EngLevel.eOver); // 预警及以上（挂状态量）/ warning and above, a state quantity
bOver := (_eLevel = E_DL_EngLevel.eOver); // 超限（挂状态量）/ over budget, a state quantity
nMonthActive := _nMonthUse; // 生效月份出口 / active month outlet
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eCause := _eFaultCause; // 故障级成因锁存回放（禁按当下输入重推断）/ the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSE
    eCause := _eCause; // 信息级成因直映 / the informational cause is mapped directly
END_IF
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 多腔体炉管各测温点报文单位不一（摄氏/华氏/开尔文混用），上位需要统一口径展示：对整行腔体温值按组态单位批量换算到统一单位，非法单位整行拒绝并置码保持上拍输出，非有限单点值换算跳过并单列计数不污染整行，换算系数用常量表不写魔数，腔体数可组态且越界钳位。
architecture_thought: 批量换算行架构：单位由 ENUM+CASE 选择换算系数，常量系数表集中声明不含魔数；入口先做单位合法性整行闸（非法整行拒绝保持上拍并置码），再逐腔判有限性（非有限跳过换算并单列计数），腔数越界钳位；输出行与跳过计数分列出口，整行与单点失效语义严格分离，无状态量每次调用独立计算。
