                      结果、逐通道有效性掩码与统计计数。内核为「先归一到摄氏、
                      再由摄氏展开到目标温标」两段式，六种换向共用同一对归一 /
                      展开函数体，不存在重复公式分支。
  溯源   Origin     : 温标换算为公开物理定义（0 摄氏度 = 273.15 开尔文 = 32 华氏度，
                      华氏步长为摄氏的 1.8 倍）；本件为 clean-room 实现，仅借鉴来源

  输出契约 Output contract:

                      wInvalidMask 位 i-1 对应通道 i，自证向量：仅通道 1 无效 → 16#0001，
                      仅通道 8 无效 → 16#0080；
                      故障级成因 eUnitBad 与 bError 配对（R45），信息级成因永不置 bError。

TYPE E_DL_TempUnit :
(
    eCelsius    := 0,   // 摄氏度 [摄氏度] / degree Celsius
    eFahrenheit := 10,  // 华氏度 [华氏度] / degree Fahrenheit
    eKelvin     := 20   // 开尔文 [开尔文] / Kelvin
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_TubCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eUnitBad    := 1,   // 温标枚举非法（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal temperature unit enumeration, a fault paired with bError
    eCountBad   := 2,   // 通道数越域已回钳（信息级）/ channel count out of domain and clamped, informational
    eChanBad    := 3,   // 存在非有限通道，已保持上拍值（信息级）/ non-finite channels present and held at the last value, informational
    eAbsZero    := 4    // 结果低于绝对零度已钳位（信息级）/ result below absolute zero and clamped, informational
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_ChamberTempUnitBank
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable        : BOOL := TRUE;           // 使能，失能时全部通道保持上拍值 [-] / enable, all channels hold their last value when disabled
    bReset         : BOOL := FALSE;          // 复位上升沿清故障锁存与掩码 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch and the mask
    eUnitIn        : E_DL_TempUnit := E_DL_TempUnit.eCelsius;    // 源温标 [枚举] / source temperature unit [enum]
    eUnitOut       : E_DL_TempUnit := E_DL_TempUnit.eCelsius;    // 目标温标 [枚举] / target temperature unit [enum]
    nChamberCount  : INT := 8;               // 参与换算的腔室数 [个]，域 1..8 / participating channels [count], domain 1 to 8
    bClampAbsZero  : BOOL := TRUE;           // 真 = 低于绝对零度钳位，假 = 仅置无效位不改值 [-] / true clamps below absolute zero, false only flags
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    afTempIn       : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL;    // 逐腔室温度输入 [源温标单位]，引用型入参由调用方持有 / per chamber temperature inputs in source unit, reference parameter owned by the caller
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    afTempOut      : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL := [8(0.0)]; // 逐腔室换算结果 [目标温标单位] / per chamber converted results in target unit
    wInvalidMask   : WORD := 16#0000;        // 无效通道掩码，位 i-1 对应通道 i [-] / invalid channel mask, bit i minus one maps to channel i
    nValidCount    : INT := 0;               // 本拍有效通道数 [个] / valid channel count of this scan
    bAllValid      : BOOL := FALSE;          // 全部参与通道有效 [-] / all participating channels valid
    bAnyInvalid    : BOOL := FALSE;          // 存在无效通道 [-] / at least one invalid channel
    fSumOut        : REAL := 0.0;            // 有效通道结果之和 [目标温标单位] / sum of the valid converted results
    fAvgOut        : REAL := 0.0;            // 有效通道结果均值 [目标温标单位] / mean of the valid converted results
    eCause         : E_DL_TubCause := E_DL_TubCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError         : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtReset        : R_TRIG;                 // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eCause        : E_DL_TubCause := E_DL_TubCause.eNone;  // 内部成因，故障级锁存、信息级每拍重算 / internal cause, latched for faults and recomputed for information
    _bFault        : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障锁存位（温标枚举非法）/ fault latch bit for an illegal unit enumeration
    _bInit         : BOOL := FALSE;          // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bUnitInOk     : BOOL := FALSE;          // 源温标枚举合法性 [-] / source unit enumeration validity
    _bUnitOutOk    : BOOL := FALSE;          // 目标温标枚举合法性 [-] / target unit enumeration validity
    _bChanOk       : BOOL := FALSE;          // 单通道输入有限性 [-] / single channel input finiteness
    _bResultOk     : BOOL := FALSE;          // 单通道结果有限性 [-] / single channel result finiteness
    _bChanBitBad   : BOOL := FALSE;          // 单通道无效位 [-] / single channel invalid bit
    _bAbsZeroHit   : BOOL := FALSE;          // 本拍出现绝对零度钳位 [-] / an absolute zero clamp occurred this scan
    _bChanNonFin   : BOOL := FALSE;          // 本拍出现非有限通道 [-] / a non-finite channel occurred this scan
    _bCountClamped : BOOL := FALSE;          // 通道数被回钳 [-] / the channel count was clamped
    _nUseCount     : INT := 0;               // 钳定后的参与通道数 [个] / clamped participating channel count
    _nIdx          : INT := 0;               // 通道游标（1 起，回钳 1..8）[通道号] / channel cursor, one-based, clamped one through eight
    _fCelsius      : REAL := 0.0;            // 归一到摄氏度的中间量 [摄氏度] / intermediate normalised to Celsius
    _fResult       : REAL := 0.0;            // 展开到目标温标的中间量 [目标温标单位] / intermediate expanded to the target unit
    _fLowLimit     : REAL := 0.0;            // 目标温标绝对零度 [目标温标单位] / absolute zero in the target unit
    _fSum          : REAL := 0.0;            // 有效结果累加 [目标温标单位] / running sum of valid results
    _wMask         : WORD := 16#0000;        // 掩码累加器，每拍清零重建 / mask accumulator, rebuilt every scan
    _wBitOne       : WORD := 16#0001;        // 单位位常量，供常量移位使用 [-] / single bit constant for the shift
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_TUB_MAX        : INT := 8;            // 通道容量，同时也是游标回钳上界 [个] / channel capacity and cursor clamp upper bound
    DL_TUB_K_OFFSET   : REAL := 273.15;      // 摄氏与开尔文零点偏移 [开尔文] / zero offset between Celsius and Kelvin
    DL_TUB_F_RATIO    : REAL := 1.8;         // 华氏与摄氏步长比 [无量纲] / scale ratio between Fahrenheit and Celsius
    DL_TUB_F_OFFSET   : REAL := 32.0;        // 华氏零点偏移 [华氏度] / zero offset of Fahrenheit
    DL_TUB_ABS_C      : REAL := -273.15;     // 摄氏绝对零度 [摄氏度] / absolute zero in Celsius
    DL_TUB_ABS_F      : REAL := -459.67;     // 华氏绝对零度 [华氏度] / absolute zero in Fahrenheit
    DL_TUB_ABS_K      : REAL := 0.0;         // 开尔文绝对零度 [开尔文] / absolute zero in Kelvin
    DL_TUB_ABS_MARGIN : REAL := 0.01;        // 绝对零度容差带，吸收换算舍入 [目标温标单位] / absolute zero tolerance absorbing rounding
    DL_TUB_MASK_NONE  : WORD := 16#0000;     // 空掩码常量 [-] / empty mask constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜复位沿无条件周期刷新（禁入分支）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh of the reset edge, never inside a branch
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_TubCause.eNone; // 成因清零 / clear the cause
    _wMask := DL_TUB_MASK_NONE; // 掩码清零 / clear the mask
    _nIdx := 1; // 游标归位 / park the cursor at one
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清锁存与清成因（通道输出保持，避免读数跳变）/ segment 2, reset edge scope, the latch and cause are cleared while channel outputs are held
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_TubCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清成因 / scope one, clear the cause
    _wMask := DL_TUB_MASK_NONE; // 作用域二：清无效掩码 / scope two, clear the invalid mask
END_IF

// 段 3｜温标枚举域闸：枚举有序直比，禁枚举转整数（跨平台安全）/ segment 3, unit enumeration gate by direct comparison, never by casting an enum to an integer
_bUnitInOk := (eUnitIn = E_DL_TempUnit.eCelsius) OR (eUnitIn = E_DL_TempUnit.eFahrenheit) OR (eUnitIn = E_DL_TempUnit.eKelvin); // 源温标三选一 / the source unit is one of three
_bUnitOutOk := (eUnitOut = E_DL_TempUnit.eCelsius) OR (eUnitOut = E_DL_TempUnit.eFahrenheit) OR (eUnitOut = E_DL_TempUnit.eKelvin); // 目标温标三选一 / the target unit is one of three
IF ((NOT _bUnitInOk) OR (NOT _bUnitOutOk)) AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 枚举非法且未锁存 / illegal enumeration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_TubCause.eUnitBad; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
END_IF

// 段 4｜通道数回钳：越域走信息级成因，不锁存故障 / segment 4, channel count clamping with an informational cause
_bCountClamped := FALSE; // 回钳标志预置假 / preset the clamp flag to false
_nUseCount := nChamberCount; // 通道数直通 / channel count passes through
IF _nUseCount < 1 THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nUseCount := 1; // 回钳到 1 / clamp to one
    _bCountClamped := TRUE; // 置回钳标志 / raise the clamp flag
ELSIF _nUseCount > DL_TUB_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nUseCount := DL_TUB_MAX; // 回钳到容量上限 / clamp to the capacity ceiling
    _bCountClamped := TRUE; // 置回钳标志 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能：不换算，全部通道保持上拍值（R191 显式声明冻结语义）/ disabled, no conversion and every channel holds its last value
    _nUseCount := 0; // 参与通道数置零使主循环不执行 / the participating count is zeroed so the main loop does not run
END_IF

// 段 5｜目标温标绝对零度选取（三支互异，非法枚举按摄氏兜底且故障已锁存）/ segment 5, absolute zero selection for the target unit
_fLowLimit := DL_TUB_ABS_C; // 绝对零度默认取摄氏 / absolute zero defaults to Celsius
IF eUnitOut = E_DL_TempUnit.eFahrenheit THEN // 目标华氏 / target Fahrenheit
    _fLowLimit := DL_TUB_ABS_F; // 华氏绝对零度 / Fahrenheit absolute zero
ELSIF eUnitOut = E_DL_TempUnit.eKelvin THEN // 目标开尔文 / target Kelvin
    _fLowLimit := DL_TUB_ABS_K; // 开尔文绝对零度 / Kelvin absolute zero
END_IF

// 段 6｜逐通道换算主循环 / segment 6, per channel conversion loop
_wMask := DL_TUB_MASK_NONE; // 掩码每拍清零重建 / the mask is rebuilt every scan
_fSum := 0.0; // 有效结果和清零 / clear the valid result sum
nValidCount := 0; // 有效通道计数清零 / clear the valid channel count
_bAbsZeroHit := FALSE; // 绝对零度钳位标志清零 / clear the absolute zero clamp flag
_bChanNonFin := FALSE; // 非有限通道标志清零 / clear the non-finite channel flag
_nIdx := 1; // 游标自 1 起，上界由 _nUseCount 约束 / the cursor starts at one, bounded by the usable count
WHILE _nIdx <= _nUseCount DO // 循环上界为钳定后的通道数，天然不越 8 / the loop bound is the clamped count, never beyond eight
    _bChanOk := (afTempIn[_nIdx] = afTempIn[_nIdx]) AND ((afTempIn[_nIdx] - afTempIn[_nIdx]) = (afTempIn[_nIdx] - afTempIn[_nIdx])); // 输入有限性闸，NaN 用自反、无穷用差值自减 / input finiteness gate
    _bChanBitBad := FALSE; // 单通道无效位预置假 / preset the single channel invalid bit to false
    IF NOT _bChanOk THEN // 输入非有限 / non-finite input
        _bChanBitBad := TRUE; // 置该通道无效位 / raise the invalid bit of that channel
        _bChanNonFin := TRUE; // 记非有限通道成因 / record the non-finite channel cause
    ELSE
        // 段 6.1｜先归一到摄氏度 / segment 6.1, normalise to Celsius first
        IF eUnitIn = E_DL_TempUnit.eFahrenheit THEN // 源华氏 / source Fahrenheit
            _fCelsius := (afTempIn[_nIdx] - DL_TUB_F_OFFSET) / DL_TUB_F_RATIO; // 除以常量 1.8，除子为非零常量 / divided by the constant one point eight
        ELSIF eUnitIn = E_DL_TempUnit.eKelvin THEN // 源开尔文 / source Kelvin
            _fCelsius := afTempIn[_nIdx] - DL_TUB_K_OFFSET; // 减零点偏移 / subtract the zero offset
        ELSE // 源摄氏或非法枚举（故障已锁存）/ source Celsius or an illegal enumeration with the fault latched
            _fCelsius := afTempIn[_nIdx]; // 直通 / pass through
        END_IF
        // 段 6.2｜再由摄氏度展开到目标温标 / segment 6.2, expand from Celsius to the target unit
        IF eUnitOut = E_DL_TempUnit.eFahrenheit THEN // 目标华氏 / target Fahrenheit
            _fResult := _fCelsius * DL_TUB_F_RATIO + DL_TUB_F_OFFSET; // 乘步长比加零点偏移 / scale then offset
        ELSIF eUnitOut = E_DL_TempUnit.eKelvin THEN // 目标开尔文 / target Kelvin
            _fResult := _fCelsius + DL_TUB_K_OFFSET; // 加零点偏移 / add the zero offset
        ELSE // 目标摄氏或非法枚举（故障已锁存）/ target Celsius or an illegal enumeration with the fault latched
            _fResult := _fCelsius; // 直通 / pass through
        END_IF
        _bResultOk := (_fResult = _fResult) AND ((_fResult - _fResult) = (_fResult - _fResult)); // 结果有限性闸 / result finiteness gate
        IF NOT _bResultOk THEN // 结果非有限 / non-finite result
            _bChanBitBad := TRUE; // 置该通道无效位 / raise the invalid bit of that channel
            _bChanNonFin := TRUE; // 记非有限通道成因 / record the non-finite channel cause
        ELSE
            IF _fResult < (_fLowLimit + DL_TUB_ABS_MARGIN) THEN // 低于绝对零度（含舍入容差带）/ below absolute zero including the rounding band
                _bAbsZeroHit := TRUE; // 记绝对零度成因 / record the absolute zero cause
                _bChanBitBad := TRUE; // 置该通道无效位 / raise the invalid bit of that channel
                IF bClampAbsZero THEN // 需要钳位 / clamping requested
                    _fResult := _fLowLimit; // 钳到绝对零点 / clamp to absolute zero
                END_IF
            END_IF
            afTempOut[_nIdx] := _fResult; // 结果落定到该通道 / settle the result into that channel
        END_IF
        IF NOT _bChanBitBad THEN // 该通道有效 / the channel is valid
            nValidCount := nValidCount + 1; // 有效计数递增 / increment the valid count
            _fSum := _fSum + afTempOut[_nIdx]; // 累加有效结果 / accumulate the valid result
        END_IF
    END_IF
    IF _bChanBitBad THEN // 该通道无效 / the channel is invalid
        _wMask := _wMask OR SHL(_wBitOne, _nIdx - 1); // 置无效位，位移量 0..7 由数组边界与循环上界共同证明 / set the invalid bit, the shift zero through seven is proven by the array bound and the loop bound
    END_IF
    _nIdx := _nIdx + 1; // 游标递增 / increment the cursor
END_WHILE

// 段 7｜统计与成因分派（R190 归因唯一，固定优先级：故障 > 回钳 > 非有限 > 绝对零度）/ segment 7, statistics and cause dispatch with a fixed priority
bAnyInvalid := _wMask <> DL_TUB_MASK_NONE; // 存在无效通道 / at least one invalid channel
bAllValid := (_wMask = DL_TUB_MASK_NONE) AND (_nUseCount >= 1); // 全部参与通道有效 / all participating channels valid
fSumOut := _fSum; // 有效和出口 / valid sum outlet
IF nValidCount > 0 THEN // 有有效通道才可算均值 / the mean needs at least one valid channel
    fAvgOut := _fSum / INT_TO_REAL(nValidCount); // 均值，除子已证大于零 / mean, divisor proven positive
ELSE
    fAvgOut := 0.0; // 无有效通道时均值为零 / zero mean when nothing is valid
END_IF
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    _eCause := E_DL_TubCause.eUnitBad; // 故障级成因锁存回放（禁按当下输入重推断）/ the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSIF _bCountClamped THEN // 通道数被回钳 / the channel count was clamped
    _eCause := E_DL_TubCause.eCountBad; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSIF _bChanNonFin THEN // 存在非有限通道 / non-finite channels present
    _eCause := E_DL_TubCause.eChanBad; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSIF _bAbsZeroHit THEN // 存在绝对零度钳位 / an absolute zero clamp occurred
    _eCause := E_DL_TubCause.eAbsZero; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSE
    _eCause := E_DL_TubCause.eNone; // 无成因 / no cause
END_IF

// 段 8｜统一出口 / segment 8, unified outlet
wInvalidMask := _wMask; // 掩码出口 / mask outlet
eCause := _eCause; // 成因出口单点映射 / single-point cause outlet mapping
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 辊压机压力系统十几个报警点需要打包成一个状态字上送 MES：每个报警点按组态位号写入 WORD 的对应位，位号冲突或越界组态时置码拒收整个字；报警字需同时给出原始字与反转后的正常字方便不同上位习惯，任一位变化时置变更沿供事件触发，打包纯位操作不得使用厂商字拼接指令。
architecture_thought: 位段打包架构：组态位号先整表校验（重复/越界即整字拒收置码），打包时按位号逐点用移位与 OR 写入对应位，不用厂商字拼接指令；原始字与取反正常字双出口，任一位相对上拍变化置变更沿（用无条件刷新的 R_TRIG 类沿检测于整字比较）；组态校验失败不输出字保持上拍，出口含原始字/正常字/变更沿/错误码。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_RollPressBitWord
  分类   Category   : DL_Process
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : 辊压压力报警字位段打包。逐区（1..8）比较实测压力与逐区
                      高压阈 / 低压阈，带回差防抖，把报警状态打包为一个 16 位字：
                      低 8 位段 = 低压报警（位 i-1 对应区 i），
                      高 8 位段 = 高压报警（位 8+i-1 对应区 i），
                      另出无效区掩码字（该区不可判：阈值非法或压力非有限）。
  溯源   Origin     : 逐区位段打包与回差防抖为通用报警字组织方式；本件为 clean-room
                      实现，仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签 roadmap-p2-rollpress），
                      道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（WORD / SHL / NOT / AND / OR，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只做压力报警字打包，不驱动辊缝、不做停机决策（属主边界）；
                      二 回差判据挂在报警字自身状态上（已置位者按 阈 - 回差 复位）；
                      三 非有限压力不判高低压，只置无效位，出口报警位保持上拍；
                      四 阈值非法（高阈不高于低阈或非有限）→ 该区无效 + 故障锁存；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      wAlarmWord 低字节为低压段、高字节为高压段，两段互不跨用；
                      自证向量：仅 1 区低压 → 16#0001，仅 1 区高压 → 16#0100，
                      1 区低压且 8 区高压 → 16#0180；
                      nFirstAlarmZone 为 1..8，无报警为 0；uAlarmCount 为本拍置位数；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 1 · 序号 5）
  ==================================================================
*)

TYPE E_DL_RpbCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eThrBad     := 1,   // 阈值非法：高阈不高于低阈或非有限（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal threshold, high not above low or non-finite, a fault paired with bError
    eCountBad   := 2,   // 区数越域已回钳（信息级）/ zone count out of domain and clamped, informational
    ePressBad   := 3    // 压力非有限，该区不可判（信息级）/ non-finite pressure, the zone is undecidable, informational
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_RollPressBitWord
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;             // 使能，失能时报警字冻结保持末值 [-] / enable, the alarm word freezes and holds its last value when disabled
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;           // 复位上升沿清报警位与故障锁存 [-] / reset rising edge clears the alarm bits and the fault latch
    nZoneCount   : INT := 8;                 // 参与判定的区数 [个]，域 1..8 / participating zones [count], domain 1 to 8
    fHystBar     : REAL := 0.5;              // 回差带 [巴]，域 大于等于零 / hysteresis band [bar], domain zero and above
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    afPressBar   : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL;      // 逐区压力实测 [巴]，引用型入参由调用方持有 / per zone measured pressure [bar], reference parameter owned by the caller
    afPressHiBar : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL;      // 逐区高压报警阈 [巴]，引用型入参由调用方持有 / per zone high alarm threshold [bar], reference parameter owned by the caller
    afPressLoBar : ARRAY[1..8] OF REAL;      // 逐区低压报警阈 [巴]，引用型入参由调用方持有 / per zone low alarm threshold [bar], reference parameter owned by the caller
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    wAlarmWord   : WORD := 16#0000;          // 打包报警字：低字节低压段 / 高字节高压段 [-] / packed alarm word, low byte for the low segment and high byte for the high segment
    wLowWord     : WORD := 16#0000;          // 低压报警段（位 i-1 对应区 i）[-] / low pressure alarm segment, bit i minus one maps to zone i
    wHighWord    : WORD := 16#0000;          // 高压报警段（位 i-1 对应区 i）[-] / high pressure alarm segment, bit i minus one maps to zone i
    wInvalidWord : WORD := 16#0000;          // 无效区掩码（不可判的区）[-] / invalid zone mask for undecidable zones
    bAnyAlarm    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 任一报警置位 [-] / any alarm bit set
    nFirstAlarmZone : INT := 0;              // 首个报警区号 [区号]，无报警为 0 / first alarming zone number, zero when none
    uAlarmCount  : UINT := 0;                // 本拍报警位数 [位] / number of alarm bits this scan
    eCause       : E_DL_RpbCause := E_DL_RpbCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtReset      : R_TRIG;                   // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eCause      : E_DL_RpbCause := E_DL_RpbCause.eNone; // 内部成因，故障级锁存、信息级每拍重算 / internal cause, latched for faults and recomputed for information
    _bFault      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存位（阈值非法）/ fault latch bit for an illegal threshold
    _bInit       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bZoneBad    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本区不可判（阈值非法或压力非有限）[-] / the zone is undecidable
    _bPressOk    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本区压力有限 [-] / the zone pressure is finite
    _bThrOk      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本区阈值合法 [-] / the zone thresholds are legal
    _bPressNonFin: BOOL := FALSE;            // 本拍出现非有限压力 [-] / a non-finite pressure occurred this scan
    _bCountClamped : BOOL := FALSE;          // 区数被回钳 [-] / the zone count was clamped
    _bHiBit      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本区高压报警位当前值 [-] / current high alarm bit of the zone
    _bLoBit      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本区低压报警位当前值 [-] / current low alarm bit of the zone
    _nUseCount   : INT := 0;                 // 钳定后的区数 [个] / clamped zone count
    _nIdx        : INT := 0;                 // 区游标（1 起，回钳 1..8）[区号] / zone cursor, one-based, clamped one through eight
    _fPress      : REAL := 0.0;              // 本区压力暂存 [巴] / zone pressure held in a local [bar]
    _fHi         : REAL := 0.0;              // 本区高压阈暂存 [巴] / zone high threshold held in a local [bar]
    _fLo         : REAL := 0.0;              // 本区低压阈暂存 [巴] / zone low threshold held in a local [bar]
    _fHiReset    : REAL := 0.0;              // 高压回差复位点 [巴] / high hysteresis reset point [bar]
    _fLoReset    : REAL := 0.0;              // 低压回差复位点 [巴] / low hysteresis reset point [bar]
    _fHyst       : REAL := 0.0;              // 钳定后的回差 [巴] / clamped hysteresis [bar]
    _wLo         : WORD := 16#0000;          // 低压段工作字，兼作回差状态 / low segment working word, also the hysteresis state
    _wHi         : WORD := 16#0000;          // 高压段工作字，兼作回差状态 / high segment working word, also the hysteresis state
    _wInv        : WORD := 16#0000;          // 无效区工作字 / invalid zone working word
    _wBit        : WORD := 16#0001;          // 本区位掩码，先移位后置位（R327）/ zone bit mask, shift before setting
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_RPB_MAX      : INT := 8;              // 区容量与游标回钳上界 [个] / zone capacity and cursor clamp upper bound
    DL_RPB_SEG_SHIFT: INT := 8;              // 高压段移入高字节的位移量 [位]，常量 8 小于字宽 16 / shift moving the high segment into the high byte, the constant eight is below the word width sixteen
    DL_RPB_MASK_NONE: WORD := 16#0000;       // 空掩码常量 [-] / empty mask constant
    DL_RPB_MASK_ONE : WORD := 16#0001;       // 单位位常量 [-] / single bit constant
    DL_RPB_HYST_MAX : REAL := 100.0;         // 回差上限 [巴]，防回差吞掉整个量程 / hysteresis ceiling against swallowing the whole range [bar]
    DL_RPB_PRESS_MAX: REAL := 1.0E6;         // 压力量级上限，防量纲错配 [巴] / pressure magnitude ceiling against a dimension mismatch [bar]
END_VAR

// 段 0｜复位沿无条件周期刷新（禁入分支）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh of the reset edge, never inside a branch
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_RpbCause.eNone; // 成因清零 / clear the cause
    _wLo := DL_RPB_MASK_NONE; // 低压段清零 / clear the low segment
    _wHi := DL_RPB_MASK_NONE; // 高压段清零 / clear the high segment
    _wInv := DL_RPB_MASK_NONE; // 无效字清零 / clear the invalid word
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清报警位 / 清无效字 / 清故障锁存（三项逐项声明）/ segment 2, reset edge scope declared item by item
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_RpbCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清成因 / scope one, clear the cause
    _wLo := DL_RPB_MASK_NONE; // 作用域二：清低压报警位 / scope two, clear the low alarm bits
    _wHi := DL_RPB_MASK_NONE; // 作用域二：清高压报警位 / scope two, clear the high alarm bits
    _wInv := DL_RPB_MASK_NONE; // 作用域三：清无效字 / scope three, clear the invalid word
END_IF

// 段 3｜区数回钳与回差域闸 / segment 3, zone count clamping and hysteresis domain gate
_bCountClamped := FALSE; // 回钳标志预置假 / preset the clamp flag to false
_nUseCount := nZoneCount; // 区数直通 / zone count passes through
IF _nUseCount < 1 THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nUseCount := 1; // 回钳到 1 / clamp to one
    _bCountClamped := TRUE; // 置回钳标志 / raise the clamp flag
ELSIF _nUseCount > DL_RPB_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nUseCount := DL_RPB_MAX; // 回钳到容量上限 / clamp to the capacity ceiling
    _bCountClamped := TRUE; // 置回钳标志 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF
_fHyst := fHystBar; // 回差直通 / hysteresis passes through
IF (_fHyst <> _fHyst) OR ((_fHyst - _fHyst) <> (_fHyst - _fHyst)) THEN // 回差非有限 / hysteresis non-finite
    _fHyst := 0.0; // 非有限归零（等价无回差）/ zeroed, equivalent to no hysteresis
END_IF
IF _fHyst < 0.0 THEN // 回差为负 / hysteresis negative
    _fHyst := 0.0; // 钳零 / clamped to zero
ELSIF _fHyst > DL_RPB_HYST_MAX THEN // 回差过大 / hysteresis too large
    _fHyst := DL_RPB_HYST_MAX; // 钳到上限 / clamped to the ceiling
END_IF
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能：报警字冻结保持末值（R191 显式声明）/ disabled, the alarm word freezes and holds its last value
    _nUseCount := 0; // 区数置零使主循环不执行 / the zone count is zeroed so the main loop does not run
END_IF

// 段 4｜逐区判定主循环：阈值闸 → 压力闸 → 回差判据 → 位打包（先移位后置位）/ segment 4, per zone loop with threshold gate, pressure gate, hysteresis criterion and bit packing
_bPressNonFin := FALSE; // 非有限压力标志清零 / clear the non-finite pressure flag
_nIdx := 1; // 游标自 1 起，上界由 _nUseCount 约束 / the cursor starts at one, bounded by the usable count
WHILE _nIdx <= _nUseCount DO // 循环上界为钳定后的区数，天然不越 8 / the loop bound is the clamped count, never beyond eight
    _wBit := SHL(DL_RPB_MASK_ONE, _nIdx - 1); // 本区位掩码，位移量 0..7 由数组边界与循环上界共同证明 / zone bit mask, the shift zero through seven is proven by the array and loop bounds
    _fPress := afPressBar[_nIdx]; // 压力暂存 / pressure held in a local
    _fHi := afPressHiBar[_nIdx]; // 高压阈暂存 / high threshold held in a local
    _fLo := afPressLoBar[_nIdx]; // 低压阈暂存 / low threshold held in a local
    _bThrOk := (_fHi = _fHi) AND ((_fHi - _fHi) = (_fHi - _fHi)) AND (_fLo = _fLo) AND ((_fLo - _fLo) = (_fLo - _fLo)) AND (_fHi > _fLo); // 阈值有限且高阈高于低阈 / thresholds finite with the high above the low
    _bPressOk := (_fPress = _fPress) AND ((_fPress - _fPress) = (_fPress - _fPress)) AND (ABS(_fPress) <= DL_RPB_PRESS_MAX); // 压力有限且量级可信 / pressure finite with a credible magnitude
    _bZoneBad := FALSE; // 本区不可判标志预置假 / preset the undecidable flag to false
    IF NOT _bThrOk THEN // 阈值非法 / illegal threshold
        _bZoneBad := TRUE; // 本区不可判 / the zone is undecidable
        IF NOT _bFault THEN // 未锁存才记故障 / record the fault only when not yet latched
            _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
            _eCause := E_DL_RpbCause.eThrBad; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
        END_IF
    ELSIF NOT _bPressOk THEN // 压力非有限 / pressure non-finite
        _bZoneBad := TRUE; // 本区不可判 / the zone is undecidable
        _bPressNonFin := TRUE; // 记非有限压力成因 / record the non-finite pressure cause
    END_IF
    _wInv := _wInv AND NOT _wBit; // 先假定本区可判，清无效位 / assume the zone is decidable and clear the invalid bit
    IF _bZoneBad THEN // 本区不可判 / the zone is undecidable
        _wInv := _wInv OR _wBit; // 置无效位 / set the invalid bit
        _wLo := _wLo AND NOT _wBit; // 低压位保持清零（不可判不报警）/ the low bit stays cleared, nothing is decided
        _wHi := _wHi AND NOT _wBit; // 高压位保持清零（不可判不报警）/ the high bit stays cleared, nothing is decided
    ELSE
        _bLoBit := ((_wLo AND _wBit) <> DL_RPB_MASK_NONE); // 低压位当前值 / current low bit
        _bHiBit := ((_wHi AND _wBit) <> DL_RPB_MASK_NONE); // 高压位当前值 / current high bit
        _fLoReset := _fLo + _fHyst; // 低压回差复位点（已报警者高于此值才复位）/ low hysteresis reset point
        _fHiReset := _fHi - _fHyst; // 高压回差复位点（已报警者低于此值才复位）/ high hysteresis reset point
        IF _bLoBit THEN // 低压已报警 / the low alarm is active
            IF _fPress > _fLoReset THEN // 回升越过回差复位点 / recovered above the reset point
                _wLo := _wLo AND NOT _wBit; // 复位低压位 / clear the low bit
            END_IF
        ELSE // 低压未报警 / the low alarm is inactive
            IF _fPress < _fLo THEN // 低于低压阈 / below the low threshold
                _wLo := _wLo OR _wBit; // 置低压位 / set the low bit
            END_IF
        END_IF
        IF _bHiBit THEN // 高压已报警 / the high alarm is active
            IF _fPress < _fHiReset THEN // 回落越过回差复位点 / recovered below the reset point
                _wHi := _wHi AND NOT _wBit; // 复位高压位 / clear the high bit
            END_IF
        ELSE // 高压未报警 / the high alarm is inactive
            IF _fPress > _fHi THEN // 高于高压阈 / above the high threshold
                _wHi := _wHi OR _wBit; // 置高压位 / set the high bit
            END_IF
        END_IF
    END_IF
    _nIdx := _nIdx + 1; // 游标递增 / increment the cursor
END_WHILE

// 段 5｜字位段打包：低字节放低压段、高字节放高压段，两段互不跨用 / segment 5, segment packing with the low byte for the low segment and the high byte for the high segment
wLowWord := _wLo; // 低压段出口 / low segment outlet
wHighWord := _wHi; // 高压段出口 / high segment outlet
wInvalidWord := _wInv; // 无效区掩码出口 / invalid zone mask outlet
wAlarmWord := _wLo OR SHL(_wHi, DL_RPB_SEG_SHIFT); // 两段合成，位移量为常量八 / both segments combined with the constant shift of eight

// 段 6｜统计：报警位数与首个报警区号（自 1 区起顺序扫，命中即止）/ segment 6, statistics for the alarm count and the first alarming zone
_bAnyAlarm := FALSE; // 任一报警标志预置假 / preset the any alarm flag to false
uAlarmCount := 0; // 报警位数清零 / clear the alarm bit count
nFirstAlarmZone := 0; // 首个报警区号清零 / clear the first alarming zone
_nIdx := 1; // 游标自 1 起 / the cursor starts at one
WHILE _nIdx <= DL_RPB_MAX DO // 全容量扫查，未参与区恒为零位 / sweep the full capacity because unused zones stay cleared
    _wBit := SHL(DL_RPB_MASK_ONE, _nIdx - 1); // 本区位掩码 / zone bit mask
    IF ((_wLo AND _wBit) <> DL_RPB_MASK_NONE) OR ((_wHi AND _wBit) <> DL_RPB_MASK_NONE) THEN // 本区任一报警位 / any alarm bit of this zone
        _bAnyAlarm := TRUE; // 置任一报警标志 / raise the any alarm flag
        uAlarmCount := uAlarmCount + 1; // 报警位数递增 / increment the alarm count
        IF nFirstAlarmZone = 0 THEN // 尚未记录首个 / nothing recorded yet
            nFirstAlarmZone := _nIdx; // 记录首个报警区号 / record the first alarming zone
        END_IF
    END_IF
    _nIdx := _nIdx + 1; // 游标递增 / increment the cursor
END_WHILE
bAnyAlarm := _bAnyAlarm; // 任一报警出口（挂状态量，非单拍标志）/ any alarm outlet, a state quantity

// 段 7｜成因分派（固定优先级：故障 > 回钳 > 非有限压力 > 无成因）/ segment 7, cause dispatch with a fixed priority
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    _eCause := E_DL_RpbCause.eThrBad; // 故障级成因锁存回放 / the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSIF _bCountClamped THEN // 区数被回钳 / the zone count was clamped
    _eCause := E_DL_RpbCause.eCountBad; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSIF _bPressNonFin THEN // 存在非有限压力 / a non-finite pressure occurred
    _eCause := E_DL_RpbCause.ePressBad; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSE
    _eCause := E_DL_RpbCause.eNone; // 无成因 / no cause
END_IF

// 段 8｜统一出口 / segment 8, unified outlet
eCause := _eCause; // 成因出口单点映射 / single-point cause outlet mapping
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 化成与分容工序的月度排产需要审计：当月计划容量与实际完成容量按工序分别累计，月窗到界自动冻结本月审计并生成结论（达成/预警/未达成），跨月窗切换时清当月累计并归档上月快照；排产参数变更只允许在月窗开始前生效，窗中变更须拒绝并置码，防止中途改计划导致审计口径漂移。
architecture_thought: 月窗审计状态机架构：段 0 无条件刷新月窗判定与跨月沿；eRun 段按工序累计计划与完成容量（非有限拒收），月窗到界迁 eFrozen 冻结并生成结论（达成/预警/未达成按达成率双阈值分档）；窗中参数变更请求先判窗相（未开始才允许，窗中拒绝置码）；跨月清当月累计并归档快照；出口含两工序累计、结论、窗相与错误码，CASE 含 ELSE 兜底。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_FormatMonthAudit
  分类   Category   : DL_Process
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : 化成 / 分容月度窗排产审计。按日历日判月度生产窗是否开启，
                      窗内以「已完数量 / 月计划数量」与「窗内已过比例」两条进度
                      比对，给出准时 / 落后 / 超前三种审计结论，并在窗关闭那一拍
                      输出审计收口脉冲与收口结论（结论锁存至下月开窗）。
  溯源   Origin     : 月度窗进度审计为通用排产审计语义；本件为 clean-room 实现，
                      仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签 roadmap-p2-formation），
                      道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（R_TRIG / REAL / UDINT 运算，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只做审计判级与收口脉冲，不派工单、不改计划量（属主边界）；
                      二 窗内已过比例按「窗首日至当日」计，窗关闭后比例钳到 100%；
                      三 计划量为零判组态故障并锁存至复位沿，不做除法；
                      四 数量类走 UDINT 直比（禁 ABS 单侧判越界，R55 口径）；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      eAudit 四态互斥（eNone 仅在窗关闭或未参与时出现）；
                      bAuditClose 为单拍脉冲（内部位置位、统一出口映射后撤销）；
                      fCompletePct / fReqDailyRate 在除子不可用时保持上拍值；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 2 · 序号 6）
  ==================================================================
*)

TYPE E_DL_FmaAudit :
(
    eNone    := 0,      // 无结论：窗未开或已收口 / no verdict, the window is closed or not yet opened
    eOnPlan  := 10,     // 准时：实际进度落在期望带内 / on plan, the actual progress sits inside the expected band
    eBehind  := 20,     // 落后：实际进度低于期望带下沿 / behind, the actual progress is below the band
    eAhead   := 30      // 超前：实际进度高于期望带上沿 / ahead, the actual progress is above the band
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_FmaCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：年月日或窗界越域（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal config, calendar or window bounds out of domain
    ePlanZero   := 2,   // 月计划量为零，进度不可算（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ monthly plan is zero, progress not computable
    eWinClosed  := 3    // 当前不在生产窗内（信息级）/ the current day is outside the production window, informational
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_FormatMonthAudit
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;             // 使能，失能时结论冻结保持 [-] / enable, the verdict freezes and holds when disabled
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;           // 复位上升沿清故障锁存与收口结论 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch and the closing verdict
    nYear        : INT := 2026;              // 当前年份 [年]，域 2000..2100 / current year [year], domain 2000 to 2100
    nMonth       : INT := 1;                 // 当前月份 [月]，域 1..12 / current month [month], domain 1 to 12
    nDayOfMonth  : INT := 1;                 // 当月第几日 [日]，域 1..31 / day of month [day], domain 1 to 31
    nWinStartDay : INT := 1;                 // 生产窗起始日 [日] / production window start day [day]
    nWinEndDay   : INT := 25;                // 生产窗结束日 [日]，须不早于起始日 / production window end day, not earlier than the start
    uPlanCells   : UDINT := 1000;            // 月度计划数量 [只]，域 大于零 / monthly planned quantity [pieces], domain above zero
    uDoneCells   : UDINT := 0;               // 已完数量 [只] / completed quantity [pieces]
    fBehindPct   : REAL := 5.0;              // 落后判定带宽度 [百分比]，域 大于零 / behind band width [percent], domain above zero
    fAheadPct    : REAL := 10.0;             // 超前判定带宽度 [百分比]，域 大于零 / ahead band width [percent], domain above zero
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bWindowOpen  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 生产窗是否开启 [-] / production window open flag
    nRemainDays  : INT := 0;                 // 窗内剩余天数（窗关闭为 0）[日] / remaining window days, zero when closed
    nElapsedDays : INT := 0;                 // 窗内已过天数（含当日）[日] / elapsed window days including today
    fCompletePct : REAL := 0.0;              // 实际完成比例 [百分比] / actual completion ratio [percent]
    fExpectPct   : REAL := 0.0;              // 按时进度期望比例 [百分比] / expected on-time progress ratio [percent]
    fReqDailyRate: REAL := 0.0;              // 达产所需日均量 [只每日] / required daily rate to hit the plan [pieces per day]
    eAudit       : E_DL_FmaAudit := E_DL_FmaAudit.eNone; // 审计结论出口 [枚举] / audit verdict outlet [enum]
    eAuditClose  : E_DL_FmaAudit := E_DL_FmaAudit.eNone; // 窗关闭拍锁存的收口结论 [枚举] / verdict latched at window closing [enum]
    bAuditClose  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 审计收口单拍脉冲 [-] / audit closing single-shot pulse
    eCause       : E_DL_FmaCause := E_DL_FmaCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtReset      : R_TRIG;                   // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eCause      : E_DL_FmaCause := E_DL_FmaCause.eNone;   // 信息级成因，每拍重算 / informational cause, recomputed every scan
    _eFaultCause : E_DL_FmaCause := E_DL_FmaCause.eNone;   // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _eAudit      : E_DL_FmaAudit := E_DL_FmaAudit.eNone;   // 内部结论 / internal verdict
    _eAuditClose : E_DL_FmaAudit := E_DL_FmaAudit.eNone;   // 收口结论锁存 / latched closing verdict
    _bFault      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bWinOpenPrev: BOOL := FALSE;            // 上一拍窗开启快照，收口沿判据用 [-] / previous scan window flag for the closing edge
    _bCloseInt   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 收口脉冲内部位，统一出口映射 / internal closing pulse bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _bWinOpen    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本拍窗开启判定 [-] / this scan window open verdict
    _bCfgBad     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 组态非法判定 [-] / illegal configuration verdict
    _bDivOk      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 除子可用判定（计划量非零）[-] / divisor usable verdict
    _nDaysInMonth: INT := 30;                // 当月日历天数 [日] / calendar days of the current month [day]
    _nStart      : INT := 1;                 // 钳定后的窗起始日 [日] / clamped window start day [day]
    _nEnd        : INT := 1;                 // 钳定后的窗结束日 [日] / clamped window end day [day]
    _nDay        : INT := 1;                 // 钳定后的当日序号 [日] / clamped day index [day]
    _nElapsed    : INT := 0;                 // 窗内已过天数工作值 [日] / elapsed window days working value [day]
    _nRemain     : INT := 0;                 // 窗内剩余天数工作值 [日] / remaining window days working value [day]
    _nWinLen     : INT := 1;                 // 窗长（天数）[日] / window length in days [day]
    _fPlan       : REAL := 0.0;              // 计划量实数化暂存 [只] / planned quantity as a real [pieces]
    _fDone       : REAL := 0.0;              // 已完量实数化暂存 [只] / completed quantity as a real [pieces]
    _fComplete   : REAL := 0.0;              // 完成比例工作值 [百分比] / completion ratio working value [percent]
    _fExpect     : REAL := 0.0;              // 期望比例工作值 [百分比] / expected ratio working value [percent]
    _fReqRate    : REAL := 0.0;              // 所需日均量工作值 [只每日] / required daily rate working value [pieces per day]
    _fGap        : REAL := 0.0;              // 计划缺口 [只] / remaining plan gap [pieces]
    _fDivWin     : REAL := 1.0;              // 窗长除子 [日]，已证不小于 1 / window length divisor proven not below one
    _fDivDay     : REAL := 1.0;              // 剩余天数除子 [日]，已证不小于 1 / remaining day divisor proven not below one
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_FMA_DAY_MAX   : INT := 31;            // 月内最大天数 [日] / maximum days within a month [day]
    DL_FMA_YEAR_MIN  : INT := 2000;          // 年份下限 [年] / year floor [year]
    DL_FMA_YEAR_MAX  : INT := 2100;          // 年份上限 [年] / year ceiling [year]
    DL_FMA_BAND_MAX  : REAL := 100.0;        // 判定带宽度上限 [百分比] / band width ceiling [percent]
    DL_FMA_PCT_MAX   : REAL := 1000.0;       // 完成比例上限，防计划量过小放大 [百分比] / completion ratio ceiling against a tiny plan
    DL_FMA_RATE_MAX  : REAL := 1.0E7;        // 日均量上限，防除子过小放大 [只每日] / daily rate ceiling against a tiny divisor
END_VAR

// 段 0｜复位沿无条件周期刷新（禁入分支）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh of the reset edge, never inside a branch
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_FmaCause.eNone; // 信息级成因清零 / clear the informational cause
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_FmaCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _eAudit := E_DL_FmaAudit.eNone; // 结论清零 / clear the verdict
    _eAuditClose := E_DL_FmaAudit.eNone; // 收口结论清零 / clear the closing verdict
    _bWinOpenPrev := FALSE; // 窗开启快照清零 / clear the window snapshot
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清故障锁存 / 清收口结论 / 清窗快照（结论不改，避免审计断档）/ segment 2, reset edge scope
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_FmaCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _eAuditClose := E_DL_FmaAudit.eNone; // 作用域二：清收口结论 / scope two, clear the closing verdict
    _bCloseInt := FALSE; // 作用域二：清收口脉冲内部位 / scope two, clear the internal closing bit
    _bWinOpenPrev := FALSE; // 作用域三：清窗开启快照 / scope three, clear the window snapshot
END_IF

// 段 3｜日历天数：闰年二月二十九日，其余按大小月 / segment 3, calendar days with a leap February
_nDaysInMonth := 31; // 默认三十一日 / default thirty one days
CASE nMonth OF
1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12: // 大月 / long months
    _nDaysInMonth := 31; // 三十一日 / thirty one days
2: // 二月 / february
    IF ((nYear MOD 4) = 0) AND (((nYear MOD 100) <> 0) OR ((nYear MOD 400) = 0)) THEN // 闰年判据 / leap year criterion
        _nDaysInMonth := 29; // 闰年二十九日 / twenty nine days in a leap year
    ELSE
        _nDaysInMonth := 28; // 平年二十八日 / twenty eight days in a common year
    END_IF
4, 6, 9, 11: // 小月 / short months
    _nDaysInMonth := 30; // 三十日 / thirty days
ELSE // 非法月份兜底（R128）/ illegal month fallback
    _nDaysInMonth := 30; // 兜底三十日，故障另由域闸锁存 / fall back to thirty days, the fault is latched by the domain gate
END_CASE

// 段 4｜组态域闸（R151 全覆盖）：年月日、窗界、计划量、判定带 / segment 4, configuration domain gate over every pin
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法预置假 / preset the illegal configuration verdict to false
IF (nYear < DL_FMA_YEAR_MIN) OR (nYear > DL_FMA_YEAR_MAX) THEN // 年份越域 / year out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nMonth < 1) OR (nMonth > 12) THEN // 月份越域 / month out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nDayOfMonth < 1) OR (nDayOfMonth > DL_FMA_DAY_MAX) THEN // 当日序号越域 / day index out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nWinStartDay < 1) OR (nWinStartDay > DL_FMA_DAY_MAX) OR (nWinEndDay < nWinStartDay) OR (nWinEndDay > DL_FMA_DAY_MAX) THEN // 窗界越域或自相矛盾 / window bounds out of domain or contradicting
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fBehindPct <= 0.0) OR (fBehindPct > DL_FMA_BAND_MAX) OR (fBehindPct <> fBehindPct) THEN // 落后带宽越域 / behind band out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fAheadPct <= 0.0) OR (fAheadPct > DL_FMA_BAND_MAX) OR (fAheadPct <> fAheadPct) THEN // 超前带宽越域 / ahead band out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_FmaCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
END_IF

// 段 5｜钳定：窗界与当日一律回钳到当月日历范围内（回钳后可安全比较）/ segment 5, clamping the window bounds and the day into the calendar range
_nStart := nWinStartDay; // 窗起始日直通 / window start passes through
IF _nStart < 1 THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nStart := 1; // 回钳到一日 / clamp to day one
ELSIF _nStart > _nDaysInMonth THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nStart := _nDaysInMonth; // 回钳到月末 / clamp to the last day
END_IF
_nEnd := nWinEndDay; // 窗结束日直通 / window end passes through
IF _nEnd < _nStart THEN // 结束早于起始 / end earlier than start
    _nEnd := _nStart; // 回钳到起始日，窗长退化为一日 / clamp to the start so the window degenerates to a single day
ELSIF _nEnd > _nDaysInMonth THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nEnd := _nDaysInMonth; // 回钳到月末 / clamp to the last day
END_IF
_nDay := nDayOfMonth; // 当日序号直通 / day index passes through
IF _nDay < 1 THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nDay := 1; // 回钳到一日 / clamp to day one
ELSIF _nDay > _nDaysInMonth THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nDay := _nDaysInMonth; // 回钳到月末 / clamp to the last day
END_IF

// 段 6｜窗开启与窗内已过 / 剩余天数 / segment 6, window open verdict with elapsed and remaining days
_nWinLen := _nEnd - _nStart + 1; // 窗长（闭区间）[日] / window length over a closed interval [day]
IF _nWinLen < 1 THEN // 窗长为零不可能（已回钳）/ a zero length is impossible after clamping
    _nWinLen := 1; // 兜底一日，防除零 / fall back to one against division by zero
END_IF
_bWinOpen := (_nDay >= _nStart) AND (_nDay <= _nEnd); // 窗开启判据 / window open criterion
IF _bWinOpen THEN // 窗内 / inside the window
    _nElapsed := _nDay - _nStart + 1; // 已过天数含当日 / elapsed days including today
    _nRemain := _nEnd - _nDay; // 剩余天数不含当日 / remaining days excluding today
ELSE // 窗外 / outside the window
    _nElapsed := 0; // 已过天数零 / elapsed days zero
    _nRemain := 0; // 剩余天数零 / remaining days zero
END_IF
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能：结论与比例冻结保持末值（R191 显式声明）/ disabled, ratios and verdict freeze and hold their last value
    _bWinOpen := FALSE; // 窗开启标志撤除 / the window flag is withdrawn
END_IF

// 段 7｜比例与日均：计划量为零不计算，除子先域闸 / segment 7, ratios and daily rate with both divisors gated first
_bDivOk := uPlanCells > 0; // 计划量非零才可算比例 / the plan must be non-zero for any ratio
_eCause := E_DL_FmaCause.eNone; // 信息级成因每拍重算（R190 归因唯一）/ the informational cause is recomputed every scan
IF NOT _bDivOk THEN // 计划量为零 / the plan is zero
    IF NOT _bFault THEN // 未锁存才记故障 / record the fault only when not yet latched
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaultCause := E_DL_FmaCause.ePlanZero; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
    END_IF
END_IF
IF _bDivOk AND _bWinOpen THEN // 计划可用且在窗内 / the plan is usable and the window is open
    _fPlan := UDINT_TO_REAL(uPlanCells); // 计划量实数化 / planned quantity as a real
    _fDone := UDINT_TO_REAL(uDoneCells); // 已完量实数化 / completed quantity as a real
    _fComplete := _fDone / _fPlan * 100.0; // 完成比例，除子已证大于零 / completion ratio, divisor proven positive
    IF _fComplete > DL_FMA_PCT_MAX THEN // 比例越上限 / ratio above the ceiling
        _fComplete := DL_FMA_PCT_MAX; // 上钳，防计划量过小放大 / clamp upward against a tiny plan
    END_IF
    _fDivWin := INT_TO_REAL(_nWinLen); // 窗长除子，已证不小于 1 / window length divisor proven not below one
    _fExpect := INT_TO_REAL(_nElapsed) / _fDivWin * 100.0; // 期望比例 / expected ratio
    _fGap := _fPlan - _fDone; // 计划缺口 / plan gap
    IF _fGap < 0.0 THEN // 已完成超出计划 / the plan is already exceeded
        _fGap := 0.0; // 缺口归零 / gap zeroed
    END_IF
    IF _nRemain > 0 THEN // 有剩余天数 / remaining days exist
        _fDivDay := INT_TO_REAL(_nRemain); // 剩余天数除子，已证大于零 / remaining day divisor proven positive
        _fReqRate := _fGap / _fDivDay; // 所需日均量 / required daily rate
        IF _fReqRate > DL_FMA_RATE_MAX THEN // 日均量越上限 / daily rate above the ceiling
            _fReqRate := DL_FMA_RATE_MAX; // 上钳，防除子过小放大 / clamp upward against a tiny divisor
        END_IF
    ELSE // 无剩余天数（窗末日或窗关闭）/ no remaining days
        _fReqRate := 0.0; // 日均需求归零 / the daily requirement is zeroed
    END_IF
    IF (_fComplete < (_fExpect - fBehindPct)) THEN // 实际低于期望带下沿 / actual below the band
        _eAudit := E_DL_FmaAudit.eBehind; // 判落后 / behind verdict
    ELSIF (_fComplete > (_fExpect + fAheadPct)) THEN // 实际高于期望带上沿 / actual above the band
        _eAudit := E_DL_FmaAudit.eAhead; // 判超前 / ahead verdict
    ELSE // 落在带内 / inside the band
        _eAudit := E_DL_FmaAudit.eOnPlan; // 判准时 / on plan verdict
    END_IF
ELSIF _bDivOk THEN // 计划可用但窗外 / the plan is usable yet outside the window
    _eAudit := E_DL_FmaAudit.eNone; // 窗外无结论 / no verdict outside the window
    _eCause := E_DL_FmaCause.eWinClosed; // 信息级成因：不在窗内 / informational cause, outside the window
END_IF

// 段 8｜收口沿：上一拍在窗内、本拍在窗外 → 锁存结论并出单拍脉冲 / segment 8, closing edge latches the verdict and raises a single-shot pulse
IF _bWinOpenPrev AND (NOT _bWinOpen) THEN // 窗关闭沿 / window closing edge
    _eAuditClose := _eAudit; // 结论锁存（窗内最后一拍的判级）/ latch the verdict from the last in-window scan
    IF _eAuditClose = E_DL_FmaAudit.eNone THEN // 收口拍无有效判级 / no valid verdict at closing
        _eAuditClose := E_DL_FmaAudit.eBehind; // 无结论按落后处理（保守侧，安全方向）/ no verdict is treated as behind on the conservative side
    END_IF
    _bCloseInt := TRUE; // 收口脉冲内部位置位（统一出口映射，R187）/ raise the internal pulse bit, mapped at the unified outlet
END_IF
_bWinOpenPrev := _bWinOpen; // 窗开启快照推进 / advance the window snapshot

// 段 9｜统一出口 / segment 9, unified outlet
bWindowOpen := _bWinOpen; // 窗开启出口 / window open outlet
nRemainDays := _nRemain; // 剩余天数出口 / remaining days outlet
nElapsedDays := _nElapsed; // 已过天数出口 / elapsed days outlet
fCompletePct := _fComplete; // 完成比例出口 / completion ratio outlet
fExpectPct := _fExpect; // 期望比例出口 / expected ratio outlet
fReqDailyRate := _fReqRate; // 所需日均量出口 / required daily rate outlet
eAudit := _eAudit; // 结论出口单点映射 / single-point verdict outlet mapping
eAuditClose := _eAuditClose; // 收口结论出口（锁存量）/ closing verdict outlet from the latch
bAuditClose := _bCloseInt; // 收口脉冲映射本拍值 / map the closing pulse for this scan
_bCloseInt := FALSE; // 映射后立即撤销，保证单拍宽度（R187 两段式）/ revoke right after mapping to keep a single-scan width
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eCause := _eFaultCause; // 故障级成因锁存回放 / the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSE
    eCause := _eCause; // 信息级成因直映 / the informational cause is mapped directly
END_IF
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 托盘属于易损耗材需要按月轮换保养：每个托盘按使用月数排进轮换队列，轮到者置保养请求并退出在线队列，保养完成确认后重新入队并清使用月数；托盘总数与轮换深度可组态，编号越界钳位，同一托盘不得重复入队，队列空转周期要有最小间隔防止整批同时停用影响产能。
architecture_thought: 轮换队列架构：托盘状态表（在线/保养中/待入队）按数组组织，游标按月推进选轮换对象并置保养请求、退出在线队列；保养完成确认沿清使用月数并回填在线队列，重复入队防护用状态表闸；段 0 无条件刷新月推进沿与队列游标，队列空转最小间隔用定时器强制；编号越界钳位置码，出口含轮换对象号、队列长度与各态计数。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_TrayMonthRotate
  分类   Category   : DL_Process
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : 托盘月度轮换保养排程。按「上次保养月」与保养周期（月数）逐盘
                      判到期，到期盘打包成 12 位到期掩码字，并给本月轮换优先盘号
                      （按月份在托盘序列上轮转），支持保养完成脉冲回写上次保养月。
  溯源   Origin     : 月度轮换保养为通用设备维护排程语义；本件为 clean-room 实现，
                      仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签 roadmap-p2-tray），
                      道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（WORD / SHL / MOD / R_TRIG，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只出到期掩码与优先盘号，不启动保养动作、不判保养质量；
                      二 周期判据按月数差计，跨年回绕按「月差加 12」补齐，只覆盖一周年内；
                      三 保养完成回写由 bMaintDone 上升沿 + nMaintTray 触发，
                         托盘号经回钳 1..12 后写入调用方持有的上次保养月表；
                      四 未保养盘（上次保养月小于 1）一律立即到期，不参与月差计算；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      wDueMask 位 i-1 对应托盘 i，自证向量：仅 1 号盘到期 → 16#0001，
                      仅 12 号盘到期 → 16#0800；
                      nPriTray 为 1..nTrayCount 内的轮换优先盘号，该盘到期时 bPriDue 为真；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 2 · 序号 7）
  ==================================================================
*)

TYPE E_DL_TmrCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：年月日、盘数或周期越域（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal config, calendar, tray count or interval out of domain
    eTrayBad    := 2,   // 保养完成脉冲的托盘号越域已回钳（信息级）/ the tray number on the maintenance pulse was clamped, informational
    eNoDue      := 3    // 本月无到期盘（信息级）/ no tray is due this month, informational
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_TrayMonthRotate
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;             // 使能，失能时掩码冻结保持末值 [-] / enable, the mask freezes and holds its last value when disabled
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;           // 复位上升沿清故障锁存与掩码 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch and the mask
    nYear        : INT := 2026;              // 当前年份 [年]，域 2000..2100 / current year [year], domain 2000 to 2100
    nMonth       : INT := 1;                 // 当前月份 [月]，域 1..12 / current month [month], domain 1 to 12
    nDayOfMonth  : INT := 1;                 // 当月第几日 [日]，域 1..31 / day of month [day], domain 1 to 31
    nTrayCount   : INT := 12;                // 参与排程的托盘数 [个]，域 1..12 / scheduled tray count [count], domain 1 to 12
    nIntervalMonths : INT := 3;              // 保养周期 [月]，域 1..60 / maintenance interval [month], domain 1 to 60
    bMaintDone   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 保养完成脉冲，上升沿回写上次保养月 [-] / maintenance done pulse, the rising edge writes back the last maintenance month
    nMaintTray   : INT := 1;                 // 保养完成脉冲对应的托盘号 [盘号] / tray number carried by the maintenance pulse
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    anLastMaintMonth : ARRAY[1..12] OF INT;  // 逐托盘上次保养月（0 = 从未保养）[月]，引用型入参由调用方持有 / per tray last maintenance month, zero means never, reference parameter owned by the caller
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    wDueMask     : WORD := 16#0000;          // 到期托盘掩码，位 i-1 对应托盘 i [-] / due tray mask, bit i minus one maps to tray i
    nDueCount    : INT := 0;                 // 到期托盘数 [个] / due tray count
    nOverdueCount: INT := 0;                 // 超期托盘数（月差超周期）[个] / overdue tray count
    nPriTray     : INT := 0;                 // 本月轮换优先托盘号 [盘号] / rotation priority tray of the month
    bPriDue      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 优先托盘本月是否到期 [-] / whether the priority tray is due this month
    bDueToday    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本月是否存在到期盘 [-] / whether any tray is due this month
    eCause       : E_DL_TmrCause := E_DL_TmrCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtReset      : R_TRIG;                   // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtMaint      : R_TRIG;                   // 保养完成沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / maintenance done edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eCause      : E_DL_TmrCause := E_DL_TmrCause.eNone;  // 内部成因 / internal cause
    _eFaultCause : E_DL_TmrCause := E_DL_TmrCause.eNone;  // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bCfgBad     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 组态非法判定 [-] / illegal configuration verdict
    _bTrayClamped: BOOL := FALSE;            // 回写托盘号被回钳 [-] / the write-back tray number was clamped
    _bDueBit     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本条托盘到期判定 [-] / per tray due verdict
    _nUseCount   : INT := 0;                 // 钳定后的托盘数 [个] / clamped tray count
    _nInterval   : INT := 1;                 // 钳定后的保养周期 [月] / clamped maintenance interval [month]
    _nTray       : INT := 1;                 // 回写用托盘号（回钳 1..12）[盘号] / write-back tray number clamped one through twelve
    _nIdx        : INT := 1;                 // 托盘游标（1 起，回钳 1..12）[盘号] / tray cursor, one-based, clamped one through twelve
    _nLast       : INT := 0;                 // 本条托盘上次保养月 [月] / last maintenance month of the tray [month]
    _nElapsed    : INT := 0;                 // 距上次保养的月差 [月] / months since the last maintenance [month]
    _nPri        : INT := 1;                 // 轮换优先盘号工作值（1..12）[盘号] / rotation priority working value, one through twelve [tray]
    _wMask       : WORD := 16#0000;          // 掩码工作字，先移位后置位（R327）/ mask working word, shift before setting
    _wBit        : WORD := 16#0001;          // 本条托盘位掩码 [-] / per tray bit mask
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_TMR_MAX       : INT := 12;            // 托盘容量与游标回钳上界 [个] / tray capacity and cursor clamp upper bound
    DL_TMR_INT_MIN   : INT := 1;             // 保养周期下限 [月] / maintenance interval floor [month]
    DL_TMR_INT_MAX   : INT := 60;            // 保养周期上限 [月] / maintenance interval ceiling [month]
    DL_TMR_YEAR_MIN  : INT := 2000;          // 年份下限 [年] / year floor [year]
    DL_TMR_YEAR_MAX  : INT := 2100;          // 年份上限 [年] / year ceiling [year]
    DL_TMR_DAY_MAX   : INT := 31;            // 月内最大天数 [日] / maximum days within a month [day]
    DL_TMR_MONTHS    : INT := 12;            // 一周年月数，跨年回绕补齐用 [月] / months in a year for the wrap fill [month]
    DL_TMR_MASK_NONE : WORD := 16#0000;      // 空掩码常量 [-] / empty mask constant
    DL_TMR_MASK_ONE  : WORD := 16#0001;      // 单位位常量 [-] / single bit constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh of the edge detectors, never inside a branch
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge
rtMaint(CLK := bMaintDone); // 保养完成沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the maintenance edge

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_TmrCause.eNone; // 信息级成因清零 / clear the informational cause
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_TmrCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _wMask := DL_TMR_MASK_NONE; // 掩码清零 / clear the mask
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清故障锁存 / 清掩码与统计（不改上次保养月表，属调用方资产）/ segment 2, reset edge scope
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_TmrCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _wMask := DL_TMR_MASK_NONE; // 作用域二：清到期掩码 / scope two, clear the due mask
    nDueCount := 0; // 作用域二：清到期计数 / scope two, clear the due count
    nOverdueCount := 0; // 作用域二：清超期计数 / scope two, clear the overdue count
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态域闸（R151 全覆盖）/ segment 3, configuration domain gate over every pin
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法预置假 / preset the illegal configuration verdict to false
IF (nYear < DL_TMR_YEAR_MIN) OR (nYear > DL_TMR_YEAR_MAX) THEN // 年份越域 / year out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nMonth < 1) OR (nMonth > DL_TMR_MONTHS) THEN // 月份越域 / month out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nDayOfMonth < 1) OR (nDayOfMonth > DL_TMR_DAY_MAX) THEN // 当日序号越域 / day index out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nTrayCount < 1) OR (nTrayCount > DL_TMR_MAX) THEN // 托盘数越域 / tray count out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nIntervalMonths < DL_TMR_INT_MIN) OR (nIntervalMonths > DL_TMR_INT_MAX) THEN // 保养周期越域 / maintenance interval out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_TmrCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
END_IF
_nUseCount := nTrayCount; // 托盘数直通 / tray count passes through
IF _nUseCount < 1 THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nUseCount := 1; // 回钳到 1 / clamp to one
ELSIF _nUseCount > DL_TMR_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nUseCount := DL_TMR_MAX; // 回钳到容量上限 / clamp to the capacity ceiling
END_IF
_nInterval := nIntervalMonths; // 周期直通 / interval passes through
IF _nInterval < DL_TMR_INT_MIN THEN // 周期过小 / interval below the floor
    _nInterval := DL_TMR_INT_MIN; // 抬到下限 / raised to the floor
ELSIF _nInterval > DL_TMR_INT_MAX THEN // 周期过大 / interval above the ceiling
    _nInterval := DL_TMR_INT_MAX; // 压到上限 / pressed to the ceiling
END_IF

// 段 4｜保养完成回写：上升沿 + 托盘号回钳后写入上次保养月表 / segment 4, maintenance write-back on the rising edge with the tray number clamped
_bTrayClamped := FALSE; // 回钳标志预置假 / preset the clamp flag to false
IF rtMaint.Q THEN // 保养完成沿 / maintenance done edge
    _nTray := nMaintTray; // 托盘号直通 / tray number passes through
    IF _nTray < 1 THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
        _nTray := 1; // 回钳到 1 / clamp to one
        _bTrayClamped := TRUE; // 置回钳标志 / raise the clamp flag
    ELSIF _nTray > DL_TMR_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
        _nTray := DL_TMR_MAX; // 回钳到 12 / clamp to twelve
        _bTrayClamped := TRUE; // 置回钳标志 / raise the clamp flag
    END_IF
    anLastMaintMonth[_nTray] := nMonth; // 回写上次保养月，下标已回钳 1..12 / write back the last maintenance month with the index already clamped
END_IF

// 段 5｜逐盘到期判定与掩码打包 / segment 5, per tray due verdict and mask packing
_wMask := DL_TMR_MASK_NONE; // 掩码每拍清零重建 / the mask is rebuilt every scan
nDueCount := 0; // 到期计数清零 / clear the due count
nOverdueCount := 0; // 超期计数清零 / clear the overdue count
_nIdx := 1; // 游标自 1 起，上界由 _nUseCount 约束 / the cursor starts at one, bounded by the usable count
WHILE _nIdx <= _nUseCount DO // 循环上界为钳定后的托盘数，天然不越 12 / the loop bound is the clamped count, never beyond twelve
    _wBit := SHL(DL_TMR_MASK_ONE, _nIdx - 1); // 本条托盘位掩码，位移量 0..11 由数组边界与循环上界共同证明 / per tray bit mask, the shift zero through eleven is proven by the array and loop bounds
    _nLast := anLastMaintMonth[_nIdx]; // 上次保养月 / last maintenance month
    _bDueBit := FALSE; // 到期判定预置假 / preset the due verdict to false
    IF _nLast < 1 THEN // 从未保养 / never maintained
        _bDueBit := TRUE; // 立即到期 / due immediately
        nOverdueCount := nOverdueCount + 1; // 计入超期统计 / counted as overdue
    ELSE
        _nElapsed := nMonth - _nLast; // 月差 / month difference
        IF _nElapsed < 0 THEN // 跨年回绕 / year wrap
            _nElapsed := _nElapsed + DL_TMR_MONTHS; // 按月数补齐，仅覆盖一周年内 / filled by the months in a year, valid within one year
        END_IF
        IF _nElapsed >= _nInterval THEN // 达到周期 / the interval is reached
            _bDueBit := TRUE; // 判到期 / due verdict
            IF _nElapsed > _nInterval THEN // 超过周期 / beyond the interval
                nOverdueCount := nOverdueCount + 1; // 计入超期统计 / counted as overdue
            END_IF
        END_IF
    END_IF
    IF _bDueBit THEN // 本条托盘到期 / the tray is due
        _wMask := _wMask OR _wBit; // 置到期位 / set the due bit
        nDueCount := nDueCount + 1; // 到期计数递增 / increment the due count
    END_IF
    _nIdx := _nIdx + 1; // 游标递增 / increment the cursor
END_WHILE

// 段 6｜轮换优先盘号：按月份在托盘序列上轮转，除子为钳定后的托盘数 / segment 6, rotation priority tray with the clamped tray count as the divisor
_nPri := ((nMonth - 1) MOD _nUseCount) + 1; // 轮换公式，除子已证不小于 1 / rotation formula, divisor proven not below one
nPriTray := _nPri; // 优先盘号出口 / priority tray outlet
bPriDue := ((_wMask AND SHL(DL_TMR_MASK_ONE, _nPri - 1)) <> DL_TMR_MASK_NONE); // 优先盘是否到期，位移量 0..11 已证 / whether the priority tray is due, the shift zero through eleven is proven
bDueToday := nDueCount > 0; // 本月是否存在到期盘（挂状态量）/ whether any tray is due, a state quantity

// 段 7｜成因分派（固定优先级：故障 > 回钳 > 无到期 > 无成因）/ segment 7, cause dispatch with a fixed priority
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eCause := _eFaultCause; // 故障级成因锁存回放 / the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSIF _bTrayClamped THEN // 回写托盘号被回钳 / the write-back tray number was clamped
    eCause := E_DL_TmrCause.eTrayBad; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSIF nDueCount < 1 THEN // 无到期盘 / no tray is due
    eCause := E_DL_TmrCause.eNoDue; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSE
    eCause := E_DL_TmrCause.eNone; // 无成因 / no cause
END_IF

// 段 8｜统一出口 / segment 8, unified outlet
wDueMask := _wMask; // 到期掩码出口 / due mask outlet
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 产量报表需要同时满足班组交接与月度考核两个口径：班次窗结束时冻结本班产量并给出交接快照，月窗结束时冻结月累计并判定是否达标；两窗口各自独立计时互不干扰，窗界参数非法先置码拒收，产量非有限当拍不计入，报表冻结期间数据只读防止中途篡改口径。
architecture_thought: 双窗独立计时架构：班窗与月窗各自维护窗判定与窗界沿，互不复用定时器防串扰；班窗界沿冻结本班产量生成交接快照，月窗界沿冻结月累计并判定达标（阈值可组态）；产量累加前置有限性闸（非有限当拍不计入并计数），冻结期间数据只读；窗界参数非法先置码拒收；出口含班快照、月累计、达标标志与两窗相，CASE 含 ELSE 兜底。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_ShiftMonthReport
  分类   Category   : DL_Process
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : 班次 / 月度窗口产量报表闸。班次结束脉冲到达时结算本班产量
                      （好品 / 废品 / 良率）并累加进月度窗口，同时打开报表闸
                      （等上位确认或超时自动关闸），关闸拍出报表完成脉冲。
                      月变更沿清月度累计与班次计数，实现「班次窗 + 月度窗」双窗一致。
  溯源   Origin     : 班次 / 月度报表闸为通用产量统计语义；本件为 clean-room 实现，
                      仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签 roadmap-p2-shift），
                      道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（R_TRIG / TON / UDINT / REAL，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只做结算与报表闸控，不生成报表文件、不写数据库（属主边界）；
                      二 报表闸在「确认沿」或「闸超时」任一到达时关闭，两条路径均可达；
                      三 月度累计只在班次结算拍增长，禁按当下累计引脚每拍重算；
                      四 班次号越域与月变更属信息级事件，不置故障；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      uShiftGood / uShiftScrap 为最近一次结算的班次量（锁存）；
                      uMonthGood / uMonthScrap 为当月累计（锁存，月变更清零）；
                      bReportDone 为单拍脉冲（内部位置位、统一出口映射后撤销）；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 2 · 序号 8）
  ==================================================================
*)

TYPE E_DL_SmrState :
(
    eIdle   := 0,       // 空闲：等班次结束脉冲 / idle, waiting for the shift end pulse
    eGate   := 10,      // 报表闸开：等上位确认或闸超时 / report gate open, waiting for the acknowledgement or the gate timeout
    eFault  := 90       // 故障：组态非法锁存 / fault, illegal configuration latched
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_SmrCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：月份、班次号或时间引脚越域（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal config, month, shift index or time pin out of domain
    eShiftBad   := 2,   // 班次号越域已回钳（信息级）/ the shift index was clamped, informational
    eMonthRoll  := 3    // 月变更，月度累计已清零（信息级）/ month rolled over and the monthly accumulation was cleared, informational
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_ShiftMonthReport
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable     : BOOL := TRUE;              // 使能，失能时关闸并冻结累计 [-] / enable, disabling closes the gate and freezes the accumulation
    bReset      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 复位上升沿清故障锁存与闸状态 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch and the gate state
    nMonth      : INT := 1;                  // 当前月份 [月]，域 1..12 / current month [month], domain 1 to 12
    nShiftIdx   : INT := 1;                  // 当前班次号 [班]，域 1..3 / current shift index [shift], domain 1 to 3
    bShiftEnd   : BOOL := FALSE;             // 班次结束脉冲，上升沿结算 [-] / shift end pulse, settled on the rising edge
    uGoodCnt    : UDINT := 0;                // 本班好品累计 [只] / good pieces accumulated in the shift [pieces]
    uScrapCnt   : UDINT := 0;                // 本班废品累计 [只] / scrap pieces accumulated in the shift [pieces]
    bReportAck  : BOOL := FALSE;             // 上位确认报表，上升沿关闸 [-] / report acknowledgement, the rising edge closes the gate
    tGateTime   : TIME := T#30S;             // 报表闸超时 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / report gate timeout [millisecond], domain above zero
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bReportGate : BOOL := FALSE;             // 报表闸开指示 [-] / report gate open indicator
    uShiftGood  : UDINT := 0;                // 最近结算班次好品数 [只] / good pieces of the last settled shift [pieces]
    uShiftScrap : UDINT := 0;                // 最近结算班次废品数 [只] / scrap pieces of the last settled shift [pieces]
    fShiftYield : REAL := 0.0;               // 最近结算班次良率 [百分比] / yield of the last settled shift [percent]
    uMonthGood  : UDINT := 0;                // 当月好品累计 [只] / monthly good pieces [pieces]
    uMonthScrap : UDINT := 0;                // 当月废品累计 [只] / monthly scrap pieces [pieces]
    fMonthYield : REAL := 0.0;               // 当月良率 [百分比] / monthly yield [percent]
    nMonthShifts: INT := 0;                  // 当月已结算班次数 [班] / settled shifts within the month [shift]
    bReportDone : BOOL := FALSE;             // 报表完成单拍脉冲 [-] / report done single-shot pulse
    eState      : E_DL_SmrState := E_DL_SmrState.eIdle; // 相位出口 [枚举] / phase outlet [enum]
    eCause      : E_DL_SmrCause := E_DL_SmrCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError      : BOOL := FALSE;             // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtShift     : R_TRIG;                    // 班次结束沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / shift end edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtAck       : R_TRIG;                    // 报表确认沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / acknowledgement edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtReset     : R_TRIG;                    // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonGate     : TON;                       // 报表闸超时，段 0 无条件刷新 / report gate timeout, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eState     : E_DL_SmrState := E_DL_SmrState.eIdle;  // 内部相位，CASE 唯一写入目标 / internal phase, the only CASE write target
    _eCause     : E_DL_SmrCause := E_DL_SmrCause.eNone;  // 信息级成因，每拍重算 / informational cause, recomputed every scan
    _eFaultCause: E_DL_SmrCause := E_DL_SmrCause.eNone;  // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault     : BOOL := FALSE;             // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;             // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bDoneInt   : BOOL := FALSE;             // 报表完成脉冲内部位，统一出口映射 / internal done bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _bShiftBad  : BOOL := FALSE;             // 班次号被回钳 [-] / the shift index was clamped
    _bCfgBad    : BOOL := FALSE;             // 组态非法判定 [-] / illegal configuration verdict
    _bYieldOk   : BOOL := FALSE;             // 良率除子可用 [-] / the yield divisor is usable
    _nMonthPrev : INT := -1;                 // 上一拍月份快照，初值 -1 使首拍必清 / previous month snapshot, minus one forces a clear on the first scan
    _nShiftUse  : INT := 1;                  // 钳定后的班次号 [班] / clamped shift index [shift]
    _uGoodLoc   : UDINT := 0;                // 本拍好品暂存 [只] / good pieces held in a local [pieces]
    _uScrapLoc  : UDINT := 0;                // 本拍废品暂存 [只] / scrap pieces held in a local [pieces]
    _uMonthG    : UDINT := 0;                // 当月好品累加器 [只] / monthly good accumulator [pieces]
    _uMonthS    : UDINT := 0;                // 当月废品累加器 [只] / monthly scrap accumulator [pieces]
    _uShiftG    : UDINT := 0;                // 班次好品保持块 [只] / shift good holder [pieces]
    _uShiftS    : UDINT := 0;                // 班次废品保持块 [只] / shift scrap holder [pieces]
    _uTotLoc    : UDINT := 0;                // 良率分母（好品加废品）[只] / yield denominator, good plus scrap [pieces]
    _uMonthTot  : UDINT := 0;                // 月度良率分母（好品加废品）[只] / monthly yield denominator [pieces]
    _fYield     : REAL := 0.0;               // 良率工作值 [百分比] / yield working value [percent]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_SMR_SHIFT_MIN : INT := 1;             // 班次号下限 [班] / shift index floor [shift]
    DL_SMR_SHIFT_MAX : INT := 3;             // 班次号上限 [班] / shift index ceiling [shift]
    DL_SMR_CNT_MAX   : UDINT := 2147483647;  // 计数加和上限，防 UDINT 相加溢出后窄化 [只] / summation ceiling against overflow before narrowing [pieces]
    DL_SMR_YIELD_MAX : REAL := 100.0;        // 良率上限 [百分比] / yield ceiling [percent]
    DL_SMR_DAY_SHIFT_MAX : INT := 3;         // 单日班次计数的自然上限 [班] / natural ceiling of the daily shift count [shift]
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支），IN 只串状态闸 / segment 0, unconditional refresh of timers and edges with state gates on IN only
rtShift(CLK := bShiftEnd); // 班次结束沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the shift end edge
rtAck(CLK := bReportAck); // 确认沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the acknowledgement edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge
tonGate(IN := (_eState = E_DL_SmrState.eGate) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tGateTime); // 报表闸超时，IN 串相位闸与故障闸 / report gate timeout with the phase gate and the fault gate on IN

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _eState := E_DL_SmrState.eIdle; // 相位从空闲起步 / the phase starts from idle
    _eCause := E_DL_SmrCause.eNone; // 信息级成因清零 / clear the informational cause
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_SmrCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _nMonthPrev := -1; // 月份快照置非法值 / put the month snapshot at an illegal value
    _uMonthG := 0; // 月度好品清零 / clear monthly good pieces
    _uMonthS := 0; // 月度废品清零 / clear monthly scrap pieces
    nMonthShifts := 0; // 月度班次计数清零 / clear the monthly shift count
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清锁存 / 迁相位 / 清闸内部位（累计不清，避免产量丢失）/ segment 2, reset edge scope
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_SmrCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _eState := E_DL_SmrState.eIdle; // 作用域二：迁回空闲相 / scope two, migrate back to idle
    _bDoneInt := FALSE; // 作用域二：清完成脉冲内部位 / scope two, clear the internal done bit
    _eCause := E_DL_SmrCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清信息级成因 / scope one, clear the informational cause
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态域闸（R151 全覆盖）/ segment 3, configuration domain gate over every pin
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法预置假 / preset the illegal configuration verdict to false
IF (nMonth < 1) OR (nMonth > 12) THEN // 月份越域 / month out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nShiftIdx < DL_SMR_SHIFT_MIN) OR (nShiftIdx > DL_SMR_SHIFT_MAX) THEN // 班次号越域 / shift index out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF tGateTime <= T#0S THEN // 闸超时非正 / gate timeout not positive
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_SmrCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
    _eState := E_DL_SmrState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_IF
_nShiftUse := nShiftIdx; // 班次号直通 / shift index passes through
_bShiftBad := FALSE; // 回钳标志预置假 / preset the clamp flag to false
IF _nShiftUse < DL_SMR_SHIFT_MIN THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nShiftUse := DL_SMR_SHIFT_MIN; // 回钳到 1 / clamp to one
    _bShiftBad := TRUE; // 置回钳标志 / raise the clamp flag
ELSIF _nShiftUse > DL_SMR_SHIFT_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nShiftUse := DL_SMR_SHIFT_MAX; // 回钳到 3 / clamp to three
    _bShiftBad := TRUE; // 置回钳标志 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF

// 段 4｜月变更：清月度累计与班次计数（信息级事件，不置故障）/ segment 4, month rollover clears the monthly accumulation, an informational event
_eCause := E_DL_SmrCause.eNone; // 信息级成因每拍重算 / the informational cause is recomputed every scan
IF (nMonth <> _nMonthPrev) THEN // 月份变化（首拍必命中）/ month changed, always true on the first scan
    _nMonthPrev := nMonth; // 月份快照推进 / advance the month snapshot
    _uMonthG := 0; // 月度好品清零 / clear monthly good pieces
    _uMonthS := 0; // 月度废品清零 / clear monthly scrap pieces
    nMonthShifts := 0; // 月度班次计数清零 / clear the monthly shift count
    _uShiftG := 0; // 班次保持块清零 / clear the shift holder
    _uShiftS := 0; // 班次保持块清零 / clear the shift holder
    _eCause := E_DL_SmrCause.eMonthRoll; // 信息级成因：月变更已清零 / informational cause, the rollover cleared the accumulation
END_IF
IF _bShiftBad THEN // 班次号被回钳 / the shift index was clamped
    _eCause := E_DL_SmrCause.eShiftBad; // 信息级成因覆盖（同拍仅报更具体者）/ the informational cause overrides for the more specific event
END_IF

// 段 5｜相位机：ENUM + CASE，含 ELSE 非法相位兜底（R128）/ segment 5, phase machine with an ELSE fallback for illegal phases
CASE _eState OF
E_DL_SmrState.eIdle: // 空闲相：等班次结束脉冲 / idle phase, waiting for the shift end pulse
    IF rtShift.Q AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 班次结束沿且无故障 / shift end edge without a fault
        _uGoodLoc := uGoodCnt; // 好品暂存 / hold the good pieces
        _uScrapLoc := uScrapCnt; // 废品暂存 / hold the scrap pieces
        _uTotLoc := _uGoodLoc + _uScrapLoc; // 良率分母 / yield denominator
        IF (_uTotLoc < _uGoodLoc) OR (_uTotLoc < _uScrapLoc) THEN // 相加回绕 / the sum wrapped around
            _uTotLoc := DL_SMR_CNT_MAX; // 饱和到上限，防窄化负值（R316 口径）/ saturated at the ceiling against a negative narrowing
        END_IF
        _bYieldOk := _uTotLoc > 0; // 分母可用性 / denominator usability
        IF _bYieldOk THEN // 分母可用 / the denominator is usable
            _fYield := UDINT_TO_REAL(_uGoodLoc) / UDINT_TO_REAL(_uTotLoc) * 100.0; // 良率，除子已证大于零 / yield, divisor proven positive
            IF _fYield > DL_SMR_YIELD_MAX THEN // 良率越上限 / yield above the ceiling
                _fYield := DL_SMR_YIELD_MAX; // 上钳 / clamp upward
            END_IF
        ELSE
            _fYield := 0.0; // 无产量时良率记零 / zero yield when nothing was produced
        END_IF
        _uShiftG := _uGoodLoc; // 班次好品保持 / hold the shift good pieces
        _uShiftS := _uScrapLoc; // 班次废品保持 / hold the shift scrap pieces
        IF (_uMonthG + _uGoodLoc) < _uMonthG THEN // 累加回绕 / the accumulation wrapped around
            _uMonthG := DL_SMR_CNT_MAX; // 饱和到上限 / saturated at the ceiling
        ELSE
            _uMonthG := _uMonthG + _uGoodLoc; // 月度好品累加 / accumulate monthly good pieces
        END_IF
        IF (_uMonthS + _uScrapLoc) < _uMonthS THEN // 累加回绕 / the accumulation wrapped around
            _uMonthS := DL_SMR_CNT_MAX; // 饱和到上限 / saturated at the ceiling
        ELSE
            _uMonthS := _uMonthS + _uScrapLoc; // 月度废品累加 / accumulate monthly scrap pieces
        END_IF
        IF nMonthShifts < DL_SMR_DAY_SHIFT_MAX THEN // 班次计数未越自然上限 / the shift count is below its natural ceiling
            nMonthShifts := nMonthShifts + 1; // 班次计数递增 / increment the shift count
        END_IF
        _eState := E_DL_SmrState.eGate; // 迁报表闸相 / migrate to the report gate phase
    END_IF

E_DL_SmrState.eGate: // 报表闸相：确认沿或闸超时关闸 / report gate phase, closed by the acknowledgement edge or the gate timeout
    IF rtAck.Q OR tonGate.Q THEN // 确认或超时 / acknowledged or timed out
        _bDoneInt := TRUE; // 报表完成脉冲内部位置位（统一出口映射，R187）/ raise the internal done bit, mapped at the unified outlet
        _eState := E_DL_SmrState.eIdle; // 迁回空闲相 / migrate back to idle
    END_IF

E_DL_SmrState.eFault: // 故障相：锁存回放，等复位沿 / fault phase, the latch is replayed until the reset edge
    _bDoneInt := FALSE; // 故障拍不出完成脉冲 / no done pulse while faulted

ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R128）/ illegal phase fallback
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_SmrCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因记组态非法 / record the illegal configuration cause
    _eState := E_DL_SmrState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 6｜失能语义：关闸并冻结累计（R191 显式声明）/ segment 6, disabled semantics, close the gate and freeze the accumulation
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    _eState := E_DL_SmrState.eIdle; // 迁回空闲相 / migrate back to idle
    _bDoneInt := FALSE; // 撤完成脉冲内部位 / withdraw the internal done bit
END_IF

// 段 7｜统一出口 / segment 7, unified outlet
bReportGate := (_eState = E_DL_SmrState.eGate); // 闸开指示（挂状态量）/ gate open indicator as a state quantity
uShiftGood := _uShiftG; // 班次好品出口 / shift good outlet
uShiftScrap := _uShiftS; // 班次废品出口 / shift scrap outlet
fShiftYield := _fYield; // 班次良率出口 / shift yield outlet
uMonthGood := _uMonthG; // 月度好品出口 / monthly good outlet
uMonthScrap := _uMonthS; // 月度废品出口 / monthly scrap outlet
_uMonthTot := _uMonthG + _uMonthS; // 月度分母先落局部量，避免重复计算 / the monthly denominator lands in a local first
IF _uMonthTot < _uMonthG THEN // 相加回绕 / the sum wrapped around
    _uMonthTot := DL_SMR_CNT_MAX; // 饱和到上限 / saturated at the ceiling
END_IF
IF _uMonthTot > 0 THEN // 月度分母可用 / the monthly denominator is usable
    fMonthYield := UDINT_TO_REAL(_uMonthG) / UDINT_TO_REAL(_uMonthTot) * 100.0; // 月度良率，除子已证大于零 / monthly yield, divisor proven positive
    IF fMonthYield > DL_SMR_YIELD_MAX THEN // 良率越上限 / yield above the ceiling
        fMonthYield := DL_SMR_YIELD_MAX; // 上钳 / clamp upward
    END_IF
ELSE
    fMonthYield := 0.0; // 无产量时良率记零 / zero yield when nothing was produced
END_IF
eState := _eState; // 相位出口单点映射 / single-point phase outlet mapping
bReportDone := _bDoneInt; // 完成脉冲映射本拍值 / map the done pulse for this scan
_bDoneInt := FALSE; // 映射后立即撤销，保证单拍宽度（R187 两段式）/ revoke right after mapping to keep a single-scan width
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eCause := _eFaultCause; // 故障级成因锁存回放 / the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSE
    eCause := _eCause; // 信息级成因直映 / the informational cause is mapped directly
END_IF
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 化成周计划需要周序号与月窗双闸：只有当前日期落在计划周窗内且月窗未冻结时才允许执行该周计划，周序号越界或周窗与月窗冲突时置码降级为只监控；计划量与完成量按周累计，周窗切换自动结算上周并装载下周，双闸任一关闭时输出保持上一拍状态不得突跳。
architecture_thought: 双闸计划架构：周闸（周序号合法且当前周窗匹配）与月闸（月窗未冻结）相与后才允许执行计划；段 0 无条件刷新周窗与月窗判定；周窗切换沿结算上周累计并装载下周计划量；双闸任一关闭输出保持上拍状态并置降级标志不突跳；周序号越界或双窗冲突置码降级为只监控；出口含周序号、双闸态、计划与完成累计、降级标志与错误码。
output:
(*
