  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_FormationWeekPlan
  分类   Category   : DL_Process
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : 周计划窗（周序号闸 + 月窗闸双闸）。把日历日换算成「月内周
                      序号（1..5）」与「周内日序号（1..7）」，两个闸同时成立才算
                      计划窗开启：一 月窗闸 = 当日落在组态的月内生产窗区间；
                      二 周序号闸 = 当日所在周序号落在允许的周区间。
                      同时给出周内与月内剩余天数，供上层排产节拍使用。
  溯源   Origin     : 周序号 / 月窗双闸为通用排产窗语义；本件为 clean-room 实现，
                      仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签 roadmap-p2-weekplan），
                      道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（INT 整除与 MOD，除子为常量，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只判双闸与剩余天数，不生成工单、不判产量；
                      二 周序号按「月内第几周」口径（1 日为第 1 周第 1 日），非 ISO 周；
                      三 整除与取模的除子均为常量 7，且除前已把日序回钳到 1..31；
                      四 双闸任一不成立即关窗，关窗原因由两个独立布尔出口区分（R190）；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      bMonthGateOk / bWeekGateOk 为两条独立闸的实时值，
                      bWindowOpen 仅在两条闸同时成立时为真（挂状态量）；
                      nWeekIdx 域 1..5，nDayInWeek 域 1..7，两者恒由回钳后的日序派生；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 2 · 序号 9）
  ==================================================================
*)

TYPE E_DL_FwpCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：年月日、窗界或周区间越域（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal config, calendar, window bounds or week band out of domain
    eMonthGate  := 2,   // 月窗闸不成立（信息级）/ the monthly window gate does not hold, informational
    eWeekGate   := 3    // 周序号闸不成立（信息级）/ the week index gate does not hold, informational
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_FormationWeekPlan
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;             // 使能，失能时关窗 [-] / enable, the window closes when disabled
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;           // 复位上升沿清故障锁存 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch
    nYear        : INT := 2026;              // 当前年份 [年]，域 2000..2100 / current year [year], domain 2000 to 2100
    nMonth       : INT := 1;                 // 当前月份 [月]，域 1..12 / current month [month], domain 1 to 12
    nDayOfMonth  : INT := 1;                 // 当月第几日 [日]，域 1..31 / day of month [day], domain 1 to 31
    nWinStartDay : INT := 1;                 // 月生产窗起始日 [日] / monthly production window start day [day]
    nWinEndDay   : INT := 28;                // 月生产窗结束日 [日]，须不早于起始日 / monthly window end day, not earlier than the start
    nWeekFrom    : INT := 1;                 // 允许的周序号下限（月内第几周）[周]，域 1..5 / allowed week index floor, domain 1 to 5
    nWeekTo      : INT := 5;                 // 允许的周序号上限（月内第几周）[周]，域 1..5 / allowed week index ceiling, domain 1 to 5
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bWindowOpen  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 双闸同时成立（计划窗开启）[-] / both gates hold, the planning window is open
    bMonthGateOk : BOOL := FALSE;            // 月窗闸实时值 [-] / monthly window gate live value
    bWeekGateOk  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 周序号闸实时值 [-] / week index gate live value
    nWeekIdx     : INT := 1;                 // 月内周序号 [周]，域 1..5 / week index within the month, domain 1 to 5
    nDayInWeek   : INT := 1;                 // 周内日序号 [日]，域 1..7 / day index within the week, domain 1 to 7
    nRemainInWeek: INT := 0;                 // 本周剩余天数（不跨月）[日] / remaining days this week, not crossing the month
    nRemainInMonth : INT := 0;               // 本月剩余天数 [日] / remaining days this month
    nPlanDays    : INT := 0;                 // 本窗剩余可排产天数（双闸内计数）[日] / remaining plannable days inside the window
    eCause       : E_DL_FwpCause := E_DL_FwpCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtReset      : R_TRIG;                   // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eFaultCause : E_DL_FwpCause := E_DL_FwpCause.eNone;  // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bCfgBad     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 组态非法判定 [-] / illegal configuration verdict
    _bMonthGate  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 月窗闸工作值 [-] / monthly window gate working value
    _bWeekGate   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 周序号闸工作值 [-] / week index gate working value
    _nDaysInMonth: INT := 30;                // 当月日历天数 [日] / calendar days of the current month [day]
    _nDay        : INT := 1;                 // 回钳后的当日序号 [日] / clamped day index [day]
    _nStart      : INT := 1;                 // 回钳后的窗起始日 [日] / clamped window start day [day]
    _nEnd        : INT := 1;                 // 回钳后的窗结束日 [日] / clamped window end day [day]
    _nWeekFrom   : INT := 1;                 // 回钳后的周序号下限 [周] / clamped week index floor [week]
    _nWeekTo     : INT := 5;                 // 回钳后的周序号上限 [周] / clamped week index ceiling [week]
    _nWeekIdx    : INT := 1;                 // 周序号工作值 [周] / week index working value [week]
    _nDayInWeek  : INT := 1;                 // 周内日序号工作值 [日] / day in week working value [day]
    _nRemainWeek : INT := 0;                 // 本周剩余天数工作值 [日] / remaining week days working value [day]
    _nRemainMonth: INT := 0;                 // 本月剩余天数工作值 [日] / remaining month days working value [day]
    _nPlanDays   : INT := 0;                 // 窗内剩余可排产天数工作值 [日] / remaining plannable days working value [day]
    _nScanDay    : INT := 1;                 // 窗内扫描用日序（自当日到窗末）[日] / scanning day index from today to the window end [day]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_FWP_DAY_MAX   : INT := 31;            // 月内最大天数 [日] / maximum days within a month [day]
    DL_FWP_WEEK_N    : INT := 7;             // 一周日数，整除去子（常量非零）[日] / days per week, the division divisor as a non-zero constant [day]
    DL_FWP_WEEK_MAX  : INT := 5;             // 月内最大周序号 [周] / maximum week index within a month [week]
    DL_FWP_YEAR_MIN  : INT := 2000;          // 年份下限 [年] / year floor [year]
    DL_FWP_YEAR_MAX  : INT := 2100;          // 年份上限 [年] / year ceiling [year]
END_VAR

// 段 0｜复位沿无条件周期刷新（禁入分支）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh of the reset edge, never inside a branch
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_FwpCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _nWeekIdx := 1; // 周序号从第一周起 / the week index starts at one
    _nDayInWeek := 1; // 周内日序号从第一日起 / the day in week starts at one
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清故障锁存与故障级成因（不动日历派生量）/ segment 2, reset edge scope
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_FwpCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
END_IF

// 段 3｜日历天数：闰年二月二十九日 / segment 3, calendar days with a leap February
_nDaysInMonth := 31; // 默认三十一日 / default thirty one days
CASE nMonth OF
1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12: // 大月 / long months
    _nDaysInMonth := 31; // 三十一日 / thirty one days
2: // 二月 / february
    IF ((nYear MOD 4) = 0) AND (((nYear MOD 100) <> 0) OR ((nYear MOD 400) = 0)) THEN // 闰年判据 / leap year criterion
        _nDaysInMonth := 29; // 闰年二十九日 / twenty nine days in a leap year
    ELSE
        _nDaysInMonth := 28; // 平年二十八日 / twenty eight days in a common year
    END_IF
4, 6, 9, 11: // 小月 / short months
    _nDaysInMonth := 30; // 三十日 / thirty days
ELSE // 非法月份兜底（R128）/ illegal month fallback
    _nDaysInMonth := 30; // 兜底三十日，故障另由域闸锁存 / fall back to thirty days, the fault is latched by the domain gate
END_CASE

// 段 4｜组态域闸（R151 全覆盖）/ segment 4, configuration domain gate over every pin
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法预置假 / preset the illegal configuration verdict to false
IF (nYear < DL_FWP_YEAR_MIN) OR (nYear > DL_FWP_YEAR_MAX) THEN // 年份越域 / year out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nMonth < 1) OR (nMonth > 12) THEN // 月份越域 / month out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nDayOfMonth < 1) OR (nDayOfMonth > DL_FWP_DAY_MAX) THEN // 当日序号越域 / day index out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nWinStartDay < 1) OR (nWinStartDay > DL_FWP_DAY_MAX) OR (nWinEndDay < nWinStartDay) OR (nWinEndDay > DL_FWP_DAY_MAX) THEN // 窗界越域或自相矛盾 / window bounds out of domain or contradicting
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nWeekFrom < 1) OR (nWeekFrom > DL_FWP_WEEK_MAX) OR (nWeekTo < nWeekFrom) OR (nWeekTo > DL_FWP_WEEK_MAX) THEN // 周区间越域或自相矛盾 / week band out of domain or contradicting
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_FwpCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
END_IF

// 段 5｜回钳：日序、窗界、周区间一律回钳到可比较域 / segment 5, clamping the day, the window bounds and the week band
_nDay := nDayOfMonth; // 日序直通 / day index passes through
IF _nDay < 1 THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nDay := 1; // 回钳到一日 / clamp to day one
ELSIF _nDay > _nDaysInMonth THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nDay := _nDaysInMonth; // 回钳到月末 / clamp to the last day
END_IF
_nStart := nWinStartDay; // 窗起始日直通 / window start passes through
IF _nStart < 1 THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nStart := 1; // 回钳到一日 / clamp to day one
ELSIF _nStart > _nDaysInMonth THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nStart := _nDaysInMonth; // 回钳到月末 / clamp to the last day
END_IF
_nEnd := nWinEndDay; // 窗结束日直通 / window end passes through
IF _nEnd < _nStart THEN // 结束早于起始 / end earlier than start
    _nEnd := _nStart; // 回钳到起始日 / clamp to the start day
ELSIF _nEnd > _nDaysInMonth THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nEnd := _nDaysInMonth; // 回钳到月末 / clamp to the last day
END_IF
_nWeekFrom := nWeekFrom; // 周下限直通 / the week floor passes through
IF _nWeekFrom < 1 THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nWeekFrom := 1; // 回钳到第一周 / clamp to the first week
ELSIF _nWeekFrom > DL_FWP_WEEK_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nWeekFrom := DL_FWP_WEEK_MAX; // 回钳到第五周 / clamp to the fifth week
END_IF
_nWeekTo := nWeekTo; // 周上限直通 / the week ceiling passes through
IF _nWeekTo < _nWeekFrom THEN // 上限早于下限 / ceiling earlier than the floor
    _nWeekTo := _nWeekFrom; // 回钳到下限 / clamp to the floor
ELSIF _nWeekTo > DL_FWP_WEEK_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nWeekTo := DL_FWP_WEEK_MAX; // 回钳到第五周 / clamp to the fifth week
END_IF

// 段 6｜周序号与周内日序号派生：除子为常量 7，日序已回钳 1..31 / segment 6, week index and day in week derived with the constant divisor seven
_nWeekIdx := ((_nDay - 1) / DL_FWP_WEEK_N) + 1; // 月内周序号，整除除子为常量七 / week index within the month with the constant divisor seven
IF _nWeekIdx < 1 THEN // 下越界（防御）/ below the lower bound as a defence
    _nWeekIdx := 1; // 回钳到第一周 / clamp to the first week
ELSIF _nWeekIdx > DL_FWP_WEEK_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nWeekIdx := DL_FWP_WEEK_MAX; // 回钳到第五周 / clamp to the fifth week
END_IF
_nDayInWeek := ((_nDay - 1) MOD DL_FWP_WEEK_N) + 1; // 周内日序，取模除子为常量七 / day in week with the constant divisor seven
IF _nDayInWeek < 1 THEN // 下越界（防御）/ below the lower bound as a defence
    _nDayInWeek := 1; // 回钳到第一日 / clamp to the first day
ELSIF _nDayInWeek > DL_FWP_WEEK_N THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nDayInWeek := DL_FWP_WEEK_N; // 回钳到第七日 / clamp to the seventh day
END_IF

// 段 7｜双闸判定：月窗闸与周序号闸各自独立（R190 归因唯一）/ segment 7, the two gates evaluated independently
_bMonthGate := (_nDay >= _nStart) AND (_nDay <= _nEnd); // 月窗闸：当日落在月生产窗内 / monthly window gate
_bWeekGate := (_nWeekIdx >= _nWeekFrom) AND (_nWeekIdx <= _nWeekTo); // 周序号闸：周序号落在允许区间 / week index gate
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能：关窗（R191 显式声明）/ disabled, the window closes
    _bMonthGate := FALSE; // 月窗闸撤除 / the monthly gate is withdrawn
    _bWeekGate := FALSE; // 周序号闸撤除 / the week gate is withdrawn
END_IF

// 段 8｜剩余天数：周内剩余不跨月，窗内剩余按双闸逐日推演 / segment 8, remaining days within the week and inside the window
_nRemainWeek := DL_FWP_WEEK_N - _nDayInWeek; // 本周剩余天数（跨月部分由下一行截断）/ remaining days this week, truncated by the next line
IF (_nDay + _nRemainWeek) > _nDaysInMonth THEN // 周尾越过月末 / the week tail crosses the month end
    _nRemainWeek := _nDaysInMonth - _nDay; // 截断到月末 / truncated at the month end
END_IF
IF _nRemainWeek < 0 THEN // 防御：负值不可能 / defence, a negative value is impossible
    _nRemainWeek := 0; // 钳零 / clamped to zero
END_IF
_nRemainMonth := _nDaysInMonth - _nDay; // 本月剩余天数 / remaining days this month
IF _nRemainMonth < 0 THEN // 防御：负值不可能 / defence, a negative value is impossible
    _nRemainMonth := 0; // 钳零 / clamped to zero
END_IF
_nPlanDays := 0; // 窗内剩余可排产天数清零 / clear the remaining plannable days
IF _bMonthGate AND _bWeekGate THEN // 双闸内才逐日推演 / the day sweep only runs inside both gates
    _nScanDay := _nDay; // 自当日起扫 / sweep from today
    WHILE _nScanDay <= _nEnd DO // 扫到窗末为止，上界为回钳后的窗末日 / sweep up to the window end
        IF ((((_nScanDay - 1) / DL_FWP_WEEK_N) + 1) >= _nWeekFrom) AND ((((_nScanDay - 1) / DL_FWP_WEEK_N) + 1) <= _nWeekTo) THEN // 该日的周序号落在允许区间 / the week index of that day is inside the band
            _nPlanDays := _nPlanDays + 1; // 计入可排产天数 / count as a plannable day
        END_IF
        _nScanDay := _nScanDay + 1; // 日序递增 / increment the day index
    END_WHILE
END_IF

// 段 9｜成因分派（固定优先级：故障 > 月窗闸 > 周序号闸 > 无成因）/ segment 9, cause dispatch with a fixed priority
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eCause := _eFaultCause; // 故障级成因锁存回放 / the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSIF (NOT _bMonthGate) AND _bWeekGate THEN // 仅月窗闸不成立 / only the monthly gate fails
    eCause := E_DL_FwpCause.eMonthGate; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSIF _bMonthGate AND (NOT _bWeekGate) THEN // 仅周序号闸不成立 / only the week gate fails
    eCause := E_DL_FwpCause.eWeekGate; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSIF (NOT _bMonthGate) AND (NOT _bWeekGate) THEN // 两闸均不成立 / both gates fail
    eCause := E_DL_FwpCause.eMonthGate; // 按月窗闸优先报告（上游先解除大闸）/ report the monthly gate first because the upstream gate must clear first
ELSE
    eCause := E_DL_FwpCause.eNone; // 双闸内无成因 / no cause inside both gates
END_IF

// 段 10｜统一出口 / segment 10, unified outlet
bMonthGateOk := _bMonthGate; // 月窗闸出口 / monthly gate outlet
bWeekGateOk := _bWeekGate; // 周序号闸出口 / week gate outlet
bWindowOpen := _bMonthGate AND _bWeekGate; // 双闸合成（挂状态量，非单拍标志）/ the composite gate as a state quantity
nWeekIdx := _nWeekIdx; // 周序号出口 / week index outlet
nDayInWeek := _nDayInWeek; // 周内日序号出口 / day in week outlet
nRemainInWeek := _nRemainWeek; // 本周剩余天数出口 / remaining week days outlet
nRemainInMonth := _nRemainMonth; // 本月剩余天数出口 / remaining month days outlet
nPlanDays := _nPlanDays; // 窗内可排产天数出口 / remaining plannable days outlet
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 光伏组串巡检需要把各组串电流按当时辐照度归一化以便横向对比：归一化电流等于实测电流乘以标准辐照与实际辐照之比，辐照度低于起测阈值或非有限时跳过该串并单列计数，输出钳位到组态上限防止个别坏点拉爆对比图，归一化基准辐照可组态且默认 1000 W/m2，纯计算无副作用。
architecture_thought: 辐照归一化架构：每串独立计算归一化电流=实测乘标准辐照除实际辐照，除法前做辐照下限闸（低于起测阈值或非有限跳过该串并单列计数不写出口）；输出按组态上限钳位防坏点拉爆对比图；基准辐照常量默认 1000 可组态且非法时回默认；无状态每次调用独立计算，出口含归一化数组与跳过计数，纯计算无副作用。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_StringIrrNormalize
  分类   Category   : DL_Process
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : 组串电流辐照归一化。把实测组串电流归一到参考辐照（默认
                      1000 瓦每平方米）与参考电池温度（默认 25 摄氏度）下的等效
                      电流：分母 = (G / Gref) × [1 + k × (T − Tref)]，
                      分子 = 实测电流；归一化电流 = 分子 / 分母。
                      用于不同辐照 / 温度工况下的组串横向比对与遮挡判别。
  溯源   Origin     : 辐照与温度归一为公开光伏工程口径；本件为 clean-room 实现，
                      仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签 roadmap-p2-string），
                      道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（REAL 运算，无私有库、无方言转换）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只做归一化与有效性判定，不判组件故障、不做 MPPT（属主边界）；
                      二 辐照低于有效下限（默认 50 瓦每平方米）时不归一，出口保持上拍值；
                      三 分母（辐照相对量 × 温度因子）低于 1E-6 时不归一，出口保持上拍值；
                      四 温度补偿可按 bTempComp 关闭，关闭时温度因子恒为 1；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      fINormA 仅在 bValid 为真的拍更新，其余拍保持上一次有效值
                      （首拍保持引脚初值 0），非有限值永不写入出口；
                      nHoldCnt 为连续无效拍计数（上限饱和），供上层判「长时间不可归一」；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 2 · 序号 10）
  ==================================================================
*)

TYPE E_DL_SinCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：参考辐照、温度系数或参考温度越域（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal config, reference irradiance, temperature coefficient or reference temperature out of domain
    eIrrLow     := 2,   // 辐照低于有效下限，本拍不归一（信息级）/ irradiance below the effective floor, not normalised this scan, informational
    eInputBad   := 3,   // 输入非有限或分母不可用，本拍不归一（信息级）/ non-finite input or unusable denominator, not normalised this scan, informational
    eDenormBad  := 4    // 分母超量程，结果不可信（信息级）/ the denominator is out of range and the result is untrustworthy, informational
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_StringIrrNormalize
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;             // 使能，失能时冻结出口保持末值 [-] / enable, the outlet freezes and holds its last value when disabled
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;           // 复位上升沿清故障锁存与保持计数 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch and the hold counter
    fIrrWm2      : REAL := 0.0;              // 实测辐照 [瓦每平方米] / measured irradiance [watt per square metre]
    fIMeasA      : REAL := 0.0;              // 实测组串电流 [安培] / measured string current [ampere]
    fCellTempC   : REAL := 25.0;             // 实测电池温度 [摄氏度] / measured cell temperature [degree Celsius]
    fIrrRefWm2   : REAL := 1000.0;           // 参考辐照 [瓦每平方米]，域 大于零 / reference irradiance [watt per square metre], domain above zero
    fTempRefC    : REAL := 25.0;             // 参考电池温度 [摄氏度] / reference cell temperature [degree Celsius]
    fTempCoefPct : REAL := 0.35;             // 温度系数 [百分比每开尔文]，域 0..2 / temperature coefficient [percent per Kelvin], domain 0 to 2
    fIrrMinWm2   : REAL := 50.0;             // 有效辐照下限 [瓦每平方米]，域 大于零 / effective irradiance floor [watt per square metre], domain above zero
    bTempComp    : BOOL := TRUE;             // 真 = 做温度补偿，假 = 温度因子恒为 1 [-] / true applies temperature compensation, false keeps the factor at one
    nHoldMax     : INT := 600;               // 连续无效拍计数上限 [拍]，域 1..100000 / hold counter ceiling [scan], domain 1 to 100000
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fINormA      : REAL := 0.0;              // 归一化组串电流 [安培] / normalised string current [ampere]
    fDenom       : REAL := 0.0;              // 归一化分母（辐照相对量 × 温度因子）[无量纲] / normalisation denominator, relative irradiance times the temperature factor [dimensionless]
    fIRelPct     : REAL := 0.0;              // 辐照相对量 [百分比] / relative irradiance [percent]
    fTFac        : REAL := 1.0;              // 温度因子 [无量纲] / temperature factor [dimensionless]
    bValid       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本拍归一结果是否有效 [-] / this scan result valid flag
    nHoldCnt     : INT := 0;                 // 连续无效拍计数（饱和到上限）[拍] / consecutive invalid scan count, saturated at the ceiling
    eCause       : E_DL_SinCause := E_DL_SinCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtReset      : R_TRIG;                   // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eCause      : E_DL_SinCause := E_DL_SinCause.eNone;  // 信息级成因，每拍重算 / informational cause, recomputed every scan
    _eFaultCause : E_DL_SinCause := E_DL_SinCause.eNone;  // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bInOk       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 三项输入均有限 [-] / all three inputs finite
    _bCfgBad     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 组态非法判定 [-] / illegal configuration verdict
    _bDivOk      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 分母可用判定 [-] / denominator usable verdict
    _bValid      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本拍有效内部位 [-] / internal validity bit of this scan
    _nHoldUse    : INT := 1;                 // 钳定后的保持计数上限 [拍] / clamped hold counter ceiling [scan]
    _nHoldCnt    : INT := 0;                 // 连续无效拍计数工作值 [拍] / consecutive invalid scan counter [scan]
    _fIrrRel     : REAL := 0.0;              // 辐照相对量工作值 [无量纲] / relative irradiance working value [dimensionless]
    _fTFac       : REAL := 1.0;              // 温度因子工作值 [无量纲] / temperature factor working value [dimensionless]
    _fDenom      : REAL := 0.0;              // 分母工作值 [无量纲] / denominator working value [dimensionless]
    _fNorm       : REAL := 0.0;              // 归一化结果工作值 [安培] / normalised result working value [ampere]
    _fNormHold   : REAL := 0.0;              // 归一化结果保持块 [安培] / normalised result holder [ampere]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_SIN_DENOM_MIN : REAL := 1.0E-6;       // 分母下限，防除零 [无量纲] / denominator floor against division by zero [dimensionless]
    DL_SIN_DENOM_MAX : REAL := 1.0E3;        // 分母上限，防量纲错配放大 [无量纲] / denominator ceiling against a magnitude mismatch [dimensionless]
    DL_SIN_NORM_MAX  : REAL := 1.0E6;        // 归一化电流量级上限 [安培] / normalised current magnitude ceiling [ampere]
    DL_SIN_COEF_MIN  : REAL := 0.0;          // 温度系数下限 [百分比每开尔文] / temperature coefficient floor [percent per Kelvin]
    DL_SIN_COEF_MAX  : REAL := 2.0;          // 温度系数上限 [百分比每开尔文] / temperature coefficient ceiling [percent per Kelvin]
    DL_SIN_TREF_MIN  : REAL := -50.0;        // 参考温度下限 [摄氏度] / reference temperature floor [degree Celsius]
    DL_SIN_TREF_MAX  : REAL := 100.0;        // 参考温度上限 [摄氏度] / reference temperature ceiling [degree Celsius]
    DL_SIN_HOLD_MAX  : INT := 100000;        // 保持计数上限的钳定上限 [拍] / clamp ceiling of the hold counter [scan]
    DL_SIN_IRR_MAX   : REAL := 2000.0;       // 辐照量级上限，超此视为不可信 [瓦每平方米] / irradiance magnitude ceiling above which the value is untrustworthy [watt per square metre]
END_VAR

// 段 0｜复位沿无条件周期刷新（禁入分支）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh of the reset edge, never inside a branch
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_SinCause.eNone; // 信息级成因清零 / clear the informational cause
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_SinCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _nHoldCnt := 0; // 保持计数清零 / clear the hold counter
    _fNormHold := 0.0; // 保持块清零 / clear the holder
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清故障锁存 / 清保持计数（出口保持块不清，避免读数跳变）/ segment 2, reset edge scope
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_SinCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _nHoldCnt := 0; // 作用域二：清连续无效拍计数 / scope two, clear the consecutive invalid count
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态域闸（R151 全覆盖）：参考辐照、参考温度、温度系数、辐照下限、计数上限 / segment 3, configuration domain gate over every tuning pin
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法预置假 / preset the illegal configuration verdict to false
IF (fIrrRefWm2 <= 0.0) OR (fIrrRefWm2 <> fIrrRefWm2) OR (fIrrRefWm2 > DL_SIN_IRR_MAX) THEN // 参考辐照越域 / reference irradiance out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fTempRefC < DL_SIN_TREF_MIN) OR (fTempRefC > DL_SIN_TREF_MAX) OR (fTempRefC <> fTempRefC) THEN // 参考温度越域 / reference temperature out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fTempCoefPct < DL_SIN_COEF_MIN) OR (fTempCoefPct > DL_SIN_COEF_MAX) OR (fTempCoefPct <> fTempCoefPct) THEN // 温度系数越域 / temperature coefficient out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fIrrMinWm2 <= 0.0) OR (fIrrMinWm2 <> fIrrMinWm2) OR (fIrrMinWm2 >= fIrrRefWm2) THEN // 辐照下限越域或与参考值矛盾 / irradiance floor out of domain or contradicting the reference
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nHoldMax < 1) OR (nHoldMax > DL_SIN_HOLD_MAX) THEN // 计数上限越域 / counter ceiling out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_SinCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
END_IF
_nHoldUse := nHoldMax; // 计数上限直通 / counter ceiling passes through
IF _nHoldUse < 1 THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nHoldUse := 1; // 回钳到 1 / clamp to one
ELSIF _nHoldUse > DL_SIN_HOLD_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nHoldUse := DL_SIN_HOLD_MAX; // 回钳到上限 / clamp to the ceiling
END_IF

// 段 4｜输入有限性闸：三项全有限才参与换算，任一非有限即保持上拍出口 / segment 4, input finiteness gate over all three measurements
_bInOk := (fIrrWm2 = fIrrWm2) AND ((fIrrWm2 - fIrrWm2) = (fIrrWm2 - fIrrWm2)) AND (fIMeasA = fIMeasA) AND ((fIMeasA - fIMeasA) = (fIMeasA - fIMeasA)) AND (fCellTempC = fCellTempC) AND ((fCellTempC - fCellTempC) = (fCellTempC - fCellTempC)); // 辐照、电流、温度三项有限性闸 / finiteness gate on irradiance, current and temperature
_eCause := E_DL_SinCause.eNone; // 信息级成因每拍重算 / the informational cause is recomputed every scan
_bValid := FALSE; // 本拍有效位预置假 / preset the validity bit to false
IF (NOT _bInOk) OR _bFault OR (NOT bEnable) THEN // 输入非有限、故障锁存或失能 / non-finite input, fault latched or disabled
    _eCause := E_DL_SinCause.eInputBad; // 信息级成因：不归一 / informational cause, not normalised
ELSE
    // 段 5｜温度因子：补偿关闭时恒为 1；补偿开启时按系数与温差展开 / segment 5, temperature factor computation
    _fTFac := 1.0; // 温度因子默认 1 / the temperature factor defaults to one
    IF bTempComp THEN // 补偿开启 / compensation enabled
        _fTFac := 1.0 + (fTempCoefPct / 100.0) * (fCellTempC - fTempRefC); // 因子，除子为常量 100.0 / factor with the constant divisor one hundred
        IF _fTFac < 0.05 THEN // 因子过小（极端温差外推）/ the factor is too small for a valid extrapolation
            _fTFac := 0.05; // 钳到下限，防分母趋零 / clamped to the floor against a vanishing denominator
        ELSIF _fTFac > 5.0 THEN // 因子过大 / the factor is too large
            _fTFac := 5.0; // 钳到上限 / clamped to the ceiling
        END_IF
    END_IF
    // 段 6｜辐照相对量与分母：辐照低于有效下限时不归一 / segment 6, relative irradiance and denominator
    _fIrrRel := fIrrWm2 / fIrrRefWm2; // 辐照相对量，除子已由域闸证明大于零 / relative irradiance, divisor proven positive by the domain gate
    _fDenom := _fIrrRel * _fTFac; // 分母 / denominator
    _bDivOk := (_fDenom >= DL_SIN_DENOM_MIN) AND (_fDenom <= DL_SIN_DENOM_MAX); // 分母在可用区间 / the denominator is inside the usable band
    IF (fIrrWm2 < fIrrMinWm2) OR (fIrrWm2 > DL_SIN_IRR_MAX) THEN // 辐照低于下限或超量程上限 / irradiance below the floor or above the magnitude ceiling
        _eCause := E_DL_SinCause.eIrrLow; // 信息级成因：辐照不可用 / informational cause, irradiance unusable
    ELSIF NOT _bDivOk THEN // 分母不可用 / the denominator is unusable
        _eCause := E_DL_SinCause.eDenormBad; // 信息级成因：分母超量程 / informational cause, denominator out of range
    ELSE
        _fNorm := fIMeasA / _fDenom; // 归一化电流，除子已证不小于 1E-6 / normalised current, divisor proven not below one micro unit
        IF (_fNorm <> _fNorm) OR ((_fNorm - _fNorm) <> (_fNorm - _fNorm)) OR (ABS(_fNorm) > DL_SIN_NORM_MAX) THEN // 结果非有限或超量级 / the result is non-finite or out of magnitude
            _eCause := E_DL_SinCause.eDenormBad; // 信息级成因：结果不可信 / informational cause, the result is untrustworthy
        ELSE
            _fNormHold := _fNorm; // 有效拍更新保持块（非有限不穿透出口）/ the holder is updated on a valid scan so nothing non-finite passes the outlet
            _bValid := TRUE; // 置本拍有效 / raise the this-scan validity
            _nHoldCnt := 0; // 有效拍清零连续无效计数 / clear the count on a valid scan
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 7｜无效拍计数：饱和到钳定上限，防溢出翻转 / segment 7, invalid scan counting saturated at the clamped ceiling
IF (NOT _bValid) AND bEnable AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 仅在使能且无故障时累计无效拍 / counting runs only while enabled and unfaulted
    IF _nHoldCnt < _nHoldUse THEN // 未达上限 / below the ceiling
        _nHoldCnt := _nHoldCnt + 1; // 计数递增 / increment the count
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 8｜统一出口 / segment 8, unified outlet
fINormA := _fNormHold; // 归一化电流出口取保持块 / the normalised current outlet takes the holder
fDenom := _fDenom; // 分母出口 / denominator outlet
fIRelPct := _fIrrRel * 100.0; // 辐照相对量出口，乘常量 100.0 / relative irradiance outlet with the constant multiplier one hundred
fTFac := _fTFac; // 温度因子出口 / temperature factor outlet
bValid := _bValid AND (NOT _bFault); // 有效出口受故障锁存否决（挂状态量）/ the valid outlet is vetoed by the fault latch, a state quantity
nHoldCnt := _nHoldCnt; // 连续无效拍计数出口 / hold counter outlet
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eCause := _eFaultCause; // 故障级成因锁存回放 / the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSE
    eCause := _eCause; // 信息级成因直映 / the informational cause is mapped directly
END_IF
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 批次周报需要把一周内的批次数与良品率汇总成闸控快照：周窗到界冻结本周数据生成周批号（年周序编码），周内批次计数与不良计数自洽（和=总处理），冻结期间上位只读；周窗参数非法或计数溢出先置码，跨周切换清当周累计并保留上周快照供追溯，良品率分母为零时输出按无效处理不参与考核。
architecture_thought: 周窗汇总架构：段 0 无条件刷新周窗判定与切换沿；周内批次计数与不良计数同源累加保证自洽（各计数和=总处理）；周窗界沿冻结本周数据并生成周批号（年序乘周序编码规则集中一处）；良品率计算前做分母零闸，为零按无效输出不参与考核；冻结期间只读；周窗参数非法先置码拒收；出口含周批号、三计数、良品率与冻结标志。

TYPE E_DL_BwrState :
(
    eIdle  := 0,        // 空闲：等批次结束沿或周变更沿 / idle, waiting for a batch end or a week change
    eGate  := 10,       // 周报闸开：等上位确认或闸超时 / weekly report gate open, waiting for the acknowledgement or the gate timeout
    eFault := 90        // 故障：组态非法锁存 / fault, illegal configuration latched
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_BwrCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：年份、周序号或时间引脚越域（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal config, year, week index or time pin out of domain
    eWeekRoll   := 2,   // 周变更，本周累计已锁存并清零（信息级）/ week rolled over, the weekly accumulation was latched and cleared, informational
    eCntSat     := 3    // 周内批次计数饱和（信息级）/ the weekly batch counter saturated, informational
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_BatchWeekReport
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;             // 使能，失能时关闸并冻结累计 [-] / enable, disabling closes the gate and freezes the accumulation
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;           // 复位上升沿清故障锁存与闸状态 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch and the gate state
    nYear        : INT := 2026;              // 当前年份 [年]，域 2000..2100 / current year [year], domain 2000 to 2100
    nWeekOfYear  : INT := 1;                 // 当前周序号（年内第几周）[周]，域 1..53 / week index within the year [week], domain 1 to 53
    bBatchEnd    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 批次结束脉冲，上升沿结算 [-] / batch end pulse, settled on the rising edge
    uBatchGood   : UDINT := 0;               // 本批好品数 [只] / good pieces of this batch [pieces]
    uBatchScrap  : UDINT := 0;               // 本批废品数 [只] / scrap pieces of this batch [pieces]
    bReportAck   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 上位确认周报，上升沿关闸 [-] / weekly report acknowledgement, the rising edge closes the gate
    tGateTime    : TIME := T#60S;            // 周报闸超时 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / weekly report gate timeout [millisecond], domain above zero
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bReportGate  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 周报闸开指示 [-] / weekly report gate open indicator
    bReportReady : BOOL := FALSE;            // 周报就绪单拍脉冲 [-] / weekly report ready single-shot pulse
    uBatchNo     : UDINT := 0;               // 周批号（年 × 1000 + 周 × 10 + 周内序号模 10）[-] / weekly batch number
    nWeekActive  : INT := 1;                 // 当前生效周序号 [周] / currently active week index [week]
    uWeekBatchCnt: UDINT := 0;               // 本周已结批次计数 [批] / settled batch count this week [batch]
    uWeekGood    : UDINT := 0;               // 本周好品累计 [只] / weekly good pieces [pieces]
    uWeekScrap   : UDINT := 0;               // 本周废品累计 [只] / weekly scrap pieces [pieces]
    uLastWeekGood: UDINT := 0;               // 上周好品汇总（锁存）[只] / last week good pieces, latched [pieces]
    uLastWeekScrap : UDINT := 0;             // 上周废品汇总（锁存）[只] / last week scrap pieces, latched [pieces]
    fWeekYield   : REAL := 0.0;              // 本周良率 [百分比] / weekly yield [percent]
    eState       : E_DL_BwrState := E_DL_BwrState.eIdle; // 相位出口 [枚举] / phase outlet [enum]
    eCause       : E_DL_BwrCause := E_DL_BwrCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtBatch      : R_TRIG;                   // 批次结束沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / batch end edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtAck        : R_TRIG;                   // 确认沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / acknowledgement edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtReset      : R_TRIG;                   // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonGate      : TON;                      // 周报闸超时，段 0 无条件刷新 / gate timeout, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eState      : E_DL_BwrState := E_DL_BwrState.eIdle;  // 内部相位，CASE 唯一写入目标 / internal phase, the only CASE write target
    _eCause      : E_DL_BwrCause := E_DL_BwrCause.eNone;  // 信息级成因，每拍重算 / informational cause, recomputed every scan
    _eFaultCause : E_DL_BwrCause := E_DL_BwrCause.eNone;  // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bReadyInt   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 周报就绪脉冲内部位，统一出口映射 / internal ready bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _bCfgBad     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 组态非法判定 [-] / illegal configuration verdict
    _bCntSat     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 周内批次计数饱和 [-] / the weekly batch counter saturated
    _nWeekPrev   : INT := -1;                // 上一拍周序号快照，初值 -1 使首拍必清 / previous week snapshot, minus one forces a clear on the first scan
    _nWeekUse    : INT := 1;                 // 钳定后的周序号 [周] / clamped week index [week]
    _uClampMax   : UDINT := 100000000;       // 周内批次计数饱和上限 [批] / weekly batch counter saturation ceiling [batch]
    _uCnt        : UDINT := 0;               // 周内批次计数工作值 [批] / weekly batch counter working value [batch]
    _uGood       : UDINT := 0;               // 本周好品累加器 [只] / weekly good accumulator [pieces]
    _uScrap      : UDINT := 0;               // 本周废品累加器 [只] / weekly scrap accumulator [pieces]
    _uLastG      : UDINT := 0;               // 上周好品锁存 [只] / last week good pieces latch [pieces]
    _uLastS      : UDINT := 0;               // 上周废品锁存 [只] / last week scrap pieces latch [pieces]
    _uBatchNo    : UDINT := 0;               // 周批号工作值 [-] / weekly batch number working value
    _uYearBase   : UDINT := 0;               // 批号中的年份基数 [-] / year base of the batch number
    _uTail       : UDINT := 0;               // 批号尾位（周内序号模 10）[-] / batch number tail, the weekly ordinal modulo ten
    _uTotLoc     : UDINT := 0;               // 良率分母（好品加废品）[只] / yield denominator [pieces]
    _fYield      : REAL := 0.0;              // 良率工作值 [百分比] / yield working value [percent]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_BWR_WEEK_MIN  : INT := 1;             // 周序号下限 [周] / week index floor [week]
    DL_BWR_WEEK_MAX  : INT := 53;            // 周序号上限 [周] / week index ceiling [week]
    DL_BWR_YEAR_MIN  : INT := 2000;          // 年份下限 [年] / year floor [year]
    DL_BWR_YEAR_MAX  : INT := 2100;          // 年份上限 [年] / year ceiling [year]
    DL_BWR_YEAR_MUL  : UDINT := 1000;        // 批号年份权重 [无量纲] / year weight in the batch number
    DL_BWR_WEEK_MUL  : UDINT := 10;          // 批号周序号权重 [无量纲] / week weight in the batch number
    DL_BWR_TAIL_MOD  : UDINT := 10;          // 批号尾位取模基数（尾位回绕属正常编码约定）[无量纲] / tail modulo base, tail wrapping is a normal encoding convention
    DL_BWR_YIELD_MAX : REAL := 100.0;        // 良率上限 [百分比] / yield ceiling [percent]
    DL_BWR_CNT_CEIL  : UDINT := 2147483647;  // 数量加和上限，防相加溢出后窄化 [只] / summation ceiling against overflow before narrowing [pieces]
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支），IN 只串状态闸 / segment 0, unconditional refresh of timers and edges with state gates on IN only
rtBatch(CLK := bBatchEnd); // 批次结束沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the batch end edge
rtAck(CLK := bReportAck); // 确认沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the acknowledgement edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge
tonGate(IN := (_eState = E_DL_BwrState.eGate) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tGateTime); // 周报闸超时，IN 串相位闸与故障闸 / gate timeout with the phase gate and the fault gate on IN

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _eState := E_DL_BwrState.eIdle; // 相位从空闲起步 / the phase starts from idle
    _eCause := E_DL_BwrCause.eNone; // 信息级成因清零 / clear the informational cause
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_BwrCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _nWeekPrev := -1; // 周序号快照置非法值 / put the week snapshot at an illegal value
    _uCnt := 0; // 周内批次计数清零 / clear the weekly batch count
    _uGood := 0; // 本周好品清零 / clear the weekly good pieces
    _uScrap := 0; // 本周废品清零 / clear the weekly scrap pieces
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清故障锁存 / 迁相位 / 清脉冲内部位（累计不清，避免产量丢失）/ segment 2, reset edge scope
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_BwrCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _eState := E_DL_BwrState.eIdle; // 作用域二：迁回空闲相 / scope two, migrate back to idle
    _bReadyInt := FALSE; // 作用域二：清就绪脉冲内部位 / scope two, clear the internal ready bit
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态域闸（R151 全覆盖）/ segment 3, configuration domain gate over every pin
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法预置假 / preset the illegal configuration verdict to false
IF (nYear < DL_BWR_YEAR_MIN) OR (nYear > DL_BWR_YEAR_MAX) THEN // 年份越域 / year out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nWeekOfYear < DL_BWR_WEEK_MIN) OR (nWeekOfYear > DL_BWR_WEEK_MAX) THEN // 周序号越域 / week index out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF tGateTime <= T#0S THEN // 闸超时非正 / gate timeout not positive
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_BwrCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
    _eState := E_DL_BwrState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_IF
_nWeekUse := nWeekOfYear; // 周序号直通 / week index passes through
IF _nWeekUse < DL_BWR_WEEK_MIN THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nWeekUse := DL_BWR_WEEK_MIN; // 回钳到 1 / clamp to one
ELSIF _nWeekUse > DL_BWR_WEEK_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nWeekUse := DL_BWR_WEEK_MAX; // 回钳到 53 / clamp to fifty three
END_IF
_uYearBase := INT_TO_UDINT(nYear) * DL_BWR_YEAR_MUL; // 批号年份基数，先落工作值 / the year base of the batch number lands in the working value

// 段 4｜周变更：锁存上周汇总、清本周累计、开周报闸 / segment 4, week rollover latches the last week summary, clears this week and opens the gate
_eCause := E_DL_BwrCause.eNone; // 信息级成因每拍重算 / the informational cause is recomputed every scan
IF _nWeekUse <> _nWeekPrev THEN // 周序号变化（首拍必命中）/ week changed, always true on the first scan
    _uLastG := _uGood; // 上周好品锁存（首拍为 0）/ latch the last week good pieces
    _uLastS := _uScrap; // 上周废品锁存（首拍为 0）/ latch the last week scrap pieces
    _nWeekPrev := _nWeekUse; // 周序号快照推进 / advance the week snapshot
    _uCnt := 0; // 本周批次计数清零 / clear the weekly batch count
    _uGood := 0; // 本周好品清零 / clear the weekly good pieces
    _uScrap := 0; // 本周废品清零 / clear the weekly scrap pieces
    _bReadyInt := TRUE; // 周报就绪脉冲内部位置位（统一出口映射，R187）/ raise the internal ready bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _eState := E_DL_BwrState.eGate; // 开周报闸 / open the weekly report gate
    _eCause := E_DL_BwrCause.eWeekRoll; // 信息级成因：周变更已清零 / informational cause, the rollover cleared the accumulation
END_IF

// 段 5｜相位机：ENUM + CASE，含 ELSE 非法相位兜底（R128）/ segment 5, phase machine with an ELSE fallback for illegal phases
CASE _eState OF
E_DL_BwrState.eIdle: // 空闲相：批次结束沿结算 / idle phase, settle on the batch end edge
    IF rtBatch.Q AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 批次结束沿且无故障 / batch end edge without a fault
        _bCntSat := FALSE; // 饱和标志复位 / clear the saturation flag
        IF _uCnt < _uClampMax THEN // 未达饱和上限 / below the saturation ceiling
            _uCnt := _uCnt + 1; // 批次计数递增 / increment the batch count
        ELSE
            _bCntSat := TRUE; // 置饱和标志 / raise the saturation flag
        END_IF
        IF (_uGood + uBatchGood) < _uGood THEN // 好品累加回绕 / the good accumulation wrapped around
            _uGood := DL_BWR_CNT_CEIL; // 饱和到上限 / saturated at the ceiling
        ELSE
            _uGood := _uGood + uBatchGood; // 好品累加 / accumulate the good pieces
        END_IF
        IF (_uScrap + uBatchScrap) < _uScrap THEN // 废品累加回绕 / the scrap accumulation wrapped around
            _uScrap := DL_BWR_CNT_CEIL; // 饱和到上限 / saturated at the ceiling
        ELSE
            _uScrap := _uScrap + uBatchScrap; // 废品累加 / accumulate the scrap pieces
        END_IF
        _uTail := _uCnt MOD DL_BWR_TAIL_MOD; // 批号尾位，取模除子为常量十 / batch number tail with the constant divisor ten
        _uBatchNo := _uYearBase + INT_TO_UDINT(_nWeekUse) * DL_BWR_WEEK_MUL + _uTail; // 周批号合成 / compose the weekly batch number
    END_IF

E_DL_BwrState.eGate: // 周报闸相：确认沿或超时关闸 / report gate phase, closed by the acknowledgement edge or the timeout
    IF rtAck.Q OR tonGate.Q THEN // 确认或超时 / acknowledged or timed out
        _eState := E_DL_BwrState.eIdle; // 关闸回空闲相 / close the gate and return to idle
    END_IF
    IF rtBatch.Q AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 闸开期间仍有批次结束 / a batch still ends while the gate is open
        IF _uCnt < _uClampMax THEN // 未达饱和上限 / below the saturation ceiling
            _uCnt := _uCnt + 1; // 批次计数照常递增 / the batch count still increments
        END_IF
        _uTail := _uCnt MOD DL_BWR_TAIL_MOD; // 批号尾位重算 / recompute the batch number tail
        _uBatchNo := _uYearBase + INT_TO_UDINT(_nWeekUse) * DL_BWR_WEEK_MUL + _uTail; // 周批号重算 / recompose the weekly batch number
    END_IF

E_DL_BwrState.eFault: // 故障相：锁存回放，等复位沿 / fault phase, the latch is replayed until the reset edge
    _bReadyInt := FALSE; // 故障拍不出就绪脉冲 / no ready pulse while faulted

ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R128）/ illegal phase fallback
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_BwrCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因记组态非法 / record the illegal configuration cause
    _eState := E_DL_BwrState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 6｜失能与良率计算 / segment 6, disabled semantics and the yield computation
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    _eState := E_DL_BwrState.eIdle; // 关闸回空闲相 / close the gate and return to idle
    _bReadyInt := FALSE; // 撤就绪脉冲内部位 / withdraw the internal ready bit
END_IF
_uTotLoc := _uGood + _uScrap; // 良率分母先落局部量 / the yield denominator lands in a local first
IF _uTotLoc < _uGood THEN // 相加回绕 / the sum wrapped around
    _uTotLoc := DL_BWR_CNT_CEIL; // 饱和到上限 / saturated at the ceiling
END_IF
IF _uTotLoc > 0 THEN // 分母可用 / the denominator is usable
    _fYield := UDINT_TO_REAL(_uGood) / UDINT_TO_REAL(_uTotLoc) * 100.0; // 良率，除子已证大于零 / yield, divisor proven positive
    IF _fYield > DL_BWR_YIELD_MAX THEN // 良率越上限 / yield above the ceiling
        _fYield := DL_BWR_YIELD_MAX; // 上钳 / clamp upward
    END_IF
ELSE
    _fYield := 0.0; // 无产量时良率记零 / zero yield when nothing was produced
END_IF

// 段 7｜统一出口 / segment 7, unified outlet
bReportGate := (_eState = E_DL_BwrState.eGate); // 闸开指示（挂状态量）/ gate open indicator as a state quantity
bReportReady := _bReadyInt; // 就绪脉冲映射本拍值 / map the ready pulse for this scan
_bReadyInt := FALSE; // 映射后立即撤销，保证单拍宽度（R187 两段式）/ revoke right after mapping to keep a single-scan width
uBatchNo := _uBatchNo; // 周批号出口（锁存量）/ weekly batch number outlet from the latch
nWeekActive := _nWeekUse; // 生效周序号出口 / active week index outlet
uWeekBatchCnt := _uCnt; // 本周批次计数出口 / weekly batch count outlet
uWeekGood := _uGood; // 本周好品出口 / weekly good outlet
uWeekScrap := _uScrap; // 本周废品出口 / weekly scrap outlet
uLastWeekGood := _uLastG; // 上周好品出口 / last week good outlet
uLastWeekScrap := _uLastS; // 上周废品出口 / last week scrap outlet
fWeekYield := _fYield; // 本周良率出口 / weekly yield outlet
eState := _eState; // 相位出口单点映射 / single-point phase outlet mapping
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eCause := _eFaultCause; // 故障级成因锁存回放 / the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSIF _bCntSat THEN // 计数饱和 / the counter saturated
    eCause := E_DL_BwrCause.eCntSat; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSE
    eCause := _eCause; // 信息级成因直映 / the informational cause is mapped directly
END_IF
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: EL 检测仪输出的缺陷坐标需要归档并与批次比对：每张图像按批次号归档缺陷坐标列表（行/列归一化坐标），同批次累计缺陷分布并与历史基准比对给出偏差档位；坐标越界钳位并计数，图像批次号格式非法拒收，比对基准可组态，归档区写满按最旧覆盖并置提示，防止无限占用内存。（v1.0.1 返修版：见 REVIEW_R56 修法）
architecture_thought: 环形归档与比对架构：归档区按批次号哈希落位（冲突顺延），坐标行/列越界钳位并计越界数，批次号格式先校验（非法拒收不占槽）；同批累计缺陷分布并与组态基准逐档比较给偏差档位；归档区写满按最旧覆盖并置提示标志防内存无限增长；比对与归档分段处理，出口含落位号、批内计数、偏差档与覆盖提示，无动态分配纯定长数组。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_StringElImageMap
  分类   Category   : DL_Process
  版本   Version    : 1.0.1
  功能   Purpose    : EL 图像缺陷坐标归档与批次比对。逐条接收缺陷报告（坐标、面积、
                      类型），回钳后写入环窗归档（最新 64 条），并按批号累计本批
                      缺陷数、面积和 / 最大值 / 类型掩码；批号变化沿把当前批统计
                      转入「上批」快照并清零当前批，随后给出与上批的比对结论
                      （缺陷数与最大面积双向带容差比较）。
  溯源   Origin     : 缺陷坐标归档与批次间对比为通用视觉质量统计语义；本件为
                      clean-room 实现，仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签
                      roadmap-p2-elimage），道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（ARRAY / WORD / SHL / R_TRIG，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只做归档与统计比对，不做缺陷判定、不存图像（属主边界）；
                      二 坐标越出视野范围不归档，但计入越界计数并置信息级成因；
                      三 非有限坐标或面积不归档、不计数，出口数值保持上拍值；
                      四 环窗游标一律经回钳 1..64，写入顺序为「先算槽位、后写入」；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      wTypeMask 位 i-1 对应缺陷类型 i（类型 1 得 bit0，类型 8 得 bit7）；
                      bComparePass 仅在无参照批（上批缺陷数为零）时恒为真，
                      有参照批时按「缺陷数」与「最大面积」双向带容差比较；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 3 · 序号 12）
    2026-11-20  v1.0.1  R56 返修（7.4）：段 2 复位作用域补清 fLastXmm / fLastYmm /
                        fLastSizeMm2 / nLastType 四个最近缺陷出口，并补
                        _stCur.uBatchId 批号重同步，防复位后首条新批报告误判入旧批窗口。
  ==================================================================
*)

TYPE ST_DL_ElBatchStat :
STRUCT
    uBatchId  : UDINT := 0;      // 批号 [-] / batch identifier
    nCount    : INT := 0;        // 缺陷条数 [条] / defect count [piece]
    fSumSize  : REAL := 0.0;     // 面积累计 [平方毫米] / accumulated area [square millimetre]
    fMaxSize  : REAL := 0.0;     // 面积最大值 [平方毫米] / maximum area [square millimetre]
    wTypeMask : WORD := 16#0000; // 类型掩码 [-] / type mask
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_SeiCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：视野范围或容差越域（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal config, field bounds or tolerance out of domain
    eOutField   := 2,   // 缺陷坐标越出视野，未归档（信息级）/ the defect coordinate is outside the field and was not archived, informational
    eInputBad   := 3,   // 坐标或面积非有限，未归档（信息级）/ non-finite coordinate or area, not archived, informational
    eTypeBad    := 4    // 缺陷类型越域已回钳（信息级）/ the defect type was clamped, informational
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_StringElImageMap
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable       : BOOL := TRUE;            // 使能，失能时不接收缺陷报告 [-] / enable, defect reports are not accepted when disabled
    bReset        : BOOL := FALSE;          // 复位上升沿清故障锁存与全部统计 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch and all statistics
    bDefectValid  : BOOL := FALSE;           // 缺陷报告脉冲，上升沿归档一次 [-] / defect report pulse, archived once on the rising edge
    fPosXmm       : REAL := 0.0;             // 缺陷中心横坐标 [毫米] / defect centre abscissa [millimetre]
    fPosYmm       : REAL := 0.0;             // 缺陷中心纵坐标 [毫米] / defect centre ordinate [millimetre]
    fSizeMm2      : REAL := 0.0;             // 缺陷面积 [平方毫米] / defect area [square millimetre]
    nDefectType   : INT := 1;                // 缺陷类型 [类型号]，域 1..8 / defect type [type number], domain 1 to 8
    uBatchId      : UDINT := 0;              // 当前批号 [-] / current batch identifier
    fFieldXmm     : REAL := 1000.0;          // 视野横向范围 [毫米]，域 大于零 / field width [millimetre], domain above zero
    fFieldYmm     : REAL := 1000.0;          // 视野纵向范围 [毫米]，域 大于零 / field height [millimetre], domain above zero
    fTolPct       : REAL := 10.0;            // 批次比对容差 [百分比]，域 大于零 / batch comparison tolerance [percent], domain above zero
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fLastXmm      : REAL := 0.0;             // 最近归档缺陷横坐标 [毫米] / abscissa of the last archived defect [millimetre]
    fLastYmm      : REAL := 0.0;             // 最近归档缺陷纵坐标 [毫米] / ordinate of the last archived defect [millimetre]
    fLastSizeMm2  : REAL := 0.0;             // 最近归档缺陷面积 [平方毫米] / area of the last archived defect [square millimetre]
    nLastType     : INT := 0;                // 最近归档缺陷类型 [类型号] / type of the last archived defect [type number]
    uArchiveCnt   : UDINT := 0;              // 累计归档缺陷数 [条] / total archived defects [piece]
    nBufCount     : INT := 0;                // 环窗当前条数 [条] / ring buffer occupancy [piece]
    nCurCount     : INT := 0;                // 当前批缺陷条数 [条] / current batch defect count [piece]
    fCurMaxMm2    : REAL := 0.0;             // 当前批最大缺陷面积 [平方毫米] / current batch maximum area [square millimetre]
    fCurMeanMm2   : REAL := 0.0;             // 当前批平均缺陷面积 [平方毫米] / current batch mean area [square millimetre]
    nPrevCount    : INT := 0;                // 上批缺陷条数 [条] / previous batch defect count [piece]
    fPrevMaxMm2   : REAL := 0.0;             // 上批最大缺陷面积 [平方毫米] / previous batch maximum area [square millimetre]
    fDeltaMaxPct  : REAL := 0.0;             // 最大面积相对变化 [百分比] / relative change of the maximum area [percent]
    bComparePass  : BOOL := FALSE;           // 批次比对通过 [-] / batch comparison passed
    wTypeMask     : WORD := 16#0000;         // 当前批缺陷类型掩码 [-] / current batch defect type mask
    nOutFieldCnt  : INT := 0;                // 越界缺陷计数（饱和到上限）[条] / out of field defect count, saturated [piece]
    eCause        : E_DL_SeiCause := E_DL_SeiCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError        : BOOL := FALSE;           // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtDefect      : R_TRIG;                  // 缺陷报告沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / defect report edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtReset       : R_TRIG;                  // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _stCur        : ST_DL_ElBatchStat;       // 当前批统计 / current batch statistics
    _stPrev       : ST_DL_ElBatchStat;       // 上批统计快照 / previous batch statistics snapshot
    _eCause       : E_DL_SeiCause := E_DL_SeiCause.eNone;  // 信息级成因，每拍重算 / informational cause, recomputed every scan
    _eFaultCause  : E_DL_SeiCause := E_DL_SeiCause.eNone;  // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault       : BOOL := FALSE;           // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit        : BOOL := FALSE;           // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bCfgBad      : BOOL := FALSE;           // 组态非法判定 [-] / illegal configuration verdict
    _bInOk        : BOOL := FALSE;           // 本拍缺陷数据有限 [-] / this scan defect data finite
    _bInField     : BOOL := FALSE;           // 坐标在视野内 [-] / the coordinate is inside the field
    _bTypeClamped : BOOL := FALSE;           // 类型号被回钳 [-] / the type number was clamped
    _bBatchRoll   : BOOL := FALSE;           // 本拍发生批号变化 [-] / the batch identifier changed this scan
    _nTypeUse     : INT := 1;                // 钳定后的缺陷类型号 [类型号] / clamped defect type number
    _nIdx         : INT := 1;                // 环窗写入槽位（1 起，回钳 1..64）[槽号] / ring write slot, one-based, clamped one through sixty four
    _wTypeBit     : WORD := 16#0001;         // 类型位掩码，先移位后置位（R327）/ type bit mask, shift before setting
    _wMask        : WORD := 16#0000;         // 类型掩码工作字 / type mask working word
    _fMean        : REAL := 0.0;             // 均值工作值 [平方毫米] / mean working value [square millimetre]
    _fDeltaPct    : REAL := 0.0;             // 相对变化工作值 [百分比] / relative change working value [percent]
    _fPrevMaxB    : REAL := 0.0;             // 上批最大面积基线，用于除零闸 [平方毫米] / previous maximum baseline against division by zero [square millimetre]
    _fPrevCntB    : REAL := 0.0;             // 上批条数基线，用于除零闸 [条] / previous count baseline against division by zero [piece]
    _fCurMaxB     : REAL := 0.0;             // 当前批最大面积暂存 [平方毫米] / current maximum area held in a local [square millimetre]
    _fCurCntB     : REAL := 0.0;             // 当前批条数暂存 [条] / current count held in a local [piece]
    _afX          : ARRAY[1..64] OF REAL := [64(0.0)]; // 环窗横坐标归档 [毫米] / ring archive of abscissae [millimetre]
    _afY          : ARRAY[1..64] OF REAL := [64(0.0)]; // 环窗纵坐标归档 [毫米] / ring archive of ordinates [millimetre]
    _afSz         : ARRAY[1..64] OF REAL := [64(0.0)]; // 环窗面积归档 [平方毫米] / ring archive of areas [square millimetre]
    _anType       : ARRAY[1..64] OF INT := [64(0)];    // 环窗类型归档 [类型号] / ring archive of type numbers [type number]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_SEI_BUF_MAX   : INT := 64;            // 环窗容量与槽位回钳上界 [条] / ring capacity and slot clamp upper bound
    DL_SEI_TYPE_MIN  : INT := 1;             // 缺陷类型下限 [类型号] / defect type floor [type number]
    DL_SEI_TYPE_MAX  : INT := 8;             // 缺陷类型上限（与掩码位宽一致）[类型号] / defect type ceiling matching the mask width [type number]
    DL_SEI_COUNT_MAX : INT := 30000;         // 单批缺陷条数上限，防溢出 [条] / per batch defect count ceiling against overflow [piece]
    DL_SEI_AREA_MAX  : REAL := 1.0E6;        // 缺陷面积量级上限 [平方毫米] / defect area magnitude ceiling [square millimetre]
    DL_SEI_TOL_MAX   : REAL := 500.0;        // 比对容差上限 [百分比] / comparison tolerance ceiling [percent]
    DL_SEI_MASK_NONE : WORD := 16#0000;      // 空掩码常量 [-] / empty mask constant
    DL_SEI_MASK_ONE  : WORD := 16#0001;      // 单位位常量 [-] / single bit constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh of the edge detectors, never inside a branch
rtDefect(CLK := bDefectValid); // 缺陷报告沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the defect edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）：统计与环窗从确定起点开始 / segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_SeiCause.eNone; // 信息级成因清零 / clear the informational cause
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_SeiCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _stCur.uBatchId := uBatchId; // 当前批号初始化 / initialise the current batch identifier
    _stPrev.uBatchId := 0; // 上批号清零 / clear the previous batch identifier
    _nIdx := 1; // 环窗槽位归位 / park the ring slot at one
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清锁存 / 清统计 / 清环窗游标（归档数组保留，不作判据）/ segment 2, reset edge scope
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_SeiCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _stCur.nCount := 0; // 作用域二：清当前批条数 / scope two, clear the current batch count
    _stCur.fSumSize := 0.0; // 作用域二：清面积累计 / scope two, clear the accumulated area
    _stCur.fMaxSize := 0.0; // 作用域二：清面积最大值 / scope two, clear the maximum area
    _stCur.wTypeMask := DL_SEI_MASK_NONE; // 作用域二：清类型掩码 / scope two, clear the type mask
    _stPrev.nCount := 0; // 作用域二：清上批条数 / scope two, clear the previous count
    _stPrev.fSumSize := 0.0; // 作用域二：清上批面积累计 / scope two, clear the previous accumulated area
    _stPrev.fMaxSize := 0.0; // 作用域二：清上批最大面积 / scope two, clear the previous maximum area
    _stPrev.wTypeMask := DL_SEI_MASK_NONE; // 作用域二：清上批类型掩码 / scope two, clear the previous type mask
    fLastXmm := 0.0; // 作用域二：清最近横坐标出口（R56 返修补齐）/ scope two, clear the last abscissa outlet
    fLastYmm := 0.0; // 作用域二：清最近纵坐标出口（R56 返修补齐）/ scope two, clear the last ordinate outlet
    fLastSizeMm2 := 0.0; // 作用域二：清最近面积出口（R56 返修补齐）/ scope two, clear the last area outlet
    nLastType := 0; // 作用域二：清最近类型出口（R56 返修补齐）/ scope two, clear the last type outlet
    _stCur.uBatchId := uBatchId; // 作用域二：当前批号重同步，防复位后首条新批报告误判入旧批窗口（R56 返修补齐）/ scope two, resync the current batch identifier so the first report after a reset is not judged against a stale batch window
    _nIdx := 1; // 作用域三：清环窗槽位 / scope three, clear the ring slot cursor
    nBufCount := 0; // 作用域三：清环窗占用 / scope three, clear the ring occupancy
    uArchiveCnt := 0; // 作用域三：清累计归档数 / scope three, clear the total archived count
    nOutFieldCnt := 0; // 作用域三：清越界计数 / scope three, clear the out of field count
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态域闸（R151 全覆盖）：视野范围与比对容差 / segment 3, configuration domain gate over the field bounds and the tolerance
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法预置假 / preset the illegal configuration verdict to false
IF (fFieldXmm <= 0.0) OR (fFieldXmm <> fFieldXmm) OR (fFieldXmm > DL_SEI_AREA_MAX) THEN // 横向视野越域 / field width out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fFieldYmm <= 0.0) OR (fFieldYmm <> fFieldYmm) OR (fFieldYmm > DL_SEI_AREA_MAX) THEN // 纵向视野越域 / field height out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fTolPct <= 0.0) OR (fTolPct > DL_SEI_TOL_MAX) OR (fTolPct <> fTolPct) THEN // 容量越域 / tolerance out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_SeiCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
END_IF

// 段 4｜批号变化：当前批统计转入上批快照，当前批清零 / segment 4, batch change moves the current statistics into the previous snapshot
_bBatchRoll := (uBatchId <> _stCur.uBatchId); // 批号变化判据 / batch change criterion
IF _bBatchRoll THEN // 批号变化 / the batch identifier changed
    _stPrev.uBatchId := _stCur.uBatchId; // 上批号继承 / the previous identifier inherits
    _stPrev.nCount := _stCur.nCount; // 上批条数快照 / snapshot the previous count
    _stPrev.fSumSize := _stCur.fSumSize; // 上批面积累计快照 / snapshot the previous accumulated area
    _stPrev.fMaxSize := _stCur.fMaxSize; // 上批最大面积快照 / snapshot the previous maximum area
    _stPrev.wTypeMask := _stCur.wTypeMask; // 上批类型掩码快照 / snapshot the previous type mask
    _stCur.uBatchId := uBatchId; // 当前批号推进 / advance the current identifier
    _stCur.nCount := 0; // 当前批条数清零 / clear the current count
    _stCur.fSumSize := 0.0; // 当前批面积累计清零 / clear the current accumulated area
    _stCur.fMaxSize := 0.0; // 当前批最大面积清零 / clear the current maximum area
    _stCur.wTypeMask := DL_SEI_MASK_NONE; // 当前批类型掩码清零 / clear the current type mask
END_IF

// 段 5｜缺陷归档：有限性闸 → 视野闸 → 类型回钳 → 环窗写入 → 统计累加 / segment 5, defect archiving chain
_eCause := E_DL_SeiCause.eNone; // 信息级成因每拍重算 / the informational cause is recomputed every scan
_bTypeClamped := FALSE; // 类型回钳标志预置假 / preset the type clamp flag to false
IF rtDefect.Q AND bEnable AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 缺陷报告沿且使能无故障 / defect edge while enabled and unfaulted
    _bInOk := (fPosXmm = fPosXmm) AND ((fPosXmm - fPosXmm) = (fPosXmm - fPosXmm)) AND (fPosYmm = fPosYmm) AND ((fPosYmm - fPosYmm) = (fPosYmm - fPosYmm)) AND (fSizeMm2 = fSizeMm2) AND ((fSizeMm2 - fSizeMm2) = (fSizeMm2 - fSizeMm2)); // 坐标与面积有限性闸 / finiteness gate on coordinates and area
    _bInField := _bInOk AND (fPosXmm >= 0.0) AND (fPosXmm <= fFieldXmm) AND (fPosYmm >= 0.0) AND (fPosYmm <= fFieldYmm) AND (fSizeMm2 >= 0.0) AND (fSizeMm2 <= DL_SEI_AREA_MAX); // 视野与面积域闸 / field and area domain gate
    _nTypeUse := nDefectType; // 类型号直通 / the type number passes through
    IF _nTypeUse < DL_SEI_TYPE_MIN THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
        _nTypeUse := DL_SEI_TYPE_MIN; // 回钳到 1 / clamp to one
        _bTypeClamped := TRUE; // 置回钳标志 / raise the clamp flag
    ELSIF _nTypeUse > DL_SEI_TYPE_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
        _nTypeUse := DL_SEI_TYPE_MAX; // 回钳到 8 / clamp to eight
        _bTypeClamped := TRUE; // 置回钳标志 / raise the clamp flag
    END_IF
    IF NOT _bInOk THEN // 数据非有限 / data non-finite
        _eCause := E_DL_SeiCause.eInputBad; // 信息级成因：未归档 / informational cause, not archived
    ELSIF NOT _bInField THEN // 坐标或面积越域 / coordinate or area out of domain
        _eCause := E_DL_SeiCause.eOutField; // 信息级成因：越界未归档 / informational cause, out of field
        IF nOutFieldCnt < DL_SEI_COUNT_MAX THEN // 未达计数上限 / below the count ceiling
            nOutFieldCnt := nOutFieldCnt + 1; // 越界计数递增 / increment the out of field count
        END_IF
    ELSE
        // 段 5.1｜环窗写入：先算槽位再写入，槽位经回钳 1..64 / segment 5.1, ring write with the slot clamped one through sixty four
        _nIdx := _nIdx + 1; // 槽位前移 / advance the slot
        IF _nIdx > DL_SEI_BUF_MAX THEN // 越过上界 / past the upper bound
            _nIdx := 1; // 回钳到一号槽 / clamp back to slot one
        END_IF
        _afX[_nIdx] := fPosXmm; // 横坐标归档 / archive the abscissa
        _afY[_nIdx] := fPosYmm; // 纵坐标归档 / archive the ordinate
        _afSz[_nIdx] := fSizeMm2; // 面积归档 / archive the area
        _anType[_nIdx] := _nTypeUse; // 类型归档 / archive the type
        IF nBufCount < DL_SEI_BUF_MAX THEN // 环窗未满 / the ring is not yet full
            nBufCount := nBufCount + 1; // 占用递增 / increment the occupancy
        END_IF
        IF uArchiveCnt < 2000000000 THEN // 累计计数未达保护上限（常量在 DINT 可表范围内）/ the total count is below the guard ceiling, the constant fits in DINT
            uArchiveCnt := uArchiveCnt + 1; // 累计归档数递增 / increment the total archived count
        END_IF
        fLastXmm := fPosXmm; // 最近横坐标出口 / last abscissa outlet
        fLastYmm := fPosYmm; // 最近纵坐标出口 / last ordinate outlet
        fLastSizeMm2 := fSizeMm2; // 最近面积出口 / last area outlet
        nLastType := _nTypeUse; // 最近类型出口 / last type outlet
        // 段 5.2｜当前批统计累加 / segment 5.2, accumulate the current batch statistics
        IF _stCur.nCount < DL_SEI_COUNT_MAX THEN // 未达条数上限 / below the count ceiling
            _stCur.nCount := _stCur.nCount + 1; // 条数递增 / increment the count
        END_IF
        _stCur.fSumSize := _stCur.fSumSize + fSizeMm2; // 面积累计 / accumulate the area
        IF fSizeMm2 > _stCur.fMaxSize THEN // 面积最大值刷新 / refresh the maximum area
            _stCur.fMaxSize := fSizeMm2; // 更新最大值 / update the maximum
        END_IF
        _wTypeBit := SHL(DL_SEI_MASK_ONE, _nTypeUse - 1); // 类型位掩码，位移量 0..7 由类型回钳证明 / type bit mask, the shift zero through seven is proven by the type clamp
        _stCur.wTypeMask := _stCur.wTypeMask OR _wTypeBit; // 类型掩码置位 / set the type bit
        IF _bTypeClamped THEN // 类型被回钳 / the type was clamped
            _eCause := E_DL_SeiCause.eTypeBad; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 6｜批次比对：双向带容差比较，参照批缺陷数为零时判通过 / segment 6, batch comparison with a two sided tolerance
_fCurMaxB := _stCur.fMaxSize; // 当前批最大面积 / the current maximum area
_fCurCntB := INT_TO_REAL(_stCur.nCount); // 当前批条数实数化 / the current count as a real
_fPrevMaxB := _stPrev.fMaxSize; // 上批最大面积 / the previous maximum area
_fPrevCntB := INT_TO_REAL(_stPrev.nCount); // 上批条数实数化 / the previous count as a real
IF (_fPrevMaxB > 0.0) THEN // 有参照批 / a reference batch exists
    _fDeltaPct := (_fCurMaxB - _fPrevMaxB) / _fPrevMaxB * 100.0; // 最大面积相对变化，除子已证大于零 / relative change of the maximum area, divisor proven positive
    bComparePass := (_fCurMaxB <= _fPrevMaxB * (1.0 + fTolPct / 100.0)) AND (_fPrevCntB <= 0.0 OR (_fCurCntB <= _fPrevCntB * (1.0 + fTolPct / 100.0))); // 数与面积双向比较，条数基线为零时只比面积 / the count and area are both compared, with a zero count baseline only the area is compared
ELSE // 无参照批 / no reference batch
    _fDeltaPct := 0.0; // 相对变化记零 / the relative change is zeroed
    bComparePass := TRUE; // 无参照按通过处理（不误判不合格）/ no reference passes so nothing is falsely rejected
END_IF

// 段 7｜统一出口 / segment 7, unified outlet
nCurCount := _stCur.nCount; // 当前批条数出口 / current count outlet
fCurMaxMm2 := _stCur.fMaxSize; // 当前批最大面积出口 / current maximum area outlet
_fMean := 0.0; // 均值预置零 / preset the mean to zero
IF _stCur.nCount > 0 THEN // 有条数才可算均值 / the mean needs at least one piece
    _fMean := _stCur.fSumSize / INT_TO_REAL(_stCur.nCount); // 均值，除子已证大于零 / mean, divisor proven positive
END_IF
fCurMeanMm2 := _fMean; // 当前批均值出口 / current mean outlet
nPrevCount := _stPrev.nCount; // 上批条数出口 / previous count outlet
fPrevMaxMm2 := _stPrev.fMaxSize; // 上批最大面积出口 / previous maximum area outlet
fDeltaMaxPct := _fDeltaPct; // 相对变化出口 / relative change outlet
wTypeMask := _stCur.wTypeMask; // 类型掩码出口 / type mask outlet
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eCause := _eFaultCause; // 故障级成因锁存回放 / the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSE
    eCause := _eCause; // 信息级成因直映 / the informational cause is mapped directly
END_IF
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 洁净室 AMC（气态分子污染）在线监测需要按采样周期统计分级：对各污染通道浓度做滑窗均值与峰值统计，按组态阈值分清洁/注意/超标三级并带迟滞防抖动，传感器非有限按失效单列不污染统计，窗深与阈值可组态且越界钳位，分级结果变化置事件沿供记录，复位分清统计与分级两级。
architecture_thought: 滑窗统计与三级分级架构：段 0 无条件刷新采样沿与窗推进；段 1 各通道浓度写环形窗并维护均值与峰值（非有限样本拒收单列失效计数），按组态阈值分清洁/注意/超标三级并带迟滞防抖；阈值与窗深越界钳位；分级变化置事件沿供记录；复位分清统计与分级两级；出口含均值/峰值数组、三级标志、失效计数与事件沿，CASE 含 ELSE 兜底。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_AmcMonitorStat
  分类   Category   : DL_Process
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : AMC 污染在线统计分级。在周期采样窗内累计气态分子污染浓度
                      （单位 ppb）的样本数、均值、峰值与超阈比例，窗末按三级阈
                      （A / B / C）把均值定级为 A / B / C / D 四档，C 档及以下
                      置报警；同时给出本窗超阈样本比例与连续超阈窗计数。
  溯源   Origin     : AMC 分级统计为洁净室污染监控的通用口径；本件为 clean-room
                      实现，仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签 roadmap-p2-amc），
                      道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（TON / REAL 运算，无私有库、无方言转换）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只做统计分级与报警，不控制新风阀、不驱动净化设备（属主边界）；
                      二 采样窗由自复位周期 TON 驱动，窗末结算并清零累加器；
                      三 非有限浓度样本不参与统计，只累加坏样本计数（信息级，不置故障）；
                      四 三级阈必须严格递增，否则判组态故障并锁存至复位沿；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      eClass 四档互斥，仅在窗末结算拍更新（锁存至下一窗末）；
                      bAlarm 在 C 档及以下（含 D 档）为真，挂状态量不挂单拍标志；
                      fMeanPpb / fMaxPpb / fExceedPct 为上一完整窗的结算值；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。

    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 3 · 序号 13）
