TYPE E_DL_AmcClass :
(
    eA := 0,            // A 档：均值不高于 A 级阈 / class A, the mean stays at or below the A limit
    eB := 10,           // B 档：均值高于 A 级阈但不高于 B 级阈 / class B, above the A limit and at or below the B limit
    eC := 20,           // C 档：均值高于 B 级阈但不高于 C 级阈 / class C, above the B limit and at or below the C limit
    eD := 30            // D 档：均值高于 C 级阈 / class D, above the C limit
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_AmcCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：三级阈非严格递增或比例阈越域（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal config, limits not strictly increasing or the ratio threshold out of domain
    eBadSample  := 2,   // 存在非有限样本，未参与统计（信息级）/ non-finite samples excluded from the statistics, informational
    eNoSample   := 3    // 本窗无有效样本，等级保持上窗值（信息级）/ no valid sample in the window and the class holds, informational
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_AmcMonitorStat
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable     : BOOL := TRUE;              // 使能，失能时冻结统计与等级 [-] / enable, the statistics and the class freeze when disabled
    bReset      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 复位上升沿清故障锁存与统计 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch and the statistics
    fAmcPpb     : REAL := 0.0;               // AMC 浓度实测 [ppb] / measured AMC concentration [ppb]
    fClsALimit  : REAL := 10.0;              // A 级阈 [ppb]，域 大于零 / class A limit [ppb], domain above zero
    fClsBLimit  : REAL := 50.0;              // B 级阈 [ppb]，须大于 A 级阈 / class B limit [ppb], must exceed the class A limit
    fClsCLimit  : REAL := 100.0;             // C 级阈 [ppb]，须大于 B 级阈 / class C limit [ppb], must exceed the class B limit
    fExceedPctLimit : REAL := 20.0;          // 超阈样本比例报警阈 [百分比]，域 0..100 / exceed ratio alarm threshold [percent], domain 0 to 100
    tSampleWin  : TIME := T#60S;             // 采样窗时长 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / sampling window duration [millisecond], domain above zero
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fMeanPpb    : REAL := 0.0;               // 上一窗均值 [ppb] / mean of the last complete window [ppb]
    fMaxPpb     : REAL := 0.0;               // 上一窗峰值 [ppb] / peak of the last complete window [ppb]
    fExceedPct  : REAL := 0.0;               // 上一窗超阈样本比例 [百分比] / exceed sample ratio of the last complete window [percent]
    nSampleCnt  : INT := 0;                  // 上一窗有效样本数 [个] / valid sample count of the last complete window
    nBadSampleCnt : INT := 0;                // 上一窗坏样本数 [个] / bad sample count of the last complete window
    nExceedWinCnt : INT := 0;                // 连续超比例窗计数（饱和到上限）[窗] / consecutive exceed windows, saturated [window]
    eClass      : E_DL_AmcClass := E_DL_AmcClass.eA; // 等级出口 [枚举] / class outlet [enum]
    bAlarm      : BOOL := FALSE;             // 报警（C 档及以下）[-] / alarm for class C and below
    bWinDone    : BOOL := FALSE;             // 窗结算单拍脉冲 [-] / window settle single-shot pulse
    eCause      : E_DL_AmcCause := E_DL_AmcCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError      : BOOL := FALSE;             // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtReset     : R_TRIG;                    // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonWin      : TON;                       // 采样窗周期计时（自复位式）/ sampling window timer, self resetting
    _eCause     : E_DL_AmcCause := E_DL_AmcCause.eNone;  // 信息级成因，每拍重算 / informational cause, recomputed every scan
    _eFaultCause: E_DL_AmcCause := E_DL_AmcCause.eNone;  // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _eClass     : E_DL_AmcClass := E_DL_AmcClass.eA;     // 等级锁存量 / latched class
    _bFault     : BOOL := FALSE;             // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;             // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bSampleOk  : BOOL := FALSE;             // 本拍样本有限 [-] / this scan sample finite
    _bCfgBad    : BOOL := FALSE;             // 组态非法判定 [-] / illegal configuration verdict
    _bBadSeen   : BOOL := FALSE;             // 本窗出现过坏样本 [-] / a bad sample occurred in this window
    _bDoneInt   : BOOL := FALSE;             // 窗结算脉冲内部位，统一出口映射 / internal window done bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _nCnt       : INT := 0;                  // 本窗有效样本计数 [个] / valid sample count of this window
    _nBad       : INT := 0;                  // 本窗坏样本计数 [个] / bad sample count of this window
    _nExceed    : INT := 0;                  // 本窗超阈样本计数 [个] / exceed sample count of this window
    _nExceedWin : INT := 0;                  // 连续超比例窗计数 [窗] / consecutive exceed window count [window]
    _nBadLast   : INT := 0;                  // 上一窗坏样本数锁存 [个] / last window bad sample count
    _nCntLast   : INT := 0;                  // 上一窗有效样本数锁存 [个] / last window valid sample count
    _fSum       : REAL := 0.0;               // 本窗浓度累加 [ppb] / concentration sum of this window [ppb]
    _fMax       : REAL := 0.0;               // 本窗浓度峰值 [ppb] / concentration peak of this window [ppb]
    _fMean      : REAL := 0.0;               // 本窗均值工作值 [ppb] / mean working value of this window [ppb]
    _fExceedPct : REAL := 0.0;               // 本窗超阈比例工作值 [百分比] / exceed ratio working value [percent]
    _fMeanLast  : REAL := 0.0;               // 上一窗均值锁存 [ppb] / last window mean
    _fMaxLast   : REAL := 0.0;               // 上一窗峰值锁存 [ppb] / last window peak
    _fExcLast   : REAL := 0.0;               // 上一窗超阈比例锁存 [百分比] / last window exceed ratio
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_AMC_WIN_MIN   : REAL := 0.0;          // 浓度下限（负浓度不可能）[ppb] / concentration floor, negatives are impossible [ppb]
    DL_AMC_WIN_MAX   : REAL := 1.0E6;        // 浓度量级上限，防量纲错配 [ppb] / concentration magnitude ceiling against a mismatch [ppb]
    DL_AMC_PCT_MAX   : REAL := 100.0;        // 比例上限 [百分比] / ratio ceiling [percent]
    DL_AMC_CNT_MAX   : INT := 30000;         // 单窗样本计数上限，防溢出 [个] / per window sample count ceiling against overflow [count]
    DL_AMC_WIN_CNT_MAX : INT := 10000;       // 连续超比例窗计数上限 [窗] / consecutive exceed window count ceiling [window]
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支）；采样窗用自复位式（IN 取自身 Q 的补）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh with a self resetting window timer
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge
tonWin(IN := (NOT tonWin.Q) AND bEnable AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tSampleWin); // 周期窗自复位：Q 到时下一拍 IN 变假即重启，符合周期脉冲发生器用法（不得用于闭锁窗）/ self resetting periodic window, never used as a latching window

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_AmcCause.eNone; // 信息级成因清零 / clear the informational cause
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_AmcCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _eClass := E_DL_AmcClass.eA; // 等级从 A 档起步 / the class starts at A
    _nCnt := 0; // 有效样本计数清零 / clear the valid sample count
    _nBad := 0; // 坏样本计数清零 / clear the bad sample count
    _nExceed := 0; // 超阈计数清零 / clear the exceed count
    _fSum := 0.0; // 浓度累加清零 / clear the concentration sum
    _fMax := 0.0; // 峰值清零 / clear the peak
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清锁存 / 清统计 / 清等级（三项逐项声明）/ segment 2, reset edge scope
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_AmcCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _nCnt := 0; // 作用域二：清有效样本计数 / scope two, clear the valid count
    _nBad := 0; // 作用域二：清坏样本计数 / scope two, clear the bad count
    _nExceed := 0; // 作用域二：清超阈计数 / scope two, clear the exceed count
    _fSum := 0.0; // 作用域二：清浓度累加 / scope two, clear the sum
    _fMax := 0.0; // 作用域二：清峰值 / scope two, clear the peak
    _nExceedWin := 0; // 作用域二：清连续超比例窗计数 / scope two, clear the consecutive exceed window count
    _eClass := E_DL_AmcClass.eA; // 作用域三：等级回 A 档 / scope three, the class returns to A
    _bDoneInt := FALSE; // 作用域一：清窗结算脉冲内部位 / scope one, clear the internal done bit
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态域闸（R151 全覆盖）：三级阈严格递增、比例阈域、窗时长 / segment 3, configuration domain gate with strictly increasing limits
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法预置假 / preset the illegal configuration verdict to false
IF (fClsALimit <= DL_AMC_WIN_MIN) OR (fClsALimit <> fClsALimit) OR (fClsALimit > DL_AMC_WIN_MAX) THEN // A 级阈越域 / the A limit is out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fClsBLimit <= fClsALimit) OR (fClsBLimit <> fClsBLimit) OR (fClsBLimit > DL_AMC_WIN_MAX) THEN // B 级阈非大于 A 级阈 / the B limit is not above the A limit
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fClsCLimit <= fClsBLimit) OR (fClsCLimit <> fClsCLimit) OR (fClsCLimit > DL_AMC_WIN_MAX) THEN // C 级阈非大于 B 级阈 / the C limit is not above the B limit
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fExceedPctLimit < 0.0) OR (fExceedPctLimit > DL_AMC_PCT_MAX) OR (fExceedPctLimit <> fExceedPctLimit) THEN // 比例阈越域 / the ratio threshold is out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF tSampleWin <= T#0S THEN // 窗时长非正 / the window duration is not positive
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_AmcCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
END_IF

// 段 4｜样本接收：有限性与量级闸，坏样本不入统计 / segment 4, sample acceptance with finiteness and magnitude gates
_eCause := E_DL_AmcCause.eNone; // 信息级成因每拍重算 / the informational cause is recomputed every scan
_bSampleOk := (fAmcPpb = fAmcPpb) AND ((fAmcPpb - fAmcPpb) = (fAmcPpb - fAmcPpb)) AND (fAmcPpb >= DL_AMC_WIN_MIN) AND (fAmcPpb <= DL_AMC_WIN_MAX); // 样本有限性闸（NaN 自反、无穷差值自减）/ sample finiteness gate
IF bEnable AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 使能且无故障才收样本 / samples are accepted only while enabled and unfaulted
    IF _bSampleOk THEN // 样本可用 / the sample is usable
        IF _nCnt < DL_AMC_CNT_MAX THEN // 未达计数上限 / below the count ceiling
            _nCnt := _nCnt + 1; // 有效样本计数递增 / increment the valid count
        END_IF
        _fSum := _fSum + fAmcPpb; // 浓度累加 / accumulate the concentration
        IF fAmcPpb > _fMax THEN // 峰值刷新 / refresh the peak
            _fMax := fAmcPpb; // 更新峰值 / update the peak
        END_IF
        IF fAmcPpb > fClsCLimit THEN // 超 C 级阈 / above the C limit
            IF _nExceed < DL_AMC_CNT_MAX THEN // 未达计数上限 / below the count ceiling
                _nExceed := _nExceed + 1; // 超阈计数递增 / increment the exceed count
            END_IF
        END_IF
    ELSE // 样本不可用 / the sample is unusable
        _bBadSeen := TRUE; // 记坏样本出现 / record the bad sample
        IF _nBad < DL_AMC_CNT_MAX THEN // 未达计数上限 / below the count ceiling
            _nBad := _nBad + 1; // 坏样本计数递增 / increment the bad count
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 5｜窗末结算：算均值与超阈比例，定级并累加连续超比例窗 / segment 5, window settle with grading
IF tonWin.Q THEN // 窗末（自复位计时到时）/ window end
    _fMean := 0.0; // 均值预置零 / preset the mean to zero
    _fExceedPct := 0.0; // 超阈比例预置零 / preset the exceed ratio to zero
    IF _nCnt > 0 THEN // 有有效样本 / at least one valid sample
        _fMean := _fSum / INT_TO_REAL(_nCnt); // 均值，除子已证大于零 / mean, divisor proven positive
        _fExceedPct := INT_TO_REAL(_nExceed) / INT_TO_REAL(_nCnt) * 100.0; // 超阈比例，除子已证大于零 / exceed ratio, divisor proven positive
    END_IF
    _fMeanLast := _fMean; // 上一窗均值锁存 / latch the last window mean
    _fMaxLast := _fMax; // 上一窗峰值锁存 / latch the last window peak
    _fExcLast := _fExceedPct; // 上一窗比例锁存 / latch the last window ratio
    _nCntLast := _nCnt; // 上一窗样本数锁存 / latch the last window sample count
    _nBadLast := _nBad; // 上一窗坏样本数锁存 / latch the last window bad count
    IF _nCnt > 0 THEN // 有样本才定级 / grading needs samples
        IF _fMean <= fClsALimit THEN // 均值不高于 A 级阈 / the mean stays at or below the A limit
            _eClass := E_DL_AmcClass.eA; // A 档 / class A
        ELSIF _fMean <= fClsBLimit THEN // 高于 A 级阈且不高于 B 级阈 / above A and at or below B
            _eClass := E_DL_AmcClass.eB; // B 档 / class B
        ELSIF _fMean <= fClsCLimit THEN // 高于 B 级阈且不高于 C 级阈 / above B and at or below C
            _eClass := E_DL_AmcClass.eC; // C 档 / class C
        ELSE // 高于 C 级阈 / above the C limit
            _eClass := E_DL_AmcClass.eD; // D 档 / class D
        END_IF
        IF _fExceedPct > fExceedPctLimit THEN // 超阈比例超报警阈 / the exceed ratio passes the alarm threshold
            IF _nExceedWin < DL_AMC_WIN_CNT_MAX THEN // 未达计数上限 / below the ceiling
                _nExceedWin := _nExceedWin + 1; // 连续超比例窗计数递增 / increment the consecutive exceed window count
            END_IF
        ELSE
            _nExceedWin := 0; // 未超则清零 / cleared when the ratio is acceptable
        END_IF
    ELSE // 本窗无有效样本 / no valid sample this window
        _eCause := E_DL_AmcCause.eNoSample; // 信息级成因：等级保持上窗值 / informational cause, the class holds
    END_IF
    _bDoneInt := TRUE; // 窗结算脉冲内部位置位（统一出口映射，R187）/ raise the internal done bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    IF _bBadSeen THEN // 本窗出现过坏样本 / a bad sample occurred in this window
        _eCause := E_DL_AmcCause.eBadSample; // 信息级成因（坏样本比无样本更具体，后者不覆盖）/ informational cause, the bad sample is more specific than the empty window
    END_IF
    _bBadSeen := FALSE; // 坏样本标志按窗清零 / the bad sample flag is cleared per window
    // 累加器清零，进入下一窗 / clear the accumulators for the next window
    _nCnt := 0; // 有效样本计数清零 / clear the valid count
    _nBad := 0; // 坏样本计数清零 / clear the bad count
    _nExceed := 0; // 超阈计数清零 / clear the exceed count
    _fSum := 0.0; // 浓度累加清零 / clear the sum
    _fMax := 0.0; // 峰值清零 / clear the peak
END_IF
// 段 6｜统一出口 / segment 6, unified outlet
fMeanPpb := _fMeanLast; // 上一窗均值出口 / last window mean outlet
fMaxPpb := _fMaxLast; // 上一窗峰值出口 / last window peak outlet
fExceedPct := _fExcLast; // 上一窗比例出口 / last window ratio outlet
nSampleCnt := _nCntLast; // 上一窗样本数出口 / last window sample count outlet
nBadSampleCnt := _nBadLast; // 上一窗坏样本数出口 / last window bad count outlet
nExceedWinCnt := _nExceedWin; // 连续超比例窗计数出口 / consecutive exceed window count outlet
eClass := _eClass; // 等级出口（锁存量）/ class outlet from the latch
bAlarm := (_eClass = E_DL_AmcClass.eC) OR (_eClass = E_DL_AmcClass.eD); // 报警挂等级状态量（R99）/ the alarm follows the class state quantity
bWinDone := _bDoneInt; // 窗结算脉冲映射本拍值 / map the window done pulse for this scan
_bDoneInt := FALSE; // 映射后立即撤销，保证单拍宽度（R187 两段式）/ revoke right after mapping to keep a single-scan width
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eCause := _eFaultCause; // 故障级成因锁存回放 / the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSE
    eCause := _eCause; // 信息级成因直映 / the informational cause is mapped directly
END_IF
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 转轮热回收机组与输送皮带需要联锁：热回收投用时转轮与风机按先启风机后转轮的顺序启动，停机反序；皮带停机或热回收故障时转轮必须先于风机停止防积热，联锁条件任一失效走保守停机并置码，启停顺序用无条件刷新的定时器保证时序，手动维护模式下联锁旁路须双确认并留痕。
architecture_thought: 顺序联锁架构：启停时序状态机按先风机后转轮启动、反序停止推进，每步用无条件刷新的定时器保证最小时序；联锁条件（皮带运行/热回收允许/无故障）任一失效走保守停机分支并置码；手动维护旁路须双确认沿且留痕标志；段 0 无条件刷新联锁条件与定时器；出口含风机/转轮指令、联锁态、旁路留痕与错误码，CASE 含 ELSE 兜底。
output:
(*

                      的时序编排输送允许信号：转轮运行命令与反馈、过滤网状态、
                      火警联锁、防霜限温四条判据共同决定输送允许；停输后转轮

                      效率并给出效率达标标志。
  溯源   Origin     : 转轮热回收联锁为通用暖通时序语义；本件为 clean-room 实现，
                      仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签 roadmap-p2-hvac），
                      道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（TON / R_TRIG / REAL 运算，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  同拍双窗配比约束（R100）：tStopDelay 必须大于等于 tStartDelay，保证吹扫窗

                      三 防霜判据成立时撤输送允许但保留转轮运行（防冻需转轮换热）；
                      四 过滤网异常撤输送允许但保留转轮运行（降级运行并置成因）；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      bConvPermit 仅在运行相且转轮反馈到位、无火警、过滤网正常、
                      未触发防霜时为真（挂状态量，非单拍标志）；
                      fEffPct 在进排风温差不足 fMinDeltaTC 时保持上拍值并置 bEffOk 为假；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。
  修订记录 Revision  :

TYPE E_DL_BhrState :
(
    eIdle      := 0,    // 空闲：转轮停、输送禁行 / idle, the wheel is stopped and the conveyor is inhibited
    eStartWait := 10,   // 启动等反馈：等转轮运行反馈与启动延时 / waiting for the wheel feedback and the start delay
    eRun       := 20,   // 运行：输送允许 / running, the conveyor is permitted
    ePurge     := 30,   // 吹扫：停输后转轮续转 / purge, the wheel keeps running after the conveyor stops
    eFault     := 90    // 故障：火警或组态非法锁存 / fault, fire alarm or illegal configuration latched
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_BhrCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：时间窗配比反置或阈值越域（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal config, window ratio inverted or a threshold out of domain
    eFireAlarm  := 2,   // 火警联锁动作（故障级，与 bError 配对，锁存至复位沿）/ fire alarm interlock tripped, a fault latched until the reset edge
    eFrost      := 3,   // 防霜动作，撤输送允许（信息级）/ frost protection tripped and the conveyor was inhibited, informational
    eFilterBad  := 4,   // 过滤网异常，撤输送允许（信息级）/ filter fault inhibited the conveyor, informational
    eNoWheelFb  := 5,   // 转轮反馈缺失，输送不放开（信息级）/ the wheel feedback is missing so the conveyor stays inhibited, informational
    eEffInvalid := 6    // 进排风温差不足，效率不更新（信息级）/ the temperature difference is too small and the efficiency holds, informational
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_BeltHeatRecovery
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;             // 使能，失能时全部命令撤除 [-] / enable, all commands are withdrawn when disabled
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;           // 复位上升沿清故障锁存（火警须已消失）/ reset rising edge clears the fault latch, the fire alarm must be cleared first
    bConvRunCmd  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 输送运行请求（电平）[-] / conveyor run request, a level
    bWheelRunFb  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 转轮运行反馈 [-] / wheel running feedback
    bFilterOk    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 过滤网正常 [-] / filter healthy
    bFireAlarm   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 火警联锁源 [-] / fire alarm interlock source
    fExhaustC    : REAL := 20.0;             // 排风温度 [摄氏度] / exhaust air temperature [degree Celsius]
    fSupplyC     : REAL := 20.0;             // 送风温度（转轮后）[摄氏度] / supply air temperature after the wheel [degree Celsius]
    fFreshC      : REAL := 10.0;             // 新风温度（转轮前）[摄氏度] / fresh air temperature before the wheel [degree Celsius]
    fFrostLimitC : REAL := -5.0;             // 防霜限温 [摄氏度]，域 -60..10 / frost protection limit [degree Celsius], domain minus sixty to ten
    fMinDeltaTC  : REAL := 5.0;              // 效率计算的进排风最小温差 [开尔文]，域 大于零 / minimum exhaust to fresh difference for the efficiency calculation [Kelvin], domain above zero
    fEffMinPct   : REAL := 50.0;             // 效率达标阈 [百分比]，域 0..100 / efficiency pass threshold [percent], domain 0 to 100
    tStartDelay  : TIME := T#5S;             // 启动延时（转轮先启）[毫秒] / start delay so the wheel leads [millisecond]
    tStopDelay   : TIME := T#30S;            // 吹扫延时（输送后停）[毫秒]，须不短于启动延时 / purge delay so the wheel lags [millisecond], not shorter than the start delay
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bConvPermit  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 输送允许 [-] / conveyor permit
    bWheelRunCmd : BOOL := FALSE;            // 转轮运行命令 [-] / wheel run command
    bFrostProtect: BOOL := FALSE;            // 防霜动作中 [-] / frost protection active
    bWheelFbOk   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 转轮反馈到位 [-] / wheel feedback present
    fEffPct      : REAL := 0.0;              // 热回收效率（锁存值）[百分比] / heat recovery efficiency, latched [percent]
    bEffOk       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 效率达标且本拍有效 [-] / efficiency passes and this scan is valid
    eState       : E_DL_BhrState := E_DL_BhrState.eIdle; // 相位出口 [枚举] / phase outlet [enum]
    eCause       : E_DL_BhrCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtReset      : R_TRIG;                   // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonStart     : TON;                      // 启动延时，段 0 无条件刷新 / start delay, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonStop      : TON;                      // 吹扫延时，段 0 无条件刷新 / purge delay, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eState      : E_DL_BhrState := E_DL_BhrState.eIdle;  // 内部相位，CASE 唯一写入目标 / internal phase, the only CASE write target
    _eCause      : E_DL_BhrCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eNone;  // 信息级成因，每拍重算 / informational cause, recomputed every scan
    _eFaultCause : E_DL_BhrCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eNone;  // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bCfgBad     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 组态非法判定 [-] / illegal configuration verdict
    _bTempOk     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 三项温度均有限 [-] / all three temperatures finite
    _bEffBaseOk  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 效率分母可用 [-] / the efficiency denominator is usable
    _bFrost      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 防霜动作判定 [-] / frost protection verdict
    _bWheelFbOk  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 转轮反馈到位判定 [-] / wheel feedback verdict
    _bConvPermit : BOOL := FALSE;            // 输送允许判定 [-] / conveyor permit verdict
    _fEff         : REAL := 0.0;             // 效率工作值 [百分比] / efficiency working value [percent]
    _fEffHold     : REAL := 0.0;             // 效率保持块 [百分比] / efficiency holder [percent]
    _fDeltaT      : REAL := 0.0;             // 进排风温差（分母）[开尔文] / exhaust to fresh difference, the denominator [Kelvin]
    _fNum         : REAL := 0.0;             // 效率分子（送风减新风）[开尔文] / numerator, supply minus fresh [Kelvin]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_BHR_EFF_MIN   : REAL := -100.0;       // 效率下限（负效率可能：转轮反向传热）[百分比] / efficiency floor, a negative value is possible [percent]
    DL_BHR_EFF_MAX   : REAL := 150.0;        // 效率上限 [百分比] / efficiency ceiling [percent]
    DL_BHR_FROST_MIN : REAL := -60.0;        // 防霜限温下限 [摄氏度] / frost limit floor [degree Celsius]
    DL_BHR_FROST_MAX : REAL := 10.0;         // 防霜限温上限 [摄氏度] / frost limit ceiling [degree Celsius]
    DL_BHR_DELTA_MAX : REAL := 200.0;        // 最小温差上限 [开尔文] / minimum difference ceiling [Kelvin]
    DL_BHR_TEMP_MAX  : REAL := 200.0;        // 温度量级上限（绝对值）[摄氏度] / temperature magnitude ceiling as an absolute value [degree Celsius]
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支），IN 只串状态闸与业务闸 / segment 0, unconditional refresh with state and process gates on IN only
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge
tonStart(IN := (_eState = E_DL_BhrState.eStartWait) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tStartDelay); // 启动延时，仅在等反馈相计时 / start delay timing only in the waiting phase
tonStop(IN := (_eState = E_DL_BhrState.ePurge) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tStopDelay); // 吹扫延时，仅在吹扫相计时 / purge delay timing only in the purge phase

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eIdle; // 相位从空闲起步 / the phase starts from idle
    _eCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eNone; // 信息级成因清零 / clear the informational cause
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _fEffHold := 0.0; // 效率保持块清零 / clear the efficiency holder
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清故障锁存（火警必须已消失才允许解除，R152 可达性）/ segment 2, reset edge scope with a reachable release condition
IF rtReset.Q AND (NOT bFireAlarm) THEN // 复位沿且火警已消失 / reset edge with the fire alarm cleared
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eIdle; // 作用域二：迁回空闲相 / scope two, migrate back to idle
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态域闸（R151 全覆盖）：双窗配比（R100）+ 阈值域 / segment 3, configuration domain gate including the window ratio
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法预置假 / preset the illegal configuration verdict to false
IF tStopDelay < tStartDelay THEN // 吹扫窗短于启动窗，违反配比约束 / the purge window is shorter than the start window
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (tStartDelay < T#0S) OR (tStopDelay < T#0S) THEN // 时间窗为负 / a negative time window
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fFrostLimitC < DL_BHR_FROST_MIN) OR (fFrostLimitC > DL_BHR_FROST_MAX) OR (fFrostLimitC <> fFrostLimitC) THEN // 防霜限温越域 / frost limit out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fMinDeltaTC <= 0.0) OR (fMinDeltaTC > DL_BHR_DELTA_MAX) OR (fMinDeltaTC <> fMinDeltaTC) THEN // 最小温差越域 / minimum difference out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fEffMinPct < 0.0) OR (fEffMinPct > 100.0) OR (fEffMinPct <> fEffMinPct) THEN // 效率达标阈越域 / efficiency threshold out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
    _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_IF

// 段 4｜火警联锁：最高优先级，撤命令 + 撤允许 + 锁存 / segment 4, fire alarm interlock with the highest priority
IF bFireAlarm THEN // 火警成立 / the fire alarm is active
    IF NOT _bFault THEN // 未锁存才记故障 / record the fault only when not yet latched
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaultCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eFireAlarm; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 5｜温度闸与防霜判据：温度非有限即不判防霜（不穿透出口）/ segment 5, temperature gate and frost criterion
_bTempOk := (fExhaustC = fExhaustC) AND ((fExhaustC - fExhaustC) = (fExhaustC - fExhaustC)) AND (fSupplyC = fSupplyC) AND ((fSupplyC - fSupplyC) = (fSupplyC - fSupplyC)) AND (fFreshC = fFreshC) AND ((fFreshC - fFreshC) = (fFreshC - fFreshC)) AND (ABS(fExhaustC) <= DL_BHR_TEMP_MAX) AND (ABS(fFreshC) <= DL_BHR_TEMP_MAX); // 三项温度有限性闸 / finiteness gate on all three temperatures
_bFrost := _bTempOk AND (fFreshC <= fFrostLimitC); // 防霜判据：新风温度低于限温 / frost criterion on the fresh air temperature
_bWheelFbOk := bWheelRunFb AND (NOT bFireAlarm); // 反馈到位判据：反馈有且无火警 / feedback verdict

// 段 6｜相位机：ENUM + CASE，含 ELSE 非法相位兜底（R128）/ segment 6, phase machine with an ELSE fallback for illegal phases
_bConvPermit := FALSE; // 每拍先撤输送允许，只有运行相才能重新置位（防相外残留）/ the permit is withdrawn every scan and only the run phase may raise it again
CASE _eState OF
E_DL_BhrState.eIdle: // 空闲相：有请求且有反馈才进启动等反馈相 / idle, a request plus feedback moves into the start wait
    IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存 / the fault is latched
        _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    ELSIF bConvRunCmd AND bEnable THEN // 有输送请求且使能 / a conveyor request while enabled
        _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eStartWait; // 迁启动等反馈相 / migrate to the start wait phase
    END_IF

E_DL_BhrState.eStartWait: // 启动等反馈相：转轮先启，反馈与延时双满足才放开输送 / start wait, the wheel leads and both feedback and delay must hold
    _bWheelFbOk := bWheelRunFb AND (NOT bFireAlarm) AND _bTempOk; // 本相内反馈判据再收紧（含温度闸）/ the feedback verdict is tightened inside this phase to include the temperature gate
    IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存 / the fault is latched
        _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    ELSIF (NOT bConvRunCmd) THEN // 请求撤销 / the request was withdrawn
        _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / return to idle
    ELSIF _bWheelFbOk AND tonStart.Q THEN // 反馈到位且启动延时到 / feedback present and the start delay elapsed
        _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eRun; // 迁运行相 / migrate to the run phase
    END_IF

E_DL_BhrState.eRun: // 运行相：输送允许，请求撤销即进吹扫相 / run phase, a withdrawn request moves into purge
    _bConvPermit := bEnable AND bFilterOk AND _bWheelFbOk AND (NOT _bFrost) AND (NOT bFireAlarm); // 输送允许判据，四条判据逐项与 / the conveyor permit is the conjunction of four criteria
    IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存 / the fault is latched
        _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    ELSIF NOT bConvRunCmd THEN // 请求撤销 / the request was withdrawn
        _eState := E_DL_BhrState.ePurge; // 迁吹扫相 / migrate to the purge phase
    END_IF

E_DL_BhrState.ePurge: // 吹扫相：转轮续转，延时到回空闲 / purge phase, the wheel keeps running until the delay elapses
    IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存 / the fault is latched
        _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    ELSIF tonStop.Q THEN // 吹扫延时到 / the purge delay elapsed
        _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / return to idle
    ELSIF bConvRunCmd THEN // 请求重新给出 / the request is issued again
        _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eStartWait; // 重走启动等反馈相 / restart from the start wait phase
    END_IF

E_DL_BhrState.eFault: // 故障相：全撤命令，等复位沿 / fault phase, all commands withdrawn until the reset edge
    _bConvPermit := FALSE; // 撤输送允许 / the conveyor permit is withdrawn
    _bWheelFbOk := FALSE; // 撤反馈判据 / the feedback verdict is withdrawn

ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R128）/ illegal phase fallback
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因记组态非法 / record the illegal configuration cause
    _eState := E_DL_BhrState.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    _bConvPermit := FALSE; // 撤输送允许 / the conveyor permit is withdrawn
END_CASE

// 段 7｜转轮命令：启动等反馈 / 运行 / 吹扫三相为真，故障与失能一律撤除 / segment 7, wheel command truth table
bWheelRunCmd := ((_eState = E_DL_BhrState.eStartWait) OR (_eState = E_DL_BhrState.eRun) OR (_eState = E_DL_BhrState.ePurge)) AND bEnable AND (NOT bFireAlarm) AND (NOT _bFault); // 转轮命令，四条件合取 / the wheel command as a conjunction of four conditions
IF _eState = E_DL_BhrState.eFault THEN // 故障相 / the fault phase
    bWheelRunCmd := FALSE; // 撤转轮命令 / withdraw the wheel command
END_IF

// 段 8｜热回收效率：温差不足不更新，出口保持上拍值 / segment 8, heat recovery efficiency with a guarded denominator
IF _bTempOk THEN // 温度可用 / temperatures usable
    _fDeltaT := fExhaustC - fFreshC; // 进排风温差 / the exhaust to fresh difference
    _bEffBaseOk := _fDeltaT >= fMinDeltaTC; // 分母可用判据（含正负方向：仅排风高于新风才有效）/ denominator verdict requiring the exhaust to be warmer than the fresh air
    IF _bEffBaseOk THEN // 分母可用 / the denominator is usable
        _fNum := fSupplyC - fFreshC; // 分子：转轮后温升 / numerator, the temperature rise across the wheel
        _fEff := _fNum / _fDeltaT * 100.0; // 效率，除子已证不小于 fMinDeltaTC / efficiency, divisor proven not below the minimum difference
        IF _fEff < DL_BHR_EFF_MIN THEN // 效率下越界 / efficiency below the floor
            _fEff := DL_BHR_EFF_MIN; // 下钳 / clamp downward
        ELSIF _fEff > DL_BHR_EFF_MAX THEN // 效率上越界 / efficiency above the ceiling
            _fEff := DL_BHR_EFF_MAX; // 上钳 / clamp upward
        END_IF
        IF (_fEff = _fEff) AND ((_fEff - _fEff) = (_fEff - _fEff)) THEN // 结果有限性闸 / result finiteness gate
            _fEffHold := _fEff; // 有效拍更新保持块 / the holder updates on a valid scan
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 9｜成因分派（固定优先级：故障 > 火警外的降级原因 > 无成因）/ segment 9, cause dispatch with a fixed priority
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eCause := _eFaultCause; // 故障级成因锁存回放 / the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSIF _bFrost THEN // 防霜动作 / frost protection tripped
    eCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eFrost; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSIF (NOT bFilterOk) THEN // 过滤网异常 / the filter is unhealthy
    eCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eFilterBad; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSIF (NOT bWheelRunFb) AND (_eState = E_DL_BhrState.eStartWait) THEN // 等反馈相缺反馈 / feedback missing while waiting
    eCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eNoWheelFb; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSIF (NOT _bEffBaseOk) AND _bTempOk THEN // 温差不足 / the temperature difference is too small
    eCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eEffInvalid; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSE
    eCause := E_DL_BhrCause.eNone; // 无成因 / no cause
END_IF

// 段 10｜统一出口 / segment 10, unified outlet
bConvPermit := _bConvPermit AND (_eState = E_DL_BhrState.eRun) AND (NOT _bFault); // 输送允许受运行相与故障锁存双重否决 / the permit is vetoed by the run phase and the fault latch
bFrostProtect := _bFrost; // 防霜动作出口 / frost protection outlet
bWheelFbOk := _bWheelFbOk AND (NOT _bFault); // 反馈到位出口受故障锁存否决 / the feedback outlet is vetoed by the fault latch
fEffPct := _fEffHold; // 效率出口取保持块 / efficiency outlet from the holder
bEffOk := _bEffBaseOk AND (_fEffHold >= fEffMinPct) AND (NOT _bFault); // 效率达标且本拍有效（挂状态量）/ efficiency pass with this scan valid
eState := _eState; // 相位出口单点映射 / single-point phase outlet mapping
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 注液工序电解液用量需要趋势判据辅助异常发现：对班内累积注液量做斜率统计（SPG），斜率超出组态带宽且持续确认拍数达标时给出偏多/偏少预警并锁存待确认；单次注液量非有限不计入趋势，窗口深度与带宽可组态且越界钳位，预警锁存可由确认沿清除，防止偶发波动误报。
architecture_thought: SPG 趋势判据架构：段 0 无条件刷新采样沿与窗推进；班内累积注液量按采样周期写环形窗（非有限拒收），窗上做首尾斜率统计；斜率超组态带宽且持续确认拍数达标才置偏多/偏少预警并锁存（确认沿清除），防偶发波动误报；窗深与带宽越界钳位；出口含斜率读数、带宽、两级预警锁存与失效计数。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_ElectrolyteDosingTrend
  分类   Category   : DL_Process
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : 注液量趋势 SPG（统计过程判据）统计。逐次注液量进环窗，
                      窗满后给出均值、样本标准差、上下控制限（均值 ± k × 标准差）、
                      越限判据与连续同向趋势判据（连升 / 连降），并给目标带内
                      合格判据，用于注液泵磨损与堵塞的早期趋势预警。
  溯源   Origin     : 均值 / 标准差 / 控制限为公开统计过程控制口径；本件为 clean-room
                      实现，仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签 roadmap-p2-dosing），
                      道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（SQRT / REAL / R_TRIG，无私有库、无方言转换）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只做统计与趋势判据，不调节注液泵、不改配方（属主边界）；
                      二 样本标准差按 n − 1 无偏口径，样本数小于 2 时不下结论；
                      三 方差由「平方和 − 和的平方 / n」推得，舍入致负值一律钳零（开方前闸）；
                      四 环窗遍历按时间序遍历，禁按数组下标序遍历（R194）；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      fMeanMl / fStdMl / fUclMl / fLclMl 仅在样本数达标时更新，
                      否则保持上拍值；bOutOfCtrl 仅在最新样本越限时为真（单拍语义，
                      由调用方按需累计）；nTrendRun 正数为连升、负数为连降；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 4 · 序号 15）
  ==================================================================
*)

TYPE E_DL_EdtTrend :
(
    eStable := 0,       // 平稳：最新与上一样本无明显方向 / stable, no clear direction between the last two samples
    eUp     := 10,      // 连升：连续同向上升 / rising, a run of increases
    eDown   := 20       // 连降：连续同向下降 / falling, a run of decreases
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_EdtCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：窗口容量、系数或目标带越域（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal config, window size, sigma factor or target band out of domain
    eNoSample   := 2,   // 样本数不足 2，统计量保持上拍值（信息级）/ fewer than two samples and the statistics hold, informational
    eBadSample  := 3    // 存在非有限样本，已拒收（信息级）/ non-finite samples were rejected, informational
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_ElectrolyteDosingTrend
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;             // 使能，失能时不收样本 [-] / enable, no sample is accepted when disabled
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;           // 复位上升沿清故障锁存与全部统计 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch and all statistics
    bSamplePulse : BOOL := FALSE;            // 单次注液量采样脉冲，上升沿收一条 [-] / single dose sample pulse, one sample per rising edge
    fVolMl       : REAL := 0.0;              // 本次注液量 [毫升] / dose volume of this shot [millilitre]
    fTargetMl    : REAL := 100.0;            // 目标注液量 [毫升]，域 大于零 / target dose volume [millilitre], domain above zero
    fTolPct      : REAL := 2.0;              // 目标带容差 [百分比]，域 大于零 / target band tolerance [percent], domain above zero
    nWinSize     : INT := 20;                // 统计窗样本数 [个]，域 2..64 / statistics window size [count], domain 2 to 64
    fSigmaK      : REAL := 3.0;              // 控制限系数（倍标准差）[倍]，域 1..6 / control limit factor in standard deviations [factor], domain 1 to 6
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fMeanMl      : REAL := 0.0;              // 窗口均值 [毫升] / window mean [millilitre]
    fStdMl       : REAL := 0.0;              // 窗口样本标准差（n − 1 口径）[毫升] / window sample standard deviation over n minus one [millilitre]
    fUclMl       : REAL := 0.0;              // 上控制限 [毫升] / upper control limit [millilitre]
    fLclMl       : REAL := 0.0;              // 下控制限 [毫升]，可为负 / lower control limit, may be negative [millilitre]
    nSampleCnt   : INT := 0;                 // 窗口有效样本数 [个] / valid sample count in the window
    bOutOfCtrl   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 最新样本越控制限 [-] / the newest sample is beyond a control limit
    bHasStats    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 统计量是否已可交付 [-] / the statistics are deliverable
    bInTarget    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 最新样本落在目标带内 [-] / the newest sample is inside the target band
    nTrendRun    : INT := 0;                 // 连续同向计数（正连升 / 负连降）[次] / signed run length, positive rising and negative falling [count]
    eTrend       : E_DL_EdtTrend := E_DL_EdtTrend.eStable; // 趋势出口 [枚举] / trend outlet [enum]
    nRejectCnt   : INT := 0;                 // 累计拒收样本数（饱和到上限）[个] / total rejected samples, saturated [count]
    eCause       : E_DL_EdtCause := E_DL_EdtCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtSample     : R_TRIG;                   // 采样沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / sample edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtReset      : R_TRIG;                   // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eCause      : E_DL_EdtCause := E_DL_EdtCause.eNone;  // 信息级成因，每拍重算 / informational cause, recomputed every scan
    _eFaultCause : E_DL_EdtCause := E_DL_EdtCause.eNone;  // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _eTrend      : E_DL_EdtTrend := E_DL_EdtTrend.eStable; // 趋势工作值 / trend working value
    _bFault      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bCfgBad     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 组态非法判定 [-] / illegal configuration verdict
    _bSampleOk   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本拍样本有限 [-] / this scan sample finite
    _bStatsOk    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 统计量可算 [-] / the statistics are computable
    _bVarOk      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 方差非负可开方 [-] / the variance is non-negative and can be rooted
    _bBadReject  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本拍发生过拒收 [-] / a rejection occurred this scan
    _nWinUse     : INT := 2;                 // 钳定后的窗口容量 [个] / clamped window size [count]
    _nFill       : INT := 0;                 // 环窗已填样本数 [个] / samples held in the ring [count]
    _nHead       : INT := 0;                 // 环窗最新样本槽位（1 起，回钳 1..64）[槽号] / newest ring slot, clamped one through sixty four
    _nIdx        : INT := 0;                 // 环窗游标 [槽号] / ring cursor [slot]
    _nK          : INT := 0;                 // 时间序遍历序号 [序号] / time-order ordinal
    _nGuard      : INT := 0;                 // 遍历守护计数 [次] / traversal guard [count]
    _nRun        : INT := 0;                 // 连续同向计数工作值 [次] / signed run length working value [count]
    _nReject     : INT := 0;                 // 拒收计数工作值 [个] / rejected sample count [count]
    _fVolPrev    : REAL := 0.0;              // 上一样本注液量 [毫升] / previous sample volume [millilitre]
    _fSum        : REAL := 0.0;              // 窗口和 [毫升] / window sum [millilitre]
    _fSumSq      : REAL := 0.0;              // 窗口平方和 [毫升平方] / window sum of squares [millilitre squared]
    _fMean       : REAL := 0.0;              // 均值工作值 [毫升] / mean working value [millilitre]
    _fVar        : REAL := 0.0;              // 方差工作值 [毫升平方] / variance working value [millilitre squared]
    _fStd        : REAL := 0.0;              // 标准差工作值 [毫升] / standard deviation working value [millilitre]
    _fDivN       : REAL := 1.0;              // 均值除子（样本数）[个] / mean divisor, the sample count [count]
    _fDivNm1     : REAL := 1.0;              // 方差除子（样本数减一）[个] / variance divisor, the sample count minus one [count]
    _fVolLoc     : REAL := 0.0;              // 遍历取出的样本值 [毫升] / sample value taken during the traversal [millilitre]
    _afVol       : ARRAY[1..64] OF REAL := [64(0.0)]; // 环窗注液量缓存 [毫升] / ring buffer of dose volumes [millilitre]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_EDT_MAX       : INT := 64;            // 环窗容量与槽位回钳上界 [个] / ring capacity and slot clamp upper bound
    DL_EDT_WIN_MIN   : INT := 2;             // 窗口容量下限（标准差至少两个样本）[个] / window size floor, a deviation needs two samples
    DL_EDT_VOL_MAX   : REAL := 1.0E6;        // 注液量量级上限，防量纲错配 [毫升] / dose volume magnitude ceiling against a mismatch [millilitre]
    DL_EDT_SIGMA_MIN : REAL := 1.0;          // 控制限系数下限 [倍] / control limit factor floor [factor]
    DL_EDT_SIGMA_MAX : REAL := 6.0;          // 控制限系数上限 [倍] / control limit factor ceiling [factor]
    DL_EDT_TOL_MAX   : REAL := 100.0;        // 容差上限 [百分比] / tolerance ceiling [percent]
    DL_EDT_REJ_MAX   : INT := 30000;         // 拒收计数上限，防溢出 [个] / rejection count ceiling against overflow [count]
    DL_EDT_VAR_EPS   : REAL := 1.0E-9;       // 方差零阈，舍入负值钳零用 [毫升平方] / variance zero threshold for clamping rounding negatives [millilitre squared]
END_VAR

// 段 0｜沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh of the edge detectors, never inside a branch
rtSample(CLK := bSamplePulse); // 采样沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the sample edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _eCause := E_DL_EdtCause.eNone; // 信息级成因清零 / clear the informational cause
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_EdtCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _nHead := 0; // 环窗无样本 / the ring holds no sample
    _nFill := 0; // 环窗计数清零 / clear the ring count
    _nRun := 0; // 趋势计数清零 / clear the run counter
    _fVolPrev := 0.0; // 上一样本清零 / clear the previous sample
    _eTrend := E_DL_EdtTrend.eStable; // 趋势从平稳起步 / the trend starts stable
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清锁存 / 清统计 / 清环窗游标（三项逐项声明）/ segment 2, reset edge scope
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_EdtCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _nHead := 0; // 作用域三：清环窗槽位 / scope three, clear the ring slot cursor
    _nFill := 0; // 作用域三：清环窗计数 / scope three, clear the ring count
    _nRun := 0; // 作用域二：清趋势计数 / scope two, clear the run counter
    _nReject := 0; // 作用域二：清拒收计数 / scope two, clear the rejection count
    _fVolPrev := 0.0; // 作用域二：清上一样本 / scope two, clear the previous sample
    _eTrend := E_DL_EdtTrend.eStable; // 作用域二：趋势回平稳 / scope two, the trend returns to stable
    fMeanMl := 0.0; // 作用域二：清均值出口 / scope two, clear the mean outlet
    fStdMl := 0.0; // 作用域二：清标准差出口 / scope two, clear the deviation outlet
    fUclMl := 0.0; // 作用域二：清上控制限出口 / scope two, clear the upper limit outlet
    fLclMl := 0.0; // 作用域二：清下控制限出口 / scope two, clear the lower limit outlet
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态域闸（R151 全覆盖）/ segment 3, configuration domain gate over every pin
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法预置假 / preset the illegal configuration verdict to false
IF (fTargetMl <= 0.0) OR (fTargetMl <> fTargetMl) OR (fTargetMl > DL_EDT_VOL_MAX) THEN // 目标量越域 / the target is out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fTolPct <= 0.0) OR (fTolPct > DL_EDT_TOL_MAX) OR (fTolPct <> fTolPct) THEN // 容差越域 / the tolerance is out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nWinSize < DL_EDT_WIN_MIN) OR (nWinSize > DL_EDT_MAX) THEN // 窗口容量越域 / the window size is out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fSigmaK < DL_EDT_SIGMA_MIN) OR (fSigmaK > DL_EDT_SIGMA_MAX) OR (fSigmaK <> fSigmaK) THEN // 系数越域 / the factor is out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_EdtCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
END_IF
_nWinUse := nWinSize; // 窗口容量直通 / the window size passes through
IF _nWinUse < DL_EDT_WIN_MIN THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nWinUse := DL_EDT_WIN_MIN; // 回钳到 2 / clamp to two
ELSIF _nWinUse > DL_EDT_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nWinUse := DL_EDT_MAX; // 回钳到 64 / clamp to sixty four
END_IF

// 段 4｜样本接收与趋势跟踪 / segment 4, sample acceptance and trend tracking
_eCause := E_DL_EdtCause.eNone; // 信息级成因每拍重算 / the informational cause is recomputed every scan
_bBadReject := FALSE; // 拒收标志预置假 / preset the rejection flag to false
IF rtSample.Q AND bEnable AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 采样沿且使能无故障 / sample edge while enabled and unfaulted
    _bSampleOk := (fVolMl = fVolMl) AND ((fVolMl - fVolMl) = (fVolMl - fVolMl)) AND (fVolMl >= 0.0) AND (fVolMl <= DL_EDT_VOL_MAX); // 样本有限性与量级闸 / sample finiteness and magnitude gate
    IF NOT _bSampleOk THEN // 样本不可用 / the sample is unusable
        _bBadReject := TRUE; // 记拒收 / record the rejection
        IF _nReject < DL_EDT_REJ_MAX THEN // 未达计数上限 / below the ceiling
            _nReject := _nReject + 1; // 拒收计数递增 / increment the rejection count
        END_IF
    ELSE
        // 段 4.1｜环窗写入：先算槽位再写入，槽位回钳 1..64 / segment 4.1, ring write with a clamped slot
        _nHead := _nHead + 1; // 槽位前移 / advance the slot
        IF _nHead > DL_EDT_MAX THEN // 越过上界 / past the upper bound
            _nHead := 1; // 回钳到一号槽 / clamp back to slot one
        END_IF
        _afVol[_nHead] := fVolMl; // 样本入环窗 / store the sample
        IF _nFill < DL_EDT_MAX THEN // 环窗未满 / the ring is not yet full
            _nFill := _nFill + 1; // 计数递增 / increment the count
        END_IF
        // 段 4.2｜趋势跟踪：与上一样本比较方向 / segment 4.2, trend tracking against the previous sample
        IF _nFill > 1 THEN // 至少两条样本才有方向 / a direction needs at least two samples
            IF fVolMl > _fVolPrev THEN // 上升 / rising
                IF _nRun < 0 THEN // 原为连降 / previously falling
                    _nRun := 1; // 方向翻转，计数从 1 起 / the direction flipped and the run restarts at one
                ELSE
                    _nRun := _nRun + 1; // 连升累加 / extended the rising run
                END_IF
            ELSIF fVolMl < _fVolPrev THEN // 下降 / falling
                IF _nRun > 0 THEN // 原为连升 / previously rising
                    _nRun := -1; // 方向翻转，计数从负 1 起 / the direction flipped and the run restarts at minus one
                ELSE
                    _nRun := _nRun - 1; // 连降累加 / extended the falling run
                END_IF
            ELSE // 相等（本拍样本与上一样本同值）/ equal to the previous sample
                _nRun := 0; // 无方向 / no direction
            END_IF
        END_IF
        _fVolPrev := fVolMl; // 上一样本推进 / advance the previous sample
    END_IF
END_IF
IF _bBadReject THEN // 本拍发生拒收 / a rejection occurred this scan
    _eCause := E_DL_EdtCause.eBadSample; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
END_IF

// 段 5｜统计量：按时间序遍历环窗求均值与样本标准差 / segment 5, statistics over the ring in time order
_bStatsOk := _nFill >= DL_EDT_WIN_MIN; // 样本数达下限才可算标准差 / the deviation needs the minimum sample count
IF _bStatsOk THEN // 统计可算 / the statistics are computable
    _fSum := 0.0; // 和清零 / clear the sum
    _fSumSq := 0.0; // 平方和清零 / clear the sum of squares
    _nIdx := _nHead - _nFill + 1; // 时间序最旧槽位 / the oldest slot in time order
    IF _nIdx < 1 THEN // 越过下界 / below the lower bound
        _nIdx := _nIdx + DL_EDT_MAX; // 单次回绕补齐 / a single wrap restores the time order
    END_IF
    _nK := 1; // 时间序序号自 1 起 / the time-order ordinal starts at one
    _nGuard := 0; // 守护计数清零 / reset the guard
    WHILE (_nK <= _nFill) AND (_nGuard < (2 * DL_EDT_MAX)) DO // 双重守护 / dual guard
        _nGuard := _nGuard + 1; // 守护计数递增 / increment the guard
        _nIdx := _nHead - _nFill + _nK; // 时间序槽位 / the slot in time order
        IF _nIdx < 1 THEN // 越过下界 / below the lower bound
            _nIdx := _nIdx + DL_EDT_MAX; // 单次回绕 / single wrap
        END_IF
        _fVolLoc := _afVol[_nIdx]; // 取出样本 / take the sample
        _fSum := _fSum + _fVolLoc; // 累加和 / accumulate the sum
        _fSumSq := _fSumSq + _fVolLoc * _fVolLoc; // 累加平方和 / accumulate the sum of squares
        _nK := _nK + 1; // 序号递增 / increment the ordinal
    END_WHILE
    _fDivN := INT_TO_REAL(_nFill); // 均值除子为样本数，已证不小于 2 / the mean divisor is the count, proven not below two
    _fMean := _fSum / _fDivN; // 均值 / mean
    _fDivNm1 := INT_TO_REAL(_nFill - 1); // 方差除子为 n − 1，已证不小于 1 / the variance divisor is n minus one, proven not below one
    _fVar := (_fSumSq - (_fSum * _fSum) / _fDivN) / _fDivNm1; // 无偏方差 / unbiased variance
    _bVarOk := _fVar > DL_EDT_VAR_EPS; // 方差可用（舍入负值不参与开方）/ the variance is usable and rounding negatives are excluded
    IF _bVarOk THEN // 方差可用 / the variance is usable
        _fStd := SQRT(_fVar); // 标准差 / standard deviation
    ELSE
        _fStd := 0.0; // 方差近零时标准差记零 / a near-zero variance yields a zero deviation
    END_IF
    fMeanMl := _fMean; // 均值出口 / mean outlet
    fStdMl := _fStd; // 标准差出口 / deviation outlet
    fUclMl := _fMean + fSigmaK * _fStd; // 上控制限 / upper control limit
    fLclMl := _fMean - fSigmaK * _fStd; // 下控制限（可为负）/ lower control limit, may be negative
    bHasStats := TRUE; // 统计量可交付 / the statistics are deliverable
ELSE // 样本不足 / too few samples
    bHasStats := FALSE; // 统计量不可交付，出口保持上拍值 / the statistics are not deliverable and the outlets hold
    _eCause := E_DL_EdtCause.eNoSample; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
END_IF

// 段 6｜越限与目标带判据（仅在有统计量时判，避免用未成型的限值下结论）/ segment 6, limit and target band verdicts
bOutOfCtrl := FALSE; // 越限标志预置假 / preset the out-of-control flag to false
bInTarget := FALSE; // 目标带标志预置假 / preset the in-target flag to false
IF bHasStats AND rtSample.Q AND _bSampleOk THEN // 仅在有效采样拍判越限与目标带 / the verdicts run only on a valid sample scan
    bOutOfCtrl := (fVolMl > fUclMl) OR (fVolMl < fLclMl); // 最新样本越控制限 / the newest sample is beyond a control limit
    bInTarget := ABS(fVolMl - fTargetMl) <= (fTargetMl * fTolPct / 100.0); // 目标带判据，除子为常量 100.0 / target band verdict with the constant divisor one hundred
END_IF

// 段 7｜趋势出口映射 / segment 7, trend outlet mapping
IF _nRun > 0 THEN // 连升 / rising run
    _eTrend := E_DL_EdtTrend.eUp; // 连升档 / rising
ELSIF _nRun < 0 THEN // 连降 / falling run
    _eTrend := E_DL_EdtTrend.eDown; // 连降档 / falling
ELSE
    _eTrend := E_DL_EdtTrend.eStable; // 平稳档 / stable
END_IF
eTrend := _eTrend; // 趋势出口单点映射 / single-point trend outlet mapping
nTrendRun := _nRun; // 连续同向计数出口 / signed run length outlet
nSampleCnt := _nFill; // 窗口样本数出口 / window sample count outlet
nRejectCnt := _nReject; // 拒收计数出口 / rejection count outlet
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eCause := _eFaultCause; // 故障级成因锁存回放 / the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSE
    eCause := _eCause; // 信息级成因直映 / the informational cause is mapped directly
END_IF
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: EVA 膜裁剪称重定量需要自动去皮：每次放膜后先采空载皮重（多点采样取中位防抖），再加膜称总重算净重与目标定量比较，皮重采集未完成或非有限时拒绝本次称重结果并保持上拍；皮重漂移超限重采一次，仍超限置码走人工确认，定量上下限可组态且越界钳位，称重稳定判据用定时器而非单拍。
architecture_thought: 自动去皮称重架构：eIdle 到 eTare（放膜后多点采样皮重取中位防抖）到 eWeigh（加膜称总重，稳定判据用定时器窗口而非单拍）到 eCalc（净重=总重-皮重，与目标定量比较）到 eDone 或 eFault；皮重未完成或非有限拒绝本次结果保持上拍；皮重漂移超限重采一次仍超限转人工置码；定量上下限越界钳位；出口含皮重/净重/偏差/稳定标志与错误码。
output:

                      把当前毛重锁为皮重），随后进入注料 / 供料相，净重 = 毛重 − 皮重；
                      净重进入目标带且稳定保持即判定定量完成。超上限判超量、稳定后
                      仍低于下限判欠量，二者各自独立成因（R190 归因唯一）。
  溯源   Origin     : 自动去皮与带内定量为通用称重定量语义；本件为 clean-room 实现，
                      仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签 roadmap-p2-eva），
                      道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（TON / R_TRIG / REAL 运算，无私有库）

  同拍双窗配比约束（R100）：tStableTime 必须同时小于 tTareTo 与 tDoseTo —— 稳定确认窗

                      bInTol 在净重进入目标带且稳定时为真（挂状态量）；
                      bDoseDone 为单拍脉冲（内部位置置位、统一出口映射后撤销）；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。
