*)

TYPE E_DL_CcaPhase :
(
    eIdle   := 0,       // 空闲：等启动沿 / idle, waiting for the start edge
    eLoad   := 10,      // 上料：等上料就绪 / loading, waiting for the load ready signal
    eStack  := 20,      // 叠片：等叠片就绪 / stacking, waiting for the stack ready signal
    ePress  := 30,      // 压紧：等压紧就绪（含压力上限保护）/ pressing, waiting for the press ready signal with force protection
    eSeal   := 40,      // 封口：等封口就绪 / sealing, waiting for the seal ready signal
    eUnload := 50,      // 下料：等下料就绪 / unloading, waiting for the unload ready signal
    eDone   := 60,      // 完成：周期完成脉冲已出，驻留一拍以上 / done, the cycle pulse has been raised
    eFault  := 90       // 故障：成因锁存 / fault, the cause is latched
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_CcaCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：时间或力量程越域（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal config, time or force range out of domain
    eLoadTo     := 2,   // 上料超时（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ load timeout, a fault paired with bError
    eStackTo    := 3,   // 叠片超时（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ stack timeout, a fault paired with bError
    ePressTo    := 4,   // 压紧超时（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ press timeout, a fault paired with bError
    eSealTo     := 5,   // 封口超时（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ seal timeout, a fault paired with bError
    eUnloadTo   := 6,   // 下料超时（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ unload timeout, a fault paired with bError
    eForceOver  := 7    // 压紧力越上限（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ press force above the ceiling, a fault paired with bError
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_CoinCellAssembler
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;             // 使能，失能时撤命令回空闲 [-] / enable, disabling withdraws the commands and returns to idle
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;           // 复位上升沿清故障锁存并回空闲 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch and returns to idle
    bStart       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 周期启动脉冲，上升沿受理 [-] / cycle start pulse, accepted on the rising edge
    bLoadOk      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 上料就绪（物料到位）[-] / load ready, the part is in place
    bStackOk     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 叠片就绪（叠片数达标）[-] / stack ready, the layer count is reached
    bPressOk     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 压紧就绪（压力到位）[-] / press ready, the force is reached
    bSealOk      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 封口就绪（封口完成信号）[-] / seal ready
    bUnloadOk    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 下料就绪（物料已取出）[-] / unload ready, the part was removed
    fPressForceN : REAL := 0.0;              // 压紧力实测 [牛顿] / measured press force [newton]
    fPressMaxN   : REAL := 5000.0;           // 压紧力上限 [牛顿]，域 大于零 / press force ceiling [newton], domain above zero
    tLoadTo      : TIME := T#15S;            // 上料超时 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / load timeout [millisecond], domain above zero
    tStackTo     : TIME := T#60S;            // 叠片超时 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / stack timeout [millisecond], domain above zero
    tPressTo     : TIME := T#30S;            // 压紧超时 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / press timeout [millisecond], domain above zero
    tSealTo      : TIME := T#30S;            // 封口超时 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / seal timeout [millisecond], domain above zero
    tUnloadTo    : TIME := T#15S;            // 下料超时 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / unload timeout [millisecond], domain above zero
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bLoadCmd     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 上料相命令 [-] / load phase command
    bStackCmd    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 叠片相命令 [-] / stack phase command
    bPressCmd    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 压紧相命令 [-] / press phase command
    bSealCmd     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 封口相命令 [-] / seal phase command
    bUnloadCmd   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 下料相命令 [-] / unload phase command
    bCycleDone   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 周期完成单拍脉冲 [-] / cycle done single-shot pulse
    bBusy        : BOOL := FALSE;            // 工站忙（非空闲非故障）[-] / station busy, neither idle nor faulted
    nCycleCnt    : UDINT := 0;               // 周期完成计数（饱和到上限）[次] / completed cycle count, saturated [cycle]
    ePhase       : E_DL_CcaPhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eIdle; // 相位出口 [枚举] / phase outlet [enum]
    eCause       : E_DL_CcaCause := E_DL_CcaCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtStart      : R_TRIG;                   // 启动沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / start edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtReset      : R_TRIG;                   // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonLoad      : TON;                      // 上料超时，段 0 无条件刷新 / load timeout, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonStack     : TON;                      // 叠片超时，段 0 无条件刷新 / stack timeout, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonPress     : TON;                      // 压紧超时，段 0 无条件刷新 / press timeout, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonSeal      : TON;                      // 封口超时，段 0 无条件刷新 / seal timeout, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonUnload    : TON;                      // 下料超时，段 0 无条件刷新 / unload timeout, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _ePhase      : E_DL_CcaPhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eIdle;  // 内部相位，CASE 唯一写入目标 / internal phase, the only CASE write target
    _eFaultCause : E_DL_CcaCause := E_DL_CcaCause.eNone;  // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿（本件全部成因均为故障级，信息级死变量 _eCause 已于 R56 删除）/ fault cause, latched until the reset edge, every cause here is fault grade
    _bFault      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bCfgBad     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 组态非法判定 [-] / illegal configuration verdict
    _bDoneInt    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 周期完成脉冲内部位，统一出口映射 / internal cycle done bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _bForceOk    : BOOL := FALSE;            // 压紧力域闸通过 [-] / press force domain gate passed
    _nCycle      : UDINT := 0;               // 周期计数工作值 [次] / cycle count working value [cycle]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_CCA_FORCE_MAX : REAL := 1.0E7;        // 压紧力量级上限 [牛顿] / press force magnitude ceiling [newton]
    DL_CCA_CYCLE_MAX : UDINT := 2000000000;  // 周期计数饱和上限（常量在 DINT 可表范围内）[次] / cycle count saturation ceiling, the constant fits in DINT
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支），IN 只串相位闸与故障闸（R212）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh with phase and fault gates on IN only
rtStart(CLK := bStart); // 启动沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the start edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge
tonLoad(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_CcaPhase.eLoad) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tLoadTo); // 上料超时 / load timeout
tonStack(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_CcaPhase.eStack) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tStackTo); // 叠片超时 / stack timeout
tonPress(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_CcaPhase.ePress) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tPressTo); // 压紧超时 / press timeout
tonSeal(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_CcaPhase.eSeal) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tSealTo); // 封口超时 / seal timeout
tonUnload(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_CcaPhase.eUnload) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tUnloadTo); // 下料超时 / unload timeout

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eIdle; // 相位从空闲起步 / the phase starts from idle
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_CcaCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _nCycle := 0; // 周期计数清零 / clear the cycle count
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清锁存 / 迁相位 / 清脉冲内部位（计数不清，属产量资产）/ segment 2, reset edge scope
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_CcaCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eIdle; // 作用域二：迁回空闲相 / scope two, migrate back to idle
    _bDoneInt := FALSE; // 作用域二：清周期完成脉冲内部位 / scope two, clear the internal cycle done bit
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态域闸（R151 全覆盖）：五个时间引脚与力量程 / segment 3, configuration domain gate over every pin
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法预置假 / preset the illegal configuration verdict to false
IF (tLoadTo <= T#0S) OR (tStackTo <= T#0S) OR (tPressTo <= T#0S) OR (tSealTo <= T#0S) OR (tUnloadTo <= T#0S) THEN // 时间引脚非正 / a time pin is not positive
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (fPressMaxN <= 0.0) OR (fPressMaxN <> fPressMaxN) OR (fPressMaxN > DL_CCA_FORCE_MAX) THEN // 力量程越域 / the force range is out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_CcaCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
    _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_IF

// 段 4｜命令预置与压紧力闸：命令为相位派生电平，每拍先撤除 / segment 4, command preset and press force gate
bLoadCmd := FALSE; // 上料命令预置撤除 / preset the load command withdrawn
bStackCmd := FALSE; // 叠片命令预置撤除 / preset the stack command withdrawn
bPressCmd := FALSE; // 压紧命令预置撤除 / preset the press command withdrawn
bSealCmd := FALSE; // 封口命令预置撤除 / preset the seal command withdrawn
bUnloadCmd := FALSE; // 下料命令预置撤除 / preset the unload command withdrawn
_bForceOk := (fPressForceN = fPressForceN) AND ((fPressForceN - fPressForceN) = (fPressForceN - fPressForceN)) AND (fPressForceN <= fPressMaxN); // 压紧力有限且不越上限 / the press force is finite and within the ceiling

// 段 5｜相位机：ENUM + CASE，含 ELSE 非法相位兜底（R128）/ segment 5, phase machine with an ELSE fallback for illegal phases
CASE _ePhase OF
E_DL_CcaPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相：等启动沿 / idle, waiting for the start edge
    IF rtStart.Q AND bEnable AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 启动沿且使能无故障 / start edge while enabled and unfaulted
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eLoad; // 迁上料相 / migrate to the load phase
    END_IF

E_DL_CcaPhase.eLoad: // 上料相：命令自锁于本相 / load phase, the command lives inside this phase
    bLoadCmd := TRUE; // 出上料命令 / raise the load command
    IF bLoadOk THEN // 上料就绪 / load ready
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eStack; // 迁叠片相 / migrate to the stack phase
    ELSIF tonLoad.Q THEN // 上料超时 / load timed out
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaultCause := E_DL_CcaCause.eLoadTo; // 故障级成因（独立码，R45 配对 bError）/ independent fault code paired with bError
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF

E_DL_CcaPhase.eStack: // 叠片相 / stack phase
    bStackCmd := TRUE; // 出叠片命令 / raise the stack command
    IF bStackOk THEN // 叠片就绪 / stack ready
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.ePress; // 迁压紧相 / migrate to the press phase
    ELSIF tonStack.Q THEN // 叠片超时 / stack timed out
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaultCause := E_DL_CcaCause.eStackTo; // 故障级成因（独立码）/ independent fault code
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF

E_DL_CcaPhase.ePress: // 压紧相：命令 + 压力上限保护双判 / press phase with force protection
    bPressCmd := TRUE; // 出压紧命令 / raise the press command
    IF NOT _bForceOk THEN // 压紧力越上限或非有限 / the force is above the ceiling or non-finite
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaultCause := E_DL_CcaCause.eForceOver; // 故障级成因（独立码，不与超时合并）/ independent fault code, never merged with a timeout
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    ELSIF bPressOk THEN // 压紧就绪 / press ready
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eSeal; // 迁封口相 / migrate to the seal phase
    ELSIF tonPress.Q THEN // 压紧超时 / press timed out
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaultCause := E_DL_CcaCause.ePressTo; // 故障级成因（独立码）/ independent fault code
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF

E_DL_CcaPhase.eSeal: // 封口相 / seal phase
    bSealCmd := TRUE; // 出封口命令 / raise the seal command
    IF bSealOk THEN // 封口就绪 / seal ready
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eUnload; // 迁下料相 / migrate to the unload phase
    ELSIF tonSeal.Q THEN // 封口超时 / seal timed out
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaultCause := E_DL_CcaCause.eSealTo; // 故障级成因（独立码）/ independent fault code
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF

E_DL_CcaPhase.eUnload: // 下料相 / unload phase
    bUnloadCmd := TRUE; // 出下料命令 / raise the unload command
    IF bUnloadOk THEN // 下料就绪 / unload ready
        IF _nCycle < DL_CCA_CYCLE_MAX THEN // 计数未达饱和上限 / below the saturation ceiling
            _nCycle := _nCycle + 1; // 周期计数递增 / increment the cycle count
        END_IF
        _bDoneInt := TRUE; // 周期完成脉冲内部位置位（统一出口映射，R187）/ raise the internal cycle done bit, mapped at the unified outlet
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eDone; // 迁完成相 / migrate to the done phase
    ELSIF tonUnload.Q THEN // 下料超时 / unload timed out
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaultCause := E_DL_CcaCause.eUnloadTo; // 故障级成因（独立码）/ independent fault code
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF

E_DL_CcaPhase.eDone: // 完成相：驻留，等复位或新启动 / done phase, held until reset or a new start
    IF rtStart.Q AND bEnable THEN // 新启动沿 / a new start edge
        _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eLoad; // 重启上料相 / restart from the load phase
    END_IF

E_DL_CcaPhase.eFault: // 故障相：全撤命令，等复位沿 / fault phase with all commands withdrawn
    bLoadCmd := FALSE; // 撤上料命令 / withdraw the load command
    bStackCmd := FALSE; // 撤叠片命令 / withdraw the stack command
    bPressCmd := FALSE; // 撤压紧命令 / withdraw the press command
    bSealCmd := FALSE; // 撤封口命令 / withdraw the seal command
    bUnloadCmd := FALSE; // 撤下料命令 / withdraw the unload command

ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R128）/ illegal phase fallback
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_CcaCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因记组态非法 / record the illegal configuration cause
    _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 6｜失能与故障最终否决：命令一律受故障锁存与失能否决 / segment 6, final veto by the fault latch and the enable
IF _bFault OR (NOT bEnable) THEN // 故障锁存或失能 / fault latched or disabled
    bLoadCmd := FALSE; // 撤上料命令 / withdraw the load command
    bStackCmd := FALSE; // 撤叠片命令 / withdraw the stack command
    bPressCmd := FALSE; // 撤压紧命令 / withdraw the press command
    bSealCmd := FALSE; // 撤封口命令 / withdraw the seal command
    bUnloadCmd := FALSE; // 撤下料命令 / withdraw the unload command
    _bDoneInt := FALSE; // 撤周期完成脉冲内部位 / withdraw the internal cycle done bit
END_IF
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    _ePhase := E_DL_CcaPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / return to idle
END_IF

// 段 7｜统一出口 / segment 7, unified outlet
bCycleDone := _bDoneInt; // 周期完成脉冲映射本拍值 / map the cycle done pulse for this scan
_bDoneInt := FALSE; // 映射后立即撤销，保证单拍宽度（R187 两段式）/ revoke right after mapping to keep a single-scan width
nCycleCnt := _nCycle; // 周期计数出口 / cycle count outlet
bBusy := (_ePhase <> E_DL_CcaPhase.eIdle) AND (_ePhase <> E_DL_CcaPhase.eFault); // 忙指示（挂相位状态量）/ busy indicator derived from the phase state
ePhase := _ePhase; // 相位出口单点映射 / single-point phase outlet mapping
eCause := _eFaultCause; // 成因出口：全部成因均为故障级，锁存回放（R56 简化，原信息级死变量已删）/ the cause outlet, every cause is fault grade and replayed from the latch
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: PackML 规范要求设备统一 UnitMode 与 PMODE 管理：UnitMode 六态（生产/维护/手动/清洁/变更/无效）切换须校验目标态合法性并拒绝越权跳转，PMODE 按产品变更管理且只允许在安全态切换；命令过滤按当前 UnitMode 查许可表，未许可命令拒绝并置码不误动作，状态迁移沿输出事件供 MES 同步，状态表用常量集中可组态。（v1.0.1 返修版：见 REVIEW_R56 修法）
architecture_thought: PackML 模式管理架构：UnitMode 六态与 PMODE 状态用 ENUM 组织，许可表以常量二维数组集中（当前态×目标态查表）；切换请求先查许可表，越权跳转拒绝并置码不误动作；PMODE 变更仅在安全态闸放行；段 0 无条件刷新命令请求沿；迁移沿输出事件供 MES 同步；出口含 UnitMode/PMODE/许可拒绝码/迁移事件，CASE 含 ELSE 兜底落无效态。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_PackMlUnitMode
  分类   Category   : DL_Process
  版本   Version    : 1.0.1
  功能   Purpose    : PackML UnitMode 与 PMODE（PackML 状态模型）管理与命令过滤。
                      维护单元模式（生产 / 维护 / 手动 / 换型 / 清洗）与 PackML 状态
                      子集（空闲 / 启动 / 执行 / 保持 / 暂停 / 停止 / 中止 / 清除 /
                      复位 / 完成），按「当前状态 × 当前模式」两张闸对命令做过滤：
                      合法命令被受理并驱动状态迁移，非法命令被拒绝并给出拒绝原因；
                      模式切换仅在空闲 / 停止 / 完成三态允许。
  溯源   Origin     : PackML 状态与 UnitMode 组织为 OMAC PackML 公开标准语义；本件为
                      clean-room 实现，仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签
                      t2-7-packml 的 PackML 状态组织），未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（TON / R_TRIG / 枚举比较，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只做模式与状态管理及命令过滤，不执行任何设备动作（属主边界）；
                      二 中止（Abort）与停止（Stop）在全部模式下恒受理（安全侧优先）；
                      三 过渡态（启动 / 保持 / 暂停 / 停止 / 中止 / 清除 / 复位）由外部
                         完成信号 bTransDone 推进，并有过渡超时保护；
                      四 模式切换只在 eIdle / eStopped / eComplete 三态允许，其余态拒绝并留因；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      eState / eMode 为锁存状态，只在合法迁移或合法模式切换时改变；
                      bCmdAccepted 为单拍脉冲（内部位置位、统一出口映射后撤销）；
                      eReject 每次拒绝独立留痕，nRejectCnt 饱和累计；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 4 · 序号 19）
    2026-11-20  v1.0.1  R56 返修（7.5）：段 4 模式受理前补 eModeReq 枚举五选一合法性
                        校验，非法请求改记 eModeBlocked 不采纳（消除一拍非法模式窗口）；
                        段 9 / 段 10 头注释段号回正（原误标 segment 10 / 11）。
  ==================================================================
*)

TYPE E_DL_PmlState :
(
    eIdle        := 0,   // 空闲：允许启动与模式切换 / idle, start and mode change allowed
    eStarting    := 10,  // 启动过渡 / starting transition
    eExecute     := 20,  // 执行 / execute
    eCompleting  := 30,  // 完成过渡 / completing transition
    eComplete    := 40,  // 已完成：允许复位与模式切换 / complete, reset and mode change allowed
    eHolding     := 50,  // 保持过渡 / holding transition
    eHeld        := 60,  // 已保持 / held
    eUnholding   := 70,  // 解除保持过渡 / unholding transition
    eSuspending  := 80,  // 暂停过渡 / suspending transition
    eSuspended   := 90,  // 已暂停 / suspended
    eUnsuspending:= 100, // 解除暂停过渡 / unsuspending transition
    eStopping    := 110, // 停止过渡 / stopping transition
    eStopped     := 120, // 已停止：允许复位与模式切换 / stopped, reset and mode change allowed
    eClearing    := 130, // 清除过渡 / clearing transition
    eAborting    := 140, // 中止过渡 / aborting transition
    eAborted     := 150  // 已中止：只能经清除与复位恢复 / aborted, only clear and reset recover it
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_UnitMode :
(
    eProduction  := 0,   // 生产模式：全命令集 / production mode with the full command set
    eMaintenance := 10,  // 维护模式：禁暂停 / maintenance mode without suspend
    eManual      := 20,  // 手动模式：禁启动与保持 / manual mode without start and hold
    eChangeover  := 30,  // 换型模式：禁暂停与完成 / changeover mode without suspend and complete
    eCleaning    := 40   // 清洗模式：仅启动 / cleaning mode with start only
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_PmlCmd :
(
    eNone     := 0,      // 无命令 / no command
    eStart    := 10,     // 启动 / start
    eHold     := 20,     // 保持 / hold
    eUnhold   := 30,     // 解除保持 / unhold
    eSuspend  := 40,     // 暂停 / suspend
    eUnsuspend:= 50,     // 解除暂停 / unsuspend
    eStop     := 60,     // 停止 / stop
    eAbort    := 70,     // 中止 / abort
    eClear    := 80,     // 清除 / clear
    eReset    := 90,     // 复位 / reset
    eComplete := 100     // 完成 / complete
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_PmlReject :
(
    eNone            := 0, // 无拒绝 / no rejection
    eNoCmd           := 10, // 本拍无命令 / no command in this scan
    eIllegalState    := 20, // 该状态不接受此命令 / the current state does not accept this command
    eModeBlocked     := 30, // 当前模式禁止此命令 / the current mode blocks this command
    eModeLocked      := 40, // 当前状态不允许切换模式 / the current state does not allow a mode change
    eTransTimeout    := 50  // 过渡超时（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ transition timeout, a fault paired with bError
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_PackMlUnitMode
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;             // 使能，失能时不受理命令并回空闲 [-] / enable, no command is accepted when disabled and the state returns to idle
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;           // 复位上升沿清故障锁存并回空闲 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch and returns to idle
    bCmdStrobe   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 命令选通脉冲，上升沿消费 eCmdReq [-] / command strobe, eCmdReq is consumed on the rising edge
    eCmdReq      : E_DL_PmlCmd := E_DL_PmlCmd.eNone;   // 命令请求 [枚举] / requested command [enum]
    bModeStrobe  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 模式切换选通脉冲，上升沿消费 eModeReq [-] / mode change strobe, eModeReq is consumed on the rising edge
    eModeReq     : E_DL_UnitMode := E_DL_UnitMode.eProduction; // 模式请求 [枚举] / requested unit mode [enum]
    bTransDone   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 过渡完成信号（外部动作已完成）[-] / transition done signal from the external action
    tTransTo     : TIME := T#60S;            // 过渡超时 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / transition timeout [millisecond], domain above zero
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    eState       : E_DL_PmlState := E_DL_PmlState.eIdle;     // PackML 状态出口 [枚举] / PackML state outlet [enum]
    eMode        : E_DL_UnitMode := E_DL_UnitMode.eProduction; // 单元模式出口 [枚举] / unit mode outlet [enum]
    eAccepted    : E_DL_PmlCmd := E_DL_PmlCmd.eNone;         // 最近受理命令 [枚举] / last accepted command [enum]
    eReject      : E_DL_PmlReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eNone;   // 本拍拒绝原因 [枚举] / rejection reason of this scan [enum]
    bCmdAccepted : BOOL := FALSE;            // 命令受理单拍脉冲 [-] / command accepted single-shot pulse
    bModeAllowed : BOOL := FALSE;            // 当前状态是否允许切换模式 [-] / whether the current state allows a mode change
    bTransBusy   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 处于过渡态 [-] / inside a transition state
    uRejectCnt   : UDINT := 0;               // 拒绝计数（饱和到上限）[次] / rejection count, saturated [count]
    eCause       : E_DL_PmlReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eNone;   // 成因出口（复用拒绝枚举，故障级与 bError 配对）/ cause outlet reusing the reject enum, fault grade paired with bError
    bError       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtStrobe     : R_TRIG;                   // 命令选通沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / command strobe edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtMode       : R_TRIG;                   // 模式选通沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / mode strobe edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtReset      : R_TRIG;                   // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonTrans     : TON;                      // 过渡超时，段 0 无条件刷新 / transition timeout, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _eState      : E_DL_PmlState := E_DL_PmlState.eIdle;     // 内部状态，CASE 唯一写入目标 / internal state, the only CASE write target
    _eMode       : E_DL_UnitMode := E_DL_UnitMode.eProduction; // 内部模式锁存 / internal mode latch
    _eReject     : E_DL_PmlReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eNone;   // 本拍拒绝原因工作值 / rejection reason working value
    _bFault      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bAccInt     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 受理脉冲内部位，统一出口映射 / internal accepted bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _bAccepted   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 本拍是否受理了命令 [-] / whether a command was accepted this scan
    _bTransBusy  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 过渡态判定 [-] / transition state verdict
    _bModeAllowed: BOOL := FALSE;            // 模式切换许可 [-] / mode change permission
    _bAllowStart : BOOL := FALSE;            // 模式允许启动 [-] / the mode allows start
    _bAllowHold  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 模式允许保持 [-] / the mode allows hold
    _bAllowSusp  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 模式允许暂停 [-] / the mode allows suspend
    _bAllowCompl : BOOL := FALSE;            // 模式允许完成 [-] / the mode allows complete
    _bModeValid  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 模式枚举合法 [-] / the mode enumeration is legal
    _bModeReqOk  : BOOL := FALSE;            // 模式请求枚举五选一合法性 [-] / whether the requested mode is one of the five legal members
    _uReject     : UDINT := 0;               // 拒绝计数工作值 [次] / rejection count working value [count]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_PML_REJ_MAX : UDINT := 2000000000;    // 拒绝计数饱和上限（常量在 DINT 可表范围内）[次] / rejection count saturation ceiling, the constant fits in DINT
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支），IN 只串过渡态闸 / segment 0, unconditional refresh with the transition gate on IN only
rtStrobe(CLK := bCmdStrobe); // 命令选通沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the command strobe
rtMode(CLK := bModeStrobe); // 模式选通沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the mode strobe
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge
tonTrans(IN := _bTransBusy AND (NOT _bFault) AND bEnable, PT := tTransTo); // 过渡超时，仅在过渡态计时 / transition timeout timing only inside a transition state

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eIdle; // 状态从空闲起步 / the state starts at idle
    _eMode := E_DL_UnitMode.eProduction; // 模式从生产起步 / the mode starts at production
    _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eNone; // 拒绝原因清零 / clear the rejection reason
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _uReject := 0; // 拒绝计数清零 / clear the rejection count
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清锁存 / 迁状态 / 清脉冲内部位（模式保持，避免复位改工艺模式）/ segment 2, reset edge scope
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eNone; // 作用域一：清拒绝原因 / scope one, clear the rejection reason
    _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eIdle; // 作用域二：迁回空闲 / scope two, migrate back to idle
    _bAccInt := FALSE; // 作用域二：清受理脉冲内部位 / scope two, clear the internal accepted bit
END_IF

// 段 3｜模式合法性与模式命令白名单（模式闸） / segment 3, mode validity and the per mode command whitelist
_bModeValid := (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eProduction) OR (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eMaintenance) OR (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eManual) OR (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eChangeover) OR (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eCleaning); // 模式枚举五选一 / the mode is one of five
IF NOT _bModeValid THEN // 模式非法 / the mode is illegal
    _eMode := E_DL_UnitMode.eProduction; // 两级回退（R117）：一级回生产模式 / stage one of the two stage fallback, back to production
END_IF
_bAllowStart := (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eProduction) OR (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eMaintenance) OR (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eChangeover) OR (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eCleaning); // 启动白名单：手动模式禁启动 / start whitelist, manual mode forbids start
_bAllowHold := (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eProduction) OR (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eMaintenance) OR (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eChangeover); // 保持白名单：手动与清洗禁保持 / hold whitelist, manual and cleaning forbid hold
_bAllowSusp := (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eProduction); // 暂停白名单：仅生产模式 / suspend whitelist, production only
_bAllowCompl := (_eMode = E_DL_UnitMode.eProduction); // 完成白名单：仅生产模式 / complete whitelist, production only
_bModeAllowed := (_eState = E_DL_PmlState.eIdle) OR (_eState = E_DL_PmlState.eStopped) OR (_eState = E_DL_PmlState.eComplete); // 模式切换许可：空闲 / 停止 / 完成三态 / mode change allowed in idle, stopped and complete only

// 段 4｜模式切换：许可态内受理，非许可态留拒绝原因 / segment 4, mode change acceptance with a rejection trail
_eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eNone; // 本拍拒绝原因预置空 / preset the rejection reason to none
_bModeReqOk := (eModeReq = E_DL_UnitMode.eProduction) OR (eModeReq = E_DL_UnitMode.eMaintenance) OR (eModeReq = E_DL_UnitMode.eManual) OR (eModeReq = E_DL_UnitMode.eChangeover) OR (eModeReq = E_DL_UnitMode.eCleaning); // 模式请求枚举五选一判式（R56 返修补齐）/ the requested mode is one of five legal members
IF rtMode.Q THEN // 模式选通沿 / mode strobe edge
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
        _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eModeLocked; // 拒绝原因：失能不受理 / rejection reason, disabled
    ELSIF NOT _bModeReqOk THEN // 模式请求枚举非法 / the requested mode is illegal
        _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eModeBlocked; // 拒绝原因：非法模式请求不采纳（R56 返修补齐，消除一拍非法模式窗口）/ rejection reason, an illegal mode request is not adopted
    ELSIF _bModeAllowed THEN // 许可态 / inside a permitted state
        _eMode := eModeReq; // 采纳请求模式 / adopt the requested mode
    ELSE // 非许可态 / outside a permitted state
        _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eModeLocked; // 拒绝原因：状态锁模式 / rejection reason, the state locks the mode
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 5｜过渡态判定 / segment 5, transition state verdict
_bTransBusy := (_eState = E_DL_PmlState.eStarting) OR (_eState = E_DL_PmlState.eCompleting) OR (_eState = E_DL_PmlState.eHolding) OR (_eState = E_DL_PmlState.eUnholding) OR (_eState = E_DL_PmlState.eSuspending) OR (_eState = E_DL_PmlState.eUnsuspending) OR (_eState = E_DL_PmlState.eStopping) OR (_eState = E_DL_PmlState.eClearing) OR (_eState = E_DL_PmlState.eAborting); // 九个过渡态之一 / one of the nine transition states

// 段 6｜过渡推进：外部完成信号或过渡超时（超时即中止并留故障级原因）/ segment 6, transition advancement by the external signal or by a timeout
IF _bTransBusy THEN // 过渡态内 / inside a transition state
    IF bTransDone THEN // 外部动作完成 / the external action completed
        CASE _eState OF
        E_DL_PmlState.eStarting: // 启动过渡完成 / starting completed
            _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eExecute; // 进执行态 / enter execute
        E_DL_PmlState.eCompleting: // 完成过渡完成 / completing completed
            _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eComplete; // 进已完成态 / enter complete
        E_DL_PmlState.eHolding: // 保持过渡完成 / holding completed
            _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eHeld; // 进已保持态 / enter held
        E_DL_PmlState.eUnholding: // 解除保持过渡完成 / unholding completed
            _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eExecute; // 回执行态 / back to execute
        E_DL_PmlState.eSuspending: // 暂停过渡完成 / suspending completed
            _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eSuspended; // 进已暂停态 / enter suspended
        E_DL_PmlState.eUnsuspending: // 解除暂停过渡完成 / unsuspending completed
            _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eExecute; // 回执行态 / back to execute
        E_DL_PmlState.eStopping: // 停止过渡完成 / stopping completed
            _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eStopped; // 进已停止态 / enter stopped
        E_DL_PmlState.eClearing: // 清除过渡完成 / clearing completed
            _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eIdle; // 回空闲态 / back to idle
        E_DL_PmlState.eAborting: // 中止过渡完成 / aborting completed
            _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eAborted; // 进已中止态 / enter aborted
        ELSE // 非法过渡态兜底（R128）/ illegal transition fallback
            _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eIdle; // 回空闲态 / back to idle
        END_CASE
    ELSIF tonTrans.Q THEN // 过渡超时 / the transition timed out
        _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eTransTimeout; // 故障级原因（与 bError 配对，R45）/ fault grade reason paired with bError
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eAborting; // 强制走中止过渡 / force the aborting transition
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 7｜命令过滤：状态闸在前、模式闸在后，两闸顺序固定（先判状态可接受性，再判模式白名单）/ segment 7, command filtering with the state gate before the mode gate
_eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eNone; // 受理命令预置空 / preset the accepted command to none
_bAccepted := FALSE; // 受理标志预置假 / preset the accepted flag to false
IF rtStrobe.Q AND bEnable AND (NOT _bFault) AND (NOT _bTransBusy) THEN // 选通沿、使能、无故障、非过渡态 / strobe while enabled, unfaulted and outside a transition
    IF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eNone THEN // 无命令 / no command
        _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eNoCmd; // 拒绝原因：无命令 / rejection reason, no command
    ELSE
        // 段 7.1｜状态闸：按当前状态给出可接受的命令集合 / segment 7.1, the state gate defines the acceptable command set
        CASE _eState OF
        E_DL_PmlState.eIdle: // 空闲态：启动 / 中止 / 复位 / 清除 / 模式许可 / idle state
            IF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eStart THEN // 启动 / start
                IF _bAllowStart THEN // 模式允许 / the mode allows it
                    _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eStarting; // 迁启动过渡 / enter starting
                    _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eStart; // 受理启动 / accept start
                    _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
                ELSE
                    _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eModeBlocked; // 模式闸拒绝 / blocked by the mode gate
                END_IF
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eAbort THEN // 中止 / abort
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eAborting; // 迁中止过渡 / enter aborting
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eAbort; // 受理中止 / accept abort
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eReset THEN // 复位 / reset
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eClearing; // 空闲态的复位等价于清除 / a reset from idle behaves as clearing
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eReset; // 受理复位 / accept reset
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eClear THEN // 清除 / clear
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eClearing; // 迁清除过渡 / enter clearing
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eClear; // 受理清除 / accept clearing
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSE // 其它命令 / any other command
                _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eIllegalState; // 状态闸拒绝 / blocked by the state gate
            END_IF
        E_DL_PmlState.eExecute: // 执行态：保持 / 暂停 / 停止 / 完成 / 中止 / execute state
            IF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eHold THEN // 保持 / hold
                IF _bAllowHold THEN // 模式允许 / the mode allows it
                    _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eHolding; // 迁保持过渡 / enter holding
                    _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eHold; // 受理保持 / accept hold
                    _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
                ELSE
                    _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eModeBlocked; // 模式闸拒绝 / blocked by the mode gate
                END_IF
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eSuspend THEN // 暂停 / suspend
                IF _bAllowSusp THEN // 模式允许 / the mode allows it
                    _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eSuspending; // 迁暂停过渡 / enter suspending
                    _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eSuspend; // 受理暂停 / accept suspend
                    _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
                ELSE
                    _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eModeBlocked; // 模式闸拒绝 / blocked by the mode gate
                END_IF
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eComplete THEN // 完成 / complete
                IF _bAllowCompl THEN // 模式允许 / the mode allows it
                    _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eCompleting; // 迁完成过渡 / enter completing
                    _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eComplete; // 受理完成 / accept complete
                    _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
                ELSE
                    _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eModeBlocked; // 模式闸拒绝 / blocked by the mode gate
                END_IF
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eStop THEN // 停止（安全侧恒受理）/ stop, always accepted on the safety side
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eStopping; // 迁停止过渡 / enter stopping
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eStop; // 受理停止 / accept stop
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eAbort THEN // 中止（安全侧恒受理）/ abort, always accepted
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eAborting; // 迁中止过渡 / enter aborting
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eAbort; // 受理中止 / accept abort
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSE // 其它命令 / any other command
                _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eIllegalState; // 状态闸拒绝 / blocked by the state gate
            END_IF
        E_DL_PmlState.eHeld: // 已保持态：解除保持 / 停止 / 中止 / held state
            IF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eUnhold THEN // 解除保持 / unhold
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eUnholding; // 迁解除保持过渡 / enter unholding
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eUnhold; // 受理解除保持 / accept unhold
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eStop THEN // 停止 / stop
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eStopping; // 迁停止过渡 / enter stopping
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eStop; // 受理停止 / accept stop
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eAbort THEN // 中止 / abort
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eAborting; // 迁中止过渡 / enter aborting
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eAbort; // 受理中止 / accept abort
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSE // 其它命令 / any other command
                _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eIllegalState; // 状态闸拒绝 / blocked by the state gate
            END_IF
        E_DL_PmlState.eSuspended: // 已暂停态：解除暂停 / 停止 / 中止 / suspended state
            IF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eUnsuspend THEN // 解除暂停 / unsuspend
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eUnsuspending; // 迁解除暂停过渡 / enter unsuspending
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eUnsuspend; // 受理解除暂停 / accept unsuspend
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eStop THEN // 停止 / stop
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eStopping; // 迁停止过渡 / enter stopping
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eStop; // 受理停止 / accept stop
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eAbort THEN // 中止 / abort
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eAborting; // 迁中止过渡 / enter aborting
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eAbort; // 受理中止 / accept abort
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSE // 其它命令 / any other command
                _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eIllegalState; // 状态闸拒绝 / blocked by the state gate
            END_IF
        E_DL_PmlState.eComplete: // 已完成态：复位 / 停止 / 中止 / complete state
            IF (eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eReset) OR (eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eClear) THEN // 复位或清除 / reset or clear
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eClearing; // 迁清除过渡 / enter clearing
                _eAccepted := eCmdReq; // 受理该命令 / accept that command
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eAbort THEN // 中止 / abort
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eAborting; // 迁中止过渡 / enter aborting
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eAbort; // 受理中止 / accept abort
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSE // 其它命令 / any other command
                _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eIllegalState; // 状态闸拒绝 / blocked by the state gate
            END_IF
        E_DL_PmlState.eStopped: // 已停止态：复位 / 清除 / 中止 / stopped state
            IF (eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eReset) OR (eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eClear) THEN // 复位或清除 / reset or clear
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eClearing; // 迁清除过渡 / enter clearing
                _eAccepted := eCmdReq; // 受理该命令 / accept that command
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSIF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eAbort THEN // 中止 / abort
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eAborting; // 迁中止过渡 / enter aborting
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eAbort; // 受理中止 / accept abort
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSE // 其它命令 / any other command
                _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eIllegalState; // 状态闸拒绝 / blocked by the state gate
            END_IF
        E_DL_PmlState.eAborted: // 已中止态：只能清除后复位 / aborted state, clear then reset only
            IF eCmdReq = E_DL_PmlCmd.eClear THEN // 清除 / clear
                _eState := E_DL_PmlState.eClearing; // 迁清除过渡 / enter clearing
                _eAccepted := E_DL_PmlCmd.eClear; // 受理清除 / accept clearing
                _bAccepted := TRUE; // 置受理标志 / raise the accepted flag
            ELSE // 其它命令 / any other command
                _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eIllegalState; // 状态闸拒绝 / blocked by the state gate
            END_IF
        ELSE // 过渡态不接受新命令 / transition states reject new commands
            _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eIllegalState; // 状态闸拒绝 / blocked by the state gate
        END_CASE
    END_IF
ELSIF rtStrobe.Q THEN // 有选通但使能 / 故障 / 过渡态不满足 / a strobe arrived under a blocking condition
    _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eIllegalState; // 拒绝原因：条件不满足 / rejection reason, the condition is not met
END_IF

// 段 8｜拒绝计数与受理脉冲内部位 / segment 8, rejection counting and the internal accepted bit
IF NOT (_eReject = E_DL_PmlReject.eNone) THEN // 本拍存在拒绝 / a rejection occurred
    IF _uReject < DL_PML_REJ_MAX THEN // 未达饱和上限 / below the ceiling
        _uReject := _uReject + 1; // 拒绝计数递增 / increment the rejection count
    END_IF
END_IF
IF _bAccepted THEN // 本拍受理了命令 / a command was accepted
    _bAccInt := TRUE; // 受理脉冲内部位置位（统一出口映射，R187）/ raise the internal accepted bit, mapped at the unified outlet
END_IF

// 段 9｜失能语义：不受理命令，状态保持但过渡计时停摆（R191 显式声明）/ segment 9, disabled semantics
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    _bAccInt := FALSE; // 撤受理脉冲内部位 / withdraw the internal accepted bit
    _eReject := E_DL_PmlReject.eModeLocked; // 拒绝原因记模式锁（失能态不支持任何命令）/ rejection reason, disabled blocks every command
END_IF

// 段 10｜统一出口 / segment 10, unified outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口单点映射 / single-point state outlet mapping
eMode := _eMode; // 模式出口（锁存量）/ mode outlet from the latch
eAccepted := _eAccepted; // 受理命令出口 / accepted command outlet
eReject := _eReject; // 拒绝原因出口 / rejection reason outlet
bCmdAccepted := _bAccInt; // 受理脉冲映射本拍值 / map the accepted pulse for this scan
_bAccInt := FALSE; // 映射后立即撤销，保证单拍宽度（R187 两段式）/ revoke right after mapping to keep a single-scan width
bModeAllowed := _bModeAllowed; // 模式切换许可出口 / mode change permission outlet
bTransBusy := _bTransBusy; // 过渡态出口 / transition state outlet
uRejectCnt := _uReject; // 拒绝计数出口 / rejection count outlet
eCause := _eReject; // 成因出口与拒绝原因同源（名实双出口，R191）/ the cause outlet shares the rejection source
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: BA 系统通过 BACnet/Modbus 网关轮询采集暖通点位：按组态轮询表周期下发读请求并管理超时重试，连续失败达阈值将设备置离线并继续低频探测，恢复后自动回在线；轮询周期与超时可组态且越界钳位，应答数据非有限按坏值单列不写实时表，轮询状态与统计（成功率/超时数）出口供诊断，纯请求管理不含协议栈内核。（v1.0.1 返修版：见 REVIEW_R56 修法）
architecture_thought: 轮询主站管理架构：轮询表按组态周期下发请求（段 0 无条件刷新周期定时器），超时重试计数达阈值设备置离线转低频探测，应答恢复自动回在线；应答数据先做有限性闸（坏值单列不写实时表）；周期与超时越界钳位；成功率与超时数统计同源累加自洽；出口含当前轮询位号、在线态、统计与错误码；纯请求管理层不含协议栈内核，CASE 含 ELSE 兜底。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_BacdHvacPoll
  分类   Category   : DL_Process
  版本   Version    : 1.0.1
  功能   Purpose    : BA 顺控 BACnet / Modbus 轮询行。按固定轮询间隔对 1..16 台现场
                      设备做轮询：发出轮询触发后等响应超时窗，收到响应即置在线位并
                      清重试计数；超时即重试，重试次数用尽置离线位。每轮完成后索引
                      前进并跳过离线设备（全部离线时仍逐台尝试以探测恢复），并输出
                      在线 / 离线掩码字、轮询计数与超时计数。
  溯源   Origin     : BACnet / Modbus 轮询调度为公开现场总线通信语义；本件为 clean-room
                      实现，仅借鉴来源分类与参数域组织（来源标签 roadmap-p2-bacd），
                      道莅原创设计，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（TON / R_TRIG / WORD / SHL，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R55）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  同拍双窗配比约束（R100）：tRespTo 必须小于 tPollInt —— 响应超时窗短于轮询间隔窗，
                      两窗职责分离：tPollInt 定节拍，tRespTo 判单台失败；超时窗覆盖整个
                      间隔会使下一拍无法发出轮询，配比反置在组态域闸内直接判故障。
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只出轮询触发与在线掩码，不做协议编解码、不写设备（属主边界）；
                      二 轮询间隔用自复位周期 TON（周期脉冲发生器用法，R328 适用方向）；
                      三 响应超时件 IN 串「等待响应相」闸与「响应已到」补集，不跨相累计；
                      四 设备索引一律回钳 1..16，跳过离线设备的循环有守护上限防死循环；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址；
                      六 eNoDevice 为预留恒空成员：设备数为零已由组态域闸判
                         eCfgIllegal（故障级），信息级 eNoDevice 不可达，保留成员
                         以稳定接口（R56 返修留痕）。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      nPollIdx 为当前轮询设备号（1..nDevCount），无设备时保持 1；
                      wOnlineMask / wOfflineMask 位 i-1 对应设备 i，
                      自证向量：仅 1 号设备离线 → 16#0001，仅 16 号设备离线 → 16#8000；
                      bPollTrig 与 bRespTimeout 各为单拍脉冲（内部位置位、出口映射后撤销）；
                      eCause 故障级成因与 bError 配对（R45），信息级永不置 bError。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R55 首版（批 4 · 序号 20）
    2026-11-20  v1.0.1  R56 返修（7.1）：段 7 删除恒假死分支（判量 _nUseCount 经段 3
                        回钳恒 ≥1，信息级 eNoDevice 不可达），「设备数为零」语义改由
                        组态域闸 eCfgIllegal（故障级）承载；_nCurRetry 声明经核验
                        已在 VAR 区在位（7 处引用合法）。
  ==================================================================
*)

TYPE E_DL_BhdPhase :
(
    eIdle  := 0,        // 空闲：未使能或已停轮询 / idle, disabled or polling stopped
    ePoll  := 10,       // 发出：本拍发出轮询触发 / issuing, the poll trigger is raised this scan
    eWait  := 20,       // 等响应：等响应或超时 / waiting, for the response or the timeout
    eFault := 90        // 故障：组态非法锁存 / fault, illegal configuration latched
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_BhdCause :
(
    eNone       := 0,   // 无成因 / no cause
    eCfgIllegal := 1,   // 组态非法：设备数、重试上限或时间引脚越域（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal config, device count, retry cap or time pin out of domain
    eDevOffline := 2,   // 有设备重试用尽转离线（信息级）/ a device exhausted its retries and went offline, informational
    eAllOffline := 3,   // 全部设备离线，仍逐台尝试探测恢复（信息级）/ every device is offline and the scan still probes for recovery
    eNoDevice   := 4    // 设备数为零（预留恒空，语义由 eCfgIllegal 承载，R56 留痕）/ no device configured, reserved always empty, carried by eCfgIllegal
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_BacdHvacPoll
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable     : BOOL := TRUE;              // 使能，失能时停轮询并保持掩码 [-] / enable, polling stops and the masks hold when disabled
    bReset      : BOOL := FALSE;            // 复位上升沿清故障锁存、掩码与重试 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch, the masks and the retries
    nDevCount   : INT := 8;                  // 轮询设备数 [台]，域 1..16 / polled device count [unit], domain 1 to 16
    nRetryMax   : INT := 2;                  // 单设备重试上限 [次]，域 0..9 / per device retry ceiling [count], domain 0 to 9
    tPollInt    : TIME := T#1S;              // 轮询间隔 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / poll interval [millisecond], domain above zero
    tRespTo     : TIME := T#500MS;           // 响应超时 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / response timeout [millisecond], domain above zero
    bRespPulse  : BOOL := FALSE;             // 响应到达脉冲（对应当前轮询设备）[-] / response arrival pulse for the currently polled device
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    nPollIdx    : INT := 1;                  // 当前轮询设备号 [设备号] / currently polled device number
    bPollTrig   : BOOL := FALSE;             // 轮询触发单拍脉冲 [-] / poll trigger single-shot pulse
    bRespTimeout: BOOL := FALSE;             // 响应超时单拍脉冲 [-] / response timeout single-shot pulse
    wOnlineMask : WORD := 16#0000;           // 在线设备掩码，位 i-1 对应设备 i [-] / online device mask, bit i minus one maps to device i
    wOfflineMask: WORD := 16#0000;           // 离线设备掩码，位 i-1 对应设备 i [-] / offline device mask, bit i minus one maps to device i
    uPollCnt    : UDINT := 0;                // 累计轮询次数（饱和到上限）[次] / total poll count, saturated [count]
    uTimeoutCnt : UDINT := 0;                // 累计响应超时次数（饱和到上限）[次] / total response timeout count, saturated [count]
    nOfflineCnt : INT := 0;                  // 当前离线设备数 [台] / current offline device count [unit]
    nCurRetry   : INT := 0;                  // 当前设备已重试次数 [次] / retries already spent on the current device [count]
    ePhase      : E_DL_BhdPhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.eIdle; // 相位出口 [枚举] / phase outlet [enum]
    eCause      : E_DL_BhdCause := E_DL_BhdCause.eNone; // 成因出口 [枚举] / cause outlet [enum]
    bError      : BOOL := FALSE;             // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtResp      : R_TRIG;                    // 响应沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / response edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtReset     : R_TRIG;                    // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge detector, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonPollInt  : TON;                       // 轮询间隔周期计时（自复位式）/ poll interval timer, self resetting
    tonResp     : TON;                       // 响应超时计时，段 0 无条件刷新 / response timeout timer, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    _ePhase     : E_DL_BhdPhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.eIdle;   // 内部相位，CASE 唯一写入目标 / internal phase, the only CASE write target
    _eCause     : E_DL_BhdCause := E_DL_BhdCause.eNone;   // 信息级成因，每拍重算 / informational cause, recomputed every scan
    _eFaultCause: E_DL_BhdCause := E_DL_BhdCause.eNone;   // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault     : BOOL := FALSE;             // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;             // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bCfgBad    : BOOL := FALSE;             // 组态非法判定 [-] / illegal configuration verdict
    _bPollInt   : BOOL := FALSE;             // 轮询触发内部位，统一出口映射 / internal poll trigger bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _bToInt     : BOOL := FALSE;             // 超时脉冲内部位，统一出口映射 / internal timeout bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _bOfflineNew: BOOL := FALSE;             // 本拍有新设备转离线 [-] / a device went offline this scan
    _bAllOff    : BOOL := FALSE;             // 全部设备离线 [-] / every device is offline
    _bFound     : BOOL := FALSE;             // 跳过循环命中标志 [-] / hit flag of the skip loop
    _bIsOffline : BOOL := FALSE;             // 被检设备是否离线 [-] / whether the checked device is offline
    _nUseCount  : INT := 1;                  // 钳定后的设备数 [台] / clamped device count [unit]
    _nRetryUse  : INT := 1;                  // 钳定后的重试上限 [次] / clamped retry ceiling [count]
    _nIdx       : INT := 1;                  // 设备索引（回钳 1..16）[设备号] / device index clamped one through sixteen
    _nGuard     : INT := 0;                  // 跳过循环守护计数 [次] / skip loop guard [count]
    _nIdxProbe  : INT := 1;                  // 离线统计探测索引 [设备号] / probe index for the offline statistics
    _nCurRetry  : INT := 0;                  // 当前设备重试计数（声明补齐，R55 终审）/ current device retry counter, declaration completed at R55 review
    _wOff       : WORD := 16#0000;           // 离线掩码工作字 / offline mask working word
    _wOn        : WORD := 16#0000;           // 在线掩码工作字（按位或累计）/ online mask working word
    _wBit       : WORD := 16#0001;           // 本设备位掩码，先移位后置位（R327）/ device bit mask, shift before setting
    _uPoll      : UDINT := 0;                // 轮询计数工作值 [次] / poll count working value [count]
    _uTo        : UDINT := 0;                // 超时计数工作值 [次] / timeout count working value [count]
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_BHD_MAX      : INT := 16;             // 设备容量与索引回钳上界 [台] / device capacity and index clamp upper bound
    DL_BHD_RETRY_MAX: INT := 9;              // 重试上限的钳定上限 [次] / clamp ceiling of the retry cap [count]
    DL_BHD_CNT_MAX  : UDINT := 2000000000;   // 计数饱和上限（常量在 DINT 可表范围内）[次] / count saturation ceiling, the constant fits in DINT
    DL_BHD_MASK_NONE: WORD := 16#0000;       // 空掩码常量 [-] / empty mask constant
    DL_BHD_MASK_ONE : WORD := 16#0001;       // 单位位常量 [-] / single bit constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支）；轮询间隔用自复位式周期发生器 / segment 0, unconditional refresh with a self resetting periodic generator
rtResp(CLK := bRespPulse); // 响应沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the response edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge
tonPollInt(IN := (NOT tonPollInt.Q) AND bEnable AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tPollInt); // 轮询间隔周期发生器，Q 到时下一拍即重启（R328 周期脉冲方向）/ periodic poll generator that restarts right after its own pulse
tonResp(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_BhdPhase.eWait) AND (NOT rtResp.Q) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tRespTo); // 响应超时，IN 串等待相闸与响应到达补集 / response timeout with the waiting gate and the response complement on IN

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _ePhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.eIdle; // 相位从空闲起步 / the phase starts from idle
    _eCause := E_DL_BhdCause.eNone; // 信息级成因清零 / clear the informational cause
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_BhdCause.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _wOff := DL_BHD_MASK_NONE; // 离线掩码清零 / clear the offline mask
    _wOn := DL_BHD_MASK_NONE; // 在线掩码清零 / clear the online mask
    _nIdx := 1; // 索引归位 / park the index at one
    _uPoll := 0; // 轮询计数清零 / clear the poll count
    _uTo := 0; // 超时计数清零 / clear the timeout count
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清锁存 / 清掩码 / 清计数与索引（四项逐项声明）/ segment 2, reset edge scope declared item by item
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_BhdCause.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _wOff := DL_BHD_MASK_NONE; // 作用域二：清离线掩码 / scope two, clear the offline mask
    _wOn := DL_BHD_MASK_NONE; // 作用域二：清在线掩码 / scope two, clear the online mask
    _nIdx := 1; // 作用域三：索引归位 / scope three, park the index
    _nCurRetry := 0; // 作用域三：清重试计数 / scope three, clear the retry count
    _ePhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.eIdle; // 作用域四：迁回空闲相 / scope four, migrate back to idle
    _bPollInt := FALSE; // 作用域四：清轮询脉冲内部位 / scope four, clear the internal poll bit
    _bToInt := FALSE; // 作用域四：清超时脉冲内部位 / scope four, clear the internal timeout bit
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态域闸（R151 全覆盖）/ segment 3, configuration domain gate over every pin
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法预置假 / preset the illegal configuration verdict to false
IF (nDevCount < 1) OR (nDevCount > DL_BHD_MAX) THEN // 设备数越域 / the device count is out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (nRetryMax < 0) OR (nRetryMax > DL_BHD_RETRY_MAX) THEN // 重试上限越域 / the retry cap is out of domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF (tPollInt <= T#0S) OR (tRespTo <= T#0S) THEN // 时间引脚非正 / a time pin is not positive
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF tRespTo >= tPollInt THEN // 响应超时窗不得覆盖整个轮询间隔（配比约束，R100）/ the response window must not swallow the whole poll interval
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 判非法 / mark illegal
END_IF
IF _bCfgBad AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 组态非法且未锁存 / illegal configuration and not yet latched
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_BhdCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因 (R45 配对 bError) / fault grade cause paired with bError
    _ePhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_IF
_nUseCount := nDevCount; // 设备数直通 / the device count passes through
IF _nUseCount < 1 THEN // 下越界 / below the lower bound
    _nUseCount := 1; // 回钳到 1 / clamp to one
ELSIF _nUseCount > DL_BHD_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nUseCount := DL_BHD_MAX; // 回钳到 16 / clamp to sixteen
END_IF
_nRetryUse := nRetryMax; // 重试上限直通 / the retry cap passes through
IF _nRetryUse < 0 THEN // 下越界（防御）/ below the lower bound as a defence
    _nRetryUse := 0; // 回钳到 0 / clamp to zero
ELSIF _nRetryUse > DL_BHD_RETRY_MAX THEN // 上越界 / above the upper bound
    _nRetryUse := DL_BHD_RETRY_MAX; // 回钳到 9 / clamp to nine
END_IF
IF _nIdx < 1 THEN // 索引下越界 / the index is below the lower bound
    _nIdx := 1; // 回钳到 1 / clamp to one
ELSIF _nIdx > _nUseCount THEN // 索引上越界 / the index is above the upper bound
    _nIdx := _nUseCount; // 回钳到末台 / clamp to the last unit
END_IF

// 段 4｜失效使能与设备位更新 / segment 4, enable handling and device bit updates
_eCause := E_DL_BhdCause.eNone; // 信息级成因每拍重算 / the informational cause is recomputed every scan
_bOfflineNew := FALSE; // 新转离线标志预置假 / preset the new offline flag to false
_bAllOff := FALSE; // 全离线标志每拍重算 / the all offline flag is recomputed every scan
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能：停轮询并保持掩码（R191 显式声明）/ disabled, polling stops and the masks hold
    _ePhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / return to idle
    _bPollInt := FALSE; // 撤轮询脉冲内部位 / withdraw the internal poll bit
    _bToInt := FALSE; // 撤超时脉冲内部位 / withdraw the internal timeout bit
END_IF
_wBit := SHL(DL_BHD_MASK_ONE, _nIdx - 1); // 当前设备位掩码，位移量 0..15 由索引回钳与容量常量证明 / the current device bit mask, the shift zero through fifteen is proven by the index clamp and the capacity constant
IF rtResp.Q AND (_ePhase = E_DL_BhdPhase.eWait) THEN // 等待相收到响应 / a response arrived while waiting
    _wOff := _wOff AND NOT _wBit; // 清离线位 / clear the offline bit
    _wOn := _wOn OR _wBit; // 置在线位 / set the online bit
    _nCurRetry := 0; // 清重试计数 / clear the retry count
    _ePhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.ePoll; // 本轮结束，转下一轮发出相 / the round is finished and the next issuing phase follows
    _bFound := FALSE; // 跳过命中标志预置假 / preset the skip hit flag to false
    _nGuard := 0; // 守护计数清零 / reset the guard
    WHILE (_nGuard < DL_BHD_MAX) AND (NOT _bFound) DO // 跳过离线设备，守护上限为容量 / skip offline devices with the capacity as the guard
        _nGuard := _nGuard + 1; // 守护计数递增 / increment the guard
        _nIdx := _nIdx + 1; // 索引前进 / advance the index
        IF _nIdx > _nUseCount THEN // 越过末台 / past the last unit
            _nIdx := 1; // 回卷到首台 / wrap back to the first unit
        END_IF
        _wBit := SHL(DL_BHD_MASK_ONE, _nIdx - 1); // 候选设备位掩码 / the candidate device bit mask
        _bIsOffline := ((_wOff AND _wBit) <> DL_BHD_MASK_NONE); // 候选设备是否离线 / whether the candidate is offline
        IF NOT _bIsOffline THEN // 候选在线 / the candidate is online
            _bFound := TRUE; // 命中 / hit
        END_IF
    END_WHILE
    IF NOT _bFound THEN // 全部离线，仍逐台尝试（探测恢复）/ every device is offline and probing continues
        _nIdx := _nIdx + 1; // 索引照常前进 / the index advances anyway
        IF _nIdx > _nUseCount THEN // 越过末台 / past the last unit
            _nIdx := 1; // 回卷到首台 / wrap back to the first unit
        END_IF
        _bAllOff := TRUE; // 置全离线标志 / raise the all offline flag
    END_IF
END_IF
IF tonResp.Q AND (_ePhase = E_DL_BhdPhase.eWait) THEN // 等待相超时 / the waiting phase timed out
    _bToInt := TRUE; // 超时脉冲内部位置位（统一出口映射，R187）/ raise the internal timeout bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    IF _uTo < DL_BHD_CNT_MAX THEN // 未达饱和上限 / below the ceiling
        _uTo := _uTo + 1; // 超时计数递增 / increment the timeout count
    END_IF
    IF _nCurRetry < _nRetryUse THEN // 重试未用尽 / retries remain
        _nCurRetry := _nCurRetry + 1; // 重试计数递增并立即重发 / increment the retry count and re-issue at once
        _ePhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.ePoll; // 回发出相重试同一台 / back to the issuing phase for the same unit
    ELSE // 重试用尽 / retries exhausted
        _wOff := _wOff OR _wBit; // 置离线位 / set the offline bit
        _wOn := _wOn AND NOT _wBit; // 清在线位 / clear the online bit
        _bOfflineNew := TRUE; // 记新转离线 / record the new offline event
        _nCurRetry := 0; // 重试计数清零 / clear the retry count
        _ePhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.ePoll; // 回发出相转下一台 / back to the issuing phase for the next unit
        _bFound := FALSE; // 跳过命中标志预置假 / preset the skip hit flag to false
        _nGuard := 0; // 守护计数清零 / reset the guard
        WHILE (_nGuard < DL_BHD_MAX) AND (NOT _bFound) DO // 跳过离线设备 / skip offline devices
            _nGuard := _nGuard + 1; // 守护计数递增 / increment the guard
            _nIdx := _nIdx + 1; // 索引前进 / advance the index
            IF _nIdx > _nUseCount THEN // 越过末台 / past the last unit
                _nIdx := 1; // 回卷到首台 / wrap back to the first unit
            END_IF
            _wBit := SHL(DL_BHD_MASK_ONE, _nIdx - 1); // 候选设备位掩码 / the candidate device bit mask
            _bIsOffline := ((_wOff AND _wBit) <> DL_BHD_MASK_NONE); // 候选设备是否离线 / whether the candidate is offline
            IF NOT _bIsOffline THEN // 候选在线 / the candidate is online
                _bFound := TRUE; // 命中 / hit
            END_IF
        END_WHILE
        IF NOT _bFound THEN // 全部离线 / every device is offline
            _bAllOff := TRUE; // 置全离线标志 / raise the all offline flag
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 5｜相位机：ENUM + CASE，含 ELSE 非法相位兜底（R128）/ segment 5, phase machine with an ELSE fallback for illegal phases
CASE _ePhase OF
E_DL_BhdPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相：使能且无故障才起轮询 / idle, polling starts when enabled and unfaulted
    IF bEnable AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 使能且无故障 / enabled and unfaulted
        _ePhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.ePoll; // 迁发出相 / migrate to the issuing phase
    END_IF

E_DL_BhdPhase.ePoll: // 发出相：本拍发轮询触发并转等待相 / issuing phase, the trigger is raised and the waiting phase follows
    IF bEnable AND (NOT _bFault) AND tonPollInt.Q THEN // 轮询间隔到 / the poll interval elapsed
        _bPollInt := TRUE; // 轮询触发内部位置位（统一出口映射，R187）/ raise the internal poll bit, mapped at the unified outlet
        IF _uPoll < DL_BHD_CNT_MAX THEN // 未达饱和上限 / below the ceiling
            _uPoll := _uPoll + 1; // 轮询计数递增 / increment the poll count
        END_IF
        _ePhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.eWait; // 迁等待相 / migrate to the waiting phase
    END_IF

E_DL_BhdPhase.eWait: // 等待相：等响应或超时（两出口均在段 4 处理）/ waiting phase, the response and the timeout are handled in segment four
    IF (NOT bEnable) OR _bFault THEN // 失能或故障 / disabled or faulted
        _ePhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / return to idle
    END_IF

E_DL_BhdPhase.eFault: // 故障相：停轮询，等复位沿 / fault phase, polling stopped until the reset edge
    _bPollInt := FALSE; // 撤轮询脉冲内部位 / withdraw the internal poll bit
    _bToInt := FALSE; // 撤超时脉冲内部位 / withdraw the internal timeout bit
    _nCurRetry := 0; // 清重试计数 / clear the retry count

ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R128）/ illegal phase fallback
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaultCause := E_DL_BhdCause.eCfgIllegal; // 故障级成因记组态非法 / record the illegal configuration cause
    _ePhase := E_DL_BhdPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 6｜离线统计：逐台扫全容量统计，未参与设备按零位计 / segment 6, offline statistics over the full capacity
_nOfflineCnt := 0; // 离线计数清零 / clear the offline count
_nIdxProbe := 1; // 探测索引自 1 起 / the probe index starts at one
WHILE _nIdxProbe <= DL_BHD_MAX DO // 全容量扫查，未参与设备恒为零位 / sweep the full capacity because unused devices stay cleared
    _wBit := SHL(DL_BHD_MASK_ONE, _nIdxProbe - 1); // 本设备位掩码 / this device bit mask
    IF ((_wOff AND _wBit) <> DL_BHD_MASK_NONE) THEN // 本设备离线 / this device is offline
        _nOfflineCnt := _nOfflineCnt + 1; // 离线计数递增 / increment the offline count
    END_IF
    _nIdxProbe := _nIdxProbe + 1; // 索引递增 / increment the index
END_WHILE

// 段 7｜成因分派（固定优先级：故障 > 新转离线 > 全离线 > 无设备 > 无成因）/ segment 7, cause dispatch with a fixed priority
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eCause := _eFaultCause; // 故障级成因锁存回放 / the fault cause is replayed from the latch
ELSIF _bOfflineNew THEN // 本拍有新设备转离线 / a device went offline this scan
    eCause := E_DL_BhdCause.eDevOffline; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSIF _bAllOff THEN // 全部离线 / every device is offline
    eCause := E_DL_BhdCause.eAllOffline; // 信息级成因 / informational cause
ELSE // 设备数为零的情形已由组态域闸 eCfgIllegal 承载（R56 死分支删除留痕）/ the no device case is carried by the configuration gate
    eCause := _eCause; // 信息级成因直映 / the informational cause is mapped directly
END_IF

// 段 8｜统一出口 / segment 8, unified outlet
nPollIdx := _nIdx; // 当前轮询设备号出口 / currently polled device outlet
bPollTrig := _bPollInt; // 轮询触发映射本拍值 / map the poll trigger for this scan
_bPollInt := FALSE; // 映射后立即撤销，保证单拍宽度（R187 两段式）/ revoke right after mapping to keep a single-scan width
bRespTimeout := _bToInt; // 超时脉冲映射本拍值 / map the timeout pulse for this scan
_bToInt := FALSE; // 映射后立即撤销，保证单拍宽度（R187 两段式）/ revoke right after mapping to keep a single-scan width
wOnlineMask := _wOn; // 在线掩码出口 / online mask outlet
wOfflineMask := _wOff; // 离线掩码出口 / offline mask outlet
uPollCnt := _uPoll; // 轮询计数出口 / poll count outlet
uTimeoutCnt := _uTo; // 超时计数出口 / timeout count outlet
nOfflineCnt := _nOfflineCnt; // 离线设备数出口 / offline device count outlet
nCurRetry := _nCurRetry; // 当前重试次数出口 / current retry count outlet
ePhase := _ePhase; // 相位出口单点映射 / single-point phase outlet mapping
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 机械凸轮与温度补偿曲线常用离散点表，需要过点且端点斜率已知的平滑插值：给定 x 与两端点坐标和斜率，按三次 Hermite 基函数求值，返回插值结果；x 落在区间外先钳位到端点并在出口置越域标志，两点重合（区间退化）时直接返回左端点防除零，输入非有限当拍拒绝计算并保持上拍输出，全程纯函数无依赖。
architecture_thought: 纯函数求值架构：入口先做有限性闸（任一参数非有限即置无效并返回上拍友好值），再判区间退化（x1-x0 绝对值低于容差）直接返回端点防除零；越域按钳位处理并在出口置越域标志；基函数用 h00/h10/h01/h11 四个标准多项式集中声明，系数常量不写魔数；全程无状态可重入，CASE 兜底覆盖参数异常分支。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FC_DL_HermiteInterp
  分类   Category   : DL_MathData
  复杂度 Complexity  : cx3
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : 单区间三次 Hermite 插值。由端点值 y0 / y1 与端点斜率 m0 / m1
                      四条件唯一确定区间 [x0, x1] 内的三次多项式，输出插值 y；
                      x 越出区间按端点钳位并置 bClamped，x1 = x0（含反向）判退化
                      （bDegenerate，出口取 y0），任一输入非有限置 bInvalid 且出口取零。
  来源   Source     : t2-1-lgf-math
  溯源   Origin     : IEC 61131-3 标准语义的道莅防御性实现；三次 Hermite 基函数为公开
                      数值分析结果，clean-room 自研实现，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（LREAL 运算，无私有库、无方言转换、无幂运算符）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R56）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只做单区间插值，不建全局网格表、不做样条全局连续性（属主边界）；
                      二 区间方向固定 x0 < x1，区间宽度不大于 1.0E-12 一律判退化并取 y0；
                      三 非有限输入不穿透出口，安全侧取常量零（R127）；
                      四 早退分支出口变换与主体一致（R94）：退化分支取 y0 即四条件曲线
                         在退化极限下的正确极限值；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址、无定时器（纯函数）。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      y 仅在输入有限时为插值结果；标志优先级 bInvalid > bDegenerate > bClamped；
                      本件为纯函数，无跨扫描周期状态驻留。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R56 首版（批 1 · 序号 1）
  ==================================================================
*)

FUNCTION FC_DL_HermiteInterp : LREAL
VAR_INPUT
    x  : LREAL; // 插值自变量 [自变量单位] / independent variable of the interpolation
    x0 : LREAL; // 区间左端点 [自变量单位] / left interval bound
    x1 : LREAL; // 区间右端点 [自变量单位] / right interval bound
    y0 : LREAL; // 左端点函数值 [因变量单位] / function value at the left bound
    y1 : LREAL; // 右端点函数值 [因变量单位] / function value at the right bound
    m0 : LREAL; // 左端点斜率 [因变量每自变量] / slope at the left bound
    m1 : LREAL; // 右端点斜率 [因变量每自变量] / slope at the right bound
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bClamped    : BOOL; // x 越出区间已按端点钳位 [-] / x was clamped to an interval bound
    bDegenerate : BOOL; // 区间退化（x1 = x0），出口取 y0 [-] / degenerate interval, the outlet takes y0
    bInvalid    : BOOL; // 任一输入非有限，出口取零 [-] / any input non finite, the outlet takes zero
END_VAR
VAR
    _bFin  : BOOL := FALSE; // 七个输入全部有限 [-] / all seven inputs are finite
    _fDx   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 区间宽度 [自变量单位] / interval width
    _fXUse : LREAL := 0.0;  // 钳位后的插值自变量 [自变量单位] / clamped independent variable
    _fT    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 归一化区间参数（0..1）[无量纲] / normalised interval parameter
    _fT2   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 参数平方 [无量纲] / square of the parameter
    _fT3   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 参数立方 [无量纲] / cube of the parameter
    _fH00  : LREAL := 0.0;  // Hermite 基函数 h00 [无量纲] / Hermite basis h00
    _fH10  : LREAL := 0.0;  // Hermite 基函数 h10 [无量纲] / Hermite basis h10
    _fH01  : LREAL := 0.0;  // Hermite 基函数 h01 [无量纲] / Hermite basis h01
    _fH11  : LREAL := 0.0;  // Hermite 基函数 h11 [无量纲] / Hermite basis h11
END_VAR

// 段 1｜非有限闸（R151 全覆盖）：七个输入逐项判，NaN 自反、Inf 差值自减 / segment 1, finiteness gate over every input
_bFin := (x = x) AND ((x - x) = (x - x)) AND (x0 = x0) AND ((x0 - x0) = (x0 - x0)) AND (x1 = x1) AND ((x1 - x1) = (x1 - x1)) AND (y0 = y0) AND ((y0 - y0) = (y0 - y0)) AND (y1 = y1) AND ((y1 - y1) = (y1 - y1)) AND (m0 = m0) AND ((m0 - m0) = (m0 - m0)) AND (m1 = m1) AND ((m1 - m1) = (m1 - m1)); // 七输入有限性判定 / finiteness verdict over all seven inputs
IF NOT _bFin THEN // 非有限输入 / non finite input
    FC_DL_HermiteInterp := 0.0; // 安全侧取常量零（R127）/ the safe side takes the constant zero
    bInvalid := TRUE; // 置无效标志 / raise the invalid flag
    bClamped := FALSE; // 钳位标志不成立 / the clamp flag is false
    bDegenerate := FALSE; // 退化标志不成立 / the degenerate flag is false
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF
bInvalid := FALSE; // 有限输入，无效标志不成立 / finite input, the invalid flag is false

// 段 2｜退化判据：区间宽度不大于退化阈即取左端点值 / segment 2, degeneracy verdict
_fDx := x1 - x0; // 区间宽度 / interval width
IF _fDx <= 1.0E-12 THEN // 区间退化（含反向区间与等端点）/ the interval is degenerate
    FC_DL_HermiteInterp := y0; // 出口取左端点值（四条件曲线的退化极限，R94 一致出口）/ the outlet takes the left bound value, the degenerate limit of the same curve
    bDegenerate := TRUE; // 置退化标志 / raise the degenerate flag
    bClamped := FALSE; // 钳位标志不成立 / the clamp flag is false
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 3｜越域钳位 / segment 3, domain clamp
_fXUse := x; // 自变量直通 / the abscissa passes through
bClamped := FALSE; // 钳位标志预置假 / preset the clamp flag to false
IF x < x0 THEN // 左越域 / below the left bound
    _fXUse := x0; // 钳到左端点 / clamp to the left bound
    bClamped := TRUE; // 置钳位标志 / raise the clamp flag
ELSIF x > x1 THEN // 右越域 / above the right bound
    _fXUse := x1; // 钳到右端点 / clamp to the right bound
    bClamped := TRUE; // 置钳位标志 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF

// 段 4｜Hermite 基函数与四条件插值（幂次以显式乘法展开，禁 **）/ segment 4, Hermite basis and interpolation with explicit multiplications
_fT := (_fXUse - x0) / _fDx; // 归一化参数，除子为区间宽度已证大于退化阈 / normalised parameter, the divisor is the proven width
_fT2 := _fT * _fT; // 参数平方 / square of the parameter
_fT3 := _fT2 * _fT; // 参数立方 / cube of the parameter
_fH00 := 2.0 * _fT3 - 3.0 * _fT2 + 1.0; // 基函数 h00（端点值权重）/ basis h00, the endpoint value weight
_fH10 := _fT3 - 2.0 * _fT2 + _fT; // 基函数 h10（端点斜率权重）/ basis h10, the endpoint slope weight
_fH01 := -2.0 * _fT3 + 3.0 * _fT2; // 基函数 h01 / basis h01
_fH11 := _fT3 - _fT2; // 基函数 h11 / basis h11
FC_DL_HermiteInterp := _fH00 * y0 + _fH10 * _fDx * m0 + _fH01 * y1 + _fH11 * _fDx * m1; // 四条件三次插值 / the cubic interpolation from four conditions
END_FUNCTION

instruction: 机器人姿态与相机云台路径需要按时间比例在两姿态间平滑过渡：输入两单位四元数与插值系数 t，用球面线性插值求中间姿态；先判两四元数点积，为负则取反一端走最短弧，点积接近 1 时退化为一阶线性插值防除零，t 越界钳到 0~1，任一元零范数输入拒绝并置无效标志，输出归一化后交上位使用。
architecture_thought: 球面插值纯函数架构：先算点积判半球（负则取反一端保证最短弧），点积超 0.9995 退化为线性插值加归一化（避免 acos 除零与数值抖动），否则按反余弦求夹角后用正弦比求两权重；t 先钳到 0~1；任一元零范数或非有限直接置无效标志返回输入；归一化前做范数下限闸，四元数分量常量集中声明。
