*)

TYPE E_DL_SscPhase :
(
    eIdle  := 0,  // 未使能：监视停摆 / disabled, the watch is idle
    eRun   := 10, // 运行：逐拍判级 / running, graded every scan
    eFault := 90  // 故障：成因锁存 / fault, the cause is latched
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_SscFault :
(
    eNone      := 0, // 无成因 / no cause
    eClogWarn  := 1, // 堵塞预警级（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the clog warning grade, fault grade paired with bError
    eClogAlarm := 2, // 堵塞报警级（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the clog alarm grade, fault grade paired with bError
    eFlowLoss  := 3, // 流量低于下限（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the flow is below the floor, fault grade paired with bError
    eSensorBad := 4, // 压差或流量非有限（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the pressure or the flow is non finite, fault grade paired with bError
    ePhaseBad  := 5  // 非法相位兜底（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal phase fallback, fault grade paired with bError
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_SlurrySieveClogWatch
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable     : BOOL := TRUE;   // 使能，失能时监视停摆 [-] / enable, the watch stops when disabled
    bReset      : BOOL := FALSE;  // 复位上升沿清全部锁存与环窗 [-] / reset rising edge clears every latch and the ring
    fDp         : LREAL := 10.0;  // 筛前筛后压差 [千帕] / the sieve differential pressure [kilopascal]
    fQ          : LREAL := 20.0;  // 筛下流量 [立方米每小时] / the under sieve flow [cubic metre per hour]
    fQMin       : LREAL := 2.0;   // 流量下限（判据与除子域）[立方米每小时]，域 大于零 / the flow floor for the criteria and the divisor, domain above zero
    fWarnRatio  : LREAL := 1.5;   // 预警级比值阈 [无量纲]，域 大于 1 / the warning ratio threshold, above one
    fAlarmRatio : LREAL := 2.5;   // 报警级比值阈 [无量纲]，域 大于预警阈 / the alarm ratio threshold, above the warning one
    fCleanRatio : LREAL := 1.2;   // 清洁态比值上限（学习判据）[无量纲] / the clean ratio ceiling for learning
    tLearnWin   : TIME := T#60S;  // 清洁态学习持续窗 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / the clean learning dwell window [millisecond], domain above zero
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fClogIdx    : LREAL := 1.0; // 堵塞指数（相对基准）[无量纲] / the clog index relative to the baseline
    fTrendSlope : LREAL := 0.0; // 8 点趋势斜率 [指数每拍] / the eight point trend slope [index per scan]
    ePhase      : E_DL_SscPhase := E_DL_SscPhase.eIdle; // 相位出口 [枚举] / phase outlet [enum]
    eFault      : E_DL_SscFault := E_DL_SscFault.eNone; // 成因出口，锁存回放 [枚举] / cause outlet replayed from the latch [enum]
    bError      : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtReset  : R_TRIG; // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtLearn  : R_TRIG; // 学习窗到时沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / the learning window edge, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonLearn : TON;    // 清洁态学习持续窗（自清洁判据驱动，非错峰窗，无自复位需求）/ the clean learning dwell window
    _ePhase  : E_DL_SscPhase := E_DL_SscPhase.eIdle; // 内部相位，CASE 唯一写入目标 / internal phase, the only CASE write target
    _eFaulC  : E_DL_SscFault := E_DL_SscFault.eNone; // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault  : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit   : BOOL := FALSE; // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bInOk   : BOOL := FALSE; // 两输入均有限 [-] / both inputs are finite
    _bCfgOk  : BOOL := FALSE; // 组态参数域内 [-] / the configuration is inside the domain
    _bBad    : BOOL := FALSE; // 传感器无效锁存 [-] / the sensor bad latch
    _bFlowLo : BOOL := FALSE; // 流量损失迟滞锁存 [-] / the flow loss hysteresis latch
    _bWarn   : BOOL := FALSE; // 预警迟滞锁存 [-] / the warning hysteresis latch
    _bAlarm  : BOOL := FALSE; // 报警迟滞锁存 [-] / the alarm hysteresis latch
    _bClean  : BOOL := FALSE; // 清洁态判定 [-] / the clean state verdict
    _nHead   : INT := 0;      // 环窗最近样本槽位（1 起）[槽号] / the newest ring slot, one based
    _nFill   : INT := 0;      // 环窗已填样本数 [个] / the ring fill count
    _nIdx    : INT := 1;      // 时间序遍历槽位 [槽号] / the time order traversal slot
    _nK      : INT := 0;      // 时间序遍历序号 [序号] / the time order ordinal
    _nGuard  : INT := 0;      // 遍历守护计数 [次] / the traversal guard [count]
    _fIdxRaw : LREAL := 0.0;  // 原始堵塞指数（dP / q²）[无量纲] / the raw clog index, dP over q squared
    _fSev    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 严重度（对基准比值）[无量纲] / the severity against the baseline
    _fSumX   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 最小二乘 Σx [无量纲] / the least squares sum of x
    _fSumY   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 最小二乘 Σy [无量纲] / the least squares sum of y
    _fSumXY  : LREAL := 0.0;  // 最小二乘 Σxy [无量纲] / the least squares sum of x times y
    _fNum    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 斜率分子 [无量纲] / the slope numerator
    _afIdx   : ARRAY[1..8] OF LREAL := [8(0.0)]; // 环窗堵塞指数缓存 [无量纲] / the ring of clog indices
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支），IN 只串状态闸（FB50-1）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh with the state gates on IN only
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge
tonLearn(IN := _bClean AND (_ePhase = E_DL_SscPhase.eRun) AND (NOT _bFault) AND (NOT _bFlowLo) AND (NOT _bWarn) AND (NOT _bAlarm), PT := tLearnWin); // 清洁态学习窗 / the clean learning window
rtLearn(CLK := tonLearn.Q); // 学习窗到时沿 / the learning window edge

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _ePhase := E_DL_SscPhase.eRun; // 相位从运行起步 / the phase starts in run
    _eFaulC := E_DL_SscFault.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _nHead := 0; // 环窗无样本 / the ring holds no sample
    _nFill := 0; // 环窗计数清零 / clear the ring count
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清锁存 / 迁相位 / 清环窗与基准（三项逐项声明）/ segment 2, reset edge scope declared item by item
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / the reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaulC := E_DL_SscFault.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _bFlowLo := FALSE; // 作用域一：清流量损失迟滞 / scope one, clear the flow loss latch
    _bWarn := FALSE; // 作用域一：清预警迟滞 / scope one, clear the warning latch
    _bAlarm := FALSE; // 作用域一：清报警迟滞 / scope one, clear the alarm latch
    _bBad := FALSE; // 作用域一：清传感器锁存 / scope one, clear the sensor latch
    _ePhase := E_DL_SscPhase.eRun; // 作用域二：迁回运行相 / scope two, migrate back to run
    _nHead := 0; // 作用域三：清环窗槽位 / scope three, clear the ring slot
    _nFill := 0; // 作用域三：清环窗计数 / scope three, clear the ring count
    fClogIdx := 1.0; // 作用域三：指数回归基准水平 / scope three, the index returns to the baseline level
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态与输入域闸（R151 全覆盖）/ segment 3, the configuration and input domain gates
_bInOk := (fDp = fDp) AND ((fDp - fDp) = (fDp - fDp)) AND (fQ = fQ) AND ((fQ - fQ) = (fQ - fQ)); // 两输入有限性 / finiteness of both inputs
_bCfgOk := (fQMin > 0.0) AND (fQMin = fQMin) AND (fWarnRatio > 1.0) AND (fWarnRatio = fWarnRatio) AND (fAlarmRatio > fWarnRatio) AND (fAlarmRatio = fAlarmRatio) AND (fCleanRatio > 1.0) AND (fCleanRatio <= fWarnRatio) AND (fCleanRatio = fCleanRatio) AND (tLearnWin > T#0S); // 组态参数域判定 / the configuration domain verdict
IF (NOT _bInOk) OR (NOT _bCfgOk) THEN // 输入非有限或组态非法 / a non finite input or an illegal configuration
    IF NOT _bBad THEN // 未锁存才置 / set only while unlatched
        _bBad := TRUE; // 置传感器无效锁存 / raise the sensor bad latch
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 4｜本拍指数计算与环窗写入 / segment 4, the per scan index computation and the ring write
_fIdxRaw := 0.0; // 原始指数预置零 / preset the raw index to zero
IF _bInOk AND (fQ > fQMin) THEN // 流量高于下限才可算（除子域闸）/ the index needs the flow above the floor
    _fIdxRaw := fDp / (fQ * fQ); // 原始堵塞指数，除子为流量平方已证超阈 / the raw index with the proven squared flow divisor
END_IF
IF (_nFill < 8) OR (_nHead < 8) THEN // 槽位推进（未满顺填，已满环回钳 1..8）/ advance the slot with the wrap clamp
    _nHead := _nHead + 1; // 槽位前移 / advance the slot
    IF _nHead > 8 THEN // 越过上界 / past the upper bound
        _nHead := 1; // 回钳到一号槽 / clamp back to slot one
    END_IF
    IF _nFill < 8 THEN // 未满顺填 / fill while not full
        _nFill := _nFill + 1; // 计数递增 / increment the count
    END_IF
    _afIdx[_nHead] := _fIdxRaw; // 指数入环窗 / store the index
END_IF

// 段 5｜时间序环窗遍历：最小二乘斜率（R194：自最旧样本起）/ segment 5, the time order traversal for the least squares slope
_fSumX := 0.0; // Σx 清零 / clear the sum of x
_fSumY := 0.0; // Σy 清零 / clear the sum of y
_fSumXY := 0.0; // Σxy 清零 / clear the sum of xy
_fTrendSlope := 0.0; // 斜率预置零 / preset the slope to zero
IF _nFill >= 2 THEN // 至少两点才可算斜率 / the slope needs at least two points
    _nK := 1; // 时间序序号起步（1 = 最旧样本）/ start the time order ordinal at the oldest
    _nGuard := 0; // 守护清零 / clear the guard
    WHILE (_nK <= _nFill) AND (_nGuard < 16) DO // 时间序遍历，守护为两倍容量 / the time order traversal with a twice capacity guard
        _nGuard := _nGuard + 1; // 守护递增 / increment the guard
        _nIdx := _nHead - _nFill + _nK; // 时间序槽位 / the slot in time order
        IF _nIdx < 1 THEN // 越过下界 / below the lower bound
            _nIdx := _nIdx + 8; // 单次回绕补齐 / a single wrap restores the order
        END_IF
        _fSumX := _fSumX + INT_TO_LREAL(_nK - 1); // x = 0..7 / the x ordinal from zero
        _fSumY := _fSumY + _afIdx[_nIdx]; // y 累计 / accumulate y
        _fSumXY := _fSumXY + INT_TO_LREAL(_nK - 1) * _afIdx[_nIdx]; // xy 累计 / accumulate xy
        _nK := _nK + 1; // 序号递增 / increment the ordinal
    END_WHILE
    _fNum := 8.0 * _fSumXY - _fSumX * _fSumY; // 斜率分子 / the slope numerator
    fTrendSlope := _fNum / 336.0; // 最小二乘斜率，分母 8·140 - 28² = 336 结构性非零（R63 反算留档）/ the slope, the denominator is structurally non zero
END_IF

// 段 6｜严重度计算（对时间序最旧样本 = 学习基准）/ segment 6, the severity against the oldest sample as the learned baseline
IF _nFill >= 1 THEN // 有样本 / a sample exists
    _nIdx := _nHead - _nFill + 1; // 时间序最旧槽位（学习基准）/ the oldest slot, the learned baseline
    IF _nIdx < 1 THEN // 越过下界 / below the lower bound
        _nIdx := _nIdx + 8; // 单次回绕 / a single wrap
    END_IF
    IF _afIdx[_nIdx] > 1.0E-9 THEN // 基准指数可用（除子域闸）/ the baseline is usable
        fClogIdx := _afIdx[_nHead] / _afIdx[_nIdx]; // 堵塞指数 = 当前 / 学习基准 / the clog index, the current over the learned baseline
        _fSev := fClogIdx; // 严重度同源 / the severity shares the source
    ELSE // 基准指数近零 / the baseline is near zero
        fClogIdx := 1.0; // 指数回归基准 / the index returns to the baseline
        _fSev := 1.0; // 严重度记一 / the severity is one
    END_IF
ELSE // 无样本 / no sample
    fClogIdx := 1.0; // 指数回归基准 / the index returns to the baseline
    _fSev := 1.0; // 严重度记一 / the severity is one
END_IF
_bClean := (_fSev <= fCleanRatio) AND (fQ > fQMin) AND _bInOk; // 清洁态判定 / the clean state verdict
IF _fSev > fAlarmRatio THEN // 报警级进入判据 / the alarm entry criterion
    _bAlarm := TRUE; // 置报警迟滞 / raise the alarm latch
    _bWarn := TRUE; // 报警级蕴含预警级 / the alarm implies the warning
ELSIF _fSev < fWarnRatio - 0.1 THEN // 报警级退出判据（迟滞收窄）/ the alarm exit criterion with the narrowed band
    _bAlarm := FALSE; // 清报警迟滞 / clear the alarm latch
END_IF
IF (_fSev > fWarnRatio) AND (NOT _bAlarm) THEN // 预警级进入判据 / the warning entry criterion
    _bWarn := TRUE; // 置预警迟滞 / raise the warning latch
ELSIF _fSev < fWarnRatio - 0.1 THEN // 预警级退出判据（迟滞收窄）/ the warning exit criterion
    _bWarn := FALSE; // 清预警迟滞 / clear the warning latch
END_IF
IF fQ <= fQMin THEN // 流量损失进入判据 / the flow loss entry criterion
    _bFlowLo := TRUE; // 置流量损失迟滞 / raise the flow loss latch
ELSIF fQ > fQMin * 1.2 THEN // 流量损失退出判据（迟滞收窄）/ the flow loss exit criterion
    _bFlowLo := FALSE; // 清流量损失迟滞 / clear the flow loss latch
END_IF

// 段 7｜相位机：ENUM + CASE，含 ELSE 非法相位兜底（R128）/ segment 7, the phase machine with an ELSE fallback
CASE _ePhase OF
E_DL_SscPhase.eIdle: // 未使能相 / the disabled phase
    IF bEnable AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 使能且无故障 / enabled and unfaulted
        _ePhase := E_DL_SscPhase.eRun; // 迁运行相 / migrate to run
    END_IF

E_DL_SscPhase.eRun: // 运行相：判级分派（优先级：传感器 > 流量损失 > 报警 > 预警）与学习更新 / the run phase, the dispatch and the learning
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
        _ePhase := E_DL_SscPhase.eIdle; // 迁未使能相 / migrate to idle
    ELSIF _bBad OR _bFlowLo OR _bAlarm OR _bWarn THEN // 存在活跃迟滞锁存 / an active latch exists
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        IF _bBad THEN // 传感器非有限优先 / the sensor takes the top priority
            _eFaulC := E_DL_SscFault.eSensorBad; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
        ELSIF _bFlowLo THEN // 流量损失次优先 / the flow loss follows
            _eFaulC := E_DL_SscFault.eFlowLoss; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
        ELSIF _bAlarm THEN // 报警级再次优先（R190 独立成因）/ the alarm grade, an independent cause
            _eFaulC := E_DL_SscFault.eClogAlarm; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
        ELSE // 预警级（R190 独立成因）/ the warning grade, an independent cause
            _eFaulC := E_DL_SscFault.eClogWarn; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
        END_IF
        _ePhase := E_DL_SscPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    ELSE // 正常运行 / the normal running
        _eFaulC := E_DL_SscFault.eNone; // 成因清零 / clear the cause
    END_IF

E_DL_SscPhase.eFault: // 故障相：锁存回放，迟滞自愈解除后回运行 / the fault phase, the latches self heal and return to run
    IF bEnable AND (NOT _bBad) AND (NOT _bFlowLo) AND (NOT _bAlarm) AND (NOT _bWarn) THEN // 全部迟滞已解除 / every latch has cleared
        _bFault := FALSE; // 清故障锁存（自愈路径，R152）/ clear the fault latch, the self healing path
        _eFaulC := E_DL_SscFault.eNone; // 成因清零 / clear the cause
        _ePhase := E_DL_SscPhase.eRun; // 迁回运行相 / migrate back to run
    ELSIF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
        _ePhase := E_DL_SscPhase.eIdle; // 迁未使能相 / migrate to idle
    END_IF

ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R128）/ the illegal phase fallback
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaulC := E_DL_SscFault.ePhaseBad; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
    _ePhase := E_DL_SscPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 8｜学习更新与统一出口 / segment 8, the learning update and the unified outlet
IF rtLearn.Q THEN // 学习窗到时沿 / the learning edge
    _nIdx := _nHead - _nFill + 1; // 时间序最旧槽位 / the oldest slot in time order
    IF _nIdx < 1 THEN // 越过下界 / below the lower bound
        _nIdx := _nIdx + 8; // 单次回绕 / a single wrap
    END_IF
    _afIdx[_nIdx] := _afIdx[_nHead]; // 基准更新：最旧样本改写为当前指数 / the baseline update, the oldest slot takes the current index
END_IF
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eFault := _eFaulC; // 故障级成因锁存回放（R152）/ the fault cause replayed from the latch
ELSE
    eFault := E_DL_SscFault.eNone; // 无锁存即无成因 / no latch, no cause
END_IF
ePhase := _ePhase; // 相位出口单点映射 / single point phase outlet mapping
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 连续失重式给料需要按失重速率闭环控制螺旋转速：对称重做差分求失重速率并滤波，PI 调节输出给料指令；补料相冻结计量并估计补料后速率，避免补料冲击污染控制；速率长期为零判无失重、称重噪声过大判传感器抖动、补料超时判补料故障；批量累计到目标置批次完成，输出速率/给料中/补料中/状态与诊断码。
architecture_thought: 失重计量状态机架构：段 0 无条件刷新采样沿与补料定时器；eDose 内对称重差分求速率并低通滤波，PI 输出给料指令，速率持续低于阈值判无失重；eRefill 冻结计量、清速率积分并在补料完成后按新重量重算基准；称重噪声按短窗方差判抖动；批量累计到目标置完成；各故障锁存并可复位；出口含速率/给料中/补料中/累计/状态与诊断码，CASE 含 ELSE 落故障态。
output:
(*

                      给料率），一阶低通滤波后进 PI 闭环调节螺旋输出；低料位触发
                      补料相（输出冻结归零、计量与速率估计暂停），补料完成沿或

                      判 eNoLossRate；称重突跳超物理限判 eWeightNoise。
  来源   Source     : t2-2-lbp（与 FB_DL_BatchDosingControl 分工：连续失重 vs 批次定量）
  溯源   Origin     : IEC 61131-3 标准语义的道莅防御性实现；失重秤连续给料为公开
                      工艺语义，clean-room 自研实现，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（TON / R_TRIG / LREAL，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R56）

  同拍双窗配比约束（R100）：tRefillTo（补料超时窗）与 tNoRateTo（无速率确认窗）
                      职责分离、分属不同相，IN 串各自相位闸，无同拍并跑；
                      配比约束 tRefillTo > tNoRateTo 在组态域闸内判故障。
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只算给料输出与批量累计，不驱动螺旋电机本体、不控补料阀
                         （补料阀由外部按 bRefilling 执行，属主边界）；
                      二 失重速率方向约定：w(t) 递减 = 给料，速率为正；

                         全部暂停，恢复后从冻结点继续；
                      四 相级看门狗使能只用相驻留本身（R145）；
                      五 故障锁存解除路径 = bReset 上升沿（唯一路径，R188）；
                      六 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      fRateOut 为 PI 后给料输出（0..fOutMax）；bDosing / bRefilling
                      为相位派生电平；fBatchAcc 为批量累计 [千克]；
                      eFault 为锁存回放；ePhaseBad 为非法相位兜底专用成员（R128）。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R56 首版（批 4 · 序号 16）

TYPE E_DL_LwfPhase :
(
    eIdle   := 0,  // 空闲：等启动沿 / idle, waiting for the start edge
    eDose   := 10, // 给料：PI 闭环与批量累计 / dosing, the PI loop and the batch accumulation
    eRefill := 20, // 补料：计量冻结，等补料完成 / refilling, the metering freezes until the refill completes
    eDone   := 30, // 批次完成：驻留等复位或新启动 / done, held until reset or a new start
    eFault  := 90  // 故障：成因锁存 / fault, the cause is latched
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_LwfFault :
(
    eNone         := 0, // 无成因 / no cause
    eNoLossRate   := 1, // 输出非零而速率长期为零（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ a nonzero output with a void loss rate, fault grade paired with bError
    eWeightNoise  := 2, // 称重突跳超物理限（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ a weight jump beyond the physical limit, fault grade paired with bError
    eRefillTimeout:= 3, // 补料超时（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the refill timed out, fault grade paired with bError
    eSensorBad    := 4, // 称重非有限或组态非法（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the weight is non finite or the config illegal, fault grade paired with bError
    ePhaseBad     := 5  // 非法相位兜底（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal phase fallback, fault grade paired with bError
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_LossInWeightFeeder
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable     : BOOL := TRUE;    // 使能，失能时停给料回空闲 [-] / enable, the feeding stops when disabled
    bReset      : BOOL := FALSE;   // 复位上升沿清故障锁存与批量累计 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch and the batch accumulation
    bStart      : BOOL := FALSE;   // 批次启动脉冲，上升沿受理 [-] / the batch start pulse, accepted on the rising edge
    bRefillDone : BOOL := FALSE;   // 补料完成脉冲（外部给出）[-] / the refill done pulse from the outside
    fWeightKg   : LREAL := 100.0;  // 称重实测 [千克] / the measured weight [kilogram]
    fRateSp     : LREAL := 10.0;   // 目标给料速率 [千克每小时]，域 大于零 / the target feed rate [kilogram per hour], domain above zero
    fKp         : LREAL := 2.0;    // PI 比例增益 [输出每速率误差] / the PI proportional gain [output per rate error]
    fTi         : LREAL := 30.0;   // PI 积分时间 [秒]，域 大于零 / the PI integral time [second], domain above zero
    fOutMax     : LREAL := 100.0;  // 输出上限 [百分比] / the output ceiling [percent]
    fRateFiltT  : LREAL := 2.0;    // 速率低通时间常数 [秒]，0 = 直通 / the rate low pass time constant [second], zero is a passthrough
    fNoiseLim   : LREAL := 500.0;  // 称重突跳物理限（速率口径）[千克每小时] / the weight jump physical limit in rate terms [kilogram per hour]
    fLowWeightKg: LREAL := 20.0;   // 低料位补料阈值 [千克] / the low weight refill threshold [kilogram]
    fBatchTarget: LREAL := 500.0;  // 批量目标 [千克]，域 大于零 / the batch target [kilogram], domain above zero
    tRefillTo   : TIME := T#120S;  // 补料超时窗 [毫秒]，域 大于 tNoRateTo / the refill timeout window, above the no rate window
    tNoRateTo   : TIME := T#10S;   // 无速率确认窗 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / the no rate confirm window [millisecond], domain above zero
    fDtS        : LREAL := 0.1;    // 调用周期 [秒]，域 大于零 / the call period [second], domain above zero
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fRateOut  : LREAL := 0.0;  // 给料输出（PI 后，0..上限）[百分比] / the feed output after the PI [percent]
    bDosing   : BOOL := FALSE; // 给料中（相位派生电平）[-] / dosing, a phase derived level
    bRefilling: BOOL := FALSE; // 补料中（相位派生电平）[-] / refilling, a phase derived level
    fBatchAcc : LREAL := 0.0;  // 批量累计 [千克] / the batch accumulation [kilogram]
    ePhase    : E_DL_LwfPhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eIdle; // 相位出口 [枚举] / phase outlet [enum]
    eFault    : E_DL_LwfFault := E_DL_LwfFault.eNone; // 成因出口，锁存回放 [枚举] / cause outlet replayed from the latch [enum]
    bError    : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtStart   : R_TRIG; // 启动沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / start edge, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtRefillD : R_TRIG; // 补料完成沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / refill done edge, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtReset   : R_TRIG; // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonRefill : TON;    // 补料超时窗，段 0 无条件刷新 / the refill timeout window, refreshed unconditionally
    tonNoRate : TON;    // 无速率确认窗，段 0 无条件刷新 / the no rate confirm window, refreshed unconditionally
    _ePhase   : E_DL_LwfPhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eIdle; // 内部相位，CASE 唯一写入目标 / internal phase, the only CASE write target
    _eFaulC   : E_DL_LwfFault := E_DL_LwfFault.eNone; // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault   : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit    : BOOL := FALSE; // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bCfgOk   : BOOL := FALSE; // 组态参数域内 [-] / the configuration is inside the domain
    _bInOk    : BOOL := FALSE; // 称重有限 [-] / the weight is finite
    _fWPrev   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 上拍称重快照 [千克] / previous scan weight snapshot [kilogram]
    _fRateRaw : LREAL := 0.0;  // 原始失重速率 [千克每小时] / the raw loss rate [kilogram per hour]
    _fRateF   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 滤后失重速率 [千克每小时] / the filtered loss rate [kilogram per hour]
    _fE       : LREAL := 0.0;  // 速率误差 [千克每小时] / the rate error [kilogram per hour]
    _fI       : LREAL := 0.0;  // 积分项保持量 [百分比] / the integral term holder [percent]
    _fUPre    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 限幅前输出 [百分比] / the pre clamp output [percent]
    _fW       : LREAL := 0.0;  // 一阶低通权 [无量纲] / the first order weight
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支），IN 只串相位闸与故障闸（FB50-1）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh, no instance call inside a branch
rtStart(CLK := bStart); // 启动沿 / the start edge
rtRefillD(CLK := bRefillDone); // 补料完成沿 / the refill done edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
tonRefill(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_LwfPhase.eRefill) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tRefillTo); // 补料超时窗，IN 串补料相闸 / the refill timeout with the refill phase gate
tonNoRate(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_LwfPhase.eDose) AND (fRateOut > 1.0) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tNoRateTo); // 无速率确认窗，IN 串给料相闸与输出非零判据 / the no rate window with the dose phase gate

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eIdle; // 相位从空闲起步 / the phase starts from idle
    _eFaulC := E_DL_LwfFault.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _fWPrev := fWeightKg; // 快照取当拍 / the snapshot takes this scan
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清锁存 / 迁相位 / 清批量累计与积分（三项逐项声明）/ segment 2, reset edge scope declared item by item
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / the reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaulC := E_DL_LwfFault.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eIdle; // 作用域二：迁回空闲相 / scope two, migrate back to idle
    fBatchAcc := 0.0; // 作用域三：清批量累计 / scope three, clear the batch accumulation
    _fI := 0.0; // 作用域三：清积分项 / scope three, clear the integral term
    _fRateF := 0.0; // 作用域三：清滤后速率 / scope three, clear the filtered rate
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态与输入域闸（R151 全覆盖）/ segment 3, the configuration and input domain gates
_bInOk := (fWeightKg = fWeightKg) AND ((fWeightKg - fWeightKg) = (fWeightKg - fWeightKg)); // 称重有限性 / the weight finiteness
_bCfgOk := (fRateSp > 0.0) AND (fRateSp = fRateSp) AND (fKp > 0.0) AND (fKp = fKp) AND (fTi > 0.0) AND (fTi = fTi) AND (fOutMax > 0.0) AND (fOutMax = fOutMax) AND (fRateFiltT >= 0.0) AND (fRateFiltT = fRateFiltT) AND (fNoiseLim > 0.0) AND (fNoiseLim = fNoiseLim) AND (fBatchTarget > 0.0) AND (fBatchTarget = fBatchTarget) AND (tRefillTo > T#0S) AND (tNoRateTo > T#0S) AND (tRefillTo > tNoRateTo) AND (fDtS > 0.0) AND (fDtS = fDtS); // 组态参数域判定（含 R100 配比）/ the configuration verdict with the window pairing
IF (NOT _bInOk) OR (NOT _bCfgOk) THEN // 输入非有限或组态非法 / a non finite input or an illegal configuration
    IF NOT _bFault THEN // 未锁存才迁移（防同拍抹除）/ migrate only while unlatched
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaulC := E_DL_LwfFault.eSensorBad; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
        _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 4｜失重速率计算（含噪声闸）：快照推进无条件执行，防恢复时速率踢 / segment 4, the loss rate computation with the noise gate, the snapshot advances unconditionally
_fRateRaw := 0.0; // 原始速率预置零 / preset the raw rate to zero
IF _bInOk AND _bCfgOk THEN // 输入与组态合法 / the input and the config are legal
    _fRateRaw := (_fWPrev - fWeightKg) / fDtS * 3600.0; // 失重速率 = 负变化 / 周期，转千克每小时（除子为周期已证大于零）/ the loss rate converted to kilogram per hour with a proven divisor
    IF ABS(_fRateRaw) > fNoiseLim THEN // 称重突跳超物理限 / the weight jump exceeds the physical limit
        IF NOT _bFault THEN // 未锁存才迁移 / migrate only while unlatched
            _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
            _eFaulC := E_DL_LwfFault.eWeightNoise; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
            _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
        END_IF
        _fRateRaw := 0.0; // 本拍噪声样本不参与 / the noisy sample does not participate
    END_IF
END_IF
_fWPrev := fWeightKg; // 快照推进（无条件）/ the snapshot advances unconditionally

// 段 5｜相位机：ENUM + CASE，含 ELSE 非法相位兜底（R128）/ segment 5, the phase machine with an ELSE fallback
CASE _ePhase OF
E_DL_LwfPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相：等启动沿 / the idle phase, waiting for the start edge
    IF bEnable AND (NOT _bFault) AND rtStart.Q THEN // 启动沿受理 / the start edge is accepted
        _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eDose; // 迁给料相 / migrate to the dose phase
    END_IF

E_DL_LwfPhase.eDose: // 给料相：PI 闭环 + 批量累计 + 低料位切换 / the dose phase, the PI loop, the accumulation and the refill switch
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
        _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / back to idle
    ELSE // 正常给料 / the normal feeding
        IF fRateFiltT > 0.0 THEN // 低通开启 / the low pass is on
            _fW := fDtS / (fDtS + fRateFiltT); // 一阶低通权，除子已证大于零 / the first order weight with a proven divisor
            _fRateF := _fRateF + _fW * (_fRateRaw - _fRateF); // 速率低通推进 / advance the rate low pass
        ELSE // 直通口径 / the passthrough
            _fRateF := _fRateRaw; // 原始速率直通 / the raw rate passes through
        END_IF
        fBatchAcc := fBatchAcc + _fRateF * fDtS / 3600.0; // 批量累计（千克每小时 × 秒 / 3600）/ accumulate the batch
        _fE := fRateSp - _fRateF; // 速率误差 / the rate error
        _fUPre := fKp * _fE + _fI; // 限幅前输出（比例 + 积分保持量）/ the pre clamp output
        IF NOT ((_fUPre >= fOutMax) AND (_fE > 0.0)) THEN // 未沿误差方向饱和才积分（抗 windup）/ the integration is gated against the saturation direction
            _fI := _fI + (fKp / fTi) * _fE * fDtS; // 积分推进，除子为积分时间已证大于零 / the integral step with the proven divisor
        END_IF
        _fUPre := fKp * _fE + _fI; // 积分后重算 / recompute after the integral
        IF _fUPre < 0.0 THEN // 下限钳零 / clamp the floor to zero
            fRateOut := 0.0; // 输出归零 / the output is zeroed
        ELSIF _fUPre > fOutMax THEN // 上限钳制 / clamp the ceiling
            fRateOut := fOutMax; // 钳到上限 / clamp to the ceiling
        ELSE // 域内 / inside the domain
            fRateOut := _fUPre; // 直接出口 / straight to the outlet
        END_IF
        IF fBatchAcc >= fBatchTarget THEN // 批量达标 / the batch target is reached
            _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eDone; // 迁完成相 / migrate to the done phase
        ELSIF fWeightKg <= fLowWeightKg THEN // 低料位触发补料 / the low weight triggers the refill
            fRateOut := 0.0; // 补料前输出归零（冻结语义）/ the output zeroes before the refill
            _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eRefill; // 迁补料相 / migrate to the refill phase
        ELSIF tonNoRate.Q THEN // 输出非零而速率长期为零 / a nonzero output with a void rate
            _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
            _eFaulC := E_DL_LwfFault.eNoLossRate; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
            _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
        END_IF
    END_IF

E_DL_LwfPhase.eRefill: // 补料相：计量冻结，等完成沿（退出条件 ≥2：完成沿 / 超时 / 失能，R98）/ the refill phase with the metering frozen, at least two exit conditions
    fRateOut := 0.0; // 输出保持归零（R191 冻结语义显式声明）/ the output holds zeroed per the declared frozen semantics
    bRefilling := TRUE; // 补料指示 / the refilling indicator
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
        _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / back to idle
    ELSIF rtRefillD.Q THEN // 补料完成沿 / the refill done edge
        _fI := 0.0; // 积分项清零（恢复后重新爬坡）/ clear the integral for a fresh ramp
        _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eDose; // 迁回给料相 / migrate back to the dose phase
    ELSIF tonRefill.Q THEN // 补料超时 / the refill timed out
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaulC := E_DL_LwfFault.eRefillTimeout; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
        _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF

E_DL_LwfPhase.eDone: // 完成相：输出归零，等复位或新启动 / the done phase, the output zeroes until reset or a new start
    fRateOut := 0.0; // 输出归零 / the output is zeroed
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
        _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / back to idle
    ELSIF rtStart.Q THEN // 新启动沿 / a new start edge
        fBatchAcc := 0.0; // 批量累计清零 / clear the batch accumulation
        _fI := 0.0; // 积分项清零 / clear the integral term
        _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eDose; // 迁给料相 / migrate to the dose phase
    END_IF

E_DL_LwfPhase.eFault: // 故障相：输出归零，成因锁存，等复位沿 / the fault phase, the output zeroes until the reset edge
    fRateOut := 0.0; // 输出安全侧归零 / the output takes the safe side zero
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
        _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eIdle; // 迁未使能相 / migrate to idle
    END_IF

ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R128）/ the illegal phase fallback
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaulC := E_DL_LwfFault.ePhaseBad; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
    _ePhase := E_DL_LwfPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 6｜统一出口 / segment 6, the unified outlet
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eFault := _eFaulC; // 故障级成因锁存回放（R152）/ the fault cause replayed from the latch
ELSE
    eFault := E_DL_LwfFault.eNone; // 无锁存即无成因 / no latch, no cause
END_IF
bDosing := (_ePhase = E_DL_LwfPhase.eDose); // 给料指示（相位派生）/ the dosing indicator derived from the phase
bRefilling := (_ePhase = E_DL_LwfPhase.eRefill); // 补料指示（相位派生）/ the refilling indicator derived from the phase
ePhase := _ePhase; // 相位出口单点映射 / single point phase outlet mapping
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: UV 固化需要保证累计剂量达标而非只看光强：按光强乘曝晒时间积分累计剂量，与目标剂量比较后调节光强输出百分比，达到目标置完成脉冲；灯管老化用外部补偿系数折算有效光强，光强非有限或低于起辉阈值判灯弱并不累计，剂量超目标一定比例判超剂，累计量做溢出保护，只输出调光指令不含镇流器驱动。
architecture_thought: 剂量积分闭环架构：段 0 无条件刷新采样沿与积分步；有效光强由实测乘老化补偿系数得，低于起辉阈值判灯弱不累计；剂量按光强乘时间步梯形积分并做上限溢出保护；达目标置完成脉冲并按超剂比例判超剂；调光输出按剂量缺口比例调节并钳 0~100%；光强非有限当拍不累计并置传感器坏；出口含剂量/调光输出/完成脉冲/诊断，CASE 含 ELSE 兜底。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_UvDoseCtrl
  分类   Category   : DL_Algo
  复杂度 Complexity  : cx5
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : UV 剂量控制。剂量 = 光强 × 曝晒时间（D = ∫I·kLamp·dt），
                      按剩余剂量误差 PI 闭环调光强输出（0..100%），累计达目标置
                      bDoseDone 单拍脉冲；灯管老化补偿系数 kLamp 外部给定；光强
                      非有限 / 负值闸；累计溢出保护；满输出长期照度不足判
                      eLampWeak；过冲超容差判 eDoseOvershoot。
  来源   Source     : 自研线（公开物理定义：剂量 = 强度 × 时间积分）
  溯源   Origin     : IEC 61131-3 标准语义的道莅防御性实现；UV 剂量定义为公开
                      光化学语义，clean-room 自研实现，未复制任何闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（TON / R_TRIG / LREAL，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R56）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只算调光输出与剂量累计，不驱动灯管电源本体（属主边界）；
                      二 bRun = FALSE 时调光输出归零、累计冻结保持（R191 显式声明）；
                      三 剂量累计溢出保护：累计达 1.0E9 mJ/cm² 上限即饱和（远超
                         任何工艺目标，防长跑溢出，R63 反算：1.0E9 在 LREAL 精确可表）；
                      四 故障锁存解除路径 = bReset 上升沿（唯一路径，R188）；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      fDimPct 恒在 [0, 100]；fDoseAcc 为累计剂量 [毫焦每平方厘米]；
                      bDoseDone 为单拍脉冲（内部 _bDoneInt 置位、统一出口映射后撤销，
                      R187 两段式）；eFault 为锁存回放；
                      ePhaseBad 为非法相位兜底专用成员（R128）。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R56 首版（批 4 · 序号 17）
  ==================================================================
*)

TYPE E_DL_UdcPhase :
(
    eIdle  := 0,  // 空闲：等运行电平 / idle, waiting for the run level
    eDose  := 10, // 照射：闭环调光与剂量累计 / dosing, the closed loop dimming and the accumulation
    eDone  := 20, // 达标：脉冲已出，灯关驻留 / done, the pulse was raised and the lamp is off
    eFault := 90  // 故障：成因锁存，灯关 / fault, the cause is latched with the lamp off
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_UdcFault :
(
    eNone          := 0, // 无成因 / no cause
    eLampWeak      := 1, // 满输出照度不足（灯管老化，故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the intensity is weak at a full output, an aged lamp, fault grade paired with bError
    eDoseOvershoot := 2, // 剂量过冲超容差（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the dose overshot the tolerance, fault grade paired with bError
    eSensorBad     := 3, // 光强非有限或负值（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the intensity is non finite or negative, fault grade paired with bError
    ePhaseBad      := 4  // 非法相位兜底（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal phase fallback, fault grade paired with bError
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_UvDoseCtrl
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable    : BOOL := TRUE;    // 使能，失能时停判级回空闲 [-] / enable, the grading stops when disabled
    bReset     : BOOL := FALSE;   // 复位上升沿清故障锁存并剂量归零重批 [-] / reset rising edge clears the latch and zeroes the dose for a fresh batch
    bRun       : BOOL := FALSE;   // 运行电平，真 = 曝晒窗开 [-] / the run level, true opens the exposure window
    fIntensity : LREAL := 0.0;    // 光强实测 [毫瓦每平方厘米] / the measured intensity [milliwatt per square centimetre]
    fDoseTarget: LREAL := 100.0;  // 目标剂量 [毫焦每平方厘米]，域 大于零 / the target dose [millijoule per square centimetre], domain above zero
    kLamp      : LREAL := 1.0;    // 灯管老化补偿系数（有效光强占比），域 0..1 / the lamp ageing compensation factor, domain zero to one
    fKp        : LREAL := 5.0;    // PI 比例增益 [百分比每毫焦] / the PI proportional gain [percent per millijoule]
    fKi        : LREAL := 0.5;    // PI 积分增益 [百分比每毫焦每秒] / the PI integral gain
    fIntMin    : LREAL := 5.0;    // 最小有效照度 [毫瓦每平方厘米]，域 大于零 / the minimum effective intensity, domain above zero
    fOverTolPct: LREAL := 5.0;    // 过冲容差 [百分比]，域 大于零 / the overshoot tolerance [percent], domain above zero
    tWeakTo    : TIME := T#30S;   // 灯弱确认窗 [毫秒]，域 大于零 / the weak lamp confirm window [millisecond], domain above zero
    fDtS       : LREAL := 0.1;    // 调用周期 [秒]，域 大于零 / the call period [second], domain above zero
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fDimPct   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 调光输出 [百分比] / the dimming output [percent]
    bDoseDone : BOOL := FALSE; // 剂量达标单拍脉冲 [-] / the dose done single shot pulse
    fDoseAcc  : LREAL := 0.0;  // 累计剂量 [毫焦每平方厘米] / the accumulated dose [millijoule per square centimetre]
    ePhase    : E_DL_UdcPhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eIdle; // 相位出口 [枚举] / phase outlet [enum]
    eFault    : E_DL_UdcFault := E_DL_UdcFault.eNone; // 成因出口，锁存回放 [枚举] / cause outlet replayed from the latch [enum]
    bError    : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtReset  : R_TRIG; // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonWeak  : TON;    // 灯弱确认窗，段 0 无条件刷新 / the weak lamp window, refreshed unconditionally
    _ePhase  : E_DL_UdcPhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eIdle; // 内部相位，CASE 唯一写入目标 / internal phase, the only CASE write target
    _eFaulC  : E_DL_UdcFault := E_DL_UdcFault.eNone; // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault  : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit   : BOOL := FALSE; // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bDoneInt: BOOL := FALSE; // 达标脉冲内部位，统一出口映射 / internal done bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _bInOk   : BOOL := FALSE; // 光强有限且非负 [-] / the intensity is finite and non negative
    _bCfgOk  : BOOL := FALSE; // 组态参数域内 [-] / the configuration is inside the domain
    _bWeakRaw: BOOL := FALSE; // 满输出照度不足原始判据 [-] / the raw weak lamp verdict
    _fRate   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 剂量率 [毫焦每平方厘米每秒] / the dose rate
    _fE      : LREAL := 0.0;  // 剩余剂量误差 [毫焦每平方厘米] / the remaining dose error
    _fUPre   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 限幅前调光输出 [百分比] / the pre clamp dimming output
    _fI      : LREAL := 0.0;  // 积分项保持量 [百分比] / the integral term holder [percent]
    _fTol    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 过冲绝对容差 [毫焦每平方厘米] / the absolute overshoot tolerance
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支），IN 只串相位闸与状态闸 / segment 0, unconditional refresh with the phase and state gates
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge
tonWeak(IN := _bWeakRaw AND (_ePhase = E_DL_UdcPhase.eDose) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tWeakTo); // 灯弱确认窗，IN 串原始判据与相位闸 / the weak lamp window with the raw verdict and the phase gate

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _ePhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eIdle; // 相位从空闲起步 / the phase starts from idle
    _eFaulC := E_DL_UdcFault.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _fI := 0.0; // 积分项清零 / clear the integral term
    fDoseAcc := 0.0; // 剂量清零 / clear the dose
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清锁存 / 迁相位 / 清剂量与积分（三项逐项声明）/ segment 2, reset edge scope declared item by item
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / the reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaulC := E_DL_UdcFault.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _ePhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eIdle; // 作用域二：迁回空闲相 / scope two, migrate back to idle
    fDoseAcc := 0.0; // 作用域三：清剂量累计 / scope three, clear the dose accumulation
    _fI := 0.0; // 作用域三：清积分项 / scope three, clear the integral term
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态与输入域闸（R151 全覆盖）/ segment 3, the configuration and input domain gates
_bInOk := (fIntensity = fIntensity) AND ((fIntensity - fIntensity) = (fIntensity - fIntensity)) AND (fIntensity >= 0.0); // 光强有限且非负 / the intensity is finite and non negative
_bCfgOk := (fDoseTarget > 0.0) AND (fDoseTarget = fDoseTarget) AND (kLamp >= 0.0) AND (kLamp <= 1.0) AND (kLamp = kLamp) AND (fKp > 0.0) AND (fKp = fKp) AND (fKi >= 0.0) AND (fKi = fKi) AND (fIntMin > 0.0) AND (fIntMin = fIntMin) AND (fOverTolPct > 0.0) AND (fOverTolPct = fOverTolPct) AND (tWeakTo > T#0S) AND (fDtS > 0.0) AND (fDtS = fDtS); // 组态参数域判定 / the configuration domain verdict
IF (NOT _bInOk) OR (NOT _bCfgOk) THEN // 光强无效或组态非法 / a void intensity or an illegal configuration
    IF NOT _bFault THEN // 未锁存才迁移（防同拍抹除）/ migrate only while unlatched
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaulC := E_DL_UdcFault.eSensorBad; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
        _ePhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 4｜相位机：ENUM + CASE，含 ELSE 非法相位兜底（R128）/ segment 4, the phase machine with an ELSE fallback
CASE _ePhase OF
E_DL_UdcPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相：等运行电平 / the idle phase, waiting for the run level
    fDimPct := 0.0; // 灯关 / the lamp is off
    IF bEnable AND (NOT _bFault) AND bRun THEN // 运行电平受理 / the run level is accepted
        _fI := 0.0; // 积分项清零 / clear the integral term
        _ePhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eDose; // 迁照射相 / migrate to the dose phase
    END_IF

E_DL_UdcPhase.eDose: // 照射相：闭环调光 + 剂量累计（退出条件 ≥2：达标 / 过冲 / 灯弱 / 失能 / 停运行，R98）/ the dose phase with at least two exit conditions
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
        fDimPct := 0.0; // 灯关 / the lamp is off
        _ePhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / back to idle
    ELSIF NOT bRun THEN // 曝晒窗关：调光归零、累计冻结保持（R191 显式声明）/ the window closed, the dimming zeroes and the dose freezes
        fDimPct := 0.0; // 灯关 / the lamp is off
        _fI := 0.0; // 积分项清零（防恢复时积分踢）/ clear the integral against a kick on resume
    ELSE // 曝晒中 / exposing
        IF _bInOk AND _bCfgOk THEN // 输入与组态合法 / the input and the config are legal
            _fRate := fIntensity * kLamp; // 剂量率 = 光强 × 老化补偿系数 / the dose rate, the intensity times the factor
            fDoseAcc := fDoseAcc + _fRate * fDtS; // 剂量累计 / accumulate the dose
            IF fDoseAcc > 1.0E9 THEN // 累计溢出保护（饱和口径，R63 反算）/ the overflow protection with the saturation basis
                fDoseAcc := 1.0E9; // 饱和到上限 / saturate at the ceiling
            END_IF
            _fTol := fDoseTarget * fOverTolPct / 100.0; // 过冲绝对容差，除子为常量一百 / the absolute tolerance with the constant divisor
            _fE := fDoseTarget - fDoseAcc; // 剩余剂量误差 / the remaining dose error
            _fUPre := fKp * _fE + _fI; // 限幅前调光输出 / the pre clamp dimming output
            IF NOT ((_fUPre >= 100.0) AND (_fE > 0.0)) THEN // 未沿误差方向饱和才积分（抗 windup）/ the integration is gated against the saturation direction
                _fI := _fI + fKi * _fE * fDtS; // 积分推进 / the integral step
            END_IF
            _fUPre := fKp * _fE + _fI; // 积分后重算 / recompute after the integral
            IF _fUPre < 0.0 THEN // 下限钳零 / clamp the floor to zero
                fDimPct := 0.0; // 输出归零 / the output is zeroed
            ELSIF _fUPre > 100.0 THEN // 上限钳百 / clamp the ceiling to one hundred
                fDimPct := 100.0; // 输出满幅 / the output is full
            ELSE // 域内 / inside the domain
                fDimPct := _fUPre; // 直接出口 / straight to the outlet
            END_IF
            _bWeakRaw := (fDimPct >= 99.0) AND (_fRate < fIntMin); // 满输出照度不足原始判据 / the raw weak lamp verdict
            IF fDoseAcc > fDoseTarget + _fTol THEN // 过冲超容差（优先归因，R190 独立成因）/ the overshoot takes the cause priority
                _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
                _eFaulC := E_DL_UdcFault.eDoseOvershoot; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
                _ePhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
            ELSIF tonWeak.Q THEN // 灯弱确认窗到 / the weak lamp window elapsed
                _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
                _eFaulC := E_DL_UdcFault.eLampWeak; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
                _ePhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
            ELSIF fDoseAcc >= fDoseTarget THEN // 剂量达标 / the dose target is reached
                _bDoneInt := TRUE; // 达标脉冲内部位置位（统一出口映射，R187）/ raise the internal done bit
                _ePhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eDone; // 迁达标相 / migrate to the done phase
            END_IF
        ELSE // 输入或组态非法：灯关防御 / a void input or config, the lamp is off as a defence
            fDimPct := 0.0; // 灯关 / the lamp is off
        END_IF
    END_IF

E_DL_UdcPhase.eDone: // 达标相：灯关驻留，等运行撤或复位 / the done phase, the lamp is off until the run drops or a reset
    fDimPct := 0.0; // 灯关 / the lamp is off
    IF (NOT bEnable) OR (NOT bRun) THEN // 失能或运行撤 / disabled or the run dropped
        _ePhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / back to idle
    END_IF

E_DL_UdcPhase.eFault: // 故障相：灯关，成因锁存，等复位沿 / the fault phase, the lamp is off until the reset edge
    fDimPct := 0.0; // 灯关（安全侧）/ the lamp is off, the safe side
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
        _ePhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eIdle; // 迁未使能相 / migrate to idle
    END_IF

ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R128）/ the illegal phase fallback
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaulC := E_DL_UdcFault.ePhaseBad; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
    _ePhase := E_DL_UdcPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 5｜统一出口 / segment 5, the unified outlet
bDoseDone := _bDoneInt; // 达标脉冲映射本拍值 / map the done pulse for this scan
_bDoneInt := FALSE; // 映射后立即撤销，保证单拍宽度（R187 两段式）/ revoke right after mapping
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eFault := _eFaulC; // 故障级成因锁存回放（R152）/ the fault cause replayed from the latch
ELSE
    eFault := E_DL_UdcFault.eNone; // 无锁存即无成因 / no latch, no cause
END_IF
ePhase := _ePhase; // 相位出口单点映射 / single point phase outlet mapping
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 超声波焊接质量取决于能量输入而非单纯时间：按下降、保压、超声、冷却、抬升顺序推进状态机，超声段用梯形法积分功率得能量，超能量与欠能量双判据加超声超时三路保护，下降超时判机械卡滞；能量与时间参数可组态越界钳位，任一段异常立即停超声并进故障态，输出超声中/焊接完成/能量值与诊断码。
architecture_thought: 焊接顺控状态机架构：eIdle→eDown（下降到位或超时）→eHold（保压）→eSonicOn（超声，功率梯形积分得能量，超能量/欠能量/超时三路保护）→eCool（冷却）→eUp（抬升）→eDone；每相配无条件刷新的定时器，异常统一进 eFault 并立即停超声；能量与时间参数越界钳位；出口含超声中/完成/能量/状态与诊断码，CASE 含 ELSE 落故障安全态。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_UltrasonicWeldCtrl
  分类   Category   : DL_Device
  复杂度 Complexity  : cx5
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : 超声波焊接顺控。相位机 eIdle → eDown → eHold → eSonicOn →
                      eCool → eUp → eDone / eFault；能量积分用梯形法（E += (P +
                      Pprev)/2·dt）；超能量 / 欠能量双判据独立成因（R190）+ 超时
                      看门狗；输出 bSonicActive / bWeldDone / fEnergy。
  来源   Source     : t2-2-lbp
  溯源   Origin     : IEC 61131-3 标准语义的道莅防御性实现；超声焊接能量 / 振幅 /
                      时间三模终点为通用工艺语义，clean-room 自研实现，未复制任何
                      闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（TON / R_TRIG / LREAL，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R56）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  同拍多窗说明（R100）：五个窗互斥 —— 每窗 IN 串「本相」闸，任一时刻只有一个窗
                      在计时；配比约束 tSonicTo > tWeld 在组态域闸内判故障
                      （看门狗窗必须覆盖目标窗）。
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只出焊接命令与能量结算，不驱动换能器电源、不控气缸
                         （属主边界）；
                      二 相级看门狗使能只用相驻留本身（R145）；
                      三 能量梯形积分仅在 eSonicOn 相执行；进入该相时能量清零
                         （单点入口赋值，防跨批残留）；
                      四 故障锁存解除路径 = bReset 上升沿（唯一路径，R188）；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      fAmplitudeCmd 恒在 [0, fAmpMax]；fEnergy 为最近一次焊接结算
                      能量 [焦]；bWeldDone 为单拍脉冲（R187 两段式）；
                      eFault 为锁存回放；ePhaseBad 为非法相位兜底专用成员（R128）。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R56 首版（批 4 · 序号 18）

*)

TYPE E_DL_UwcPhase :
(
    eIdle    := 0,  // 空闲：等启动沿 / idle, waiting for the start edge
    eDown    := 10, // 下压：等到位反馈 / down, waiting for the position feedback
    eHold    := 20, // 保压：保压计时 / holding, the hold timing
    eSonicOn := 30, // 超声：能量积分与双判据 / sonic on, the energy integral with the twin verdicts
    eCool    := 40, // 冷却：冷却计时 / cooling, the cool timing
    eUp      := 50, // 回升：等原位反馈 / up, waiting for the home feedback
    eDone    := 60, // 完成：结算驻留 / done, the settlement holds
    eFault   := 90  // 故障：成因锁存，超声撤 / fault, the cause is latched with the sonic off
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_UwcFault :
(
    eNone         := 0, // 无成因 / no cause
    eEnergyHigh   := 1, // 能量超上限（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the energy is over the ceiling, fault grade paired with bError
    eEnergyLow    := 2, // 焊接窗耗尽能量仍低于下限（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the window expired with the energy below the floor, fault grade paired with bError
    eSonicTimeout := 3, // 超声相看门狗超时（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the sonic phase watchdog timed out, fault grade paired with bError
    eDownTimeout  := 4, // 下压相超时（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the down phase timed out, fault grade paired with bError
    eUpTimeout    := 5, // 回升相超时（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the up phase timed out, fault grade paired with bError
    eSensorBad    := 6, // 功率非有限或组态非法（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ the power is non finite or the config illegal, fault grade paired with bError
    ePhaseBad     := 7  // 非法相位兜底（故障级，与 bError 配对）/ illegal phase fallback, fault grade paired with bError
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_UltrasonicWeldCtrl
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable     : BOOL := TRUE;    // 使能，失能时停顺控回空闲 [-] / enable, the sequence stops when disabled
    bReset      : BOOL := FALSE;   // 复位上升沿清故障锁存 [-] / reset rising edge clears the fault latch
    bStart      : BOOL := FALSE;   // 焊接启动脉冲，上升沿受理 [-] / the weld start pulse, accepted on the rising edge
    bAbort      : BOOL := FALSE;   // 中止（电平），任何中间态撤超声回空闲 [-] / the abort level, any middle phase withdraws the sonic
    bPosDownFb  : BOOL := FALSE;   // 焊接位置到位反馈 [-] / the weld position feedback
    bPosUpFb    : BOOL := TRUE;    // 原位反馈 [-] / the home position feedback
    fPowerW     : LREAL := 0.0;    // 超声功率实测 [瓦] / the measured sonic power [watt]
    fAmpSet     : LREAL := 60.0;   // 振幅设定 [百分比]，域 0..100 / the amplitude setpoint [percent], domain zero to one hundred
    fAmpMax     : LREAL := 100.0;  // 振幅上限 [百分比] / the amplitude ceiling [percent]
    fEnergyMinJ : LREAL := 50.0;   // 能量下限 [焦] / the energy floor [joule]
    fEnergyTgtJ : LREAL := 200.0;  // 能量目标 [焦]，域 大于下限 / the energy target [joule], above the floor
    fEnergyMaxJ : LREAL := 300.0;  // 能量上限 [焦]，域 大于目标 / the energy ceiling [joule], above the target
    tHold       : TIME := T#500MS; // 保压时长 [毫秒] / the hold duration [millisecond]
    tWeld       : TIME := T#3S;    // 焊接目标窗 [毫秒] / the weld target window [millisecond]
    tSonicTo    : TIME := T#5S;    // 超声相看门狗窗 [毫秒]，域 大于 tWeld / the sonic watchdog window, above the weld window
    tCool       : TIME := T#1S;    // 冷却时长 [毫秒] / the cool duration [millisecond]
    tDownTo     : TIME := T#5S;    // 下压超时窗 [毫秒] / the down timeout window [millisecond]
    tUpTo       : TIME := T#5S;    // 回升超时窗 [毫秒] / the up timeout window [millisecond]
    fDtS        : LREAL := 0.01;   // 调用周期 [秒]，域 大于零 / the call period [second], domain above zero
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bSonicActive  : BOOL := FALSE; // 超声激活命令（相位派生电平）[-] / the sonic active command, a phase derived level
    fAmplitudeCmd : LREAL := 0.0;  // 振幅命令输出 [百分比] / the amplitude command outlet [percent]
    bWeldDone     : BOOL := FALSE; // 焊接完成单拍脉冲 [-] / the weld done single shot pulse
    fEnergy       : LREAL := 0.0;  // 最近一次焊接结算能量 [焦] / the settled energy of the last weld [joule]
    ePhase        : E_DL_UwcPhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eIdle; // 相位出口 [枚举] / phase outlet [enum]
    eFault        : E_DL_UwcFault := E_DL_UwcFault.eNone; // 成因出口，锁存回放 [枚举] / cause outlet replayed from the latch [enum]
    bError        : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障锁存标志 [-] / fault latch flag
END_VAR
VAR
    rtStart  : R_TRIG; // 启动沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / start edge, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    rtReset  : R_TRIG; // 复位沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / reset edge, refreshed unconditionally in segment zero
    tonDown  : TON;    // 下压超时窗，段 0 无条件刷新 / the down timeout window, refreshed unconditionally
    tonHold  : TON;    // 保压计时窗，段 0 无条件刷新 / the hold timing window, refreshed unconditionally
    tonWeld  : TON;    // 焊接目标窗，段 0 无条件刷新 / the weld target window, refreshed unconditionally
    tonSonic : TON;    // 超声看门狗窗，段 0 无条件刷新 / the sonic watchdog window, refreshed unconditionally
    tonCool  : TON;    // 冷却计时窗，段 0 无条件刷新 / the cool timing window, refreshed unconditionally
    tonUp    : TON;    // 回升超时窗，段 0 无条件刷新 / the up timeout window, refreshed unconditionally
    _ePhase  : E_DL_UwcPhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eIdle; // 内部相位，CASE 唯一写入目标 / internal phase, the only CASE write target
    _eFaulC  : E_DL_UwcFault := E_DL_UwcFault.eNone; // 故障级成因，锁存至复位沿 / fault cause, latched until the reset edge
    _bFault  : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障锁存位 [-] / fault latch bit
    _bInit   : BOOL := FALSE; // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）/ first scan initialisation flag
    _bDoneInt: BOOL := FALSE; // 完成脉冲内部位，统一出口映射 / internal done bit, mapped at the unified outlet
    _bInOk   : BOOL := FALSE; // 功率有限 [-] / the power is finite
    _bCfgOk  : BOOL := FALSE; // 组态参数域内 [-] / the configuration is inside the domain
    _fPwPrev : LREAL := 0.0;  // 上拍功率快照 [瓦] / previous scan power snapshot [watt]
    _fEnergyW: LREAL := 0.0;  // 能量积分工作值 [焦] / the energy integral working value [joule]
    _fAmpUse : LREAL := 60.0;  // 钳定后的振幅 [百分比] / the clamped amplitude [percent]
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支），IN 只串相位闸与故障闸（FB50-1）/ segment 0, unconditional refresh, no instance call inside a branch
rtStart(CLK := bStart); // 启动沿 / the start edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
tonDown(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_UwcPhase.eDown) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tDownTo); // 下压超时窗 / the down timeout window
tonHold(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_UwcPhase.eHold) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tHold); // 保压计时窗 / the hold timing window
tonWeld(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_UwcPhase.eSonicOn) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tWeld); // 焊接目标窗 / the weld target window
tonSonic(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_UwcPhase.eSonicOn) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tSonicTo); // 超声看门狗窗 / the sonic watchdog window
tonCool(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_UwcPhase.eCool) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tCool); // 冷却计时窗 / the cool timing window
tonUp(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_UwcPhase.eUp) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tUpTo); // 回升超时窗 / the up timeout window

// 段 1｜首扫初始化（R310）/ segment 1, first scan initialisation
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首扫一拍 / the very first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首扫完成标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eIdle; // 相位从空闲起步 / the phase starts from idle
    _eFaulC := E_DL_UwcFault.eNone; // 故障级成因清零 / clear the fault cause
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存清零 / clear the fault latch
    _fPwPrev := fPowerW; // 快照取当拍 / the snapshot takes this scan
END_IF

// 段 2｜复位沿作用域：清锁存 / 迁相位 / 清能量工作值（三项逐项声明）/ segment 2, reset edge scope declared item by item
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿 / the reset edge
    _bFault := FALSE; // 作用域一：清故障锁存 / scope one, clear the fault latch
    _eFaulC := E_DL_UwcFault.eNone; // 作用域一：清故障级成因 / scope one, clear the fault cause
    _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eIdle; // 作用域二：迁回空闲相 / scope two, migrate back to idle
    _fEnergyW := 0.0; // 作用域三：清能量工作值（结算出口 fEnergy 保持）/ scope three, the integral clears while the settlement holds
END_IF

// 段 3｜组态与输入域闸（R151 全覆盖，含 R100 配比）/ segment 3, the configuration gate with the window pairing
_bInOk := (fPowerW = fPowerW) AND ((fPowerW - fPowerW) = (fPowerW - fPowerW)) AND (fPowerW >= 0.0); // 功率有限且非负 / the power is finite and non negative
_bCfgOk := (fAmpSet >= 0.0) AND (fAmpSet = fAmpSet) AND (fAmpMax > 0.0) AND (fAmpMax = fAmpMax) AND (fEnergyMinJ > 0.0) AND (fEnergyMinJ = fEnergyMinJ) AND (fEnergyTgtJ > fEnergyMinJ) AND (fEnergyTgtJ = fEnergyTgtJ) AND (fEnergyMaxJ > fEnergyTgtJ) AND (fEnergyMaxJ = fEnergyMaxJ) AND (tHold > T#0S) AND (tWeld > T#0S) AND (tSonicTo > tWeld) AND (tCool > T#0S) AND (tDownTo > T#0S) AND (tUpTo > T#0S) AND (fDtS > 0.0) AND (fDtS = fDtS); // 组态参数域判定（含 tSonicTo > tWeld 配比，R100）/ the configuration verdict with the pairing
IF (NOT _bInOk) OR (NOT _bCfgOk) THEN // 功率无效或组态非法 / a void power or an illegal configuration
    IF NOT _bFault THEN // 未锁存才迁移（防同拍抹除）/ migrate only while unlatched
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaulC := E_DL_UwcFault.eSensorBad; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF
END_IF
_fAmpUse := fAmpSet; // 振幅直通 / the amplitude passes through
IF _fAmpUse > fAmpMax THEN // 振幅上钳（R117 两级回退）/ clamp the amplitude high
    _fAmpUse := fAmpMax; // 钳到上限 / clamp to the ceiling
END_IF

// 段 4｜相位机：ENUM + CASE，含 ELSE 非法相位兜底（R128）/ segment 4, the phase machine with an ELSE fallback
CASE _ePhase OF
E_DL_UwcPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相：等启动沿 / the idle phase, waiting for the start edge
    IF bEnable AND (NOT _bFault) AND (NOT bAbort) AND rtStart.Q THEN // 启动沿受理 / the start edge is accepted
        _fEnergyW := 0.0; // 能量工作值清零 / clear the energy integral
        _fPwPrev := 0.0; // 功率快照清零 / clear the power snapshot
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eDown; // 迁下压相 / migrate to the down phase
    END_IF

E_DL_UwcPhase.eDown: // 下压相：等到位反馈（退出条件 ≥2：到位 / 超时 / 中止 / 失能，R98）/ the down phase with at least two exit conditions
    IF (NOT bEnable) OR bAbort THEN // 失能或中止 / disabled or aborting
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / back to idle
    ELSIF bPosDownFb THEN // 到位 / the position is reached
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eHold; // 迁保压相 / migrate to the hold phase
    ELSIF tonDown.Q THEN // 下压超时 / the down phase timed out
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaulC := E_DL_UwcFault.eDownTimeout; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF

E_DL_UwcPhase.eHold: // 保压相：保压计时 / the hold phase, the hold timing
    IF (NOT bEnable) OR bAbort THEN // 失能或中止 / disabled or aborting
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / back to idle
    ELSIF tonHold.Q THEN // 保压时长已到 / the hold duration elapsed
        _fEnergyW := 0.0; // 能量积分入口清零（单点入口赋值，防跨批残留）/ the entry zeroing of the energy integral
        _fPwPrev := 0.0; // 功率快照入口清零 / the entry zeroing of the power snapshot
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eSonicOn; // 迁超声相 / migrate to the sonic phase
    END_IF

E_DL_UwcPhase.eSonicOn: // 超声相：梯形能量积分 + 双判据 + 看门狗 / the sonic phase, the trapezoid integral with the twin verdicts and the watchdog
    IF (NOT bEnable) OR bAbort THEN // 失能或中止 / disabled or aborting
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / back to idle
    ELSE // 焊接中 / welding
        IF _bInOk THEN // 功率有限 / the power is finite
            _fEnergyW := _fEnergyW + (fPowerW + _fPwPrev) / 2.0 * fDtS; // 梯形法能量积分，除子无（乘法口径）/ the trapezoid energy integral
            _fPwPrev := fPowerW; // 功率快照推进 / advance the power snapshot
        END_IF
        fEnergy := _fEnergyW; // 能量出口实时跟随 / the energy outlet follows live
        IF _fEnergyW > fEnergyMaxJ THEN // 超能量判据（R190 独立成因）/ the over energy criterion, an independent cause
            _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
            _eFaulC := E_DL_UwcFault.eEnergyHigh; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
            _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
        ELSIF tonSonic.Q THEN // 看门狗超时（覆盖目标窗的兜底，R100）/ the watchdog expired, the fallback over the target window
            _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
            _eFaulC := E_DL_UwcFault.eSonicTimeout; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
            _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
        ELSIF tonWeld.Q THEN // 焊接目标窗耗尽 / the weld target window expired
            IF _fEnergyW < fEnergyMinJ THEN // 欠能量判据（R190 独立成因）/ the under energy criterion, an independent cause
                _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
                _eFaulC := E_DL_UwcFault.eEnergyLow; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
                _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
            ELSE // 能量在窗内，按时间终点收焊 / the energy is inside the window, the time based close
                _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eCool; // 迁冷却相 / migrate to the cool phase
            END_IF
        ELSIF _fEnergyW >= fEnergyTgtJ THEN // 能量达标（优先终点）/ the energy target is reached, the primary end
            _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eCool; // 迁冷却相 / migrate to the cool phase
        END_IF
    END_IF

E_DL_UwcPhase.eCool: // 冷却相：冷却计时 / the cool phase, the cool timing
    IF (NOT bEnable) OR bAbort THEN // 失能或中止 / disabled or aborting
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / back to idle
    ELSIF tonCool.Q THEN // 冷却时长已到 / the cool duration elapsed
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eUp; // 迁回升相 / migrate to the up phase
    END_IF

E_DL_UwcPhase.eUp: // 回升相：等原位反馈（退出条件 ≥2：原位 / 超时 / 中止 / 失能，R98）/ the up phase with at least two exit conditions
    IF (NOT bEnable) OR bAbort THEN // 失能或中止 / disabled or aborting
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / back to idle
    ELSIF bPosUpFb THEN // 原位 / the home position is reached
        _bDoneInt := TRUE; // 完成脉冲内部位置位（统一出口映射，R187）/ raise the internal done bit
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eDone; // 迁完成相 / migrate to the done phase
    ELSIF tonUp.Q THEN // 回升超时 / the up phase timed out
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
        _eFaulC := E_DL_UwcFault.eUpTimeout; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF

E_DL_UwcPhase.eDone: // 完成相：结算驻留，等复位或新启动 / the done phase, the settlement holds until reset or a new start
    IF (NOT bEnable) OR rtStart.Q THEN // 失能或新启动沿 / disabled or a new start edge
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲相 / back to idle
    END_IF

E_DL_UwcPhase.eFault: // 故障相：超声撤，成因锁存，等复位沿 / the fault phase, the sonic off until the reset edge
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
        _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eIdle; // 迁未使能相 / migrate to idle
    END_IF

ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R128）/ the illegal phase fallback
    _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / raise the fault latch
    _eFaulC := E_DL_UwcFault.ePhaseBad; // 故障级成因（R45 配对 bError）/ the fault cause paired with bError
    _ePhase := E_DL_UwcPhase.eFault; // 迁故障相 / migrate to the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 6｜命令出口派生（互斥的结构性承载）/ segment 6, the command outlets, the structural carrier
bSonicActive := (_ePhase = E_DL_UwcPhase.eSonicOn) AND (NOT _bFault) AND bEnable AND (NOT bAbort); // 超声激活命令：仅超声相派生 / the sonic command, derived in the sonic phase only
IF bSonicActive THEN // 超声激活拍 / the sonic active scan
    fAmplitudeCmd := _fAmpUse; // 振幅命令出口 / the amplitude command outlet
ELSE // 非激活拍 / the inactive scan
    fAmplitudeCmd := 0.0; // 振幅归零（安全侧）/ the amplitude zeroes, the safe side
END_IF

// 段 7｜统一出口 / segment 7, the unified outlet
bWeldDone := _bDoneInt; // 完成脉冲映射本拍值 / map the done pulse for this scan
_bDoneInt := FALSE; // 映射后立即撤销，保证单拍宽度（R187 两段式）/ revoke right after mapping
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存优先 / the fault latch takes priority
    eFault := _eFaulC; // 故障级成因锁存回放（R152）/ the fault cause replayed from the latch
ELSE
    eFault := E_DL_UwcFault.eNone; // 无锁存即无成因 / no latch, no cause
END_IF
ePhase := _ePhase; // 相位出口单点映射 / single point phase outlet mapping
bError := _bFault; // 故障标志与锁存位同源 / the fault flag shares the latch source
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 工件测头测量需要完整循环而非单点锁存：按快进、慢探、触发锁存、退回、稳定、记录的顺序推进，快进与慢探两段速度分离保证不撞头，触发用边沿锁存值记录（锁存副本与实时镜像严格分离，不用实时值做记录），超行程立即反向退回并置故障；重复测量按离散度判稳定，输出测量位置/有效标志/状态与诊断码。
architecture_thought: 测量循环状态机架构：eIdle→eFastApproach（快进）→eProbeLatch（慢探，触发沿锁存位置到锁存变量，记录只用锁存值不用实时镜像）→eRetract→eSettle（稳定定时器）→eRecord→eDone；超行程立即反向退回并置故障；重复测量按多次锁存位置的离散度判稳定；段 0 无条件刷新触发沿与各段定时器；出口含测量位置/有效标志/状态/诊断，CASE 含 ELSE 落退回安全态。
output:
(*

  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_AxisProbeMeasCycle
  分类   Category   : DL_Motion
  复杂度 Complexity  : cx5
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  功能   Purpose    : 探针测量循环。相位机 eIdle → eFastApproach → eProbeLatch →
                      eRetract → eSettle → eRecord → eDone / eFault；快进 - 慢探
                      两段速度；探针触发用 R_TRIG 边沿锁存（锁存值用于记录，
                      禁与实时镜像混用）；超行程保护；nRepeat 次重复测量后做
                      离散度判据（max - min 对容差），超差判 eScatterHigh。
  来源   Source     : t2-2-lbp（与 FB_DL_MarkPositionLatch 分工：锁存原子 vs 完整测量循环）
  溯源   Origin     : IEC 61131-3 标准语义的道莅防御性实现；趋近 - 触发锁存 - 回退 -
                      评价测量循环为通用测量语义，clean-room 自研实现，未复制任何
                      闭源代码行。
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（TON / R_TRIG / ARRAY / LREAL，无私有库）
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R56）
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  同拍多窗说明（R100）：四个窗互斥 —— 每窗 IN 串「本相」闸，任一时刻只有一个窗
                      在计时，无同拍双窗配比约束。
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 本件只出速度命令与测量结论，不驱动轴本体、不解算几何尺寸
                         （属主边界）；
                      二 锁存纪律：_fMeasPos 只在触发沿那一拍由 fPosAct 写入一次，
                         其后评价一律用锁存值（R33 锁存副本与实时镜像不混用）；
                      三 相级看门狗使能只用相驻留本身（R145）；
                      四 故障锁存解除路径 = bReset 上升沿（唯一路径，R188）；
                      五 无全局变量、无外部变量声明、无物理地址寻址。
  输出契约 Output contract:
                      fVelCmd 为速度命令（快进 / 慢探 / 回退三档）；fMeasPos 为
                      nRepeat 次均值；bMeasValid 为单拍脉冲（R187 两段式）；
                      eFault 为锁存回放；ePhaseBad 为非法相位兜底专用成员（R128）。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-20  v1.0.0  R56 首版（批 4 · 序号 19）
