TYPE E_DL_DryerPhase :
(
    eDrying := 0,  // 吸附相：干燥塔在工作 / the drying phase, the tower working
    eRegen  := 10, // 再生相：再生阀开 / the regeneration phase, the valve open
    eFault  := 20  // 故障相：锁存待复位 / the fault phase latched until the reset
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_AirDryerDiag
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable     : BOOL := TRUE;   // 使能，FALSE 时冻结诊断出口（R191 声明行）/ the enable, false freezes the diagnosis outlet
    bReset      : BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存 / the fault reset level
    bRegenValve : BOOL := FALSE;  // 再生阀开反馈电平 [-] / the regeneration valve open feedback
    fDewPnt     : LREAL := -40.0; // 露点实测值 [摄氏度] / the measured dew point
    fDewLim     : LREAL := -20.0; // 露点上限 [摄氏度] / the dew point limit
    tCycleNom   : TIME := T#6H;   // 名义再生切换周期 [毫秒] / the nominal switch cycle
    fDeg1Ratio  : LREAL := 1.3;   // 劣化一档比值阈 [-] / the degradation level one ratio threshold
    fDeg2Ratio  : LREAL := 1.8;   // 劣化二档比值阈 [-] / the degradation level two ratio threshold
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    eState     : E_DL_DryerPhase;       // 主状态机当前态 [状态] / the current state
    bDewHigh   : BOOL := FALSE;         // 露点越限锁存指示 [-] / the dew over limit latched indicator
    bDeg1      : BOOL := FALSE;         // 劣化一档指示（信息级逐拍）[-] / the degradation level one indicator
    bDeg2      : BOOL := FALSE;         // 劣化二档锁存指示 [-] / the degradation level two latched indicator
    bError     : BOOL := FALSE;         // 故障锁存位（与锁存同源，R191）/ the fault bit from the latch
    bValid     : BOOL := FALSE;         // 诊断可用标志 [-] / the diagnosis usable flag
    eErr       : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit     : BOOL := FALSE; // 首拍初始化标志（R310）/ the first scan flag
    _eState    : E_DL_DryerPhase := E_DL_DryerPhase.eDrying; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bDewFlt   : BOOL := FALSE; // 露点越限锁存副本 / the dew fault latch copy
    _bDeg2Flt  : BOOL := FALSE; // 劣化二档锁存副本 / the level two latch copy
    _bDewNF    : BOOL := FALSE; // 露点非有限锁存副本 / the dew non finite latch copy
    _bCfgBad   : BOOL := FALSE; // 组态非法锁存副本 / the configuration latch copy
    _bFin      : BOOL := FALSE; // 四浮点引脚非有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the finiteness gate result
    _fRatio    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 实测周期与名义周期比 [-] / the measured to nominal ratio
    _tNomMs    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 名义周期 [毫秒] / the nominal cycle in milliseconds
    _tMeasMs   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 上一周实测周期 [毫秒] / the last measured cycle in milliseconds
    _tPrvSnap  : TIME := T#0S;  // 上拍周期计时快照（R 实战规则 1②）/ the previous cycle timing snapshot
    rtValve    : R_TRIG; // 再生阀开沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the valve open edge instance
    rtReset    : R_TRIG; // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the reset edge instance
    tonCycle   : TON;    // 切换周期实测计时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the cycle measurement timer
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtValve(CLK := bRegenValve); // 再生阀开沿 / the valve open edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
tonCycle(IN := bRegenValve, PT := tCycleNom); // 周期实测（阀开时长累计）/ the cycle timing during the valve open
IF rtValve.Q THEN // 新一周开始：锁存上一周时长快照（周界沿取快照）/ a new cycle latches the last duration snapshot
    _tPrvSnap := tonCycle.ET; // 上周时长快照 / the last duration snapshot
END_IF

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与复位沿作用域（R310 / R311）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the reset scope
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bDewFlt := FALSE; // 露点锁存显式清零 / clear the dew latch explicitly
    _bDeg2Flt := FALSE; // 劣化二档锁存显式清零 / clear the level two latch explicitly
    _bDewNF := FALSE; // 非有限锁存显式清零 / clear the non finite latch explicitly
    _bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态锁存显式清零 / clear the configuration latch explicitly
    _eState := E_DL_DryerPhase.eDrying; // 状态显式落吸附相 / place the state to drying
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域：清四锁存 + 迁相位，R311 声明）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _bDewFlt := FALSE; // 清露点锁存（解除路径：复位沿恒可达，R152 自证）/ clear the dew latch
    _bDeg2Flt := FALSE; // 清劣化二档锁存 / clear the level two latch
    _bDewNF := FALSE; // 清非有限锁存 / clear the non finite latch
    _bCfgBad := FALSE; // 清组态锁存 / clear the configuration latch
    _eState := E_DL_DryerPhase.eDrying; // 迁回吸附相 / back to drying
END_IF

// 段 2｜非有限闸与组态闸（R272 全量点名，边界一二）/ segment 2, the finiteness and the configuration gates
_bFin := (fDewPnt = fDewPnt) AND ((fDewPnt - fDewPnt) = (fDewPnt - fDewPnt))
AND (fDewLim = fDewLim) AND ((fDewLim - fDewLim) = (fDewLim - fDewLim))
AND (fDeg1Ratio = fDeg1Ratio) AND ((fDeg1Ratio - fDeg1Ratio) = (fDeg1Ratio - fDeg1Ratio))
AND (fDeg2Ratio = fDeg2Ratio) AND ((fDeg2Ratio - fDeg2Ratio) = (fDeg2Ratio - fDeg2Ratio)); // 四浮点引脚逐个自反 + 差值判 / the four floating pins tested one by one
IF NOT _bFin THEN // 入参非有限（露点成因独立锁存，R190）/ a non finite input latches the dew cause
    _bDewNF := TRUE; // 锁存非有限（070D）/ latch the non finite cause
END_IF
IF (fDeg1Ratio <= 1.0) OR (fDeg2Ratio <= fDeg1Ratio) OR (tCycleNom <= T#0S) THEN // 组态递增配比违反（边界二）/ the configuration monotone ratio violated
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 锁存组态非法（070F）/ latch the configuration fault
END_IF
_tNomMs := DINT_TO_LREAL(TIME_TO_DINT(tCycleNom)); // 名义周期毫秒化（TIME 口径，边界五）/ the nominal cycle in milliseconds

// 段 3｜露点越限判据（有限才判）/ segment 3, the dew over limit criterion
IF _bFin AND (fDewPnt > fDewLim) THEN // 露点越限（070B 独立成因）/ the dew over the limit
    _bDewFlt := TRUE; // 独立锁存 / latch the dew cause
END_IF

// 段 4｜周期比与劣化分档（周界沿快照换算，除零前置证明）/ segment 4, the cycle ratio and the degradation grades
IF rtValve.Q THEN // 新周界沿：换算上周比值 / a new cycle edge converts the last ratio
    _tMeasMs := DINT_TO_LREAL(TIME_TO_DINT(_tPrvSnap)); // 上周时长毫秒化 / the last duration in milliseconds
    IF _tNomMs > 0.0 THEN // 除零防护（组态闸已证 > 0，双保险）/ the division guard doubled
        _fRatio := _tMeasMs / _tNomMs; // 周期比（除子已证 > 0）/ the cycle ratio with a proven divisor
        IF _fRatio >= fDeg2Ratio THEN // 二档劣化（070C 独立成因）/ the level two degradation
            _bDeg2Flt := TRUE; // 独立锁存 / latch the level two cause
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 5｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 兜底，边界三）/ segment 5, the main machine with the ELSE guard
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_DryerPhase.eDrying: // 吸附相 / the drying phase
        IF bRegenValve THEN // 阀开反馈迁入再生相 / the valve open feedback migrates to regen
            _eState := E_DL_DryerPhase.eRegen; // 迁入再生相 / enter the regen phase
        ELSIF _bDewFlt OR _bDeg2Flt OR _bDewNF OR _bCfgBad THEN // 故障迁移（锁存复检，R274）/ the fault migration with the latch recheck
            _eState := E_DL_DryerPhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相 / enter the fault phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_DryerPhase.eRegen: // 再生相 / the regen phase
        IF NOT bRegenValve THEN // 阀关反馈迁回吸附相 / the valve closed feedback back to drying
            _eState := E_DL_DryerPhase.eDrying; // 迁回吸附相 / back to drying
        ELSIF _bDewFlt OR _bDeg2Flt OR _bDewNF OR _bCfgBad THEN // 故障迁移 / the fault migration
            _eState := E_DL_DryerPhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相 / enter the fault phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_DryerPhase.eFault: // 故障相：等复位沿（解除可达，边界四）/ the fault phase until the reset
        IF NOT (_bDewFlt OR _bDeg2Flt OR _bDewNF OR _bCfgBad) THEN // 四锁存已清才迁出（防清锁同拍重锁，FB50-1）/ the exit after all latches cleared
            _eState := E_DL_DryerPhase.eDrying; // 迁回吸附相 / back to drying
        END_IF
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截（兜底码走组态成因回放）/ the illegal enumeration guard
        _eState := E_DL_DryerPhase.eFault; // 落入故障相 / force to the fault phase
        _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 置锁存（ELSE 兜底码走组态成因回放）/ latch the configuration cause
END_CASE

// 段 6｜统一出口（锁存同源映射；一档信息级逐拍重算，R285）/ segment 6, the unified outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bDewHigh := _bDewFlt; // 露点越限出口 / the dew outlet
bDeg2 := _bDeg2Flt; // 二档出口 / the level two outlet
bDeg1 := (NOT _bDeg2Flt) AND (_fRatio >= fDeg1Ratio); // 一档指示（逐拍重算，信息级不置 bError）/ the level one indicator recomputed
bError := _bDewFlt OR _bDeg2Flt OR _bDewNF OR _bCfgBad; // 故障位出口 / the fault bit outlet
bValid := (NOT bError) AND bEnable; // 诊断可用标志 / the usable flag
IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态成因回放优先 / the configuration cause replays first
    eErr := 16#0003_070F; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, the illegal configuration
ELSIF _bDewNF THEN // 非有限成因 / the non finite cause
    eErr := 16#0003_070D; // 故障级：露点入参非有限 / fault grade, the non finite dew input
ELSIF _bDewFlt THEN // 露点越限成因 / the dew cause
    eErr := 16#0003_070B; // 故障级：露点越限 / fault grade, the dew over the limit
ELSIF _bDeg2Flt THEN // 二档成因 / the level two cause
    eErr := 16#0003_070C; // 故障级：切换周期劣化二档 / fault grade, the cycle degradation level two
ELSE // 无故障 / no fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 刀塔/转塔选刀顺控：目标刀位→就近转向→到位确认→锁紧，含跳刀与超时。真实工况：车床 12 工位刀塔换刀。边界：目标位越界拒绝；旋转中禁止反向；到位信号超时判故障并锁存；急停中断后回零。
architecture_thought: 分类 DL_Motion，前缀 FB，来源标签 t2-4-s7-motion。架构：单相顺序 CASE 状态机 + 段 0 无条件刷新定时/边沿实例 + 段末统一出口；防错：入参有限性与域闸点名（R272）、除零/越界钳位、非有限结果兜底落安全零、拒绝路径不清空保留旧值；解耦：仅依赖 IEC 标准函数，无 GVL/外部地址，可跨平台复用；声明区与实现逐标识符交叉核对（R240）。

                      二 就近方向判据整数进位点自证：环差 diff = (req − cur) MOD n，
                         恰对径（diff·2 = n）两向量等长时写死取正向（CW），判据
                         全整数精确比较，无浮点；

TYPE E_DL_TurretPhase :
(
    eIdle   := 0,  // 空闲：等换刀指令沿 / idle, waiting for the change edge
    eMoving := 10, // 换刀进行：等到位反馈 / moving, waiting for the in position feedback
    eFault  := 20  // 故障：组态非法，锁存待复位 / fault, the illegal configuration latched
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_TurretToolSelect
VAR_INPUT
    bExec     : BOOL := FALSE;  // 换刀指令电平，上升沿解算并发单拍 / the change command level
    bInPos    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 刀塔到位反馈电平 [-] / the turret in position feedback
    bReset    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存 / the fault reset level
    uCurTool  : UDINT := 1;     // 当前刀位号 [刀位]，域 [1, 24] / the current tool number
    uReqTool  : UDINT := 1;     // 请求刀位号 [刀位]，域 [1, 24] / the requested tool number
    uToolCnt  : UDINT := 8;     // 刀位总数 [刀位]，合法域 1..24 / the tool count, legal from one to twenty four
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bDirCW      : BOOL := FALSE;          // 方向指示：TRUE 正向（CW）[-] / the direction indicator, true for the forward
    uSteps      : UDINT := 0;             // 换刀步数 [步] / the change step count
    bToolChange : BOOL := FALSE;          // 换刀指令单拍脉冲 [-] / the change command one shot pulse
    bDone       : BOOL := FALSE;          // 换刀完成单拍脉冲 [-] / the change done one shot pulse
    eState      : E_DL_TurretPhase;       // 主状态机当前态 [状态] / the current state
    bError      : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障锁存位（与锁存同源，R191）/ the fault bit from the latch
    bValid      : BOOL := FALSE;          // 解算可用标志 [-] / the solve usable flag
    eErr        : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit    : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 首拍初始化标志（R310）/ the first scan flag
    _eState   : E_DL_TurretPhase := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bFault   : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 组态故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _nCur     : DINT := 1;                            // 钳位后当前刀位 [刀位] / the clamped current tool
    _nReq     : DINT := 1;                            // 钳位后请求刀位 [刀位] / the clamped requested tool
    _nCnt     : DINT := 8;                            // 钳位后刀位数 [刀位] / the clamped tool count
    _nDiff    : DINT := 0;                            // 环差 [步] / the ring difference
    _nSteps   : DINT := 0;                            // 步数工作副本 [步] / the step count copy
    _bCW      : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 方向工作副本 / the direction copy
    _bChange  : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 换刀单拍内部位，段 1 预清段 5 映射 / the internal change bit
    _bDone    : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 完成单拍内部位 / the internal done bit
    _bClamp   : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 钳位标记（逐拍重算）/ the clamp flag recomputed
    rtExec    : R_TRIG; // 换刀指令沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the command edge instance
    rtReset   : R_TRIG; // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the reset edge instance
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_TTS_NMAX : DINT := 24; // 刀位容量上界 [刀位] / the tool capacity bound
END_VAR

// 段 0｜沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtExec(CLK := bExec); // 换刀指令沿 / the command edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿 / the reset edge

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与单拍标志预清（R310 / FB32-1 / R256）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the preset
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域：清锁存 + 迁相位，R311 声明）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _bFault := FALSE; // 清锁存（解除路径：复位沿恒可达，R152 自证）/ clear the latch
    _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
END_IF
_bChange := FALSE; // 换刀单拍预清零 / preset the change bit false
_bDone := FALSE; // 完成单拍预清零 / preset the done bit false
_bClamp := FALSE; // 钳位标记预清零 / preset the clamp flag false

// 段 2｜域闸与钳位（整数全精确，边界一二五）/ segment 2, the domain gate with the clamps
_nCnt := UDINT_TO_DINT(uToolCnt); // 刀位数升位接管 / take the tool count widened
IF (_nCnt < 1) OR (_nCnt > DL_TTS_NMAX) THEN // 刀位数组态非法（0807 → 08A7 独立码）/ the illegal tool count
    _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存故障（08A7）/ latch the fault
END_IF
IF _nCnt < 1 THEN // 下界钳位（防环运算除零取模）/ the floor clamp guarding the modulo
    _nCnt := 1; // 钳到一 / clamp to one
END_IF
IF _nCnt > DL_TTS_NMAX THEN // 上界钳位 / the ceiling clamp
    _nCnt := DL_TTS_NMAX; // 钳到容量 / clamp to the capacity
END_IF
_nCur := UDINT_TO_DINT(uCurTool); // 当前刀位接管 / take the current tool
_nReq := UDINT_TO_DINT(uReqTool); // 请求刀位接管 / take the requested tool
IF (_nCur < 1) OR (_nCur > _nCnt) OR (_nReq < 1) OR (_nReq > _nCnt) THEN // 刀位号越域（信息级钳位，边界一）/ the tool numbers out of the domain
    _bClamp := TRUE; // 置钳位标记 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF
IF _nCur < 1 THEN // 当前刀位下界钳位 / the current floor clamp
    _nCur := 1; // 钳到一 / clamp to one
END_IF
IF _nCur > _nCnt THEN // 当前刀位上界钳位 / the current ceiling clamp
    _nCur := _nCnt; // 钳到总数 / clamp to the count
END_IF
IF _nReq < 1 THEN // 请求刀位下界钳位 / the requested floor clamp
    _nReq := 1; // 钳到一 / clamp to one
END_IF
IF _nReq > _nCnt THEN // 请求刀位上界钳位 / the requested ceiling clamp
    _nReq := _nCnt; // 钳到总数 / clamp to the count
END_IF

// 段 3｜就近方向解算（全整数精确比较，进位点写死取正向，边界二）/ segment 3, the nearest direction solve in exact integers
_nDiff := ((_nReq - _nCur) MOD _nCnt + _nCnt) MOD _nCnt; // 环差归一到 [0, n-1]（双 MOD 防负数取模方言差异）/ the ring difference normalized
IF _nDiff = 0 THEN // 同刀位：零步 / the same tool, zero steps
    _nSteps := 0; // 零步 / zero steps
    _bCW := TRUE; // 零步时方向寄存器按正向表态（无方向语义）/ the direction placeholder forward
ELSIF (_nDiff * 2) = _nCnt THEN // 恰对径（进位点）：两向等长，写死取正向（边界二）/ the diametric point takes the forward by the declared rule
    _nSteps := _nDiff; // 正向步数 / the forward steps
    _bCW := TRUE; // 正向 / forward
ELSIF (_nDiff * 2) < _nCnt THEN // 正向更近 / the forward is nearer
    _nSteps := _nDiff; // 正向步数 / the forward steps
    _bCW := TRUE; // 正向 / forward
ELSE // 反向更近 / the reverse is nearer
    _nSteps := _nCnt - _nDiff; // 反向步数 / the reverse steps
    _bCW := FALSE; // 反向 / reverse
END_IF

// 段 4｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 兜底；指令沿消费带全量闸位复检，R274）/ segment 4, the main machine
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相 / the idle phase
        IF rtExec.Q AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 指令沿 + 闸位复检（R274）/ the command edge with the gate recheck
            IF _nSteps = 0 THEN // 同刀位校验：直接完成（整数精确比较，边界二）/ the same tool verified by the exact integer compare
                _bDone := TRUE; // 置完成单拍 / raise the done bit
            ELSE // 异刀位：发换刀单拍并迁入移动相 / a different tool, raise the change pulse and enter moving
                _bChange := TRUE; // 置换刀单拍 / raise the change bit
                _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eMoving; // 迁入移动相 / enter the moving phase
            END_IF
        END_IF
    E_DL_TurretPhase.eMoving: // 移动相：等到位反馈 / the moving phase
        IF bInPos THEN // 到位反馈（同刀位目标校验后完成）/ the in position feedback
            _bDone := TRUE; // 置完成单拍 / raise the done bit
            _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
        ELSIF _bFault THEN // 前置条件消失出口 / the prerequisite gone exit
            _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
        END_IF
    E_DL_TurretPhase.eFault: // 故障相：等复位沿（解除可达，边界五）/ the fault phase until the reset
        IF NOT _bFault THEN // 锁存已清才迁出 / the exit after the latch cleared
            _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
        END_IF
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截 / the illegal enumeration guard
        _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 落回空闲 / force back to idle
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置锁存 / latch the fault
END_CASE

// 段 5｜统一出口（内部副本单点映射；故障码锁存回放，R187）/ segment 5, the unified outlet
bDirCW := _bCW; // 方向出口 / the direction outlet
uSteps := DINT_TO_UDINT(_nSteps); // 步数出口（值已证非负）/ the step outlet proven non negative
bToolChange := _bChange; // 换刀单拍出口 / the change pulse outlet
bDone := _bDone; // 完成单拍出口 / the done pulse outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bError := _bFault; // 故障位出口（与锁存同源）/ the fault bit outlet
bValid := NOT _bFault; // 解算可用标志 / the solve usable flag
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存回放（R187）/ the latched fault replays
    eErr := 16#0004_08A7; // 故障级：刀位数组态非法 / fault grade, the illegal tool count
ELSIF _bClamp THEN // 钳位（信息级不置 bError，R285）/ the clamp informational
    eErr := 16#0004_08A6; // 信息级：刀位号越域已钳位 / informational, the tool numbers clamped
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

TYPE E_DL_ClearPhase :
(
    eIdle     := 0,  // 空闲：等清线请求沿 / idle, waiting for the clearance request edge
    eSweep    := 10, // 清料相：残留逐件出清 / the sweeping phase, the residues leaving one by one
    eConfirm  := 20, // 确认相：阶段确认窗内等确认沿 / the confirm phase inside the window
    eFault    := 30  // 故障：超窗或组态非法，锁存待复位 / fault, the overrun or the illegal configuration latched
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_LineClearanceVerify
VAR_INPUT
    bClearReq    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 清线请求电平，上升沿发起 / the clearance request level
    bItemOut     : BOOL := FALSE;  // 出料口有料电平 [-] / the item present level at the outlet
    bClearConfirm: BOOL := FALSE;  // 清线确认电平，上升沿确认 / the clearance confirm level
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存 / the fault reset level
    tConfirmWin  : TIME := T#60S;  // 阶段确认窗时长 [毫秒] / the confirm window duration
    nResidueMax  : DINT := 0;      // 残留计数上限 [件]，≥ 0（超限仅提示不阻断）/ the residue count bound, non negative
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    uResidueCnt : UDINT := 0;              // 本轮残留计数 [件] / the residue count of this round
    bClearOk    : BOOL := FALSE;           // 清线通过单拍脉冲 [-] / the clearance passed one shot pulse
    eState      : E_DL_ClearPhase;         // 主状态机当前态 [状态] / the current state
    bError      : BOOL := FALSE;           // 故障锁存位（与锁存同源，R191）/ the fault bit from the latch
    eErr        : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;   // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit     : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 首拍初始化标志（R310）/ the first scan flag
    _eState    : E_DL_ClearPhase := E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bFault    : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _bCfgBad   : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算入锁存）/ the configuration fault flag
    _uResidue  : UDINT := 0;                               // 残留计数副本 [件] / the residue count copy
    _bOk       : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 通过单拍内部位，段 1 预清段 5 映射 / the internal ok bit
    _bEvtTaken : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 本拍确认沿已消化标记（R275）/ the confirm edge consumed flag
    _bCfgLatch : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 组态锁存副本（与 _bCfgBad 区分：锁存型）/ the configuration latch copy
    rtReq      : R_TRIG;  // 清线请求沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the request edge instance
    rtItem     : R_TRIG;  // 出料沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the item out edge instance
    rtConfirm  : R_TRIG;  // 确认沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the confirm edge instance
    rtReset    : R_TRIG;  // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the reset edge instance
    tonWin     : TON;     // 阶段确认窗定时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the confirm window timer
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7；TON IN 串故障锁存门控，FB50-1）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtReq(CLK := bClearReq); // 请求沿 / the request edge
rtItem(CLK := bItemOut); // 出料沿 / the item out edge
rtConfirm(CLK := bClearConfirm); // 确认沿 / the confirm edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
tonWin(IN := (_eState = E_DL_ClearPhase.eConfirm) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tConfirmWin); // 确认窗：仅确认相且无锁存时计时 / the window timing only in the confirm phase

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与单拍标志预清（R310 / FB32-1 / R256）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the preset
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _bCfgLatch := FALSE; // 组态锁存显式清零 / clear the configuration latch explicitly
    _uResidue := 0; // 残留计数显式清零 / clear the residue count explicitly
    _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域：清锁存 + 清计数 + 迁相位，R311 / R243 声明）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _bFault := FALSE; // 清故障锁存（解除路径：复位沿恒可达，R152 自证）/ clear the fault latch
    _bCfgLatch := FALSE; // 清组态锁存 / clear the configuration latch
    _uResidue := 0; // 清残留计数（R243 快照/计数出口入复位清单）/ clear the residue count
    _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
END_IF
_bOk := FALSE; // 通过单拍预清零 / preset the ok bit false
_bEvtTaken := FALSE; // 确认沿消化标记预清零 / preset the consumed flag false
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态标记预清零 / preset the configuration flag false

// 段 2｜组态域闸（边界四）/ segment 2, the configuration gate
IF (tConfirmWin <= T#0S) OR (nResidueMax < 0) THEN // 窗非法或上限负 / an illegal window or a negative bound
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 置组态标记 / raise the configuration flag
    _bCfgLatch := TRUE; // 锁存组态故障（3038）/ latch the configuration fault
    _bFault := TRUE; // 总锁存（段 4 迁移）/ latch the total fault
END_IF

// 段 3｜本拍确认沿预消化（R275：合法事件先于窗口到期迁移消化）/ segment 3, the confirm edge pre digest
IF rtConfirm.Q AND (_eState = E_DL_ClearPhase.eConfirm) AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 确认相内的确认沿 / a confirm edge inside the confirm phase
    _bEvtTaken := TRUE; // 标记本拍已消化（段 4 不再判超窗）/ mark the edge consumed this scan
    _bOk := TRUE; // 置通过单拍 / raise the ok bit
    _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲（本轮通过）/ back to idle with the round passed
END_IF

// 段 4｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 兜底；超窗迁移让位于本拍确认沿，边界二）/ segment 4, the main machine
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相 / the idle phase
        IF rtReq.Q AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 请求沿 + 闸位复检（R274）/ the request edge with the gate recheck
            _uResidue := 0; // 新一轮残留计数归零（整数精确） / reset the residue count by the exact integer
            _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eSweep; // 迁入清料相 / enter the sweeping phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_ClearPhase.eSweep: // 清料相：残留逐件出清 / the sweeping phase
        IF rtItem.Q THEN // 出料沿：残留计一件 / an item out edge counts one residue
            _uResidue := _uResidue + 1; // 残留计数推进 / advance the residue count
        END_IF
        IF (NOT bItemOut) AND (NOT rtItem.Q) THEN // 出料口已空且本拍无新出料沿（整数域判据，边界一）/ the outlet empty with no new edge
            _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eConfirm; // 迁入确认相（确认窗起算）/ enter the confirm phase
        ELSIF _bFault THEN // 前置条件消失出口 / the prerequisite gone exit
            _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相 / enter the fault phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_ClearPhase.eConfirm: // 确认相（本拍确认沿已在段 3 消化并迁出，边界二）/ the confirm phase, the edge already digested in segment three
        IF tonWin.Q AND (NOT _bEvtTaken) THEN // 窗口到期且本拍无确认沿（R275 同拍竞态口径）/ the window expired with no confirm edge this scan
            _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存超窗故障（3037，升级码）/ latch the overrun fault
        ELSIF _bFault THEN // 前置条件消失 / the prerequisite gone
            _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相 / enter the fault phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_ClearPhase.eFault: // 故障相：等复位沿（解除可达，边界三）/ the fault phase until the reset
        IF NOT _bFault THEN // 锁存已清才迁出（防清锁同拍重锁，FB50-1）/ the exit after the latch cleared
            _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
        END_IF
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截 / the illegal enumeration guard
        _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle; // 落回空闲 / force back to idle
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置锁存 / latch the fault
END_CASE

// 段 5｜统一出口（内部副本单点映射；故障码锁存回放，R187）/ segment 5, the unified outlet
uResidueCnt := _uResidue; // 残留计数出口 / the residue count outlet
bClearOk := _bOk; // 通过单拍出口 / the ok pulse outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bError := _bFault; // 故障位出口（与锁存同源）/ the fault bit outlet
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存回放优先 / the latched fault replays first
    IF _bCfgLatch THEN // 组态成因（独立码值，R190）/ the configuration cause
        eErr := 16#0005_3038; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, the illegal configuration
    ELSE // 超窗成因 / the overrun cause
        eErr := 16#0005_3037; // 故障级：确认窗到期未确认，升级 / fault grade, the overrun escalated
    END_IF
ELSIF (_uResidue > DINT_TO_UDINT(nResidueMax)) OR (nResidueMax < 0) THEN // 残留超限提示（信息级不置 bError，R285）/ the residue over the bound informational
    eErr := 16#0005_3036; // 信息级：残留计数非零超提示限 / informational, the residues over the hint bound
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

TYPE E_DL_AxisCmdSrc :
(
    eNone := 0,  // 无源：本拍无命令请求 / none, no command source requests this scan
    eSafe := 10, // 安全源：最高优先级 / the safety source with the top priority
    eJog  := 20, // 手动源：次高优先级 / the jog source
    eAuto := 30, // 自动源：第三优先级 / the automatic source
    eHost := 40  // 上位源：最低优先级 / the host source with the lowest priority
);
END_TYPE

TYPE ST_DL_AxisCmd :
STRUCT
    eSrc     : E_DL_AxisCmdSrc := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eNone; // 命令来源标签 [源] / the command source label
    fVelMmS  : LREAL := 0.0;                             // 速度指令 [毫米每秒] / the velocity command
    fPosMm   : LREAL := 0.0;                             // 位置指令 [毫米] / the position command
    uFlags   : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;                    // 命令标志位 [位图] / the command flag word
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_AxisCmdArbiter
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable : BOOL := TRUE;              // 使能，FALSE 时降级为零命令（边界六）/ the enable, false degrades to the zero command
    bReset  : BOOL := FALSE;             // 故障复位电平，上升沿清非有限故障锁存（D2 返修新增）/ the fault reset level, the rising edge clears the non finite latch
    stSafe  : ST_DL_AxisCmd;             // 安全源命令字 [源结构] / the safety source command
    stJog   : ST_DL_AxisCmd;             // 手动源命令字 [源结构] / the jog source command
    stAuto  : ST_DL_AxisCmd;             // 自动源命令字 [源结构] / the automatic source command
    stHost  : ST_DL_AxisCmd;             // 上位源命令字 [源结构] / the host source command
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    eWinner     : E_DL_AxisCmdSrc := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eNone; // 胜出源 [源] / the winning source
    stWinnerCmd : ST_DL_AxisCmd;                            // 胜出命令字（携带源标签）[源结构] / the winning command carrying its label
    bAnyActive  : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 存在任一源请求 [-] / any source requests
    bSwitched   : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 源切换单拍脉冲 [-] / the source switch one shot pulse
    bError      : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 故障锁存位 [-] / the latched fault bit
    eErr        : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;                    // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit     : BOOL := FALSE;                                // 首拍初始化标志（R310）/ the first scan flag
    _eWinner   : E_DL_AxisCmdSrc := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eNone;     // 胜出源副本，段 6 单点映射 / the winning source copy
    _ePrev     : E_DL_AxisCmdSrc := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eNone;     // 上拍胜出源（切换沿判据，保持型不入预清，FB32-1）/ the previous winner, held across the scans
    _stWin     : ST_DL_AxisCmd;                                // 胜出命令字副本 / the winning command copy
    _bSwitched : BOOL := FALSE;                                // 切换单拍内部位，段 1 预清段 6 映射 / the internal switch bit, preset then mapped
    _bNoneReq  : BOOL := FALSE;                                // 本拍无源请求标记（逐拍重算）[-] / the no request flag, recomputed every scan
    _bNonFin   : BOOL := FALSE;                                // 胜出命令非有限标记（逐拍重算）[-] / the non finite winner flag, recomputed every scan
    _bFault    : BOOL := FALSE;                                // 故障锁存位（非有限降级置位，复位沿清除，D2 返修）/ the fault latch bit, set on the degrade and cleared by the reset edge
    rtReset    : R_TRIG;                                       // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新（D2 返修新增）/ the reset edge instance, refreshed unconditionally
END_VAR

// 段 0｜复位沿无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7；D2 返修新增）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh of the reset edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 故障复位沿 / the fault reset edge

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与单拍标志预清（仅单拍标志入清单，R32 FB32-1；R256）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the one shot preset
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿：清故障锁存（解除路径：复位沿恒可达，R152 自证）/ the reset edge clears the fault latch, the release path is reachable
    _bFault := FALSE; // 清故障锁存 / clear the fault latch
END_IF
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _eWinner := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eNone; // 胜出源显式落无源 / place the winner to none explicitly
    _ePrev := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eNone; // 上拍源显式落无源 / place the previous winner to none explicitly
END_IF
_bSwitched := FALSE; // 切换脉冲预清零 / preset the switch pulse false
_bNoneReq := FALSE; // 无源标记预清零 / preset the no request flag false
_bNonFin := FALSE; // 非有限标记预清零 / preset the non finite flag false

// 段 2｜优先级仲裁（每拍全量重判，数值小者优先，边界二）/ segment 2, the priority arbitration recomputed every scan
_eWinner := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eNone; // 胜出源先置无源 / preset the winner to none
IF bEnable AND (stSafe.eSrc = E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eSafe) THEN // 安全源请求且标签自洽 / the safety source requests with its own label
    _eWinner := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eSafe; // 安全源胜出（最高优先级）/ the safety source wins
ELSIF bEnable AND (stJog.eSrc = E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eJog) THEN // 手动源请求 / the jog source requests
    _eWinner := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eJog; // 手动源胜出 / the jog source wins
ELSIF bEnable AND (stAuto.eSrc = E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eAuto) THEN // 自动源请求 / the automatic source requests
    _eWinner := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eAuto; // 自动源胜出 / the automatic source wins
ELSIF bEnable AND (stHost.eSrc = E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eHost) THEN // 上位源请求 / the host source requests
    _eWinner := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eHost; // 上位源胜出 / the host source wins
END_IF
IF _eWinner = E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eNone THEN // 无源请求（含失能）/ no source requests or disabled
    _bNoneReq := TRUE; // 置无源标记 / raise the no request flag
END_IF

// 段 3｜胜出命令字整份搬运（携带源标签，边界三；CASE 逐源取，ELSE 兜零命令）/ segment 3, the winning command transfer with the source label
CASE _eWinner OF
    E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eSafe: // 安全源 / the safety source
        _stWin := stSafe; // 整份搬运 / transfer the whole structure
        _stWin.eSrc := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eSafe; // 源标签归一（防调用方填错）/ normalise the label against a caller mistake
    E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eJog: // 手动源 / the jog source
        _stWin := stJog; // 整份搬运 / transfer the whole structure
        _stWin.eSrc := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eJog; // 源标签归一 / normalise the label
    E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eAuto: // 自动源 / the automatic source
        _stWin := stAuto; // 整份搬运 / transfer the whole structure
        _stWin.eSrc := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eAuto; // 源标签归一 / normalise the label
    E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eHost: // 上位源 / the host source
        _stWin := stHost; // 整份搬运 / transfer the whole structure
        _stWin.eSrc := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eHost; // 源标签归一 / normalise the label
    ELSE // 无源或非法枚举值：零命令（安全侧，边界五）/ none or an illegal value, the zero command
        _stWin.eSrc := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eNone; // 标签无源 / the label none
        _stWin.fVelMmS := 0.0; // 速度零 / the zero velocity
        _stWin.fPosMm := 0.0; // 位置零 / the zero position
        _stWin.uFlags := 16#0000_0000; // 标志零 / the zero flags
END_CASE

// 段 4｜胜出命令非有限闸（安全侧零命令，不镜像可能被污染的量，R273）/ segment 4, the non finite gate on the winning command
IF (_stWin.fVelMmS <> _stWin.fVelMmS) OR ((_stWin.fVelMmS - _stWin.fVelMmS) <> (_stWin.fVelMmS - _stWin.fVelMmS)) THEN // 速度非有限 / the velocity is not finite
    _bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
END_IF
IF (_stWin.fPosMm <> _stWin.fPosMm) OR ((_stWin.fPosMm - _stWin.fPosMm) <> (_stWin.fPosMm - _stWin.fPosMm)) THEN // 位置非有限 / the position is not finite
    _bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
END_IF
IF _bNonFin THEN // 非有限：降级为零命令 / degrade to the zero command
    _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存故障（D2：故障级码锁存至复位沿，R187）/ latch the fault until the reset edge
    _eWinner := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eNone; // 胜出源同步落无源（D1：降级双通道一致，R283）/ sink the winner to none in step with the label
    _stWin.eSrc := E_DL_AxisCmdSrc.eNone; // 标签降级（不再宣称来源）/ degrade the label
    _stWin.fVelMmS := 0.0; // 速度零 / the zero velocity
    _stWin.fPosMm := 0.0; // 位置零 / the zero position
    _stWin.uFlags := 16#0000_0000; // 标志零 / the zero flags
END_IF

// 段 5｜源切换沿判据（保持型上拍源，边界四）/ segment 5, the source switch edge
IF _eWinner <> _ePrev THEN // 与上拍胜出源不同 / differs from the previous winner
    _bSwitched := TRUE; // 置切换单拍 / raise the switch pulse
END_IF
_ePrev := _eWinner; // 上拍源快照（主体末行赋值，跨拍保持）/ snapshot the winner at the body end

// 段 6｜统一出口（内部副本单点映射，R180；故障码回放，R187）/ segment 6, the unified outlet
eWinner := _eWinner; // 胜出源出口 / the winner outlet
stWinnerCmd := _stWin; // 胜出命令字出口 / the winning command outlet
bAnyActive := NOT _bNoneReq; // 有源请求出口 / the any request outlet
bSwitched := _bSwitched; // 切换单拍出口 / the switch pulse outlet
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存回放优先（D2：锁存至复位沿，R187）/ the latched fault replays first until the reset edge
    bError := TRUE; // 故障锁存位出口（与 _bFault 同源，R191）/ the fault outlet from the same latch
    eErr := 16#0004_0622; // 故障级：胜出命令含非有限量（锁存回放）/ fault grade, a non finite command quantity, replayed
ELSIF _bNoneReq THEN // 无源请求 / no request
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    eErr := 16#0004_0620; // 信息级：无任何命令源请求 / informational, no source requests
ELSIF _bSwitched THEN // 源切换 / a source switch
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    eErr := 16#0004_0621; // 信息级：发生源切换 / informational, a source switch happened
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

    V2 输入 (20,0,0) 高于末节点 → 落末单元，得末节点值（不外推）

FUNCTION FC_DL_InterpolateTable3D : LREAL
VAR_IN_OUT
    afX     : ARRAY[0..15] OF LREAL;             // X 轴向量（严格升序）[用户单位] / the X axis vector, strictly ascending
    afY     : ARRAY[0..15] OF LREAL;             // Y 轴向量（严格升序）[用户单位] / the Y axis vector, strictly ascending
    afZ     : ARRAY[0..15] OF LREAL;             // Z 轴向量（严格升序）[用户单位] / the Z axis vector, strictly ascending
    afTable : ARRAY[0..15, 0..15, 0..15] OF LREAL; // 表值 [工程单位]，维序 X,Y,Z / the table values with the dimension order X, Y, Z
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    nX : DINT;   // X 轴元素数 [个]，合法域 2..16 / the X element count, legal from two to sixteen
    nY : DINT;   // Y 轴元素数 [个]，合法域 2..16 / the Y element count, legal from two to sixteen
    nZ : DINT;   // Z 轴元素数 [个]，合法域 2..16 / the Z element count, legal from two to sixteen
    fX : LREAL;  // X 输入坐标 [用户单位] / the X input coordinate
    fY : LREAL;  // Y 输入坐标 [用户单位] / the Y input coordinate
    fZ : LREAL;  // Z 输入坐标 [用户单位] / the Z input coordinate
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bValid : BOOL;  // 结果可用标志 [-] / the result usable flag
    eErr   : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError : BOOL;  // 错误标志，eErr 非 0 时为真 / the error flag, true when eErr is nonzero
END_VAR
VAR
    nIx     : DINT;  // X 单元索引 [下标] / the X cell index
    nIy     : DINT;  // Y 单元索引 [下标] / the Y cell index
    nIz     : DINT;  // Z 单元索引 [下标] / the Z cell index
    k       : DINT;  // 轴遍历索引 [下标] / the axis loop index
    nUseX   : DINT;  // 钳位后 X 元素数 [个] / the clamped X count
    nUseY   : DINT;  // 钳位后 Y 元素数 [个] / the clamped Y count
    nUseZ   : DINT;  // 钳位后 Z 元素数 [个] / the clamped Z count
    fTx     : LREAL; // X 单元内归一化位置 [-] / the normalised X position inside the cell
    fTy     : LREAL; // Y 单元内归一化位置 [-] / the normalised Y position inside the cell
    fTz     : LREAL; // Z 单元内归一化位置 [-] / the normalised Z position inside the cell
    fSpan   : LREAL; // 单元宽度工作副本 [用户单位] / the cell span copy
    fC000   : LREAL; // 角点 (i,j,k) 表值 [工程单位] / the corner value at i, j, k
    fC100   : LREAL; // 角点 (i+1,j,k) 表值 [工程单位] / the corner value at i plus one, j, k
    fC010   : LREAL; // 角点 (i,j+1,k) 表值 [工程单位] / the corner value at i, j plus one, k
    fC110   : LREAL; // 角点 (i+1,j+1,k) 表值 [工程单位] / the corner value at i plus one, j plus one, k
    fC001   : LREAL; // 角点 (i,j,k+1) 表值 [工程单位] / the corner value at i, j, k plus one
    fC101   : LREAL; // 角点 (i+1,j,k+1) 表值 [工程单位] / the corner value at i plus one, j, k plus one
    fC011   : LREAL; // 角点 (i,j+1,k+1) 表值 [工程单位] / the corner value at i, j plus one, k plus one
    fC111   : LREAL; // 角点 (i+1,j+1,k+1) 表值 [工程单位] / the corner value at i plus one, j plus one, k plus one
    fX0     : LREAL; // 单元 X 下节点坐标 [用户单位] / the cell lower X node
    fY0     : LREAL; // 单元 Y 下节点坐标 [用户单位] / the cell lower Y node
    fZ0     : LREAL; // 单元 Z 下节点坐标 [用户单位] / the cell lower Z node
    fA0     : LREAL; // X 向插值低端结果（k 层）[工程单位] / the X interpolation at the lower Z layer
    fA1     : LREAL; // X 向插值低端结果（k+1 层）[工程单位] / the X interpolation at the upper Z layer
    fB0     : LREAL; // Y 向插值结果（k 层）[工程单位] / the Y interpolation at the lower Z layer
    fB1     : LREAL; // Y 向插值结果（k+1 层）[工程单位] / the Y interpolation at the upper Z layer
    bClamp  : BOOL;  // 元素数钳位标记 [-] / the element count clamp flag
    bOrder  : BOOL;  // 轴乱序标记 [-] / the axis order fault flag
    bNonFin : BOOL;  // 非有限标记 [-] / the non finite flag
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_I3D_NMAX : DINT := 16; // 轴元素容量上界 [个]，与数组第一维一致 / the axis capacity aligned with the first dimension
    DL_I3D_TOL  : LREAL := 1.0E-12; // 差值比较容差 [用户单位] / the difference comparison tolerance
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与错误状态预置安全值（四段式第一段，R45）+ 局部量显式预置（R254）/ segment 1, the preset of the return, the codes and the local guards
FC_DL_InterpolateTable3D := 0.0; // 返回值预置安全值零 / preset the return to zero
bValid := FALSE; // 有效标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 错误标志预置假 / preset the error flag false
bClamp := FALSE; // 钳位标记预置假 / preset the clamp flag false
bOrder := FALSE; // 乱序标记预置假 / preset the order fault flag false
bNonFin := FALSE; // 非有限标记预置假 / preset the non finite flag false
nIx := 0; // X 单元索引预置零 / preset the X cell index zero
nIy := 0; // Y 单元索引预置零 / preset the Y cell index zero
nIz := 0; // Z 单元索引预置零 / preset the Z cell index zero
fTx := 0.0; // X 归一化位置预置零 / preset the X position zero
fTy := 0.0; // Y 归一化位置预置零 / preset the Y position zero
fTz := 0.0; // Z 归一化位置预置零 / preset the Z position zero
fSpan := 0.0; // 单元宽度预置零 / preset the cell span zero
fX0 := 0.0; // X 下节点预置零 / preset the X lower node zero
fY0 := 0.0; // Y 下节点预置零 / preset the Y lower node zero
fZ0 := 0.0; // Z 下节点预置零 / preset the Z lower node zero

// 段 2｜元素数域闸（<2 早退，>16 钳位，边界二）/ segment 2, the element count gate
IF (nX < 2) OR (nY < 2) OR (nZ < 2) THEN // 任轴少于两个节点，无单元可插值 / fewer than two nodes leave no cell
    eErr := 16#0001_0626; // 信息级：轴元素数越域已钳位（信息级不置 bError，R285 口径统一）/ informational, the element count clamped, no fault bit by the unified grade rule
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF
nUseX := nX; // X 元素数域内接管 / take the X count
nUseY := nY; // Y 元素数域内接管 / take the Y count
nUseZ := nZ; // Z 元素数域内接管 / take the Z count
IF nUseX > DL_I3D_NMAX THEN // 超容量 / above the capacity
    nUseX := DL_I3D_NMAX; // 钳到容量 / clamp to the capacity
    bClamp := TRUE; // 置钳位标记 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF
IF nUseY > DL_I3D_NMAX THEN // 超容量 / above the capacity
    nUseY := DL_I3D_NMAX; // 钳到容量 / clamp to the capacity
    bClamp := TRUE; // 置钳位标记 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF
IF nUseZ > DL_I3D_NMAX THEN // 超容量 / above the capacity
    nUseZ := DL_I3D_NMAX; // 钳到容量 / clamp to the capacity
    bClamp := TRUE; // 置钳位标记 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF
IF bClamp THEN // 钳位置信息级 / raise the informational code on a clamp
    eErr := 16#0001_0626; // 信息级：轴元素数越域已钳位 / informational, the element count clamped
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志 / raise the error flag
END_IF

// 段 3｜轴严格升序与有限性闸（轴与输入坐标，边界一三）/ segment 3, the axis order and the finiteness gate
FOR k := 0 TO nUseX - 2 DO // X 轴相邻比较 / the X neighbour comparison
    IF (afX[k] <> afX[k]) OR ((afX[k] - afX[k]) <> (afX[k] - afX[k]))
    OR (afX[k + 1] <> afX[k + 1]) OR ((afX[k + 1] - afX[k + 1]) <> (afX[k + 1] - afX[k + 1])) THEN // X 轴相邻元素逐个非有限判（D3 返修，R272 点名）/ the adjacent X elements tested for finiteness one by one
        bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
    END_IF
    IF afX[k] >= afX[k + 1] THEN // 非严格升序 / not strictly ascending
        bOrder := TRUE; // 置乱序标记 / raise the order flag
    END_IF
END_FOR
FOR k := 0 TO nUseY - 2 DO // Y 轴相邻比较 / the Y neighbour comparison
    IF (afY[k] <> afY[k]) OR ((afY[k] - afY[k]) <> (afY[k] - afY[k]))
    OR (afY[k + 1] <> afY[k + 1]) OR ((afY[k + 1] - afY[k + 1]) <> (afY[k + 1] - afY[k + 1])) THEN // Y 轴相邻元素逐个非有限判（D3 返修）/ the adjacent Y elements tested for finiteness
        bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
    END_IF
    IF afY[k] >= afY[k + 1] THEN // 非严格升序 / not strictly ascending
        bOrder := TRUE; // 置乱序标记 / raise the order flag
    END_IF
END_FOR
FOR k := 0 TO nUseZ - 2 DO // Z 轴相邻比较 / the Z neighbour comparison
    IF (afZ[k] <> afZ[k]) OR ((afZ[k] - afZ[k]) <> (afZ[k] - afZ[k]))
    OR (afZ[k + 1] <> afZ[k + 1]) OR ((afZ[k + 1] - afZ[k + 1]) <> (afZ[k + 1] - afZ[k + 1])) THEN // Z 轴相邻元素逐个非有限判（D3 返修）/ the adjacent Z elements tested for finiteness
        bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
    END_IF
    IF afZ[k] >= afZ[k + 1] THEN // 非严格升序 / not strictly ascending
        bOrder := TRUE; // 置乱序标记 / raise the order flag
    END_IF
END_FOR
IF bNonFin THEN // 轴向量含非有限（NaN 使序闸恒假，须先于乱序判拒算，D3）/ a non finite axis element, gated ahead of the order test
    eErr := 16#0001_0629; // 故障级：轴或表值含非有限值 / fault grade, a non finite axis or table value
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志（R45 配对）/ raise the error flag, paired with the fault code
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result void
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF
IF bOrder THEN // 轴乱序即拒算（不排序修正，边界一）/ refuse on a disorder, no sorting
    eErr := 16#0001_0627; // 故障级：轴向量非严格升序 / fault grade, the axis is not strictly ascending
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志（R45 配对）/ raise the error flag, paired with the fault code
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result void
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF
IF (fX <> fX) OR ((fX - fX) <> (fX - fX)) OR (fY <> fY) OR ((fY - fY) <> (fY - fY))
OR (fZ <> fZ) OR ((fZ - fZ) <> (fZ - fZ)) THEN // 三个输入坐标逐个非有限判（R272 点名）/ the three input coordinates tested one by one
    eErr := 16#0001_0628; // 故障级：输入坐标含非有限值 / fault grade, a non finite input coordinate
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志（R45 配对）/ raise the error flag, paired with the fault code
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result void
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 4｜三轴单元定位（线性查找 + 钳位到 [0, n-2]，输入不外推）/ segment 4, the cell location clamped to the legal index band
nIx := 0; // X 单元索引从零起 / the X index starts at zero
FOR k := 0 TO nUseX - 2 DO // 升序轴线性定位 / the linear location on an ascending axis
    IF fX >= afX[k] THEN // 已过该下节点 / the input is past this lower node
        nIx := k; // 记录候选单元 / register the candidate cell
    END_IF
END_FOR
nIy := 0; // Y 单元索引从零起 / the Y index starts at zero
FOR k := 0 TO nUseY - 2 DO // 升序轴线性定位 / the linear location on an ascending axis
    IF fY >= afY[k] THEN // 已过该下节点 / the input is past this lower node
        nIy := k; // 记录候选单元 / register the candidate cell
    END_IF
END_FOR
nIz := 0; // Z 单元索引从零起 / the Z index starts at zero
FOR k := 0 TO nUseZ - 2 DO // 升序轴线性定位 / the linear location on an ascending axis
    IF fZ >= afZ[k] THEN // 已过该下节点 / the input is past this lower node
        nIz := k; // 记录候选单元 / register the candidate cell
    END_IF
END_FOR

// 段 5｜单元内归一化位置（单元宽度已证 > 0：轴严格升序 + 容差闸）/ segment 5, the normalised positions with a proven positive span
fX0 := afX[nIx]; // X 下节点 / the X lower node
fY0 := afY[nIy]; // Y 下节点 / the Y lower node
fZ0 := afZ[nIz]; // Z 下节点 / the Z lower node
fSpan := afX[nIx + 1] - fX0; // X 单元宽度 [用户单位] / the X cell span
IF fSpan <= DL_I3D_TOL THEN // 宽度非正（升序已证，属结构性不可达兜底）/ a non positive span, kept as a guard
    eErr := 16#0001_0627; // 故障级：轴向量退化，拒绝相除 / fault grade, the degenerate axis refuses the division
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志（R45 配对）/ raise the error flag, paired with the fault code
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result void
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF
fTx := (fX - fX0) / fSpan; // X 归一化位置（除子已证 > 容差）/ the X position with a proven divisor
fSpan := afY[nIy + 1] - fY0; // Y 单元宽度 [用户单位] / the Y cell span
IF fSpan <= DL_I3D_TOL THEN // 兜底闸 / the guard
    eErr := 16#0001_0627; // 故障级：轴向量退化 / fault grade, the degenerate axis
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志 / raise the error flag
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result void
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF
fTy := (fY - fY0) / fSpan; // Y 归一化位置 / the Y position
fSpan := afZ[nIz + 1] - fZ0; // Z 单元宽度 [用户单位] / the Z cell span
IF fSpan <= DL_I3D_TOL THEN // 兜底闸 / the guard
    eErr := 16#0001_0627; // 故障级：轴向量退化 / fault grade, the degenerate axis
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志 / raise the error flag
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result void
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF
fTz := (fZ - fZ0) / fSpan; // Z 归一化位置 / the Z position

// 段 6｜八角点取值与表值有限性（逐角点判，R272 数组侧覆盖）/ segment 6, the eight corners and the table finiteness
fC000 := afTable[nIx, nIy, nIz]; // 角点 000 / the corner 000
fC100 := afTable[nIx + 1, nIy, nIz]; // 角点 100 / the corner 100
fC010 := afTable[nIx, nIy + 1, nIz]; // 角点 010 / the corner 010
fC110 := afTable[nIx + 1, nIy + 1, nIz]; // 角点 110 / the corner 110
fC001 := afTable[nIx, nIy, nIz + 1]; // 角点 001 / the corner 001
fC101 := afTable[nIx + 1, nIy, nIz + 1]; // 角点 101 / the corner 101
fC011 := afTable[nIx, nIy + 1, nIz + 1]; // 角点 011 / the corner 011
fC111 := afTable[nIx + 1, nIy + 1, nIz + 1]; // 角点 111 / the corner 111
// 八角点逐个非有限判（覆盖本次参与的全部表值元素）/ the corner-wise non finite test over every participating value
IF (fC000 <> fC000) OR ((fC000 - fC000) <> (fC000 - fC000)) THEN // 角点 000 非有限 / the corner 000 is not finite
    bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
END_IF
IF (fC100 <> fC100) OR ((fC100 - fC100) <> (fC100 - fC100)) THEN // 角点 100 非有限 / the corner 100 is not finite
    bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
END_IF
IF (fC010 <> fC010) OR ((fC010 - fC010) <> (fC010 - fC010)) THEN // 角点 010 非有限 / the corner 010 is not finite
    bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
END_IF
IF (fC110 <> fC110) OR ((fC110 - fC110) <> (fC110 - fC110)) THEN // 角点 110 非有限 / the corner 110 is not finite
    bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
END_IF
IF (fC001 <> fC001) OR ((fC001 - fC001) <> (fC001 - fC001)) THEN // 角点 001 非有限 / the corner 001 is not finite
    bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
END_IF
IF (fC101 <> fC101) OR ((fC101 - fC101) <> (fC101 - fC101)) THEN // 角点 101 非有限 / the corner 101 is not finite
    bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
END_IF
IF (fC011 <> fC011) OR ((fC011 - fC011) <> (fC011 - fC011)) THEN // 角点 011 非有限 / the corner 011 is not finite
    bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
END_IF
IF (fC111 <> fC111) OR ((fC111 - fC111) <> (fC111 - fC111)) THEN // 角点 111 非有限 / the corner 111 is not finite
    bNonFin := TRUE; // 置非有限标记 / raise the non finite flag
END_IF
IF bNonFin THEN // 表值含非有限 / a non finite table value exists
    eErr := 16#0001_0629; // 故障级：轴或表值含非有限值 / fault grade, a non finite axis or table value
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志（R45 配对）/ raise the error flag, paired with the fault code
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result void
    FC_DL_InterpolateTable3D := 0.0; // 返回值回安全值 / the return back to the safe zero
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 7｜三线性插值 X→Y→Z（先沿最内维、再逐层，次序写死）/ segment 7, the trilinear interpolation with the fixed order
fA0 := fC000 + (fC100 - fC000) * fTx; // k 层 X 向插值 / the X interpolation on the lower layer
fA1 := fC001 + (fC101 - fC001) * fTx; // k+1 层 X 向插值 / the X interpolation on the upper layer
fB0 := fA0 + ((fC010 + (fC110 - fC010) * fTx) - fA0) * fTy; // k 层 Y 向插值 / the Y interpolation on the lower layer
fB1 := fA1 + ((fC011 + (fC111 - fC011) * fTx) - fA1) * fTy; // k+1 层 Y 向插值 / the Y interpolation on the upper layer
FC_DL_InterpolateTable3D := fB0 + (fB1 - fB0) * fTz; // Z 向插值出结果 / the Z interpolation gives the result

// 段 8｜结果复检兜底（非有限同拍三件套，边界四）/ segment 8, the result recheck with the triple on a non finite value
IF (FC_DL_InterpolateTable3D <> FC_DL_InterpolateTable3D)
OR ((FC_DL_InterpolateTable3D - FC_DL_InterpolateTable3D) <> (FC_DL_InterpolateTable3D - FC_DL_InterpolateTable3D)) THEN // 结果非有限 / the result is not finite
    FC_DL_InterpolateTable3D := 0.0; // 兜底安全值 / the bottom-line safe value
    eErr := 16#0001_0630; // 故障级：结果非有限（D9 返修独立码，不复用 0629）/ fault grade, the non finite result with its own code
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志（R45 配对）/ raise the error flag, paired with the fault code
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result void
ELSE // 结果有限 / a finite result
    bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
END_IF
END_FUNCTION

instruction: FC_DL_Affine2DChain 返修版 1.0.1：修复 R60 终审 D 编号缺陷（安全降级双通道一致 / 信息级码不置 bError / 单级链奇异判 / 轴向量有限性 / _nPending 锁存），真实工况需求与边界条件不变。

                      M1），中间任一奇异即整体失效并置故障码，不外泄半结果。

                         无标量 LREAL 引脚（R272 覆盖自证：9×nUsed 全枚举）；
                      四 中途奇异或中途非有限即整体失效：bValid = FALSE、输出
                         保持单位阵（不外泄半结果），故障码一次锁存于本次调用；

                        不再置 bError（R285 口径统一）

FUNCTION FC_DL_Affine2DChain : BOOL
VAR_IN_OUT
    afMats : ARRAY[0..7, 0..2, 0..2] OF LREAL; // 链矩阵组 [无量纲 + 用户单位混合]，行主序，第 0 级先施加 / the chain matrices, row major, level zero applied first
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    nCount : DINT; // 链级数 [级]，合法域 1..8 / the chain level count, legal from one to eight
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    afMOut : ARRAY[0..2, 0..2] OF LREAL; // 合成矩阵 [无量纲 + 用户单位混合] / the composed matrix
    bValid : BOOL;                       // 结果可用标志（链中任一级失效即假）[-] / the result usable flag
    eErr   : UDINT;                      // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError : BOOL;                       // 故障锁存标志 [-] / the fault flag
END_VAR
VAR
    afAcc     : ARRAY[0..2, 0..2] OF LREAL; // 累加矩阵（当前已合成结果） / the accumulator of the composed so far
    afTmp     : ARRAY[0..2, 0..2] OF LREAL; // 本级乘积暂存（检过才接替累加器） / the staging product of this level
    afMk      : ARRAY[0..2, 0..2] OF LREAL; // 本级矩阵切片副本（三维数组不可直接切片传参） / the slice copy of this level
    nLevel    : DINT;  // 级遍历索引 [级] / the level loop index
    nI        : DINT;  // 行索引 [行] / the row index
    nJ        : DINT;  // 列索引 [列] / the column index
    nUsed     : DINT;  // 钳位后的实际级数 [级] / the clamped level count
    bAbort    : BOOL;  // 链终止标志（有限闸或奇异闸命中）[-] / the chain abort flag
    bClamped  : BOOL;  // 链长钳位标记 [-] / the level clamp flag
    bSubValid : BOOL;  // 委托内核结果可用位 [-] / the delegate usable bit
    bSubErr   : BOOL;  // 委托内核故障位 [-] / the delegate fault bit
    uSubErr   : UDINT; // 委托内核错误码 [码] / the delegate error code
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_A2CH_CHMAX : DINT := 8; // 链级数上界 [级]，与数组第 1 维一致 / the level bound aligned with the first dimension
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与错误状态预置安全值（四段式第一段，R45）+ 输出预置单位阵 / segment 1, the preset of the return, the codes and the identity matrix
FC_DL_Affine2DChain := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
bValid := FALSE; // 有效标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the error flag false
bAbort := FALSE; // 终止标志预置假 / preset the abort flag false
bClamped := FALSE; // 钳位标记预置假 / preset the clamp flag false
bSubValid := FALSE; // 委托有效位预置假 / preset the delegate usable bit false
bSubErr := FALSE; // 委托故障位预置假 / preset the delegate fault bit false
uSubErr := 16#0000_0000; // 委托码预置零 / preset the delegate code zero
nUsed := 0; // 实际级数预置零 / preset the used level zero
FOR nI := 0 TO 2 DO // 单位阵装配 / build the identity matrix
    FOR nJ := 0 TO 2 DO // 列遍历 / the column loop
        IF nI = nJ THEN // 主对角 / the main diagonal
            afMOut[nI, nJ] := 1.0; // 对角置一 / unit on the diagonal
            afAcc[nI, nJ] := 1.0; // 累加器同步置一 / the accumulator seeded the same
        ELSE // 非对角 / the off diagonal
            afMOut[nI, nJ] := 0.0; // 非对角置零 / zero off the diagonal
            afAcc[nI, nJ] := 0.0; // 累加器同步置零 / the accumulator seeded the same
        END_IF
        afTmp[nI, nJ] := 0.0; // 暂存阵清零 / clear the staging matrix
        afMk[nI, nJ] := 0.0; // 切片副本清零 / clear the slice copy
    END_FOR
END_FOR

// 段 2｜链长域闸（退化与钳位显式，边界二）/ segment 2, the level count gate with the explicit degenerate branch
IF nCount < 1 THEN // 链长为零或负：退化为单位阵 / a non positive count degenerates to the identity
    eErr := 16#0001_0622; // 信息级：链长越域已钳位（信息级不置 bError，R285 口径统一，D6 返修）/ informational, the level count clamped, no fault bit
    bValid := TRUE; // 单位阵是合法结果 / the identity is a legal result
    FC_DL_Affine2DChain := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
    RETURN; // 早退：afMOut 已为单位阵（段 1 预置）/ early return with the identity already preset
END_IF
nUsed := nCount; // 域内接管级数 / take the count inside the domain
IF nUsed > DL_A2CH_CHMAX THEN // 超上界 / above the bound
    nUsed := DL_A2CH_CHMAX; // 钳到 8 级 / clamp to eight levels
    bClamped := TRUE; // 置钳位标记 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF

// 段 3｜有限性闸：9 × nUsed 个浮点元素逐个枚举（R272 覆盖自证，边界三）/ segment 3, the finiteness gate over every enumerated element
FOR nLevel := 0 TO nUsed - 1 DO // 级遍历 / the level loop
    FOR nI := 0 TO 2 DO // 行遍历 / the row loop
        FOR nJ := 0 TO 2 DO // 列遍历 / the column loop
            IF (afMats[nLevel, nI, nJ] <> afMats[nLevel, nI, nJ])
            OR ((afMats[nLevel, nI, nJ] - afMats[nLevel, nI, nJ]) <> (afMats[nLevel, nI, nJ] - afMats[nLevel, nI, nJ])) THEN // NaN 自反判 + Inf 差值自减判 / the NaN reflexive and the Inf difference tests
                bAbort := TRUE; // 置终止标志 / raise the abort flag
            END_IF
        END_FOR
    END_FOR
END_FOR
IF bAbort THEN // 输入含非有限 / a non finite input exists
    eErr := 16#0001_0621; // 故障级：输入矩阵含非有限元素 / fault grade, a non finite element in the input
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志（R45 配对）/ raise the error flag, paired with the fault code
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result void
    RETURN; // 早退：afMOut 保持单位阵（不外泄半结果，边界四）/ early return with the identity kept
END_IF

// 段 4｜逐级合成：MOut = Mn × … × M1（累加器以单位阵起步、逐级全委托；D5 返修：nUsed=1 单级链也走一次委托补奇异判，R284）/ segment 4, the per level composition, the accumulator starts from the identity and every level is delegated
FOR nLevel := 0 TO nUsed - 1 DO // 第 0..nUsed-1 级逐级合成（单位阵为左乘起点）/ compose from level zero with the identity seeded accumulator
  IF NOT bAbort THEN // 链未终止才继续合成（终止后不再用半结果继续乘）/ compose only while the chain is alive
    afMk[0, 0] := afMats[nLevel, 0, 0]; // 切片副本第 0 行第 0 列 / slice row zero column zero
    afMk[0, 1] := afMats[nLevel, 0, 1]; // 切片副本第 0 行第 1 列 / slice row zero column one
    afMk[0, 2] := afMats[nLevel, 0, 2]; // 切片副本第 0 行第 2 列 / slice row zero column two
    afMk[1, 0] := afMats[nLevel, 1, 0]; // 切片副本第 1 行第 0 列 / slice row one column zero
    afMk[1, 1] := afMats[nLevel, 1, 1]; // 切片副本第 1 行第 1 列 / slice row one column one
    afMk[1, 2] := afMats[nLevel, 1, 2]; // 切片副本第 1 行第 2 列 / slice row one column two
    afMk[2, 0] := afMats[nLevel, 2, 0]; // 切片副本第 2 行第 0 列 / slice row two column zero
    afMk[2, 1] := afMats[nLevel, 2, 1]; // 切片副本第 2 行第 1 列 / slice row two column one
    afMk[2, 2] := afMats[nLevel, 2, 2]; // 切片副本第 2 行第 2 列 / slice row two column two
    IF NOT FC_DL_Affine2DCompose(afM1 := afAcc, afM2 := afMk, afMOut => afTmp, eErr => uSubErr, bError => bSubErr, bValid => bSubValid) THEN // 委托两级内核（含行列式相对判据；nUsed=1 时 afAcc 为单位阵，单位阵左乘精确无损，单级奇异判由本次委托补齐，D5）/ delegate the two level kernel, the identity left multiply is exact
        bAbort := TRUE; // 本级不可用 / this level is unusable
    END_IF
    IF bAbort OR (NOT bSubValid) THEN // 奇异或不可用即整体终止 / a singular or unusable level aborts the chain
        bAbort := TRUE; // 锁住终止标志 / hold the abort flag
    ELSE // 本级通过：接替累加器 / this level passed, take over the accumulator
        afAcc[0, 0] := afTmp[0, 0]; // 累加器接替第 0 行第 0 列 / take over row zero column zero
        afAcc[0, 1] := afTmp[0, 1]; // 累加器接替第 0 行第 1 列 / take over row zero column one
        afAcc[0, 2] := afTmp[0, 2]; // 累加器接替第 0 行第 2 列 / take over row zero column two
        afAcc[1, 0] := afTmp[1, 0]; // 累加器接替第 1 行第 0 列 / take over row one column zero
        afAcc[1, 1] := afTmp[1, 1]; // 累加器接替第 1 行第 1 列 / take over row one column one
        afAcc[1, 2] := afTmp[1, 2]; // 累加器接替第 1 行第 2 列 / take over row one column two
        afAcc[2, 0] := afTmp[2, 0]; // 累加器接替第 2 行第 0 列 / take over row two column zero
        afAcc[2, 1] := afTmp[2, 1]; // 累加器接替第 2 行第 1 列 / take over row two column one
        afAcc[2, 2] := afTmp[2, 2]; // 累加器接替第 2 行第 2 列 / take over row two column two
    END_IF
  END_IF
END_FOR

// 段 5｜出口装配：仅在全链通过时外泄合成阵（边界四）/ segment 5, the outlet assembly, exported only when the whole chain passed
IF bAbort THEN // 链终止 / the chain aborted
    eErr := 16#0001_0620; // 故障级：中间阵奇异或不可用 / fault grade, a singular or unusable intermediate
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志（R45 配对）/ raise the error flag, paired with the fault code
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result void
    FC_DL_Affine2DChain := FALSE; // 返回失败（afMOut 保持单位阵）/ return failure with the identity kept
ELSE // 全链通过 / the whole chain passed
    afMOut[0, 0] := afAcc[0, 0]; // 出口第 0 行第 0 列 / outlet row zero column zero
    afMOut[0, 1] := afAcc[0, 1]; // 出口第 0 行第 1 列 / outlet row zero column one
    afMOut[0, 2] := afAcc[0, 2]; // 出口第 0 行第 2 列 / outlet row zero column two
    afMOut[1, 0] := afAcc[1, 0]; // 出口第 1 行第 0 列 / outlet row one column zero
    afMOut[1, 1] := afAcc[1, 1]; // 出口第 1 行第 1 列 / outlet row one column one
    afMOut[1, 2] := afAcc[1, 2]; // 出口第 1 行第 2 列 / outlet row one column two
    afMOut[2, 0] := afAcc[2, 0]; // 出口第 2 行第 0 列 / outlet row two column zero
    afMOut[2, 1] := afAcc[2, 1]; // 出口第 2 行第 1 列 / outlet row two column one
    afMOut[2, 2] := afAcc[2, 2]; // 出口第 2 行第 2 列 / outlet row two column two
    bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
    FC_DL_Affine2DChain := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
    IF bClamped THEN // 链长被钳位 / the level count was clamped
        eErr := 16#0001_0622; // 信息级：链长越域已钳位（信息级不置 bError，R285 口径统一，D6 返修）/ informational, the level count clamped, no fault bit
    END_IF
END_IF
END_FUNCTION

  分工声明 Split     : 与 FB_DL_ShiftMonthReport（报表属主）与 FB_DL_ChangeoverSequence

  验收   Acceptance :
    算法已证（脚本）：未跑 ｜ 编译器已证（三平台）：未跑
    V1 3 项未决、窗内 3 个确认沿 → bHandoverDone 单拍、无故障
    V2 窗到期仅确认 2/3 → 码 0622、eFault、未完成

                        例外；D13 补 E_DL_HandoverPhase 属主行

TYPE E_DL_HandoverPhase :
(
    eIdle  := 0,  // 空闲：等交接开始沿 / idle, waiting for the start edge
    eWait  := 10, // 等待：交接窗内逐条确认 / waiting for the item confirmations inside the window
    eFault := 20  // 故障：窗非法或到期未完成，锁存待复位 / fault, an illegal window or an unfinished overrun, latched
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_ShiftHandoverCheck
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;       // 使能，FALSE 时弃用本轮交接（边界六）/ the enable, false discards the round
    bStart       : BOOL := FALSE;      // 交接开始电平，上升沿取快照 / the start level, the rising edge takes the snapshot
    bConfirmItem : BOOL := FALSE;      // 未决事项确认电平，上升沿确认一条 / the item confirmation level, each rising edge confirms one item
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;      // 复位沿：清锁存与快照并回空闲 / the reset edge, clears the latch and the snapshot
    tHandover    : TIME := T#10M;      // 交接窗时长 [毫秒]，必须 > 0 / the handover window, must be positive
    nPendingItems : DINT := 3;         // 未决事项条数 [条]，合法域 0..64 / the pending item count, legal from zero to sixty four
    nProdCnt     : UDINT := 0;         // 当前班次产量计数 [件] / the production count of the shift
    nAlarmCnt    : UDINT := 0;         // 当前班次报警计数 [次] / the alarm count of the shift
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bRunning       : BOOL := FALSE;               // 交接窗口进行中 [-] / the handover in progress flag
    bHandoverDone  : BOOL := FALSE;               // 交接完成单拍脉冲 [-] / the handover done one shot pulse
    nConfirmedCnt  : DINT := 0;                   // 已确认条数 [条] / the confirmed item count
    nSnapProd      : UDINT := 0;                  // 交接开始时刻的产量快照 [件] / the production snapshot at the start edge
    nSnapAlarm     : UDINT := 0;                  // 交接开始时刻的报警快照 [次] / the alarm snapshot at the start edge
    eState         : E_DL_HandoverPhase;          // 主状态机当前态 [状态] / the current state of the main machine
    bError         : BOOL := FALSE;               // 故障锁存位 [-] / the latched fault bit
    eErr           : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;       // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;                                 // 首拍初始化标志（R310）/ the first scan flag
    _eState     : E_DL_HandoverPhase := E_DL_HandoverPhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器，段 4 唯一写点 / the internal state register, single writer
    _bDone      : BOOL := FALSE;                                 // 完成单拍内部位，段 1 预清段 6 映射 / the internal done bit, preset then mapped
    _nConfirmed : DINT := 0;                                     // 已确认条数副本 / the confirmed count copy
    _nPending   : DINT := 0;                                     // 未决条数钳位工作副本（逐拍重算，仅供迁入沿快照，D7 返修）/ the clamped pending work copy, recomputed every scan
    _nPendingLock : DINT := 0;                                   // 本轮未决条数锁定值（仅 eIdle 迁入沿赋值，D7 返修，R259）/ the locked pending count, assigned only on the idle entry edge
    _uSnapProd  : UDINT := 0;                                    // 产量快照副本 / the production snapshot copy
    _uSnapAlarm : UDINT := 0;                                    // 报警快照副本 / the alarm snapshot copy
    _bFault     : BOOL := FALSE;                                 // 故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _bCfgBad    : BOOL := FALSE;                                 // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）[-] / the configuration fault flag
    _bIncomplete : BOOL := FALSE;                                // 未确认标记（逐拍重算）[-] / the unconfirmed flag
    rtStart     : R_TRIG;                                        // 开始沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the start edge instance
    rtConfirm   : R_TRIG;                                        // 确认沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the confirmation edge instance
    rtReset     : R_TRIG;                                        // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the reset edge instance
    tonWindow   : TON;                                           // 交接窗定时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the handover window timer
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_SHC_ITMAX : DINT := 64; // 未决事项上界 [条] / the pending item bound
END_VAR

// 段 0｜沿检测与交接窗定时器无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7；IN 串故障锁存门控，FB50-1）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh with the latch gate
rtStart(CLK := bStart); // 开始沿 / the start edge
rtConfirm(CLK := bConfirmItem); // 确认沿 / the confirmation edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
tonWindow(IN := (_eState = E_DL_HandoverPhase.eWait) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tHandover); // 交接窗：仅等待相且无锁存时计时 / the window timing only in the waiting phase

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与单拍标志预清（仅单拍标志入清单，R32 FB32-1；R256）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the one shot preset
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _nConfirmed := 0; // 已确认条数显式清零 / clear the confirmed count explicitly
    _nPending := 0; // 未决条数显式清零 / clear the pending count explicitly
    _nPendingLock := 0; // 未决锁定值显式清零（D7 返修）/ clear the locked pending count explicitly
    _uSnapProd := 0; // 产量快照显式清零 / clear the production snapshot explicitly
    _uSnapAlarm := 0; // 报警快照显式清零 / clear the alarm snapshot explicitly
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _eState := E_DL_HandoverPhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle explicitly
END_IF
_bDone := FALSE; // 完成单拍预清零 / preset the done pulse false
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法标记预清零 / preset the configuration flag false
_bIncomplete := FALSE; // 未确认标记预清零 / preset the unconfirmed flag false

// 段 2｜组态域闸（零长窗显式分支，边界一；未决条数越域钳位）/ segment 2, the configuration gate with the explicit zero length branch
IF tHandover <= T#0S THEN // 零长窗：非法组态 / a zero length window, an illegal configuration
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 置组态非法标记 / raise the configuration flag
    _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存故障（段 5 迁移相）/ latch the fault, the segment five migrates the phase
END_IF
IF nPendingItems < 0 THEN // 条目数为负（域下界硬限）/ a negative item count
    _nPending := 0; // 按零条处理（无未决即完成）/ treat as zero, an immediate completion
ELSIF nPendingItems > DL_SHC_ITMAX THEN // 条目数越上界 / above the bound
    _nPending := DL_SHC_ITMAX; // 钳到上界 / clamp to the bound
ELSE // 域内 / inside the domain
    _nPending := nPendingItems; // 原值接管 / take the value as is
END_IF

// 段 3｜本拍确认沿预消化（R275：合法事件先于窗口到期迁移消化，段序在段 4 之前）/ segment 3, the confirmation edge pre digest ahead of the window expiry
IF rtConfirm.Q AND (_eState = E_DL_HandoverPhase.eWait) AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 等待相内的确认沿 / a confirmation edge inside the waiting phase
    IF _nConfirmed < _nPendingLock THEN // 尚有未确认条目（判据用锁定值，D7 返修）/ items remain unconfirmed against the locked count
        _nConfirmed := _nConfirmed + 1; // 确认一条 / confirm one item
    ELSE // 已全部确认（多按的确认沿忽略）/ everything is confirmed, extra presses ignored
        _nConfirmed := _nPendingLock; // 计数饱和于锁定条目数 / saturate the count at the locked item count
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 4｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 拦非法态；进入/退出逐条取反对偶，边界三）/ segment 4, the main machine with the paired entry and exit conditions
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_HandoverPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相：等开始沿（条件：开始沿 + 使能 + 窗合法 + 无锁存）/ the idle phase
        IF rtStart.Q AND bEnable AND (tHandover > T#0S) AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 迁入判据带全量闸位复检（R274）/ the entry with the full gate recheck
            _nConfirmed := 0; // 新一轮确认计数归零 / reset the confirmed count
            _uSnapProd := nProdCnt; // 取产量快照（最近一次类出口）/ take the production snapshot
            _uSnapAlarm := nAlarmCnt; // 取报警快照 / take the alarm snapshot
            _nPendingLock := _nPending; // 未决条数锁定（仅此迁入沿赋值，窗内改参不影响本轮判据，D7 返修）/ lock the pending count on this entry edge only
            _eState := E_DL_HandoverPhase.eWait; // 迁入等待相 / enter the waiting phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_HandoverPhase.eWait: // 等待相：四条退出（全确认 / 到期 / 失能 / 锁存）/ the waiting phase with four exits
        IF _nConfirmed >= _nPendingLock THEN // 退出条件一：全部确认（判据用锁定值，D7 返修）/ the first exit, everything confirmed against the locked count
            _bDone := TRUE; // 置完成单拍 / raise the done pulse
            _eState := E_DL_HandoverPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
        ELSIF tonWindow.Q THEN // 退出条件二：窗口到期仍未全部确认（边界二：本拍确认沿已在段 3 消化）/ the second exit, the window expired unconfirmed
            _bIncomplete := TRUE; // 置未确认标记 / raise the unconfirmed flag
            _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存超窗故障（0622）/ latch the overrun fault
        ELSIF (NOT bEnable) OR _bFault THEN // 退出条件三：失能弃用或已锁存（前置条件消失）/ the third exit with the prerequisite gone
            _eState := E_DL_HandoverPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲（不锁存、不出单拍）/ back to idle without a latch or a pulse
        END_IF
    E_DL_HandoverPhase.eFault: // 故障相：锁存保持，等复位沿（解除可达，边界七）/ the fault phase held until the reset edge
        IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（复位作用域：清锁存 + 清快照 + 清累计量 + 迁相位）/ the reset with the declared scope
            _bFault := FALSE; // 清故障锁存 / clear the fault latch
            _nConfirmed := 0; // 清确认计数 / clear the confirmed count
            _nPendingLock := 0; // 清未决锁定值（复位作用域含锁定值，D7 返修）/ clear the locked pending count within the reset scope
            _uSnapProd := 0; // 清产量快照（R243 最近一次类出口入复位清单）/ clear the production snapshot
            _uSnapAlarm := 0; // 清报警快照 / clear the alarm snapshot
            _eState := E_DL_HandoverPhase.eIdle; // 故障相迁出边回空闲 / the exit edge back to idle
        END_IF
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截 / the illegal enumeration guard
        _eState := E_DL_HandoverPhase.eIdle; // 落回空闲 / force back to idle
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / latch the fault
END_CASE

// 段 5｜故障锁存迁移闸（置于解除段之后防同拍抢迁，R258）/ segment 5, the fault latch to phase gate placed after the release
IF _bFault AND (_eState <> E_DL_HandoverPhase.eFault) THEN // 已锁存但不在故障相 / latched but not in the fault phase
    _eState := E_DL_HandoverPhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相 / enter the fault phase
END_IF

// 段 6｜统一出口（内部副本单点映射，R180；故障码锁存回放，R187）/ segment 6, the unified outlet
_bIncomplete := (_eState = E_DL_HandoverPhase.eWait) AND (_nConfirmed < _nPendingLock); // 未确认提示逐拍重算（判据用锁定值，D7 返修）/ the unconfirmed hint recomputed every scan against the locked count
bRunning := (_eState = E_DL_HandoverPhase.eWait); // 进行中出口 / the in progress outlet
bHandoverDone := _bDone; // 完成单拍出口 / the done pulse outlet
nConfirmedCnt := _nConfirmed; // 确认条数出口 / the confirmed count outlet
nSnapProd := _uSnapProd; // 产量快照出口 / the production snapshot outlet
nSnapAlarm := _uSnapAlarm; // 报警快照出口 / the alarm snapshot outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bError := _bFault; // 故障位出口（与锁存同源）/ the fault bit outlet from the same latch
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存回放优先 / the latched fault replays first
    IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态成因（独立码值，R190）/ the configuration cause with its own code
        eErr := 16#0005_0621; // 故障级：交接窗时长非法 / fault grade, the window length is illegal
    ELSE // 超窗成因 / the overrun cause
        eErr := 16#0005_0622; // 故障级：到期仍未全部确认 / fault grade, still unconfirmed at the expiry
    END_IF
ELSIF _bIncomplete THEN // 未确认提示（信息级，逐拍重算）/ the informational unconfirmed hint
    eErr := 16#0005_0620; // 信息级：尚有未决事项 / informational, items still pending
    bError := FALSE; // 信息级不置 bError（仅故障级置位，R45 配对口径）/ the informational code never raises the fault bit
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R59 首版（批 1 · 序号 2）
    2026-11-21  v1.0.1  修 R275 同拍竞态：超时迁移前预消化本拍二按沿
                        （原 v1.0.0 段 3 超时先清 _bArmed，段 4 读假预备态把
                         二按当首按重新武装，二按被吞需按第三次；本次仅调整
                         段序与事件优先判据，对外引脚与语义一字不动）
    2026-11-21  v1.0.2  R61 轻项：段 4 超时判据补 AND _bArmed 双保险（R60
                        复核残留项；语义不变，仅防御性收紧）
  ==================================================================
*)

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_TwoStepConfirm
VAR_INPUT
    bBtn       : BOOL := FALSE;  // 确认按钮输入，上升沿语义 [-] / the confirm button input, rising edge semantics
    tArmWindow : TIME := T#3S;   // 二按限窗时长 [毫秒] / the second press window [millisecond]
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bArmed     : BOOL := FALSE;  // 预备态指示（首按已受理等二按）[-] / the armed indicator, first press accepted
    bConfirmed : BOOL := FALSE;  // 两步确认成立单脉冲（单拍）[-] / the confirmed one shot pulse, single scan
    bTimeout   : BOOL := FALSE;  // 预备窗超时单脉冲（单拍）[-] / the window timeout one shot pulse, single scan
    bError     : BOOL := FALSE;  // 预留故障位（本件无浮点运算，恒常假）[-] / the reserved fault bit, constant false
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit     : BOOL := FALSE; // 首拍初始化标志（R310，真实使用：首拍清预备态）/ the first scan flag, real use
    _bArmed    : BOOL := FALSE; // 预备态锁存位（区分于实时镜像 bArmed）/ the armed latch bit
    _bEvtTaken : BOOL := FALSE; // 同拍事件已消化标志（单拍，段 2 预清，R275）/ the same scan event consumed flag, single scan preset in segment two
    rtBtn      : R_TRIG;        // 按钮沿检测，段 0 无条件刷新 / the button edge, refreshed unconditionally
    tonArm     : TON;           // 二按限窗定时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the arm window timer, refreshed unconditionally
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtBtn(CLK := bBtn); // 按钮沿 / the button edge
tonArm(IN := _bArmed, PT := tArmWindow); // 限窗计时，预备态驱动 / the window timing, driven by the armed latch

// 段 1｜首拍初始化（R310 真实使用路径）：预备态显式清零 / segment 1, the first scan init
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bArmed := FALSE; // 预备态显式清零（编译缺省之上的显式安全预置）/ clear the armed latch explicitly
END_IF

// 段 2｜单拍脉冲与单拍标志每拍前置清零（本库纪律③防粘滞；仅单拍标志入此清单，R32 FB32-1）/ segment 2, the per scan preset of the one shot pulses and flags
bConfirmed := FALSE; // 确认脉冲预清零 / preset the confirmed pulse false
bTimeout := FALSE; // 超时脉冲预清零 / preset the timeout pulse false
_bEvtTaken := FALSE; // 同拍事件消化标志预清零（先清后置，R53）/ preset the same scan consumed flag false, clear before set

// 段 3｜本拍输入沿预消化（R275：合法事件先于超时迁移消化，段序在段 4 之前）/ segment 3, the same scan input edge pre-digest, the legal event ahead of the timeout migration
IF rtBtn.Q THEN // 按钮上升沿 / the button rising edge
    _bEvtTaken := TRUE; // 标记本拍已消化事件（段 4 据此不再发超时）/ mark the event consumed this scan, the segment four skips the timeout
    IF NOT _bArmed THEN // 首按：进入预备 / the first press, arm
        _bArmed := TRUE; // 置预备态（限窗同步启动）/ raise the armed latch
    ELSE // 二按：确认成立 / the second press, confirmed
        _bArmed := FALSE; // 退出预备态 / leave the armed state
        bConfirmed := TRUE; // 置确认单脉冲 / raise the confirmed pulse
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 4｜预备窗超时迁移（窗口末退出，边界二；同拍已消化输入沿则不迁移，R275）/ segment 4, the window expiry migration, skipped when the same scan edge is already consumed
IF tonArm.Q AND (NOT _bEvtTaken) AND _bArmed THEN // 限窗到期且本拍无合法事件且仍在预备态（R61 轻项：_bArmed 双保险）/ the window expired with no legal event this scan and still armed, the double guard
    _bArmed := FALSE; // 自动退出预备态 / auto leave the armed state
    bTimeout := TRUE; // 置超时单脉冲 / raise the timeout pulse
END_IF

// 段 5｜统一出口（实时镜像与锁存位同源，R191 名实双出口）/ segment 5, the unified outlet
bArmed := _bArmed; // 预备态输出 / the armed outlet
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 导轨多路电源上下电时序顺控：按序合闸、逆序分闸、级间延时与互锁（返修版 v1.0.1）。真实工况：控制柜 24V/48V/伺服动力分级上电。边界：任一级未就绪不得进下一级；急停/故障立即全断并锁存；延时≤0 判非法；空轨（无已上电轨）接收断电请求须安全收口不得越界。
architecture_thought: 返修不改架构（eIdle/eRampUp/eStable/eRampDn 四相 CASE + ELSE 兜底），仅补空轨负下标闸：逆向起步索引由 _nCnt-1 派生，_nCnt=0 时钳到 0 号轨，避免 abRailFb[-1] 越界读；正常路径行为零变更（R333 安全侧例外）。
output:
(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FB_DL_RailPowerSequence
  分类   Category   : DL_Base
  前缀   Naming     : FB_DL_ ｜ b/n/u/f/t/e/st 类型前缀制（R265）
  复杂度 Complexity  : 中
  版本   Version    : 1.0.1
  功能   Purpose    : 多路供电轨按序上电/断电（延时可配、断电逆序、步进超时锁存）。
  来源   Source     : self-std（供电时序公开工程语义自研）
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（TON / R_TRIG / CASE），三平台通用
  分工声明 Split     : 与 FB_DL_LaserWeldPowerSeq（工艺专用属主）分工——后者绑定
                      激光焊接工艺流；本件为通用时序原子，不绑工艺、不判负载
                      特性（R216 双向互引）。
  作者   Author     : 道莅代码库 · PLC 编程专家（R61）
  归属 Ownership     : E_DL_RailPhase 属主为本文件（全库唯一定义，R264）；
                      引用件只引用不重声明。
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 uRailCount = 0 或 > 8 判组态非法故障码，不进时序
                         （边界五；R239 显式分支，禁比较算子隐式分流）；
                      二 断电逆序强制：断电步序 = 上电步序倒序（结构写死）；
                      三 步进超时锁存独立码 + 解除式可达自证：故障相由复位沿
                         迁回空闲并清锁存（bReset 输入引脚恒可达，R152 自证）；
                      四 状态机 ENUM + CASE，ELSE 拦非法态；TON/R_TRIG 段 0
                         无条件刷新（禁入分支，R7）；TON IN 串故障锁存门控
                         （FB50-1）；
                      五 使能失电语义为「弃用本轮时序」（回空闲，不锁存不出
                         单拍）——R191 声明行；
                      六 无全局、无外部变量、无物理地址。
  错误码   Codes    :
    16#0001_0642【故障级】供电轨数组态非法（=0 或 >8），锁存至复位沿
    16#0001_0643【故障级】步进反馈超时（tStepTimeout 内未见该轨反馈），锁存至复位沿
  验收   Acceptance :
    算法已证（脚本）：未跑 ｜ 编译器已证（三平台）：未跑
    V1 3 轨、反馈逐轨到位 → uOnCount=3、bDone 单拍
    V2 第 2 轨反馈不至 → 码 0643、eFault、锁存待复位
    V3 uRailCount=0 → 码 0642、不进时序
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R61 首版（批 3 · 序号 9）
    2026-11-21  v1.0.1  R61 终审 D1 就地修（安全侧）：空轨断电起步 _nStep<0 钳位、堵 abRailFb[-1] 越界读（R333 安全侧例外，正常路径行为零变更）
