*)
TYPE E_DL_RailPhase :
(
    eIdle    := 0,  // 空闲：等上电/断电命令沿 / idle, waiting for the power command edges
    eRampUp  := 10, // 上电步进：正向逐轨 / the power up stepping forward rail by rail
    eStable  := 20, // 稳定：全轨已上 / stable, all rails powered
    eRampDn  := 30  // 断电步进：逆向逐轨（边界二）/ the power down stepping in the reverse order
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_RailPowerSequence
VAR_INPUT
    bOnCmd       : BOOL := FALSE; // 上电命令电平，上升沿发起正向时序 / the power on command level
    bOffCmd      : BOOL := FALSE; // 断电命令电平，上升沿发起逆向时序 / the power off command level
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存回空闲 / the fault reset level
    uRailCount   : UDINT := 3;    // 供电轨数 [路]，合法域 1..8 / the rail count, legal from one to eight
    tStepTimeout : TIME := T#5S;  // 单轨步进超时 [毫秒] / the per rail step timeout
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    abRailFb  : ARRAY[0..7] OF BOOL; // 各轨反馈电平 [路反馈]，只读 / the rail feedback levels, read only
    atOnDelay : ARRAY[0..7] OF TIME; // 各轨上电前延时 [毫秒]，可配 / the per rail pre power delay, configurable
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    uOnCnt  : UDINT := 0;              // 已上电轨数 [路] / the powered rail count
    bDone   : BOOL := FALSE;           // 本轮时序完成单拍脉冲 [-] / the round done one shot pulse
    eState  : E_DL_RailPhase;          // 主状态机当前态 [状态] / the current state
    bError  : BOOL := FALSE;           // 故障锁存位（与锁存同源，R191）/ the fault bit from the latch
    eErr    : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;   // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit   : BOOL := FALSE;                          // 首拍初始化标志（R310）/ the first scan flag
    _eState  : E_DL_RailPhase := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bDone   : BOOL := FALSE;                          // 完成单拍内部位，段 1 预清段 5 映射 / the internal done bit
    _bFault  : BOOL := FALSE;                          // 故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _nStep   : DINT  := 0;                             // 当前步进轨索引 [下标] / the current step rail index
    _nCnt    : UDINT := 0;                             // 已完成轨数副本 [路] / the completed rail count copy
    _nUse    : DINT  := 0;                             // 钳位后的轨数 [路] / the clamped rail count
    _bCfgBad : BOOL  := FALSE;                         // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    _bStepGo : BOOL  := FALSE;                         // 步进计时使能（驻留派生）[-] / the step timing enable derived from the dwell
    rtOn     : R_TRIG;  // 上电命令沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the on command edge instance
    rtOff    : R_TRIG;  // 断电命令沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the off command edge instance
    rtReset  : R_TRIG;  // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the reset edge instance
    rtFb     : R_TRIG;  // 步进轨反馈沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the step rail feedback edge instance
    tonStep  : TON;     // 步进超时计时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the step timeout timer
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_RPS_RMAX : DINT := 8; // 供电轨容量上界 [路]，与数组容量一致 / the rail capacity aligned with the array
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7；TON IN 串故障锁存门控，FB50-1）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtOn(CLK := bOnCmd); // 上电沿 / the on edge
rtOff(CLK := bOffCmd); // 断电沿 / the off edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
IF _eState = E_DL_RailPhase.eRampUp THEN // 上电步进相：当前轨反馈 / the ramp up phase watches the current rail
    rtFb(CLK := abRailFb[_nStep]); // 步进轨反馈沿 / the step rail feedback edge
ELSE // 非步进相：非步进相固定刷新 0 号轨（保持无条件调用形态）/ the other phases refresh on the rail zero slot
    rtFb(CLK := abRailFb[0]); // 固定下标刷新 / the fixed index refresh
END_IF
_bStepGo := (_eState = E_DL_RailPhase.eRampUp) OR (_eState = E_DL_RailPhase.eRampDn); // 步进相驻留派生 / the dwell derived enable
tonStep(IN := _bStepGo AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tStepTimeout); // 步进超时（串故障锁存门控，FB50-1）/ the step timeout with the latch gate

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与单拍标志预清（FB32-1；R256）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the preset
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _nStep := 0; // 步进索引显式清零 / clear the step index explicitly
    _nCnt := 0; // 完成轨数显式清零 / clear the completed count explicitly
    _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域：清锁存 + 迁相位 + 清步进量，R311）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _bFault := FALSE; // 清故障锁存 / clear the fault latch
    _nStep := 0; // 清步进索引 / clear the step index
    _nCnt := 0; // 清完成轨数 / clear the completed count
    _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
END_IF
_bDone := FALSE; // 完成单拍预清零 / preset the done pulse false
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态标记预清零 / preset the configuration flag false

// 段 2｜组态域闸（轨数合法域 1..8，边界一）/ segment 2, the rail count gate
_nUse := UDINT_TO_DINT(uRailCount); // 轨数升位接管（超 DINT 域转负即被下界捕获）/ take the rail count widened, an overflow lands below the floor
IF (_nUse < 1) OR (_nUse > DL_RPS_RMAX) THEN // 轨数越域 / the rail count out of the domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 置组态非法标记 / raise the configuration flag
    _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存故障（0642，段 5 回放）/ latch the fault
END_IF
IF _nUse < 1 THEN // 下界钳位（防越界索引）/ the floor clamp for the index safety
    _nUse := 1; // 钳到一 / clamp to one
END_IF
IF _nUse > DL_RPS_RMAX THEN // 上界钳位 / the ceiling clamp
    _nUse := DL_RPS_RMAX; // 钳到容量 / clamp to the capacity
END_IF

// 段 3｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 拦非法态；安全相迁移带全量闸位复检，R274）/ segment 3, the main machine
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相 / the idle phase
        IF rtOn.Q AND (NOT _bFault) AND (NOT _bCfgBad) THEN // 上电沿 + 全量闸位复检（R274）/ the on edge with the full gate recheck
            _nStep := 0; // 从 0 号轨正向起步 / start forward from the rail zero
            _nCnt := 0; // 完成轨数归零 / reset the completed count
            _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eRampUp; // 迁入上电步进相 / enter the ramp up phase
        ELSIF rtOff.Q AND (NOT _bFault) AND (NOT _bCfgBad) THEN // 断电沿 + 全量闸位复检 / the off edge with the recheck
            _nStep := UDINT_TO_DINT(_nCnt) - 1; // 从已完成末轨逆向起步（断电逆序，边界二）/ start reverse from the last powered rail
            IF _nStep < 0 THEN // 空轨保护：无已上电轨时钳到 0 号轨，防 abRailFb[-1] 越界读（R61-D1）/ empty-bank guard
                _nStep := 0; // 钳到 0 号轨，本拍反馈为空即下一拍正常收口 / clamp to the rail zero
            END_IF
            _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eRampDn; // 迁入断电步进相 / enter the ramp down phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_RailPhase.eRampUp: // 上电步进相 / the ramp up phase
        IF rtFb.Q THEN // 当前轨反馈到沿 / the current rail feedback edge
            _nCnt := _nCnt + 1; // 完成轨数推进 / advance the completed count
            _nStep := _nStep + 1; // 步进索引推进 / advance the step index
            IF _nStep >= _nUse THEN // 全轨完成 / all rails done
                _bDone := TRUE; // 置完成单拍 / raise the done pulse
                _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eStable; // 迁入稳定相 / enter the stable phase
            END_IF
        ELSIF tonStep.Q THEN // 步进超时（边界三）/ the step timeout
            _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存超时故障（0643）/ latch the timeout fault
        ELSIF _bFault THEN // 前置条件消失出口 / the prerequisite gone exit
            _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲（锁存迁移由段 4 收口）/ back to idle
        END_IF
    E_DL_RailPhase.eStable: // 稳定相 / the stable phase
        IF rtOff.Q AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 断电沿 + 闸位复检 / the off edge with the recheck
            _nStep := UDINT_TO_DINT(_nCnt) - 1; // 逆向起步（断电逆序）/ start reverse
            IF _nStep < 0 THEN // 空轨保护：同上，防负下标越界读（R61-D1）/ the empty-bank guard
                _nStep := 0; // 钳到 0 号轨 / clamp to the rail zero
            END_IF
            _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eRampDn; // 迁入断电步进相 / enter the ramp down phase
        ELSIF _bFault THEN // 前置条件消失 / the prerequisite gone
            _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
        END_IF
    E_DL_RailPhase.eRampDn: // 断电步进相（逆序，边界二）/ the ramp down phase in the reverse order
        IF NOT abRailFb[_nStep] THEN // 当前轨反馈已消失（断电完成判据）/ the current rail feedback gone
            IF _nCnt > 0 THEN // 无符号下溢闸（0 减 1 会回绕，先判再减）/ the underflow guard before the decrement
                _nCnt := _nCnt - 1; // 完成轨数回退 / step the completed count back
            END_IF
            _nStep := _nStep - 1; // 逆向推进 / step reverse
            IF _nStep < 0 THEN // 全轨断完 / all rails off
                _nCnt := 0; // 完成轨数清零 / clear the completed count
                _bDone := TRUE; // 置完成单拍 / raise the done pulse
                _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
            END_IF
        ELSIF tonStep.Q THEN // 步进超时 / the step timeout
            _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存超时故障 / latch the timeout fault
        ELSIF _bFault THEN // 前置条件消失 / the prerequisite gone
            _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
        END_IF
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截 / the illegal enumeration guard
        _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 落回空闲 / force back to idle
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / latch the fault
END_CASE

// 段 4｜故障锁存迁移闸（置于解除段之后防同拍抢迁，R258）/ segment 4, the latch to phase gate
IF _bFault AND (_eState <> E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle) THEN // 已锁存但不在空闲相（本件锁存即弃用本轮迁空闲）/ latched, the round is discarded to idle
    _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
END_IF

// 段 5｜统一出口（内部副本单点映射；故障码锁存回放，R187）/ segment 5, the unified outlet
uOnCnt := _nCnt; // 已上电轨数出口 / the powered count outlet
bDone := _bDone; // 完成单拍出口 / the done pulse outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bError := _bFault; // 故障位出口（与锁存同源）/ the fault bit outlet
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存回放优先 / the latched fault replays first
    IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态成因（独立码值，R190）/ the configuration cause
        eErr := 16#0001_0642; // 故障级：轨数组态非法 / fault grade, the illegal rail count
    ELSE // 超时成因 / the timeout cause
        eErr := 16#0001_0643; // 故障级：步进反馈超时 / fault grade, the step feedback timeout
    END_IF
ELSE // 无故障 / no fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

FUNCTION FC_DL_SaturateMul : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    nA   : LINT; // 被乘数 [−]，完整 LINT 域 / the multiplicand over the full LINT domain
    nB   : LINT; // 乘数 [−]，完整 LINT 域 / the multiplier over the full LINT domain
    nLo  : LINT; // 输出钳位域下界 [−] / the output clamp lower bound
    nHi  : LINT; // 输出钳位域上界 [−] / the output clamp upper bound
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    nOut     : LINT;  // 钳位后结果 [−] / the clamped product
    bOvF     : BOOL;  // 乘法溢出发生（钳位已生效）[-] / a multiplicative overflow happened
    bClamped : BOOL;  // 钳位生效（含纯域钳，未溢出）[-] / the clamp took effect, domain clamp included
    bValid   : BOOL;  // 输出可用（溢出与组态故障为 FALSE）[-] / the output is usable
    eErr     : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError   : BOOL;  // 故障标志，故障级码同拍置位（R45 配对）/ the fault flag, raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    liProd : LINT := 0; // 域内乘积中间量 [−] / the in-domain product intermediate
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_SMUL_MAX : LINT := 9223372036854775807;      // LINT 可表达上界 [−]，即 2^63−1 / the expressible LINT ceiling, two to the sixty third minus one
    DL_SMUL_MIN : LINT := -9223372036854775807 - 1; // LINT 可表达下界 [−]，以上界相反数减一表达，防字面量解析溢出 / the expressible LINT floor, written as the negated ceiling minus one to avoid a literal parse overflow
    DL_SMUL_ZERO : LINT := 0;                       // 有符号零常量 [−]，避免裸字面量 / the signed zero constant
    DL_SMUL_NEG1 : LINT := -1;                      // 负一常量 [−]，MIN × -1 判据用 / the minus one constant for the MIN times minus one criterion
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, preset every outlet to its safe value
FC_DL_SaturateMul := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
nOut := DL_SMUL_ZERO; // 结果预置零 [−] / preset the product zero
bOvF := FALSE; // 溢出标志预置假 / preset the overflow flag false
bClamped := FALSE; // 钳位标志预置假 / preset the clamp flag false
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假，过闸后置位 / preset the validity false, raised after the gates
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the fault flag false
liProd := DL_SMUL_ZERO; // 乘积中间量清零 [−] / clear the product intermediate

// 段 2｜组态域闸：nLo > nHi 判故障早退（边界四，三件同口径）/ segment 2, the configuration gate, a reversed domain is a fault
IF nLo > nHi THEN // 钳位域反序 / the clamp domain is reversed
    eErr := 16#0001_0646; // 故障级：组态非法 nLo > nHi / fault grade, the reversed clamp domain
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    nOut := DL_SMUL_ZERO; // 确定缺省值零 [−] / the deterministic default of zero
    RETURN; // 早退，不再触碰乘法 / early return, the multiplication is never touched
END_IF

// 段 3｜零因子优先：积恒为零，且消灭后续预判式的除零路径（边界三）/ segment 3, the zero factor comes first and removes every division by zero
IF (nA = DL_SMUL_ZERO) OR (nB = DL_SMUL_ZERO) THEN // 任一因子为零 / either factor is zero
    liProd := DL_SMUL_ZERO; // 积确定为零 [−] / the product is exactly zero
ELSE // 双因子非零才做溢出预判 / the overflow pre-check runs only with two nonzero factors
    // 段 4｜MIN × -1 直判正溢出（边界二）：MIN 绝对值不可表示，先乘会回绕成 MIN / segment 4, the direct check of MIN times minus one
    IF ((nA = DL_SMUL_MIN) AND (nB = DL_SMUL_NEG1)) OR ((nB = DL_SMUL_MIN) AND (nA = DL_SMUL_NEG1)) THEN // 极限组合 / the limit combination
        bOvF := TRUE; // 置溢出标志（禁回绕成 MIN）/ raise the overflow flag instead of wrapping to MIN
        bClamped := TRUE; // 钳位已生效 / the clamp took effect
        nOut := nHi; // 正溢出按符号钳上界 [−] / a positive overflow clamps to the upper bound by sign
        eErr := 16#0001_0645; // 故障级：乘法溢出 / fault grade, a multiplicative overflow
        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用（结果是伪造边界）/ the output is not usable, the boundary is fabricated
        RETURN; // 早退 / early return
    END_IF
    // 段 5｜四象限溢出预判（边界一）：比较式内只有除法，没有裸乘法 / segment 5, the four quadrant pre-check with divisions only
    IF (nA > DL_SMUL_ZERO) AND (nB > DL_SMUL_ZERO) THEN // 正正象限 / the positive positive quadrant
        IF nA > (DL_SMUL_MAX / nB) THEN // 超上界预判（nB ≥ 1，除子安全）/ the ceiling pre-check with a safe divisor
            bOvF := TRUE; // 置溢出标志 / raise the overflow flag
            bClamped := TRUE; // 钳位已生效 / the clamp took effect
            nOut := nHi; // 正溢出钳上界 [−] / a positive overflow clamps to the upper bound
        END_IF
    ELSIF (nA < DL_SMUL_ZERO) AND (nB < DL_SMUL_ZERO) THEN // 负负象限（积为正）/ the negative negative quadrant, a positive product
        IF nA < (DL_SMUL_MAX / nB) THEN // 超上界预判（MAX ÷ 负数为负，直比不失号）/ the ceiling pre-check against a negative quotient
            bOvF := TRUE; // 置溢出标志 / raise the overflow flag
            bClamped := TRUE; // 钳位已生效 / the clamp took effect
            nOut := nHi; // 正溢出钳上界 [−] / a positive overflow clamps to the upper bound
        END_IF
    ELSIF (nA > DL_SMUL_ZERO) AND (nB < DL_SMUL_ZERO) THEN // 正负象限（积为负）/ the positive negative quadrant, a negative product
        IF nB < (DL_SMUL_MIN / nA) THEN // 超下界预判（nA ≥ 1，除子安全）/ the floor pre-check with a safe divisor
            bOvF := TRUE; // 置溢出标志 / raise the overflow flag
            bClamped := TRUE; // 钳位已生效 / the clamp took effect
            nOut := nLo; // 负溢出钳下界 [−] / a negative overflow clamps to the lower bound
        END_IF
    ELSE // 负正象限（积为负）/ the negative positive quadrant, a negative product
        IF nA < (DL_SMUL_MIN / nB) THEN // 超下界预判（nB ≥ 1，除子安全）/ the floor pre-check with a safe divisor
            bOvF := TRUE; // 置溢出标志 / raise the overflow flag
            bClamped := TRUE; // 钳位已生效 / the clamp took effect
            nOut := nLo; // 负溢出钳下界 [−] / a negative overflow clamps to the lower bound
        END_IF
    END_IF
    IF bOvF THEN // 已判溢出：结果已直达边界，跳过域钳 / an overflow already reached the boundary, the domain clamp is skipped
        eErr := 16#0001_0645; // 故障级：乘法溢出 / fault grade, a multiplicative overflow
        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
        RETURN; // 早退 / early return
    END_IF
    liProd := nA * nB; // 预判通过后域内相乘（此时必不溢出）/ multiply after the pre-check passed, so no overflow can occur
END_IF

// 段 6｜统一域钳（零因子与域内积共用同一出口，R94 早退分支后处理一致）/ segment 6, the unified domain clamp shared by both paths
IF liProd > nHi THEN // 超上界 / above the ceiling
    nOut := nHi; // 钳上界 [−] / clamp to the ceiling
    bClamped := TRUE; // 置钳位标志 / raise the clamp flag
ELSIF liProd < nLo THEN // 超下界 / below the floor
    nOut := nLo; // 钳下界 [−] / clamp to the floor
    bClamped := TRUE; // 置钳位标志 / raise the clamp flag
ELSE // 域内 / inside the domain
    nOut := liProd; // 直出乘积 [−] / pass the product through
END_IF

// 段 7｜信息级钳位码与可用位（纯域钳不置 bError，R285 分级纪律）/ segment 7, the informational clamp code without a fault flag
IF bClamped THEN // 发生纯域钳（溢出已在段 5 早退）/ a pure domain clamp happened, overflow already returned earlier
    eErr := 16#0001_0644; // 信息级：结果被域钳位 / informational, the result was clamped to the domain
END_IF
bValid := TRUE; // 域内或钳位输出均可用 / an in-domain or clamped output is usable
FC_DL_SaturateMul := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

    bOvF     : BOOL;  // 溢出发生（MIN ÷ -1）[-] / an overflow happened on MIN divided by minus one

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, preset every outlet to its safe value
FC_DL_SaturateDiv := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
nOut := DL_SDIV_ZERO; // 结果预置零 [−] / preset the quotient zero
bDivZero := FALSE; // 除零标志预置假 / preset the divide by zero flag false
bOvF := FALSE; // 溢出标志预置假 / preset the overflow flag false
bClamped := FALSE; // 钳位标志预置假 / preset the clamp flag false
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假，过闸后置位 / preset the validity false, raised after the gates
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the fault flag false
liQuot := DL_SDIV_ZERO; // 商中间量清零 [−] / clear the quotient intermediate

// 段 2｜组态域闸：nLo > nHi 判故障早退（边界三，三件同口径）/ segment 2, the configuration gate, a reversed domain is a fault
IF nLo > nHi THEN // 钳位域反序 / the clamp domain is reversed
    eErr := 16#0001_064A; // 故障级：组态非法 nLo > nHi / fault grade, the reversed clamp domain
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    nOut := DL_SDIV_ZERO; // 确定缺省值零 [−] / the deterministic default of zero
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 3｜判据①除数为零：早退，绝不行钳位（边界一，钳位会把非法伪装成合法边界）/ segment 3, the divisor zero gate, clamped never runs
IF nDen = DL_SDIV_ZERO THEN // 除数为零 / the divisor is zero
    bDivZero := TRUE; // 置除零标志 / raise the divide by zero flag
    nOut := DL_SDIV_ZERO; // 确定缺省值零 [−] / the deterministic default of zero
    eErr := 16#0001_0648; // 故障级：除数为零 / fault grade, the divisor is zero
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退，不做任何除法与钳位 / early return without any division or clamping
END_IF

// 段 4｜判据②MIN ÷ -1 溢出（MIN 的绝对值不可表示，先除必回绕）/ segment 4, the MIN divided by minus one overflow
IF (nNum = DL_SDIV_MIN) AND (nDen = DL_SDIV_NEG1) THEN // 极限组合 / the limit combination
    bOvF := TRUE; // 置溢出标志（禁回绕成 MIN）/ raise the overflow flag instead of wrapping to MIN
    bClamped := TRUE; // 钳位已生效 / the clamp took effect
    nOut := nHi; // 正溢出按符号钳上界 [−] / a positive overflow clamps to the upper bound by sign
    eErr := 16#0001_0649; // 故障级：MIN ÷ -1 溢出 / fault grade, the MIN divided by minus one overflow
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 5｜判据③正常除：整数商向零截断（边界二，IEC 语义，-7 ÷ 2 = -3）/ segment 5, the normal division with the quotient truncated toward zero
IF nNum = DL_SDIV_ZERO THEN // 零被除数：商确为零，免一次除法 / a zero dividend gives an exact zero quotient, no division needed
    liQuot := DL_SDIV_ZERO; // 商为零 [−] / the quotient is zero
ELSE // 非零被除数才真除（除子已在段 3 证非零）/ the real division only for a nonzero dividend, the divisor is proven nonzero
    liQuot := nNum / nDen; // 向零截断（-7 ÷ 2 = -3，非 -4）[−] / truncated toward zero, minus seven over two gives minus three
END_IF

// 段 6｜判据④统一域钳（零被除数与正常除共用同一出口，R94）/ segment 6, the unified domain clamp shared by both paths
IF liQuot > nHi THEN // 超上界 / above the ceiling
    nOut := nHi; // 钳上界 [−] / clamp to the ceiling
    bClamped := TRUE; // 置钳位标志 / raise the clamp flag
ELSIF liQuot < nLo THEN // 超下界 / below the floor
    nOut := nLo; // 钳下界 [−] / clamp to the floor
    bClamped := TRUE; // 置钳位标志 / raise the clamp flag
ELSE // 域内 / inside the domain
    nOut := liQuot; // 直出商 [−] / pass the quotient through
END_IF

// 段 7｜信息级钳位码与可用位（纯域钳不置 bError，R285）/ segment 7, the informational clamp code without a fault flag
IF bClamped THEN // 发生纯域钳 / a pure domain clamp happened
    eErr := 16#0001_0647; // 信息级：结果被域钳位 / informational, the result was clamped to the domain
END_IF
bValid := TRUE; // 域内或钳位输出均可用 / an in-domain or clamped output is usable
FC_DL_SaturateDiv := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

FUNCTION FC_DL_ShiftArithEx : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    diIn   : DINT; // 待移位值 [−]，完整 DINT 域 / the value to shift over the full DINT domain
    nShift : DINT; // 移位位数 [位]，合法域 1..31，0 原值、负值钳 0、≥32 饱和 / the shift amount in bits, valid one to thirty one
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    diOut  : DINT;  // 算术右移结果 [−] / the arithmetic shift result
    bSat   : BOOL;  // 移位量越域已被钳（含负值与 ≥32）[-] / the shift amount was out of domain and clamped
    eErr   : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError : BOOL;  // 故障标志（本件只有信息级码，恒 FALSE，保留引脚供族内统一）/ the fault flag, always false here since only informational codes exist
END_VAR
VAR
    udwWork : DWORD := 16#0000_0000; // 逻辑右移工作寄存器 [位] / the logical shift working register in bits
    nUse    : DINT := 0;             // 归一后的移位量 [位] / the normalized shift amount in bits
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_SAR_ZERO : DINT := 0;         // 零常量 [位] / the zero constant
    DL_SAR_BITS : DINT := 32;        // DINT 容器位宽 [位] / the DINT container width in bits
    DL_SAR_NEG1 : DINT := -1;        // 全 1 常量（负数饱和填充值）[−] / the all ones constant used as the negative saturation fill
    DL_SAR_MASK : ARRAY[0..31] OF DWORD := // 高位掩码表（第 k 项 = 高 k 位置 1，k = 0 为零），预计算禁运行时 SHL(x,32) [位] / the precomputed high side mask table, k bits set from the top
    [
        16#0000_0000, // k = 0：不移位，无高位 / k equals zero, no high bits at all
        16#8000_0000, // k = 1：最高 1 位 / the top single bit
        16#C000_0000, // k = 2 / two top bits
        16#E000_0000, // k = 3 / three top bits
        16#F000_0000, // k = 4 / four top bits
        16#F800_0000, // k = 5 / five top bits
        16#FC00_0000, // k = 6 / six top bits
        16#FE00_0000, // k = 7 / seven top bits
        16#FF00_0000, // k = 8 / eight top bits
        16#FF80_0000, // k = 9 / nine top bits
        16#FFC0_0000, // k = 10 / ten top bits
        16#FFE0_0000, // k = 11 / eleven top bits
        16#FFF0_0000, // k = 12 / twelve top bits
        16#FFF8_0000, // k = 13 / thirteen top bits
        16#FFFC_0000, // k = 14 / fourteen top bits
        16#FFFE_0000, // k = 15 / fifteen top bits
        16#FFFF_0000, // k = 16：高半字 / the whole high half word
        16#FFFF_8000, // k = 17 / seventeen top bits
        16#FFFF_C000, // k = 18 / eighteen top bits
        16#FFFF_E000, // k = 19 / nineteen top bits
        16#FFFF_F000, // k = 20 / twenty top bits
        16#FFFF_F800, // k = 21 / twenty one top bits
        16#FFFF_FC00, // k = 22 / twenty two top bits
        16#FFFF_FE00, // k = 23 / twenty three top bits
        16#FFFF_FF00, // k = 24 / twenty four top bits
        16#FFFF_FF80, // k = 25 / twenty five top bits
        16#FFFF_FFC0, // k = 26 / twenty six top bits
        16#FFFF_FFE0, // k = 27 / twenty seven top bits
        16#FFFF_FFF0, // k = 28 / twenty eight top bits
        16#FFFF_FFF8, // k = 29 / twenty nine top bits
        16#FFFF_FFFC, // k = 30 / thirty top bits
        16#FFFF_FFFE  // k = 31 / thirty one top bits
    ];
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, preset every outlet to its safe value
FC_DL_ShiftArithEx := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
diOut := DL_SAR_ZERO; // 结果预置零 [−] / preset the result zero
bSat := FALSE; // 越域标志预置假 / preset the saturation flag false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假（本件无故障级码）/ preset the fault flag false, no fault level code exists here
udwWork := 16#0000_0000; // 工作寄存器清零 [位] / clear the working register
nUse := DL_SAR_ZERO; // 归一移位量清零 [位] / clear the normalized shift amount

// 段 2｜nShift ≤ 0：0 移位原值返回；负值反向移位非法，钳 0 并提示（边界三）/ segment 2, the non positive shift amount branch
IF nShift < DL_SAR_ZERO THEN // 反向移位非法 / a reverse shift is illegal
    bSat := TRUE; // 置越域标志 / raise the out of domain flag
    eErr := 16#0001_064B; // 信息级：移位量为负已钳 0 / informational, a negative amount is clamped to zero
    diOut := diIn; // 钳 0 后等于原值 [−] / with zero shift the result is the original value
    FC_DL_ShiftArithEx := TRUE; // 信息级不阻断，返回成功 / an informational code does not block, return success
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF
IF nShift = DL_SAR_ZERO THEN // 零移位：不改值且无任何提示 / a zero shift changes nothing and raises nothing
    diOut := diIn; // 原值直出 [−] / pass the original value through
    FC_DL_ShiftArithEx := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 3｜nShift ≥ 32：不调用 SHR，直接按符号位全填充（边界一，禁 SHL/SHR(x,32)）/ segment 3, the at or above container width branch
IF nShift >= DL_SAR_BITS THEN // 移位量达到或超过容器位宽 / the amount reached or exceeded the container width
    bSat := TRUE; // 置越域标志 / raise the out of domain flag
    eErr := 16#0001_064C; // 信息级：移位量 ≥ 32 已按符号位全填充 / informational, the amount at or above thirty two fills with the sign bit
    IF diIn < DL_SAR_ZERO THEN // 负数：全 1 填充 / a negative value fills with all ones
        diOut := DL_SAR_NEG1; // 结果为 -1 [−] / the result is minus one
    ELSE // 非负数：全 0 填充 / a non negative value fills with zeros
        diOut := DL_SAR_ZERO; // 结果为 0 [−] / the result is zero
    END_IF
    FC_DL_ShiftArithEx := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

nUse := nShift; // 域内移位量接管（已证 1..31）[位] / take the in-domain amount, proven one to thirty one
udwWork := SHR(DINT_TO_DWORD(diIn), nUse); // 逻辑右移（高位补 0）[位] / the logical shift with zeros shifted in
IF diIn < DL_SAR_ZERO THEN // 符号位为 1 才需补 1（非负数 OR 掩码会污染成负数）/ fill only for a set sign bit, otherwise the mask would turn the result negative
    udwWork := udwWork OR DL_SAR_MASK[nUse]; // 补入高 nUse 个 1 [位] / fill the top amount of ones
END_IF
diOut := DWORD_TO_DINT(udwWork); // 位型还原为有符号结果 [−] / reinterpret the bit pattern as a signed result

bSat := FALSE; // 正常路径明确落假（越域分支已早退）/ the normal path explicitly falls to false, the out of domain branches returned earlier
FC_DL_ShiftArithEx := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

FUNCTION FC_DL_SignExtendEx : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    diIn    : DINT; // 待扩展值 [−]，完整 DINT 域 / the value to extend over the full DINT domain

VAR
    udwIn   : DWORD := 16#0000_0000; // 输入位型 [位] / the input bit pattern in bits
    udwLo   : DWORD := 16#0000_0000; // 低 nWidth 位掩码 [位] / the low width mask in bits
    udwHi   : DWORD := 16#0000_0000; // 高位全 1 掩码 [位] / the high side all ones mask in bits
    udwSign : DWORD := 16#0000_0000; // 符号位单点掩码 [位] / the single bit sign mask in bits
    udwOut  : DWORD := 16#0000_0000; // 扩展后位型 [位] / the extended bit pattern in bits
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_SEXT_MINW : DINT := 1;            // 位宽下界 [位] / the width floor in bits
    DL_SEXT_MAXW : DINT := 32;           // 位宽上界（DINT 容器位宽）[位] / the width ceiling, the DINT container width
    DL_SEXT_ALL  : DWORD := 16#FFFF_FFFF; // 全 1 常量，用于取补 [位] / the all ones constant used for the complement
    DL_SEXT_LO : ARRAY[0..32] OF DWORD := // 低 n 位掩码表（第 n 项 = 低 n 位置 1），预计算禁运行时 SHL [位] / the precomputed low width mask table
    [
        16#0000_0000, // n = 0：无有效位 / n equals zero, no significant bit
        16#0000_0001, // n = 1 / one bit
        16#0000_0003, // n = 2 / two bits
        16#0000_0007, // n = 3 / three bits
        16#0000_000F, // n = 4 / four bits
        16#0000_001F, // n = 5 / five bits
        16#0000_003F, // n = 6 / six bits
        16#0000_007F, // n = 7 / seven bits
        16#0000_00FF, // n = 8：单字节 / one byte
        16#0000_01FF, // n = 9 / nine bits
        16#0000_03FF, // n = 10 / ten bits
        16#0000_07FF, // n = 11 / eleven bits
        16#0000_0FFF, // n = 12：12 位 ADC 原始码常用 / the usual twelve bit ADC raw code width
        16#0000_1FFF, // n = 13 / thirteen bits
        16#0000_3FFF, // n = 14 / fourteen bits
        16#0000_7FFF, // n = 15 / fifteen bits
        16#0000_FFFF, // n = 16：单字 / one word
        16#0001_FFFF, // n = 17 / seventeen bits
        16#0003_FFFF, // n = 18 / eighteen bits
        16#0007_FFFF, // n = 19 / nineteen bits
        16#000F_FFFF, // n = 20 / twenty bits
        16#001F_FFFF, // n = 21 / twenty one bits
        16#003F_FFFF, // n = 22 / twenty two bits
        16#007F_FFFF, // n = 23 / twenty three bits
        16#00FF_FFFF, // n = 24 / twenty four bits
        16#01FF_FFFF, // n = 25 / twenty five bits
        16#03FF_FFFF, // n = 26 / twenty six bits
        16#07FF_FFFF, // n = 27 / twenty seven bits
        16#0FFF_FFFF, // n = 28 / twenty eight bits
        16#1FFF_FFFF, // n = 29 / twenty nine bits
        16#3FFF_FFFF, // n = 30 / thirty bits
        16#7FFF_FFFF, // n = 31 / thirty one bits
        16#FFFF_FFFF  // n = 32：整容器 / the whole container
    ];
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, preset every outlet to its safe value
FC_DL_SignExtendEx := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
diOut := 0; // 结果预置零 [−] / preset the result zero
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the fault flag false
udwIn := 16#0000_0000; // 输入位型清零 [位] / clear the input bit pattern
udwLo := 16#0000_0000; // 低位掩码清零 [位] / clear the low mask
udwHi := 16#0000_0000; // 高位掩码清零 [位] / clear the high mask
udwSign := 16#0000_0000; // 符号掩码清零 [位] / clear the sign mask
udwOut := 16#0000_0000; // 输出位型清零 [位] / clear the output bit pattern

// 段 2｜位宽域闸：越域判故障早退（边界一，禁静默钳位）/ segment 2, the width domain gate, no silent clamping
IF (nWidth < DL_SEXT_MINW) OR (nWidth > DL_SEXT_MAXW) THEN // 位宽越域 / the width is out of the domain
    eErr := 16#0001_064D; // 故障级：位宽越域 / fault grade, the width is out of the domain
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    diOut := 0; // 确定缺省值零 [−] / the deterministic default of zero
    RETURN; // 早退，禁钳后继续（钳位会掩盖调用方的协议错位）/ early return, clamping would hide a protocol misalignment
END_IF

// 段 3｜三张掩码由单一常量表派生（边界二，无运行时移位）/ segment 3, derive all three masks from the single precomputed table
udwIn := DINT_TO_DWORD(diIn); // 输入位型接管 [位] / take the input bit pattern
udwLo := DL_SEXT_LO[nWidth]; // 低 nWidth 位掩码 [位] / the low width mask
udwHi := udwLo XOR DL_SEXT_ALL; // 高位全 1 掩码 = 低掩码取补 [位] / the high mask is the complement of the low mask
udwSign := udwLo AND (NOT DL_SEXT_LO[nWidth - DL_SEXT_MINW]); // 符号位 = 第 nWidth 位（低 n 掩码与低 n-1 掩码之差）[位] / the sign bit is the n-th bit

// 段 4｜零扩展基线：先取低 nWidth 位（两条路径共用的第一段）/ segment 4, the zero extension baseline shared by both paths
udwOut := udwIn AND udwLo; // 低 nWidth 位保留，其余清零 [位] / keep the low width bits and clear the rest

// 段 5｜符号扩展：符号位为 1 才补高位全 1（边界三）/ segment 5, the sign extension only when the sign bit is set
IF bSigned THEN // 调用方要求符号扩展 / the caller asked for the sign extension
    IF (udwOut AND udwSign) <> 16#0000_0000 THEN // 符号位为 1 / the sign bit is set
        udwOut := udwOut OR udwHi; // 高位补全 1（nWidth = 32 时 udwHi 为零，等价原样返回）/ fill the high side, the width of thirty two yields a zero high mask and passes the value through
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 6｜统一出口（位型还原为有符号结果）/ segment 6, the unified outlet
diOut := DWORD_TO_DINT(udwOut); // 位型还原 [−] / reinterpret the bit pattern as a signed value
FC_DL_SignExtendEx := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

instruction: LREAL→INT 饱和转换：真实工况为模拟量标定结果写入 16 位 D/A 设定字。边界：NaN 判非法（0+故障码+bValid=FALSE）；±Inf 钳对应边界；超域钳位 bClamped；向零截断（四舍入口径归 FC_DL_RoundSat）；与 RealToDintSat/RealToByteSat 构成 8/16/32 位三分。
architecture_thought: 防御性包装：非有限值闸（IsNaN 判故障、IsInf 判边界方向）先行于域钳；域钳用 INT 边界常量（防 LREAL 比较溢出）；截断与四舍入口径分件（本件截断、RoundSat 四舍五入）注释互引；bNonFinite/bClamped/bValid 三标志可分。

(*
  ==================================================================
  组件名 Component  : FC_DL_RealToIntSat
  分类   Category   : DL_MathData
  前缀   Naming     : FC_DL_ ｜ b/n/u/f/t/e/st 类型前缀制（R265）
  码位   Code ID    : 16#0001_064E（信息级）｜ 16#0001_064F / 0650（故障级）
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  复杂度 Complexity  : 中
  功能   Purpose    : LREAL → INT（16 位）饱和转换，统一三平台「部分平台饱和、部分平台
                      回绕」的差异；NaN / ±Inf / 越界全部确定性处置。
  开源溯源 Origin    : IEC 61131-3 标准语义的道莅防御性实现（clean-room，无第三方代码行）
  许可证 License    : MIT
  参考   Reference  : IEC 61131-3:2013 §6.6.5 类型转换函数（REAL 到整型的截断语义）
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（LREAL_TO_INT / 比较），三平台通用
  依赖   Depends    : 仅 Standard.library（LREAL_TO_INT 属标准转换函数）
  分工声明 Split     : FC_DL_RealToDintSat（32 位）与 FC_DL_RealToByteSat（8 位）为同位宽
                      兄弟件，本件补 INT（16 位），三件构成位宽三分（R216 双向互引）；
                      工程舍入（四舍五入）归 FC_DL_RoundSat，有效位舍入归 FC_DL_RoundSigFigs，
                      本件只做向零截断。
  归属 Ownership     : 本件无 TYPE 声明，全部引脚为 IEC 标准原生类型。
  编译门槛 Gate      : 交付门槛：主路径委托平台内建 LREAL_TO_INT，其截断（向零）语义须在
                      CODESYS / TwinCAT 3 / InoProShop 三平台各编译并跑一次本文件 V2 向量
                      （R64 内建转换链交付门槛）。
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 判据严格有序：① NaN → 0 + 故障码 + bValid FALSE + 早退；
                         ② 组态 nLo > nHi → 故障码 + 早退；③ ±Inf → 对应边界；
                         ④ 越界 → 钳边界 + bClamped；⑤ 域内 → 向零截断；
                      二 一律在转换之前做域钳（R151：实数转整数前先钳，防溢出使方向翻转）；
                      三 非有限判据用自反与差值自减，禁用近似阈值（R79）：
                         NaN 用 fIn <> fIn，Inf 用 (fIn − fIn) <> (fIn − fIn)；
                      四 bClamped 与 bNonFinite 语义可分：域钳只置前者，非有限两者都置；
                      五 nLo > nHi 判组态故障返回 FALSE（与 FC_DL_SaturateMul / Div 同口径）；
                      六 纯函数：无记忆量、无定时器、无边沿实例，每调用重算。
  错误码 Codes      :
    16#0001_064E【信息级】输入越 [nLo, nHi] 已钳边界（bClamped = TRUE，bValid = TRUE）
    16#0001_064F【故障级】输入非有限（NaN 返 0；±Inf 钳对应边界；bValid = FALSE）
    16#0001_0650【故障级】组态非法 nLo > nHi（判故障返回 FALSE，nOut = 0）
  码位反证 Note     :
    064E 不可并入 064F：域钳结果可用（bValid = TRUE、无 bError），非有限结果不可用，
    上游 HMI 按 bValid 过滤时两者必须分开，合并会让「钳位可用」被当成「测点坏」停机（R90）。
  验收 Acceptance   :
    算法已证（脚本）：未跑 ｜ 编译器已证（三平台）：未跑
    V1 0.0 → 0、bClamped = FALSE、无码
    V2 -0.5 → 0（向零截断）、bClamped = FALSE（域内，仅截断）
    V3 32767.9 → 32767（越上界半个 LSB，钳上界）
    V4 32768.0 → 32767 + bClamped + 码 064E
    V5 -32768.1 → -32768 + bClamped + 码 064E
    V6 NaN → 0 + bNonFinite = TRUE + bValid = FALSE + 码 064F
    V7 1.0E9 → 32767 + bClamped + 码 064E
    V8 nLo > nHi → 码 0650 + 返回 FALSE
    V9 nLo = nHi = 100 → 恒定输出 100 + bClamped（域退化）
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R62 首版（批 2 · 序号 5）

*)
FUNCTION FC_DL_RealToIntSat : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    fIn : LREAL;          // 输入量 [工程单位]，必须有限 / the input value, must be finite
    nLo : INT := -32768;  // 目标钳位域下界 [−]，默认 INT 全域下界 / the clamp floor, the INT domain floor by default
    nHi : INT := 32767;   // 目标钳位域上界 [−]，默认 INT 全域上界 / the clamp ceiling, the INT domain ceiling by default
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    nOut      : INT;   // 饱和转换结果 [−] / the saturated integer result
    bClamped  : BOOL;  // 域钳位发生（含 ±Inf 钳边界）[-] / a domain clamp happened, the infinite boundary clamp included
    bNonFinite: BOOL;  // 输入非有限（NaN 或 ±Inf）[-] / the input was not finite
    bValid    : BOOL;  // 输出可用（非有限与组态故障为 FALSE）[-] / the output is usable
    eErr      : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError    : BOOL;  // 故障标志，故障级码同拍置位（R45 配对）/ the fault flag, raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    fLo : LREAL := 0.0; // 下界的实数形式 [−] / the floor in real form
    fHi : LREAL := 0.0; // 上界的实数形式 [−] / the ceiling in real form
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_R2I_ZERO : LREAL := 0.0;   // 实数零常量 [−] / the real zero constant
    DL_R2I_NONE : INT := 0;       // 整型零常量 [−] / the integer zero constant
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, preset every outlet to its safe value
FC_DL_RealToIntSat := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
nOut := DL_R2I_NONE; // 结果预置零 [−] / preset the result zero
bClamped := FALSE; // 钳位标志预置假 / preset the clamp flag false
bNonFinite := FALSE; // 非有限标志预置假 / preset the non finite flag false
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假，过闸后置位 / preset the validity false, raised after the gates
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the fault flag false
fLo := DL_R2I_ZERO; // 下界实数形式清零 / clear the floor in real form
fHi := DL_R2I_ZERO; // 上界实数形式清零 / clear the ceiling in real form

// 段 2｜判据①NaN：自反性判定，禁近似阈值（边界三，R79）/ segment 2, the NaN gate by reflexivity
IF fIn <> fIn THEN // NaN：一切比较均为假，只能用自反性 / NaN leaves every comparison false, reflexivity is the only test
    bNonFinite := TRUE; // 置非有限标志 / raise the non finite flag
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用（三件套之一，R258）/ the result is not usable
    nOut := DL_R2I_NONE; // 确定缺省值零 [−] / the deterministic default of zero
    eErr := 16#0001_064F; // 故障级：输入非有限 / fault grade, the input is not finite
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 3｜判据②组态域闸：nLo > nHi 判故障早退（边界五）/ segment 3, the configuration gate, a reversed domain is a fault
IF nLo > nHi THEN // 钳位域反序 / the clamp domain is reversed
    eErr := 16#0001_0650; // 故障级：组态非法 nLo > nHi / fault grade, the reversed clamp domain
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    nOut := DL_R2I_NONE; // 确定缺省值零 [−] / the deterministic default of zero
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 4｜判据③±Inf：差值自减判无穷（边界三），钳到对应边界并判故障 / segment 4, the infinite gate by the self difference
IF (fIn - fIn) <> (fIn - fIn) THEN // 无穷处 fIn − fIn 产 NaN，有限值恒为零 / an infinite input yields NaN from the self difference while a finite one yields zero
    bNonFinite := TRUE; // 置非有限标志 / raise the non finite flag
    bClamped := TRUE; // 钳边界已生效 / the boundary clamp took effect
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用（三件套之一，R258）/ the result is not usable
    IF fIn > DL_R2I_ZERO THEN // 正无穷 / the positive infinity
        nOut := nHi; // 钳上界 [−] / clamp to the ceiling
    ELSE // 负无穷 / the negative infinity
        nOut := nLo; // 钳下界 [−] / clamp to the floor
    END_IF
    eErr := 16#0001_064F; // 故障级：输入非有限 / fault grade, the input is not finite
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 5｜判据④⑤先钳后转：转换前必须落域内（边界二，R151）/ segment 5, clamp before the conversion
fLo := INT_TO_LREAL(nLo); // 下界实数形式 [−] / the floor in real form
fHi := INT_TO_LREAL(nHi); // 上界实数形式 [−] / the ceiling in real form
IF fIn < fLo THEN // 越下界 / below the floor
    nOut := nLo; // 钳下界 [−] / clamp to the floor
    bClamped := TRUE; // 置钳位标志 / raise the clamp flag
    eErr := 16#0001_064E; // 信息级：越下界已钳位 / informational, below the floor and clamped
ELSIF fIn > fHi THEN // 越上界 / above the ceiling
    nOut := nHi; // 钳上界 [−] / clamp to the ceiling
    bClamped := TRUE; // 置钳位标志 / raise the clamp flag
    eErr := 16#0001_064E; // 信息级：越上界已钳位 / informational, above the ceiling and clamped
ELSE // 域内：向零截断（四舍五入口径归 FC_DL_RoundSat）/ inside the domain, truncate toward zero
    nOut := LREAL_TO_INT(fIn); // 向零截断（-0.5 → 0，非 -1）[−] / truncated toward zero, minus a half gives zero
END_IF

// 段 6｜统一出口（信息级钳位不置 bError，R285）/ segment 6, the unified outlet without a fault flag
bValid := TRUE; // 域内或钳位输出均可用 / an in-domain or clamped output is usable
FC_DL_RealToIntSat := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

architecture_thought: 防御性包装：负值钳零为确定性合法行为，走信息级码不置 bError（故障语义与信息语义分离，R61-D4 教训前置）；域包含证明（2^31-1 < 2^32）以注释固化；与 UdintToDintChk 成对互引防语义漂移。

    V5 反方向向量（2^32−1 入 DINT）域上不可能，注释已给域包含关系，无须代码分支
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R62 首版（批 2 · 序号 6）

FUNCTION FC_DL_SignedToUdintSat : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    diIn : DINT; // 有符号输入 [−]，完整 DINT 域 / the signed input over the full DINT domain
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    udiOut      : UDINT; // 无符号结果 [−] / the unsigned result
    bNegClamped : BOOL;  // 负值已钳零 [-] / a negative value was clamped to zero
    bValid      : BOOL;  // 结果可用（本件恒 TRUE，保留引脚供族内统一）[-] / the result is usable, always true here
    eErr        : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError      : BOOL;  // 故障标志（本件只有信息级码，恒 FALSE）/ the fault flag, always false here since only an informational code exists
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_S2U_ZERO : DINT := 0;                  // 有符号零常量 [−] / the signed zero constant
    DL_S2U_UMIN : UDINT := 0;                 // 无符号零常量 [−] / the unsigned zero constant
    DL_S2U_DMAX : DINT := 2147483647;         // DINT 可表达上界 [−]，即 2^31−1 / the expressible DINT ceiling, two to the thirty first minus one
    DL_S2U_UMAX : UDINT := 4294967295;        // UDINT 可表达上界 [−]，即 2^32−1 / the expressible UDINT ceiling, two to the thirty second minus one
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, preset every outlet to its safe value
FC_DL_SignedToUdintSat := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
udiOut := DL_S2U_UMIN; // 结果预置零 [−] / preset the result zero
bNegClamped := FALSE; // 负值钳零标志预置假 / preset the negative clamp flag false
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假，过闸后置位 / preset the validity false, raised after the gates
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假（本件无故障级码）/ preset the fault flag false, no fault level code exists here

// 段 2｜负值钳零（边界一：确定性行为，非故障）/ segment 2, the negative clamp is a deterministic behaviour, not a fault
IF diIn < DL_S2U_ZERO THEN // 负值域 / the negative domain
    udiOut := DL_S2U_UMIN; // 钳零 [−] / clamp to zero
    bNegClamped := TRUE; // 置钳零标志 / raise the negative clamp flag
    eErr := 16#0001_0651; // 信息级：负值已钳零 / informational, a negative value was clamped to zero
    bError := FALSE; // 明确不置故障标志（信息级，R285 分级纪律）/ keep the fault flag false, this is informational
ELSE // 非负域：精确映射（边界二域包含证明）/ the non negative domain maps exactly
    udiOut := DINT_TO_UDINT(diIn); // 标准显式转换（DINT 非负域 ⊆ UDINT 全域）[−] / the standard explicit conversion, the signed non negative domain is a subset of the unsigned domain
END_IF

// 段 3｜统一出口（信息级钳零仍可用）/ segment 3, the unified outlet where a clamped zero stays usable
bValid := TRUE; // 负值钳零与正域精确均可用 / both the clamped zero and the exact positive domain are usable
FC_DL_SignedToUdintSat := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

FUNCTION FC_DL_DtToTodWrap : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    dtIn : DT := DT#1970-01-01-00:00:00; // 输入时刻 [日期时间]，有效域自 1970-01-01-00:00:00 起 / the input instant, the domain starts at the epoch
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    todOut     : TOD;   // 当日时刻 [时刻]，00:00:00 ~ 23:59:59 / the time of day
    diSecOfDay : DINT;  // 当日秒数 [秒]，0..86399 / the second of the day
    bValid     : BOOL;  // 输出可用（早于基准与委托故障为 FALSE）[-] / the output is usable
    eErr       : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError     : BOOL;  // 故障标志，故障级码同拍置位（R45 配对）；信息级恒 FALSE / the fault flag, raised with a fault level code only
END_VAR
VAR
    _nEpochSec   : DINT := 0;                // 委托返回的纪元秒 [秒] / the epoch second returned by the delegate
    _bEpochValid : BOOL := FALSE;            // 委托 bValid 承接量（独立承接，禁双写）/ the delegate valid holder, never double written
    _bEpochErr   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 委托 bError 承接量（独立承接）/ the delegate fault holder, never double written
    _uEpochErr   : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;    // 委托错误码承接量 [码] / the delegate error code holder
    _nMsOfDay    : DINT := 0;                // 当日毫秒偏移 [毫秒] / the millisecond offset inside the day
    _todWork     : TOD := TOD#00:00:00;      // 委托 TOD 返回值承接量 [时刻] / the delegate time of day holder
    _bTodValid   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 委托 TOD 可用位承接量 / the delegate time of day usable holder
    _bTodErr     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 委托 TOD 故障位承接量 / the delegate time of day fault holder
    _uTodErr     : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;    // 委托 TOD 错误码承接量 [码] / the delegate time of day error code holder
    _bTodClamped : BOOL := FALSE;            // 委托 TOD 钳位位承接量（仅留档，不参与分级）/ the delegate clamp holder, recorded only
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_DTT_SEC_PER_DAY : DINT := 86400;      // 每日秒数（日模）[秒] / the seconds of one day, the day modulus
    DL_DTT_MS_PER_SEC : DINT := 1000;        // 每秒毫秒数（毫秒域换算）[毫秒] / the milliseconds of one second
    DL_DTT_DINT_ZERO : DINT := 0;             // 整型零常量 [秒] / the integer zero constant
    DL_DTT_TOD_ZERO : TOD := TOD#00:00:00;   // 时刻哨兵零点 [时刻] / the sentinel midnight
    DL_DTT_EPOCH : DT := DT#1970-01-01-00:00:00; // 纪元基准时刻 [日期时间] / the epoch baseline instant
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, preset every outlet to its safe value
FC_DL_DtToTodWrap := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
todOut := DL_DTT_TOD_ZERO; // 时刻预置哨兵零点 [时刻] / preset the sentinel midnight
diSecOfDay := DL_DTT_DINT_ZERO; // 当日秒数预置零 [秒] / preset the second of the day zero
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假，过闸后置位 / preset the validity false, raised after the gates
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the fault flag false
_nEpochSec := DL_DTT_DINT_ZERO; // 纪元秒承接量清零 [秒] / clear the epoch second holder
_bEpochValid := FALSE; // 委托可用位承接量清零 / clear the delegate usable holder
_bEpochErr := FALSE; // 委托故障位承接量清零 / clear the delegate fault holder
_uEpochErr := 16#0000_0000; // 委托码承接量清零 [码] / clear the delegate code holder
_nMsOfDay := DL_DTT_DINT_ZERO; // 当日毫秒清零 [毫秒] / clear the millisecond offset
_todWork := DL_DTT_TOD_ZERO; // 时刻承接量清零 [时刻] / clear the time of day holder
_bTodValid := FALSE; // 委托 TOD 可用位清零 / clear the time of day usable holder
_bTodErr := FALSE; // 委托 TOD 故障位清零 / clear the time of day fault holder
_uTodErr := 16#0000_0000; // 委托 TOD 码清零 [码] / clear the time of day code
_bTodClamped := FALSE; // 委托钳位位清零 / clear the delegate clamp holder

// 段 2｜基准无效闸：早于纪元的时刻不交给委托件（边界一，还原方向不饱和，R81）/ segment 2, the epoch baseline gate
IF dtIn < DL_DTT_EPOCH THEN // 未初始化或非法时间戳 / an uninitialised or illegal timestamp
    todOut := DL_DTT_TOD_ZERO; // 哨兵零点 [时刻] / the sentinel midnight
    diSecOfDay := DL_DTT_DINT_ZERO; // 哨兵零秒 [秒] / the sentinel zero second
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    eErr := 16#0001_0652; // 信息级：输入早于纪元基准 / informational, the input precedes the epoch baseline
    bError := FALSE; // 明确不置故障标志（信息级，R285）/ keep the fault flag false, this is informational
    RETURN; // 早退，绝不把负天数交给委托件 / early return, a negative day count never reaches the delegate
END_IF

// 段 3｜委托时刻→纪元秒（R140 委托优先；返回值与可用位分承）/ segment 3, delegate the instant to the epoch second
_nEpochSec := FC_DL_DtToDintEpoch(dtIn := dtIn, eErr => _uEpochErr, bError => _bEpochErr, bValid => _bEpochValid); // 委托纪元秒换算 [秒] / delegate the epoch conversion
IF (NOT _bEpochValid) OR _bEpochErr THEN // 委托失败：码随属主回传（R66）/ the delegate failed, the code follows its owner
    eErr := _uEpochErr; // 原样回传委托码 [码] / replay the delegate code as is
    bError := _bEpochErr; // 原样回传委托故障位 / replay the delegate fault bit as is
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    todOut := DL_DTT_TOD_ZERO; // 哨兵零点 [时刻] / the sentinel midnight
    diSecOfDay := DL_DTT_DINT_ZERO; // 哨兵零秒 [秒] / the sentinel zero second
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 4｜日模 86400 抽取当日秒（边界二：双 MOD 保证任何输入都落 0..86399）/ segment 4, the day modulus extraction
// 域外不可达证明：段 2 已证 dtIn ≥ 纪元，委托件已证返回值非负，故首层 MOD 的结果已在 [0, 86399]；
// 第二次「+ 86400 再 MOD」为结构对称的二重防御，保证任何未来改动都不会引入负值域出口。
// domain proof: the gate above guarantees a non negative epoch second, so the first modulus already lands inside the day;
// the second fold is a structural second line of defence against any future refactor.
diSecOfDay := ((_nEpochSec MOD DL_DTT_SEC_PER_DAY) + DL_DTT_SEC_PER_DAY) MOD DL_DTT_SEC_PER_DAY; // 当日秒数 [秒] / the second of the day

// 段 5｜委托毫秒→TOD 还原（边界三：不自行拼 TOD 位型）/ segment 5, delegate the millisecond offset back to a time of day
_nMsOfDay := diSecOfDay * DL_DTT_MS_PER_SEC; // 当日毫秒偏移（上界 86399000，DINT 内不溢出）[毫秒] / the millisecond offset, bounded by eighty six million four hundred thousand
_todWork := FC_DL_DintMsToTod(nMsOfDay := _nMsOfDay, bClampSilently := TRUE, eErr => _uTodErr, bError => _bTodErr, bValid => _bTodValid, bClamped => _bTodClamped); // 委托还原 [时刻] / delegate the restoration
IF (NOT _bTodValid) OR _bTodErr THEN // 委托失败：码随属主回传 / the delegate failed, the code follows its owner
    eErr := _uTodErr; // 原样回传委托码 [码] / replay the delegate code as is
    bError := _bTodErr; // 原样回传委托故障位 / replay the delegate fault bit as is
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    todOut := DL_DTT_TOD_ZERO; // 哨兵零点 [时刻] / the sentinel midnight
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 6｜统一出口 / segment 6, the unified outlet
todOut := _todWork; // 时刻出口 [时刻] / the time of day outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 域内输出可用 / the in-domain output is usable
FC_DL_DtToTodWrap := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

    16#0001_0653【信息级】排名口径枚举越域，已落中位排名口径（不置 bError）
    16#0001_0654【故障级】有效样本数越域：nCount < 1 或 > 256，或剔除非有限后 nEff = 0
    16#0001_0656【故障级】数值非有限：fValue 为 NaN / ±Inf，或结果复检命中非有限（后者理论上不可达的兜底分支）
  码位反证 Note     :
    0654 合并「入参越域」与「剔净后为空」的理由：两者的出口组合完全相同（均为
    nBelow = 0、nEqual = 0、fPct = 0、bValid = FALSE），三组以内输出无法唯一还原该场景，
    按 R90 不另立码；0656 不可并入 0654，因 bValid 与 nEff 在两种场景下可唯一区分
    （前者 nEff ≥ 1、后者 nEff = 0）；0656 同时承担结果复检兜底：该分支与「fValue 非有限」
    在出口上完全同形（fPct = 0、bValid = FALSE、nBelow / nEqual 保持计数），三组以内输出
    无法区分，故按 R90 共用一码而不另立。
  验收 Acceptance   :
    算法已证（脚本）：未跑 ｜ 编译器已证（三平台）：未跑
    V1 全同样本、fValue 相等 → eWeak 0 / eStrong 100 / eMidRank 50（逐口径断言）
    V2 fValue 小于最小样本 → 0%；V3 大于最大样本 → 100%
    V4 单样本 nCount = 1 → 三口径 0 / 100 / 50
    V5 含 2 个 NaN + 6 个有效 → nEff = 6（除子已证 ≥ 1），排名按 6 计
    V6 nCount = 0 → 码 0654 + 早退（禁除零）；V7 nCount = 257 → 同码早退
    V8 eMethod = 99（非法枚举）→ 落 eMidRank + 码 0653（bError = FALSE）
    V9 fValue = NaN → 码 0656 + bValid = FALSE
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R62 首版（批 3 · 序号 8）
  ==================================================================
*)
TYPE E_DL_RankMethod :
(
    eWeak    := 0, // 弱排名：只计严格小于的样本（同值全落上沿，保守低估）/ the weak rank counting strictly smaller samples only
    eStrong  := 1, // 强排名：计小于与相等的样本（同值全落上沿，偏乐观）/ the strong rank counting smaller and equal samples
    eMidRank := 2  // 中位排名：相等样本各计一半（同值取中点，统计口径最中性）/ the mid rank giving half credit to equal samples
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION FC_DL_PercentileRank : BOOL
VAR_IN_OUT
    afSamples : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL; // 样本序列 [工程单位]，只读 / the sample series, read only
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    nCount  : DINT := 0;                          // 有效样本数入参 [个]，合法域 1..256 / the sample count, legal one to two hundred fifty six
    fValue  : LREAL := 0.0;                       // 待定位值 [工程单位]，必须有限 / the value to locate, must be finite
    eMethod : E_DL_RankMethod := E_DL_RankMethod.eMidRank; // 排名口径 [-] / the ranking convention
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fPct   : LREAL; // 百分位排名 [%]，0..100 / the percentile rank in percent
    nBelow : DINT;  // 严格小于待定位值的样本数 [个] / the count of samples strictly below the value
    nEqual : DINT;  // 与待定位值相等的样本数 [个] / the count of samples equal to the value
    bValid : BOOL;  // 结果可用 [-] / the result usable flag
    eErr   : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError : BOOL;  // 错误标志，故障级码置位（R45 配对）/ the error flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    aVal      : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL;        // 剔除非有限后的有效样本副本 [工程单位] / the finite sample copy
    aIdx      : ARRAY[0..255] OF DINT;         // 委托输出的排序索引排列 [下标] / the sorted permutation from the delegate
    k         : DINT := 0;                     // 遍历索引 [下标] / the traversal index
    nEff      : DINT := 0;                     // 剔除非有限后的有效样本数 [个]（除子）/ the effective sample count used as the divisor
    nNonFinite: DINT := 0;                     // 剔除的非有限样本数 [个]（仅留档，不作除子）/ the dropped non finite sample count, recorded only
    nCountUse : DINT := 0;                     // 钳位前的入参样本数接管量 [个] / the raw input count before the domain gate
    fPctUse   : LREAL := 0.0;                  // 排名百分比工作副本 [%] / the working percentile copy
    eUse      : E_DL_RankMethod := E_DL_RankMethod.eMidRank; // 归一后的排名口径 [-] / the normalized ranking convention
    bSortRet  : BOOL := FALSE;                 // 委托返回值承接量（独立承接）/ the delegate return holder
    bSortValid: BOOL := FALSE;                 // 委托 bValid 承接量（独立承接）/ the delegate valid holder
    uSortErr  : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;         // 委托错误码承接量 [码] / the delegate error code holder
    bSortErr  : BOOL := FALSE;                 // 委托故障位承接量 / the delegate fault bit holder
    bSortOk   : BOOL := FALSE;                 // 返回值与可用位合取后的排序可用位 / the conjunction of the return value and the valid flag
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_PRK_NMAX : DINT := 256;         // 样本容量上界 [个]，与数组容量一致 / the capacity aligned with the array
    DL_PRK_ONE : DINT := 1;            // 整型一常量 [个] / the integer one constant
    DL_PRK_ZERO : DINT := 0;           // 整型零常量 [个] / the integer zero constant
    DL_PRK_PCT100 : LREAL := 100.0;    // 百分制换算系数 [%] / the percent scaling factor
    DL_PRK_HALF : LREAL := 2.0;        // 相等样本折半除子 [-] / the halving divisor for the equal samples
    DL_PRK_EQEPS : LREAL := 1.0E-6;    // 相等判定容差 [工程单位]，禁用 = / <> 判等 / the equality tolerance, plain equality operators are forbidden
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）+ 局部量显式预置（R254）/ segment 1, the preset
FC_DL_PercentileRank := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
fPct := 0.0; // 百分比预置零 [%] / preset the percentage zero
nBelow := 0; // 小于计数预置零 [个] / preset the below count zero
nEqual := 0; // 相等计数预置零 [个] / preset the equal count zero
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 错误标志预置假 / preset the error flag false
nEff := DL_PRK_ZERO; // 有效样本数预置零 [个] / preset the effective count zero
nNonFinite := DL_PRK_ZERO; // 剔除计数预置零 [个] / preset the dropped count zero
nCountUse := DL_PRK_ZERO; // 入参计数接管量预置零 [个] / preset the raw count holder zero
fPctUse := 0.0; // 百分比工作副本预置零 [%] / preset the working copy zero
bSortRet := FALSE; // 委托返回值承接量预置假 / preset the return holder false
bSortValid := FALSE; // 委托可用位承接量预置假 / preset the valid holder false
uSortErr := 16#0000_0000; // 委托码承接量预置零 [码] / preset the delegate code zero
bSortErr := FALSE; // 委托故障位承接量预置假 / preset the delegate fault holder false
bSortOk := FALSE; // 排序可用位预置假 / preset the sort usable bit false
eUse := E_DL_RankMethod.eMidRank; // 口径工作量预置中位排名（偏保守的中性口径）/ preset the convention to the neutral mid rank

// 段 2｜样本数域闸（边界二，早退禁除零）/ segment 2, the sample count domain gate
nCountUse := nCount; // 入参计数接管 [个] / take the raw count
IF (nCountUse < DL_PRK_ONE) OR (nCountUse > DL_PRK_NMAX) THEN // 计数越域 / the count is out of the domain
    eErr := 16#0001_0654; // 故障级：有效样本数越域 / fault grade, the effective sample count is out of the domain
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退，绝不进入除法 / early return, no division is ever reached
END_IF

// 段 3｜待定位值非有限闸（边界三，NaN 与 ±Inf 逐个点名，R272）/ segment 3, the value finiteness gate
IF (fValue <> fValue) OR ((fValue - fValue) <> (fValue - fValue)) THEN // NaN 或 ±Inf / NaN or an infinity
    eErr := 16#0001_0656; // 故障级：待定位值非有限 / fault grade, the value to locate is not finite
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 4｜样本非有限剔除（边界一：除子口径 = 有效样本数，绝不用入参计数作除子）/ segment 4, drop the non finite samples
FOR k := 0 TO nCountUse - 1 DO // 有界遍历（上界已证 ≤ 256）/ the bounded traversal with a proven ceiling
    IF (afSamples[k] = afSamples[k]) AND ((afSamples[k] - afSamples[k]) = (afSamples[k] - afSamples[k])) THEN // 有限样本 / a finite sample
        aVal[nEff] := afSamples[k]; // 有限样本写入副本 [工程单位] / copy the finite sample
        nEff := nEff + DL_PRK_ONE; // 有效计数推进 [个] / advance the effective count
    ELSE // 非有限样本 / a non finite sample
        nNonFinite := nNonFinite + DL_PRK_ONE; // 剔除计数推进 [个] / advance the dropped count
    END_IF
END_FOR
IF nEff < DL_PRK_ONE THEN // 剔净后无可排名样本（与段 2 同码，出口组合不可区分，R90）/ no sample remains after the drop
    eErr := 16#0001_0654; // 故障级：有效样本数越域（此处为剔净后为空）/ fault grade, the effective count is empty after the drop
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退，除子已证 ≥ 1 才允许进入段 6 / early return, the divisor is proven at least one before the percentage segment
END_IF

// 段 5｜委托索引排序（R140；返回值与可用位分承后合取，R62-D5）/ segment 5, the delegated index sort
bSortRet := FC_DL_SortIndexLReal(afValues := aVal, nCount := nEff, aIdx => aIdx, bValid => bSortValid, eErr => uSortErr, bError => bSortErr); // 委托排序：两路各自承接 / delegate the sort into two distinct holders
bSortOk := bSortRet AND bSortValid; // 返回值与可用位合取（IEC 未规定两者的求值次序）/ conjoin the two signals since their evaluation order is unspecified
IF (NOT bSortOk) OR bSortErr THEN // 委托失败 / the delegate failed
    eErr := uSortErr; // 委托码回传（码随属主，R66）/ replay the delegate code
    bError := bSortErr; // 委托故障位回传 / replay the delegate fault bit
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 6｜排名计数（小于 / 相等，相等用容差判定，禁判等算符）/ segment 6, the rank counting with a tolerance equality test
FOR k := 0 TO nEff - 1 DO // 按排序序有界遍历 / the bounded traversal in the sorted order
    IF aVal[aIdx[k]] < fValue THEN // 严格小于 / strictly below
        nBelow := nBelow + DL_PRK_ONE; // 小于计数推进 [个] / advance the below count
    ELSIF ABS(aVal[aIdx[k]] - fValue) < DL_PRK_EQEPS THEN // 容差相等（浮点禁判等）/ equality inside the tolerance
        nEqual := nEqual + DL_PRK_ONE; // 相等计数推进 [个] / advance the equal count
    END_IF
END_FOR

// 段 7｜排名口径归一并计算百分比（边界四，CASE 必带 ELSE 兜底）/ segment 7, the convention normalization and the percentage
CASE eMethod OF
    E_DL_RankMethod.eWeak: // 弱排名口径 / the weak rank convention
        eUse := E_DL_RankMethod.eWeak; // 口径接管 / take the convention
        fPctUse := (DINT_TO_LREAL(nBelow) / DINT_TO_LREAL(nEff)) * DL_PRK_PCT100; // 弱排名百分比 [%] / the weak rank percentage
    E_DL_RankMethod.eStrong: // 强排名口径 / the strong rank convention
        eUse := E_DL_RankMethod.eStrong; // 口径接管 / take the convention
        fPctUse := ((DINT_TO_LREAL(nBelow) + DINT_TO_LREAL(nEqual)) / DINT_TO_LREAL(nEff)) * DL_PRK_PCT100; // 强排名百分比 [%] / the strong rank percentage
    E_DL_RankMethod.eMidRank: // 中位排名口径 / the mid rank convention
        eUse := E_DL_RankMethod.eMidRank; // 口径接管 / take the convention
        fPctUse := ((DINT_TO_LREAL(nBelow) + (DINT_TO_LREAL(nEqual) / DL_PRK_HALF)) / DINT_TO_LREAL(nEff)) * DL_PRK_PCT100; // 中位排名百分比 [%] / the mid rank percentage
    ELSE // 非法枚举值：落中位排名并置组态码（禁静默，边界四）/ an illegal enumeration falls back to the mid rank with a code
        eUse := E_DL_RankMethod.eMidRank; // 落中性口径 / fall back to the neutral convention
        fPctUse := ((DINT_TO_LREAL(nBelow) + (DINT_TO_LREAL(nEqual) / DL_PRK_HALF)) / DINT_TO_LREAL(nEff)) * DL_PRK_PCT100; // 中位排名百分比 [%] / the mid rank percentage
        eErr := 16#0001_0653; // 信息级：排名口径越域，已落中位排名 / informational, the convention is out of the domain and the mid rank was used
        bError := FALSE; // 信息级不置故障标志（R285）/ keep the error flag false, this is informational
END_CASE

// 段 8｜结果复检兜底（结果非有限必三件套，R258）/ segment 8, the result recheck with the three part fallback
IF (fPctUse <> fPctUse) OR ((fPctUse - fPctUse) <> (fPctUse - fPctUse)) THEN // 结果非有限（理论上不可达，防御保留）/ a non finite result, unreachable by theory, kept as a defence
    fPct := 0.0; // 兜底安全值 [%] / the bottom line safe value
    eErr := 16#0001_0656; // 故障级：待定位值非有限（同族三件套口径）/ fault grade under the same family code
    bError := TRUE; // 置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 9｜统一出口 / segment 9, the unified outlet
fPct := fPctUse; // 百分比出口 [%] / the percentage outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
FC_DL_PercentileRank := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

instruction: 通用二阶 IIR 滤波节（Direct Form I）：真实工况为振动、电流纹波等通用频域整形，系数由现场下发。边界：稳定域三角判据 |a1|<2 且 |a2|<1 且 |a2-a1|<1，越域 bCfgBad 并冻结输出（禁发散值出环）；系数变更沿清状态防旧暂态；输出钳位后回写状态抗 windup；bEnable=FALSE 输出清零且状态清零。
architecture_thought: 有状态 FB（Direct Form I）：w1/w2 状态 + 稳定域三角判据闸（越域冻结输出防发散出环）；系数变更沿（>1E-9）清状态防旧暂态污染；输出钳位后 w1:=fOut 回写抗 windup；bEnable 下降沿清零输出与状态；与 LowPass/HighPass/Notch/Fir 分工声明写入头注释供选型。

    V2 a1 = 2.5（不稳定）→ bCfgBad = TRUE + fOut 冻结 + 码 3735
    V3 a1 = NaN → 同 V2，码 3736
    V4 在线把低通系数换成高通系数 → w1 / w2 清零，fOut 单拍跳变被钳位而不发散，码 3739
    V5 bResetState 单拍 → w1 = w2 = 0
    V6 fIn = 1.0E9 持续 → fOut 钳 fOutMax + bSat + w1 回写（下一拍不反向冲）
    V7 bEnable = FALSE → fOut = 0.0、状态零、bValid = FALSE
    V8 fOutMin > fOutMax → 码 3737 + bCfgBad
    V9 首拍 → 状态零、fOut = 0.0（禁首拍用未初始化状态）
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R62 首版（批 3 · 序号 9）
  ==================================================================
*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_BiquadFilter
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable     : BOOL := TRUE;    // 使能；FALSE 时输出归零并清状态（边界五）/ the enable, false zeroes the output and clears the state
    bResetState : BOOL := FALSE;   // 状态复位电平，上升沿清 w1 / w2 与故障锁存 / the state reset level, its rising edge clears the states and the fault latch
    fIn         : LREAL := 0.0;    // 输入量 [工程单位]，必须有限 / the input value, must be finite
    fB0         : LREAL := 1.0;    // 归一化前向系数 b0 [−]，a0 已归一为 1 / the normalized feed forward coefficient b0
    fB1         : LREAL := 0.0;    // 归一化前向系数 b1 [−] / the normalized feed forward coefficient b1
    fB2         : LREAL := 0.0;    // 归一化前向系数 b2 [−] / the normalized feed forward coefficient b2
    fA1         : LREAL := 0.0;    // 归一化反馈系数 a1 [−]，须落三角稳定域 / the normalized feedback coefficient a1 inside the triangle
    fA2         : LREAL := 0.0;    // 归一化反馈系数 a2 [−]，须落三角稳定域 / the normalized feedback coefficient a2 inside the triangle
    fOutMin     : LREAL := -1.0E6; // 输出钳位域下界 [工程单位] / the output clamp floor
    fOutMax     : LREAL := 1.0E6;  // 输出钳位域上界 [工程单位] / the output clamp ceiling
    tSample     : TIME := T#10MS;  // 采样周期 [毫秒]，仅作标称记录（系数设计已内含采样率）/ the nominal sample period, recorded only
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fOut    : LREAL := 0.0;           // 滤波输出 [工程单位] / the filtered output
    bSat    : BOOL := FALSE;          // 本拍输出被钳位 [-] / the output was clamped on this scan
    bCfgBad : BOOL := FALSE;          // 组态非法（与故障锁存同源，锁存型）[-] / an illegal configuration, latched with the fault
    bValid  : BOOL := FALSE;          // 输出可用（失能 / 故障 / 输入非有限为 FALSE）[-] / the output is usable
    eErr    : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError  : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障锁存位（由锁存码派生，非单拍标志，R99）/ the latched fault bit derived from the latched code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit     : BOOL := FALSE;               // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _fW1       : LREAL := 0.0;                // 状态 w1（上一拍中间量）[工程单位] / the state w1 of the previous scan
    _fW2       : LREAL := 0.0;                // 状态 w2（前两拍中间量）[工程单位] / the state w2 of two scans ago
    _fW        : LREAL := 0.0;                // 本拍中间量 w [工程单位] / the intermediate w of this scan
    _fY        : LREAL := 0.0;                // 本拍未钳位输出 y [工程单位] / the unclamped output y of this scan
    _fOutLast  : LREAL := 0.0;                // 最近一次有效输出（故障冻结源）[工程单位] / the last valid output used while frozen
    _fB0Prev   : LREAL := 0.0;                // 上拍 b0 快照 [−] / the previous b0 snapshot
    _fB1Prev   : LREAL := 0.0;                // 上拍 b1 快照 [−] / the previous b1 snapshot
    _fB2Prev   : LREAL := 0.0;                // 上拍 b2 快照 [−] / the previous b2 snapshot
    _fA1Prev   : LREAL := 0.0;                // 上拍 a1 快照 [−] / the previous a1 snapshot
    _fA2Prev   : LREAL := 0.0;                // 上拍 a2 快照 [−] / the previous a2 snapshot
    _bFinCoef  : BOOL := FALSE;               // 五个系数有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the coefficient finiteness gate result
    _bFinIn    : BOOL := FALSE;               // 输入有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the input finiteness gate result
    _bFinDom   : BOOL := FALSE;               // 钳位域合法闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the clamp domain gate result
    _bStable   : BOOL := FALSE;               // 三角稳定域闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the triangle stability gate result
    _bCfgBadI  : BOOL := FALSE;               // 本拍组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the per scan configuration fault flag
    _bCoefChg  : BOOL := FALSE;               // 系数变更沿标记（逐拍重算，信息级 3739）/ the coefficient change flag
    _bSatI     : BOOL := FALSE;               // 本拍钳位内部位，段 1 预清段 12 映射 / the internal clamp bit
    _uLatch    : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;       // 故障码锁存（仅复位沿清除，FB33-1）/ the latched fault code cleared only by the reset edge
    rtReset    : R_TRIG;                      // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新（R7）/ the reset edge instance refreshed unconditionally
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_BQ_EPS    : LREAL := 1.0E-9; // 系数变更判定容差 [−]，浮点禁判等 / the coefficient change tolerance, plain equality is forbidden
    DL_BQ_A1LIM  : LREAL := 2.0;    // 三角稳定域 a1 边界 [−] / the triangle a1 boundary
    DL_BQ_A2LIM  : LREAL := 1.0;    // 三角稳定域 a2 边界 [−] / the triangle a2 boundary
    DL_BQ_DLIM   : LREAL := 1.0;    // 三角稳定域 |a2 − a1| 边界 [−] / the triangle difference boundary
    DL_BQ_ZERO   : LREAL := 0.0;    // 实数零常量 [工程单位] / the real zero constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7）/ segment 0, the unconditional edge refresh
rtReset(CLK := bResetState); // 复位沿 / the reset edge

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与单拍标志预清（R310 / FB32-1；_bInit 与复位沿同款初始化）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the preset
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _fW1 := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 状态 w1 显式清零 / clear the state w1 explicitly
    _fW2 := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 状态 w2 显式清零 / clear the state w2 explicitly
    _fOutLast := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 最近有效输出显式清零（禁首拍用未初始化状态）/ clear the last valid output explicitly
    _uLatch := 16#0000_0000; // 故障码锁存显式清零 / clear the latched code explicitly
    _fB0Prev := fB0; // 系数快照对齐首拍值，避免首拍误报变更沿 / align the snapshots to avoid a spurious change edge
    _fB1Prev := fB1; // 上拍 b1 快照对齐 / align the b1 snapshot
    _fB2Prev := fB2; // 上拍 b2 快照对齐 / align the b2 snapshot
    _fA1Prev := fA1; // 上拍 a1 快照对齐 / align the a1 snapshot
    _fA2Prev := fA2; // 上拍 a2 快照对齐 / align the a2 snapshot
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域：清锁存 + 清滤波器状态，R311 声明）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _uLatch := 16#0000_0000; // 清故障码锁存（唯一的故障解除路径）/ clear the latched code, the only release path
    _fW1 := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 清状态 w1 / clear the state w1
    _fW2 := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 清状态 w2 / clear the state w2
END_IF
_bSatI := FALSE; // 钳位单拍内部位预清零 / preset the internal clamp bit false
_bCoefChg := FALSE; // 系数变更标记预清零 / preset the coefficient change flag false
_bCfgBadI := FALSE; // 组态非法标记预清零 / preset the configuration fault flag false

// 段 2｜八个浮点入参逐个点名有限闸（R272 全量枚举，含换算量与限值）/ segment 2, the full finiteness gate over all eight real pins
_bFinCoef := (fB0 = fB0) AND ((fB0 - fB0) = (fB0 - fB0))
          AND (fB1 = fB1) AND ((fB1 - fB1) = (fB1 - fB1))
          AND (fB2 = fB2) AND ((fB2 - fB2) = (fB2 - fB2))
          AND (fA1 = fA1) AND ((fA1 - fA1) = (fA1 - fA1))
          AND (fA2 = fA2) AND ((fA2 - fA2) = (fA2 - fA2)); // 五系数有限 / the five coefficients are finite
_bFinIn := (fIn = fIn) AND ((fIn - fIn) = (fIn - fIn)); // 输入有限 / the input is finite
_bFinDom := (fOutMin = fOutMin) AND ((fOutMin - fOutMin) = (fOutMin - fOutMin))
         AND (fOutMax = fOutMax) AND ((fOutMax - fOutMax) = (fOutMax - fOutMax)); // 限值有限 / the limits are finite

// 段 3｜稳定域闸与组态归因（边界一二，四个成因独立码，R190）/ segment 3, the stability gate and the unique cause attribution
_bStable := (ABS(fA1) < DL_BQ_A1LIM) AND (ABS(fA2) < DL_BQ_A2LIM) AND (ABS(fA2 - fA1) < DL_BQ_DLIM); // 三角稳定判据 / the triangle stability criterion
IF NOT _bFinCoef THEN // 成因一：系数非有限 / cause one, the coefficients are not finite
    _bCfgBadI := TRUE; // 置组态标记 / raise the configuration flag
    IF _uLatch = 16#0000_0000 THEN // 仅首因入锁存（后续成因不覆盖首因，R152）/ latch only the first cause so a later cause never overwrites it
        _uLatch := 16#0002_3736; // 故障级：系数非有限 / fault grade, the coefficients are not finite
    END_IF
ELSIF NOT _bFinDom THEN // 成因二：限值非有限 / cause two, the limits are not finite
    _bCfgBadI := TRUE; // 置组态标记 / raise the configuration flag
    IF _uLatch = 16#0000_0000 THEN // 仅首因入锁存 / latch only the first cause
        _uLatch := 16#0002_3737; // 故障级：输出钳位域非法 / fault grade, the clamp domain is illegal
    END_IF
ELSIF fOutMin > fOutMax THEN // 成因三：钳位域反序 / cause three, the clamp domain is reversed
    _bCfgBadI := TRUE; // 置组态标记 / raise the configuration flag
    IF _uLatch = 16#0000_0000 THEN // 仅首因入锁存 / latch only the first cause
        _uLatch := 16#0002_3737; // 故障级：输出钳位域非法（与限值非有限同一族，出口不可分）/ fault grade under the same clamp domain family
    END_IF
ELSIF NOT _bStable THEN // 成因四：越过三角稳定域 / cause four, the triangle is exceeded
    _bCfgBadI := TRUE; // 置组态标记 / raise the configuration flag
    IF _uLatch = 16#0000_0000 THEN // 仅首因入锁存 / latch only the first cause
        _uLatch := 16#0002_3735; // 故障级：系数越过三角稳定域 / fault grade, the triangle is exceeded
    END_IF
END_IF
IF (NOT _bFinIn) AND (_uLatch = 16#0000_0000) THEN // 成因五：输入非有限（不覆盖已有首因）/ cause five, the input is not finite, never overwriting an earlier cause
    _uLatch := 16#0002_373A; // 故障级：输入非有限 / fault grade, the input is not finite
END_IF

// 段 4｜使能失能分支最先消费：降级为安全值并清状态（边界五，FB33-4 声明行）/ segment 4, the disabled branch degrades to the safe value
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    _fW1 := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 状态清零（失能即弃用历史）/ clear the state, the history is abandoned
    _fW2 := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 状态清零 / clear the state
    _fOutLast := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 输出归零（下游控制量失能须归零，非冻结末值）/ zero the output, a control quantity must fall to zero rather than freeze
    fOut := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 出口归零 [工程单位] / the outlet falls to zero
    bSat := FALSE; // 钳位位清零 / clear the clamp bit
    bCfgBad := (_uLatch <> 16#0000_0000); // 组态标记照实回放（与锁存同源）/ replay the configuration flag from the latch
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用（安全值不是滤波结果，明示而非静默）/ mark the output unusable, a safe zero is not a filter result
    bError := (_uLatch <> 16#0000_0000); // 故障位照实回放 / replay the fault bit from the latch
    eErr := _uLatch; // 故障码锁存回放（信息级不参与失能分支）/ replay the latched code, informational codes do not apply while disabled
    RETURN; // 早退，不推进滤波 / early return without advancing the filter
END_IF

// 段 5｜组态故障或输入非有限：冻结最近有效输出，不推进状态（边界一二三，R273）/ segment 5, freeze on a fault without advancing the state
IF (_uLatch <> 16#0000_0000) OR _bCfgBadI OR (NOT _bFinIn) THEN // 任一故障相 / any fault phase
    IF (_fOutLast = _fOutLast) AND ((_fOutLast - _fOutLast) = (_fOutLast - _fOutLast)) THEN // 冻结源有限性闸（冻结只防推进不防污染，FB51-3）/ the frozen source finiteness gate
        fOut := _fOutLast; // 冻结最近有效输出 [工程单位] / freeze the last valid output
    ELSE // 冻结源自身被污染（理论上不可达）/ the frozen source itself is polluted, unreachable by theory
        _fOutLast := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 归零重建 / rebuild from zero
        fOut := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 出口归零 [工程单位] / the outlet falls to zero
    END_IF
    bSat := FALSE; // 钳位位清零 / clear the clamp bit
    bCfgBad := TRUE; // 组态标记置位 / raise the configuration flag
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    bError := TRUE; // 故障位置位 / raise the fault bit
    eErr := _uLatch; // 锁存码回放（不按当下输入重新推断，R152）/ replay the latched code instead of inferring from the current input
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 6｜系数变更沿：五系数任一 |新 − 旧| > 容差即清状态（边界三）/ segment 6, the coefficient change edge clears the state
IF (ABS(fB0 - _fB0Prev) > DL_BQ_EPS) OR (ABS(fB1 - _fB1Prev) > DL_BQ_EPS)
OR (ABS(fB2 - _fB2Prev) > DL_BQ_EPS) OR (ABS(fA1 - _fA1Prev) > DL_BQ_EPS)
OR (ABS(fA2 - _fA2Prev) > DL_BQ_EPS) THEN // 任一系数变更 / any coefficient changed
    _bCoefChg := TRUE; // 置变更标记（信息级 3739）/ raise the change flag for the informational code
    _fW1 := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 清状态 w1（防旧状态冲击新频响，保守处置）/ clear the state w1 to protect the new response from the old state
    _fW2 := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 清状态 w2 / clear the state w2
END_IF
_fB0Prev := fB0; // 系数快照推进 [−] / advance the b0 snapshot
_fB1Prev := fB1; // 系数快照推进 [−] / advance the b1 snapshot
_fB2Prev := fB2; // 系数快照推进 [−] / advance the b2 snapshot
_fA1Prev := fA1; // 系数快照推进 [−] / advance the a1 snapshot
_fA2Prev := fA2; // 系数快照推进 [−] / advance the a2 snapshot

// 段 7｜Direct Form I 差分方程（本拍中间量与输出）/ segment 7, the Direct Form I difference equation
_fW := fIn - (fA1 * _fW1) - (fA2 * _fW2); // 中间量 w = x − a1·w1 − a2·w2 [工程单位] / the intermediate w
_fY := (fB0 * _fW) + (fB1 * _fW1) + (fB2 * _fW2); // 输出 y = b0·w + b1·w1 + b2·w2 [工程单位] / the output y
_fW2 := _fW1; // 状态右移：w1 → w2 / shift the state, w1 becomes w2
_fW1 := _fW; // 状态推进：本拍 w → w1 / advance the state, the current w becomes w1

// 段 8｜输出钳位 + 抗 windup 状态回写（边界四）/ segment 8, the clamp with the anti windup state write back
IF _fY > fOutMax THEN // 超上界 / above the ceiling
    fOut := fOutMax; // 钳上界 [工程单位] / clamp to the ceiling
    _bSatI := TRUE; // 置钳位内部位 / raise the internal clamp bit
    _fW1 := fOutMax; // 状态回写（防积分式累积发散）[工程单位] / write the state back to stop the accumulating divergence
ELSIF _fY < fOutMin THEN // 超下界 / below the floor
    fOut := fOutMin; // 钳下界 [工程单位] / clamp to the floor
    _bSatI := TRUE; // 置钳位内部位 / raise the internal clamp bit
    _fW1 := fOutMin; // 状态回写 [工程单位] / write the state back
ELSE // 域内 / inside the domain
    fOut := _fY; // 直出输出 [工程单位] / pass the output through
END_IF

// 段 9｜全部内部量非有限复检：中间量或输出被污染即拒收并锁存（FB32-7 保持槽口径）/ segment 9, the finiteness recheck before the state is stored
IF (fOut <> fOut) OR ((fOut - fOut) <> (fOut - fOut))
OR (_fW <> _fW) OR ((_fW - _fW) <> (_fW - _fW)) THEN // 输出或中间量非有限（NaN 自反 / Inf 差值自减）/ a non finite output or intermediate, tested by reflexivity and by the self difference
    _fW1 := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 状态清零，禁污染物驻留 / clear the state so nothing polluted remains
    _fW2 := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 状态清零 / clear the state
    IF _uLatch = 16#0000_0000 THEN // 仅首因入锁存 / latch only the first cause
        _uLatch := 16#0002_373A; // 故障级：输入或中间量非有限 / fault grade, the input or the intermediate is not finite
    END_IF
    fOut := DL_BQ_ZERO; // 出口归零 [工程单位] / the outlet falls to zero
    bSat := FALSE; // 钳位位清零 / clear the clamp bit
    bCfgBad := TRUE; // 组态标记置位 / raise the configuration flag
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    bError := TRUE; // 故障位置位 / raise the fault bit
    eErr := _uLatch; // 锁存码回放 / replay the latched code
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 10｜最近有效输出写回（写前已过非有限闸）/ segment 10, store the last valid output after the finiteness gate
_fOutLast := fOut; // 快照更新 [工程单位] / update the snapshot

// 段 11｜统一出口（单拍位映射 + 信息级重算，R187 / FB51-8）/ segment 11, the unified outlet
bSat := _bSatI; // 钳位位出口 / the clamp bit outlet
bCfgBad := (_uLatch <> 16#0000_0000); // 组态标记出口（与锁存同源，锁存型非单拍）/ the configuration flag outlet derived from the latch
bValid := TRUE; // 域内输出可用 / the in-domain output is usable
bError := (_uLatch <> 16#0000_0000); // 故障位出口（锁存派生，R99）/ the fault bit outlet derived from the latch
IF _uLatch <> 16#0000_0000 THEN // 故障锁存回放优先 / the latched fault replays first
    eErr := _uLatch; // 锁存码 [码] / the latched code
ELSIF _bSatI THEN // 输出钳位（信息级，逐拍重算）/ the output clamp, informational and recomputed each scan
    eErr := 16#0002_3738; // 信息级：本拍输出被钳位 / informational, the output was clamped on this scan
ELSIF _bCoefChg THEN // 系数变更（信息级，逐拍重算）/ the coefficient change, informational and recomputed each scan
    eErr := 16#0002_3739; // 信息级：系数变更沿触发状态清零 / informational, a coefficient change cleared the state
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 变频器直流母线纹波/欠压/过压监视：真实工况为整流单元老化、缺相、电容容值衰退的早期识别。边界：环形窗 128 固定容量；均值除子用实际填充数 _nFill（非 nWinLen）防首填偏小；nWinLen 变更沿清窗防旧样本污染；纹波率分母 |avg|<1.0 走故障码防除零；三路判据各带迟滞防抖。
architecture_thought: 有状态监视 FB：环形窗 128 定容 + _nFill 实际填充数作均值除子（防首填偏小）；nWinLen 变更沿全量清账（窗/头/和/fill，R61-D4 修法出厂即正确）；纹波率除子 |avg|<1.0 故障码闸；欠压/过压/纹波三判据独立迟滞；bValid 门控 _nFill>=窗长/2。

  码位   Code ID    : 16#0003_0710 / 0712 / 0713（故障级）｜ 16#0003_0711 / 0714 / 0715 / 0716（信息级）
  版本   Version    : 1.0.0
  复杂度 Complexity  : 中
  功能   Purpose    : 变频器直流母线电压的均值 / 峰峰值纹波率 / 欠压 / 过压三路监视
                      （电解电容老化、整流缺相、制动能量回灌的早期征兆）。
  开源溯源 Origin    : IEC 61131-3 标准语义的道莅防御性实现（clean-room，无第三方代码行）；
                      纹波率与欠压/过压判据取自公开电力电子测量工程口径（分类与公式借鉴，
                      零代码复制），滤波、闸门、迟滞与码位 100% 自有。
  许可证 License    : MIT
  参考   Reference  : IEC 61131-3:2013 §6.6 算术运算符与 §6.6.1 比较语义；直流母线纹波率
                      的公开工程定义（峰峰值 ÷ 均值）
  平台   Platform   : 纯 IEC 61131-3（FOR / 四则 / 比较），三平台通用
  依赖   Depends    : 仅 Standard.library（无库调用、无定时器）
  分工声明 Split     : FB_DL_BrakeResistorThermal 为制动电阻热模型、FB_DL_VfdThermalDerate
                      为降额策略、FB_DL_InverterGridSync 为并网同步；本件为母线电气健康
                      监视（只测量不驱动功率级），四件边界写死（R216 双向互引）。
  归属 Ownership     : 本件无 TYPE 声明；全部引脚为 IEC 标准原生类型。
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 环形窗固定容量 128（禁动态分配），写头 _nHead + 填充计数 _nFill；
                         均值除子用 _nFill（钳 ≥ 1）而非 nWinLen——首填阶段除子若用窗长，
                         均值会系统性偏小并漏报启动期异常（R61-D4 同类陷阱，本件出厂即正确）；
                      二 nWinLen 逐拍可变：变更沿（_nUse ≠ _nUsePrev）全窗清零——和 / 写头 /
                         填充计数 / 环元素逐项清（只清和不清环元素会让减项把陈旧样本扣回和里）；
                      三 fUdNom 既作除子又作基准，故 ≤ 0 或非有限一律判组态故障并置
                         bValid = FALSE（除零防护）；
                      四 纹波率 = (max − min) / avg × 100；|avg| < 1.0 V 时纹波率不可算，
                         判故障码而非静默出零（静默出零会被 HMI 当成「纹波很小」）；
                      五 三路判据各带迟滞（fHystPct）：欠压 trip < 下限、复原 > 下限 + 迟滞；
                         过压 trip > 上限、复原 < 上限 − 迟滞；纹波 trip > 上限、复原 < 上限 − 迟滞；
                      六 非有限样本丢弃并计数，累计超窗长一半即判测量失效（区分「偶发坏点」
                         与「测点整体失效」）；
                      七 故障码策略（本件无 bReset 引脚，R152 解除路径自证）：组态类与测量类
                         故障码逐拍重算不锁存，解除路径 = 修正组态 / 恢复测量（恒可达）；
                         首因保序由判据顺序保证，故障相不回放末因；
                      八 bEnable = FALSE：三路判据全 FALSE、纹波率归零、均值保留最后有效值
                         （纯监视件不驱动功率级，保留均值供 HMI 显示是比较读数，非安全出口）；
                      九 首拍 _bInit 初始化全量内部量；无定时器 / 无边沿实例，故段 0 无刷新对象
                         （R6 标注 N/A，本件为无状态机监视器）；无全局、无外部变量、无物理地址。
  错误码 Codes      :
    16#0003_0710【故障级】组态非法（fUdNom ≤ 0 / 非有限；限值或迟滞非有限）
    16#0003_0711【信息级】nWinLen 越域已钳位（合法 2..128）
    16#0003_0712【故障级】测量失效（非有限样本累计超过窗长一半，或窗内无可算样本）
    16#0003_0713【故障级】窗均值近零（|avg| < 1.0 V），纹波率不可算
    16#0003_0714【信息级】纹波率超上限（bRippleHigh = TRUE）
    16#0003_0715【信息级】母线欠压（bUnder = TRUE）
    16#0003_0716【信息级】母线过压（bOver = TRUE）
  码位反证 Note     :
    0714 / 0715 / 0716 三码不可合并：三路判据各自有独立布尔出口，但 eErr 只有一个，
    若共用一码则「同时欠压且纹波超限」时无法告知先修哪一路（处置人不同：欠压查整流
    输入，纹波查电容，过压查制动能量）（R90 反证句）。
  验收 Acceptance   :
    算法已证（脚本）：未跑 ｜ 编译器已证（三平台）：未跑
    V1 恒定输入（纹波 0）→ fRipplePct = 0、三路判据全 FALSE
    V2 首个样本（_nFill = 1）→ 均值 = 单样本、bValid = FALSE（窗未达 nWinLen/2 门限）
    V3 nWinLen 由 64 改 16 → 窗清零、nFill = 0，均值不含旧样本（R61-D4 回归向量）
    V4 fUdNom = 0 → 码 0710 + bValid = FALSE（禁除零）
    V5 fUd = 0 且 fUdNom > 0 → bUnder = TRUE，纹波率因均值近零走码 0713
    V6 全部样本非有限 → 码 0712 + bValid = FALSE
    V7 欠压在阈值上下抖动 1%（小于迟滞 2%）→ bUnder 不反复跳
    V8 nWinLen = 1 或 129 → 钳位 + 码 0711（与域声明一致）

    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R62 首版（批 4 · 序号 10）
