*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_VfdDcBusRipple
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable       : BOOL := TRUE;       // 使能，FALSE 时判据全关（边界八）/ the enable, false turns every criterion off
    fUdMeas       : LREAL := 0.0;       // 母线电压实测 [伏]，必须有限 / the measured bus voltage, must be finite
    fUdNom        : LREAL := 540.0;     // 额定母线电压 [伏]，必须 > 0（既作基准又作除子）/ the nominal bus voltage, positive and used as both the reference and the divisor
    tSample       : TIME := T#1MS;      // 采样周期标称值 [毫秒]，仅作记录（本件不设定时器）/ the nominal sample period, recorded only
    nWinLen       : DINT := 64;         // 滑窗样本数 [个]，合法 2..128 / the window length in samples, legal two to one hundred twenty eight
    fRippleLimPct : LREAL := 5.0;       // 纹波率上限 [%]，相对均值 / the ripple rate limit in percent of the mean
    fUnderLimPct  : LREAL := 85.0;      // 欠压阈值 [%]，相对额定 / the undervoltage threshold relative to the nominal
    fOverLimPct   : LREAL := 115.0;     // 过压阈值 [%]，相对额定 / the overvoltage threshold relative to the nominal
    fHystPct      : LREAL := 2.0;       // 三路判据迟滞 [%]，须 ≥ 0 / the hysteresis of all three criteria, non negative
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fUdAvg      : LREAL := 0.0;          // 窗均值 [伏] / the window mean voltage
    fRipplePct  : LREAL := 0.0;          // 峰峰值纹波率 [%] / the peak to peak ripple rate in percent
    bUnder      : BOOL := FALSE;         // 欠压判据（带迟滞）[-] / the undervoltage criterion with hysteresis
    bOver       : BOOL := FALSE;         // 过压判据（带迟滞）[-] / the overvoltage criterion with hysteresis
    bRippleHigh : BOOL := FALSE;         // 纹波率超上限判据（带迟滞）[-] / the ripple criterion with hysteresis
    nFill       : DINT := 0;             // 窗已填样本数 [个] / the filled sample count
    bValid      : BOOL := FALSE;         // 测量可用（窗达半满且无故障）[-] / the measurement is usable
    eErr        : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError      : BOOL := FALSE;         // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;              // 首拍初始化标志（R310）/ the first scan flag
    _afWin      : ARRAY[0..127] OF LREAL;     // 母线电压环形窗 [伏]，固定容量 128 / the fixed capacity ring of the bus voltage
    _nHead      : DINT := 0;                  // 环形窗写头 [下标] / the ring write head
    _nFill      : DINT := 0;                  // 环形窗已填样本数 [个]（均值除子）/ the filled sample count used as the mean divisor
    _nUse       : DINT := 64;                 // 钳位后的窗长 [个] / the clamped window length
    _nUsePrev   : DINT := 0;                  // 上拍窗长快照 [个]，置 0 使首拍必触发一次全窗清零 / the previous length, zero forces one full clear
    _nRingIdx   : DINT := 0;                  // 环元素清零遍历索引 [下标] / the ring clearing traversal index
    _nScanIdx   : DINT := 0;                  // 极值统计遍历索引 [下标] / the extreme value traversal index
    _nNonFinite : DINT := 0;                  // 连续非有限样本计数 [个] / the consecutive non finite sample count
    _fSum       : LREAL := 0.0;               // 环窗电压和 [伏] / the ring voltage sum
    _fMax       : LREAL := 0.0;               // 窗内最大值 [伏] / the window maximum
    _fMin       : LREAL := 0.0;               // 窗内最小值 [伏] / the window minimum
    _fAvg       : LREAL := 0.0;               // 本拍均值工作副本 [伏] / the working mean of this scan
    _fRip       : LREAL := 0.0;               // 本拍纹波率工作副本 [%] / the working ripple rate of this scan
    _fPct       : LREAL := 0.0;               // 均值相对额定的百分比 [%] / the mean as a percentage of the nominal
    _bFinMeas   : BOOL := FALSE;              // 样本有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the sample finiteness gate result
    _bCfgBad    : BOOL := FALSE;              // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    _bWinClamp  : BOOL := FALSE;              // 窗长钳位标记（逐拍重算，信息级 0711）/ the window clamp flag
    _bMeasBad   : BOOL := FALSE;              // 测量失效标记（窗内无样本 / 连续坏点超半窗，逐拍重算）/ the measurement failure flag
    _bAvgZero   : BOOL := FALSE;              // 均值近零标记（纹波率不可算，逐拍重算，码 0713）/ the near zero mean flag under which the ripple is undefined
    _fAvgLast   : LREAL := 0.0;               // 最近一次有效均值 [伏]（失能相显示用，禁自赋值出口）/ the last valid mean kept for the disabled phase
    _bUnderL    : BOOL := FALSE;              // 欠压迟滞状态寄存器（跨拍保持）/ the undervoltage hysteresis state
    _bOverL     : BOOL := FALSE;              // 过压迟滞状态寄存器（跨拍保持）/ the overvoltage hysteresis state
    _bRipL      : BOOL := FALSE;              // 纹波迟滞状态寄存器（跨拍保持）/ the ripple hysteresis state
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_VFD_WMAX   : DINT := 128;     // 环形窗容量 [个]，与数组容量一致 / the ring capacity aligned with the array
    DL_VFD_WMIN   : DINT := 2;       // 窗长下界 [个]（单样本无峰峰值语义）/ the window floor, one sample has no peak to peak meaning
    DL_VFD_HALF   : LREAL := 2.0;    // 半满门限除子 [-] / the half full threshold divisor
    DL_VFD_AVGMIN : LREAL := 1.0;    // 均值近零门限 [伏]，低于此值纹波率不可算 / the near zero mean threshold below which the ripple is undefined
    DL_VFD_PCT    : LREAL := 100.0;  // 百分比换算系数 [%] / the percentage scaling factor
    DL_VFD_ZERO   : LREAL := 0.0;    // 实数零常量 [伏] / the real zero constant
    DL_VFD_ONE    : DINT := 1;       // 整型一常量 [个] / the integer one constant
    DL_VFD_DZERO  : DINT := 0;       // 整型零常量 [个] / the integer zero constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜本件无定时器与边沿实例（纯监视器，R6 标注 N/A），无刷新对象 / segment 0, no timers and no edge instances exist here

// 段 1｜首拍初始化（R310 / FB50-2）/ segment 1, the first scan init
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _nFill := DL_VFD_DZERO; // 填充计数显式清零 / clear the filled count explicitly
    _nHead := DL_VFD_DZERO; // 写头显式清零 / clear the write head explicitly
    _fSum := DL_VFD_ZERO; // 环窗和显式清零 / clear the ring sum explicitly
    _nUsePrev := DL_VFD_DZERO; // 窗长快照置 0，使段 3 变更沿必然触发一次全窗清零 / zero the snapshot so the change edge clears the ring once
    _nNonFinite := DL_VFD_DZERO; // 非有限计数显式清零 / clear the non finite count explicitly
    _bUnderL := FALSE; // 欠压迟滞状态显式清零 / clear the undervoltage state explicitly
    _bOverL := FALSE; // 过压迟滞状态显式清零 / clear the overvoltage state explicitly
    _bRipL := FALSE; // 纹波迟滞状态显式清零 / clear the ripple state explicitly
    FOR _nRingIdx := 0 TO DL_VFD_WMAX - DL_VFD_ONE DO // 有界遍历全容量（128 项）/ the bounded traversal over the full capacity
        _afWin[_nRingIdx] := DL_VFD_ZERO; // 环元素逐项清零 / zero every ring element
    END_FOR
    _afWin[DL_VFD_DZERO] := DL_VFD_ZERO; // 显式覆盖首元素（配合上面的有界遍历，防遍历上下界被改动）/ explicitly cover the first element in case the traversal bounds change
    _fAvgLast := DL_VFD_ZERO; // 最近有效均值显式清零 / clear the last valid mean explicitly
END_IF

// 段 2｜单拍量预置 / segment 2, the per scan preset
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态非法标记预清零 / preset the configuration flag false
_bWinClamp := FALSE; // 窗长钳位标记预清零 / preset the window clamp flag false
_bMeasBad := FALSE; // 测量失效标记预清零 / preset the measurement failure flag false
_bAvgZero := FALSE; // 均值近零标记预清零 / preset the near zero mean flag false
_fRip := DL_VFD_ZERO; // 纹波率工作副本预置零 [%] / preset the ripple copy zero

// 段 3｜组态域闸（边界三，全部限值与非有限逐个点名，R272）/ segment 3, the configuration gates
_bFinMeas := (fUdMeas = fUdMeas) AND ((fUdMeas - fUdMeas) = (fUdMeas - fUdMeas)); // 样本有限 / the sample is finite
IF (fUdNom <> fUdNom) OR ((fUdNom - fUdNom) <> (fUdNom - fUdNom)) OR (fUdNom <= DL_VFD_ZERO) THEN // 额定非有限或非正 / the nominal is not finite or not positive
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 置组态标记 / raise the configuration flag
ELSIF (fRippleLimPct <> fRippleLimPct) OR ((fRippleLimPct - fRippleLimPct) <> (fRippleLimPct - fRippleLimPct))
   OR (fUnderLimPct <> fUnderLimPct) OR ((fUnderLimPct - fUnderLimPct) <> (fUnderLimPct - fUnderLimPct))
   OR (fOverLimPct <> fOverLimPct) OR ((fOverLimPct - fOverLimPct) <> (fOverLimPct - fOverLimPct))
   OR (fHystPct <> fHystPct) OR ((fHystPct - fHystPct) <> (fHystPct - fHystPct))
   OR (fHystPct < DL_VFD_ZERO) THEN // 限值或迟滞非有限 / a limit or the hysteresis is not finite
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 置组态标记 / raise the configuration flag
END_IF

// 段 4｜窗长钳位与变更沿全窗清零（边界二，R61-D4 修法固化）/ segment 4, the window length clamp and the full clear
_nUse := nWinLen; // 窗长接管 [个] / take the window length
IF (_nUse < DL_VFD_WMIN) OR (_nUse > DL_VFD_WMAX) THEN // 窗长越域 / the length is out of the domain
    _bWinClamp := TRUE; // 置钳位标记（信息级 0711）/ raise the clamp flag
    IF _nUse < DL_VFD_WMIN THEN // 下界钳位 / the floor clamp
        _nUse := DL_VFD_WMIN; // 钳到下界 [个] / clamp to the floor
    ELSE // 上界钳位 / the ceiling clamp
        _nUse := DL_VFD_WMAX; // 钳到容量 [个] / clamp to the capacity
    END_IF
END_IF
IF _nUse <> _nUsePrev THEN // 窗长变更沿（含首拍）/ the length change edge, the first scan included
    _fSum := DL_VFD_ZERO; // 环窗和清零 [伏] / clear the ring sum
    _nHead := DL_VFD_DZERO; // 写头回零 / reset the write head
    _nFill := DL_VFD_DZERO; // 填充计数回零 / reset the filled count
    _nNonFinite := DL_VFD_DZERO; // 非有限计数回零 / reset the non finite count
    FOR _nRingIdx := 0 TO DL_VFD_WMAX - DL_VFD_ONE DO // 有界遍历全容量 / the bounded traversal over the full capacity
        _afWin[_nRingIdx] := DL_VFD_ZERO; // 环元素逐项清零：减项读到零才不会把旧样本扣回和里 / zero every element so the subtract term cannot re-inject a stale sample
    END_FOR
    _nUsePrev := _nUse; // 快照本拍窗长 / snapshot the length
END_IF

// 段 5｜样本入窗（非有限样本丢弃并计数，边界六）/ segment 5, push the sample or count the drop
IF _bFinMeas THEN // 有限样本才入窗 / only a finite sample enters the ring
    _fSum := _fSum - _afWin[_nHead] + fUdMeas; // 滑窗和更新（被替换槽已证为有效样本或零）[伏] / update the sliding sum, the replaced slot is a live sample or zero
    _afWin[_nHead] := fUdMeas; // 本拍样本入环 [伏] / push the sample
    _nHead := _nHead + DL_VFD_ONE; // 写头推进 / advance the head
    IF _nHead >= _nUse THEN // 回卷（按钳位窗长）/ wrap by the clamped length
        _nHead := DL_VFD_DZERO; // 写头回零 / reset the head
    END_IF
    IF _nFill < _nUse THEN // 窗未满才累加 / count only while the window is not yet full
        _nFill := _nFill + DL_VFD_ONE; // 填充计数推进 [个] / advance the filled count
    END_IF
    _nNonFinite := DL_VFD_DZERO; // 连续非有限计数归零（按「连续」口径，非累计）/ reset the consecutive drop count
ELSE // 非有限样本：丢弃并计数 / a non finite sample is dropped and counted
    _nNonFinite := _nNonFinite + DL_VFD_ONE; // 非有限计数推进 [个] / advance the drop count
END_IF
IF DINT_TO_LREAL(_nNonFinite) > (DINT_TO_LREAL(_nUse) / DL_VFD_HALF) THEN // 连续坏点超窗长一半 / the consecutive drops exceed half the window
    _bMeasBad := TRUE; // 置测量失效标记（码 0712）/ raise the measurement failure flag
END_IF
IF _nFill < DL_VFD_ONE THEN // 窗内无可算样本（与失效同码，出口不可分，R90）/ no sample is available at all
    _bMeasBad := TRUE; // 置测量失效标记 / raise the measurement failure flag
END_IF

// 段 6｜均值与极值（除子 = _nFill，首填不偏小，边界一）/ segment 6, the mean and the extremes with the fill based divisor
IF _nFill >= DL_VFD_ONE THEN // 除子已证 ≥ 1（禁用裸除子）/ the divisor is proven at least one
    _fAvg := _fSum / DINT_TO_LREAL(_nFill); // 窗均值 [伏] / the window mean
    _fMax := _afWin[DL_VFD_DZERO]; // 最大值初值取首元素 [伏] / seed the maximum from the first element
    _fMin := _afWin[DL_VFD_DZERO]; // 最小值初值取首元素 [伏] / seed the minimum from the first element
    // 遍历口径证明：写头仅在 _nHead 达到 _nUse 时回卷，故填充未满时有效样本恰为下标 0.._nFill-1；
    // 填满后有效样本恰为 0.._nUse-1，两者都等于区间 [0, _nFill-1]（_nFill 已封顶于 _nUse）。
    // traversal proof: the head wraps only after reaching the length, so the live samples always occupy the range from zero to the fill count minus one.
    FOR _nScanIdx := DL_VFD_ONE TO _nFill - DL_VFD_ONE DO // 有界遍历有效样本 / the bounded traversal over the live samples
        IF _afWin[_nScanIdx] > _fMax THEN // 更新最大值 / update the maximum
            _fMax := _afWin[_nScanIdx]; // 最大值替换 [伏] / replace the maximum
        END_IF
        IF _afWin[_nScanIdx] < _fMin THEN // 更新最小值 / update the minimum
            _fMin := _afWin[_nScanIdx]; // 最小值替换 [伏] / replace the minimum
        END_IF
    END_FOR
ELSE // 无样本：均值保持最近有效值（禁自赋值出口，R261）/ no sample, keep the last valid mean instead of a self assignment
    _fAvg := _fAvgLast; // 最近有效均值 [伏] / the last valid mean
END_IF

// 段 7｜纹波率（均值近零判故障，不静默出零，边界四）/ segment 7, the ripple rate with the near zero mean guard
IF _nFill >= DL_VFD_ONE THEN // 有样本才谈纹波 / the ripple is only meaningful with samples
    IF ABS(_fAvg) < DL_VFD_AVGMIN THEN // 均值近零：纹波率不可算 / a near zero mean makes the ripple undefined
        _bAvgZero := TRUE; // 置均值近零标记（码 0713 的独立成因，R190）/ raise the near zero flag as its own cause
    ELSE // 均值可用 / a usable mean
        _fRip := ((_fMax - _fMin) / ABS(_fAvg)) * DL_VFD_PCT; // 峰峰值纹波率 [%] / the peak to peak ripple rate
        _fAvgLast := _fAvg; // 最近有效均值快照（写前已过近零与有限闸）[伏] / snapshot the last valid mean after the gates
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 8｜三路判据（各带迟滞，边界五，方向各自独立，R146）/ segment 8, the three criteria with independent hysteresis
IF _nFill >= DL_VFD_ONE THEN // 有样本才判 / judge only with samples
    _fPct := (_fAvg / fUdNom) * DL_VFD_PCT; // 均值相对额定 [%]（用本拍均值，不读上拍出口）/ the mean relative to the nominal using this scan value
    // 欠压：低于下限触发，回升超过「下限 + 迟滞」才复原 / undervoltage trips below the limit and releases above the limit plus the hysteresis
    IF NOT _bUnderL THEN // 未报警态 / the released state
        IF _fPct < fUnderLimPct THEN // 跌破下限 / below the limit
            _bUnderL := TRUE; // 置迟滞状态 / set the hysteresis state
        END_IF
    ELSE // 已报警态 / the tripped state
        IF _fPct > (fUnderLimPct + fHystPct) THEN // 回升超过下限加迟滞 / above the limit plus the hysteresis
            _bUnderL := FALSE; // 复原 / release
        END_IF
    END_IF
    // 过压：高于上限触发，回落低于「上限 − 迟滞」才复原 / overvoltage trips above the limit and releases below the limit minus the hysteresis
    IF NOT _bOverL THEN // 未报警态 / the released state
        IF _fPct > fOverLimPct THEN // 超过上限 / above the limit
            _bOverL := TRUE; // 置迟滞状态 / set the hysteresis state
        END_IF
    ELSE // 已报警态 / the tripped state
        IF _fPct < (fOverLimPct - fHystPct) THEN // 回落低于上限减迟滞 / below the limit minus the hysteresis
            _bOverL := FALSE; // 复原 / release
        END_IF
    END_IF
    // 纹波：高于上限触发，回落低于「上限 − 迟滞」才复原 / the ripple trips above the limit and releases below the limit minus the hysteresis
    IF NOT _bRipL THEN // 未报警态 / the released state
        IF _fRip > fRippleLimPct THEN // 超过上限 / above the limit
            _bRipL := TRUE; // 置迟滞状态 / set the hysteresis state
        END_IF
    ELSE // 已报警态 / the tripped state
        IF _fRip < (fRippleLimPct - fHystPct) THEN // 回落低于上限减迟滞 / below the limit minus the hysteresis
            _bRipL := FALSE; // 复原 / release
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 9｜统一出口（R191 名实双出口：bEnable = FALSE 时判据全关但均值保留）/ segment 9, the unified outlet
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能：判据全关、纹波归零、均值保留（边界八）/ disabled, every criterion off, the mean retained
    fUdAvg := _fAvgLast; // 均值保持最近有效值（HMI 比较读数用，禁自赋值）/ keep the last valid mean for the HMI
    fRipplePct := DL_VFD_ZERO; // 纹波率归零 [%] / the ripple rate falls to zero
    bUnder := FALSE; // 欠压判据关 / the undervoltage criterion off
    bOver := FALSE; // 过压判据关 / the overvoltage criterion off
    bRippleHigh := FALSE; // 纹波判据关 / the ripple criterion off
    nFill := _nFill; // 填充计数照实出口 [个] / the fill count is exported as is
    bValid := FALSE; // 失能即不可用 / the measurement is not usable while disabled
    bError := _bCfgBad; // 组态非法照实上报（配置错与失能无关，禁静默）/ an illegal configuration is still reported, it is independent of the enable
    IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态成因 / the configuration cause
        eErr := 16#0003_0710; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, an illegal configuration
    ELSE // 失能本身不是事件 / a disabled device is not an event
        eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 失能不发码 / no code is emitted while disabled
    END_IF
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF
fUdAvg := _fAvg; // 均值出口 [伏] / the mean outlet
fRipplePct := _fRip; // 纹波率出口 [%] / the ripple rate outlet
bUnder := _bUnderL; // 欠压判据出口（迟滞状态派生）/ the undervoltage outlet derived from the hysteresis state
bOver := _bOverL; // 过压判据出口 / the overvoltage outlet
bRippleHigh := _bRipL; // 纹波判据出口 / the ripple outlet
nFill := _nFill; // 填充计数出口 [个] / the fill count outlet
bValid := (NOT _bCfgBad) AND (NOT _bMeasBad) AND (NOT _bAvgZero) AND (DINT_TO_LREAL(_nFill) >= (DINT_TO_LREAL(_nUse) / DL_VFD_HALF)); // 可用 = 无故障且窗达半满（边界二门限，显式转换后比较）/ usable, no fault and the window at least half full compared after explicit conversion
bError := _bCfgBad OR _bMeasBad OR _bAvgZero; // 故障位由三路故障成因派生（R190 各成因独立赋值点）/ the fault bit derived from all three fault causes
IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态成因优先（首因保序，边界七）/ the configuration cause comes first
    eErr := 16#0003_0710; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, an illegal configuration
ELSIF _bMeasBad THEN // 测量失效：窗内无样本或连续坏点超半窗 / the measurement failed on an empty window or a drop burst
    eErr := 16#0003_0712; // 故障级：测量失效 / fault grade, the measurement failed
ELSIF _bAvgZero THEN // 均值近零：纹波率不可算（独立成因，R190）/ a near zero mean under its own cause
    eErr := 16#0003_0713; // 故障级：窗均值近零，纹波率不可算 / fault grade, the mean is near zero and the ripple is undefined
ELSIF _bRipL THEN // 纹波超限（信息级）/ the ripple over the limit, informational
    eErr := 16#0003_0714; // 信息级：纹波率超上限 / informational, the ripple is over the limit
ELSIF _bUnderL THEN // 欠压（信息级）/ undervoltage, informational
    eErr := 16#0003_0715; // 信息级：母线欠压 / informational, the bus is undervoltage
ELSIF _bOverL THEN // 过压（信息级）/ overvoltage, informational
    eErr := 16#0003_0716; // 信息级：母线过压 / informational, the bus is overvoltage
ELSIF _bWinClamp THEN // 窗长钳位（信息级，仅提示）/ the window clamp, informational
    eErr := 16#0003_0711; // 信息级：nWinLen 越域已钳位 / informational, the window length was clamped
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 静电消除离子风机三级联锁许可：真实工况为静电敏感区要求运行反馈+风速下限+平衡电压限值三者同时满足且持续确认才发许可。边界：许可发放可延迟、撤除零延时（非对称安全）；首拍 bPermit=FALSE；非有限输入保守判不满足并区分测点坏/真超标；状态机 ELSE 落 eAlarm 并清许可。

TYPE E_DL_IonFanPhase :
(
    eIdle   := 0,  // 空闲：未使能或已失能 / idle, disabled
    eWarmup := 10, // 确认中：三判据满足并正在计时 tConfirm / confirming, the three criteria hold while the timer runs
    ePermit := 20, // 已许可：下游允许运行 / permitted, the downstream may run
    eAlarm  := 30  // 判据失效报警：许可已撤除 / an alarm, the permit has been withdrawn
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_IonFanInterlock
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable       : BOOL := TRUE;        // 使能，FALSE 时清许可并回空闲（边界八）/ the enable, false clears the permit and returns to idle
    bFanRun       : BOOL := FALSE;       // 风机运行反馈 [-] / the fan running feedback
    fAirSpeed     : LREAL := 0.0;        // 出风速度 [米每秒]，必须有限 / the air speed, must be finite
    fSpeedMin     : LREAL := 0.5;        // 风速下限 [米每秒]，须 > 0 / the air speed floor, must be positive
    fBalanceV     : LREAL := 0.0;        // 离子平衡电压实测 [伏]，必须有限 / the measured balance voltage, must be finite
    fBalanceLimV  : LREAL := 5.0;        // 平衡电压绝对上限 [伏]，须 > 0 / the balance voltage absolute limit, must be positive
    tConfirm      : TIME := T#3S;        // 判据持续确认窗 [毫秒]，须 > 0 / the confirmation window, must be positive
    fHystPct      : LREAL := 5.0;        // 判据迟滞 [%]，须 ≥ 0 / the criterion hysteresis in percent, non negative
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bPermit       : BOOL := FALSE;            // 下游允许运行（安全侧默认 FALSE，边界一）/ the downstream permit, safe side default false
    bAlarmSpeed   : BOOL := FALSE;            // 风速判据报警（OutOfSpec 级）[-] / the air speed alarm
    bAlarmBalance : BOOL := FALSE;            // 平衡电压判据报警（OutOfSpec 级）[-] / the balance voltage alarm
    bAlarmFan     : BOOL := FALSE;            // 风机运行反馈丧失报警（Failure 级）[-] / the fan feedback loss alarm
    eState        : E_DL_IonFanPhase;         // 状态机出口 [状态] / the state machine outlet
    bValid        : BOOL := FALSE;            // 测量可用（无测点故障与组态故障）[-] / the measurement is usable
    eErr          : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;    // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError        : BOOL := FALSE;            // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 首拍初始化标志（R310）/ the first scan flag
    _eState     : E_DL_IonFanPhase := E_DL_IonFanPhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bFanOk     : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 风机运行判据（逐拍重算）/ the fan criterion
    _bSpeedOk   : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 风速判据（带迟滞，逐拍重算）/ the air speed criterion with hysteresis
    _bBalOk     : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 平衡电压判据（带迟滞，逐拍重算）/ the balance criterion with hysteresis
    _bAllOk     : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 三判据合取（逐拍重算）/ the conjunction of the three criteria
    _bAlmSpd    : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 风速报警迟滞状态（跨拍保持）/ the air speed alarm hysteresis state
    _bAlmBal    : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 平衡电压报警迟滞状态（跨拍保持）/ the balance alarm hysteresis state
    _bFinSpd    : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 风速测点有限标记（逐拍重算）/ the air speed finiteness flag
    _bFinBal    : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 平衡测点有限标记（逐拍重算）/ the balance finiteness flag
    _bCfgBad    : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    _fSpdTrip   : LREAL := 0.0;                         // 风速置警阈值 [米每秒] / the air speed trip threshold
    _fSpdRele   : LREAL := 0.0;                         // 风速复原阈值 [米每秒] / the air speed release threshold
    _fBalTrip   : LREAL := 0.0;                         // 平衡置警阈值（绝对值）[伏] / the balance trip threshold
    _fBalRele   : LREAL := 0.0;                         // 平衡复原阈值（绝对值）[伏] / the balance release threshold
    _fBalAbs    : LREAL := 0.0;                         // 平衡电压绝对值 [伏] / the absolute balance voltage
    _fPctScale  : LREAL := 0.0;                         // 迟滞百分比换算中间量 [−] / the hysteresis percentage intermediate
    tonConfirm  : TON;                                  // 判据持续确认定时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the confirmation timer refreshed unconditionally
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_IFI_ZERO  : LREAL := 0.0;   // 实数零常量 [工程单位] / the real zero constant
    DL_IFI_HUND  : LREAL := 100.0; // 百分比换算系数 [%] / the percentage scaling factor
    DL_IFI_TIME0 : TIME := T#0S;   // 时间零常量 [毫秒] / the time zero constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7）：IN = 三判据合取 AND 使能 AND 无组态故障 / segment 0, the unconditional timer refresh
_bFanOk := bFanRun; // 风机运行判据（无迟滞，掉电即失效）/ the fan criterion without hysteresis, it fails as soon as the feedback drops
_bFinSpd := (fAirSpeed = fAirSpeed) AND ((fAirSpeed - fAirSpeed) = (fAirSpeed - fAirSpeed)); // 风速测点有限 / the air speed sample is finite
_bFinBal := (fBalanceV = fBalanceV) AND ((fBalanceV - fBalanceV) = (fBalanceV - fBalanceV)); // 平衡测点有限 / the balance sample is finite
// 迟滞阈值预计算（组态闸在段 2，故此处先按域内假设算，域外值不作为判据依据）/ the hysteresis thresholds are precomputed here, the configuration gate in segment two decides whether they are used
_fPctScale := fHystPct / DL_IFI_HUND; // 迟滞小数化 [−] / the hysteresis as a fraction
_fSpdTrip := fSpeedMin * (1.0 - _fPctScale); // 风速置警阈值 = 下限 × (1 − h) [米每秒] / the trip threshold
_fSpdRele := fSpeedMin * (1.0 + _fPctScale); // 风速复原阈值 = 下限 × (1 + h) [米每秒] / the release threshold
_fBalTrip := fBalanceLimV; // 平衡置警阈值 = 绝对上限 [伏] / the balance trip threshold equals the limit
_fBalRele := fBalanceLimV * (1.0 - _fPctScale); // 平衡复原阈值 = 上限 × (1 − h) [伏] / the balance release threshold
_fBalAbs := ABS(fBalanceV); // 平衡电压绝对值（正负偏等量处理，迟滞对称）[伏] / the absolute balance voltage
// 风速判据：非有限即保守判不满足（边界四）/ the air speed criterion treats a non finite sample as failing
IF _bFinSpd THEN // 测点有限才用迟滞判据 / the hysteresis runs only on a finite sample
    IF NOT _bAlmSpd THEN // 未报警态 / the released state
        IF fAirSpeed < _fSpdTrip THEN // 跌破置警阈值 / below the trip threshold
            _bAlmSpd := TRUE; // 置报警迟滞状态 / set the alarm state
        END_IF
    ELSE // 已报警态 / the tripped state
        IF fAirSpeed > _fSpdRele THEN // 回升超过复原阈值 / above the release threshold
            _bAlmSpd := FALSE; // 复原 / release
        END_IF
    END_IF
    _bSpeedOk := NOT _bAlmSpd; // 判据结果由迟滞状态派生 / the criterion derives from the hysteresis state
ELSE // 测点非有限：保守判不满足并置报警（区分码见段 6）/ a non finite sample conservatively fails and raises the alarm
    _bAlmSpd := TRUE; // 保守落报警态 / conservatively trip
    _bSpeedOk := FALSE; // 判据不满足 / the criterion fails
END_IF
// 平衡判据：非有限即保守判不满足（边界四）/ the balance criterion treats a non finite sample as failing
IF _bFinBal THEN // 测点有限才用迟滞判据 / the hysteresis runs only on a finite sample
    IF NOT _bAlmBal THEN // 未报警态 / the released state
        IF _fBalAbs > _fBalTrip THEN // 超过置警阈值 / above the trip threshold
            _bAlmBal := TRUE; // 置报警迟滞状态 / set the alarm state
        END_IF
    ELSE // 已报警态 / the tripped state
        IF _fBalAbs < _fBalRele THEN // 回落低于复原阈值（限 5 V 时 4.9 V 仍在报警带内）/ below the release threshold, four point nine volts still sits inside the band
            _bAlmBal := FALSE; // 复原 / release
        END_IF
    END_IF
    _bBalOk := NOT _bAlmBal; // 判据结果由迟滞状态派生 / the criterion derives from the hysteresis state
ELSE // 测点非有限：保守判不满足并置报警 / a non finite sample conservatively fails and raises the alarm
    _bAlmBal := TRUE; // 保守落报警态 / conservatively trip
    _bBalOk := FALSE; // 判据不满足 / the criterion fails
END_IF
_bAllOk := _bFanOk AND _bSpeedOk AND _bBalOk; // 三判据合取 / the conjunction
tonConfirm(IN := _bAllOk AND bEnable AND (NOT _bCfgBad), PT := tConfirm); // 确认窗计时（使能 + 组态闸串入）/ the confirmation window with the enable and the configuration gate in series

// 段 1｜首拍初始化（R310；出厂默认无许可，边界二）/ segment 1, the first scan init with the safe default
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _eState := E_DL_IonFanPhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle
    _bAlmSpd := FALSE; // 风速报警迟滞态显式清零 / clear the air speed alarm state explicitly
    _bAlmBal := FALSE; // 平衡报警迟滞态显式清零 / clear the balance alarm state explicitly
    bPermit := FALSE; // 许可显式落假（出厂默认 F）/ force the permit false on the first scan
END_IF

// 段 2｜组态域闸（边界五，全部限值与换算量逐个点名，R272）/ segment 2, the configuration gates
_bCfgBad := (fSpeedMin <> fSpeedMin) OR ((fSpeedMin - fSpeedMin) <> (fSpeedMin - fSpeedMin)) OR (fSpeedMin <= DL_IFI_ZERO)
         OR (fBalanceLimV <> fBalanceLimV) OR ((fBalanceLimV - fBalanceLimV) <> (fBalanceLimV - fBalanceLimV)) OR (fBalanceLimV <= DL_IFI_ZERO)
         OR (fHystPct <> fHystPct) OR ((fHystPct - fHystPct) <> (fHystPct - fHystPct)) OR (fHystPct < DL_IFI_ZERO)
         OR (tConfirm <= DL_IFI_TIME0); // 组态非法（含 tConfirm 非正与迟滞负值）/ an illegal configuration including a non positive window and a negative hysteresis
IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态非法（含 tConfirm 非正与迟滞负值）：禁止发放许可 / an illegal configuration forbids any permit
    _bAllOk := FALSE; // 合取强制失满足（组态阈值不可信，可能是 NaN）/ force the conjunction to fail, the thresholds may be NaN
END_IF

// 段 3｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 兜底并清许可；安全相迁移带全量闸位复检，R274）/ segment 3, the main machine
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_IonFanPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相（失能时驻留，驻留由分支表达，禁自赋值死语句，R261）/ the idle phase, dwelling is expressed by the branch
        IF bEnable AND _bCfgBad THEN // 使能但组态非法（边界五）/ enabled with an illegal configuration
            _eState := E_DL_IonFanPhase.eAlarm; // 迁入报警相 / enter the alarm phase
        ELSIF bEnable THEN // 使能且组态合法 / enabled with a legal configuration
            _eState := E_DL_IonFanPhase.eWarmup; // 迁入确认相（确认窗自下一拍起计）/ enter the confirmation phase, the window counts from the next scan
        END_IF
    E_DL_IonFanPhase.eWarmup: // 确认相：TON 计时中 / the confirmation phase
        IF (NOT bEnable) OR _bCfgBad THEN // 退出条件一：失能或组态非法（前置条件已消失）/ exit one, the prerequisite disappeared
            _eState := E_DL_IonFanPhase.eAlarm; // 迁入报警相 / enter the alarm phase
        ELSIF tonConfirm.Q AND _bAllOk THEN // 退出条件二：确认窗到且三判据仍满足（安全相迁移全量复检）/ exit two, the window elapsed with the criteria still holding
            _eState := E_DL_IonFanPhase.ePermit; // 迁入已许可相 / enter the permitted phase
        ELSIF NOT _bAllOk THEN // 退出条件三：判据在窗内失效 / exit three, a criterion failed inside the window
            _eState := E_DL_IonFanPhase.eAlarm; // 迁入报警相 / enter the alarm phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_IonFanPhase.ePermit: // 已许可相 / the permitted phase
        IF NOT _bAllOk THEN // 任一判据失效：零延时撤除（边界一）/ any criterion failed, the permit is withdrawn with no delay
            _eState := E_DL_IonFanPhase.eAlarm; // 同拍迁入报警相 / enter the alarm phase on the same scan
        ELSIF (NOT bEnable) OR _bCfgBad THEN // 失能或组态非法 / disabled or an illegal configuration
            _eState := E_DL_IonFanPhase.eAlarm; // 迁入报警相 / enter the alarm phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_IonFanPhase.eAlarm: // 报警相 / the alarm phase
        IF NOT bEnable THEN // 退出条件一：失能 / exit one, disabled
            _eState := E_DL_IonFanPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
        ELSIF _bAllOk AND (NOT _bCfgBad) THEN // 退出条件二：三判据全恢复且组态合法（须重走确认窗）/ exit two, every criterion recovered, the window restarts
            _eState := E_DL_IonFanPhase.eWarmup; // 回确认相（不直接回许可相，禁跳过确认窗）/ back to confirmation, never jumping straight to permitted
        END_IF
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截（边界六：落报警相并清许可，禁静默）/ the illegal enumeration guard
        _eState := E_DL_IonFanPhase.eAlarm; // 落报警相 / force the alarm phase
END_CASE

// 段 4｜统一出口（R191 名实双出口：bPermit 与 eState 同源；安全侧默认 FALSE）/ segment 4, the unified outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bPermit := (_eState = E_DL_IonFanPhase.ePermit) AND _bAllOk AND bEnable AND (NOT _bCfgBad); // 许可出口：态 + 合取 + 使能 + 组态四重同源（同拍撤除）/ the permit outlet with four sources, withdrawn on the same scan
bAlarmFan := NOT bFanRun; // 风机反馈丧失（Failure 级，无迟滞）/ the fan feedback loss without hysteresis
bAlarmSpeed := _bAlmSpd; // 风速报警出口（迟滞状态派生）/ the air speed alarm outlet
bAlarmBalance := _bAlmBal; // 平衡报警出口（迟滞状态派生）/ the balance alarm outlet
bValid := (NOT _bCfgBad) AND _bFinSpd AND _bFinBal; // 测量可用：组态合法且两测点均有限 / usable, a legal configuration and two finite samples
bError := _bCfgBad OR (NOT _bFinSpd) OR (NOT _bFinBal) OR (NOT bFanRun); // 故障位：组态 / 两测点 / 风机反馈（0718 属 Failure 级，R45 配对要求 bError 同拍）/ the fault bit covers the configuration, both samples and the fan feedback

// 段 5｜码位回放（首因保序：组态 → 风机 → 风速测点 → 平衡测点 → 信息级）/ segment 5, the code replay with the first cause kept first
IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态成因优先 / the configuration cause comes first
    eErr := 16#0003_0717; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, an illegal configuration
ELSIF NOT _bFinSpd THEN // 风速测点坏（与真超标分开，R90）/ the air speed sample is broken, kept apart from a real overshoot
    eErr := 16#0003_0719; // 故障级：风速测点非有限 / fault grade, the air speed sample is not finite
ELSIF NOT _bFinBal THEN // 平衡测点坏 / the balance sample is broken
    eErr := 16#0003_071A; // 故障级：平衡电压测点非有限 / fault grade, the balance sample is not finite
ELSIF NOT bFanRun THEN // 风机反馈丧失（Failure 级）/ the fan feedback loss
    eErr := 16#0003_0718; // 故障级：风机运行反馈丧失 / fault grade, the fan feedback is lost
ELSIF _bAlmSpd THEN // 风速真低于下限（OutOfSpec）/ the air speed really is below the floor
    eErr := 16#0003_071B; // 信息级：风速低于下限 / informational, the air speed is below the floor
ELSIF _bAlmBal THEN // 平衡真超限（OutOfSpec）/ the balance really is over the limit
    eErr := 16#0003_071C; // 信息级：平衡电压超限 / informational, the balance voltage is over the limit
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 返修版 v1.0.2：导轨多路电源上下电顺控。R61 钳位只堵越界读未堵语义——空轨（_nCnt=0）收到断电沿仍迁移并伪造 bDone，上位多计轮次；_bStepGo 为整段派生量致标称单轨超时实为整段超时。修法：eIdle/eStable 空轨早退不迁移不置 bDone 仅信息码；新增 _bRailPending 按相位取反/取正串入 tonStep.IN 实现真单轨超时；段 0 rtFb 刷新条件扩至 eRampUp 或 eRampDn。
architecture_thought: 返修不改架构（eIdle/eRampUp/eStable/eRampDn 四相 CASE + ELSE 兜底），三处定点修复：空轨早退闸（_nCnt=0 不迁移不置 bDone）；_bRailPending 相位相关反馈串入 tonStep.IN（真单轨超时）；rtFb 刷新条件扩相。原 R61 钳位保留为二重防御，正常路径行为零变更。

TYPE E_DL_RailPhase :
(
    eIdle    := 0,  // 空闲：等上电/断电命令沿 / idle, waiting for the power command edges
    eRampUp  := 10, // 上电步进：正向逐轨 / the power up stepping forward rail by rail
    eStable  := 20, // 稳定：全轨已上 / stable, all rails powered
    eRampDn  := 30  // 断电步进：逆向逐轨（边界二）/ the power down stepping in the reverse order
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_RailPowerSequence
VAR_INPUT
    bOnCmd       : BOOL := FALSE; // 上电命令电平，上升沿发起正向时序 / the power on command level
    bOffCmd      : BOOL := FALSE; // 断电命令电平，上升沿发起逆向时序 / the power off command level
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存回空闲 / the fault reset level
    uRailCount   : UDINT := 3;    // 供电轨数 [路]，合法域 1..8 / the rail count, legal from one to eight
    tStepTimeout : TIME := T#5S;  // 单轨步进超时 [毫秒] / the per rail step timeout
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    abRailFb  : ARRAY[0..7] OF BOOL; // 各轨反馈电平 [路反馈]，只读 / the rail feedback levels, read only
    atOnDelay : ARRAY[0..7] OF TIME; // 各轨上电前延时 [毫秒]，可配 / the per rail pre power delay, configurable
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    uOnCnt  : UDINT := 0;              // 已上电轨数 [路] / the powered rail count
    bDone   : BOOL := FALSE;           // 本轮时序完成单拍脉冲 [-] / the round done one shot pulse
    eState  : E_DL_RailPhase;          // 主状态机当前态 [状态] / the current state
    bError  : BOOL := FALSE;           // 故障锁存位（与锁存同源，R191）/ the fault bit from the latch
    eErr    : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;   // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit   : BOOL := FALSE;                          // 首拍初始化标志（R310）/ the first scan flag
    _eState  : E_DL_RailPhase := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bDone   : BOOL := FALSE;                          // 完成单拍内部位，段 1 预清段 5 映射 / the internal done bit
    _bFault  : BOOL := FALSE;                          // 故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _nStep   : DINT  := 0;                             // 当前步进轨索引 [下标] / the current step rail index
    _nCnt    : UDINT := 0;                             // 已完成轨数副本 [路] / the completed rail count copy
    _nUse    : DINT  := 0;                             // 钳位后的轨数 [路] / the clamped rail count
    _bCfgBad : BOOL  := FALSE;                         // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    _bStepGo : BOOL  := FALSE;                         // 步进计时使能（驻留派生）[-] / the step timing enable derived from the dwell
    _bRailPending : BOOL := FALSE;                     // 本轨待响应量（逐拍派生：上电取未反馈、断电取仍反馈）[-] / the pending rail of this step, derived every scan
    _bEmptyOff : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 空轨断电早退标记（逐拍重算，信息级 0655）/ the empty bank off request flag, recomputed every scan
    rtOn     : R_TRIG;  // 上电命令沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the on command edge instance
    rtOff    : R_TRIG;  // 断电命令沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the off command edge instance
    rtReset  : R_TRIG;  // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the reset edge instance
    rtFb     : R_TRIG;  // 步进轨反馈沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the step rail feedback edge instance
    tonStep  : TON;     // 步进超时计时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the step timeout timer
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_RPS_RMAX : DINT := 8; // 供电轨容量上界 [路]，与数组容量一致 / the rail capacity aligned with the array
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7；TON IN 串故障锁存门控，FB50-1）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtOn(CLK := bOnCmd); // 上电沿 / the on edge
rtOff(CLK := bOffCmd); // 断电沿 / the off edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
IF (_eState = E_DL_RailPhase.eRampUp) OR (_eState = E_DL_RailPhase.eRampDn) THEN // 两相步进相均刷当前轨反馈（v1.0.2 扩相，防断电相恒刷 0 号轨）/ both stepping phases watch the current rail
    rtFb(CLK := abRailFb[_nStep]); // 当前步进轨反馈沿 / the current step rail feedback edge
ELSE // 非步进相：非步进相固定刷新 0 号轨（保持无条件调用形态）/ the other phases refresh on the rail zero slot
    rtFb(CLK := abRailFb[0]); // 固定下标刷新 / the fixed index refresh
END_IF
_bStepGo := (_eState = E_DL_RailPhase.eRampUp) OR (_eState = E_DL_RailPhase.eRampDn); // 步进相驻留派生 / the dwell derived enable
// 单轨待响应量：只由「本相 + 本轨反馈」派生，本轨一响应即落 FALSE 使 TON 自动复位（v1.0.2 修 D2）/ the per rail pending, the timer resets by itself once this rail responds
IF _eState = E_DL_RailPhase.eRampUp THEN // 上电相：本轨尚未反馈即待响应 / the ramp up phase waits for the feedback to appear
    _bRailPending := NOT abRailFb[_nStep]; // 未反馈为待响应 / pending while the feedback is still absent
ELSIF _eState = E_DL_RailPhase.eRampDn THEN // 断电相：本轨仍反馈即待响应 / the ramp down phase waits for the feedback to vanish
    _bRailPending := abRailFb[_nStep]; // 仍反馈为待响应 / pending while the feedback is still present
ELSE // 其余相无单轨待响应语义 / no per rail pending outside the stepping phases
    _bRailPending := FALSE; // 非步进相清待响应 / clear the pending outside the stepping phases
END_IF
tonStep(IN := _bStepGo AND (NOT _bFault) AND _bRailPending, PT := tStepTimeout); // 单轨超时（串故障锁存门控 + 本轨待响应，FB50-1）/ the per rail timeout with the latch gate and the rail pending

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与单拍标志预清（FB32-1；R256）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the preset
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _nStep := 0; // 步进索引显式清零 / clear the step index explicitly
    _nCnt := 0; // 完成轨数显式清零 / clear the completed count explicitly
    _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域：清锁存 + 迁相位 + 清步进量，R311）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _bFault := FALSE; // 清故障锁存 / clear the fault latch
    _nStep := 0; // 清步进索引 / clear the step index
    _nCnt := 0; // 清完成轨数 / clear the completed count
    _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
END_IF
_bDone := FALSE; // 完成单拍预清零 / preset the done pulse false
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态标记预清零 / preset the configuration flag false
_bEmptyOff := FALSE; // 空轨早退标记预清零（单拍信息位，段 5 映射 0655）/ preset the empty bank flag false

// 段 2｜组态域闸（轨数合法域 1..8，边界一）/ segment 2, the rail count gate
_nUse := UDINT_TO_DINT(uRailCount); // 轨数升位接管（超 DINT 域转负即被下界捕获）/ take the rail count widened, an overflow lands below the floor
IF (_nUse < 1) OR (_nUse > DL_RPS_RMAX) THEN // 轨数越域 / the rail count out of the domain
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 置组态非法标记 / raise the configuration flag
    _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存故障（0642，段 5 回放）/ latch the fault
END_IF
IF _nUse < 1 THEN // 下界钳位（防越界索引）/ the floor clamp for the index safety
    _nUse := 1; // 钳到一 / clamp to one
END_IF
IF _nUse > DL_RPS_RMAX THEN // 上界钳位 / the ceiling clamp
    _nUse := DL_RPS_RMAX; // 钳到容量 / clamp to the capacity
END_IF

// 段 3｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 拦非法态；安全相迁移带全量闸位复检，R274）/ segment 3, the main machine
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相 / the idle phase
        IF rtOn.Q AND (NOT _bFault) AND (NOT _bCfgBad) THEN // 上电沿 + 全量闸位复检（R274）/ the on edge with the full gate recheck
            _nStep := 0; // 从 0 号轨正向起步 / start forward from the rail zero
            _nCnt := 0; // 完成轨数归零 / reset the completed count
            _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eRampUp; // 迁入上电步进相 / enter the ramp up phase
        ELSIF rtOff.Q AND (NOT _bFault) AND (NOT _bCfgBad) THEN // 断电沿 + 全量闸位复检 / the off edge with the recheck
            IF _nCnt = 0 THEN // 空轨早退（v1.0.2 修 D1）：无已上电轨则无从逆序断电 / the empty bank early exit, no powered rail to cut
                _bEmptyOff := TRUE; // 仅置信息级标记，不迁移、不置 bDone / raise the informational flag only, no migration and no done pulse
            ELSE // 有已上电轨：正常逆序起步 / a powered bank, start the reverse sequence
                _nStep := UDINT_TO_DINT(_nCnt) - 1; // 从已完成末轨逆向起步（断电逆序，边界二）/ start reverse from the last powered rail
                IF _nStep < 0 THEN // 二重防御：空轨已在上面早退，本钳位不再是唯一防线（R61-D1 保留）/ a second line of defence, no longer the only guard
                    _nStep := 0; // 钳到 0 号轨，防 abRailFb[-1] 越界读 / clamp to the rail zero against the negative index read
                END_IF
                _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eRampDn; // 迁入断电步进相 / enter the ramp down phase
            END_IF
        END_IF
    E_DL_RailPhase.eRampUp: // 上电步进相 / the ramp up phase
        IF rtFb.Q THEN // 当前轨反馈到沿 / the current rail feedback edge
            _nCnt := _nCnt + 1; // 完成轨数推进 / advance the completed count
            _nStep := _nStep + 1; // 步进索引推进 / advance the step index
            IF _nStep >= _nUse THEN // 全轨完成 / all rails done
                _bDone := TRUE; // 置完成单拍 / raise the done pulse
                _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eStable; // 迁入稳定相 / enter the stable phase
            END_IF
        ELSIF tonStep.Q THEN // 步进超时（边界三）/ the step timeout
            _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存超时故障（0643）/ latch the timeout fault
        ELSIF _bFault THEN // 前置条件消失出口 / the prerequisite gone exit
            _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲（锁存迁移由段 4 收口）/ back to idle
        END_IF
    E_DL_RailPhase.eStable: // 稳定相 / the stable phase
        IF rtOff.Q AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 断电沿 + 闸位复检 / the off edge with the recheck
            IF _nCnt = 0 THEN // 空轨早退（与 eIdle 同口径，v1.0.2 修 D1）：异常态下 _nCnt 被清零亦不得伪造完成 / the same empty bank exit as the idle phase
                _bEmptyOff := TRUE; // 仅置信息级标记，不迁移、不置 bDone / raise the informational flag only
            ELSE // 有已上电轨：正常逆序起步 / a powered bank, start the reverse sequence
                _nStep := UDINT_TO_DINT(_nCnt) - 1; // 逆向起步（断电逆序）/ start reverse
                IF _nStep < 0 THEN // 二重防御（空轨已在上面早退）/ a second line of defence
                    _nStep := 0; // 钳到 0 号轨，防负下标越界读 / clamp to the rail zero against the negative index read
                END_IF
                _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eRampDn; // 迁入断电步进相 / enter the ramp down phase
            END_IF
        ELSIF _bFault THEN // 前置条件消失 / the prerequisite gone
            _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
        END_IF
    E_DL_RailPhase.eRampDn: // 断电步进相（逆序，边界二）/ the ramp down phase in the reverse order
        IF NOT abRailFb[_nStep] THEN // 当前轨反馈已消失（断电完成判据）/ the current rail feedback gone
            IF _nCnt > 0 THEN // 无符号下溢闸（0 减 1 会回绕，先判再减）/ the underflow guard before the decrement
                _nCnt := _nCnt - 1; // 完成轨数回退 / step the completed count back
            END_IF
            _nStep := _nStep - 1; // 逆向推进 / step reverse
            IF _nStep < 0 THEN // 全轨断完 / all rails off
                _nCnt := 0; // 完成轨数清零 / clear the completed count
                _bDone := TRUE; // 置完成单拍 / raise the done pulse
                _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
            END_IF
        ELSIF tonStep.Q THEN // 步进超时 / the step timeout
            _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存超时故障 / latch the timeout fault
        ELSIF _bFault THEN // 前置条件消失 / the prerequisite gone
            _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
        END_IF
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截 / the illegal enumeration guard
        _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 落回空闲 / force back to idle
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置故障锁存 / latch the fault
END_CASE

// 段 4｜故障锁存迁移闸（置于解除段之后防同拍抢迁，R258）/ segment 4, the latch to phase gate
IF _bFault AND (_eState <> E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle) THEN // 已锁存但不在空闲相（本件锁存即弃用本轮迁空闲）/ latched, the round is discarded to idle
    _eState := E_DL_RailPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
END_IF

// 段 5｜统一出口（内部副本单点映射；故障码锁存回放，R187）/ segment 5, the unified outlet
uOnCnt := _nCnt; // 已上电轨数出口 / the powered count outlet
bDone := _bDone; // 完成单拍出口 / the done pulse outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bError := _bFault; // 故障位出口（与锁存同源）/ the fault bit outlet
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存回放优先 / the latched fault replays first
    IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态成因（独立码值，R190）/ the configuration cause
        eErr := 16#0001_0642; // 故障级：轨数组态非法 / fault grade, the illegal rail count
    ELSE // 超时成因 / the timeout cause
        eErr := 16#0001_0643; // 故障级：步进反馈超时 / fault grade, the step feedback timeout
    END_IF
ELSE // 无故障 / no fault
    IF _bEmptyOff THEN // 空轨断电请求已忽略（信息级不置 bError，R285）/ the empty bank request ignored, informational without bError
        eErr := 16#0001_0655; // 信息级：空轨断电请求已忽略 / informational, the empty bank off request ignored
    ELSE // 无事件 / no event
        eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
    END_IF
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 返修版 v1.0.1：刀塔换刀状态机死相位修复。原实现 eFault 相位存在但无迁入闸（各处 ELSIF _bFault 均落 eIdle），故障态不可达、诊断失真。修法：补独立迁入闸 IF _bFault AND 状态<>eFault THEN 迁 eFault；eIdle/eMoving 故障出口由 eIdle 改 eFault 防同拍先迁 idle 再被拉回；eFault 出口 NOT _bFault 才迁出；不删相理由（诊断保真）写入头注释。
architecture_thought: 返修不改架构（eIdle/eMoving/eSelecting/eToolChange/eFault 相位保留），补 eFault 迁入闸 + 统一故障出口（eIdle/eMoving 的 ELSIF _bFault 改落 eFault），消除同拍先迁 idle 再被拉回的竞态；eFault 自有出口不变；诊断保真理由写入头注释。

TYPE E_DL_TurretPhase :
(
    eIdle   := 0,  // 空闲：等换刀指令沿 / idle, waiting for the change edge
    eMoving := 10, // 换刀进行：等到位反馈 / moving, waiting for the in position feedback
    eFault  := 20  // 故障：组态非法，锁存待复位 / fault, the illegal configuration latched
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_TurretToolSelect
VAR_INPUT
    bExec     : BOOL := FALSE;  // 换刀指令电平，上升沿解算并发单拍 / the change command level
    bInPos    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 刀塔到位反馈电平 [-] / the turret in position feedback
    bReset    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存 / the fault reset level
    uCurTool  : UDINT := 1;     // 当前刀位号 [刀位]，域 [1, 24] / the current tool number
    uReqTool  : UDINT := 1;     // 请求刀位号 [刀位]，域 [1, 24] / the requested tool number
    uToolCnt  : UDINT := 8;     // 刀位总数 [刀位]，合法域 1..24 / the tool count, legal from one to twenty four
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bDirCW      : BOOL := FALSE;          // 方向指示：TRUE 正向（CW）[-] / the direction indicator, true for the forward
    uSteps      : UDINT := 0;             // 换刀步数 [步] / the change step count
    bToolChange : BOOL := FALSE;          // 换刀指令单拍脉冲 [-] / the change command one shot pulse
    bDone       : BOOL := FALSE;          // 换刀完成单拍脉冲 [-] / the change done one shot pulse
    eState      : E_DL_TurretPhase;       // 主状态机当前态 [状态] / the current state
    bError      : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障锁存位（与锁存同源，R191）/ the fault bit from the latch
    bValid      : BOOL := FALSE;          // 解算可用标志 [-] / the solve usable flag
    eErr        : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit    : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 首拍初始化标志（R310）/ the first scan flag
    _eState   : E_DL_TurretPhase := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bFault   : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 组态故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _nCur     : DINT := 1;                            // 钳位后当前刀位 [刀位] / the clamped current tool
    _nReq     : DINT := 1;                            // 钳位后请求刀位 [刀位] / the clamped requested tool
    _nCnt     : DINT := 8;                            // 钳位后刀位数 [刀位] / the clamped tool count
    _nDiff    : DINT := 0;                            // 环差 [步] / the ring difference
    _nSteps   : DINT := 0;                            // 步数工作副本 [步] / the step count copy
    _bCW      : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 方向工作副本 / the direction copy
    _bChange  : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 换刀单拍内部位，段 1 预清段 5 映射 / the internal change bit
    _bDone    : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 完成单拍内部位 / the internal done bit
    _bClamp   : BOOL := FALSE;                        // 钳位标记（逐拍重算）/ the clamp flag recomputed
    rtExec    : R_TRIG; // 换刀指令沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the command edge instance
    rtReset   : R_TRIG; // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the reset edge instance
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_TTS_NMAX : DINT := 24; // 刀位容量上界 [刀位] / the tool capacity bound
END_VAR

// 段 0｜沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtExec(CLK := bExec); // 换刀指令沿 / the command edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿 / the reset edge

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与单拍标志预清（R310 / FB32-1 / R256）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the preset
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域：清锁存 + 迁相位，R311 声明）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _bFault := FALSE; // 清锁存（解除路径：复位沿恒可达，R152 自证）/ clear the latch
    _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
END_IF
_bChange := FALSE; // 换刀单拍预清零 / preset the change bit false
_bDone := FALSE; // 完成单拍预清零 / preset the done bit false
_bClamp := FALSE; // 钳位标记预清零 / preset the clamp flag false

// 段 2｜域闸与钳位（整数全精确，边界一二五）/ segment 2, the domain gate with the clamps
_nCnt := UDINT_TO_DINT(uToolCnt); // 刀位数升位接管 / take the tool count widened
IF (_nCnt < 1) OR (_nCnt > DL_TTS_NMAX) THEN // 刀位数组态非法（0807 → 08A7 独立码）/ the illegal tool count
    _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存故障（08A7）/ latch the fault
END_IF
IF _nCnt < 1 THEN // 下界钳位（防环运算除零取模）/ the floor clamp guarding the modulo
    _nCnt := 1; // 钳到一 / clamp to one
END_IF
IF _nCnt > DL_TTS_NMAX THEN // 上界钳位 / the ceiling clamp
    _nCnt := DL_TTS_NMAX; // 钳到容量 / clamp to the capacity
END_IF
_nCur := UDINT_TO_DINT(uCurTool); // 当前刀位接管 / take the current tool
_nReq := UDINT_TO_DINT(uReqTool); // 请求刀位接管 / take the requested tool
IF (_nCur < 1) OR (_nCur > _nCnt) OR (_nReq < 1) OR (_nReq > _nCnt) THEN // 刀位号越域（信息级钳位，边界一）/ the tool numbers out of the domain
    _bClamp := TRUE; // 置钳位标记 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF
IF _nCur < 1 THEN // 当前刀位下界钳位 / the current floor clamp
    _nCur := 1; // 钳到一 / clamp to one
END_IF
IF _nCur > _nCnt THEN // 当前刀位上界钳位 / the current ceiling clamp
    _nCur := _nCnt; // 钳到总数 / clamp to the count
END_IF
IF _nReq < 1 THEN // 请求刀位下界钳位 / the requested floor clamp
    _nReq := 1; // 钳到一 / clamp to one
END_IF
IF _nReq > _nCnt THEN // 请求刀位上界钳位 / the requested ceiling clamp
    _nReq := _nCnt; // 钳到总数 / clamp to the count
END_IF

// 段 3｜就近方向解算（全整数精确比较，进位点写死取正向，边界二）/ segment 3, the nearest direction solve in exact integers
_nDiff := ((_nReq - _nCur) MOD _nCnt + _nCnt) MOD _nCnt; // 环差归一到 [0, n-1]（双 MOD 防负数取模方言差异）/ the ring difference normalized
IF _nDiff = 0 THEN // 同刀位：零步 / the same tool, zero steps
    _nSteps := 0; // 零步 / zero steps
    _bCW := TRUE; // 零步时方向寄存器按正向表态（无方向语义）/ the direction placeholder forward
ELSIF (_nDiff * 2) = _nCnt THEN // 恰对径（进位点）：两向等长，写死取正向（边界二）/ the diametric point takes the forward by the declared rule
    _nSteps := _nDiff; // 正向步数 / the forward steps
    _bCW := TRUE; // 正向 / forward
ELSIF (_nDiff * 2) < _nCnt THEN // 正向更近 / the forward is nearer
    _nSteps := _nDiff; // 正向步数 / the forward steps
    _bCW := TRUE; // 正向 / forward
ELSE // 反向更近 / the reverse is nearer
    _nSteps := _nCnt - _nDiff; // 反向步数 / the reverse steps
    _bCW := FALSE; // 反向 / reverse
END_IF

// 段 4｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 兜底；指令沿消费带全量闸位复检，R274）/ segment 4, the main machine
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相 / the idle phase
        IF rtExec.Q AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 指令沿 + 闸位复检（R274）/ the command edge with the gate recheck
            IF _nSteps = 0 THEN // 同刀位校验：直接完成（整数精确比较，边界二）/ the same tool verified by the exact integer compare
                _bDone := TRUE; // 置完成单拍 / raise the done bit
            ELSE // 异刀位：发换刀单拍并迁入移动相 / a different tool, raise the change pulse and enter moving
                _bChange := TRUE; // 置换刀单拍 / raise the change bit
                _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eMoving; // 迁入移动相 / enter the moving phase
            END_IF
        END_IF
    E_DL_TurretPhase.eMoving: // 移动相：等到位反馈 / the moving phase
        IF bInPos THEN // 到位反馈（同刀位目标校验后完成）/ the in position feedback
            _bDone := TRUE; // 置完成单拍 / raise the done bit
            _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
        ELSIF _bFault THEN // 前置条件消失出口（直接迁故障相，不经 eIdle，v1.0.1 修 D3）/ the prerequisite gone exit straight to the fault phase
            _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相（与统一迁入闸同向，避免同拍先迁 idle 再被拉回）/ enter the fault phase, aligned with the unified gate
        END_IF
    E_DL_TurretPhase.eFault: // 故障相：等复位沿（解除可达，边界五）/ the fault phase until the reset
        IF NOT _bFault THEN // 锁存已清才迁出 / the exit after the latch cleared
            _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
        END_IF
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截 / the illegal enumeration guard
        _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eIdle; // 落回空闲 / force back to idle
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置锁存 / latch the fault
END_CASE

// 段 4b｜故障统一迁入闸（置于状态机之后、解除段之外，R274 迁入完备性；v1.0.1 修 D3）/ segment 4b, the unified fault entry gate
IF _bFault AND (_eState <> E_DL_TurretPhase.eFault) THEN // 已锁存但当前不在故障相（含 eIdle 检出与非法枚举值兜底）/ latched but not yet in the fault phase
    _eState := E_DL_TurretPhase.eFault; // 任何相检出故障一律落故障相，eFault 由此可达 / any phase with a latch lands in the fault phase, which makes it reachable
END_IF

// 段 5｜统一出口（内部副本单点映射；故障码锁存回放，R187）/ segment 5, the unified outlet
bDirCW := _bCW; // 方向出口 / the direction outlet
uSteps := DINT_TO_UDINT(_nSteps); // 步数出口（值已证非负）/ the step outlet proven non negative
bToolChange := _bChange; // 换刀单拍出口 / the change pulse outlet
bDone := _bDone; // 完成单拍出口 / the done pulse outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bError := _bFault; // 故障位出口（与锁存同源）/ the fault bit outlet
bValid := NOT _bFault; // 解算可用标志 / the solve usable flag
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存回放（R187）/ the latched fault replays
    eErr := 16#0004_08A7; // 故障级：刀位数组态非法 / fault grade, the illegal tool count
ELSIF _bClamp THEN // 钳位（信息级不置 bError，R285）/ the clamp informational
    eErr := 16#0004_08A6; // 信息级：刀位号越域已钳位 / informational, the tool numbers clamped
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 返修版 v1.0.1：双传感器互校环窗残留修复。窗长变更沿未清账致旧窗样本与新窗混算产生假一致性；首填阶段均值除子用已用数致系统性偏小漏报启动漂移。修法：新增 _nUsePrev 与窗长变更沿清 _fRingSum/_nHead/_nFill；均值除子改 _nFill；_nFill=0 跳过判据；复位清单补全。

TYPE E_DL_SensorPairPhase :
(
    eUseA   := 0,  // 择优 A 源 / using the source A
    eUseB   := 10, // 择优 B 源 / using the source B
    eFault  := 20  // 故障锁定：输出冻结快照 / fault locked, the outlet frozen at the snapshot
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_SensorPairPlausibility
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable   : BOOL := TRUE;   // 使能，FALSE 时冻结择优出口（R191 声明行）/ the enable, false freezes the outlet
    bReset    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存 / the fault reset level
    fA        : LREAL := 0.0;   // A 传感器测量值 [工程单位] / the sensor A value
    fB        : LREAL := 0.0;   // B 传感器测量值 [工程单位] / the sensor B value
    fDevWin   : LREAL := 2.0;   // 偏差窗 [工程单位]，必须 > 0 / the deviation window, must be positive
    fDriftLim : LREAL := 5.0;   // 漂移趋势限 [工程单位]，必须 > 0 / the drift trend limit, must be positive
    nTrendWin : DINT  := 8;     // 漂移趋势滚动窗长度 [拍]，合法域 1..32 / the rolling window length, legal from one to thirty two
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fSel      : LREAL := 0.0;  // 择优输出 [工程单位] / the selected outlet
    bSrcA     : BOOL := TRUE;  // 当前择优 A 源指示 [-] / the source A indicator
    bSrcB     : BOOL := FALSE; // 当前择优 B 源指示 [-] / the source B indicator
    bSwitched : BOOL := FALSE; // 源切换单拍脉冲 [-] / the source switch one shot pulse
    eState    : E_DL_SensorPairPhase; // 主状态机当前态 [状态] / the current state
    bError    : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障锁存位（与锁存同源，R191）/ the fault bit from the latch
    bValid    : BOOL := FALSE; // 择优可用标志 [-] / the selection usable flag
    eErr      : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit    : BOOL := FALSE;                          // 首拍初始化标志（R310）/ the first scan flag
    _eState   : E_DL_SensorPairPhase := E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseA; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bFault   : BOOL := FALSE;                          // 故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _bDevFlt  : BOOL := FALSE;                          // 偏差超窗锁存副本（独立成因，R190）/ the deviation fault latch copy
    _bDriftFlt: BOOL := FALSE;                          // 漂移超限锁存副本（独立成因）/ the drift fault latch copy
    _bFin     : BOOL := FALSE;                          // 入参非有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the finiteness gate result
    _bFinA    : BOOL := FALSE;                          // A 源有限标记（逐拍重算）/ the A finiteness flag
    _bFinB    : BOOL := FALSE;                          // B 源有限标记 / the B finiteness flag
    _fDev     : LREAL := 0.0;                           // 本拍偏差 [工程单位] / the deviation this scan
    _fSnap    : LREAL := 0.0;                           // 最近有效择优快照（写前过闸，FB32-7）/ the last valid snapshot gated before write
    _nUse     : DINT := 8;                              // 钳位后的滚动窗长度 [拍] / the clamped window length
    _afRing   : ARRAY[0..31] OF LREAL;                  // 偏差滚动环形窗 [工程单位] / the deviation rolling ring
    _nHead    : DINT := 0;                              // 环形窗写头 [下标] / the ring write head
    _nFill    : DINT := 0;                              // 环形窗已填样本数 [拍]，均值除子（v1.0.1 修 D4）/ the filled sample count of the ring, the mean divisor
    _nUsePrev : DINT := 0;                              // 上拍窗长快照 [拍]，置 0 使首拍必触发一次全窗清零 / the previous window length snapshot, zero forces a full clear on the first scan
    _nRingIdx : DINT := 0;                              // 环元素清零遍历索引 [下标] / the ring clearing traversal index
    _fRingSum : LREAL := 0.0;                           // 环窗偏差和 [工程单位] / the ring deviation sum
    _bSw      : BOOL := FALSE;                          // 切换单拍内部位，段 1 预清段 5 映射 / the internal switch bit
    _bWinBad  : BOOL := FALSE;                          // 窗长钳位标记（逐拍重算）/ the window clamp flag
    rtReset   : R_TRIG; // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the reset edge instance
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_SPP_RMAX : DINT := 32; // 滚动窗容量上界 [拍]，与环形数组一致 / the ring capacity aligned with the array
END_VAR

// 段 0｜复位沿无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿 / the reset edge

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与单拍标志预清（R310 / FB32-1 / R256）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the preset
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _bDevFlt := FALSE; // 偏差锁存显式清零 / clear the deviation latch explicitly
    _bDriftFlt := FALSE; // 漂移锁存显式清零 / clear the drift latch explicitly
    _eState := E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseA; // 状态显式落 A 源 / place the state to the source A
    _nFill := 0; // 填充计数显式清零（R243 复位清单）/ clear the filled count explicitly
    _nUsePrev := 0; // 窗长快照置 0，使段 2 变更沿必然触发一次全窗清零 / zero the window snapshot so the change edge clears the ring once
    _fRingSum := 0.0; // 环窗和显式清零 / clear the ring sum explicitly
    _nHead := 0; // 写头显式清零 / clear the write head explicitly
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域：清双侧锁存 + 迁相位 + 清环窗累计量，R311 声明）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _bDevFlt := FALSE; // 清偏差锁存（解除路径：复位沿恒可达，R152 自证）/ clear the deviation latch
    _bDriftFlt := FALSE; // 清漂移锁存 / clear the drift latch
    _eState := E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseA; // 迁回 A 源 / back to the source A
    _nFill := 0; // 填充计数清零（R243 复位清单）/ clear the filled count
    _nUsePrev := 0; // 窗长快照置 0 触发一次全窗清零 / zero the window snapshot to force a ring clear
    _fRingSum := 0.0; // 环窗和清零 / clear the ring sum
    _nHead := 0; // 写头清零 / clear the write head
END_IF
_bSw := FALSE; // 切换单拍预清零 / preset the switch bit false
_bWinBad := FALSE; // 钳位标记预清零 / preset the clamp flag false

// 段 2｜非有限闸与窗长钳位（R272 全量点名，边界三二）/ segment 2, the finiteness gate and the window clamp
_bFinA := (fA = fA) AND ((fA - fA) = (fA - fA)); // A 源自反 + 差值判 / the A source tests
_bFinB := (fB = fB) AND ((fB - fB) = (fB - fB)); // B 源自反 + 差值判 / the B source tests
_bFin := _bFinA AND _bFinB
AND (fDevWin = fDevWin) AND ((fDevWin - fDevWin) = (fDevWin - fDevWin))
AND (fDriftLim = fDriftLim) AND ((fDriftLim - fDriftLim) = (fDriftLim - fDriftLim)); // 阈值引脚同判 / the threshold pins tested the same way
_nUse := nTrendWin; // 窗长接管 / take the window length
IF (_nUse < 1) OR (_nUse > DL_SPP_RMAX) THEN // 窗长越域（边界二）/ the window length out of the domain
    _bWinBad := TRUE; // 置钳位标记 / raise the clamp flag
    IF _nUse < 1 THEN // 下界钳位 / the floor clamp
        _nUse := 1; // 钳到一 / clamp to one
    ELSE // 上界钳位 / the ceiling clamp
        _nUse := DL_SPP_RMAX; // 钳到容量 / clamp to the capacity
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 2b｜窗长变更沿全窗清零（v1.0.1 修 D4：仅清和与写头不足，减项 _afRing[_nHead] 会把陈旧样本重新注入和）/ segment 2b, the full window clear on a length change
IF _nUse <> _nUsePrev THEN // 窗长变更沿（含首拍 _nUsePrev = 0）/ the window length change edge, including the first scan
    _fRingSum := 0.0; // 环窗和清零 / clear the ring sum
    _nHead := 0; // 写头回零 / reset the write head
    _nFill := 0; // 填充计数回零 / reset the filled count
    FOR _nRingIdx := 0 TO DL_SPP_RMAX - 1 DO // 有界遍历全容量（32 项，无死循环风险）/ the bounded traversal over the full capacity
        _afRing[_nRingIdx] := 0.0; // 环元素逐项清零：减项读到零才不会把旧样本扣回和里 / zero every element so the subtract term reads zero instead of a stale sample
    END_FOR
    _nUsePrev := _nUse; // 快照本拍窗长，防重复清零 / snapshot the length to avoid a repeated clear
END_IF

// 段 3｜偏差与漂移判据（闸覆盖全量入参后执行）/ segment 3, the deviation and the drift criteria
IF _bFinA AND _bFinB THEN // 双源有限才判偏差（双源非有限即整段跳过，_nFill 保持不增）/ the deviation judged on two finite sources, otherwise the whole segment is skipped
    _fDev := ABS(fA - fB); // 偏差（无除法，无除零风险）/ the deviation without a division
    _fRingSum := _fRingSum - _afRing[_nHead] + _fDev; // 环窗和滑窗更新（环元素已在清零沿置零，减项必为有效样本或零）/ update the ring sum, the subtract term is either a live sample or zero
    _afRing[_nHead] := _fDev; // 本拍偏差入环 / push the deviation into the ring
    _nHead := _nHead + 1; // 写头推进 / advance the head
    IF _nHead >= _nUse THEN // 回卷（按钳位窗长）/ wrap by the clamped length
        _nHead := 0; // 写头回零 / reset the head
    END_IF
    IF _nFill < _nUse THEN // 窗未填满才累加 / count only while the window is not yet full
        _nFill := _nFill + 1; // 填充计数推进 / advance the filled count
    END_IF
    IF _fDev > fDevWin THEN // 偏差超窗（0707 独立成因）/ the deviation over the window
        _bDevFlt := TRUE; // 独立锁存 / latch the deviation cause
    END_IF
    // 除子证明（v1.0.1 重写）：① _nFill 在上一行刚自增且上界为 _nUse，而 _nUse 已在段 2 钳到 ≥ 1，
    // 故进入本判时 _nFill ≥ 1 恒成立；② 唯一能把 _nFill 置 0 的是段 2b 的窗长变更沿，它在段 3 之前执行；
    // ③ 下方 _nFill ≥ 1 复检为第三重防御，供后续重构时不破除零。
    // divisor proof: the count is incremented just above and bounded by the clamped length of at least one, so it is at least one here;
    // the only zeroing path is the length change edge executed before this segment; the explicit recheck below is a third line of defence.
    IF _nFill >= 1 THEN // 除零复检（正常路径恒真，禁用裸除子）/ the divisor recheck, always true on the normal path
        IF (_fRingSum / DINT_TO_LREAL(_nFill)) > fDriftLim THEN // 滚动均值超限（除子已证 ≥ 1，0708 独立成因）/ the rolling mean over the limit with a proven divisor
            _bDriftFlt := TRUE; // 独立锁存 / latch the drift cause
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF
IF _bDevFlt OR _bDriftFlt THEN // 任一成因锁存即整体故障 / any cause latches the whole fault
    _bFault := TRUE; // 总锁存 / latch the total fault
END_IF

// 段 4｜择优状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 兜底；迟滞纪律，边界一）/ segment 4, the selection machine with the hysteresis
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseA: // A 源相 / the source A phase
        IF _bFault THEN // 故障迁移（安全相带全量闸位复检，R274）/ the fault migration with the full gate recheck
            _eState := E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eFault; // 迁入故障锁存相 / enter the fault phase
        ELSIF NOT _bFinA THEN // A 源失效：迟滞边界切换（唯一切换判据）/ the A source invalid, the hysteresis boundary switch
            _eState := E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseB; // 切到 B 源 / switch to the source B
            _bSw := TRUE; // 置切换单拍 / raise the switch bit
        END_IF
    E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseB: // B 源相 / the source B phase
        IF _bFault THEN // 故障迁移 / the fault migration
            _eState := E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eFault; // 迁入故障锁存相 / enter the fault phase
        ELSIF NOT _bFinB THEN // B 源失效：切回 A / the B source invalid, back to A
            _eState := E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseA; // 切回 A 源 / back to the source A
            _bSw := TRUE; // 置切换单拍 / raise the switch bit
        END_IF
    E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eFault: // 故障锁存相：等复位沿（解除可达，边界四）/ the fault phase until the reset edge
        IF rtReset.Q AND (NOT _bDevFlt) AND (NOT _bDriftFlt) THEN // 双锁存已清才迁出（防清锁同拍重锁，FB50-1）/ the exit only after both latches cleared
            _eState := E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseA; // 迁回 A 源 / back to the source A
        END_IF
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截 / the illegal enumeration guard
        _eState := E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseA; // 落回 A 源 / force back to A
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置总锁存 / latch the total fault
END_CASE

// 段 5｜统一出口（择优值按态取源；故障冻结快照，R273）/ segment 5, the unified outlet
bSwitched := _bSw; // 切换单拍出口 / the switch pulse outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bSrcA := (_eState = E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseA); // A 源指示 / the A indicator
bSrcB := (_eState = E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseB); // B 源指示 / the B indicator
IF _eState = E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseA THEN // A 源相出口取 A（非有限时安全零，R273）/ the A outlet with the safe zero on a non finite source
    IF _bFinA THEN // A 有限才外泄 / export only a finite A
        fSel := fA; // 择优值 / the selected value
        _fSnap := fA; // 快照更新（写前过闸，FB32-7）/ update the snapshot gated
    ELSE // A 非有限：保持快照（切换已在状态机发生）/ keep the snapshot
        fSel := _fSnap; // 冻结快照出口 / freeze the snapshot outlet
    END_IF
ELSIF _eState = E_DL_SensorPairPhase.eUseB THEN // B 源相出口取 B / the B outlet
    IF _bFinB THEN // B 有限才外泄 / export only a finite B
        fSel := fB; // 择优值 / the selected value
        _fSnap := fB; // 快照更新 / update the snapshot
    ELSE // B 非有限：保持快照 / keep the snapshot
        fSel := _fSnap; // 冻结快照出口 / freeze the snapshot outlet
    END_IF
ELSE // 故障相：冻结最近有效快照（R273）/ the fault phase freezes the snapshot
    fSel := _fSnap; // 冻结快照出口 / freeze the snapshot outlet
END_IF
bError := _bFault; // 故障位出口（与锁存同源）/ the fault bit outlet
bValid := (NOT _bFault) AND (_bFinA OR _bFinB); // 可用标志（无故障且至少一源有限，单点单写）/ the usable flag, no fault and at least one finite source
IF _bDevFlt THEN // 偏差成因回放（R187 锁存回放）/ the deviation cause replayed
    eErr := 16#0003_0707; // 故障级：偏差超窗 / fault grade, the deviation over the window
ELSIF _bDriftFlt THEN // 漂移成因 / the drift cause
    eErr := 16#0003_0708; // 故障级：漂移趋势超限 / fault grade, the drift over the limit
ELSIF _bSw THEN // 切换（信息级不置 bError，R285）/ the switch informational
    eErr := 16#0003_0709; // 信息级：发生择优源切换 / informational, the source switched
ELSIF _bWinBad THEN // 窗长钳位（信息级）/ the window clamp informational
    eErr := 16#0003_070A; // 信息级：滚动窗长度越域已钳位 / informational, the window clamped
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 返修版 v1.0.1：加权分位数计算。原实现委托排序函数的返回值与 bValid 输出共用一个变量承接（隐性回夹），返回 TRUE 但 bValid=FALSE 的异常组合被吞。修法：返回值落 _bSortRet、bValid=> 落 _bSortValid，再 AND 合成 bSortOk，与 v1.0.0 结果逐位一致无回退。
architecture_thought: 返修不改算法主体，仅修委托承接：_bSortRet/_bSortValid 双变量承接后 AND 合成，异常组合（返回 TRUE 但 bValid=FALSE）不再被吞；无回退断言写入头注释。

                      排序内核（R140 委托优先，R216 双向互引）。

                         p = 0 → 排序首元，p = 1 → 排序末元（两端点向量自证）；
                      二 权向量闸：任一 wᵢ < 0、非有限或 Σw = 0 判故障级拒绝
                         （无权可分即无分位可言）；
                      三 插值除子 (cum_k − cum_{k-1}) ≤ 0 时直接取右元值（禁除零）；
                      四 结果复检兜底同拍置 eErr + bError + bValid 三件套（R258）；

  错误码   Codes    :
    16#0001_0639【信息级】计数越域已钳位或分位 p 越域已钳位到 [0,1]
    16#0001_063A【故障级】权向量非法（负权 / 非有限 / Σw = 0），拒绝出值
    16#0001_063B【故障级】结果非有限（复检兜底）
  验收   Acceptance :
    算法已证（脚本）：未跑 ｜ 编译器已证（三平台）：未跑
    V1 值 1/2/3 权 1/1/2、p=0.5 → 目标 2.0 落第 2 位 → 2.0
    V2 p=0 → 首元；p=1 → 末元；p=1.5 → 钳 1 码 0639
    V3 权全零 → 码 063A、bValid=FALSE
    V4 正常 8 样本 → 结果与 v1.0.0 逐位一致（无行为回退，v1.0.1 回归向量）
    V5 委托件返回 TRUE 但内部 bValid=FALSE（构造）→ bSortOk=FALSE（v1.0.1 新增可捕获组合）
  无回退断言 Regression  :
    v1.0.1 仅改委托调用的承接方式（返回值落 _bSortRet、bValid 映射落 _bSortValid，再合取），
    不触碰段 2 / 段 3 / 段 5 / 段 6 的任何判据、钳位与插值公式，故三平台同一输入下
    结果与 v1.0.0 逐位一致（位级相等，非容差相等）。
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R61 首版（批 2 · 序号 6）
    2026-11-21  v1.0.1  R62-D5 返修：委托返回值落 _bSortRet、bValid => 落 _bSortValid，再 bSortOk := _bSortRet AND _bSortValid（禁双写同一变量）；头注释补「与 v1.0.0 结果逐位一致」无回退断言说明

*)
FUNCTION FC_DL_WeightedPercentile : BOOL
VAR_IN_OUT
    afValues : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL; // 数值序列 [工程单位]，只读 / the value series, read only
    afWeights : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL; // 权序列 [权]，只读 / the weight series, read only
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    nCount : DINT;  // 序列个数 [个]，合法域 1..256 / the count, legal from one to two hundred fifty six
    fP     : LREAL; // 目标分位 [-]，域 [0,1] 钳位 / the target quantile, clamped to the unit domain
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fOut   : LREAL; // 加权百分位结果 [工程单位] / the weighted percentile result
    bValid : BOOL;  // 结果可用标志 [-] / the result usable flag
    eErr   : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError : BOOL;  // 错误标志，故障级码置位（R45 配对）/ the error flag
END_VAR
VAR
    aOrd    : ARRAY[0..255] OF DINT; // 排序索引排列（委托输出）/ the sorted permutation from the delegate
    k       : DINT;  // 遍历索引 [下标] / the traversal index
    nUse    : DINT;  // 钳位后的个数 [个] / the clamped count
    fPUse   : LREAL; // 钳位后的分位 [-] / the clamped quantile
    fWsum   : LREAL; // 权和 [权] / the weight sum
    fTarget : LREAL; // 目标累积权 [权] / the target cumulative weight
    fCum    : LREAL; // 当前累积权 [权] / the current cumulative weight
    fCumPrv : LREAL; // 前一位置累积权 [权] / the previous cumulative weight
    fVL     : LREAL; // 插值左元值 [工程单位] / the left interpolation value
    fVR     : LREAL; // 插值右元值 [工程单位] / the right interpolation value
    fFrac   : LREAL; // 插值分数 [-] / the interpolation fraction
    nHit    : DINT;  // 命中位置 [下标] / the hit position
    bFound  : BOOL;  // 命中标记 [-] / the hit flag
    bSortOk : BOOL;  // 委托排序可用位（返回值与 bValid 合取）/ the delegate sort usable bit, the conjunction
    _bSortRet : BOOL; // 委托函数返回值承接变量（独立承接，禁双写，R62-D5）/ the delegate return value holder, never double written
    _bSortValid : BOOL; // 委托 bValid 输出承接变量（独立承接，禁双写）/ the delegate valid output holder, never double written
    bSortEr : BOOL;  // 委托排序故障位 [-] / the delegate sort fault bit
    uSortEr : UDINT; // 委托排序错误码 [码] / the delegate error code
    bClamp  : BOOL;  // 钳位发生标记 [-] / the clamp happened flag
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_WPC_NMAX : DINT := 256; // 序列容量上界 [个]，与数组容量一致 / the capacity aligned with the array
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与错误状态预置安全值 + 局部量显式预置（R45 / R254）/ segment 1, the preset
FC_DL_WeightedPercentile := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
fOut := 0.0; // 结果预置零 / preset the result zero
bValid := FALSE; // 有效标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 错误标志预置假 / preset the error flag false
nUse := 0; // 个数预置零 / preset the count zero
fPUse := 0.0; // 分位预置零 / preset the quantile zero
fWsum := 0.0; // 权和预置零 / preset the weight sum zero
fTarget := 0.0; // 目标累积权预置零 / preset the target zero
fCum := 0.0; // 累积权预置零 / preset the cumulative zero
fCumPrv := 0.0; // 前位累积权预置零 / preset the previous zero
fVL := 0.0; // 左元值预置零 / preset the left value zero
fVR := 0.0; // 右元值预置零 / preset the right value zero
fFrac := 0.0; // 分数预置零 / preset the fraction zero
nHit := 0; // 命中位置预置零 / preset the hit zero
bFound := FALSE; // 命中标记预置假 / preset the hit flag false
bSortOk := FALSE; // 委托成功位预置假 / preset the delegate bit false
_bSortRet := FALSE; // 委托返回值承接量预置假 / preset the return holder false
_bSortValid := FALSE; // 委托可用位承接量预置假 / preset the valid holder false
bSortEr := FALSE; // 委托故障位预置假 / preset the delegate fault bit false
uSortEr := 16#0000_0000; // 委托码预置零 / preset the delegate code zero
bClamp := FALSE; // 钳位标记预置假 / preset the clamp flag false
FOR k := 0 TO 255 DO // 排列数组预置恒等 / preset the permutation array
    aOrd[k] := k; // 恒等索引 / the identity index
END_FOR

// 段 2｜计数与分位域闸（钳位显式，边界一）/ segment 2, the count and quantile gates
IF nCount < 1 THEN // 空序列无分位 / an empty series has no percentile
    eErr := 16#0001_0639; // 信息级：计数越域已钳位（信息级不置 bError）/ informational, the count clamped
    RETURN; // 早退：fOut 保持零、bValid 保持假 / early return
END_IF
nUse := nCount; // 域内接管 / take the count
IF nUse > DL_WPC_NMAX THEN // 超容量 / above the capacity
    nUse := DL_WPC_NMAX; // 钳到容量 / clamp to the capacity
    bClamp := TRUE; // 置钳位标记 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF
fPUse := fP; // 分位接管 / take the quantile
IF fPUse < 0.0 THEN // 低于下界 / below the floor
    fPUse := 0.0; // 钳到零 / clamp to zero
    bClamp := TRUE; // 置钳位标记 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF
IF fPUse > 1.0 THEN // 高于上界 / above the ceiling
    fPUse := 1.0; // 钳到一 / clamp to one
    bClamp := TRUE; // 置钳位标记 / raise the clamp flag
END_IF
IF (fPUse <> fPUse) OR ((fPUse - fPUse) <> (fPUse - fPUse)) THEN // 分位非有限（NaN 钳位序闸兜不住，逐个点名，R272）/ a non finite quantile
    eErr := 16#0001_063A; // 故障级：入参非法归权向量闸同码口径（判据集合内非法）/ fault grade, an illegal input
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志（R45 配对）/ raise the error flag
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF
IF bClamp THEN // 钳位发生置信息级 / the clamp raises the informational code
    eErr := 16#0001_0639; // 信息级：计数或分位越域已钳位 / informational, clamped
END_IF

// 段 3｜权向量闸：逐元素负权 / 非有限点名 + Σw 判（边界二，R272）/ segment 3, the weight gate
FOR k := 0 TO nUse - 1 DO // 有界遍历 / the bounded traversal
    IF (afWeights[k] < 0.0)
    OR (afWeights[k] <> afWeights[k])
    OR ((afWeights[k] - afWeights[k]) <> (afWeights[k] - afWeights[k])) THEN // 负权或非有限 / a negative or non finite weight
        eErr := 16#0001_063A; // 故障级：权向量非法 / fault grade, an illegal weight vector
        bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志（R45 配对）/ raise the error flag
        RETURN; // 早退 / early return
    END_IF
    fWsum := fWsum + afWeights[k]; // 权和累加 / accumulate the weight sum
END_FOR
IF fWsum <= 0.0 THEN // 权和为零（权和已证非负，本判覆盖恰零）/ a zero weight sum
    eErr := 16#0001_063A; // 故障级：权向量和为零 / fault grade, the zero weight sum
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志（R45 配对）/ raise the error flag
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 4｜委托稳定排序（R140 委托优先；返回值与 bValid 分承，禁双写，R62-D5）/ segment 4, the delegated stable sort with two separate holders
_bSortRet := FC_DL_SortIndexLReal(afValues := afValues, nCount := nUse, aIdx => aOrd, bValid => _bSortValid, eErr => uSortEr, bError => bSortEr); // 委托索引排序：返回值落 _bSortRet、可用位映射落 _bSortValid / delegate the index sort with two distinct holders
bSortOk := _bSortRet AND _bSortValid; // 返回值与可用位各自承接后合取（IEC 未规定返回值与输出映射的求值次序）/ conjoin the return value and the valid flag, since IEC leaves their evaluation order unspecified
IF (NOT bSortOk) OR bSortEr THEN // 委托失败（含其非有限故障码回传）/ the delegate failed
    eErr := uSortEr; // 委托码回传（码随属主，R66）/ replay the delegate code
    bError := bSortEr; // 委托故障位回传 / replay the delegate fault bit
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 5｜加权累积定位与邻位插值（边界一三）/ segment 5, the weighted location and the neighbour interpolation
fTarget := fPUse * fWsum; // 目标累积权（p=0 取首元、p=1 取末元，两端点自证）/ the target cumulative weight
fCum := 0.0; // 累积权清零 / reset the cumulative
FOR k := 0 TO nUse - 1 DO // 按排序序累积（命中后余轮守卫跳过，禁改循环变量）/ accumulate in the sorted order, the rounds after the hit are guarded out
    IF NOT bFound THEN // 未命中才继续累积 / accumulate only before the hit
        fCumPrv := fCum; // 前位累积权快照 / snapshot the previous cumulative
        fCum := fCum + afWeights[aOrd[k]]; // 累进当前权 / add the current weight
        IF fCum >= fTarget THEN // 越过目标即命中（p=0 时首位置即命中）/ the target crossed
            nHit := k; // 记录命中位置 / register the hit position
            bFound := TRUE; // 置命中标记 / raise the hit flag
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_FOR
IF NOT bFound THEN // 全遍历未越过（浮点和误差兜底）：取末元 / the fallback to the last element
    nHit := nUse - 1; // 命中末位置 / the last position
END_IF
fVR := afValues[aOrd[nHit]]; // 右元值 = 命中位值 / the right value is the hit value
IF nHit = 0 THEN // 命中首位：无左邻（p=0 端点）/ the first position, no left neighbour
    fOut := fVR; // 直接取右元 / take the right value directly
ELSE // 邻位插值 / the neighbour interpolation
    fVL := afValues[aOrd[nHit - 1]]; // 左元值 / the left value
    IF (fCum - fCumPrv) > 0.0 THEN // 插值除子已证 > 0（边界三）/ the proven positive divisor
        fFrac := (fTarget - fCumPrv) / (fCum - fCumPrv); // 插值分数 / the interpolation fraction
        IF fFrac < 0.0 THEN // 分数越下界（浮点和误差兜底钳位）/ the fraction below the floor
            fFrac := 0.0; // 钳到零（取左元）/ clamp to zero
        END_IF
        IF fFrac > 1.0 THEN // 分数越上界 / the fraction above the ceiling
            fFrac := 1.0; // 钳到一（取右元）/ clamp to one
        END_IF
        fOut := fVL + (fVR - fVL) * fFrac; // 线性插值出结果 / the linear interpolation
    ELSE // 除子非正（零权相邻）：直接取右元（禁除零，边界三）/ a non positive divisor, take the right value
        fOut := fVR; // 直接取右元 / take the right value directly
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 6｜结果复检兜底（非有限同拍三件套，边界四）/ segment 6, the result recheck
IF (fOut <> fOut) OR ((fOut - fOut) <> (fOut - fOut)) THEN // 结果非有限 / the result is not finite
    fOut := 0.0; // 兜底安全值 / the bottom line safe value
    eErr := 16#0001_063B; // 故障级：结果非有限 / fault grade, the non finite result
    bError := TRUE; // 置错误标志（R45 配对）/ raise the error flag
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result void
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF
bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
FC_DL_WeightedPercentile := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION
