TYPE E_DL_ClearPhase :
(
    eIdle     := 0,  // 空闲：等清线请求沿 / idle, waiting for the clearance request edge
    eSweep    := 10, // 清料相：残留逐件出清 / the sweeping phase, the residues leaving one by one
    eConfirm  := 20, // 确认相：阶段确认窗内等确认沿 / the confirm phase inside the window
    eFault    := 30  // 故障：超窗或组态非法，锁存待复位 / fault, the overrun or the illegal configuration latched
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_LineClearanceVerify
VAR_INPUT
    bClearReq    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 清线请求电平，上升沿发起 / the clearance request level
    bItemOut     : BOOL := FALSE;  // 出料口有料电平 [-] / the item present level at the outlet
    bClearConfirm: BOOL := FALSE;  // 清线确认电平，上升沿确认 / the clearance confirm level
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存 / the fault reset level
    tConfirmWin  : TIME := T#60S;  // 阶段确认窗时长 [毫秒] / the confirm window duration
    nResidueMax  : DINT := 0;      // 残留计数上限 [件]，≥ 0；默认 0 即残留非零即提示，调大则该量残留仍允许放行 / the residue count bound, non negative; zero means any residue hints, a larger bound tolerates that many residues
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    uResidueCnt : UDINT := 0;              // 本轮残留计数 [件] / the residue count of this round
    bClearOk    : BOOL := FALSE;           // 清线通过单拍脉冲 [-] / the clearance passed one shot pulse
    eState      : E_DL_ClearPhase;         // 主状态机当前态 [状态] / the current state
    bError      : BOOL := FALSE;           // 故障锁存位（与锁存同源，R191）/ the fault bit from the latch
    eErr        : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;   // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit     : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 首拍初始化标志（R310）/ the first scan flag
    _eState    : E_DL_ClearPhase := E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bFault    : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _bCfgBad   : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算入锁存）/ the configuration fault flag
    _uResidue  : UDINT := 0;                               // 残留计数副本 [件] / the residue count copy
    _bOk       : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 通过单拍内部位，段 1 预清段 5 映射 / the internal ok bit
    _bEvtTaken : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 本拍确认沿已消化标记（R275）/ the confirm edge consumed flag
    _bCfgLatch : BOOL := FALSE;                            // 组态锁存副本（与 _bCfgBad 区分：锁存型）/ the configuration latch copy
    rtReq      : R_TRIG;  // 清线请求沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the request edge instance
    rtItem     : R_TRIG;  // 出料沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the item out edge instance
    rtConfirm  : R_TRIG;  // 确认沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the confirm edge instance
    rtReset    : R_TRIG;  // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the reset edge instance
    tonWin     : TON;     // 阶段确认窗定时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the confirm window timer
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7；TON IN 串故障锁存门控，FB50-1）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtReq(CLK := bClearReq); // 请求沿 / the request edge
rtItem(CLK := bItemOut); // 出料沿 / the item out edge
rtConfirm(CLK := bClearConfirm); // 确认沿 / the confirm edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
tonWin(IN := (_eState = E_DL_ClearPhase.eConfirm) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tConfirmWin); // 确认窗：仅确认相且无锁存时计时 / the window timing only in the confirm phase

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与单拍标志预清（R310 / FB32-1 / R256）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the preset
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bFault := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _bCfgLatch := FALSE; // 组态锁存显式清零 / clear the configuration latch explicitly
    _uResidue := 0; // 残留计数显式清零 / clear the residue count explicitly
    _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域：清锁存 + 清计数 + 迁相位，R311 / R243 声明）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _bFault := FALSE; // 清故障锁存（解除路径：复位沿恒可达，R152 自证）/ clear the fault latch
    _bCfgLatch := FALSE; // 清组态锁存 / clear the configuration latch
    _uResidue := 0; // 清残留计数（R243 快照/计数出口入复位清单）/ clear the residue count
    _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
END_IF
_bOk := FALSE; // 通过单拍预清零 / preset the ok bit false
_bEvtTaken := FALSE; // 确认沿消化标记预清零 / preset the consumed flag false
_bCfgBad := FALSE; // 组态标记预清零 / preset the configuration flag false

// 段 2｜组态域闸（边界四）/ segment 2, the configuration gate
IF (tConfirmWin <= T#0S) OR (nResidueMax < 0) THEN // 窗非法或上限负 / an illegal window or a negative bound
    _bCfgBad := TRUE; // 置组态标记 / raise the configuration flag
    _bCfgLatch := TRUE; // 锁存组态故障（3038）/ latch the configuration fault
    _bFault := TRUE; // 总锁存（段 4 迁移）/ latch the total fault
END_IF

// 段 3｜本拍确认沿预消化（R275：合法事件先于窗口到期迁移消化）/ segment 3, the confirm edge pre digest
IF rtConfirm.Q AND (_eState = E_DL_ClearPhase.eConfirm) AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 确认相内的确认沿 / a confirm edge inside the confirm phase
    _bEvtTaken := TRUE; // 标记本拍已消化（段 4 不再判超窗）/ mark the edge consumed this scan
    _bOk := TRUE; // 置通过单拍 / raise the ok bit
    _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲（本轮通过）/ back to idle with the round passed
END_IF

// 段 4｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 兜底；超窗迁移让位于本拍确认沿，边界二）/ segment 4, the main machine
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相 / the idle phase
        IF rtReq.Q AND (NOT _bFault) THEN // 请求沿 + 闸位复检（R274）/ the request edge with the gate recheck
            _uResidue := 0; // 新一轮残留计数归零（整数精确） / reset the residue count by the exact integer
            _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eSweep; // 迁入清料相 / enter the sweeping phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_ClearPhase.eSweep: // 清料相：残留逐件出清 / the sweeping phase
        IF rtItem.Q THEN // 出料沿：残留计一件 / an item out edge counts one residue
            _uResidue := _uResidue + 1; // 残留计数推进 / advance the residue count
        END_IF
        IF (NOT bItemOut) AND (NOT rtItem.Q) THEN // 出料口已空且本拍无新出料沿（整数域判据，边界一）/ the outlet empty with no new edge
            _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eConfirm; // 迁入确认相（确认窗起算）/ enter the confirm phase
        ELSIF _bFault THEN // 前置条件消失出口 / the prerequisite gone exit
            _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相 / enter the fault phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_ClearPhase.eConfirm: // 确认相（本拍确认沿已在段 3 消化并迁出，边界二）/ the confirm phase, the edge already digested in segment three
        IF tonWin.Q AND (NOT _bEvtTaken) THEN // 窗口到期且本拍无确认沿（R275 同拍竞态口径）/ the window expired with no confirm edge this scan
            _bFault := TRUE; // 锁存超窗故障（3037，升级码）/ latch the overrun fault
        ELSIF _bFault THEN // 前置条件消失 / the prerequisite gone
            _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相 / enter the fault phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_ClearPhase.eFault: // 故障相：等复位沿（解除可达，边界三）/ the fault phase until the reset
        IF NOT _bFault THEN // 锁存已清才迁出（防清锁同拍重锁，FB50-1）/ the exit after the latch cleared
            _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
        END_IF
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截 / the illegal enumeration guard
        _eState := E_DL_ClearPhase.eIdle; // 落回空闲 / force back to idle
        _bFault := TRUE; // 置锁存 / latch the fault
END_CASE

// 段 5｜统一出口（内部副本单点映射；故障码锁存回放，R187）/ segment 5, the unified outlet
uResidueCnt := _uResidue; // 残留计数出口 / the residue count outlet
bClearOk := _bOk; // 通过单拍出口 / the ok pulse outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bError := _bFault; // 故障位出口（与锁存同源）/ the fault bit outlet
IF _bFault THEN // 故障锁存回放优先 / the latched fault replays first
    IF _bCfgLatch THEN // 组态成因（独立码值，R190）/ the configuration cause
        eErr := 16#0005_3038; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, the illegal configuration
    ELSE // 超窗成因 / the overrun cause
        eErr := 16#0005_3037; // 故障级：确认窗到期未确认，升级 / fault grade, the overrun escalated
    END_IF
ELSIF (_uResidue > DINT_TO_UDINT(nResidueMax)) OR (nResidueMax < 0) THEN // 残留超限提示（信息级，排在故障回放之后即链末位，不覆盖故障码，R285）/ the residue over the bound, informational and last in the chain so it never covers a fault code
    eErr := 16#0005_3036; // 信息级：残留计数非零超提示限 / informational, the residues over the hint bound
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

VAR_INPUT

END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    nOut    : DINT := 0;            // 解码结果 [个]，非法码元时为 0 / the decoded result, zero when a digit is illegal
    bBadDigit : BOOL := FALSE;      // 非法码元标志（任一半字节 > 9）[-] / the illegal digit flag raised when any nibble exceeds nine
    bValid  : BOOL := FALSE;        // 结果可用 [-] / the result usable flag
    eErr    : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok

    nShift  : DINT := 0;  // 移位量 [位]，4·k ≤ 28 结构性安全 / the shift amount of four times the index, proven below the word width
    uDig    : USINT := 0; // 当前半字节码元 [位] / the current digit nibble

    DL_BCD_N     : DINT := 8;            // 码元总数 [个]（DWORD 恰 8 半字节，R57）/ the nibble count of eight aligned with the container
    DL_BCD_ZERO  : DINT := 0;            // 整型零常量 [个] / the integer zero constant
    DL_BCD_ONE   : DINT := 1;            // 整型一常量 [个] / the integer one constant
    DL_BCD_TEN   : DINT := 10;           // 十进制权值基数 [个] / the decimal weight base of ten
END_VAR

FC_DL_BcdToDint := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
nOut := DL_BCD_ZERO; // 结果预置零 [个] / preset the result zero
bBadDigit := FALSE; // 非法码元标志预置假 / preset the illegal digit flag false
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the error flag false
nAcc := DL_BCD_ZERO; // 累加器预置零 [个] / preset the accumulator zero
k := DL_BCD_ZERO; // 索引预置零 / preset the index zero
nShift := DL_BCD_ZERO; // 移位量预置零 [位] / preset the shift amount zero
uDig := 0; // 码元预置零 [位] / preset the digit zero

// 段 2｜逐码元提取与合法性闸（移位量 4·k ≤ 28 < 32 结构性安全，边界二）/ segment 2, the digit extraction with the structural shift bound
FOR k := DL_BCD_ZERO TO DL_BCD_N - DL_BCD_ONE DO // 有界遍历 8 个半字节（循环界常量证明，无死循环）/ the bounded traversal over eight nibbles proven by the constant loop bound

        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
        nOut := DL_BCD_ZERO; // 结果强制归零（禁部分折算值外泄）/ force the result to zero so no partial fold leaks
        RETURN; // 早退（首因保序，边界四）/ early return with the first cause kept
    END_IF
    nAcc := (nAcc * DL_BCD_TEN) + USINT_TO_DINT(uDig); // Horner 十进制累加：nAcc = nAcc×10 + 码元 [个] / the Horner decimal accumulation, the domain proof in boundary one covers every step
END_FOR

nOut := nAcc; // 结果出口 [个] / the result outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
FC_DL_BcdToDint := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

FUNCTION FC_DL_DintToBcd : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    nIn     : DINT := 0; // 待编码整数 [个]，合法域 0..99999999 / the integer to encode, legal from zero to ninety nine million
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT

    bOvF    : BOOL := FALSE;        // 越域标志（仅 nIn > 99999999 置位）[-] / the overflow flag raised only above the BCD domain
    bValid  : BOOL := FALSE;        // 结果可用 [-] / the result usable flag
    eErr    : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError  : BOOL := FALSE;        // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    k       : DINT := 0;  // 码元位置索引 [下标]，0..7 / the digit position index from zero to seven
    nShift  : DINT := 0;  // 移位量 [位]，4·k ≤ 28 结构性安全 / the shift amount of four times the position, proven below the word width
    nWork   : DINT := 0;  // 逐位提取工作副本 [个] / the working copy of the digit extraction
    uDig    : USINT := 0; // 当前位码元 [位] / the current digit extracted
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_BCD_MAX   : DINT := 99999999;   // 8 位 BCD 可表上界 [个] / the representable ceiling of the eight digit BCD
    DL_BCD_N     : DINT := 8;          // 码元总数 [个] / the digit count of eight
    DL_BCD_TEN   : DINT := 10;         // 十进制提取基数 [个] / the decimal extraction base of ten
    DL_BCD_NIB   : DINT := 4;          // 每码元位宽 [位] / the nibble width of four bits
    DL_BCD_ZERO  : DINT := 0;          // 整型零常量 [个] / the integer zero constant
    DL_BCD_ONE   : DINT := 1;          // 整型一常量 [个] / the integer one constant
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, the preset of the return and every outlet
FC_DL_DintToBcd := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
udBcd := 16#00000000; // BCD 输出预置全零 [码] / preset the BCD output to all zeros
bOvF := FALSE; // 越域标志预置假 / preset the overflow flag false
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the error flag false
nWork := DL_BCD_ZERO; // 工作副本预置零 [个] / preset the working copy zero
k := DL_BCD_ZERO; // 索引预置零 / preset the index zero
nShift := DL_BCD_ZERO; // 移位量预置零 [位] / preset the shift amount zero
uDig := 0; // 码元预置零 [位] / preset the digit zero

    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 3｜判据二：越域显式拒绝（边界一②，禁静默截断）/ segment 3, the domain overflow rejection
IF nIn > DL_BCD_MAX THEN // 超 8 位 BCD 可表上界 / above the representable ceiling
    udBcd := 16#00000000; // 输出强制全零 [码] / force the output to all zeros
    bOvF := TRUE; // 置越域标志（与负值场景的唯一区分位）/ raise the overflow flag, the only bit distinguishing this scene
    eErr := 16#0001_0658; // 故障级：不可 BCD 编码（越域）/ fault grade, not encodable as BCD, the domain is exceeded
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

nWork := nIn; // 工作副本接管 [个] / take the working copy

    nShift := DL_BCD_NIB * k; // 移位量 = 4·k，最大 28 [位] / the shift amount of four times the position

END_FOR

bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
FC_DL_DintToBcd := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

    fOut     : LREAL := 0.0;           // 滤波输出 [工程单位] / the filtered output
    bValid   : BOOL := FALSE;          // 输出可用（使能 + 无故障 + 首样本已收）[-] / the output is usable
    eErr     : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError   : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit    : BOOL := FALSE;   // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _bHasSamp : BOOL := FALSE;   // 已收首样本标志（跨拍保持）/ the first sample received flag
    _fOutLast : LREAL := 0.0;    // 最近一次有效输出（冻结与递推基线）[工程单位] / the last valid output used as the freeze and the recursion base
    _bFinIn   : BOOL := FALSE;   // 输入有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the input finiteness gate result
    _bFinAlp  : BOOL := FALSE;   // 平滑系数有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the alpha finiteness gate result
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_EWM_ZERO : LREAL := 0.0; // 实数零常量 [工程单位] / the real zero constant
    DL_EWM_ONE  : LREAL := 1.0; // 实数一常量（α 上界）[-] / the real unit constant, the alpha ceiling
END_VAR

// 段 0｜本件无定时器与边沿实例（纯递推滤波器，R6 标注 N/A），无刷新对象 / segment 0, no timers and no edge instances exist here

// 段 1｜首拍初始化（FB50-2）/ segment 1, the first scan init
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bHasSamp := FALSE; // 首样本标志显式清零（触发首拍直通）/ clear the first sample flag so the direct pass triggers
    _fOutLast := DL_EWM_ZERO; // 最近有效输出显式清零 / clear the last valid output explicitly
END_IF

// 段 2｜非有限闸逐个点名（R272：fAlpha 与 fIn 双双入闸）/ segment 2, the finiteness gates naming both real pins
_bFinAlp := (fAlpha = fAlpha) AND ((fAlpha - fAlpha) = (fAlpha - fAlpha)); // 平滑系数有限 / the alpha is finite
_bFinIn := (fIn = fIn) AND ((fIn - fIn) = (fIn - fIn)); // 输入有限 / the input is finite

// 段 3｜α 组态域闸：结构早退（边界一，出口三件套 + RETURN）/ segment 3, the alpha domain gate with the structural early exit
IF (NOT _bFinAlp) OR (fAlpha <= DL_EWM_ZERO) OR (fAlpha > DL_EWM_ONE) THEN // 组态非法 / an illegal configuration
    fOut := _fOutLast; // 出口保持最近有效值（禁自赋值出口，R261）/ keep the last valid output instead of a self assignment
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    eErr := 16#0002_373B; // 故障级：α 组态非法 / fault grade, the alpha configuration is illegal
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 早退（组态非法结构早退，R1 同族口径）/ early return, the structural exit on an illegal configuration
END_IF

// 段 4｜失能分支：冻结最后有效值（边界四声明行）/ segment 4, the disabled branch freezes the last valid output
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    fOut := _fOutLast; // 冻结最后有效值（纯监视滤波，理由见边界四）/ freeze the last valid output, a pure monitoring filter
    bValid := FALSE; // 失能即不可用 / the output is not usable while disabled
    bError := FALSE; // 失能不是故障 / a disabled device is not a fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 失能不发码 / no code is emitted while disabled
    RETURN; // 早退，不推进递推 / early return without advancing the recursion
END_IF

// 段 5｜输入非有限：拒绝更新并保持（边界二，禁污染物进状态）/ segment 5, a non finite input is rejected
IF NOT _bFinIn THEN // 输入坏 / the input is broken
    fOut := _fOutLast; // 保持上拍有效值 [工程单位] / keep the last valid output
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    eErr := 16#0002_373C; // 故障级：输入非有限 / fault grade, the input is not finite
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 早退，递推状态不被污染 / early return, the recursion state stays clean
END_IF

// 段 6｜首样本直通（边界三，禁 0 假跳变）/ segment 6, the first sample passes straight through
IF NOT _bHasSamp THEN // 尚无首样本 / no first sample yet
    _fOutLast := fIn; // 基线 = 首样本 [工程单位] / the base is the first sample
    _bHasSamp := TRUE; // 置首样本标志 / raise the first sample flag
    fOut := fIn; // 首拍直通 [工程单位] / the first scan passes straight through
    bValid := TRUE; // 输出可用 / the output is usable
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 7｜EWMA 递推（公开公式）：fOut = fOutLast + α×(fIn − fOutLast) / segment 7, the EWMA recursion
fOut := _fOutLast + (fAlpha * (fIn - _fOutLast)); // 指数加权滑动平均 [工程单位] / the exponentially weighted moving average

// 段 8｜递推结果非有限兜底（三件套，R258；与输入坏同码，反证见码表）/ segment 8, the non finite result fallback
IF (fOut <> fOut) OR ((fOut - fOut) <> (fOut - fOut)) THEN // 结果非有限（NaN 自反 / Inf 差值自减）/ a non finite result tested by reflexivity and the self difference
    fOut := _fOutLast; // 回退保持上拍有效值 [工程单位] / fall back to the last valid output
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    eErr := 16#0002_373C; // 故障级：输入或结果非有限（同族一码）/ fault grade, the input or the result is not finite
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 早退，基线不被污染 / early return, the base stays clean
END_IF

// 段 9｜统一出口（基线推进 + 可用声明）/ segment 9, the unified outlet
_fOutLast := fOut; // 基线推进（写前已过非有限闸）[工程单位] / advance the base after the finiteness gate
bValid := TRUE; // 输出可用 / the output is usable
bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 双端截尾均值（稳健位置估计）：真实工况为多次称重/多探头读数受野点污染后的均值口径。边界：NaN 样本逐条剔除（nNonFinite 局部计数不外显，诊断引 SignalStatistics，R62-D7 口径固化）；uTrimLo+uTrimHi ≥ nEff 组态码早退（禁截尾成空集）；委托 SortIndexLReal 升序索引双承接（R295）；除子 nEff−trim ≥ 1 证明注释；nCount 越域 [1,256] 早退。

FUNCTION FC_DL_TrimmedMeanCalc : BOOL
VAR_IN_OUT
    afSamples : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL; // 样本序列 [工程单位]，只读 / the sample series, read only
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    nCount  : DINT := 0;    // 有效样本数入参 [个]，合法域 1..256 / the sample count, legal from one to two hundred fifty six
    uTrimLo : USINT := 0;   // 低端截去个数 [个] / the count trimmed from the low end
    uTrimHi : USINT := 0;   // 高端截去个数 [个] / the count trimmed from the high end
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fMean   : LREAL := 0.0; // 截尾均值 [工程单位] / the trimmed mean
    nEff    : DINT := 0;    // 参与均值样本数 [个]（剔除非有限后）/ the effective sample count after dropping non finite samples
    bValid  : BOOL := FALSE; // 结果可用 [-] / the result usable flag
    eErr    : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError  : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    aVal      : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL; // 剔除非有限后的有效样本副本 [工程单位] / the finite sample copy
    aIdx      : ARRAY[0..255] OF DINT;  // 委托输出的排序索引排列 [下标] / the sorted permutation from the delegate
    k         : DINT := 0;    // 遍历索引 [下标] / the traversal index
    nNonFinite: DINT := 0;    // 剔除的非有限样本数 [个]（仅局部留档，不外显，R62-D7 口径；诊断请用 FC_DL_SignalStatistics）/ the dropped non finite count, local only and never exposed
    nCountUse : DINT := 0;    // 入参样本数接管量 [个] / the raw input count holder
    nTrim     : DINT := 0;    // 双端截去总数 [个]（升位防 USINT 和溢出）/ the total trimmed count widened before the sum
    nTrimLo   : DINT := 0;    // 低端截去数升位副本 [个] / the low trim count widened
    nTrimHi   : DINT := 0;    // 高端截去数升位副本 [个] / the high trim count widened
    nKeep     : DINT := 0;    // 参与均值样本数（除子）[个] / the kept sample count used as the divisor
    fSum      : LREAL := 0.0; // 区间样本和 [工程单位] / the interval sample sum
    fMeanUse  : LREAL := 0.0; // 均值工作副本 [工程单位] / the working mean copy
    bSortRet  : BOOL := FALSE; // 委托返回值承接量（独立承接，R295）/ the delegate return holder
    bSortValid: BOOL := FALSE; // 委托 bValid 承接量（独立承接，R295）/ the delegate valid holder
    uSortErr  : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 委托错误码承接量 [码] / the delegate error code holder
    bSortErr  : BOOL := FALSE; // 委托故障位承接量 / the delegate fault bit holder
    bSortOk   : BOOL := FALSE; // 返回值与可用位合取后的排序可用位 / the conjunction of the return value and the valid flag
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_TMC_NMAX  : DINT := 256;      // 样本容量上界 [个]，与数组容量一致 / the capacity aligned with the array
    DL_TMC_ONE   : DINT := 1;        // 整型一常量 [个] / the integer one constant
    DL_TMC_ZERO  : DINT := 0;        // 整型零常量 [个] / the integer zero constant
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, the preset of the return and every outlet
FC_DL_TrimmedMeanCalc := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
fMean := 0.0; // 均值预置零 [工程单位] / preset the mean zero
nEff := DL_TMC_ZERO; // 有效样本数预置零 [个] / preset the effective count zero
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the error flag false
nNonFinite := DL_TMC_ZERO; // 剔除计数预置零 [个] / preset the dropped count zero
nCountUse := DL_TMC_ZERO; // 入参计数接管量预置零 [个] / preset the raw count holder zero
nTrim := DL_TMC_ZERO; // 截去总数预置零 [个] / preset the trimmed total zero
nTrimLo := DL_TMC_ZERO; // 低端截去数预置零 [个] / preset the low trim zero
nTrimHi := DL_TMC_ZERO; // 高端截去数预置零 [个] / preset the high trim zero
nKeep := DL_TMC_ZERO; // 除子预置零 [个] / preset the divisor zero
fSum := 0.0; // 区间和预置零 [工程单位] / preset the interval sum zero
fMeanUse := 0.0; // 均值工作副本预置零 [工程单位] / preset the working mean zero
bSortRet := FALSE; // 委托返回值承接量预置假 / preset the delegate return holder false
bSortValid := FALSE; // 委托可用位承接量预置假 / preset the delegate valid holder false
uSortErr := 16#0000_0000; // 委托码承接量预置零 [码] / preset the delegate code zero
bSortErr := FALSE; // 委托故障位承接量预置假 / preset the delegate fault holder false
bSortOk := FALSE; // 排序可用位预置假 / preset the sort usable bit false

// 段 2｜样本数域闸（边界二，早退禁除零）/ segment 2, the sample count domain gate
nCountUse := nCount; // 入参计数接管 [个] / take the raw count
IF (nCountUse < DL_TMC_ONE) OR (nCountUse > DL_TMC_NMAX) THEN // 计数越域 / the count is out of the domain
    eErr := 16#0001_0659; // 故障级：有效样本数越域 / fault grade, the effective sample count is out of the domain
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 3｜非有限样本剔除（边界一：除子口径 = 剔除后有效样本数）/ segment 3, drop the non finite samples
FOR k := DL_TMC_ZERO TO nCountUse - DL_TMC_ONE DO // 有界遍历（上界已证 ≤ 256）/ the bounded traversal with a proven ceiling
    IF (afSamples[k] = afSamples[k]) AND ((afSamples[k] - afSamples[k]) = (afSamples[k] - afSamples[k])) THEN // 有限样本 / a finite sample
        aVal[nEff] := afSamples[k]; // 有限样本写入副本 [工程单位] / copy the finite sample
        nEff := nEff + DL_TMC_ONE; // 有效计数推进 [个] / advance the effective count
    ELSE // 非有限样本 / a non finite sample
        nNonFinite := nNonFinite + DL_TMC_ONE; // 剔除计数推进（仅局部留档，不外显）/ advance the dropped count, local only
    END_IF
END_FOR
IF nEff < DL_TMC_ONE THEN // 剔净后无有效样本（与段 2 同码，出口组合不可区分，R90）/ no sample remains after the drop
    eErr := 16#0001_0659; // 故障级：有效样本数越域（此处为剔净后为空）/ fault grade, the effective count is empty after the drop
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 4｜截尾组态闸（边界三，trim 以 nEff 为基准；升位防 USINT 和回绕）/ segment 4, the trim configuration gate
nTrimLo := USINT_TO_DINT(uTrimLo); // 低端截去数升位 [个] / widen the low trim count
nTrimHi := USINT_TO_DINT(uTrimHi); // 高端截去数升位 [个] / widen the high trim count
nTrim := nTrimLo + nTrimHi; // 双端总数（DINT 域无回绕）[个] / the trimmed total in the widened domain
IF nTrim >= nEff THEN // 截尾成空集 / the trim leaves an empty set
    eErr := 16#0001_065A; // 故障级：截尾组态非法 / fault grade, the trim configuration is illegal
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退，除子 nKeep 不可为零 / early return, the divisor can never reach zero
END_IF
nKeep := nEff - nTrim; // 参与均值样本数（除子）[个]，已证 ≥ 1 / the kept count, proven at least one

// 段 5｜委托索引排序（R140；返回值与可用位分承后合取，R295）/ segment 5, the delegated index sort
bSortRet := FC_DL_SortIndexLReal(afValues := aVal, nCount := nEff, aIdx => aIdx, bValid => bSortValid, eErr => uSortErr, bError => bSortErr); // 委托排序：两路各自承接 / delegate the sort into two distinct holders
bSortOk := bSortRet AND bSortValid; // 返回值与可用位合取（IEC 未规定两者的求值次序）/ conjoin the two signals since their evaluation order is unspecified
IF (NOT bSortOk) OR bSortErr THEN // 委托失败 / the delegate failed
    eErr := uSortErr; // 委托码回传（码随属主，R66）/ replay the delegate code
    bError := bSortErr; // 委托故障位回传 / replay the delegate fault bit
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 6｜区间求和（索引区间 [uTrimLo, nEff−1−uTrimHi]；除子 nKeep 已证 ≥ 1，边界五）/ segment 6, the interval sum over the trimmed range
FOR k := nTrimLo TO (nEff - DL_TMC_ONE) - nTrimHi DO // 有界遍历中段区间（区间端点已证合法）/ the bounded traversal over the kept range with proven endpoints
    fSum := fSum + aVal[aIdx[k]]; // 区间样本累加 [工程单位] / accumulate the kept samples
END_FOR
fMeanUse := fSum / DINT_TO_LREAL(nKeep); // 截尾均值 = 和 ÷ 参与数 [工程单位]，除子已证 ≥ 1 / the trimmed mean with the proven divisor

// 段 7｜结果复检兜底（三件套，R258）/ segment 7, the result recheck with the three part fallback
IF (fMeanUse <> fMeanUse) OR ((fMeanUse - fMeanUse) <> (fMeanUse - fMeanUse)) THEN // 结果非有限（理论上不可达，防御保留）/ a non finite result, unreachable by theory, kept as a defence
    fMean := 0.0; // 兜底安全值 [工程单位] / the bottom line safe value
    nEff := DL_TMC_ZERO; // 有效数清零（出口与故障场景同形）/ clear the effective count
    eErr := 16#0001_0659; // 故障级：结果非有限（与样本数越域同族一码，出口组合不可区分，R90）/ fault grade under the same family code
    bError := TRUE; // 置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 8｜统一出口 / segment 8, the unified outlet
fMean := fMeanUse; // 均值出口 [工程单位] / the mean outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
FC_DL_TrimmedMeanCalc := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

FUNCTION FC_DL_PearsonCorrCalc : BOOL
VAR_IN_OUT
    afX : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL; // 通道 X 样本 [工程单位]，只读 / the channel X samples, read only
    afY : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL; // 通道 Y 样本 [工程单位]，只读 / the channel Y samples, read only
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    nCount  : DINT := 0; // 样本对数入参 [对]，合法域 1..256 / the pair count, legal from one to two hundred fifty six
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fCorr   : LREAL := 0.0; // 相关系数 [−]，−1..1 / the correlation coefficient inside the unit interval
    nPairs  : DINT := 0;    // 有效样本对数 [对]（配对剔除后）/ the effective pair count after the paired drop
    bValid  : BOOL := FALSE; // 结果可用 [-] / the result usable flag
    eErr    : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError  : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    aXVal     : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL; // 剔除后 X 有效副本 [工程单位] / the effective copy of channel X
    aYVal     : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL; // 剔除后 Y 有效副本 [工程单位] / the effective copy of channel Y
    k         : DINT := 0;    // 遍历索引 [下标] / the traversal index
    nCountUse : DINT := 0;    // 入参对数接管量 [对] / the raw input count holder
    fSx       : LREAL := 0.0; // Σx 累加量 [工程单位] / the sum of x
    fSy       : LREAL := 0.0; // Σy 累加量 [工程单位] / the sum of y
    fSxx      : LREAL := 0.0; // Σx² 累加量 [工程单位²] / the sum of x squared
    fSyy      : LREAL := 0.0; // Σy² 累加量 [工程单位²] / the sum of y squared
    fSxy      : LREAL := 0.0; // Σxy 累加量 [工程单位²] / the sum of the cross products
    fMx       : LREAL := 0.0; // X 均值 [工程单位] / the mean of x
    fMy       : LREAL := 0.0; // Y 均值 [工程单位] / the mean of y
    fDxx      : LREAL := 0.0; // 中心化离差平方和 Sxx [工程单位²] / the centered sum of squares of x
    fDyy      : LREAL := 0.0; // 中心化离差平方和 Syy [工程单位²] / the centered sum of squares of y
    fDxy      : LREAL := 0.0; // 中心化叉积和 Sxy [工程单位²] / the centered cross product sum
    fDen      : LREAL := 0.0; // 归一化除子 SQRT(Sxx×Syy) [工程单位²] / the normalization divisor
    fCorrUse  : LREAL := 0.0; // 相关系数工作副本 [−] / the working correlation copy
    nPairsUse : DINT := 0;    // 有效对数工作副本 [对] / the working pair count
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_PCC_NMAX  : DINT := 256;       // 样本容量上界 [对]，与数组容量一致 / the capacity aligned with the arrays
    DL_PCC_MIN   : DINT := 3;         // 相关系数可定义最少对数 [对] / the minimum pair count for a defined correlation
    DL_PCC_ONE   : DINT := 1;         // 整型一常量 [对] / the integer one constant
    DL_PCC_ZERO  : DINT := 0;         // 整型零常量 [对] / the integer zero constant
    DL_PCC_DENMIN: LREAL := 1.0E-12;  // 除子防下溢门限 [工程单位⁴] / the divisor underflow threshold
    DL_PCC_ONE_R : LREAL := 1.0;      // 单位一常量 [−]（钳位界）[-] / the unit constant used as the clamp bound
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, the preset of the return and every outlet
FC_DL_PearsonCorrCalc := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
fCorr := 0.0; // 相关系数预置零 [−] / preset the correlation zero
nPairs := DL_PCC_ZERO; // 有效对数预置零 [对] / preset the pair count zero
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the error flag false
nCountUse := DL_PCC_ZERO; // 入参对数接管量预置零 [对] / preset the raw count holder zero
nPairsUse := DL_PCC_ZERO; // 有效对数工作副本预置零 [对] / preset the working pair count zero
fSx := 0.0; // Σx 预置零 [工程单位] / preset the sum of x zero
fSy := 0.0; // Σy 预置零 [工程单位] / preset the sum of y zero
fSxx := 0.0; // Σx² 预置零 [工程单位²] / preset the sum of x squared zero
fSyy := 0.0; // Σy² 预置零 [工程单位²] / preset the sum of y squared zero
fSxy := 0.0; // Σxy 预置零 [工程单位²] / preset the cross sum zero
fMx := 0.0; // X 均值预置零 [工程单位] / preset the mean of x zero
fMy := 0.0; // Y 均值预置零 [工程单位] / preset the mean of y zero
fDxx := 0.0; // Sxx 预置零 [工程单位²] / preset the centered sum of squares zero
fDyy := 0.0; // Syy 预置零 [工程单位²] / preset the centered sum of squares zero
fDxy := 0.0; // Sxy 预置零 [工程单位²] / preset the centered cross sum zero
fDen := 0.0; // 除子预置零 [工程单位²] / preset the divisor zero
fCorrUse := 0.0; // 相关系数工作副本预置零 [−] / preset the working correlation zero
k := DL_PCC_ZERO; // 索引预置零 / preset the index zero

// 段 2｜样本对数域闸（边界八，早退禁除零）/ segment 2, the pair count domain gate
nCountUse := nCount; // 入参对数接管 [对] / take the raw count
IF (nCountUse < DL_PCC_ONE) OR (nCountUse > DL_PCC_NMAX) THEN // 对数越域 / the count is out of the domain
    eErr := 16#0001_065B; // 故障级：样本对数越域 / fault grade, the pair count is out of the domain
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 3｜配对剔除（边界一：任一通道非有限则整对剔除）/ segment 3, the paired drop
FOR k := DL_PCC_ZERO TO nCountUse - DL_PCC_ONE DO // 有界遍历（上界已证 ≤ 256）/ the bounded traversal with a proven ceiling
    IF ((afX[k] = afX[k]) AND ((afX[k] - afX[k]) = (afX[k] - afX[k]))
    AND (afY[k] = afY[k]) AND ((afY[k] - afY[k]) = (afY[k] - afY[k]))) THEN // 整对有限 / the whole pair is finite
        aXVal[nPairsUse] := afX[k]; // X 写入有效副本 [工程单位] / copy the x sample
        aYVal[nPairsUse] := afY[k]; // Y 写入有效副本 [工程单位] / copy the y sample
        nPairsUse := nPairsUse + DL_PCC_ONE; // 有效对数推进 [对] / advance the pair count
    END_IF // 任一通道非有限：整对丢弃（不拆对）/ either channel broken, the whole pair is dropped
END_FOR
nPairs := nPairsUse; // 有效对数出口 [对] / export the pair count
IF nPairsUse < DL_PCC_MIN THEN // 有效对数 ≤ 2：相关系数无定义（边界二）/ too few pairs for a defined correlation
    eErr := 16#0001_065C; // 故障级：有效样本对数不足 / fault grade, the effective pairs are too few
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退，除子段不可达 / early return, the divisor segment is unreachable
END_IF

// 段 4｜单遍累加（nPairs ≥ 3 已证，除子安全，边界四）/ segment 4, the single pass accumulation
FOR k := DL_PCC_ZERO TO nPairsUse - DL_PCC_ONE DO // 有界遍历有效对 / the bounded traversal over the effective pairs
    fSx := fSx + aXVal[k]; // Σx 累加 [工程单位] / accumulate the sum of x
    fSy := fSy + aYVal[k]; // Σy 累加 [工程单位] / accumulate the sum of y
    fSxx := fSxx + (aXVal[k] * aXVal[k]); // Σx² 累加 [工程单位²] / accumulate the sum of squares
    fSyy := fSyy + (aYVal[k] * aYVal[k]); // Σy² 累加 [工程单位²] / accumulate the sum of squares
    fSxy := fSxy + (aXVal[k] * aYVal[k]); // Σxy 累加 [工程单位²] / accumulate the cross products
END_FOR
fMx := fSx / DINT_TO_LREAL(nPairsUse); // X 均值 [工程单位]，除子已证 ≥ 3 / the mean of x with the proven divisor
fMy := fSy / DINT_TO_LREAL(nPairsUse); // Y 均值 [工程单位] / the mean of y
fDxx := fSxx - (DINT_TO_LREAL(nPairsUse) * fMx * fMx); // Sxx = Σx² − n·mx² [工程单位²] / the centered sum of squares of x
fDyy := fSyy - (DINT_TO_LREAL(nPairsUse) * fMy * fMy); // Syy = Σy² − n·my² [工程单位²] / the centered sum of squares of y
fDxy := fSxy - (DINT_TO_LREAL(nPairsUse) * fMx * fMy); // Sxy = Σxy − n·mx·my [工程单位²] / the centered cross product sum

// 段 5｜常量通道退化与除子防下溢闸（边界三，禁除零）/ segment 5, the constant channel and the underflow gate
IF (fDxx <= 0.0) OR (fDyy <= 0.0) OR (ABS(fDxx * fDyy) < DL_PCC_DENMIN) THEN // 常量通道或乘积下溢 / a constant channel or an underflowing product
    fCorr := 0.0; // 兜底安全值 [−] / the bottom line safe value
    eErr := 16#0001_065D; // 故障级：常量通道退化 / fault grade, a constant channel degeneration
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退，除法不可达 / early return, the division is unreachable
END_IF

// 段 6｜相关系数计算（除子已证 > 0 且 ≥ 下溢门限）/ segment 6, the correlation computation
fDen := SQRT(fDxx * fDyy); // 归一化除子 [工程单位²]，已证有限且非零 / the normalization divisor proven finite and nonzero
fCorrUse := fDxy / fDen; // 皮尔逊相关系数 [−] / the Pearson correlation coefficient

// 段 7｜|r| > 1 钳位（浮点数值误差，信息级 065E，不置 bError）/ segment 7, the unit interval clamp with an informational code
IF ABS(fCorrUse) > DL_PCC_ONE_R THEN // 数值误差越单位圆 / a numerical overshoot beyond the unit circle
    IF fCorrUse > 0.0 THEN // 正向越界 / a positive overshoot
        fCorrUse := DL_PCC_ONE_R; // 钳回 +1 [−] / clamp to plus one
    ELSE // 负向越界 / a negative overshoot
        fCorrUse := -DL_PCC_ONE_R; // 钳回 −1 [−] / clamp to minus one
    END_IF
    eErr := 16#0001_065E; // 信息级：|r| 越界已钳回（不置 bError，R285）/ informational, the coefficient was clamped
END_IF

// 段 8｜结果复检兜底（三件套，R258）/ segment 8, the result recheck with the three part fallback
IF (fCorrUse <> fCorrUse) OR ((fCorrUse - fCorrUse) <> (fCorrUse - fCorrUse)) THEN // 结果非有限（理论上不可达，防御保留）/ a non finite result, unreachable by theory, kept as a defence
    fCorr := 0.0; // 兜底安全值 [−] / the bottom line safe value
    eErr := 16#0001_065D; // 故障级：常量通道退化（同族一码，出口组合不可区分，R90）/ fault grade under the same family code
    bError := TRUE; // 置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 9｜统一出口 / segment 9, the unified outlet
fCorr := fCorrUse; // 相关系数出口 [−] / the correlation outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
FC_DL_PearsonCorrCalc := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

  分工声明 Split     : FB_DL_NotchFilter（陷波一体机：内算内滤）/ FB_DL_SecondOrder

  归属 Ownership     : E_DL_BiquadType 属主为本文件（全库唯一定义，R264）；引用件

TYPE E_DL_BiquadType :
(
    eLowPass  := 0, // 低通：通带以下通过，截止频率以上衰减 / the low pass type passing below the cutoff
    eHighPass := 1, // 高通：截止频率以上通过，以下衰减 / the high pass type passing above the cutoff
    eBandPass := 2, // 带通：中心频率附近通过（0 dB 峰值增益口径）/ the band pass type passing around the center with a zero dB peak gain
    eNotch    := 3  // 陷波：中心频率处深衰减（挖槽）/ the notch type with a deep attenuation at the center
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION FC_DL_BiquadCoeff : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    eType   : E_DL_BiquadType := E_DL_BiquadType.eLowPass; // 滤波器类型 [-] / the filter type
    fFs     : LREAL := 1000.0; // 采样频率 [赫兹]，须 > 0 / the sampling frequency, must be positive
    fF0     : LREAL := 100.0;  // 中心 / 截止频率 [赫兹]，0 < fF0 < 0.45×fFs / the center or cutoff frequency below the Nyquist guard
    fQ      : LREAL := 0.7071; // 品质因数 [−]，域 [0.1, 20.0] / the quality factor inside its domain
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fB0     : LREAL := 0.0; // 归一化前向系数 b0 [−]，a0 = 1 口径 / the normalized feed forward coefficient b0
    fB1     : LREAL := 0.0; // 归一化前向系数 b1 [−] / the normalized feed forward coefficient b1
    fB2     : LREAL := 0.0; // 归一化前向系数 b2 [−] / the normalized feed forward coefficient b2
    fA1     : LREAL := 0.0; // 归一化反馈系数 a1 [−] / the normalized feedback coefficient a1
    fA2     : LREAL := 0.0; // 归一化反馈系数 a2 [−] / the normalized feedback coefficient a2
    bValid  : BOOL := FALSE; // 结果可用 [-] / the result usable flag
    eErr    : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError  : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    fW0     : LREAL := 0.0; // 数字角频率 w0 = 2π·f0/Fs [弧度] / the digital angular frequency
    fCosW0  : LREAL := 0.0; // cos(w0) 中间量 [−] / the cosine intermediate
    fSinW0  : LREAL := 0.0; // sin(w0) 中间量 [−] / the sine intermediate
    fAlpha  : LREAL := 0.0; // 阻尼因子 alpha = sin(w0)/(2Q) [−]，除子 2Q 已证 > 0 / the damping factor with the proven divisor
    fA0     : LREAL := 0.0; // 归一化前分母 a0 = 1 + alpha [−] / the pre normalization denominator
    fB0Raw  : LREAL := 0.0; // 未归一化 b0 暂存 [−] / the raw b0 in staging
    fB1Raw  : LREAL := 0.0; // 未归一化 b1 暂存 [−] / the raw b1 in staging
    fB2Raw  : LREAL := 0.0; // 未归一化 b2 暂存 [−] / the raw b2 in staging
    fA1Raw  : LREAL := 0.0; // 未归一化 a1 暂存 [−] / the raw a1 in staging
    fA2Raw  : LREAL := 0.0; // 未归一化 a2 暂存 [−] / the raw a2 in staging
    fNyq    : LREAL := 0.0; // 奈奎斯特闸限 0.45×fFs [赫兹] / the Nyquist guard value
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_BQC_2PI   : LREAL := 6.283185307179586; // 2π 常量（LREAL 精度字面量，R55）/ the two pi constant at LREAL precision
    DL_BQC_NYQ   : LREAL := 0.45;   // 奈奎斯特闸系数 [−]（0.45×fFs）/ the Nyquist guard fraction
    DL_BQC_QMIN  : LREAL := 0.1;    // 品质因数下界 [−] / the quality factor floor
    DL_BQC_QMAX  : LREAL := 20.0;   // 品质因数上界 [−] / the quality factor ceiling
    DL_BQC_DENEPS: LREAL := 1.0E-9; // 归一化分母近零门限 [−] / the near zero denominator threshold
    DL_BQC_TWO   : LREAL := 2.0;    // 实数二常量 [−]（阻尼因子除子）/ the real two constant
    DL_BQC_ZERO  : LREAL := 0.0;    // 实数零常量 [−] / the real zero constant
    DL_BQC_ONE   : LREAL := 1.0;    // 实数一常量 [−] / the real one constant
    DL_BQC_HALF  : LREAL := 0.5;    // 实数半常量 [−] / the real half constant
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段：五系数全 0）/ segment 1, the preset of the return and every outlet
FC_DL_BiquadCoeff := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
fB0 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 系数 b0 预置零 [−] / preset the coefficient b0 zero
fB1 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 系数 b1 预置零 [−] / preset the coefficient b1 zero
fB2 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 系数 b2 预置零 [−] / preset the coefficient b2 zero
fA1 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 系数 a1 预置零 [−] / preset the coefficient a1 zero
fA2 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 系数 a2 预置零 [−] / preset the coefficient a2 zero
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the error flag false
fW0 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 角频率预置零 [弧度] / preset the angular frequency zero
fCosW0 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 余弦预置零 [−] / preset the cosine zero
fSinW0 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 正弦预置零 [−] / preset the sine zero
fAlpha := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 阻尼因子预置零 [−] / preset the damping zero
fA0 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 分母预置零 [−] / preset the denominator zero
fB0Raw := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 原始 b0 预置零 [−] / preset the raw b0 zero
fB1Raw := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 原始 b1 预置零 [−] / preset the raw b1 zero
fB2Raw := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 原始 b2 预置零 [−] / preset the raw b2 zero
fA1Raw := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 原始 a1 预置零 [−] / preset the raw a1 zero
fA2Raw := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 原始 a2 预置零 [−] / preset the raw a2 zero
fNyq := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 奈奎斯特闸限预置零 [赫兹] / preset the Nyquist guard zero

// 段 2｜域闸全量枚举（边界一，R272：fFs / fF0 / fQ 逐个点名 + 非有限双判）/ segment 2, the full domain gate naming every real pin
fNyq := DL_BQC_NYQ * fFs; // 奈奎斯特闸限（fFs 非有限时乘积亦非有限，闸随后命中）[赫兹] / the Nyquist guard, a non finite sampling frequency lands non finite and the gate catches it
IF (fFs <> fFs) OR ((fFs - fFs) <> (fFs - fFs)) OR (fFs <= DL_BQC_ZERO)
OR (fF0 <> fF0) OR ((fF0 - fF0) <> (fF0 - fF0)) OR (fF0 <= DL_BQC_ZERO) OR (fF0 >= fNyq)
OR (fQ <> fQ) OR ((fQ - fQ) <> (fQ - fQ)) OR (fQ < DL_BQC_QMIN) OR (fQ > DL_BQC_QMAX) THEN // 域闸失败 / a domain gate failure
    eErr := 16#0002_373D; // 故障级：域闸失败 / fault grade, a domain gate failure
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 结构早退：五系数已预置全 0，计算段不可达 / the structural early exit with all five coefficients preset to zero
END_IF

// 段 3｜中间量计算（除子 fFs 已证 > 0、2Q 已证 > 0.2）/ segment 3, the intermediates
fW0 := (DL_BQC_2PI * fF0) / fFs; // 数字角频率 [弧度]，除子已证 > 0 / the angular frequency with the proven divisor
fCosW0 := COS(fW0); // cos(w0) [−] / the cosine
fSinW0 := SIN(fW0); // sin(w0) [−] / the sine
fAlpha := fSinW0 / (DL_BQC_TWO * fQ); // 阻尼因子 [−]，除子已证 > 0 / the damping factor with the proven divisor
fA0 := DL_BQC_ONE + fAlpha; // 归一化前分母 [−]，结构性 > 1（边界三证明）/ the pre normalization denominator structurally above one

// 段 4｜四型未归一化系数（CASE 必带 ELSE 兜底，边界二）/ segment 4, the four raw coefficient families
CASE eType OF
    E_DL_BiquadType.eLowPass: // 低通 / the low pass family
        fB0Raw := (DL_BQC_ONE - fCosW0) * DL_BQC_HALF; // b0 = (1−cos w0)/2 [−] / the raw b0
        fB1Raw := DL_BQC_ONE - fCosW0; // b1 = 1−cos w0 [−] / the raw b1
        fB2Raw := (DL_BQC_ONE - fCosW0) * DL_BQC_HALF; // b2 = (1−cos w0)/2 [−] / the raw b2
        fA1Raw := -DL_BQC_TWO * fCosW0; // a1 = −2·cos w0 [−] / the raw a1
        fA2Raw := DL_BQC_ONE - fAlpha; // a2 = 1−alpha [−] / the raw a2
    E_DL_BiquadType.eHighPass: // 高通 / the high pass family
        fB0Raw := (DL_BQC_ONE + fCosW0) * DL_BQC_HALF; // b0 = (1+cos w0)/2 [−] / the raw b0
        fB1Raw := -(DL_BQC_ONE + fCosW0); // b1 = −(1+cos w0) [−] / the raw b1
        fB2Raw := (DL_BQC_ONE + fCosW0) * DL_BQC_HALF; // b2 = (1+cos w0)/2 [−] / the raw b2
        fA1Raw := -DL_BQC_TWO * fCosW0; // a1 = −2·cos w0 [−] / the raw a1
        fA2Raw := DL_BQC_ONE - fAlpha; // a2 = 1−alpha [−] / the raw a2
    E_DL_BiquadType.eBandPass: // 带通（0 dB 峰值增益口径）/ the band pass family
        fB0Raw := fAlpha; // b0 = alpha [−] / the raw b0
        fB1Raw := DL_BQC_ZERO; // b1 = 0 [−] / the raw b1
        fB2Raw := -fAlpha; // b2 = −alpha [−] / the raw b2
        fA1Raw := -DL_BQC_TWO * fCosW0; // a1 = −2·cos w0 [−] / the raw a1
        fA2Raw := DL_BQC_ONE - fAlpha; // a2 = 1−alpha [−] / the raw a2
    E_DL_BiquadType.eNotch: // 陷波 / the notch family
        fB0Raw := DL_BQC_ONE; // b0 = 1 [−] / the raw b0
        fB1Raw := -DL_BQC_TWO * fCosW0; // b1 = −2·cos w0 [−] / the raw b1
        fB2Raw := DL_BQC_ONE; // b2 = 1 [−] / the raw b2
        fA1Raw := -DL_BQC_TWO * fCosW0; // a1 = −2·cos w0 [−] / the raw a1
        fA2Raw := DL_BQC_ONE - fAlpha; // a2 = 1−alpha [−] / the raw a2
    ELSE // 枚举非法：落 373D 同码（反证句见码表，出口与域闸失败同形）/ an illegal enumeration under the same code
        eErr := 16#0002_373D; // 故障级：类型枚举非法（归入域闸族）/ fault grade, the type enumeration is illegal in the gate family
        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
        RETURN; // 早退，五系数保持预置全 0 / early return with the preset zeros
END_CASE

// 段 5｜归一化除子闸与系数归一（边界三，禁除零）/ segment 5, the normalization with the denominator guard
IF ABS(fA0) < DL_BQC_DENEPS THEN // 分母近零（理论不可达的平台数值兜底）/ a near zero denominator, a platform numerical fallback
    eErr := 16#0002_373E; // 故障级：归一化分母近零 / fault grade, the normalization denominator is near zero
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退，五系数保持全 0 / early return with the zeros
END_IF
fB0 := fB0Raw / fA0; // 归一化 b0 [−]，除子已证 ≥ 门限 / the normalized b0
fB1 := fB1Raw / fA0; // 归一化 b1 [−] / the normalized b1
fB2 := fB2Raw / fA0; // 归一化 b2 [−] / the normalized b2
fA1 := fA1Raw / fA0; // 归一化 a1 [−] / the normalized a1
fA2 := fA2Raw / fA0; // 归一化 a2 [−] / the normalized a2

// 段 6｜结果复检兜底（三件套，R258；与 373E 同码，反证见码表）/ segment 6, the result recheck with the three part fallback
IF (fB0 <> fB0) OR ((fB0 - fB0) <> (fB0 - fB0))
OR (fB1 <> fB1) OR ((fB1 - fB1) <> (fB1 - fB1))
OR (fB2 <> fB2) OR ((fB2 - fB2) <> (fB2 - fB2))
OR (fA1 <> fA1) OR ((fA1 - fA1) <> (fA1 - fA1))
OR (fA2 <> fA2) OR ((fA2 - fA2) <> (fA2 - fA2)) THEN // 任一系数非有限（理论上不可达，防御保留）/ any non finite coefficient, unreachable by theory
    fB0 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 系数 b0 兜底归零 [−] / the bottom line zero
    fB1 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 系数 b1 兜底归零 [−] / the bottom line zero
    fB2 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 系数 b2 兜底归零 [−] / the bottom line zero
    fA1 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 系数 a1 兜底归零 [−] / the bottom line zero
    fA2 := DL_BQC_ZERO; // 系数 a2 兜底归零 [−] / the bottom line zero
    eErr := 16#0002_373E; // 故障级：结果非有限（同族一码）/ fault grade under the same family code
    bError := TRUE; // 置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 7｜统一出口 / segment 7, the unified outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
FC_DL_BiquadCoeff := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

                      一 委托双承接（R295）：两次排序委托的返回值与 bValid 均由独立
                         变量承接后合取；委托码随属主回传（R66）；
                      二 窗长固定容量 64（禁动态分配）；nWinLen 越域钳位 + 信息级
                         3740，变更沿全窗清零（防新旧窗样本混算）；
                      三 判据 ABS(fIn − fMedian) > fNSigma × fSigmaHat + 1.0E-9 →
                         野点：不入窗、fOut 保持上次有效、bHold = TRUE、nReject + 1；
                      四 真阶跃处置（写死）：连续剔除计数 _nRejectRun ≥ nWinLen/2 →
                         判「真实阶跃」，清窗 + fIn 入窗直通 + 信息级 3741（禁死锁）；
                      五 tHoldMax 到时仍保持 → 故障级 3742 + bValid = FALSE（测点
                         疑似坏）；tonHold 段 0 无条件刷新，IN 串组态闸与保持态
                         （FB50-1 监视门控）；故障码逐拍重算不锁存（无 bReset 引脚，
                         R152 解除路径自证 = 修正组态 / 测点恢复入窗，恒可达）；
                      六 非有限 fIn → 视同野点丢弃（计数单列局部 nNonFinite，
                         不外显，不推进 _nRejectRun——测点坏与真阶跃不混淆）；
                      七 fNSigma 域闸 (0, 10] 且 tHoldMax > T#0S：非法 → 组态码
                         373F + 三件套 + RETURN 结构早退；
                      八 bEnable = FALSE 的语义写死（FB33-4 声明行）：输出冻结 +
                         窗保留（纯监视件），bHold 复位；
                      九 首拍 _bInit 全量初始化 + 首样本直通；中值 / MAD 为序不变量，
                         环形窗活样本恒为下标 0.._nFill−1（写头仅在达 _nUse 时回卷）；
                      十 无全局、无外部变量、无物理地址、无指针。
  错误码 Codes      :
    16#0002_373F【故障级】组态非法（fNSigma ≤ 0 / > 10 / 非有限，或 tHoldMax ≤ 0）
    16#0002_3740【信息级】nWinLen 越域已钳位（合法 4..64，不置 bError）
    16#0002_3741【信息级】真阶跃重基线触发（连续剔除达窗长一半，不置 bError）
    16#0002_3742【故障级】野点保持超 tHoldMax，测点疑似坏（bValid = FALSE）
  码位反证 Note     :
    373F / 3742 不可合并：373F 与窗内容无关（组态即刻判），3742 需窗已建立且持续
    保持，处置人不同（组态工程师 / 仪表工），可由 bHold 与窗状态还原（R90）；
    3740 / 3741 为信息级与故障级分属不同子带（R75 子带纪律），不可跨用。
  验收 Acceptance   :
    算法已证（脚本）：未跑 ｜ 编译器已证（三平台）：未跑
    V1 平稳序列 + 单点尖峰（10×σ）→ 剔除、fOut 保持、bHold 单拍
    V2 尖峰后立即回落 → 窗无污染；V3 真阶跃 → 连续剔除达窗长/2 后重基线直通 + 3741
    V4 fNSigma = 0 → 码 373F 早退；V5 保持超 tHoldMax → 3742 + bValid = FALSE
    V6 nWinLen = 3 → 钳 4 + 3740；V7 nWinLen 变更沿清窗；V8 首拍直通
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R63 首版（批 2 · 序号 7）
  ==================================================================
*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_OutlierFilter
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable  : BOOL := TRUE;   // 使能，FALSE 时输出冻结 + 窗保留（边界八）/ the enable, false freezes the output and keeps the window
    fIn      : LREAL := 0.0;   // 输入量 [工程单位]，必须有限 / the input value, must be finite
    nWinLen  : DINT := 16;     // 窗长 [个]，合法域 4..64，变更沿清窗 / the window length, legal four to sixty four, a change clears the window
    fNSigma  : LREAL := 4.0;   // MAD 倍数 [−]，域 (0, 10] / the MAD multiple inside the half open domain
    tHoldMax : TIME := T#5S;   // 野点连续保持上限 [毫秒]，超时判测点坏 / the hold ceiling before the point is declared broken
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fOut     : LREAL := 0.0;            // 滤波输出 [工程单位] / the filtered output
    nReject  : UDINT := 0;             // 累计剔除计数 [个] / the accumulated reject count
    bHold    : BOOL := FALSE;          // 本拍处于保持态 [-] / the hold state of this scan
    bValid   : BOOL := FALSE;          // 输出可用 [-] / the output is usable
    eErr     : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError   : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit     : BOOL := FALSE;               // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _bHasSamp  : BOOL := FALSE;               // 已收首样本标志（首拍直通用）/ the first sample received flag
    _afWin     : ARRAY[0..63] OF LREAL;       // 采样环形窗 [工程单位]，固定容量 64 / the fixed capacity ring of samples
    _afSort    : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL;      // 中值排序工作数组 [工程单位] / the median sort work array
    _afDev     : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL;      // MAD 偏差序列工作数组 [工程单位] / the MAD deviation work array
    _aIdxM     : ARRAY[0..255] OF DINT;       // 中值排序索引承接 [下标] / the median sort index holder
    _aIdxD     : ARRAY[0..255] OF DINT;       // MAD 排序索引承接 [下标] / the MAD sort index holder
    _nHead     : DINT := 0;                   // 环形窗写头 [下标] / the ring write head
    _nFill     : DINT := 0;                   // 环形窗填充计数 [个] / the ring filled count
    _nUse      : DINT := 16;                  // 钳位后的窗长 [个] / the clamped window length
    _nUsePrev  : DINT := 0;                   // 上拍窗长快照 [个]，置 0 使首拍必触发清窗 / the previous length, zero forces one clear
    _nClrIdx   : DINT := 0;                   // 清窗遍历索引 [下标] / the clearing traversal index
    _nCopyIdx  : DINT := 0;                   // 拷贝遍历索引 [下标] / the copying traversal index
    _nMidIdx   : DINT := 0;                   // 中值下标 [下标] / the median index
    _nRejectRun: DINT := 0;                   // 连续剔除计数 [个]（真阶跃判据）/ the consecutive reject count for the step test
    _nNonFinite: DINT := 0;                   // 非有限丢弃计数 [个]（仅局部留档，不外显，R62-D7 口径）/ the dropped non finite count, local only and never exposed
    _fMedian   : LREAL := 0.0;                // 窗内中值 [工程单位] / the window median
    _fMad      : LREAL := 0.0;                // 绝对偏差中值 [工程单位] / the median absolute deviation
    _fSigmaHat : LREAL := 0.0;                // 稳健标准差估计 [工程单位] / the robust sigma estimate
    _fDev      : LREAL := 0.0;                // 本拍样本绝对偏差 [工程单位] / the absolute deviation of this scan
    _fOutLast  : LREAL := 0.0;                // 最近一次有效输出（保持源）[工程单位] / the last valid output used while holding
    _bHoldActive : BOOL := FALSE;             // 保持态寄存器（跨拍保持，tonHold 驱动源）/ the hold state register driving the timer
    _bCfgBad   : BOOL := FALSE;               // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    _bWinClamp : BOOL := FALSE;               // 窗长钳位标记（逐拍重算，信息级 3740）/ the window clamp flag
    _bStepReb  : BOOL := FALSE;               // 真阶跃重基线标记（逐拍重算，信息级 3741）/ the step rebuild flag
    _bHoldOut  : BOOL := FALSE;               // 本拍保持出口位（统一出口映射）/ the hold outlet bit of this scan
    _bRejectI  : BOOL := FALSE;               // 本拍拒绝内部位 / the internal reject bit of this scan
    _bFinIn    : BOOL := FALSE;               // 输入有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the input finiteness gate result
    _bFinSig   : BOOL := FALSE;               // fNSigma 有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the sigma pin finiteness gate result
    _bSortRet  : BOOL := FALSE;               // 中值委托返回值承接量（独立承接，R295）/ the median delegate return holder
    _bSortValid: BOOL := FALSE;               // 中值委托可用位承接量 / the median delegate valid holder
    _bSortRet2 : BOOL := FALSE;               // MAD 委托返回值承接量（独立承接，R295）/ the MAD delegate return holder
    _bSortValid2: BOOL := FALSE;              // MAD 委托可用位承接量 / the MAD delegate valid holder
    _uSortErr  : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;       // 中值委托码承接量 [码] / the median delegate code holder
    _uSortErr2 : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;       // MAD 委托码承接量 [码] / the MAD delegate code holder
    _bSortErr  : BOOL := FALSE;               // 中值委托故障位承接量 / the median delegate fault holder
    _bSortErr2 : BOOL := FALSE;               // MAD 委托故障位承接量 / the MAD delegate fault holder
    tonHold    : TON;                         // 保持超时定时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the hold timeout timer refreshed unconditionally
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_OF_WMAX  : DINT := 64;       // 窗容量上界 [个]，与数组容量一致 / the window capacity aligned with the array
    DL_OF_WMIN  : DINT := 4;        // 窗长下界 [个] / the window floor
    DL_OF_NSIGMAX : LREAL := 10.0;  // MAD 倍数上界 [−] / the MAD multiple ceiling
    DL_OF_NSIGZERO: LREAL := 0.0;   // MAD 倍数零常量 [−] / the MAD multiple zero constant
    DL_OF_MADK    : LREAL := 1.4826; // MAD 正态一致性因子 [−] / the MAD normal consistency factor
    DL_OF_EPS     : LREAL := 1.0E-9; // 判据容差 [工程单位] / the criterion tolerance
    DL_OF_STEPDIV : LREAL := 2.0;   // 真阶跃判据除子 [−]（窗长一半）/ the step criterion divisor of one half
    DL_OF_ZERO    : LREAL := 0.0;   // 实数零常量 [工程单位] / the real zero constant
    DL_OF_ONE     : DINT := 1;      // 整型一常量 [个] / the integer one constant
    DL_OF_TWO     : DINT := 2;      // 整型二常量 [个]（中值判据最少样本）/ the integer two constant, the minimum for a median
    DL_OF_ZEROI   : DINT := 0;      // 整型零常量 [个] / the integer zero constant
    DL_OF_TIME0   : TIME := T#0S;   // 时间零常量 [毫秒] / the time zero constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜组态闸先行 + 定时器无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7；监视 TON 串组态闸，FB50-1）/ segment 0, the configuration gate first and the unconditional timer refresh
_bFinSig := (fNSigma = fNSigma) AND ((fNSigma - fNSigma) = (fNSigma - fNSigma)); // fNSigma 有限 / the sigma pin is finite
_bCfgBad := (NOT _bFinSig) OR (fNSigma <= DL_OF_NSIGZERO) OR (fNSigma > DL_OF_NSIGMAX) OR (tHoldMax <= DL_OF_TIME0); // 组态非法（MAD 倍数域外或保持上限非正）/ an illegal configuration
tonHold(IN := _bHoldActive AND (NOT _bCfgBad), PT := tHoldMax); // 保持超时计时（串组态闸，防复位同拍重锁，FB50-1）/ the hold timeout with the configuration gate in series

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与窗长接管预派生（FB50-2）/ segment 1, the first scan init
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bHasSamp := FALSE; // 首样本标志显式清零（触发直通）/ clear the first sample flag so the pass through triggers
    _nFill := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 填充计数显式清零 / clear the filled count explicitly
    _nHead := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 写头显式清零 / clear the write head explicitly
    _nUsePrev := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 窗长快照置 0，使段 2 变更沿必然触发一次清窗 / zero the snapshot so the change edge clears the window once
    _nRejectRun := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 连续剔除计数显式清零 / clear the consecutive reject count explicitly
    _nNonFinite := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 非有限计数显式清零 / clear the non finite count explicitly
    _bHoldActive := FALSE; // 保持态显式清零 / clear the hold state explicitly
    _fOutLast := DL_OF_ZERO; // 最近有效输出显式清零 / clear the last valid output explicitly
    FOR _nClrIdx := DL_OF_ZEROI TO DL_OF_WMAX - DL_OF_ONE DO // 有界遍历全容量 / the bounded traversal over the full capacity
        _afWin[_nClrIdx] := DL_OF_ZERO; // 窗元素逐项清零 / zero every window element
    END_FOR
END_IF

// 段 2｜窗长钳位与变更沿全窗清零（边界二）/ segment 2, the window length clamp and the full clear
_bWinClamp := FALSE; // 钳位标记预清零（单拍信息位，段 8 统一映射）/ preset the clamp flag false
_bStepReb := FALSE; // 重基线标记预清零（单拍信息位）/ preset the rebuild flag false
_bHoldOut := FALSE; // 保持出口位预清零（单拍信息位，R256 统一出口预置）/ preset the hold outlet bit false
_bRejectI := FALSE; // 拒绝内部位预清零（单拍位）/ preset the reject bit false
_nUse := nWinLen; // 窗长接管 [个] / take the window length
IF (_nUse < DL_OF_WMIN) OR (_nUse > DL_OF_WMAX) THEN // 窗长越域 / the length is out of the domain
    _bWinClamp := TRUE; // 置钳位标记（信息级 3740）/ raise the clamp flag
    IF _nUse < DL_OF_WMIN THEN // 下界钳位 / the floor clamp
        _nUse := DL_OF_WMIN; // 钳到下界 [个] / clamp to the floor
    ELSE // 上界钳位 / the ceiling clamp
        _nUse := DL_OF_WMAX; // 钳到容量 [个] / clamp to the capacity
    END_IF
END_IF
IF _nUse <> _nUsePrev THEN // 窗长变更沿（含首拍）/ the length change edge, the first scan included
    _nHead := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 写头回零 / reset the write head
    _nFill := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 填充计数回零 / reset the filled count
    _nRejectRun := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 连续剔除计数回零 / reset the consecutive reject count
    _bHasSamp := FALSE; // 窗已清，首样本语义复位 / the window is cleared, the first sample semantics reset
    FOR _nClrIdx := DL_OF_ZEROI TO DL_OF_WMAX - DL_OF_ONE DO // 有界遍历全容量 / the bounded traversal over the full capacity
        _afWin[_nClrIdx] := DL_OF_ZERO; // 窗元素逐项清零（禁陈旧样本混算）/ zero every window element so no stale sample mixes in
    END_FOR
    _nUsePrev := _nUse; // 快照本拍窗长 / snapshot the length
END_IF

// 段 3｜失能分支：输出冻结 + 窗保留（边界八声明行）/ segment 3, the disabled branch freezes the output
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    fOut := _fOutLast; // 冻结最后有效输出 [工程单位] / freeze the last valid output
    bHold := FALSE; // 保持态复位 / the hold state resets
    bValid := FALSE; // 失能即不可用 / the output is not usable while disabled
    bError := FALSE; // 失能不是故障 / a disabled device is not a fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 失能不发码 / no code is emitted while disabled
    _bHoldActive := FALSE; // 保持态寄存器复位（tonHold 断输入）/ clear the hold state register
    RETURN; // 早退，窗保留；nReject 为累计量按 R187 不清零（保持语义由本注释表达，禁自赋值行）/ early return with the window kept, the accumulated reject count is kept per the pulse discipline, expressed by this comment without a dead statement
END_IF

// 段 4｜组态非法结构早退（边界七，出口三件套 + RETURN）/ segment 4, the structural early exit on an illegal configuration
IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态非法 / an illegal configuration
    fOut := _fOutLast; // 输出保持最近有效值 [工程单位] / keep the last valid output
    bHold := FALSE; // 保持态复位 / the hold state resets
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    eErr := 16#0002_373F; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, an illegal configuration
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    _bHoldActive := FALSE; // 保持态寄存器复位 / clear the hold state register
    RETURN; // 早退，判据段不可达 / early return, the criterion segment is unreachable
END_IF

// 段 5｜输入有限闸（边界六）/ segment 5, the input finiteness gate
_bFinIn := (fIn = fIn) AND ((fIn - fIn) = (fIn - fIn)); // 输入有限 / the input is finite
IF NOT _bHasSamp THEN // 首样本直通（边界十）/ the first sample passes straight through
    _afWin[_nHead] := fIn; // 首样本入窗 [工程单位] / the first sample enters the window
    _nHead := _nHead + DL_OF_ONE; // 写头推进 / advance the head
    IF _nHead >= _nUse THEN // 回卷 / wrap
        _nHead := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 写头回零 / reset the head
    END_IF
    _nFill := _nFill + DL_OF_ONE; // 填充计数推进 [个] / advance the filled count
    fOut := fIn; // 首拍直通 [工程单位] / the first scan passes straight through
    _fOutLast := fIn; // 有效输出快照 [工程单位] / snapshot the valid output
    _bHasSamp := TRUE; // 置首样本标志 / raise the first sample flag
    bHold := FALSE; // 无保持 / no hold
    bValid := TRUE; // 输出可用 / the output is usable
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 6｜非有限输入：视同野点丢弃（边界六，计数单列，不推进连续剔除计数）/ segment 6, a non finite input is dropped like an outlier
IF NOT _bFinIn THEN // 输入坏 / the input is broken
    _nNonFinite := _nNonFinite + DL_OF_ONE; // 非有限计数推进（仅局部留档）/ advance the non finite count, local only
    _bHoldActive := TRUE; // 置保持态（tonHold 持续计时）/ raise the hold state
    fOut := _fOutLast; // 输出保持 [工程单位] / keep the output
    bHold := TRUE; // 保持出口位 / the hold outlet
    bValid := TRUE; // 保持值本身可用（未超时前）/ the held value is still usable before the timeout
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 信息级不占故障位 / no fault code for a single drop
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 7｜中值与 MAD 计算（两次委托，双承接 R295；活样本恒为 0.._nFill−1，边界九）/ segment 7, the median and the MAD via two delegates
IF _nFill >= DL_OF_TWO THEN // 窗内至少两样本才建判据（单样本无离散度语义）/ the criterion needs at least two samples
    FOR _nCopyIdx := DL_OF_ZEROI TO _nFill - DL_OF_ONE DO // 有界遍历活样本（上界已证 ≤ 64）/ the bounded traversal over the live samples
        _afSort[_nCopyIdx] := _afWin[_nCopyIdx]; // 拷贝到排序工作数组 [工程单位] / copy into the sort work array
    END_FOR
    _bSortRet := FC_DL_SortIndexLReal(afValues := _afSort, nCount := _nFill, aIdx => _aIdxM, bValid => _bSortValid, eErr => _uSortErr, bError => _bSortErr); // 中值排序委托 / delegate the median sort
    _nMidIdx := (_nFill - DL_OF_ONE) / DL_OF_TWO; // 中值下标（偶数窗取下中值）[下标] / the median index, the lower median for an even window
    _fMedian := _afSort[_aIdxM[_nMidIdx]]; // 窗内中值 [工程单位] / the window median
    FOR _nCopyIdx := DL_OF_ZEROI TO _nFill - DL_OF_ONE DO // 有界遍历活样本 / the bounded traversal over the live samples
        _afDev[_nCopyIdx] := ABS(_afWin[_nCopyIdx] - _fMedian); // 绝对偏差序列 [工程单位] / the absolute deviation series
    END_FOR
    _bSortRet2 := FC_DL_SortIndexLReal(afValues := _afDev, nCount := _nFill, aIdx => _aIdxD, bValid => _bSortValid2, eErr => _uSortErr2, bError => _bSortErr2); // MAD 排序委托（双承接）/ delegate the MAD sort with the dual catch
    _fMad := _afDev[_aIdxD[_nMidIdx]]; // 绝对偏差中值 [工程单位] / the median absolute deviation
    _fSigmaHat := _fMad * DL_OF_MADK; // 稳健标准差估计 [工程单位] / the robust sigma estimate
    IF (NOT (_bSortRet AND _bSortValid)) OR _bSortErr OR (NOT (_bSortRet2 AND _bSortValid2)) OR _bSortErr2 THEN // 任一委托失败（双承接合取，R295）/ either delegate failed under the dual catch
        fOut := _fOutLast; // 输出保持 [工程单位] / keep the output
        bHold := FALSE; // 保持态不置（委托失败非野点）/ the hold is not raised, a delegate failure is not an outlier
        bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
        eErr := _uSortErr; // 委托码回传（码随属主，R66）/ replay the delegate code
        bError := _bSortErr OR _bSortErr2; // 委托故障位回传 / replay the delegate fault bits
        RETURN; // 早退 / early return
    END_IF
ELSE // 窗内样本不足：判据挂起，直接接受本拍样本 / too few samples, the criterion suspends and the sample is accepted
    _fMedian := _afWin[DL_OF_ZEROI]; // 中值占位（不参与判据）[工程单位] / a placeholder median, not used by the criterion
    _fSigmaHat := DL_OF_ZERO; // 离散度占位零 [工程单位] / a placeholder sigma of zero
END_IF

// 段 8｜野点判据与真阶跃处置（边界三四；本拍接受语义优先于超时迁移，R275）/ segment 8, the outlier criterion and the true step handling
_fDev := ABS(fIn - _fMedian); // 本拍绝对偏差 [工程单位] / the absolute deviation of this scan
IF _nFill >= DL_OF_TWO THEN // 判据已建立才比较 / the comparison runs only with a built criterion
    IF _fDev > (fNSigma * _fSigmaHat) + DL_OF_EPS THEN // 超出 MAD 带外：疑似野点 / beyond the MAD band, a suspected outlier
        _nRejectRun := _nRejectRun + DL_OF_ONE; // 连续剔除计数推进 [个] / advance the consecutive reject count
        IF DINT_TO_LREAL(_nRejectRun) >= (DINT_TO_LREAL(_nUse) / DL_OF_STEPDIV) THEN // 连续剔除达窗长一半：判真阶跃（边界四，禁死锁）/ the consecutive rejects reach half the window, a true step
            _nHead := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 清窗：写头回零 / the rebuild, the head resets
            _nFill := DL_OF_ONE; // 填充计数重置为新基线首样本 [个] / the fill resets to the first sample of the new base
            _nRejectRun := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 连续剔除计数清零 / clear the consecutive reject count
            FOR _nClrIdx := DL_OF_ZEROI TO DL_OF_WMAX - DL_OF_ONE DO // 有界遍历全容量 / the bounded traversal over the full capacity
                _afWin[_nClrIdx] := DL_OF_ZERO; // 窗元素逐项清零 / zero every window element
            END_FOR
            _afWin[DL_OF_ZEROI] := fIn; // 新基线首样本入窗 [工程单位] / the new base sample enters the window
            _nHead := DL_OF_ONE; // 写头推进一位 / advance the head by one
            fOut := fIn; // 阶跃直通 [工程单位] / the step passes straight through
            _fOutLast := fIn; // 有效输出快照 [工程单位] / snapshot the valid output
            _bStepReb := TRUE; // 置重基线标记（信息级 3741）/ raise the rebuild flag
            _bHoldActive := FALSE; // 保持态解除 / release the hold state
            bHold := FALSE; // 保持出口位复位 / the hold outlet resets
            bValid := TRUE; // 输出可用 / the output is usable
            bError := FALSE; // 信息级不置故障位 / the informational code never raises the fault bit
            IF _bWinClamp THEN // 同拍窗长钳位（信息级优先序：钳位先于重基线）/ a clamp on the same scan
                eErr := 16#0002_3740; // 信息级：窗长越域已钳位 / informational, the length was clamped
            ELSE // 无钳位 / no clamp
                eErr := 16#0002_3741; // 信息级：真阶跃重基线触发 / informational, a true step rebuilt the base
            END_IF
            RETURN; // 早退 / early return
        ELSE // 单点野点：丢弃并保持（边界三）/ a single outlier, dropped with the output held
            _bHoldActive := TRUE; // 置保持态 / raise the hold state
            _bHoldOut := TRUE; // 保持出口位置位（段 10 映射）/ raise the hold outlet bit
            _bRejectI := TRUE; // 拒绝位置位 / raise the reject bit
            fOut := _fOutLast; // 输出保持上次有效值 [工程单位] / hold the last valid output
        END_IF
    ELSE // 带内：接受样本 / inside the band, the sample is accepted
        _afWin[_nHead] := fIn; // 样本入窗 [工程单位] / the sample enters the window
        _nHead := _nHead + DL_OF_ONE; // 写头推进 / advance the head
        IF _nHead >= _nUse THEN // 回卷 / wrap
            _nHead := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 写头回零 / reset the head
        END_IF
        IF _nFill < _nUse THEN // 窗未满才累加 / count only while not full
            _nFill := _nFill + DL_OF_ONE; // 填充计数推进 [个] / advance the filled count
        END_IF
        _nRejectRun := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 连续剔除计数清零 / clear the consecutive reject count
        _bHoldActive := FALSE; // 保持态解除 / release the hold state
        fOut := fIn; // 接受直通 [工程单位] / the accepted sample passes straight through
        _fOutLast := fIn; // 有效输出快照 [工程单位] / snapshot the valid output
    END_IF
ELSE // 判据挂起拍：直接接受（窗建立期）/ the criterion suspended, the sample is accepted while the window builds
    _afWin[_nHead] := fIn; // 样本入窗 [工程单位] / the sample enters the window
    _nHead := _nHead + DL_OF_ONE; // 写头推进 / advance the head
    IF _nHead >= _nUse THEN // 回卷 / wrap
        _nHead := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 写头回零 / reset the head
    END_IF
    IF _nFill < _nUse THEN // 窗未满才累加 / count only while not full
        _nFill := _nFill + DL_OF_ONE; // 填充计数推进 [个] / advance the filled count
    END_IF
    _nRejectRun := DL_OF_ZEROI; // 连续剔除计数清零 / clear the consecutive reject count
    _bHoldActive := FALSE; // 保持态解除 / release the hold state
    fOut := fIn; // 接受直通 [工程单位] / the accepted sample passes straight through
    _fOutLast := fIn; // 有效输出快照 [工程单位] / snapshot the valid output
END_IF

// 段 9｜保持超时判据（边界五：测点疑似坏）/ segment 9, the hold timeout test
IF tonHold.Q THEN // 保持超 tonHoldMax / the hold exceeded its ceiling
    fOut := _fOutLast; // 输出保持（安全侧冻结）[工程单位] / hold the output
    bHold := TRUE; // 保持出口位 / the hold outlet
    bValid := FALSE; // 测点疑似坏，输出不可用 / the point is suspected broken, the output is unusable
    eErr := 16#0002_3742; // 故障级：保持超时 / fault grade, the hold timed out
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 10｜统一出口（单拍位映射 + 累计计数单点写入，R187 / FB51-8）/ segment 10, the unified outlet
bHold := _bHoldOut; // 保持出口位（段 2 预置 + 段 8 置位映射）/ the hold outlet mapped from the preset and the raise
IF _bRejectI THEN // 本拍发生拒绝 / a reject happened on this scan
    nReject := nReject + 1; // 累计剔除计数单点写入 [个] / the accumulated reject count written at this single point
END_IF
bValid := TRUE; // 输出可用 / the output is usable
bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
IF _bWinClamp THEN // 窗长钳位（信息级，逐拍重算）/ the length clamp, informational and recomputed
    eErr := 16#0002_3740; // 信息级：窗长越域已钳位 / informational, the length was clamped
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 多节二阶 IIR 级联（≤4 节 Direct Form II 独立状态）：真实工况为高阶（8 阶=4 节）抗混叠/谱成形现场组合。边界：逐节 Jury 稳定闸——任一活动节 NOT(|a2|<1 ∧ 1+a1+a2>0 ∧ 1−a1+a2>0) 或系数非有限 → bCfgBad + 故障码 + 三件套 + RETURN 结构早退（fOut 冻结）；未激活节（i≥nStages）系数不参与判据（死节豁免防误锁）；系数变更沿 >1E-9 全链状态清零；nStages 越 [1,4] 组态早退；bEnable=FALSE 全零安全侧。
architecture_thought: 有状态 FB 逐节递推：w1[i]/w2[i] 固定 4 节状态数组，仅前 nStages 节参与；逐节 Jury 闸 + RETURN 结构早退（族① 判据固化）；死节豁免（未激活节系数不进判据）防误锁；系数变更沿检测遍历活动节任一 >1E-9 全链清零；输出钳位 + bSat；bEnable=FALSE 全零安全侧（下游控制量理由注释）。
