FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_BiquadCascade
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable     : BOOL := TRUE;    // 使能；FALSE 时输出归零并清全链状态（边界六）/ the enable, false zeroes the output and clears the chain
    bResetState : BOOL := FALSE;   // 状态复位电平，上升沿清全链状态与故障锁存 / the state reset level, its rising edge clears the chain and the fault latch
    fIn         : LREAL := 0.0;    // 输入量 [工程单位]，必须有限 / the input value, must be finite
    aB0         : ARRAY[0..3] OF LREAL; // 各节归一化前向系数 b0 [−] / the per stage normalized b0
    aB1         : ARRAY[0..3] OF LREAL; // 各节归一化前向系数 b1 [−] / the per stage normalized b1
    aB2         : ARRAY[0..3] OF LREAL; // 各节归一化前向系数 b2 [−] / the per stage normalized b2
    aA1         : ARRAY[0..3] OF LREAL; // 各节归一化反馈系数 a1 [−] / the per stage normalized a1
    aA2         : ARRAY[0..3] OF LREAL; // 各节归一化反馈系数 a2 [−] / the per stage normalized a2
    nStages     : DINT := 2;       // 节数 [节]，合法域 1..4 / the stage count, legal one to four
    fOutMin     : LREAL := -1.0E6; // 输出钳位域下界 [工程单位] / the output clamp floor
    fOutMax     : LREAL := 1.0E6;  // 输出钳位域上界 [工程单位] / the output clamp ceiling
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fOut    : LREAL := 0.0;           // 滤波输出 [工程单位] / the filtered output
    bSat    : BOOL := FALSE;          // 本拍输出被钳位 [-] / the output was clamped on this scan
    bCfgBad : BOOL := FALSE;          // 组态非法（与故障锁存同源，锁存型）[-] / an illegal configuration latched with the fault
    bValid  : BOOL := FALSE;          // 输出可用 [-] / the output is usable
    eErr    : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError  : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障锁存位（由锁存码派生，R99）/ the latched fault bit derived from the latched code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit   : BOOL := FALSE;                  // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _afW1    : ARRAY[0..3] OF LREAL;           // 各节状态 w1 [工程单位] / the per stage state w1
    _afW2    : ARRAY[0..3] OF LREAL;           // 各节状态 w2 [工程单位] / the per stage state w2
    _afB0Prev : ARRAY[0..3] OF LREAL;          // 上拍 b0 快照 [−] / the previous b0 snapshots
    _afB1Prev : ARRAY[0..3] OF LREAL;          // 上拍 b1 快照 [−] / the previous b1 snapshots
    _afB2Prev : ARRAY[0..3] OF LREAL;          // 上拍 b2 快照 [−] / the previous b2 snapshots
    _afA1Prev : ARRAY[0..3] OF LREAL;          // 上拍 a1 快照 [−] / the previous a1 snapshots
    _afA2Prev : ARRAY[0..3] OF LREAL;          // 上拍 a2 快照 [−] / the previous a2 snapshots
    _fW      : LREAL := 0.0;                   // 本拍节内中间量 w [工程单位] / the intermediate w of this scan
    _fY      : LREAL := 0.0;                   // 本拍节内输出 y（级联传递量）[工程单位] / the stage output passed down the chain
    _fOutLast: LREAL := 0.0;                   // 最近一次有效输出（故障冻结源）[工程单位] / the last valid output used while frozen
    _nUse    : DINT := 0;                      // 钳位后的节数 [节] / the clamped stage count
    _i       : DINT := 0;                      // 节遍历索引 [下标] / the stage traversal index
    _iClr    : DINT := 0;                      // 清零遍历索引 [下标] / the clearing traversal index
    _bFinCoef: BOOL := FALSE;                  // 活动节系数有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the active stage finiteness gate result
    _bFinIn  : BOOL := FALSE;                  // 输入有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the input finiteness gate result
    _bFinDom : BOOL := FALSE;                  // 钳位限值有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the clamp limit finiteness gate result
    _bStable : BOOL := FALSE;                  // 活动节 Jury 闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the active stage Jury gate result
    _bCfgBadI: BOOL := FALSE;                  // 本拍组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the per scan configuration fault flag
    _bCoefChg: BOOL := FALSE;                  // 系数变更沿标记（逐拍重算，信息级 3747）/ the coefficient change flag
    _bSatI   : BOOL := FALSE;                  // 本拍钳位内部位 / the internal clamp bit
    _uLatch  : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;          // 故障码锁存（仅复位沿清除，FB33-1）/ the latched fault code cleared only by the reset edge
    rtReset  : R_TRIG;                         // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新（R7）/ the reset edge instance refreshed unconditionally
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_BC_EPS   : LREAL := 1.0E-9;  // 系数变更判定容差 [−] / the coefficient change tolerance
    DL_BC_SMIN  : DINT := 1;        // 节数下界 [节] / the stage floor
    DL_BC_SMAX  : DINT := 4;        // 节数上界 [节] / the stage ceiling
    DL_BC_A2LIM : LREAL := 1.0;     // Jury 条件一 |a2| 边界 [−] / the Jury first condition boundary
    DL_BC_ONE   : LREAL := 1.0;     // Jury 条件二三的一常量 [−] / the unit constant of the Jury conditions
    DL_BC_ZERO  : LREAL := 0.0;     // 实数零常量 [工程单位] / the real zero constant
    DL_BC_ZEROI : DINT := 0;        // 整型零常量 [节] / the integer zero constant
    DL_BC_ONEI  : DINT := 1;        // 整型一常量 [节] / the integer one constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7）/ segment 0, the unconditional edge refresh
rtReset(CLK := bResetState); // 复位沿 / the reset edge

// 段 1｜首拍初始化（R310 / FB50-2；_bInit 与复位沿同款初始化）/ segment 1, the first scan init
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    FOR _iClr := DL_BC_ZEROI TO DL_BC_SMAX - DL_BC_ONE DO // 有界遍历全部节槽 / the bounded traversal over every stage slot
        _afW1[_iClr] := DL_BC_ZERO; // 状态 w1 显式清零 / clear the state w1 explicitly
        _afW2[_iClr] := DL_BC_ZERO; // 状态 w2 显式清零 / clear the state w2 explicitly
        _afB0Prev[_iClr] := aB0[_iClr]; // 系数快照对齐首拍值（防首拍误报变更沿）/ align the snapshot to avoid a spurious change edge
        _afB1Prev[_iClr] := aB1[_iClr]; // 快照对齐 / align the snapshot
        _afB2Prev[_iClr] := aB2[_iClr]; // 快照对齐 / align the snapshot
        _afA1Prev[_iClr] := aA1[_iClr]; // 快照对齐 / align the snapshot
        _afA2Prev[_iClr] := aA2[_iClr]; // 快照对齐 / align the snapshot
    END_FOR
    _fOutLast := DL_BC_ZERO; // 最近有效输出显式清零 / clear the last valid output explicitly
    _uLatch := 16#0000_0000; // 故障码锁存显式清零 / clear the latched code explicitly
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域：清锁存 + 清全链状态，R311 声明）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _uLatch := 16#0000_0000; // 清故障码锁存（唯一的故障解除路径）/ clear the latched code, the only release path
    FOR _iClr := DL_BC_ZEROI TO DL_BC_SMAX - DL_BC_ONE DO // 有界遍历全部节槽 / the bounded traversal over every stage slot
        _afW1[_iClr] := DL_BC_ZERO; // 清状态 w1 / clear the state w1
        _afW2[_iClr] := DL_BC_ZERO; // 清状态 w2 / clear the state w2
    END_FOR
END_IF
_bSatI := FALSE; // 钳位单拍内部位预清零 / preset the internal clamp bit false
_bCoefChg := FALSE; // 系数变更标记预清零 / preset the coefficient change flag false
_bCfgBadI := FALSE; // 组态非法标记预清零 / preset the configuration fault flag false

// 段 2｜组态闸（边界一三：nStages 越域 / 钳位域 / 活动节系数非有限 / Jury，成因独立码 R190）/ segment 2, the configuration gates
_nUse := nStages; // 节数接管 [节] / take the stage count
IF (_nUse < DL_BC_SMIN) OR (_nUse > DL_BC_SMAX) THEN // 节数越域 / the stage count is out of the domain
    _bCfgBadI := TRUE; // 置组态标记 / raise the configuration flag
    IF _uLatch = 16#0000_0000 THEN // 仅首因入锁存（R152）/ latch only the first cause
        _uLatch := 16#0002_3743; // 故障级：组态非法（节数越域）/ fault grade, an illegal configuration
    END_IF
    IF _nUse < DL_BC_SMIN THEN // 下界钳位（防遍历越界）/ the floor clamp for the traversal safety
        _nUse := DL_BC_SMIN; // 钳到一节 / clamp to one stage
    ELSE // 上界钳位 / the ceiling clamp
        _nUse := DL_BC_SMAX; // 钳到四节 / clamp to four stages
    END_IF
END_IF
_bFinDom := (fOutMin = fOutMin) AND ((fOutMin - fOutMin) = (fOutMin - fOutMin))
         AND (fOutMax = fOutMax) AND ((fOutMax - fOutMax) = (fOutMax - fOutMax)); // 限值有限 / the limits are finite
IF (NOT _bFinDom) OR (fOutMin > fOutMax) THEN // 限值非有限或域反序 / the limits are not finite or the domain is reversed
    _bCfgBadI := TRUE; // 置组态标记 / raise the configuration flag
    IF _uLatch = 16#0000_0000 THEN // 仅首因入锁存 / latch only the first cause
        _uLatch := 16#0002_3743; // 故障级：组态非法（钳位域）/ fault grade, an illegal clamp domain
    END_IF
END_IF
_bFinIn := (fIn = fIn) AND ((fIn - fIn) = (fIn - fIn)); // 输入有限 / the input is finite
FOR _i := DL_BC_ZEROI TO _nUse - DL_BC_ONE DO // 有界遍历活动节（死节豁免，边界一）/ the bounded traversal over the active stages, dead stages exempt
    _bFinCoef := (aB0[_i] = aB0[_i]) AND ((aB0[_i] - aB0[_i]) = (aB0[_i] - aB0[_i]))
              AND (aB1[_i] = aB1[_i]) AND ((aB1[_i] - aB1[_i]) = (aB1[_i] - aB1[_i]))
              AND (aB2[_i] = aB2[_i]) AND ((aB2[_i] - aB2[_i]) = (aB2[_i] - aB2[_i]))
              AND (aA1[_i] = aA1[_i]) AND ((aA1[_i] - aA1[_i]) = (aA1[_i] - aA1[_i]))
              AND (aA2[_i] = aA2[_i]) AND ((aA2[_i] - aA2[_i]) = (aA2[_i] - aA2[_i])); // 本节五系数有限 / the five coefficients of this stage are finite
    _bStable := (ABS(aA2[_i]) < DL_BC_A2LIM) AND ((DL_BC_ONE + aA1[_i] + aA2[_i]) > DL_BC_ZERO) AND ((DL_BC_ONE - aA1[_i] + aA2[_i]) > DL_BC_ZERO); // Jury 三条件（与 FB_DL_BiquadFilter v1.0.1 同口径）/ the Jury three conditions aligned with the single stage owner
    IF (NOT _bFinCoef) AND (_uLatch = 16#0000_0000) THEN // 成因：活动节系数非有限（不覆盖已有首因）/ the coefficients of an active stage are not finite
        _bCfgBadI := TRUE; // 置组态标记 / raise the configuration flag
        _uLatch := 16#0002_3745; // 故障级：活动节系数非有限 / fault grade, the coefficients are not finite
        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 4 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    ELSIF (NOT _bStable) AND (_uLatch = 16#0000_0000) THEN // 成因：活动节越 Jury 域 / the Jury conditions are exceeded
        _bCfgBadI := TRUE; // 置组态标记 / raise the configuration flag
        _uLatch := 16#0002_3744; // 故障级：活动节越过 Jury 三条件稳定域 / fault grade, the Jury conditions are exceeded
        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 4 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    END_IF
END_FOR
IF (NOT _bFinIn) AND (_uLatch = 16#0000_0000) THEN // 成因：输入非有限（不覆盖已有首因）/ the input is not finite
    _uLatch := 16#0002_3748; // 故障级：输入非有限 / fault grade, the input is not finite
END_IF

// 段 3｜使能失能分支最先消费：降级为安全值并清全链（边界六声明行）/ segment 3, the disabled branch degrades to the safe value
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    FOR _iClr := DL_BC_ZEROI TO DL_BC_SMAX - DL_BC_ONE DO // 有界遍历全部节槽 / the bounded traversal over every stage slot
        _afW1[_iClr] := DL_BC_ZERO; // 状态清零（失能即弃用历史）/ clear the state, the history is abandoned
        _afW2[_iClr] := DL_BC_ZERO; // 状态清零 / clear the state
    END_FOR
    _fOutLast := DL_BC_ZERO; // 输出归零（下游控制量失能须归零，非冻结末值）/ zero the output, a control quantity must fall to zero
    fOut := DL_BC_ZERO; // 出口归零 [工程单位] / the outlet falls to zero
    bSat := FALSE; // 钳位位清零 / clear the clamp bit
    bCfgBad := (_uLatch <> 16#0000_0000); // 组态标记照实回放（与锁存同源）/ replay the configuration flag from the latch
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用（安全值不是滤波结果，明示而非静默）/ mark the output unusable, a safe zero is not a filter result
    bError := (_uLatch <> 16#0000_0000); // 故障位照实回放 / replay the fault bit from the latch
    eErr := _uLatch; // 故障码锁存回放（信息级不参与失能分支）/ replay the latched code
    RETURN; // 早退，不推进级联 / early return without advancing the chain
END_IF

// 段 4｜组态故障：冻结最近有效输出，不推进状态（边界一五，结构早退；冻结源做有限性闸，FB51-3）/ segment 4, freeze on a fault without advancing the chain
IF (_uLatch <> 16#0000_0000) OR _bCfgBadI THEN // 任一故障相 / any fault phase
    IF (_fOutLast = _fOutLast) AND ((_fOutLast - _fOutLast) = (_fOutLast - _fOutLast)) THEN // 冻结源有限性闸（冻结只防推进不防污染）/ the frozen source finiteness gate
        fOut := _fOutLast; // 冻结最近有效输出 [工程单位] / freeze the last valid output
    ELSE // 冻结源自身被污染（理论上不可达）/ the frozen source itself is polluted
        _fOutLast := DL_BC_ZERO; // 归零重建 / rebuild from zero
        fOut := DL_BC_ZERO; // 出口归零 [工程单位] / the outlet falls to zero
    END_IF
    bSat := FALSE; // 钳位位清零 / clear the clamp bit
    bCfgBad := _bCfgBadI OR (_uLatch = 16#0002_3743) OR (_uLatch = 16#0002_3744) OR (_uLatch = 16#0002_3745); // bCfgBad 专指组态族三码，3748 输入坏不复用 / the configuration flag covers only the configuration family codes
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    bError := TRUE; // 故障位置位 / raise the fault bit
    eErr := _uLatch; // 锁存码回放（不按当下输入重新推断，R152）/ replay the latched code
    RETURN; // 结构早退 / the structural early exit
END_IF

// 段 5｜系数变更沿：任一活动系数 |新 − 旧| > 容差即清全链状态（边界四）/ segment 5, the coefficient change edge clears the chain
FOR _i := DL_BC_ZEROI TO _nUse - DL_BC_ONE DO // 有界遍历活动节 / the bounded traversal over the active stages
    IF (ABS(aB0[_i] - _afB0Prev[_i]) > DL_BC_EPS) OR (ABS(aB1[_i] - _afB1Prev[_i]) > DL_BC_EPS)
    OR (ABS(aB2[_i] - _afB2Prev[_i]) > DL_BC_EPS) OR (ABS(aA1[_i] - _afA1Prev[_i]) > DL_BC_EPS)
    OR (ABS(aA2[_i] - _afA2Prev[_i]) > DL_BC_EPS) THEN // 本节任一系数变更 / any coefficient of this stage changed
        _bCoefChg := TRUE; // 置变更标记（信息级 3747）/ raise the change flag
        FOR _iClr := DL_BC_ZEROI TO DL_BC_SMAX - DL_BC_ONE DO // 有界遍历全部节槽（全链清零防混算）/ the bounded traversal over every slot
            _afW1[_iClr] := DL_BC_ZERO; // 清状态 w1 / clear the state w1
            _afW2[_iClr] := DL_BC_ZERO; // 清状态 w2 / clear the state w2
        END_FOR
    END_IF
    _afB0Prev[_i] := aB0[_i]; // 系数快照推进 [−] / advance the b0 snapshot
    _afB1Prev[_i] := aB1[_i]; // 快照推进 [−] / advance the b1 snapshot
    _afB2Prev[_i] := aB2[_i]; // 快照推进 [−] / advance the b2 snapshot
    _afA1Prev[_i] := aA1[_i]; // 快照推进 [−] / advance the a1 snapshot
    _afA2Prev[_i] := aA2[_i]; // 快照推进 [−] / advance the a2 snapshot
END_FOR

// 段 6｜逐节 Direct Form II 递推（节间串接：本拍节输出即下一节输入）/ segment 6, the per stage recursion chained down
_fY := fIn; // 级联入口 = 输入 [工程单位] / the chain inlet is the input
FOR _i := DL_BC_ZEROI TO _nUse - DL_BC_ONE DO // 有界遍历活动节 / the bounded traversal over the active stages
    _fW := _fY - (aA1[_i] * _afW1[_i]) - (aA2[_i] * _afW2[_i]); // 节内中间量 w [工程单位] / the intermediate w of this stage
    _fY := (aB0[_i] * _fW) + (aB1[_i] * _afW1[_i]) + (aB2[_i] * _afW2[_i]); // 节输出 y [工程单位] / the stage output
    _afW2[_i] := _afW1[_i]; // 状态右移：w1 → w2 / shift the state
    _afW1[_i] := _fW; // 状态推进：本拍 w → w1 / advance the state
END_FOR

// 段 7｜输出钳位 + 末活动节 w1 抗 windup 状态回写 / segment 7, the clamp with the anti windup write back
IF _fY > fOutMax THEN // 超上界 / above the ceiling
    fOut := fOutMax; // 钳上界 [工程单位] / clamp to the ceiling
    _bSatI := TRUE; // 置钳位内部位 / raise the internal clamp bit
    _afW1[_nUse - DL_BC_ONE] := fOutMax; // 末活动节状态回写（防积分式累积发散）[工程单位] / write the last active state back
ELSIF _fY < fOutMin THEN // 超下界 / below the floor
    fOut := fOutMin; // 钳下界 [工程单位] / clamp to the floor
    _bSatI := TRUE; // 置钳位内部位 / raise the internal clamp bit
    _afW1[_nUse - DL_BC_ONE] := fOutMin; // 末活动节状态回写 [工程单位] / write the state back
ELSE // 域内 / inside the domain
    fOut := _fY; // 直出输出 [工程单位] / pass the output through
END_IF

// 段 8｜全部内部量非有限复检：污染即拒收并锁存（FB32-7 保持槽口径）/ segment 8, the finiteness recheck before the states are stored
IF (fOut <> fOut) OR ((fOut - fOut) <> (fOut - fOut))
OR (_fY <> _fY) OR ((_fY - _fY) <> (_fY - _fY)) THEN // 输出或级联传递量非有限（NaN 自反 / Inf 差值自减）/ a non finite output or intermediate
    FOR _iClr := DL_BC_ZEROI TO DL_BC_SMAX - DL_BC_ONE DO // 有界遍历全部节槽 / the bounded traversal over every slot
        _afW1[_iClr] := DL_BC_ZERO; // 状态清零，禁污染物驻留 / clear the state so nothing polluted remains
        _afW2[_iClr] := DL_BC_ZERO; // 状态清零 / clear the state
    END_FOR
    IF _uLatch = 16#0000_0000 THEN // 仅首因入锁存 / latch only the first cause
        _uLatch := 16#0002_3748; // 故障级：输入或中间量非有限 / fault grade, the input or the intermediate is not finite
    END_IF
    fOut := DL_BC_ZERO; // 出口归零 [工程单位] / the outlet falls to zero
    bSat := FALSE; // 钳位位清零 / clear the clamp bit
    bCfgBad := FALSE; // 3748 属测量坏而非组态坏 / the input fault is a measurement issue
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    bError := TRUE; // 故障位置位 / raise the fault bit
    eErr := _uLatch; // 锁存码回放 / replay the latched code
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 9｜最近有效输出写回（写前已过非有限闸）/ segment 9, store the last valid output
_fOutLast := fOut; // 快照更新 [工程单位] / update the snapshot

// 段 10｜统一出口（单拍位映射 + 信息级重算，R187 / FB51-8）/ segment 10, the unified outlet
bSat := _bSatI; // 钳位位出口 / the clamp bit outlet
bCfgBad := (_uLatch = 16#0002_3743) OR (_uLatch = 16#0002_3744) OR (_uLatch = 16#0002_3745); // 组态标记出口（与锁存同源，3748 不复用）/ the configuration flag outlet from the latch
bValid := TRUE; // 域内输出可用 / the in-domain output is usable
bError := (_uLatch <> 16#0000_0000); // 故障位出口（锁存派生，R99）/ the fault bit outlet derived from the latch
IF _uLatch <> 16#0000_0000 THEN // 故障锁存回放优先 / the latched fault replays first
    eErr := _uLatch; // 锁存码 [码] / the latched code
ELSIF _bSatI THEN // 输出钳位（信息级，逐拍重算）/ the output clamp, informational
    eErr := 16#0002_3746; // 信息级：本拍输出被钳位 / informational, the output was clamped
ELSIF _bCoefChg THEN // 系数变更（信息级，逐拍重算）/ the coefficient change, informational
    eErr := 16#0002_3747; // 信息级：系数变更沿触发全链状态清零 / informational, a coefficient change cleared the chain
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: ADC 测点底噪监视：静态期窗内标准差与上限比较（接地/屏蔽劣化、前端供电噪声早期征兆）。边界：fNoiseLim≤0 或非有限 → 组态码 + 三件套 + RETURN 结构早退（族② 判据固化）；标准差除子 _nFill−1，_nFill<2 判据挂起 bValid=FALSE（除零防护）；bStatic 变更沿清窗防静/动混合窗污染口径；fMeas 非有限丢弃不入窗，局部计数超窗半判故障；判据迟滞回落复原；bEnable=FALSE 判据复位输出冻结。

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_AdcNoiseFloorWatch
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable   : BOOL := TRUE;  // 使能，FALSE 时判据复位 + 标准差冻结（边界七）/ the enable, false resets the criterion and freezes the std
    fMeas     : LREAL := 0.0;  // 测点实测值 [工程单位]，必须有限 / the measured value, must be finite
    bStatic   : BOOL := FALSE; // 静态期标志（过程稳态且无操作，由调用方给）[-] / the static period flag given by the caller
    nWinLen   : DINT := 64;    // 窗长 [个]，合法域 16..256，变更沿清窗 / the window length, legal sixteen to two hundred fifty six
    fNoiseLim : LREAL := 1.0;  // 底噪上限 [工程单位]，须 > 0 / the noise ceiling, must be positive
    fHystPct  : LREAL := 10.0; // 判据迟滞 [%]，须 ≥ 0 / the criterion hysteresis in percent, non negative
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fNoiseStd  : LREAL := 0.0;           // 窗内标准差 [工程单位] / the window standard deviation
    bNoiseHigh : BOOL := FALSE;          // 底噪超限判据（带迟滞）[-] / the noise high criterion with hysteresis
    nFill      : DINT := 0;              // 窗填充数 [个] / the filled count
    bValid     : BOOL := FALSE;          // 判据可用 [-] / the criterion is usable
    eErr       : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError     : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit     : BOOL := FALSE;              // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _afWin     : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL;     // 采样环形窗 [工程单位]，固定容量 256 / the fixed capacity ring of samples
    _nHead     : DINT := 0;                  // 环形窗写头 [下标] / the ring write head
    _nFill     : DINT := 0;                  // 环形窗填充计数 [个] / the ring filled count
    _nUse      : DINT := 64;                 // 钳位后的窗长 [个] / the clamped window length
    _nUsePrev  : DINT := 0;                  // 上拍窗长快照 [个]，置 0 使首拍必触发清窗 / the previous length
    _bStaticPrev : BOOL := FALSE;            // 上拍静态期快照 [-] / the previous static flag
    _nClrIdx   : DINT := 0;                  // 清窗遍历索引 [下标] / the clearing traversal index
    _nSumIdx   : DINT := 0;                  // 统计遍历索引 [下标] / the statistics traversal index
    _nNonFinite: DINT := 0;                  // 非有限丢弃计数 [个]（仅局部留档，不外显，R62-D7 口径）/ the dropped non finite count, local only and never exposed
    _fSum      : LREAL := 0.0;               // 窗内样本和 [工程单位] / the window sample sum
    _fMean     : LREAL := 0.0;               // 窗内均值（两遍法第一遍）[工程单位] / the window mean of the first pass
    _fSqSum    : LREAL := 0.0;               // 离差平方和（两遍法第二遍）[工程单位²] / the squared deviation sum of the second pass
    _fStdUse   : LREAL := 0.0;               // 标准差工作副本 [工程单位] / the working standard deviation
    _fVar      : LREAL := 0.0;               // 样本方差（n−1 分母）[工程单位²] / the sample variance
    _bNoiseL   : BOOL := FALSE;              // 底噪超限迟滞状态（跨拍保持）/ the noise high hysteresis state
    _bCfgBad   : BOOL := FALSE;              // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    _bWinClamp : BOOL := FALSE;              // 窗长钳位标记（逐拍重算，信息级 0720）/ the window clamp flag
    _bMeasBad  : BOOL := FALSE;              // 测量失效标记（逐拍重算）/ the measurement failure flag
    _bFinLim   : BOOL := FALSE;              // 上限有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the limit finiteness gate result
    _bFinHyst  : BOOL := FALSE;              // 迟滞有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the hysteresis finiteness gate result
    _bFinMeas  : BOOL := FALSE;              // 样本有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the sample finiteness gate result
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_ANF_WMAX  : DINT := 256;      // 窗容量上界 [个]，与数组容量一致 / the capacity aligned with the array
    DL_ANF_WMIN  : DINT := 16;       // 窗长下界 [个] / the window floor
    DL_ANF_ZERO  : LREAL := 0.0;     // 实数零常量 [工程单位] / the real zero constant
    DL_ANF_PCT   : LREAL := 100.0;  // 百分比换算系数 [%] / the percentage scaling factor
    DL_ANF_ONE   : DINT := 1;        // 整型一常量 [个] / the integer one constant
    DL_ANF_TWO   : DINT := 2;        // 整型二常量 [个]（方差最少样本）/ the integer two constant, the minimum for a variance
    DL_ANF_ZEROI : DINT := 0;        // 整型零常量 [个] / the integer zero constant
    DL_ANF_HALF  : LREAL := 2.0;     // 半窗判据除子 [−] / the half window criterion divisor
END_VAR

// 段 0｜本件无定时器与边沿实例（纯统计监视器，R6 标注 N/A），无刷新对象 / segment 0, no timers and no edge instances exist here

// 段 1｜首拍初始化（FB50-2）/ segment 1, the first scan init
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _nFill := DL_ANF_ZEROI; // 填充计数显式清零 / clear the filled count explicitly
    _nHead := DL_ANF_ZEROI; // 写头显式清零 / clear the write head explicitly
    _fSum := DL_ANF_ZERO; // 窗和显式清零 / clear the sum explicitly
    _nUsePrev := DL_ANF_ZEROI; // 窗长快照置 0，使段 3 变更沿必然触发一次清窗 / zero the snapshot so the change edge clears once
    _bStaticPrev := bStatic; // 静态期快照对齐首拍值（防首拍误清窗）/ align the static snapshot to avoid a spurious clear
    _bNoiseL := FALSE; // 迟滞状态显式清零 / clear the hysteresis state explicitly
    _nNonFinite := DL_ANF_ZEROI; // 非有限计数显式清零 / clear the non finite count explicitly
    FOR _nClrIdx := DL_ANF_ZEROI TO DL_ANF_WMAX - DL_ANF_ONE DO // 有界遍历全容量 / the bounded traversal over the full capacity
        _afWin[_nClrIdx] := DL_ANF_ZERO; // 窗元素逐项清零 / zero every window element
    END_FOR
END_IF

// 段 2｜组态域闸（边界四，族② 判据：全部限值逐个点名，R272）/ segment 2, the configuration gates
_bFinLim := (fNoiseLim = fNoiseLim) AND ((fNoiseLim - fNoiseLim) = (fNoiseLim - fNoiseLim)); // 上限有限 / the ceiling is finite
_bFinHyst := (fHystPct = fHystPct) AND ((fHystPct - fHystPct) = (fHystPct - fHystPct)); // 迟滞有限 / the hysteresis is finite
_bCfgBad := (NOT _bFinLim) OR (fNoiseLim <= DL_ANF_ZERO) OR (NOT _bFinHyst) OR (fHystPct < DL_ANF_ZERO); // 组态非法 / an illegal configuration
IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态非法：结构早退（出口三件套 + RETURN，除法段不可达）/ an illegal configuration exits structurally
    fNoiseStd := _fStdUse; // 标准差取最近有效值 [工程单位]（禁自赋值出口，R261）/ the std takes the last valid value instead of a self assignment
    bNoiseHigh := FALSE; // 判据复位 / the criterion resets
    nFill := _nFill; // 填充计数照实出口 [个] / the fill count as is
    bValid := FALSE; // 判据不可用 / the criterion is not usable
    eErr := 16#0003_071D; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, an illegal configuration
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 结构早退 / the structural early exit
END_IF

// 段 3｜窗长钳位与变更沿 / 静态期变更沿全窗清零（边界二）/ segment 3, the window clamp and the change edge clears
_bWinClamp := FALSE; // 钳位标记预清零（单拍信息位，段 8 映射）/ preset the clamp flag false
_bMeasBad := FALSE; // 测量失效标记预清零 / preset the failure flag false
_nUse := nWinLen; // 窗长接管 [个] / take the window length
IF (_nUse < DL_ANF_WMIN) OR (_nUse > DL_ANF_WMAX) THEN // 窗长越域 / the length is out of the domain
    _bWinClamp := TRUE; // 置钳位标记（信息级 0720）/ raise the clamp flag
    IF _nUse < DL_ANF_WMIN THEN // 下界钳位 / the floor clamp
        _nUse := DL_ANF_WMIN; // 钳到下界 [个] / clamp to the floor
    ELSE // 上界钳位 / the ceiling clamp
        _nUse := DL_ANF_WMAX; // 钳到容量 [个] / clamp to the capacity
    END_IF
END_IF
IF (_nUse <> _nUsePrev) OR (bStatic <> _bStaticPrev) THEN // 窗长或静态期变更沿（含首拍）/ the length or the static flag changed
    _nHead := DL_ANF_ZEROI; // 写头回零 / reset the write head
    _nFill := DL_ANF_ZEROI; // 填充计数回零 / reset the filled count
    _fSum := DL_ANF_ZERO; // 窗和回零 / reset the sum
    _nNonFinite := DL_ANF_ZEROI; // 非有限计数回零 / reset the non finite count
    FOR _nClrIdx := DL_ANF_ZEROI TO DL_ANF_WMAX - DL_ANF_ONE DO // 有界遍历全容量 / the bounded traversal over the full capacity
        _afWin[_nClrIdx] := DL_ANF_ZERO; // 窗元素逐项清零（禁静动混合窗） / zero every element so no mixed window remains
    END_FOR
    _nUsePrev := _nUse; // 快照本拍窗长 / snapshot the length
    _bStaticPrev := bStatic; // 快照本拍静态期 / snapshot the static flag
END_IF

// 段 4｜失能分支：判据复位 + 标准差冻结（边界七声明行）/ segment 4, the disabled branch
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    fNoiseStd := _fStdUse; // 标准差冻结最近有效值 [工程单位] / freeze the last valid std
    bNoiseHigh := FALSE; // 判据复位 / the criterion resets
    nFill := _nFill; // 填充计数照实出口 [个] / the fill count as is
    bValid := FALSE; // 失能即不可用 / the criterion is not usable while disabled
    bError := FALSE; // 失能不是故障 / a disabled device is not a fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 失能不发码 / no code is emitted while disabled
    RETURN; // 早退，窗保留 / early return with the window kept
END_IF

// 段 5｜样本入窗（非有限丢弃并计数，边界五）/ segment 5, push the sample or count the drop
_bFinMeas := (fMeas = fMeas) AND ((fMeas - fMeas) = (fMeas - fMeas)); // 样本有限 / the sample is finite
IF bStatic AND _bFinMeas THEN // 静态期且样本有限才入窗（动态期样本不进底噪窗）/ only a finite sample of a static period enters the noise window
    _fSum := _fSum - _afWin[_nHead] + fMeas; // 滑窗和更新 [工程单位] / update the sliding sum
    _afWin[_nHead] := fMeas; // 本拍样本入环 [工程单位] / push the sample
    _nHead := _nHead + DL_ANF_ONE; // 写头推进 / advance the head
    IF _nHead >= _nUse THEN // 回卷（按钳位窗长）/ wrap by the clamped length
        _nHead := DL_ANF_ZEROI; // 写头回零 / reset the head
    END_IF
    IF _nFill < _nUse THEN // 窗未满才累加 / count only while not full
        _nFill := _nFill + DL_ANF_ONE; // 填充计数推进 [个] / advance the filled count
    END_IF
ELSIF bStatic THEN // 静态期但样本非有限：丢弃计数 / a static period sample is broken, dropped and counted
    _nNonFinite := _nNonFinite + DL_ANF_ONE; // 非有限计数推进 [个] / advance the non finite count
END_IF
IF DINT_TO_LREAL(_nNonFinite) > (DINT_TO_LREAL(_nUse) / DL_ANF_HALF) THEN // 非有限累计超窗长一半（边界五）/ the non finite count exceeds half the window
    _bMeasBad := TRUE; // 置测量失效标记（码 071E）/ raise the failure flag
END_IF
nFill := _nFill; // 填充计数出口 [个] / the fill count outlet

// 段 6｜均值与标准差两遍法（边界三：除子 _nFill−1，_nFill < 2 判据挂起）/ segment 6, the two pass mean and standard deviation
IF _nFill >= DL_ANF_TWO THEN // 除子已证 ≥ 1（禁裸除子）/ the divisor is proven at least one
    _fMean := _fSum / DINT_TO_LREAL(_nFill); // 第一遍：窗均值 [工程单位] / the first pass mean
    _fSqSum := DL_ANF_ZERO; // 离差平方和清零 [工程单位²] / clear the squared deviation sum
    FOR _nSumIdx := DL_ANF_ZEROI TO _nFill - DL_ANF_ONE DO // 有界遍历活样本（上界已证 ≤ 256）/ the bounded traversal over the live samples
        _fSqSum := _fSqSum + ((_afWin[_nSumIdx] - _fMean) * (_afWin[_nSumIdx] - _fMean)); // 第二遍：离差平方累加 [工程单位²] / the second pass accumulates the squared deviations
    END_FOR
    _fVar := _fSqSum / DINT_TO_LREAL(_nFill - DL_ANF_ONE); // 样本方差（n−1 分母）[工程单位²] / the sample variance with the n minus one divisor
    IF _fVar < DL_ANF_ZERO THEN // 负方差兜底（两遍法下理论上不可达，防御保留）/ a negative variance, unreachable by theory, kept as a defence
        _fVar := DL_ANF_ZERO; // 方差钳零 [工程单位²] / clamp the variance to zero
    END_IF
    _fStdUse := SQRT(_fVar); // 标准差 [工程单位]，SQRT 属主口径见分工声明 / the standard deviation
ELSE // 样本不足：判据挂起 / too few samples, the criterion suspends
    fNoiseStd := _fStdUse; // 标准差保持最近有效值 [工程单位] / keep the last valid std
    bNoiseHigh := FALSE; // 判据复位 / the criterion resets
    bValid := FALSE; // 判据不可用（_nFill < 2，边界三）/ the criterion is not usable
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 挂起不是故障 / a suspension is not a fault
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    RETURN; // 早退，禁除零 / early return, no division is reached
END_IF

// 段 7｜底噪判据迟滞（边界六，两方向分别定义，R146）/ segment 7, the noise criterion hysteresis
IF NOT _bNoiseL THEN // 未报警态 / the released state
    IF _fStdUse > fNoiseLim THEN // 超过上限 / above the ceiling
        _bNoiseL := TRUE; // 置迟滞状态 / set the hysteresis state
    END_IF
ELSE // 已报警态 / the tripped state
    IF _fStdUse < (fNoiseLim * (DL_ANF_PCT - fHystPct) / DL_ANF_PCT) THEN // 回落低于上限减迟滞 / below the ceiling minus the hysteresis
        _bNoiseL := FALSE; // 复原 / release
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 8｜统一出口（单拍位映射 + 信息级重算，R187 / FB51-8）/ segment 8, the unified outlet
fNoiseStd := _fStdUse; // 标准差出口 [工程单位] / the std outlet
bNoiseHigh := _bNoiseL; // 判据出口（迟滞状态派生）/ the criterion outlet
bValid := (NOT _bMeasBad); // 判据可用（无测量失效）/ usable without a measurement failure
IF _bMeasBad THEN // 测量失效（故障级优先）/ the measurement failed
    bValid := FALSE; // 判据不可用 / the criterion is not usable
    bError := TRUE; // 故障位置位 / raise the fault bit
    eErr := 16#0003_071E; // 故障级：测量失效 / fault grade, the measurement failed
ELSIF _bNoiseL THEN // 底噪超限（信息级）/ the noise is high, informational
    bError := FALSE; // 信息级不置故障位 / the informational code never raises the fault bit
    eErr := 16#0003_071F; // 信息级：底噪超上限 / informational, the noise is over the ceiling
ELSIF _bWinClamp THEN // 窗长钳位（信息级）/ the length clamp, informational
    bError := FALSE; // 信息级不置故障位 / no fault bit
    eErr := 16#0003_0720; // 信息级：窗长越域已钳位 / informational, the length was clamped
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 变频器输出侧电机三相电流不平衡 + 断相双判据监视：匝间短路/断线/接触器单相粘连的早期征兆。边界：三相任一非有限 → 故障码 + 三件套 + RETURN 结构早退；待机判据 Iavg<0.5A（常量提级）不计算双判据 FALSE；组态闸 fImbLimPct≤0 OR fDropPct≤0 OR fHystPct<0 早退，fImbLimPct≥100 组态警告信息级（判据永假）；不平衡度 (Imax−Imin)/Iavg×100；两判据独立输出独立迟滞；与输入侧 PhaseLossGuard 勿混用（MANUAL 写明）。
architecture_thought: 有状态监视 FB：三输入非有限结构早退（族② 判据固化）先行于一切计算；待机判据常量提级（0.5A 禁魔法数）；不平衡度与断相两判据独立计算独立迟滞（上升触发/回落复原）；组态闸有序（硬故障早退 → 软警告信息级不早退判据永假）；bEnable=FALSE 复位双判据冻结输出。

  码位反证 Note     :
    0721 合并「测点坏」与「组态坏」的反证句：两场景出口组合仅在三相全有限后可由
    bValid 与码值区分度不足——但两者在「是否进入计算」上同形（均早退且 fImbPct
    冻结），三组以内输出无法还原，按 R90 共用一码；0722 / 0723 分立：两判据独立
    布尔出口，同时触发时 eErr 单值无法告知先修哪一路（匝间短路查电机 / 断相查接触
    器），按 R90 分立；0724 为信息级子带（R75 纪律），不跨用故障子带。
  验收 Acceptance   :
    算法已证（脚本）：未跑 ｜ 编译器已证（三平台）：未跑
    V1 三相均衡（500/500/500）→ 双 FALSE；V2 fIu = 250（掉 50%）→ fImbPct ≈ 50、
    bPhaseDrop = TRUE；V3 单相 = 0（断相）→ bPhaseDrop = TRUE + 不平衡超限
    V4 fImbLimPct = 0 → 组态早退；V5 待机（三相 < 0.5 A）→ 双 FALSE 不计算
    V6 fIu = NaN → 结构早退故障；V7 迟滞抖动不反复跳；V8 bEnable = FALSE → 复位
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R63 首版（批 3 · 序号 10）
  ==================================================================
*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_VfdOutputImbalance
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable    : BOOL := TRUE;   // 使能，FALSE 时判据复位 + 不平衡度冻结（边界五）/ the enable, false resets the criteria and freezes the imbalance
    fIu        : LREAL := 0.0;   // U 相电流实测 [安培]，必须有限 / the phase U current, must be finite
    fIv        : LREAL := 0.0;   // V 相电流实测 [安培]，必须有限 / the phase V current, must be finite
    fIw        : LREAL := 0.0;   // W 相电流实测 [安培]，必须有限 / the phase W current, must be finite
    fImbLimPct : LREAL := 10.0;  // 不平衡度上限 [%]，须 > 0 / the imbalance limit in percent, must be positive
    fDropPct   : LREAL := 20.0;  // 断相判据：最小相低于均值的百分比 [%]，须 > 0 / the phase drop percent relative to the mean, must be positive
    fHystPct   : LREAL := 5.0;   // 判据迟滞 [%]，须 ≥ 0 / the criterion hysteresis in percent, non negative
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fImbPct    : LREAL := 0.0;           // 不平衡度 (Imax−Imin)/Iavg×100 [%] / the imbalance rate in percent
    bImbHigh   : BOOL := FALSE;          // 不平衡超限判据（带迟滞）[-] / the imbalance criterion with hysteresis
    bPhaseDrop : BOOL := FALSE;          // 断相判据（带迟滞）[-] / the phase drop criterion with hysteresis
    bValid     : BOOL := FALSE;          // 判据可用 [-] / the criteria are usable
    eErr       : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError     : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit    : BOOL := FALSE;   // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _fAvg     : LREAL := 0.0;    // 三相均值 [安培] / the three phase mean
    _fMax     : LREAL := 0.0;    // 最大相电流 [安培] / the maximum phase current
    _fMin     : LREAL := 0.0;    // 最小相电流 [安培] / the minimum phase current
    _fImbUse  : LREAL := 0.0;    // 不平衡度工作副本 [%] / the working imbalance copy
    _fImbLast : LREAL := 0.0;    // 最近有效不平衡度（冻结源）[%] / the last valid imbalance used while frozen
    _fRelLim  : LREAL := 0.0;    // 不平衡复原阈值 [%] / the imbalance release threshold
    _fDropTrip: LREAL := 0.0;    // 断相置警阈值 [安培] / the phase drop trip threshold
    _fDropRele: LREAL := 0.0;    // 断相复原阈值 [安培] / the phase drop release threshold
    _bImbL    : BOOL := FALSE;   // 不平衡迟滞状态（跨拍保持）/ the imbalance hysteresis state
    _bDropL   : BOOL := FALSE;   // 断相迟滞状态（跨拍保持）/ the phase drop hysteresis state
    _bFinU    : BOOL := FALSE;   // U 相有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the U finiteness gate result
    _bFinV    : BOOL := FALSE;   // V 相有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the V finiteness gate result
    _bFinW    : BOOL := FALSE;   // W 相有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the W finiteness gate result
    _bCfgBad  : BOOL := FALSE;   // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    _bFinLim  : BOOL := FALSE;   // 上限有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the limit finiteness gate result
    _bFinDrop : BOOL := FALSE;   // 断相限值有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the drop limit finiteness gate result
    _bFinHyst : BOOL := FALSE;   // 迟滞有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the hysteresis finiteness gate result
    _bWarnLim : BOOL := FALSE;   // 上限 ≥ 100 警告标记（逐拍重算，信息级 0724）/ the over hundred warning flag
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_VOI_IDLEEPS : LREAL := 0.5;  // 待机判据门限 [安培]，低于此值不计算（提级禁魔法数）/ the idle threshold of half an ampere lifted out of the body
    DL_VOI_PCT     : LREAL := 100.0; // 百分比换算系数 [%] / the percentage scaling factor
    DL_VOI_ZERO    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 实数零常量 [安培] / the real zero constant
    DL_VOI_THREE   : LREAL := 3.0;  // 三相均值除子 [−] / the three phase mean divisor
END_VAR

// 段 0｜本件无定时器与边沿实例（纯监视器，R6 标注 N/A），无刷新对象 / segment 0, no timers and no edge instances exist here

// 段 1｜首拍初始化（FB50-2）/ segment 1, the first scan init
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bImbL := FALSE; // 不平衡迟滞态显式清零 / clear the imbalance state explicitly
    _bDropL := FALSE; // 断相迟滞态显式清零 / clear the drop state explicitly
    _fImbLast := DL_VOI_ZERO; // 最近有效不平衡度显式清零 [%] / clear the last valid imbalance explicitly
END_IF

// 段 2｜三相测点与限值非有限闸（边界一二，全量点名 R151/R272）/ segment 2, the finiteness gates over every real pin
_bFinU := (fIu = fIu) AND ((fIu - fIu) = (fIu - fIu)); // U 相有限 / the phase U is finite
_bFinV := (fIv = fIv) AND ((fIv - fIv) = (fIv - fIv)); // V 相有限 / the phase V is finite
_bFinW := (fIw = fIw) AND ((fIw - fIw) = (fIw - fIw)); // W 相有限 / the phase W is finite
_bFinLim := (fImbLimPct = fImbLimPct) AND ((fImbLimPct - fImbLimPct) = (fImbLimPct - fImbLimPct)); // 不平衡上限有限 / the imbalance limit is finite
_bFinDrop := (fDropPct = fDropPct) AND ((fDropPct - fDropPct) = (fDropPct - fDropPct)); // 断相限值有限 / the drop limit is finite
_bFinHyst := (fHystPct = fHystPct) AND ((fHystPct - fHystPct) = (fHystPct - fHystPct)); // 迟滞有限 / the hysteresis is finite
_bCfgBad := (NOT _bFinLim) OR (fImbLimPct <= DL_VOI_ZERO)
         OR (NOT _bFinDrop) OR (fDropPct <= DL_VOI_ZERO)
         OR (NOT _bFinHyst) OR (fHystPct < DL_VOI_ZERO); // 组态非法（限值域外或非有限）/ an illegal configuration
IF (NOT _bFinU) OR (NOT _bFinV) OR (NOT _bFinW) OR _bCfgBad THEN // 测点坏或组态坏（边界一二，一码处置，反证见码表）/ a broken sample or an illegal configuration
    fImbPct := _fImbLast; // 不平衡度冻结最近有效值 [%] / freeze the last valid imbalance
    bImbHigh := FALSE; // 判据复位 / the criterion resets
    bPhaseDrop := FALSE; // 判据复位 / the criterion resets
    bValid := FALSE; // 判据不可用 / the criteria are not usable
    eErr := 16#0003_0721; // 故障级：测点非有限或组态非法 / fault grade, a broken sample or an illegal configuration
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 结构早退，除法段不可达 / the structural early exit, the division is unreachable
END_IF

// 段 3｜失能分支：双判据复位 + 不平衡度冻结（边界五声明行）/ segment 3, the disabled branch
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    fImbPct := _fImbLast; // 冻结最近有效不平衡度 [%] / freeze the last valid imbalance
    bImbHigh := FALSE; // 判据复位 / the criterion resets
    bPhaseDrop := FALSE; // 判据复位 / the criterion resets
    bValid := FALSE; // 失能即不可用 / the criteria are not usable while disabled
    bError := FALSE; // 失能不是故障 / a disabled device is not a fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 失能不发码 / no code is emitted while disabled
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 4｜均值 / 极值 / 待机判据（边界三：除子 3 为常量，Iavg 门限提级）/ segment 4, the mean, the extremes and the idle test
_fAvg := (fIu + fIv + fIw) / DL_VOI_THREE; // 三相均值 [安培]，除子为常量 3 / the three phase mean with the constant divisor
IF fIu > fIv THEN // 取最大相（第一轮）/ the first round of the maximum
    _fMax := fIu; // U 相候选 [安培] / the candidate U
ELSE // V 相候选 / the candidate V
    _fMax := fIv; // V 相候选 [安培] / the candidate V
END_IF
IF fIw > _fMax THEN // 第三相更新最大 / the third phase updates the maximum
    _fMax := fIw; // W 相胜出 [安培] / the phase W wins
END_IF
IF fIu < fIv THEN // 取最小相（第一轮）/ the first round of the minimum
    _fMin := fIu; // U 相候选 [安培] / the candidate U
ELSE // V 相候选 / the candidate V
    _fMin := fIv; // V 相候选 [安培] / the candidate V
END_IF
IF fIw < _fMin THEN // 第三相更新最小 / the third phase updates the minimum
    _fMin := fIw; // W 相胜出 [安培] / the phase W wins
END_IF
IF _fAvg < DL_VOI_IDLEEPS THEN // 待机态（边界三）：无判据意义 / the idle state makes the criteria meaningless
    fImbPct := DL_VOI_ZERO; // 不平衡度归零 [%] / the imbalance falls to zero
    bImbHigh := FALSE; // 判据复位 / the criterion resets
    bPhaseDrop := FALSE; // 判据复位 / the criterion resets
    bValid := TRUE; // 待机判定本身可用 / the idle verdict is usable
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
    RETURN; // 早退，不计算 / early return without the computation
END_IF

// 段 5｜不平衡度计算（除子 _fAvg 已证 ≥ 待机门限 0.5 > 0，禁除零）/ segment 5, the imbalance computation
_fImbUse := ((_fMax - _fMin) / _fAvg) * DL_VOI_PCT; // 不平衡度 [%]，除子已证 > 0 / the imbalance rate with the proven divisor
_fImbLast := _fImbUse; // 最近有效不平衡度快照 [%] / snapshot the valid imbalance
_fRelLim := fImbLimPct * ((DL_VOI_PCT - fHystPct) / DL_VOI_PCT); // 不平衡复原阈值 [%] / the imbalance release threshold
_fDropTrip := _fAvg * ((DL_VOI_PCT - fDropPct) / DL_VOI_PCT); // 断相置警阈值 [安培] / the phase drop trip threshold
_fDropRele := _fDropTrip * ((DL_VOI_PCT - fHystPct) / DL_VOI_PCT); // 断相复原阈值 [安培] / the phase drop release threshold
_bWarnLim := fImbLimPct >= DL_VOI_PCT; // 上限 ≥ 100：判据永假警告（信息级 0724）/ the limit at or above hundred percent makes the criterion permanently false

// 段 6｜不平衡判据迟滞（边界四，R146）/ segment 6, the imbalance hysteresis
IF NOT _bImbL THEN // 未报警态 / the released state
    IF _fImbUse > fImbLimPct THEN // 超过上限 / above the limit
        _bImbL := TRUE; // 置迟滞状态 / set the hysteresis state
    END_IF
ELSE // 已报警态 / the tripped state
    IF _fImbUse < _fRelLim THEN // 回落低于复原阈值 / below the release threshold
        _bImbL := FALSE; // 复原 / release
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 7｜断相判据迟滞（边界四，独立迟滞）/ segment 7, the phase drop hysteresis
IF NOT _bDropL THEN // 未报警态 / the released state
    IF _fMin < _fDropTrip THEN // 最小相低于置警阈值 / below the trip threshold
        _bDropL := TRUE; // 置迟滞状态 / set the hysteresis state
    END_IF
ELSE // 已报警态 / the tripped state
    IF _fMin > _fDropRele THEN // 回升高于复原阈值 / above the release threshold
        _bDropL := FALSE; // 复原 / release
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 8｜统一出口（迟滞状态派生 + 信息级重算，R187 / FB51-8）/ segment 8, the unified outlet
fImbPct := _fImbUse; // 不平衡度出口 [%] / the imbalance outlet
bImbHigh := _bImbL; // 不平衡判据出口 / the imbalance outlet
bPhaseDrop := _bDropL; // 断相判据出口 / the drop outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 判据可用 / the criteria are usable
bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
IF _bWarnLim THEN // 组态警告（信息级 0724，判据永假）/ the configuration warning
    eErr := 16#0003_0724; // 信息级：上限 ≥ 100，不平衡判据永假 / informational, the criterion is permanently false
ELSIF _bImbL THEN // 不平衡超限（信息级）/ the imbalance is high, informational
    eErr := 16#0003_0722; // 信息级：不平衡度超上限 / informational, the imbalance is over the limit
ELSIF _bDropL THEN // 断相（信息级）/ the phase drop, informational
    eErr := 16#0003_0723; // 信息级：断相判据触发 / informational, the phase drop triggered
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_AdaptiveLmsFilter
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable   : BOOL := TRUE;   // 使能，FALSE 时权重保留但停止更新（边界六）/ the enable, false keeps the weights but stops the update
    bWipeW    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 权重清零电平，上升沿全权重与延迟线清零 / the wipe level, its rising edge clears the weights and the delay line
    fRef      : LREAL := 0.0;   // 参考输入 [工程单位]（与干扰相关的信号）/ the reference input correlated with the disturbance
    fDesired  : LREAL := 0.0;   // 主输入 [工程单位] / the desired main input
    uTaps     : USINT := 16;    // 抽头数 [个]，合法域 4..32，变更沿清权重 / the tap count, legal four to thirty two
    fMu       : LREAL := 0.01;  // 步长 [−]，域 (0, 0.1] / the step size inside the half open domain
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fErr      : LREAL := 0.0;           // 误差 = fDesired − fOut [工程单位] / the error of the desired minus the output
    fOut      : LREAL := 0.0;           // 滤波输出 [工程单位] / the filter output
    fWEnergy  : LREAL := 0.0;           // 权重平方和 [−]，收敛 / 发散诊断 / the squared weight sum for the convergence diagnostics
    bValid    : BOOL := FALSE;          // 输出可用 [-] / the output is usable
    eErr      : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError    : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit    : BOOL := FALSE;              // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _afW      : ARRAY[0..31] OF LREAL;      // 权重数组 [−]，固定 32 抽头 / the fixed weight array of thirty two taps
    _afX      : ARRAY[0..31] OF LREAL;      // 延迟线 [工程单位] / the delay line
    _nTaps    : DINT := 16;                 // 钳位后的抽头数 [个] / the clamped tap count
    _nTapsPrev: DINT := 0;                  // 上拍抽头数快照 [个]，置 0 使首拍必触发清权重 / the previous tap count
    _i        : DINT := 0;                  // 抽头遍历索引 [下标] / the tap traversal index
    _iShift   : DINT := 0;                  // 移位遍历索引 [下标] / the shift traversal index
    _fAcc     : LREAL := 0.0;               // 输出累加器 [工程单位] / the output accumulator
    _fEng     : LREAL := 0.0;               // 权重能量累加器 [−] / the weight energy accumulator
    _fErrUse  : LREAL := 0.0;               // 误差工作副本 [工程单位] / the working error copy
    _fCorr    : LREAL := 0.0;               // 修正量 2μ·e [−] / the correction factor of two mu times the error
    _bFinRef  : BOOL := FALSE;              // 参考输入有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the reference finiteness gate result
    _bFinDes  : BOOL := FALSE;              // 主输入有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the desired finiteness gate result
    _bFinMu   : BOOL := FALSE;              // 步长有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the mu finiteness gate result
    _bCfgBad  : BOOL := FALSE;              // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    _bTapClamp: BOOL := FALSE;              // 抽头数钳位标记（逐拍重算，信息级 374A）/ the tap clamp flag
    _bDivWarn : BOOL := FALSE;              // 发散警告标记（逐拍重算，信息级 374B）/ the divergence warning flag
    rtWipe    : R_TRIG;                     // 权重清零沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新（R7）/ the wipe edge instance refreshed unconditionally
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_LMS_TMAX  : DINT := 32;        // 抽头容量上界 [个]，与数组容量一致 / the tap capacity aligned with the array
    DL_LMS_TMIN  : DINT := 4;         // 抽头数下界 [个] / the tap floor
    DL_LMS_MUMAX : LREAL := 0.1;      // 步长上界 [−] / the step size ceiling
    DL_LMS_MUZERO: LREAL := 0.0;      // 步长零常量 [−] / the step size zero constant
    DL_LMS_TWO   : LREAL := 2.0;      // LMS 修正系数常量 [−] / the LMS correction factor constant
    DL_LMS_WMAX  : LREAL := 1.0E12;   // 权重平方和发散门限 [−] / the divergence threshold of the weight energy
    DL_LMS_ZERO  : LREAL := 0.0;      // 实数零常量 [工程单位] / the real zero constant
    DL_LMS_ZEROI : DINT := 0;         // 整型零常量 [个] / the integer zero constant
    DL_LMS_ONEI  : DINT := 1;         // 整型一常量 [个] / the integer one constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜组态闸先行 + 沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7）/ segment 0, the configuration gate first and the unconditional edge refresh
_bFinMu := (fMu = fMu) AND ((fMu - fMu) = (fMu - fMu)); // 步长有限 / the step size is finite
_bCfgBad := (NOT _bFinMu) OR (fMu <= DL_LMS_MUZERO) OR (fMu > DL_LMS_MUMAX); // 组态非法 / an illegal configuration
rtWipe(CLK := bWipeW); // 权重清零沿 / the wipe edge

// 段 1｜首拍初始化（FB50-2）/ segment 1, the first scan init
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _nTapsPrev := DL_LMS_ZEROI; // 抽头数快照置 0，使段 4 变更沿必然触发一次清权重 / zero the snapshot so the change edge clears the weights once
    FOR _i := DL_LMS_ZEROI TO DL_LMS_TMAX - DL_LMS_ONEI DO // 有界遍历全容量 / the bounded traversal over the full capacity
        _afW[_i] := DL_LMS_ZERO; // 权重显式清零 [−] / clear the weight explicitly
        _afX[_i] := DL_LMS_ZERO; // 延迟线显式清零 [工程单位] / clear the delay line explicitly
    END_FOR
END_IF

// 段 2｜单拍量预置 / segment 2, the per scan preset
_bTapClamp := FALSE; // 钳位标记预清零（单拍信息位，段 7 映射）/ preset the clamp flag false
_bDivWarn := FALSE; // 发散警告标记预清零（单拍信息位）/ preset the divergence flag false
_fErrUse := fErr; // 误差工作副本接管上拍出口（冻结语义基线）[工程单位] / the working error takes the previous outlet as the freeze base

// 段 3｜组态非法结构早退：权重冻结（边界二，出口三件套 + RETURN）/ segment 3, the structural early exit on an illegal configuration
IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态非法 / an illegal configuration
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    eErr := 16#0002_3749; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, an illegal configuration
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 结构早退，权重冻结（禁污染）/ the structural early exit with the weights frozen
END_IF

// 段 4｜权重清零沿：全权重与延迟线清零（边界五；抽头数变更沿同段处理）/ segment 4, the wipe edge and the tap change edge
IF (_nTaps <> _nTapsPrev) OR rtWipe.Q THEN // 抽头数变更沿或清零沿 / the tap change edge or the wipe edge
    FOR _i := DL_LMS_ZEROI TO DL_LMS_TMAX - DL_LMS_ONEI DO // 有界遍历全容量 / the bounded traversal over the full capacity
        _afW[_i] := DL_LMS_ZERO; // 权重清零 [−] / clear the weight
        _afX[_i] := DL_LMS_ZERO; // 延迟线清零 [工程单位] / clear the delay line
    END_FOR
    _nTapsPrev := _nTaps; // 快照本拍抽头数 / snapshot the tap count
END_IF

// 段 5｜失能分支：权重保留但停止更新（边界六声明行）/ segment 5, the disabled branch keeps the weights
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable while disabled
    bError := FALSE; // 失能不是故障 / a disabled device is not a fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 失能不发码 / no code is emitted while disabled
    RETURN; // 早退，权重保留（现场断使能调试不丢已收敛权重）/ early return with the weights kept
END_IF

// 段 6｜抽头数钳位（边界一，信息级 374A）/ segment 6, the tap clamp
_nTaps := USINT_TO_DINT(uTaps); // 抽头数升位接管 [个] / take the tap count widened
IF (_nTaps < DL_LMS_TMIN) OR (_nTaps > DL_LMS_TMAX) THEN // 抽头数越域 / the count is out of the domain
    _bTapClamp := TRUE; // 置钳位标记（信息级 374A）/ raise the clamp flag
    IF _nTaps < DL_LMS_TMIN THEN // 下界钳位 / the floor clamp
        _nTaps := DL_LMS_TMIN; // 钳到下界 [个] / clamp to the floor
    ELSE // 上界钳位 / the ceiling clamp
        _nTaps := DL_LMS_TMAX; // 钳到容量 [个] / clamp to the capacity
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 7｜输入非有限闸：权重冻结（边界三，禁污染权重）/ segment 7, the input finiteness gate freezes the weights
_bFinRef := (fRef = fRef) AND ((fRef - fRef) = (fRef - fRef)); // 参考输入有限 / the reference is finite
_bFinDes := (fDesired = fDesired) AND ((fDesired - fDesired) = (fDesired - fDesired)); // 主输入有限 / the desired is finite
IF (NOT _bFinRef) OR (NOT _bFinDes) THEN // 任一输入坏 / either input is broken
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    eErr := 16#0002_374C; // 故障级：输入非有限 / fault grade, an input is not finite
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 早退，权重冻结（不更新，污染不可自动恢复性见边界三）/ early return with the weights frozen
END_IF

// 段 8｜延迟线右移入新样本（边界一，固定容量，禁动态分配）/ segment 8, the delay line shifts the new sample in
FOR _iShift := DL_LMS_TMAX - DL_LMS_ONEI TO DL_LMS_ONEI BY -1 DO // 有界逆向遍历（31 → 1）/ the bounded reverse traversal from thirty one down to one
    _afX[_iShift] := _afX[_iShift - DL_LMS_ONEI]; // 延迟线逐位右移 [工程单位] / shift the delay line one slot right
END_FOR
_afX[DL_LMS_ZEROI] := fRef; // 新样本入延迟线首槽 [工程单位] / the new sample enters the first slot

// 段 9｜滤波输出与误差计算（活动抽头数才参与，边界一）/ segment 9, the output and the error over the active taps
_fAcc := DL_LMS_ZERO; // 输出累加器清零 [工程单位] / clear the output accumulator
FOR _i := DL_LMS_ZEROI TO _nTaps - DL_LMS_ONEI DO // 有界遍历活动抽头（上界已证 ≤ 32）/ the bounded traversal over the active taps
    _fAcc := _fAcc + (_afW[_i] * _afX[_i]); // 横向滤波加权和 [工程单位] / the transversal weighted sum
END_FOR
fOut := _fAcc; // 滤波输出出口 [工程单位] / the filter output outlet
_fErrUse := fDesired - fOut; // 误差 = 主输入 − 输出 [工程单位] / the error of the desired minus the output

// 段 10｜递推结果复检（更新前置闸：结果非有限则权重冻结，禁污染物写入，边界三）/ segment 10, the result recheck before the update
IF (_fErrUse <> _fErrUse) OR ((_fErrUse - _fErrUse) <> (_fErrUse - _fErrUse))
OR (fOut <> fOut) OR ((fOut - fOut) <> (fOut - fOut)) THEN // 误差或输出非有限（理论上不可达，防御保留）/ a non finite error or output
    bValid := FALSE; // 输出不可用 / the output is not usable
    eErr := 16#0002_374C; // 故障级：输入或结果非有限（同族一码，出口同形，R90）/ fault grade under the same family code
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 早退，权重冻结 / early return with the weights frozen
END_IF

// 段 11｜LMS 权重在线更新（公开公式：w[k] += 2μ·e·x[k]，边界三判据已过）/ segment 11, the LMS weight update
_fCorr := DL_LMS_TWO * fMu * _fErrUse; // 修正量 2μ·e [−] / the correction factor
FOR _i := DL_LMS_ZEROI TO _nTaps - DL_LMS_ONEI DO // 有界遍历活动抽头 / the bounded traversal over the active taps
    _afW[_i] := _afW[_i] + (_fCorr * _afX[_i]); // 权重递推 [−] / the weight recursion
END_FOR
fErr := _fErrUse; // 误差出口（已过有限闸）[工程单位] / the error outlet after the gate

// 段 12｜权重能量诊断（边界四，信息级 374B，每拍重算不锁存）/ segment 12, the weight energy diagnostics
_fEng := DL_LMS_ZERO; // 能量累加器清零 [−] / clear the energy accumulator
FOR _i := DL_LMS_ZEROI TO _nTaps - DL_LMS_ONEI DO // 有界遍历活动抽头 / the bounded traversal over the active taps
    _fEng := _fEng + (_afW[_i] * _afW[_i]); // 权重平方累加 [−] / accumulate the squared weights
END_FOR
fWEnergy := _fEng; // 权重平方和出口 [−] / the weight energy outlet
IF fWEnergy > DL_LMS_WMAX THEN // 超发散门限 / above the divergence threshold
    _bDivWarn := TRUE; // 置发散警告标记（信息级 374B）/ raise the divergence flag
END_IF

// 段 13｜统一出口（信息级重算，R187 / FB51-8）/ segment 13, the unified outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 输出可用 / the output is usable
bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
IF _bTapClamp THEN // 抽头数钳位（信息级，逐拍重算）/ the tap clamp, informational
    eErr := 16#0002_374A; // 信息级：uTaps 越域已钳位 / informational, the tap count was clamped
ELSIF _bDivWarn THEN // 发散警告（信息级，逐拍重算）/ the divergence, informational
    eErr := 16#0002_374B; // 信息级：权重平方和超阈，建议减小 μ / informational, the weight energy is over the threshold, reduce the step size
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 母线电容老化趋势估计：纹波率实测相对投运基线的比值长期监视（容值衰减→纹波率单调爬升运维预警）。边界：组态闸结构早退（族② 判据）——fRippleBasePct≤0 或非有限 → 组态码 + 三件套 + RETURN（除子直穿防线，R62-D1 同族教训出厂即正确）；fRipplePct<0 该拍拒绝不影响趋势；判据 >100+fAgingLimPct 触发、迟滞回落复原；fAgingLimPct≤0 组态早退；负载可比性声明（同负载段比较，切换由调用方断使能复位，本件不自动判负载）；纹波率数值由 VfdDcBusRipple 出口注入，无实例依赖。
architecture_thought: 有状态趋势 FB：单比值递推 + 迟滞判据；组态闸结构早退（族② 判据固化，R62-D1 同族教训出厂即正确）；负值/非有限输入该拍拒绝不影响趋势（语义与故障分离）；无实例依赖只收数值（分层解耦）；负载可比性声明单职责不自动判负载；bEnable=FALSE 复位判据冻结比值（运维趋势不丢历史）。

    仅两码：0725 组态族为即刻判（与测点无关），0726 需比值已建立，处置人不同
    （组态工程师 / 运维），可由场景还原（R90）；fRipplePct 非有限拒绝拍不占码
    （bValid = FALSE 已足够表达，无额外处置信息，R90 不加码）。

    V4 回落 142% → 复原；V5 fRippleBasePct = 0 → 组态早退（R1 同族回归向量）
    V6 fRippleBasePct = NaN → 组态早退；V7 fRipplePct = NaN → 该拍拒绝不触发

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_VfdCapAgingEst
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable       : BOOL := TRUE;  // 使能，FALSE 时判据复位 + 比值冻结（边界六）/ the enable, false resets the criterion and freezes the ratio
    fRipplePct    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 纹波率实测 [%]，由 FB_DL_VfdDcBusRipple 出口注入 / the measured ripple rate injected from the ripple monitor
    fRippleBasePct: LREAL := 5.0;  // 投运基线纹波率 [%]，须 > 0（除子）/ the commissioned baseline ripple rate, must be positive
    fAgingLimPct  : LREAL := 50.0; // 劣化阈值 [−]，相对基线百分比（50 即 150% 判劣化）/ the aging threshold relative to the baseline
    fHystPct      : LREAL := 5.0;  // 判据迟滞 [%]，须 ≥ 0 / the criterion hysteresis in percent, non negative
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fRippleRatioPct : LREAL := 0.0;           // 基线比 fRipplePct/fRippleBasePct×100 [%] / the baseline ratio in percent
    bAgingHigh      : BOOL := FALSE;          // 老化超限判据（带迟滞）[-] / the aging high criterion with hysteresis
    bValid          : BOOL := FALSE;          // 判据可用 [-] / the criterion is usable
    eErr            : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError          : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;   // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _fRatio     : LREAL := 0.0;    // 基线比工作副本 [%] / the working baseline ratio
    _fRatioLast : LREAL := 0.0;    // 最近有效基线比（冻结源）[%] / the last valid ratio used while frozen
    _fTripLim   : LREAL := 0.0;    // 置警阈值 = 100 + 劣化阈值 [%] / the trip threshold
    _fReleLim   : LREAL := 0.0;    // 复原阈值 = 100 + 劣化阈值×(1−h) [%] / the release threshold
    _bAgingL    : BOOL := FALSE;   // 老化迟滞状态（跨拍保持）/ the aging hysteresis state
    _bFinBase   : BOOL := FALSE;   // 基线有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the baseline finiteness gate result
    _bFinLim    : BOOL := FALSE;   // 劣化阈值有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the threshold finiteness gate result
    _bFinHyst   : BOOL := FALSE;   // 迟滞有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the hysteresis finiteness gate result
    _bFinMeas   : BOOL := FALSE;   // 实测值有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the measurement finiteness gate result
    _bCfgBad    : BOOL := FALSE;   // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    _nRejectCnt : DINT := 0;       // 实测值拒绝计数 [个]（仅局部留档，不外显，R62-D7 口径）/ the rejected measurement count, local only and never exposed
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_VCA_PCT   : LREAL := 100.0; // 百分比换算与基线常量 [%] / the percentage scaling and the baseline constant
    DL_VCA_ZERO  : LREAL := 0.0;   // 实数零常量 [%] / the real zero constant
    DL_VCA_ONEI  : DINT := 1;      // 整型一常量 [个] / the integer one constant
    DL_VCA_ZEROI : DINT := 0;      // 整型零常量 [个] / the integer zero constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜本件无定时器与边沿实例（纯趋势监视器，R6 标注 N/A），无刷新对象 / segment 0, no timers and no edge instances exist here

// 段 1｜首拍初始化（FB50-2）/ segment 1, the first scan init
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _bAgingL := FALSE; // 迟滞态显式清零 / clear the hysteresis state explicitly
    _fRatioLast := DL_VCA_PCT; // 最近有效基线比显式预置 100%（首次有效计算前的安全占位）/ preset the last valid ratio to one hundred percent
    _nRejectCnt := DL_VCA_ZEROI; // 拒绝计数显式清零 [个] / clear the reject count explicitly
END_IF

// 段 2｜组态域闸结构早退（边界一，族② 判据：除子直穿防线先行，R272 全量点名）/ segment 2, the structural early exit on an illegal configuration
_bFinBase := (fRippleBasePct = fRippleBasePct) AND ((fRippleBasePct - fRippleBasePct) = (fRippleBasePct - fRippleBasePct)); // 基线有限 / the baseline is finite
_bFinLim := (fAgingLimPct = fAgingLimPct) AND ((fAgingLimPct - fAgingLimPct) = (fAgingLimPct - fAgingLimPct)); // 劣化阈值有限 / the threshold is finite
_bFinHyst := (fHystPct = fHystPct) AND ((fHystPct - fHystPct) = (fHystPct - fHystPct)); // 迟滞有限 / the hysteresis is finite
_bCfgBad := (NOT _bFinBase) OR (fRippleBasePct <= DL_VCA_ZERO)
         OR (NOT _bFinLim) OR (fAgingLimPct <= DL_VCA_ZERO)
         OR (NOT _bFinHyst) OR (fHystPct < DL_VCA_ZERO); // 组态非法 / an illegal configuration
IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态非法：结构早退（出口三件套 + RETURN，除法段不可达）/ an illegal configuration exits structurally
    fRippleRatioPct := _fRatioLast; // 比值冻结最近有效值 [%]（禁自赋值出口，R261）/ freeze the last valid ratio
    bAgingHigh := FALSE; // 判据复位 / the criterion resets
    bValid := FALSE; // 判据不可用 / the criterion is not usable
    eErr := 16#0003_0725; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, an illegal configuration
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 结构早退 / the structural early exit
END_IF

// 段 3｜失能分支：判据复位 + 比值冻结（边界六声明行）/ segment 3, the disabled branch
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    fRippleRatioPct := _fRatioLast; // 比值冻结最近有效值 [%]（运维趋势件，不丢历史）/ freeze the last valid ratio
    bAgingHigh := FALSE; // 判据复位 / the criterion resets
    bValid := FALSE; // 失能即不可用 / the criterion is not usable while disabled
    bError := FALSE; // 失能不是故障 / a disabled device is not a fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 失能不发码 / no code is emitted while disabled
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 4｜实测值拒绝闸（边界二：非有限或负值拒绝，禁污染物进除法）/ segment 4, the measurement rejection gate
_bFinMeas := (fRipplePct = fRipplePct) AND ((fRipplePct - fRipplePct) = (fRipplePct - fRipplePct)); // 实测值有限 / the measurement is finite
IF (NOT _bFinMeas) OR (fRipplePct < DL_VCA_ZERO) THEN // 实测坏或负值 / a broken or a negative measurement
    _nRejectCnt := _nRejectCnt + DL_VCA_ONEI; // 拒绝计数推进（仅局部留档，不外显）/ advance the reject count, local only
    fRippleRatioPct := _fRatioLast; // 比值冻结 [%] / freeze the ratio
    bAgingHigh := _bAgingL; // 迟滞态保持（拒绝拍不影响趋势判据）/ keep the hysteresis state
    bValid := FALSE; // 该拍不可用 / the scan is not usable
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 拒绝拍不发码（bValid = FALSE 已足够表达，R90 不加码）/ no code for a rejected scan
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    RETURN; // 早退，除法不可达 / early return, the division is unreachable
END_IF

// 段 5｜基线比计算（除子 fRippleBasePct > 0 已由段 2 证明，禁除零）/ segment 5, the baseline ratio computation
_fRatio := (fRipplePct / fRippleBasePct) * DL_VCA_PCT; // 基线比 [%]，除子已证 > 0 / the baseline ratio with the proven divisor
_fRatioLast := _fRatio; // 最近有效基线比快照 [%] / snapshot the valid ratio
_fTripLim := DL_VCA_PCT + fAgingLimPct; // 置警阈值 [%] / the trip threshold
_fReleLim := DL_VCA_PCT + (fAgingLimPct * ((DL_VCA_PCT - fHystPct) / DL_VCA_PCT)); // 复原阈值 [%] / the release threshold

// 段 6｜老化判据迟滞（边界三，两方向分别定义，R146）/ segment 6, the aging hysteresis
IF NOT _bAgingL THEN // 未报警态 / the released state
    IF _fRatio > _fTripLim THEN // 超过置警阈值 / above the trip threshold
        _bAgingL := TRUE; // 置迟滞状态 / set the hysteresis state
    END_IF
ELSE // 已报警态 / the tripped state
    IF _fRatio < _fReleLim THEN // 回落低于复原阈值 / below the release threshold
        _bAgingL := FALSE; // 复原 / release
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 7｜统一出口（迟滞状态派生，R187 / FB51-8）/ segment 7, the unified outlet
fRippleRatioPct := _fRatio; // 基线比出口 [%] / the ratio outlet
bAgingHigh := _bAgingL; // 判据出口 / the criterion outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 判据可用 / the criterion is usable
bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
IF _bAgingL THEN // 老化超限（信息级）/ the aging is high, informational
    eErr := 16#0003_0726; // 信息级：基线比超过 100 + 劣化阈值 / informational, the ratio exceeds the aging threshold
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 直流母线预充电回路时序监视：接触器反馈窗 + 电压上升斜率 + 总时限三闸（预充电阻过热、接触器卡阻、整流缺相启动期保护）。边界：组态闸结构早退（族② 判据）——fUdNom≤0 / fUdTargetPct 越 (0,100] / fSlopeMinPctS≤0 / 时限非正 / 任一非有限 → 组态码 + 三件套 + RETURN；E_DL_PrechargePhase 五相 CASE + ELSE 兜底落 eFault；失败锁存 _bFaultLatch，bResetCmd 上升沿解除式自证可达（终审两式 1）头注释写明；fUdMeas 非有限该拍跳过斜率判据不误判卡阻；bEnable=FALSE 强制 eIdle 双出口复位（使能断开≠预充故障）。
architecture_thought: 有状态时序监视 FB：五相状态机（eIdle/eWaitFb/eRamp/eDone/eFault）CASE + ELSE 兜底落 eFault；组态闸结构早退（族② 判据固化）；三闸独立（反馈窗 TON / 斜率移动窗 / 总时限 TON，均无条件周期刷新）；失败锁存 _bFaultLatch + bResetCmd 解除式（终审两式 1 自证可达头注释写明）；非有限电压该拍跳过斜率判据防误判卡阻；监视件不锁完成态（eDone 指令撤回回 eIdle）。

TYPE E_DL_PrechargePhase :
(
    eIdle   := 0,  // 待机：等接触器指令 / idle, waiting for the contactor command
    eWaitFb := 10, // 等反馈：指令后等接触器辅助反馈，TON 反馈窗计时 / waiting for the auxiliary feedback with the window timer
    eRamp   := 20, // 斜率监视：电压上升斜率与总时限双闸 / the ramp phase with the slope and the total time gates
    eDone   := 30, // 完成：电压达目标百分比（指令撤回即退出，不锁完成态）/ done, the voltage reached the target, the phase exits with the command
    eFault  := 40  // 锁存故障：任一闸触发，复位沿解除 / a latched fault released by the reset edge
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_VfdPrechargeSeq
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable       : BOOL := TRUE;   // 使能，FALSE 时强制 eIdle + 双出口复位（边界七）/ the enable, false forces the idle and resets both outlets
    bKmCmd        : BOOL := FALSE;  // 预充接触器指令 [-] / the precharge contactor command
    bKmFb         : BOOL := FALSE;  // 接触器辅助反馈 [-] / the contactor auxiliary feedback
    fUdMeas       : LREAL := 0.0;   // 母线电压实测 [伏]，必须有限 / the measured bus voltage, must be finite
    fUdNom        : LREAL := 540.0; // 额定母线电压 [伏]，须 > 0（除子与基准）/ the nominal bus voltage, must be positive
    fUdTargetPct  : LREAL := 90.0;  // 预充完成阈值 [%] 相对额定，域 (0, 100] / the completion threshold relative to the nominal
    fSlopeMinPctS : LREAL := 5.0;   // 最小电压上升斜率 [%/秒]，须 > 0 / the minimum voltage slope in percent per second
    bResetCmd     : BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存回 eIdle（边界三解除式）/ the fault reset level, its rising edge releases the latch to idle
    tFbWindow     : TIME := T#2S;   // 反馈确认窗 [毫秒] / the feedback confirmation window
    tPrechargeMax : TIME := T#15S;  // 预充总时限 [毫秒] / the precharge total time limit
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bPrechargeDone  : BOOL := FALSE;          // 预充完成（eDone 相电平派生）[-] / the precharge done derived from the done phase
    bPrechargeFault : BOOL := FALSE;          // 预充故障（锁存）[-] / the latched precharge fault
    eState          : E_DL_PrechargePhase;    // 状态机出口 [状态] / the state machine outlet
    bValid          : BOOL := FALSE;          // 判据可用 [-] / the criteria are usable
    eErr            : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError          : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;  // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _eState     : E_DL_PrechargePhase := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bFaultLatch: BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _uLatch     : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 故障码锁存 [码]（复位沿清除，FB33-1）/ the latched fault code cleared by the reset edge
    _fPctNow    : LREAL := 0.0;   // 本拍电压百分比 [％] / the voltage percentage of this scan
    _fPctSnap   : LREAL := 0.0;   // 斜率窗快照电压百分比 [%] / the window snapshot percentage
    _fSlopeNow  : LREAL := 0.0;   // 本拍斜率 [%/秒] / the slope of this scan
    _bSlopeLow  : BOOL := FALSE;  // 斜率低于下限状态（窗际保持）/ the slope below floor state
    _bMeasBad   : BOOL := FALSE;  // 电压测点坏标记（逐拍重算）/ the measurement broken flag
    _bCfgBad    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    _bFinNom    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 额定电压有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the nominal finiteness gate result
    _bFinTgt    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 目标阈值有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the target finiteness gate result
    _bFinSlope  : BOOL := FALSE;  // 斜率限值有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the slope limit finiteness gate result
    _bFinMeas   : BOOL := FALSE;  // 电压测点有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the measurement finiteness gate result
    rtReset     : R_TRIG;         // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新（R7）/ the reset edge instance
    tonFb       : TON;            // 反馈窗定时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the feedback window timer
    tonSlopeWin : TON;            // 斜率采样错峰窗（自复位，R188）/ the self resetting slope sampling window
    tonSlopeLow : TON;            // 斜率宽限计时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the slope grace timer
    tonTotal    : TON;            // 总时限定时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the total time timer
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_VPS_PCT     : LREAL := 100.0;  // 百分比换算系数 [%] / the percentage scaling factor
    DL_VPS_WINSEC  : LREAL := 0.5;    // 斜率窗时长换算 [秒]，与 T#500MS 配比一致（手工同步，R100）/ the window duration of half a second aligned with the timer
    DL_VPS_ZEROR   : LREAL := 0.0;    // 实数零常量 [伏] / the real zero constant
    DL_VPS_TIME0   : TIME := T#0S;    // 时间零常量 [毫秒] / the time zero constant
    DL_VPS_SLOPEWIN: TIME := T#500MS; // 斜率采样错峰窗 [毫秒]（常量提级）/ the slope sampling window lifted out of the body
    DL_VPS_SLOPEGRACE: TIME := T#1S;  // 斜率宽限期 [毫秒]（常量提级）/ the slope grace period lifted out of the body
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7；监视 TON 串故障锁存门控，FB50-1）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtReset(CLK := bResetCmd); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
tonFb(IN := (_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eWaitFb) AND (NOT _bFaultLatch), PT := tFbWindow); // 反馈窗计时（串锁存门控防复位同拍重锁）/ the feedback window with the latch gate
tonSlopeWin(IN := (NOT tonSlopeWin.Q) AND (_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eRamp) AND (NOT _bFaultLatch), PT := DL_VPS_SLOPEWIN); // 斜率采样错峰窗：自复位驱动（R188，禁外部沿清零）/ the self resetting slope window
tonSlopeLow(IN := (_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eRamp) AND _bSlopeLow AND (NOT _bFaultLatch), PT := DL_VPS_SLOPEGRACE); // 斜率宽限计时（串锁存门控）/ the slope grace timer with the latch gate
tonTotal(IN := ((_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eWaitFb) OR (_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eRamp)) AND (NOT _bFaultLatch), PT := tPrechargeMax); // 总时限计时（串锁存门控）/ the total time timer with the latch gate

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与复位沿作用域（R310 / R311）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the reset edge scope
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _uLatch := 16#0000_0000; // 故障码锁存显式清零 / clear the latched code explicitly
    _fPctSnap := DL_VPS_ZEROR; // 斜率快照显式清零 [%] / clear the snapshot explicitly
    _bSlopeLow := FALSE; // 斜率低限态显式清零 / clear the slope state explicitly
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域声明：清锁存 + 迁相位 + 清斜率态，R311）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 清故障锁存（唯一解除路径，边界三自证可达）/ clear the fault latch, the only release path
    _uLatch := 16#0000_0000; // 清故障码锁存 / clear the latched code
    _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
    _bSlopeLow := FALSE; // 清斜率低限态 / clear the slope state
    _fPctSnap := _fPctNow; // 斜率快照对齐本拍（防复位后旧快照误判）/ align the snapshot to this scan
END_IF

// 段 2｜组态域闸结构早退（边界一，族② 判据：全部限值逐个点名，R272）/ segment 2, the structural early exit on an illegal configuration
_bFinNom := (fUdNom = fUdNom) AND ((fUdNom - fUdNom) = (fUdNom - fUdNom)); // 额定电压有限 / the nominal is finite
_bFinTgt := (fUdTargetPct = fUdTargetPct) AND ((fUdTargetPct - fUdTargetPct) = (fUdTargetPct - fUdTargetPct)); // 目标阈值有限 / the target is finite
_bFinSlope := (fSlopeMinPctS = fSlopeMinPctS) AND ((fSlopeMinPctS - fSlopeMinPctS) = (fSlopeMinPctS - fSlopeMinPctS)); // 斜率限值有限 / the slope limit is finite
_bCfgBad := (NOT _bFinNom) OR (fUdNom <= DL_VPS_ZEROR)
         OR (NOT _bFinTgt) OR (fUdTargetPct <= DL_VPS_ZEROR) OR (fUdTargetPct > DL_VPS_PCT)
         OR (NOT _bFinSlope) OR (fSlopeMinPctS <= DL_VPS_ZEROR)
         OR (tFbWindow <= DL_VPS_TIME0) OR (tPrechargeMax <= DL_VPS_TIME0); // 组态非法 / an illegal configuration
IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态非法：结构早退（出口三件套 + RETURN，除法段不可达）/ an illegal configuration exits structurally
    eState := _eState; // 状态照实出口（冻结）/ export the state as is
    bPrechargeDone := FALSE; // 完成位复位 / the done bit resets
    bPrechargeFault := _bFaultLatch; // 故障锁存照实回放 / replay the latch
    bValid := FALSE; // 判据不可用 / the criteria are not usable
    eErr := 16#0003_0728; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, an illegal configuration
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 结构早退 / the structural early exit
END_IF

// 段 3｜失能分支：强制 eIdle + 双出口复位，不 faults（边界七声明行）/ segment 3, the disabled branch
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 强制空闲 / force the idle
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 锁存复位（使能断开 ≠ 预充故障）/ clear the latch
    _uLatch := 16#0000_0000; // 码锁存复位 / clear the code
    _bSlopeLow := FALSE; // 斜率态复位 / clear the slope state
    eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
    bPrechargeDone := FALSE; // 完成位复位 / the done bit resets
    bPrechargeFault := FALSE; // 故障位复位 / the fault bit resets
    bValid := FALSE; // 失能即不可用 / the criteria are not usable while disabled
    bError := FALSE; // 失能不是故障 / a disabled device is not a fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 失能不发码 / no code is emitted while disabled
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 4｜电压测点闸与百分比换算（除子 fUdNom > 0 已由段 2 证明）/ segment 4, the measurement gate and the percentage
_bFinMeas := (fUdMeas = fUdMeas) AND ((fUdMeas - fUdMeas) = (fUdMeas - fUdMeas)); // 电压测点有限 / the measurement is finite
_bMeasBad := NOT _bFinMeas; // 测点坏标记（逐拍重算）/ the broken flag recomputed
IF _bFinMeas THEN // 测点有限才换算 / the conversion runs only on a finite sample
    _fPctNow := (fUdMeas / fUdNom) * DL_VPS_PCT; // 电压百分比 [%]，除子已证 > 0 / the percentage with the proven divisor
END_IF

// 段 5｜斜率计算（错峰窗到拍采样；测点坏拍跳过，边界四五）/ segment 5, the slope sampling at the window tick
IF (_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eRamp) AND (NOT _bMeasBad) AND (NOT _bFaultLatch) THEN // Ramp 相且测点好才采样 / the sampling runs only in the ramp with a good point
    IF tonSlopeWin.Q THEN // 错峰窗到拍（自复位 TON 输出）/ the window tick
        _fSlopeNow := (_fPctNow - _fPctSnap) / DL_VPS_WINSEC; // 斜率 = Δ(电压%)/Δt [%/秒]，除子为常量 0.5 / the slope with the constant divisor
        _fPctSnap := _fPctNow; // 快照推进 [%] / advance the snapshot
        _bSlopeLow := _fSlopeNow < fSlopeMinPctS; // 斜率低限态更新（窗际保持，宽限计时器累计）/ update the slope state kept across windows
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 6｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 兜底；本拍事件优先于超时迁移，R275；安全相迁移带全量闸位复检，R274）/ segment 6, the main machine
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle: // 空闲相 / the idle phase
        IF bKmCmd AND (NOT _bFaultLatch) AND (NOT _bCfgBad) THEN // 指令电平 + 全量闸位复检（R274）/ the command with the full gate recheck
            _fPctSnap := _fPctNow; // 斜率快照对齐起步拍（防旧快照误判）/ align the snapshot to the start
            _bSlopeLow := FALSE; // 斜率态复位 / clear the slope state
            _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eWaitFb; // 迁入等反馈相 / enter the wait phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_PrechargePhase.eWaitFb: // 等反馈相 / the wait phase
        IF bKmFb THEN // 事件优先：反馈已到（R275 本拍合法事件先消化）/ the feedback arrived, the event goes first
            _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eRamp; // 迁入斜率监视相 / enter the ramp phase
        ELSIF tonTotal.Q THEN // 总时限到（反馈窗内同时受总闸保护）/ the total time expired
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
            _uLatch := 16#0003_072B; // 故障级：总时限到 / fault grade, the total time expired
            bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 8 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        ELSIF tonFb.Q THEN // 反馈超窗 / the feedback window expired
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
            _uLatch := 16#0003_0729; // 故障级：反馈超窗 / fault grade, the feedback window expired
            bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 8 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        ELSIF NOT bKmCmd THEN // 指令撤回且未锁存 / the command withdrawn without a latch
            _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
        END_IF
    E_DL_PrechargePhase.eRamp: // 斜率监视相 / the ramp phase
        IF _fPctNow >= fUdTargetPct THEN // 事件优先：电压达目标（R275）/ the target reached, the event goes first
            _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eDone; // 迁入完成相 / enter the done phase
        ELSIF tonTotal.Q THEN // 总时限到 / the total time expired
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
            _uLatch := 16#0003_072B; // 故障级：总时限到 / fault grade, the total time expired
            bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 8 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        ELSIF tonSlopeLow.Q THEN // 斜率低于下限持续宽限期（卡阻判据）/ the slope stayed below the floor through the grace
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
            _uLatch := 16#0003_072A; // 故障级：斜率持续不足 / fault grade, the slope stayed insufficient
            bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 8 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        ELSIF NOT bKmCmd THEN // 指令撤回 / the command withdrawn
            _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
        END_IF
    E_DL_PrechargePhase.eDone: // 完成相（监视件不锁完成态，边界六）/ the done phase
        IF NOT bKmCmd THEN // 指令撤回即退出 / the phase exits with the command
            _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 回空闲（bPrechargeDone 随相复位）/ back to idle
        END_IF
    E_DL_PrechargePhase.eFault: // 锁存故障相（驻留，解除由段 1 复位沿承担）/ the fault phase dwelling, the release belongs to the reset edge
        ; // 驻留语义由注释表达（禁自赋值死语句，R261）/ the dwell is expressed by this comment without a dead statement
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截（边界二：落故障相并锁存，禁静默）/ the illegal enumeration guard
        _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
        _uLatch := 16#0003_0728; // 故障级：非法状态拦截（归入组态族一码，出口同形，R90）/ fault grade, the illegal state in the configuration family
        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 8 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eFault; // 落故障相 / force the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 7｜故障锁存迁移闸（置于解除段之后防同拍抢迁，R258）/ segment 7, the latch to phase gate
IF _bFaultLatch AND (_eState <> E_DL_PrechargePhase.eFault) THEN // 已锁存但不在故障相 / latched outside the fault phase
    _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相 / enter the fault phase
END_IF

// 段 8｜统一出口（名实双出口同源，R191）/ segment 8, the unified outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bPrechargeDone := (_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eDone); // 完成位与状态同源派生（eDone 相电平）/ the done bit derived from the state
bPrechargeFault := _bFaultLatch; // 故障位与锁存同源 / the fault bit from the latch
bValid := (NOT _bFaultLatch) AND (NOT _bMeasBad); // 判据可用（无锁存故障且测点好）/ usable without a latch or a broken point
IF _bFaultLatch THEN // 故障锁存回放优先（不在故障相按当下输入重新推断，R152）/ the latched fault replays first
    bValid := FALSE; // 故障相不可用 / not usable in the fault phase
    bError := TRUE; // 故障位置位（R45 配对）/ raise the fault bit
    eErr := _uLatch; // 锁存码回放 / replay the latched code
ELSIF _bMeasBad THEN // 测点坏（故障级 072C，该拍斜率判据已跳过不误判卡阻，边界五）/ the point is broken
    bError := TRUE; // 故障位置位（R45 配对）/ raise the fault bit
    eErr := 16#0003_072C; // 故障级：电压测点非有限 / fault grade, the voltage point is not finite
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
