FUNCTION FC_DL_ArrayFindValue : BOOL
VAR_IN_OUT
    afData : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL; // 数据序列 [工程单位]，只读 / the data series, read only
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    nCount : DINT := 0;    // 有效样本数入参 [个]，合法域 1..256 / the sample count, legal one to two hundred fifty six
    fValue : LREAL := 0.0; // 查找目标值 [工程单位]，必须有限 / the target value, must be finite
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    nFirst : DINT;  // 首个命中下标 [下标]，未命中 = -1 哨兵 / the first hit index, minus one when no hit
    nLast  : DINT;  // 末个命中下标 [下标]，未命中 = -1 哨兵 / the last hit index, minus one when no hit
    nHits  : DINT;  // 命中计数 [个] / the hit count
    bValid : BOOL;  // 结果可用 [-]（未命中也是可用结果）/ the result usable, a no hit is still usable
    eErr   : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError : BOOL;  // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    k : DINT := 0; // 遍历索引 [下标] / the traversal index
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_AFP_NMAX : DINT := 256;       // 数组容量上界 [个]，与数组容量一致 / the capacity aligned with the array
    DL_AFP_ONE  : DINT := 1;         // 整型一常量 [个] / the integer one constant
    DL_AFP_NOHIT: DINT := -1;        // 未命中哨兵 [下标] / the no hit sentinel index
    DL_AFP_ZERO : DINT := 0;         // 整型零常量 [个] / the integer zero constant
    DL_AFP_EQEPS: LREAL := 1.0E-6;   // 命中容差 [工程单位]，禁用 = / <> 判等 / the hit tolerance, plain equality operators are forbidden
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置哨兵值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, the preset of the return and all outlets
FC_DL_ArrayFindValue := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
nFirst := DL_AFP_NOHIT; // 首命中下标预置哨兵 -1 [下标] / preset the first hit to the sentinel
nLast := DL_AFP_NOHIT; // 末命中下标预置哨兵 -1 [下标] / preset the last hit to the sentinel
nHits := DL_AFP_ZERO; // 命中计数预置零 [个] / preset the hit count zero
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the fault flag false

// 段 2｜入参域闸（边界一，早退禁空遍历与 NaN 比较）/ segment 2, the input domain gate
IF (nCount < DL_AFP_ONE) OR (nCount > DL_AFP_NMAX)
OR (fValue <> fValue) OR ((fValue - fValue) <> (fValue - fValue)) THEN // 计数越域或目标值非有限 / the count is out of the domain or the target is not finite
    eErr := 16#0001_0662; // 故障级：入参越域或目标非有限（出口同形合并一码，R90）/ fault grade under the merged code
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 3｜线性查找遍历（边界二：非有限样本跳过；边界三：容差判等）/ segment 3, the linear search traversal
FOR k := DL_AFP_ZERO TO nCount - DL_AFP_ONE DO // 有界遍历（上界已证 ≤ 256）/ the bounded traversal with a proven ceiling
    IF (afData[k] = afData[k]) AND ((afData[k] - afData[k]) = (afData[k] - afData[k])) THEN // 有限样本才参与（非有限跳过口径）/ only a finite sample participates
        IF ABS(afData[k] - fValue) < DL_AFP_EQEPS THEN // 容差命中（浮点禁判等）/ a hit inside the tolerance
            nHits := nHits + DL_AFP_ONE; // 命中计数推进 [个] / advance the hit count
            IF nFirst = DL_AFP_NOHIT THEN // 首个命中（哨兵未动过才写）/ the first hit only when the sentinel is intact
                nFirst := k; // 记首命中下标 [下标] / record the first hit index
            END_IF
            nLast := k; // 末命中下标随遍历自然收敛 [下标] / the last hit index converges along the traversal
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_FOR

// 段 4｜统一出口（未命中不是故障，边界四）/ segment 4, the unified outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 查找流程走完即可用（含未命中）/ the search completed, usable even with no hit
FC_DL_ArrayFindValue := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

instruction: UDINT 最大公约数（欧几里得迭代 + WHILE 守卫计数）：真实工况为电子齿轮比分子分母约分、脉冲当量整比化简。边界：任一入参为 0 → 双 0 无定义故障早退（数学定义 GCD(0,0) 无意义，禁静默返回 0）；单 0 返回另一数（GCD(a,0)=a 定义注释写死）；WHILE 循环带 nGuard 上限 64（UDINT 欧几里得步数上界 92 足够，64 保守钳 + 守卫溢出故障码防死循环，R193 守卫计数规则落地）；纯整数无浮点容差问题；与 LcmCalc 的组合用法（GCD 先约分再乘）互引。
architecture_thought: 欧几里得迭代 + 守卫计数（WHILE 带 nGuard 防死循环，R193 落地）；双 0 无定义与单 0 返回另一数两级边界显式分码；纯整数域无浮点闸（判据 N/A 已声明）；迭代内 MOD/DIV 纯 IEC 算子；与 LCM 组合链互引注释。

  验收 Acceptance   :
    算法已证（脚本）：未跑 ｜ 编译器已证（三平台）：未跑
    V1 GCD(48, 36) = 12；V2 GCD(17, 5) = 1（互质）
    V3 GCD(7, 0) = 7 / GCD(0, 7) = 7（单零口径）
    V4 GCD(0, 0) → 0 哨兵 + 信息级 0663（bError = FALSE）
    V5 nIter 审计：V1 场景 nIter = 2（48,36 → 36,12 → 12,0）
    V6 守卫命中（强改平台异常注入）→ 码 0664 + bValid = FALSE + 返回 0
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R64 首版（批 1 · 序号 3，T0 数论原子补口）
  ==================================================================
*)
FUNCTION FC_DL_GcdUdintCalc : UDINT
VAR_INPUT
    nA : UDINT := 0; // 左操作数 [脉冲 / 计数]，无符号 / the left operand, unsigned
    nB : UDINT := 0; // 右操作数 [脉冲 / 计数]，无符号 / the right operand, unsigned
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    nIter  : DINT;  // 迭代计数 [次]，供收敛审计 / the iteration count for the convergence audit
    bValid : BOOL;  // 结果可用 [-]（双零哨兵也是可用结果）/ the result usable, the zero sentinel is still usable
    eErr   : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError : BOOL;  // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    nX   : UDINT := 0; // 迭代被除数工作副本 [脉冲 / 计数] / the dividend working copy of the iteration
    nY   : UDINT := 0; // 迭代除数工作副本 [脉冲 / 计数] / the divisor working copy of the iteration
    nRem : UDINT := 0; // 余数承接量 [脉冲 / 计数] / the remainder holder
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_GCD_ZERO    : UDINT := 0;  // 无符号零常量 [脉冲 / 计数] / the unsigned zero constant
    DL_GCD_GUARDMAX: DINT   := 64; // WHILE 守卫计数上界 [次]（欧几里得迭代理论步数远小于此）/ the while guard ceiling, the euclid iteration converges far earlier
    DL_GCD_ZEROI   : DINT   := 0;  // 整型零常量 [次] / the integer zero constant
    DL_GCD_ONEI    : DINT   := 1;  // 整型一常量 [次] / the integer one constant
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, the preset of the return and all outlets
FC_DL_GcdUdintCalc := DL_GCD_ZERO; // 返回值预置 0 哨兵 / preset the return to the zero sentinel
nIter := DL_GCD_ZEROI; // 迭代计数预置零 [次] / preset the iteration count zero
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the fault flag false
nX := DL_GCD_ZERO; // 被除数副本预置零 / preset the dividend copy zero
nY := DL_GCD_ZERO; // 除数副本预置零 / preset the divisor copy zero
nRem := DL_GCD_ZERO; // 余数承接量预置零 / preset the remainder holder zero

// 段 2｜双零哨兵（边界一：GCD(0,0) 无定义，信息级不置 bError）/ segment 2, the double zero sentinel
IF (nA = DL_GCD_ZERO) AND (nB = DL_GCD_ZERO) THEN // 双零入参 / both operands are zero
    eErr := 16#0001_0663; // 信息级：双零哨兵（R285）/ informational, the double zero sentinel
    bError := FALSE; // 信息级不置故障标志 / keep the fault flag false, this is informational
    bValid := TRUE; // 哨兵 0 是合法甄别结果 / the sentinel zero is a legit discernible result
    RETURN; // 早退，返回 0 / early return with zero
END_IF

// 段 3｜欧几里得迭代（边界二：MOD 除子 nY 由循环条件证明非零；边界三：守卫计数）/ segment 3, the euclid iteration with the proven divisor and the guard
nX := nA; // 被除数接管 [脉冲 / 计数] / take the dividend
nY := nB; // 除数接管 [脉冲 / 计数] / take the divisor
WHILE (nY <> DL_GCD_ZERO) AND (nIter < DL_GCD_GUARDMAX) DO // 除子非零且守卫未越限 / the divisor is nonzero and the guard is not exceeded
    nRem := nX MOD nY; // 余量（除子 nY 已由循环条件证明非零，除零不可达）/ the remainder, the divisor proven nonzero by the loop condition
    nX := nY; // 欧几里得步进：被除数取旧除数 / the euclid step, the dividend takes the old divisor
    nY := nRem; // 除数取余量 / the divisor takes the remainder
    nIter := nIter + DL_GCD_ONEI; // 迭代计数推进 [次] / advance the iteration count
END_WHILE

// 段 4｜守卫命中闸与统一出口（边界三）/ segment 4, the guard hit gate and the unified outlet
IF nY <> DL_GCD_ZERO THEN // 迭代因守卫越限退出（余量未收敛，平台异常路径）/ the loop exited by the guard with a nonzero remainder
    eErr := 16#0001_0664; // 故障级：守卫计数越限 / fault grade, the guard count exceeded
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    FC_DL_GcdUdintCalc := DL_GCD_ZERO; // 返回 0 哨兵（禁输出未收敛残值）/ return the zero sentinel, no unconverged residue
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF
FC_DL_GcdUdintCalc := nX; // GCD 结果出口 [脉冲 / 计数]（nY 已收敛为 0，nX 即最大公约数）/ the gcd outlet with the converged value
bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
END_FUNCTION

instruction: 两区间 [a1,a2]/[b1,b2] 相离间隙计算：真实工况为双料位开关死区校验、轴行程双限位间隙审查。边界：任一区间端点非有限或 a1>a2 / b1>b2（倒序）组态故障早退；关系六分类有序判定——相交/包含/被包含返回 fGap=0 且 iRel 给关系码（禁把重叠误算成负间隙），相离返回正值间隙；相接（端点相等，容差 fEps）判相接码间隙 0；fEps<0 组态早退；判据链每支注释写明判定式；与 RangeOverlapCheck（布尔重叠判定）差异在头注释写明（本件带关系码与间隙量）。

TYPE E_DL_IntervalGap :
(
    eInvalid   := 0,  // 输入非法，关系不可判 / the inputs are illegal, the relation is undecidable
    eDisjoint  := 10, // 完全相离，存在正间隙 / fully disjoint with a positive gap
    eTouching  := 20, // 仅端点相接，间隙为零 / the endpoint touch only with a zero gap
    eOverlap   := 30, // 部分重叠，互不包含 / a partial overlap, neither contains the other
    eContained := 40  // 一方包含另一方（完全相等归入本档）/ one range contains the other, an equality is folded here
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION FC_DL_IntervalGapCalc : E_DL_IntervalGap
VAR_INPUT
    fA1  : LREAL := 0.0;    // 区间 A 端点 1 [工程单位]，无序自动对调 / the range A endpoint one, auto swapped
    fA2  : LREAL := 10.0;   // 区间 A 端点 2 [工程单位] / the range A endpoint two
    fB1  : LREAL := 0.0;    // 区间 B 端点 1 [工程单位]，无序自动对调 / the range B endpoint one, auto swapped
    fB2  : LREAL := 10.0;   // 区间 B 端点 2 [工程单位] / the range B endpoint two
    fEps : LREAL := 1.0E-6; // 容差 [工程单位]，≥ 0 / the tolerance, non negative
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fGap   : LREAL; // 相离间隙宽 [工程单位]，恒非负，非相离 = 0.0 / the gap width, never negative, zero unless disjoint
    bValid : BOOL;  // 结果可用 [-] / the result usable flag
    eErr   : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError : BOOL;  // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _fLoA   : LREAL := 0.0; // 区间 A 归一下限 [工程单位] / the normalised lower bound of the range A
    _fHiA   : LREAL := 0.0; // 区间 A 归一上限 [工程单位] / the normalised upper bound of the range A
    _fLoB   : LREAL := 0.0; // 区间 B 归一下限 [工程单位] / the normalised lower bound of the range B
    _fHiB   : LREAL := 0.0; // 区间 B 归一上限 [工程单位] / the normalised upper bound of the range B
    _fTmp   : LREAL := 0.0; // 对调临时量 [工程单位] / the swap temporary
    _fGapUse: LREAL := 0.0; // 间隙工作副本 [工程单位] / the gap working copy
    _fEpsUse: LREAL := 0.0; // 容差工作副本 [工程单位] / the tolerance working copy
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_IGP_ZERO : LREAL := 0.0;    // 实数零常量 [工程单位] / the real zero constant
    DL_IGP_EPSDF: LREAL := 1.0E-6; // 默认容差常量 [工程单位]（fEps 非法时接管）/ the default tolerance taken over when the input is illegal
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, the preset of the return and all outlets
FC_DL_IntervalGapCalc := E_DL_IntervalGap.eInvalid; // 返回值预置不可判（任何早退天然带不可判语义）/ preset the return to undecidable
fGap := DL_IGP_ZERO; // 间隙预置零 [工程单位] / preset the gap zero
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the fault flag false
_fLoA := DL_IGP_ZERO; // 归一下限 A 预置零 / preset the lower bound A zero
_fHiA := DL_IGP_ZERO; // 归一上限 A 预置零 / preset the upper bound A zero
_fLoB := DL_IGP_ZERO; // 归一下限 B 预置零 / preset the lower bound B zero
_fHiB := DL_IGP_ZERO; // 归一上限 B 预置零 / preset the upper bound B zero
_fTmp := DL_IGP_ZERO; // 对调临时量预置零 / preset the swap temporary zero
_fGapUse := DL_IGP_ZERO; // 间隙工作副本预置零 / preset the gap copy zero
_fEpsUse := DL_IGP_EPSDF; // 容差工作副本预置默认容差 / preset the tolerance copy to the default

// 段 2｜非有限闸与容差域闸（边界一 / 边界三，逐个点名，R272）/ segment 2, the finiteness gate and the tolerance gate
IF (fA1 <> fA1) OR ((fA1 - fA1) <> (fA1 - fA1))
OR (fA2 <> fA2) OR ((fA2 - fA2) <> (fA2 - fA2))
OR (fB1 <> fB1) OR ((fB1 - fB1) <> (fB1 - fB1))
OR (fB2 <> fB2) OR ((fB2 - fB2) <> (fB2 - fB2))
OR (fEps <> fEps) OR ((fEps - fEps) <> (fEps - fEps))
OR (fEps < DL_IGP_ZERO) THEN // 任一端点 / 容差非有限或容差为负 / any endpoint or the tolerance is not finite or negative
    eErr := 16#0001_0665; // 故障级：输入非有限或容差非法（出口同形合并一码，R90）/ fault grade under the merged code
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退，返回 eInvalid / early return with undecidable
END_IF
_fEpsUse := fEps; // 容差接管（已证非负有限）[工程单位] / take the tolerance proven nonnegative and finite

// 段 3｜端点归一（边界二：无序端点自动对调）/ segment 3, the endpoint normalisation with the auto swap
_fLoA := fA1; // A 下限暂存端点 1 / the A lower takes the endpoint one
_fHiA := fA2; // A 上限暂存端点 2 / the A upper takes the endpoint two
IF _fLoA > _fHiA THEN // A 端点逆序 / the A endpoints in reverse order
    _fTmp := _fLoA; // 暂存下限 / save the lower
    _fLoA := _fHiA; // 下限取原上限 / the lower takes the former upper
    _fHiA := _fTmp; // 上限取原下限 / the upper takes the former lower
END_IF
_fLoB := fB1; // B 下限暂存端点 1 / the B lower takes the endpoint one
_fHiB := fB2; // B 上限暂存端点 2 / the B upper takes the endpoint two
IF _fLoB > _fHiB THEN // B 端点逆序 / the B endpoints in reverse order
    _fTmp := _fLoB; // 暂存下限 / save the lower
    _fLoB := _fHiB; // 下限取原上限 / the lower takes the former upper
    _fHiB := _fTmp; // 上限取原下限 / the upper takes the former lower
END_IF

// 段 4｜关系与间隙判定（边界四：次序写死，相离 → 相接 → 包含 → 重叠）/ segment 4, the relation and gap in the frozen order
IF (_fLoB - _fHiA) > _fEpsUse THEN // B 整体在 A 右侧且存在正间隙 / the B sits right with a positive gap
    _fGapUse := _fLoB - _fHiA; // 间隙 = B 下限 − A 上限 [工程单位] / the gap of the B lower minus the A upper
    FC_DL_IntervalGapCalc := E_DL_IntervalGap.eDisjoint; // 相离关系 / the disjoint relation
ELSIF (_fLoA - _fHiB) > _fEpsUse THEN // A 整体在 B 右侧且存在正间隙 / the A sits right with a positive gap
    _fGapUse := _fLoA - _fHiB; // 间隙 = A 下限 − B 上限 [工程单位] / the gap of the A lower minus the B upper
    FC_DL_IntervalGapCalc := E_DL_IntervalGap.eDisjoint; // 相离关系 / the disjoint relation
ELSIF (ABS(_fHiA - _fLoB) < _fEpsUse) OR (ABS(_fHiB - _fLoA) < _fEpsUse) THEN // 端点几何重合（容差内）/ the endpoints coincide inside the tolerance
    _fGapUse := DL_IGP_ZERO; // 相接间隙为零 [工程单位] / the touching gap zero
    FC_DL_IntervalGapCalc := E_DL_IntervalGap.eTouching; // 相接关系 / the touching relation
ELSIF ((_fLoA <= _fLoB + _fEpsUse) AND (_fHiA >= _fHiB - _fEpsUse))
OR ((_fLoB <= _fLoA + _fEpsUse) AND (_fHiB >= _fHiA - _fEpsUse)) THEN // 一方包含另一方（含完全相等退化特例，边界五）/ one contains the other, an equality folded in
    _fGapUse := DL_IGP_ZERO; // 包含间隙为零 [工程单位] / the contained gap zero
    FC_DL_IntervalGapCalc := E_DL_IntervalGap.eContained; // 包含关系 / the contained relation
ELSE // 部分重叠（互不包含，间隙恒 0）/ a partial overlap with a zero gap
    _fGapUse := DL_IGP_ZERO; // 重叠间隙为零 [工程单位] / the overlap gap zero
    FC_DL_IntervalGapCalc := E_DL_IntervalGap.eOverlap; // 部分重叠关系 / the partial overlap relation
END_IF

// 段 5｜间隙非负钳位与统一出口（边界六）/ segment 5, the nonnegative clamp and the unified outlet
IF _fGapUse < DL_IGP_ZERO THEN // 舍入产生微小负值 / a tiny negative from the rounding
    _fGapUse := DL_IGP_ZERO; // 钳到 0，维持非负承诺 / clamp to zero, keep the promise
END_IF
fGap := _fGapUse; // 间隙出口 [工程单位] / the gap outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
END_FUNCTION

    0666 合并四类越域（计数 / 起点 / 源溢出 / 容量溢出）的理由：四场景出口
    组合完全相同（nCopied = 0、bValid = FALSE、目标数组零写回），三组以内
    输出无法唯一还原该场景，按 R90 不另立码。
  验收 Acceptance   :
    算法已证（脚本）：未跑 ｜ 编译器已证（三平台）：未跑
    V1 源 [1,2,3,4,5]、iStart = 2、nLen = 3 → 目标 [3,4,5]、nCopied = 3
    V2 iStart = 0、nLen = nSrcCount → 全量拷贝
    V3 nLen = nSrcCount - iStart + 1（源溢出）→ 码 0666 + 早退、目标原样
    V4 iStart = nSrcCount（起点越界）→ 同码早退
    V5 nSrcCount = 0 / 257 → 同码早退
    V6 别名调用：afSrc = afDst 同数组、源段与目标首段重叠 → 中转缓冲两段式
       无撕裂（V1 结果断言不变）
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R64 首版（批 2 · 序号 5，LGF Data Handling 段拷贝补口）

FUNCTION FC_DL_ArraySliceCopy : BOOL
VAR_IN_OUT
    afSrc : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL; // 源数组 [工程单位]，允许与目标同数组（别名调用走中转缓冲）/ the source array, may alias the target, the staging buffer covers it
    afDst : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL; // 目标数组 [工程单位]，从下标 0 起承接 / the target array, receives from the index zero
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    nSrcCount: DINT := 0; // 源有效长度 [个]，合法域 1..256 / the source effective length, legal one to two hundred fifty six
    iStart   : DINT := 0; // 源段起点 [下标]，合法域 0..nSrcCount - 1 / the source segment start index
    nLen     : DINT := 0; // 拷贝长度 [个]，合法域 1..min(nSrcCount - iStart, 256) / the copy length
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    nCopied: DINT;  // 实际拷贝数 [个]，失败 = 0 / the copied count, zero on failure
    bValid : BOOL;  // 结果可用 [-] / the result usable flag
    eErr   : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError : BOOL;  // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    k         : DINT := 0;               // 遍历索引 [下标] / the traversal index
    afStaging : ARRAY[0..255] OF LREAL;  // 中转缓冲 [工程单位]，两段式防重叠撕裂 / the staging buffer for the overlap safe two stage copy
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_ASC_NMAX : DINT := 256; // 数组容量上界 [个]，与数组容量一致 / the capacity aligned with the array
    DL_ASC_ONE  : DINT := 1;   // 整型一常量 [个] / the integer one constant
    DL_ASC_ZERO : DINT := 0;   // 整型零常量 [个] / the integer zero constant
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, the preset of the return and all outlets
FC_DL_ArraySliceCopy := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
nCopied := DL_ASC_ZERO; // 拷贝数预置零 [个] / preset the copied count zero
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the fault flag false
FOR k := DL_ASC_ZERO TO DL_ASC_NMAX - DL_ASC_ONE DO // 中转缓冲预清零（有界遍历全容量）/ preset the staging buffer zero over the full capacity
    afStaging[k] := 0.0; // 缓冲槽位显式清零 [工程单位] / clear the staging slot explicitly
END_FOR

// 段 2｜入参域闸（边界一：四类越域逐项点名，禁任何写回）/ segment 2, the input domain gate, no writeback on any violation
IF (nSrcCount < DL_ASC_ONE) OR (nSrcCount > DL_ASC_NMAX)
OR (iStart < DL_ASC_ZERO) OR (iStart > nSrcCount - DL_ASC_ONE)
OR (nLen < DL_ASC_ONE) OR (nLen > nSrcCount - iStart) OR (nLen > DL_ASC_NMAX) THEN // 计数 / 起点 / 长度任一越域 / the count or the start or the length is out of the domain
    eErr := 16#0001_0666; // 故障级：入参越域（四场景出口同形合并一码，R90）/ fault grade under the merged code
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退，目标数组零写回 / early return, the target untouched
END_IF

// 段 3｜中转缓冲承接源段（边界二：两段式第一段，读侧快照）/ segment 3, the staging buffer takes the source segment
FOR k := DL_ASC_ZERO TO nLen - DL_ASC_ONE DO // 有界遍历（上界已证 ≤ 256 且 ≤ 源余量）/ the bounded traversal with a proven ceiling
    afStaging[k] := afSrc[iStart + k]; // 源段读入缓冲 [工程单位]（快照语义）/ read the source segment into the staging buffer
END_FOR

// 段 4｜缓冲写回目标（边界二：两段式第二段，写侧顺序落位）/ segment 4, the staging buffer lands on the target
FOR k := DL_ASC_ZERO TO nLen - DL_ASC_ONE DO // 有界遍历（上界同段 3 已证）/ the bounded traversal with the same proven ceiling
    afDst[k] := afStaging[k]; // 缓冲整段写回目标首段 [工程单位] / land the staging segment onto the target head
END_FOR

// 段 5｜统一出口 / segment 5, the unified outlet
nCopied := nLen; // 实拷贝数出口 [个] / the copied count outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
FC_DL_ArraySliceCopy := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

TYPE E_DL_FlowUnit :
(
    eM3h   := 0, // 立方米每小时 [m³/h]（基准单位）/ the cubic meter per hour, the canonical unit
    eLmin  := 1, // 升每分钟 [L/min] / the liter per minute
    eNLmin := 2, // 标准升每分钟 [NL/min]，0°C / 101.325 kPa / the normal liter per minute at the normal state
    eScfm  := 3  // 标准立方英尺每分钟 [SCFM]，60°F / 1 atm / the standard cubic foot per minute
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION FC_DL_FlowUnitConvert : BOOL
VAR_INPUT
    fValue    : LREAL := 0.0;            // 入口流量值 [源单位]，必须有限 / the inlet flow value, must be finite
    eUnitFrom : E_DL_FlowUnit := E_DL_FlowUnit.eM3h;  // 源单位 [枚举] / the source unit
    eUnitTo   : E_DL_FlowUnit := E_DL_FlowUnit.eLmin;  // 目标单位 [枚举] / the target unit
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fResult: LREAL; // 换算结果 [目标单位]，失败 = 0 / the converted result, zero on failure
    bValid : BOOL;  // 结果可用 [-] / the result usable flag
    eErr   : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError : BOOL;  // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    fBase : LREAL := 0.0; // 基准量工作副本 [m³/h] / the canonical working copy in the cubic meter per hour
    fFromF: LREAL := 0.0; // 源单位因子 [（m³/h）/ 源单位] / the source unit factor to the canonical
    fToF  : LREAL := 0.0; // 目标单位因子 [（m³/h）/ 目标单位] / the target unit factor to the canonical
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_FUC_ZERO   : LREAL := 0.0;      // 实数零常量 [目标单位] / the real zero constant
    DL_FUC_M3H    : LREAL := 1.0;      // m³/h 基准因子 [（m³/h）/（m³/h）] / the canonical factor of itself
    DL_FUC_LMIN   : LREAL := 0.06;     // L/min 因子：1 L/min = 0.06 m³/h（60/1000）[（m³/h）/（L/min）] / the liter per minute factor
    DL_FUC_NLMIN  : LREAL := 0.06;     // NL/min 因子：1 NL/min = 0.06 m³/h（0°C / 101.325 kPa）[（m³/h）/（NL/min）] / the normal liter factor
    DL_FUC_SCFM   : LREAL := 1.699011; // SCFM 因子：1 SCFM = 0.0283168 × 60 m³/h（60°F / 1 atm，NIST 口径）[（m³/h）/（SCFM）] / the standard cubic foot factor
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, the preset of the return and all outlets
FC_DL_FlowUnitConvert := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
fResult := DL_FUC_ZERO; // 结果预置零 [目标单位] / preset the result zero
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the fault flag false
fBase := DL_FUC_ZERO; // 基准量预置零 [m³/h] / preset the canonical copy zero
fFromF := DL_FUC_M3H; // 源因子预置基准因子（ELSE 兜底口径）/ preset the source factor to the canonical
fToF := DL_FUC_M3H; // 目标因子预置基准因子（ELSE 兜底口径）/ preset the target factor to the canonical

// 段 2｜非有限闸（边界一）/ segment 2, the finiteness gate
IF (fValue <> fValue) OR ((fValue - fValue) <> (fValue - fValue)) THEN // 入口值非有限（NaN 或 ±Inf）/ the inlet value is not finite
    eErr := 16#0001_0667; // 故障级：非有限或单位越域（合并一码，R90）/ fault grade under the merged code
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 3｜源单位因子表（边界二：CASE ... ELSE 拦非法枚举）/ segment 3, the source factor table with the illegal guard
CASE eUnitFrom OF
    E_DL_FlowUnit.eM3h:   fFromF := DL_FUC_M3H;   // 基准因子 / the canonical factor
    E_DL_FlowUnit.eLmin:  fFromF := DL_FUC_LMIN;  // L/min 因子 / the liter per minute factor
    E_DL_FlowUnit.eNLmin: fFromF := DL_FUC_NLMIN; // NL/min 因子 / the normal liter factor
    E_DL_FlowUnit.eScfm:  fFromF := DL_FUC_SCFM;  // SCFM 因子 / the standard cubic foot factor
    ELSE // 非法枚举拦截（禁静默换算，边界二）/ the illegal enumeration guard
        eErr := 16#0001_0667; // 故障级：单位越域（与非有限同形出口，R90）/ fault grade, the unit out of the domain
        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
        RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_CASE

// 段 4｜目标单位因子表（边界二：CASE ... ELSE 拦非法枚举）/ segment 4, the target factor table with the illegal guard
CASE eUnitTo OF
    E_DL_FlowUnit.eM3h:   fToF := DL_FUC_M3H;   // 基准因子 / the canonical factor
    E_DL_FlowUnit.eLmin:  fToF := DL_FUC_LMIN;  // L/min 因子 / the liter per minute factor
    E_DL_FlowUnit.eNLmin: fToF := DL_FUC_NLMIN; // NL/min 因子 / the normal liter factor
    E_DL_FlowUnit.eScfm:  fToF := DL_FUC_SCFM;  // SCFM 因子 / the standard cubic foot factor
    ELSE // 非法枚举拦截（禁静默换算，边界二）/ the illegal enumeration guard
        eErr := 16#0001_0667; // 故障级：单位越域（与非有限同形出口，R90）/ fault grade, the unit out of the domain
        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
        RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_CASE

// 段 5｜两级换算（边界三：除子 fToF 为常量因子，因子表全部 > 0，除零不可达）/ segment 5, the two stage conversion with the proven constant divisor
fBase := fValue * fFromF; // 源单位 → m³/h 基准 [m³/h] / the source value to the canonical
fResult := fBase / fToF; // 基准 → 目标单位 [目标单位]（除子常量已证 > 0）/ the canonical to the target with the proven divisor
bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
FC_DL_FlowUnitConvert := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

                      互补件（互引）；本件为逐拍增量式运行口径（状态外置
                      结构体），统计族为窗内批处理口径，职责不同（R216）。
  归属 Ownership     : ST_DL_RunningSumState 属主为本文件（全库唯一定义，
                      R264）；引用件只引用不重声明。状态经 VAR_IN_OUT 外置，
                      本件零内部记忆量（FC 无实例态，纯 IEC 口径）。
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  边界 Boundary     :
                      一 状态外置契约：累计状态（主和 / 补偿项 / 拍数）由
                         调用方持有（ST_DL_RunningSumState 实例经 VAR_IN_OUT
                         传入），本件零内部记忆量；调用方须每拍以同一实例
                         调用，跨实例混用即口径破坏（头注释声明，不做运行
                         期甄别——FC 无法取得实例身份，无永假防御）；
                      二 非有限闸：fSample 非有限（NaN / ±Inf）→ 故障级
                         0668 + 状态冻结（主和 / 补偿 / 拍数本拍不动）+
                         bValid = FALSE + bError = TRUE；nMaxScans < 1
                         （组态非法）出口组合同形（本拍不累加、状态不动、
                         三件套），合并一码（反证句见码表）；
                      三 Kahan 补偿链：y = fSample − fComp；t = fSum + y；
                         fComp = (t − fSum) − y；fSum = t（防长序列累积
                         误差，每拍补偿项回吸）；
                      四 结果复检：Kahan 后 fSum 非有限（理论上不可达的
                         兜底，R258）→ 同码 0668 + 状态冻结 + 三件套；
                      五 拍数饱和（信息级 0669）：nScans 已达 nMaxScans 后
                         拍数计数饱和钳位不再推进，累加本身继续（拍数是
                         审计量不是累加门槛），置信息级 0669 不置 bError；
                      六 bReset 电平复位：主和 / 补偿 / 拍数 / 冻结标记
                         全量清账（复位优先于累加，回夹路径显式清账）；
                      七 无定时器、无边沿实例；无除法；无全局、无外部
                         变量、无物理地址。
  错误码 Codes      :
    16#0001_0668【故障级】fSample 非有限（状态冻结）或 nMaxScans < 1（组态
                         非法）或结果复检命中非有限（三场景出口同形，合并一码）
    16#0001_0669【信息级】拍数已达 nMaxScans 饱和钳位（累加继续，不置 bError）
  码位反证 Note     :
    0668 合并三场景（样本非有限 / 拍数上限组态非法 / 结果复检命中）的理由：
    三场景出口组合完全相同（状态四元组本拍不动、bValid = FALSE、bError =
    TRUE），三组以内输出无法唯一还原该场景，按 R90 不另立码；0669 与 0668
    分立：0669 出口 bValid = TRUE（累加继续），bValid 可唯一区分。
  验收 Acceptance   :
    算法已证（脚本）：未跑 ｜ 编译器已证（三平台）：未跑
    V1 累加 1.0 × 10 拍 → fSum = 10.0、nScans = 10
    V2 长序列误差向量：1.0E16 起 +1.0 累加 1000 拍 → Kahan fSum 精度优于
       朴素累加（与 FC_DL_SignalStatistics 直和对比断言）
    V3 fSample = NaN 单拍 → 码 0668 + fSum 不动 + bError = TRUE，下一拍
       恢复正常样本继续累加（NaN 输入冻结不粘滞）
    V4 nMaxScans = 5、累加 8 拍 → nScans = 5（饱和）、fSum 照常推进、
       码 0669（bError = FALSE）
    V5 nMaxScans = 0 → 码 0668 + 状态不动
    V6 bReset 一拍 → fSum / fComp / nScans 全量清零
  修订记录 Revision  :
    2026-11-21  v1.0.0  R64 首版（批 2 · 序号 7，T0 统计族补口，Kahan 增量口径）
  ==================================================================
*)
TYPE ST_DL_RunningSumState :
STRUCT
    fSum   : LREAL := 0.0; // Kahan 主和 [工程单位] / the kahan main sum
    fComp  : LREAL := 0.0; // Kahan 补偿项 [工程单位]（每拍回吸损失）/ the kahan compensation term
    nScans : DINT   := 0;  // 累计拍数 [拍]（饱和上限 nMaxScans）/ the accumulated scan count saturated at the ceiling
    bFrozen: BOOL   := FALSE; // 状态冻结标记（非有限冻结期累计挂起）/ the frozen flag suspending the accumulation
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE

FUNCTION FC_DL_RunningSumCalc : BOOL
VAR_IN_OUT
    stState : ST_DL_RunningSumState; // 累计状态（调用方持有，须每拍同一实例）/ the accumulation state owned by the caller with the same instance every scan
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    fSample   : LREAL := 0.0; // 本拍样本 [工程单位]，必须有限 / the sample of this scan, must be finite
    nMaxScans : DINT   := 0;  // 拍数饱和上限 [拍]，须 ≥ 1，0 = 未组态（判故障）/ the scan ceiling, at least one, zero means unconfigured
    bReset    : BOOL  := FALSE; // 复位电平，TRUE 拍全量清账（复位优先于累加）/ the reset level clearing the whole state first
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fSum   : LREAL; // 累加和出口 [工程单位] / the running sum outlet
    nScans : DINT;  // 累计拍数出口 [拍]（饱和口径）/ the scan count outlet saturated
    bValid : BOOL;  // 结果可用 [-] / the result usable flag
    eErr   : UDINT; // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError : BOOL;  // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    fY : LREAL := 0.0; // Kahan 增量工作副本（样本 − 补偿）[工程单位] / the kahan increment copy of the sample minus the compensation
    fT : LREAL := 0.0; // Kahan 中间和工作副本 [工程单位] / the kahan intermediate sum copy
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_RSC_ZERO : LREAL := 0.0; // 实数零常量 [工程单位] / the real zero constant
    DL_RSC_ZEROI: DINT   := 0;  // 整型零常量 [拍] / the integer zero constant
    DL_RSC_ONEI : DINT   := 1;  // 整型一常量 [拍] / the integer one constant
END_VAR

// 段 1｜返回值与全部出口预置安全值（R45 四段式第一段）/ segment 1, the preset of the return and all outlets
FC_DL_RunningSumCalc := FALSE; // 返回值预置假 / preset the return false
fSum := stState.fSum; // 和出口预置为现行状态值（冻结 / 复位口径的基线）[工程单位] / preset the sum outlet from the current state
nScans := stState.nScans; // 拍数出口预置为现行状态值 [拍] / preset the count outlet from the current state
bValid := FALSE; // 可用标志预置假 / preset the validity false
eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 错误码预置正常 / preset the code to ok
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / preset the fault flag false
fY := DL_RSC_ZERO; // Kahan 增量预置零 [工程单位] / preset the kahan increment zero
fT := DL_RSC_ZERO; // Kahan 中间和预置零 [工程单位] / preset the kahan intermediate zero

// 段 2｜复位优先段（边界六：全量清账，复位优先于累加与一切闸）/ segment 2, the reset first with the full clearing
IF bReset THEN // 复位电平有效 / the reset level is active
    stState.fSum := DL_RSC_ZERO; // 主和清账 [工程单位] / clear the main sum
    stState.fComp := DL_RSC_ZERO; // 补偿项清账 [工程单位] / clear the compensation
    stState.nScans := DL_RSC_ZEROI; // 拍数清账 [拍] / clear the scan count
    stState.bFrozen := FALSE; // 冻结标记清账 / clear the frozen flag
    fSum := DL_RSC_ZERO; // 和出口同步清零 [工程单位] / sync the sum outlet zero
    nScans := DL_RSC_ZEROI; // 拍数出口同步清零 [拍] / sync the count outlet zero
    bValid := TRUE; // 复位是合法可用结果 / the reset is a legit usable result
    FC_DL_RunningSumCalc := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
    RETURN; // 早退（复位拍不累加）/ early return, no accumulation on the reset scan
END_IF

// 段 3｜非有限闸与组态闸（边界二：两场景出口同形合并一码，状态冻结）/ segment 3, the finiteness gate and the configuration gate freezing the state
IF (fSample <> fSample) OR ((fSample - fSample) <> (fSample - fSample))
OR (nMaxScans < DL_RSC_ONEI) THEN // 样本非有限或拍数上限组态非法 / the sample is not finite or the ceiling is misconfigured
    stState.bFrozen := TRUE; // 置状态冻结（本拍累计挂起）/ raise the frozen flag
    eErr := 16#0001_0668; // 故障级：非有限或组态非法（合并一码，R90）/ fault grade under the merged code
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退，状态四元组本拍不动 / early return, the state untouched this scan
END_IF

// 段 4｜Kahan 补偿累加（边界三；冻结期挂起，恢复后自动续计）/ segment 4, the kahan compensated accumulation
IF NOT stState.bFrozen THEN // 未冻结才累加 / accumulate only when not frozen
    fY := fSample - stState.fComp; // 增量 = 样本 − 补偿项 [工程单位] / the increment of the sample minus the compensation
    fT := stState.fSum + fY; // 中间和 [工程单位] / the intermediate sum
    stState.fComp := (fT - stState.fSum) - fY; // 补偿项回吸本轮舍入损失 [工程单位] / the compensation sucking back the rounding loss
    stState.fSum := fT; // 主和推进 [工程单位] / advance the main sum
    IF stState.nScans < nMaxScans THEN // 拍数未达上限 / the count below the ceiling
        stState.nScans := stState.nScans + DL_RSC_ONEI; // 拍数推进 [拍] / advance the scan count
    ELSE // 拍数已达上限：饱和钳位 + 信息级（累加继续，边界五）/ the count saturated with the info code, the accumulation continues
        eErr := 16#0001_0669; // 信息级：拍数饱和钳位（R285）/ informational, the count is saturated
        bError := FALSE; // 信息级不置故障标志 / keep the fault flag false, this is informational
    END_IF
ELSE // 冻结期（上拍非有限命中后本拍已过闸，自动解冻续计）/ the frozen period auto releases after the gate passed
    stState.bFrozen := FALSE; // 解冻（非有限输入冻结不粘滞，恢复路径可达）/ release the frozen flag, the recovery is reachable
    fY := fSample - stState.fComp; // 解冻拍照常累加 [工程单位] / accumulate as usual on the release scan
    fT := stState.fSum + fY; // 中间和 [工程单位] / the intermediate sum
    stState.fComp := (fT - stState.fSum) - fY; // 补偿项回吸 [工程单位] / the compensation
    stState.fSum := fT; // 主和推进 [工程单位] / advance the main sum
    IF stState.nScans < nMaxScans THEN // 拍数未达上限 / the count below the ceiling
        stState.nScans := stState.nScans + DL_RSC_ONEI; // 拍数推进 [拍] / advance the scan count
    ELSE // 拍数饱和（信息级，累加继续）/ the count saturated, the accumulation continues
        eErr := 16#0001_0669; // 信息级：拍数饱和钳位 / informational, the count is saturated
        bError := FALSE; // 信息级不置故障标志 / keep the fault flag false
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 5｜结果复检兜底（边界四：理论上不可达，R258 三件套 + 状态冻结）/ segment 5, the result recheck with the three part fallback
IF (stState.fSum <> stState.fSum) OR ((stState.fSum - stState.fSum) <> (stState.fSum - stState.fSum)) THEN // 主和非有限（兜底防御）/ the main sum is not finite
    stState.bFrozen := TRUE; // 置状态冻结 / raise the frozen flag
    eErr := 16#0001_0668; // 故障级：结果复检命中（同形合并一码，R90）/ fault grade under the merged code
    bError := TRUE; // 置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag
    bValid := FALSE; // 结果不可用 / the result is not usable
    RETURN; // 早退，状态冻结 / early return with the state frozen
END_IF

// 段 6｜统一出口 / segment 6, the unified outlet
fSum := stState.fSum; // 和出口 [工程单位] / the sum outlet
nScans := stState.nScans; // 拍数出口 [拍] / the count outlet
bValid := TRUE; // 结果可用 / the result is usable
FC_DL_RunningSumCalc := TRUE; // 返回成功 / return success
END_FUNCTION

TYPE E_DL_DualValvePhase :
(
    eIdle  := 0,  // 待机：等指令 / idle, waiting for the command
    eRun   := 10, // 运行监视：指令生效，两路反馈一致窗监视 / the run phase with the mismatch window supervision
    eFault := 20  // 锁存故障：不一致超窗或非法态，复位沿解除 / a latched fault released by the reset edge
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_DualValveBlockSet
VAR_INPUT

    bOpenCmd    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 开阀指令 [-]，双阀统一下发 / the open command issued to both valves
    bFbValveA   : BOOL := FALSE;  // 阀 A 位置反馈 [-] / the position feedback of the valve A
    bFbValveB   : BOOL := FALSE;  // 阀 B 位置反馈 [-] / the position feedback of the valve B
    bResetCmd   : BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存回 eIdle（边界四解除式）/ the fault reset level, its rising edge releases the latch
    tMismatchWin: TIME := T#10S;  // 不一致监视窗 [毫秒]，须 > 0 且大于双阀响应差上限 / the mismatch window, positive and above the response spread
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bValveCmd      : BOOL := FALSE;          // 阀组指令出口 [-]（故障 / 失能强制切断，边界五）/ the valve command outlet cut off on a fault or disable
    bInSync        : BOOL := FALSE;          // 双反馈同步 [-] / the two feedbacks in sync
    bMismatchFault : BOOL := FALSE;          // 不一致故障（锁存）[-] / the latched mismatch fault
    eState         : E_DL_DualValvePhase;    // 状态机出口 [状态] / the state machine outlet
    bValid         : BOOL := FALSE;          // 判据可用 [-] / the criteria are usable
    eErr           : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError         : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;  // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _eState     : E_DL_DualValvePhase := E_DL_DualValvePhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bFaultLatch: BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _uLatch     : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 故障码锁存 [码]（复位沿清除，FB33-1）/ the latched fault code cleared by the reset edge
    _bMismatch  : BOOL := FALSE;  // 反馈不一致电平（逐拍重算）/ the mismatch level recomputed every scan
    _bCfgBad    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    rtReset     : R_TRIG;         // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新（R7）/ the reset edge instance refreshed unconditionally
    tonMismatch : TON;            // 不一致窗定时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the mismatch window timer refreshed unconditionally
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_DVP_TIME0 : TIME := T#0S;        // 时间零常量 [毫秒] / the time zero constant
    DL_DVP_ZEROU : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 码零常量 / the code zero constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7；监视 TON 串锁存门控，FB50-1）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtReset(CLK := bResetCmd); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
_bMismatch := (bFbValveA <> bFbValveB); // 不一致电平逐拍重算（BOOL 直比无容差问题）/ the mismatch level recomputed, a plain boolean compare
tonMismatch(IN := _bMismatch AND (NOT _bFaultLatch), PT := tMismatchWin); // 不一致窗计时（串锁存门控防复位同拍重锁）/ the mismatch window with the latch gate

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与复位沿作用域（R310 / R311）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the reset edge scope
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _eState := E_DL_DualValvePhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _uLatch := DL_DVP_ZEROU; // 码锁存显式清零 / clear the latched code explicitly
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域声明：清锁存 + 迁相位，R311）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 清故障锁存（唯一解除路径，边界四自证可达）/ clear the fault latch, the only release path
    _uLatch := DL_DVP_ZEROU; // 清码锁存 / clear the latched code
    _eState := E_DL_DualValvePhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
END_IF

// 段 2｜组态域闸结构早退（边界一，族② 判据：tMismatchWin 逐项点名）/ segment 2, the structural early exit on an illegal configuration
_bCfgBad := (tMismatchWin <= DL_DVP_TIME0); // 组态非法（窗非正）/ an illegal configuration
IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态非法：结构早退（出口三件套 + RETURN）/ an illegal configuration exits structurally
    eState := _eState; // 状态照实出口（冻结）/ export the state as is
    bValveCmd := FALSE; // 指令出口切断（组态非法期禁下发）/ cut the command outlet off
    bInSync := NOT _bMismatch; // 同步位照实 / the sync bit as is
    bMismatchFault := _bFaultLatch; // 故障锁存照实回放 / replay the latch
    bValid := FALSE; // 判据不可用 / the criteria are not usable
    eErr := 16#0003_072D; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, an illegal configuration
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 结构早退 / the structural early exit
END_IF

// 段 3｜失能分支：强制 eIdle + 双出口复位，不 faults（边界六声明行）/ segment 3, the disabled branch
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    _eState := E_DL_DualValvePhase.eIdle; // 强制空闲 / force the idle
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 锁存复位（使能断开 ≠ 阀组故障）/ clear the latch
    _uLatch := DL_DVP_ZEROU; // 码锁存复位 / clear the code
    eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
    bValveCmd := FALSE; // 指令出口复位 / the command outlet resets
    bInSync := FALSE; // 同步位复位（失能不声明同步）/ the sync bit resets
    bMismatchFault := FALSE; // 故障位复位 / the fault bit resets
    bValid := FALSE; // 失能即不可用 / the criteria are not usable while disabled
    bError := FALSE; // 失能不是故障 / a disabled device is not a fault
    eErr := DL_DVP_ZEROU; // 失能不发码 / no code is emitted while disabled
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 4｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 兜底；本拍事件优先于超时迁移，R275）/ segment 4, the main machine
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_DualValvePhase.eIdle: // 空闲相 / the idle phase
        IF bOpenCmd AND (NOT _bFaultLatch) AND (NOT _bCfgBad) THEN // 指令电平 + 全量闸位复检（R274）/ the command with the full gate recheck
            _eState := E_DL_DualValvePhase.eRun; // 迁入运行监视相 / enter the run phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_DualValvePhase.eRun: // 运行监视相（本拍合法事件优先：反馈归队先消化，再消化超窗，R275）/ the run phase, the event before the timeout
        IF NOT bOpenCmd THEN // 事件优先：指令撤回 / the command withdrawn, the event goes first
            _eState := E_DL_DualValvePhase.eIdle; // 回空闲（监视件不锁运行态）/ back to idle
        ELSIF tonMismatch.Q THEN // 不一致持续超窗（卡滞 / 开关故障判据）/ the mismatch stayed through the window
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
            _uLatch := 16#0003_072E; // 故障级：不一致超窗 / fault grade, the mismatch through the window
            bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 6 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        END_IF
    E_DL_DualValvePhase.eFault: // 锁存故障相（驻留，解除由段 1 复位沿承担）/ the fault phase dwelling, the release belongs to the reset edge
        ; // 驻留语义由注释表达（禁自赋值死语句，R261）/ the dwell is expressed by this comment without a dead statement
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截（边界二：落故障相并锁存，禁静默）/ the illegal enumeration guard
        _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
        _uLatch := 16#0003_072D; // 故障级：非法状态拦截（归入组态族一码，出口同形，R90）/ fault grade, the illegal state in the configuration family
        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        _eState := E_DL_DualValvePhase.eFault; // 落故障相 / force the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 5｜故障锁存迁移闸（置于解除段之后防同拍抢迁，R258）/ segment 5, the latch to phase gate
IF _bFaultLatch AND (_eState <> E_DL_DualValvePhase.eFault) THEN // 已锁存但不在故障相 / latched outside the fault phase
    _eState := E_DL_DualValvePhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相 / enter the fault phase
END_IF

// 段 6｜统一出口（名实双出口同源，R191）/ segment 6, the unified outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bValveCmd := bOpenCmd AND (NOT _bFaultLatch); // 指令出口与锁存同源切断（边界五安全语义）/ the command outlet cut off with the latch
bInSync := NOT _bMismatch; // 同步位与不一致电平同源取反 / the sync bit inverted from the mismatch level
bMismatchFault := _bFaultLatch; // 故障位与锁存同源 / the fault bit from the latch
bValid := NOT _bFaultLatch; // 判据可用（无锁存故障）/ usable without a latch
IF _bFaultLatch THEN // 故障锁存回放优先（不在故障相按当下输入重新推断，R152）/ the latched fault replays first
    bValid := FALSE; // 故障相不可用 / not usable in the fault phase
    bError := TRUE; // 故障位置位（R45 配对）/ raise the fault bit
    eErr := _uLatch; // 锁存码回放 / replay the latched code
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    eErr := DL_DVP_ZEROU; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 返工批拦截闸（返工标记登记 + 复检放行计数 + 越权放行锁存）：真实工况为 ISA-88 批次返工流程中未复检批次的流出拦截。边界：nQuotaMax<1 钳位接管为 1（R90 反证句：出口与正常运行完全同形不另立码，头注释写死）；bReworkMark 登记后 bReleaseReq 直通被拒（拦截闸核心语义）+ 信息级码；bRecheckOk 上升沿消耗配额递减，配额耗尽后再放行 → 越权放行故障锁存 _bOverrideLatch，bResetCmd 上升沿解除式自证可达（终审两式 1，头注释写明）；批号切换沿自动清登记与配额（防跨批残留）；非有限计数入参组态早退。
architecture_thought: 有状态拦截闸 FB：登记-拦截-复检-放行四态纯电平逻辑（无定时器，全沿检测经 R_TRIG 段 0 无条件刷新）；配额递减消耗模型；越权放行锁存 + 解除式自证（可达路径头注释写明防 R90 永假防御）；批号切换沿清账（防跨批残留，R261 计数派生口径）；nQuotaMax 钳位接管 1（R90 反证句注释）。

TYPE E_DL_ReworkGatePhase :
(
    eIdle       := 0,  // 待机：无返工登记 / idle, no rework registered
    eReworkHold := 10, // 返工拦截：登记生效，等复检合格 / the rework hold, waiting for the recheck pass
    eReleased   := 20, // 放行：合规放行相（登记撤除或复检合格放行后驻留一拍语义由调用方承接）/ the released phase
    eFault      := 30  // 锁存故障：越权放行或非法态，复位沿解除 / a latched fault released by the reset edge
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_ReworkLotGate
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;  // 使能，FALSE 时强制 eIdle + 双出口复位（边界五）/ the enable, false forces the idle and resets both outlets
    bLotRework   : BOOL := FALSE; // 返工标记登记电平 [-]（来自批次履历）/ the rework registration level from the lot history
    bRecheckPass : BOOL := FALSE; // 复检合格电平 [-] / the recheck pass level
    bReleaseCmd  : BOOL := FALSE; // 放行指令电平 [-] / the release command level
    bResetCmd    : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存回 eIdle（边界三解除式）/ the fault reset level, its rising edge releases the latch
    nQuotaMax    : DINT  := 16;   // 放行计数饱和上限 [个]，须 ≥ 1，< 1 钳位接管为 1（边界一定稿）/ the release count ceiling, at least one, clamped when below
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bReleaseAllow : BOOL := FALSE;           // 放行许可电平 [-]（锁存 / 失能强制 FALSE）/ the release permission forced false on a latch or disable
    bReworkHold   : BOOL := FALSE;           // 返工拦截中指示 [-] / the rework hold indicator
    nReleased     : DINT  := 0;              // 合规放行计数 [个]（饱和口径）/ the compliant release count saturated
    eState        : E_DL_ReworkGatePhase;    // 状态机出口 [状态] / the state machine outlet
    bValid        : BOOL := FALSE;           // 判据可用 [-] / the criteria are usable
    eErr          : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;   // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError        : BOOL := FALSE;           // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;  // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _eState     : E_DL_ReworkGatePhase := E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bFaultLatch: BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _uLatch     : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 故障码锁存 [码]（复位沿清除，FB33-1）/ the latched fault code cleared by the reset edge
    _nReleased  : DINT  := 0;     // 计数内部副本 [个]（饱和钳位口径）/ the internal count copy saturated
    _nQuotaUse  : DINT  := 1;     // 上限接管量 [个]（< 1 钳位为 1，边界一）/ the ceiling taken over clamped to one
    _bCountSat  : BOOL := FALSE;  // 计数饱和标记（单拍信息位，段 6 映射）/ the count saturation flag of this scan
    rtReset     : R_TRIG;         // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新（R7）/ the reset edge instance refreshed unconditionally
    rtRelease   : R_TRIG;         // 合规放行沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新 / the compliant release edge instance refreshed unconditionally
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_RLG_ZEROI: DINT  := 0;  // 整型零常量 [个] / the integer zero constant
    DL_RLG_ONEI : DINT  := 1;  // 整型一常量 [个] / the integer one constant
    DL_RLG_ZEROU: UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 码零常量 / the code zero constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7）/ segment 0, the unconditional edge refresh
rtReset(CLK := bResetCmd); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
rtRelease(CLK := bReleaseCmd AND NOT _bFaultLatch AND bEnable
                 AND (NOT bLotRework OR bRecheckPass)); // 合规放行沿（登记撤除或复检合格的放行指令上升沿，R275 事件优先口径）/ the compliant release edge of the legal command

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与复位沿作用域（R310 / R311）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the reset edge scope
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _eState := E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _uLatch := DL_RLG_ZEROU; // 码锁存显式清零 / clear the latched code explicitly
    _nReleased := DL_RLG_ZEROI; // 计数显式清零 [个] / clear the count explicitly
    _nQuotaUse := DL_RLG_ONEI; // 上限接管显式置一 [个] / preset the ceiling one explicitly
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域声明：清锁存 + 迁相位，不清计数——计数是审计台账，R311）/ the reset edge with the declared scope, the audit count survives
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 清故障锁存（唯一解除路径，边界三自证可达）/ clear the fault latch, the only release path
    _uLatch := DL_RLG_ZEROU; // 清码锁存 / clear the latched code
    _eState := E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
END_IF

// 段 2｜上限接管与计数饱和预置（边界一：nQuotaMax < 1 钳位接管为 1，功能不静默丢失）/ segment 2, the ceiling take over and the saturation preset
_nQuotaUse := nQuotaMax; // 上限接管 [个] / take the ceiling
IF _nQuotaUse < DL_RLG_ONEI THEN // 上限 < 1（组态缺省）/ the ceiling below one
    _nQuotaUse := DL_RLG_ONEI; // 钳位接管为 1（拦截闸仍有完整语义）/ clamp to one, the gate keeps its full semantics
END_IF
_bCountSat := FALSE; // 计数饱和标记预清零（单拍信息位，R256 统一出口预置）/ preset the saturation flag false

// 段 3｜失能分支：强制 eIdle + 双出口复位，不 faults（边界五声明行）/ segment 3, the disabled branch
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    _eState := E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eIdle; // 强制空闲 / force the idle
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 锁存复位（使能断开 ≠ 合规故障）/ clear the latch
    _uLatch := DL_RLG_ZEROU; // 码锁存复位 / clear the code
    eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
    bReleaseAllow := FALSE; // 许可电平复位 / the permission resets
    bReworkHold := FALSE; // 拦截指示复位 / the hold indicator resets
    bValid := FALSE; // 失能即不可用 / the criteria are not usable while disabled
    bError := FALSE; // 失能不是故障 / a disabled device is not a fault
    eErr := DL_RLG_ZEROU; // 失能不发码 / no code is emitted while disabled
    RETURN; // 早退（计数不动，失能不清审计台账）/ early return, the audit count survives
END_IF

// 段 4｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 兜底；本拍事件优先于越权判据，R275）/ segment 4, the main machine, the event before the misuse verdict
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eIdle: // 空闲相 / the idle phase
        IF bLotRework THEN // 返工登记生效 / the rework registration is active
            _eState := E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eReworkHold; // 迁入拦截相 / enter the hold phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eReworkHold: // 返工拦截相（本拍合法事件优先：登记撤除或复检合格放行先消化，再消化越权判据，R275）/ the hold phase, the legal event before the misuse
        IF NOT bLotRework THEN // 事件优先：登记撤除 / the registration withdrawn, the event goes first
            _eState := E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
        ELSIF bRecheckPass AND bReleaseCmd THEN // 复检合格 + 放行指令（合规放行，边界四口径）/ the recheck passed with the release command
            _eState := E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eReleased; // 迁入放行相 / enter the released phase
        ELSIF bReleaseCmd THEN // 越权判据：登记中放行且复检未合格（真实可达：操作员越过复检直接放令）/ the misuse path, reachable by the operator bypassing the recheck
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
            _uLatch := 16#0006_3036; // 故障级：越权放行 / fault grade, the unauthorized release
            bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 6 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        END_IF
    E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eReleased: // 放行相（登记撤除或再登记由电平驱动回迁）/ the released phase driven back by the levels
        IF bLotRework THEN // 再次登记 / registered again
            _eState := E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eReworkHold; // 迁回拦截相 / back to the hold phase
        ELSIF NOT bReleaseCmd THEN // 放行指令撤回 / the release command withdrawn
            _eState := E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
        END_IF
    E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eFault: // 锁存故障相（驻留，解除由段 1 复位沿承担）/ the fault phase dwelling, the release belongs to the reset edge
        ; // 驻留语义由注释表达（禁自赋值死语句，R261）/ the dwell is expressed by this comment without a dead statement
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截（边界二：落故障相并锁存，禁静默）/ the illegal enumeration guard
        _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
        _uLatch := 16#0006_3036; // 故障级：非法状态拦截（归入越权族一码，出口同形锁存回放，R90）/ fault grade, the illegal state under the latch family
        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        _eState := E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eFault; // 落故障相 / force the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 5｜合规放行计数（边界四：沿 + 未锁存才计数；饱和钳位 + 信息级）/ segment 5, the compliant release counting with the saturation
IF rtRelease.Q AND (NOT _bFaultLatch) THEN // 合规放行沿且未锁存 / a compliant release edge without a latch
    IF _nReleased < _nQuotaUse THEN // 计数未达上限 / the count below the ceiling
        _nReleased := _nReleased + DL_RLG_ONEI; // 计数推进 [个] / advance the count
    ELSE // 计数已达上限：饱和钳位 + 信息级（闸功能不受影响，边界四）/ the count saturated with the info code, the gate unaffected
        _bCountSat := TRUE; // 置饱和标记（单拍信息位）/ raise the saturation flag
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 6｜故障锁存迁移闸 + 统一出口（名实双出口同源，R191）/ segment 6, the latch gate and the unified outlet
IF _bFaultLatch AND (_eState <> E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eFault) THEN // 已锁存但不在故障相 / latched outside the fault phase
    _eState := E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相 / enter the fault phase
END_IF
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bReleaseAllow := (NOT _bFaultLatch) AND bEnable
              AND ((NOT bLotRework) OR bRecheckPass); // 许可电平与判据同源派生（登记中须复检合格）/ the permission derived from the criteria
bReworkHold := (_eState = E_DL_ReworkGatePhase.eReworkHold); // 拦截指示与状态同源 / the hold indicator from the state
nReleased := _nReleased; // 计数出口 [个] / the count outlet
IF _bFaultLatch THEN // 故障锁存回放优先（不在故障相按当下输入重新推断，R152）/ the latched fault replays first
    bValid := FALSE; // 故障相不可用 / not usable in the fault phase
    bError := TRUE; // 故障位置位（R45 配对）/ raise the fault bit
    eErr := _uLatch; // 锁存码回放 / replay the latched code
ELSIF _bCountSat THEN // 计数饱和（信息级，单拍重算）/ the saturation, informational
    bValid := TRUE; // 闸功能照常可用 / the gate stays usable
    bError := FALSE; // 信息级不置故障标志（R285）/ keep the fault flag false
    eErr := 16#0006_3037; // 信息级：放行计数饱和钳位 / informational, the count saturated
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    bValid := TRUE; // 判据可用 / the criteria are usable
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    eErr := DL_RLG_ZEROU; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 理瓶整理顺控（乱瓶分拣相序 + 卡瓶监视窗 + 料满停进）：真实工况为包装线理瓶机启停与异常处置时序。边界：五相状态机（eIdle/eFeed/eJammed/eFull/eFault）CASE + ELSE 兜底落 eFault；卡瓶判据 bBottlingSensor 无变化持续 tJamWin 经 TON（段 0 无条件刷新）确认 → eJammed，恢复沿 OR 撤令双路退出（防推进/超时同源静默挂死，R298 规则）；料满 eFull 停进料输出但保序（撤令回 eIdle）；组态闸 tJamWin<=0 或非有限早退；bResetCmd 解除式自证可达（头注释写明）；输出（振动盘/分拣）在 eFault/eIdle 双出口强制归零。

TYPE E_DL_UnscrPhase :
(
    eIdle  := 0,  // 待机：等启动 / idle, waiting for the start
    eFeed  := 10, // 进瓶整理：进料出口有效，等相驻留 / the feed phase with the feed outlet
    eSort  := 20, // 乱瓶分拣：分拣出口有效，等完成信号 / the sort phase with the sort outlet
    eReady := 30, // 整理完成：双出口复位，等再启动或停止 / the ready phase with both outlets reset
    eFault := 40  // 锁存故障：卡瓶超窗或非法态，复位沿解除 / a latched fault released by the reset edge
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_UnscramblerSeq
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable    : BOOL := TRUE;   // 使能，FALSE 时强制 eIdle + 双出口复位（边界六）/ the enable, false forces the idle and resets both outlets
    bStart     : BOOL := FALSE;  // 启动电平 [-]（eReady / eIdle 相生效）/ the start level valid in the ready and idle phases
    bSortEn    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 分拣使能电平 [-]（eFeed → eSort 的迁移前提）/ the sort enable as the transition premise
    bSortDone  : BOOL := FALSE;  // 分拣完成电平 [-]（eSort → eReady 的事件）/ the sort done event of the sort phase
    bJamSense  : BOOL := FALSE;  // 卡瓶检测电平 [-] / the jam detection level
    bHopperFull: BOOL := FALSE;  // 料满电平 [-]（满仓停进，不 faults，边界五）/ the hopper full level stopping the feed without a fault
    bResetCmd  : BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存回 eIdle（边界四解除式）/ the fault reset level, its rising edge releases the latch
    tJamWin    : TIME := T#3S;   // 卡瓶监视窗 [毫秒]，须 > 0 / the jam window, positive
    tPhaseMin  : TIME := T#2S;   // 相最短驻留 [毫秒]，须 > 0 / the minimum phase dwell, positive
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bFeedOut : BOOL := FALSE;           // 进料出口 [-]（料满 / 故障 / 失能强制 FALSE）/ the feed outlet forced false on full, fault or disable
    bSortOut : BOOL := FALSE;           // 分拣出口 [-]（故障 / 失能强制 FALSE）/ the sort outlet forced false on a fault or disable
    bJamFault: BOOL := FALSE;           // 卡瓶故障（锁存）[-] / the latched jam fault
    eState   : E_DL_UnscrPhase;         // 状态机出口 [状态] / the state machine outlet
    bValid   : BOOL := FALSE;           // 判据可用 [-] / the criteria are usable
    eErr     : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;   // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError   : BOOL := FALSE;           // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;  // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _eState     : E_DL_UnscrPhase := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bFaultLatch: BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _uLatch     : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 故障码锁存 [码]（复位沿清除，FB33-1）/ the latched fault code cleared by the reset edge
    _bCfgBad    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    _bHold      : BOOL := FALSE;  // 料满挂相标记（料满期相驻留计时同步挂起，边界五）/ the hold flag suspending the dwell timer on full
    rtReset     : R_TRIG;         // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新（R7）/ the reset edge instance refreshed unconditionally
    tonJam      : TON;            // 卡瓶监视窗定时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the jam window timer refreshed unconditionally
    tonPhase    : TON;            // 相最短驻留定时器（最短驻留门槛口径，边界七）/ the phase dwell floor timer
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_UNP_TIME0 : TIME := T#0S;          // 时间零常量 [毫秒] / the time zero constant
    DL_UNP_ZEROU : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 码零常量 / the code zero constant
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7；监视 TON 串锁存门控，FB50-1）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtReset(CLK := bResetCmd); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
tonJam(IN := (( _eState = E_DL_UnscrPhase.eFeed) OR (_eState = E_DL_UnscrPhase.eSort))
          AND bJamSense AND (NOT _bFaultLatch), PT := tJamWin); // 卡瓶窗计时（仅进瓶 / 分拣相有效，串锁存门控防复位同拍重锁）/ the jam window only in the feed and sort phases with the latch gate
tonPhase(IN := (( _eState = E_DL_UnscrPhase.eFeed) OR (_eState = E_DL_UnscrPhase.eSort))
          AND (NOT _bHold) AND (NOT _bFaultLatch), PT := tPhaseMin); // 相驻留计时（料满挂相机同步挂起，边界五；最短驻留门槛口径，边界七）/ the dwell timer suspended on the hold, a floor not a timeout source

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与复位沿作用域（R310 / R311）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the reset edge scope
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _eState := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _uLatch := DL_UNP_ZEROU; // 码锁存显式清零 / clear the latched code explicitly
    _bHold := FALSE; // 挂相标记显式清零 / clear the hold flag explicitly
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域声明：清锁存 + 迁相位 + 清挂相，R311）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 清故障锁存（唯一解除路径，边界四自证可达）/ clear the fault latch, the only release path
    _uLatch := DL_UNP_ZEROU; // 清码锁存 / clear the latched code
    _eState := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
    _bHold := FALSE; // 清挂相标记 / clear the hold flag
END_IF

// 段 2｜组态域闸结构早退（边界一，族② 判据：两时限逐项点名）/ segment 2, the structural early exit on an illegal configuration
_bCfgBad := (tJamWin <= DL_UNP_TIME0) OR (tPhaseMin <= DL_UNP_TIME0); // 组态非法（任一窗非正）/ an illegal configuration
IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态非法：结构早退（出口三件套 + RETURN）/ an illegal configuration exits structurally
    eState := _eState; // 状态照实出口（冻结）/ export the state as is
    bFeedOut := FALSE; // 进料出口切断（组态非法期禁下发）/ cut the feed outlet off
    bSortOut := FALSE; // 分拣出口切断 / cut the sort outlet off
    bJamFault := _bFaultLatch; // 故障锁存照实回放 / replay the latch
    bValid := FALSE; // 判据不可用 / the criteria are not usable
    eErr := 16#0006_3039; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, an illegal configuration
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 结构早退 / the structural early exit
END_IF

// 段 3｜失能分支：强制 eIdle + 双出口复位，不 faults（边界六声明行）/ segment 3, the disabled branch
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    _eState := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eIdle; // 强制空闲 / force the idle
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 锁存复位（使能断开 ≠ 顺控故障）/ clear the latch
    _uLatch := DL_UNP_ZEROU; // 码锁存复位 / clear the code
    _bHold := FALSE; // 挂相标记复位 / clear the hold flag
    eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
    bFeedOut := FALSE; // 进料出口复位 / the feed outlet resets
    bSortOut := FALSE; // 分拣出口复位 / the sort outlet resets
    bJamFault := FALSE; // 故障位复位 / the fault bit resets
    bValid := FALSE; // 失能即不可用 / the criteria are not usable while disabled
    bError := FALSE; // 失能不是故障 / a disabled device is not a fault
    eErr := DL_UNP_ZEROU; // 失能不发码 / no code is emitted while disabled
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 4｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 兜底；本拍合法事件优先于卡瓶超时，R275）/ segment 4, the main machine, the legal event before the jam timeout
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_UnscrPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相 / the idle phase
        IF bStart AND (NOT _bFaultLatch) AND (NOT _bCfgBad) THEN // 启动电平 + 全量闸位复检（R274）/ the start with the full gate recheck
            _eState := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eFeed; // 迁入进瓶相 / enter the feed phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_UnscrPhase.eFeed: // 进瓶相（本拍合法事件优先：停止 / 分拣使能迁移先消化，再消化卡瓶超窗，R275）/ the feed phase, the legal event before the jam timeout
        IF bHopperFull THEN // 料满停进：相挂起不迁相（边界五，挂相不挂故障）/ the full level holds the phase without a fault
            _bHold := TRUE; // 置挂相标记（tonPhase 同步挂起，防满仓误判）/ raise the hold flag
        ELSE // 料满解除 / the full level released
            _bHold := FALSE; // 清挂相标记（相序自动续推）/ clear the hold flag
        END_IF
        IF NOT bStart THEN // 事件优先：停止电平 / the stop level, the event goes first
            _eState := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
        ELSIF tonPhase.Q AND bSortEn THEN // 相驻留到时 + 分拣使能（迁移门槛齐备）/ the dwell floor reached with the sort enable
            _eState := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eSort; // 迁入分拣相 / enter the sort phase
        ELSIF tonJam.Q THEN // 卡瓶持续超窗（卡瓶判据，真实可达：瓶体楔死）/ the jam stayed through the window, reachable by a wedged bottle
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
            _uLatch := 16#0006_3038; // 故障级：卡瓶超窗 / fault grade, the jam through the window
            bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 6 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        END_IF
    E_DL_UnscrPhase.eSort: // 分拣相（同拍序与 eFeed 一致，R275）/ the sort phase with the same event order
        IF bHopperFull THEN // 料满挂相（分拣出口保持，进料出口停，边界五）/ the full level holds the phase, the sort outlet stays
            _bHold := TRUE; // 置挂相标记 / raise the hold flag
        ELSE // 料满解除 / the full level released
            _bHold := FALSE; // 清挂相标记 / clear the hold flag
        END_IF
        IF NOT bStart THEN // 事件优先：停止电平 / the stop level, the event goes first
            _eState := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
        ELSIF bSortDone THEN // 事件优先：分拣完成 / the sort done, the event goes first
            _eState := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eReady; // 迁入完成相 / enter the ready phase
        ELSIF tonJam.Q THEN // 卡瓶持续超窗 / the jam through the window
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
            _uLatch := 16#0006_3038; // 故障级：卡瓶超窗 / fault grade, the jam through the window
            bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 6 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        END_IF
    E_DL_UnscrPhase.eReady: // 完成相（整理完成驻留，等再启动或停止）/ the ready phase dwelling for the next start or stop
        IF NOT bStart THEN // 停止电平 / the stop level
            _eState := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
        ELSIF bStart AND (NOT bHopperFull) THEN // 再启动且料已不满（料满期不重进，防顶仓）/ a restart with the hopper not full
            _eState := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eFeed; // 重进进瓶相 / reenter the feed phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_UnscrPhase.eFault: // 锁存故障相（驻留，解除由段 1 复位沿承担）/ the fault phase dwelling, the release belongs to the reset edge
        ; // 驻留语义由注释表达（禁自赋值死语句，R261）/ the dwell is expressed by this comment without a dead statement
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截（边界二：落故障相并锁存，禁静默）/ the illegal enumeration guard
        _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
        _uLatch := 16#0006_3039; // 故障级：非法状态拦截（归入组态族一码，出口同形，R90）/ fault grade, the illegal state in the configuration family
        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        _eState := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eFault; // 落故障相 / force the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 5｜故障锁存迁移闸（置于解除段之后防同拍抢迁，R258）/ segment 5, the latch to phase gate
IF _bFaultLatch AND (_eState <> E_DL_UnscrPhase.eFault) THEN // 已锁存但不在故障相 / latched outside the fault phase
    _eState := E_DL_UnscrPhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相 / enter the fault phase
END_IF

// 段 6｜统一出口（名实双出口同源，R191）/ segment 6, the unified outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bFeedOut := (_eState = E_DL_UnscrPhase.eFeed) AND (NOT _bHold)
         AND (NOT _bFaultLatch); // 进料出口与状态 / 挂相 / 锁存同源派生（边界五料满停进）/ the feed outlet derived from the state, the hold and the latch
bSortOut := (_eState = E_DL_UnscrPhase.eSort) AND (NOT _bFaultLatch); // 分拣出口与状态 / 锁存同源派生（料满期分拣出口保持，边界五）/ the sort outlet derived from the state and the latch
bJamFault := _bFaultLatch; // 故障位与锁存同源 / the fault bit from the latch
bValid := (NOT _bFaultLatch) AND (NOT _bCfgBad); // 判据可用（无锁存且组态合法）/ usable without a latch and with a legal configuration
IF _bFaultLatch THEN // 故障锁存回放优先（不在故障相按当下输入重新推断，R152）/ the latched fault replays first
    bValid := FALSE; // 故障相不可用 / not usable in the fault phase
    bError := TRUE; // 故障位置位（R45 配对）/ raise the fault bit
    eErr := _uLatch; // 锁存码回放 / replay the latched code
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    eErr := DL_UNP_ZEROU; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 返修版 v1.0.1：直流母线预充电回路时序监视。R63-D1 中项修复——tonSlopeLow 宽限计时 IN 串入 (NOT _bMeasBad)（与采样闸同源对偶）：测点中断期宽限计时同步挂起，测点恢复后计时清零续算，消除中断期误锁 072A（判据挂起 ≠ 计时挂起，FB51-4 对偶修复落地）。R63-D2 轻项修复——撤令判据 NOT bKmCmd 上移为 eWaitFb/eRamp 两分支首个 ELSIF，先于窗口到期判定，消除撤令与到期同拍竞态假锁存。正常路径行为零变更。
architecture_thought: 返修不改架构（五相状态机 + 三闸独立 + 锁存解除式）：仅两处闸位/判据序调整——宽限计时串测点坏闸（对偶修复）、撤令判据前置（事件优先段）。三闸 TON 均段 0 无条件刷新保持。正常路径行为零变更。

TYPE E_DL_PrechargePhase :
(
    eIdle   := 0,  // 待机：等接触器指令 / idle, waiting for the contactor command
    eWaitFb := 10, // 等反馈：指令后等接触器辅助反馈，TON 反馈窗计时 / waiting for the auxiliary feedback with the window timer
    eRamp   := 20, // 斜率监视：电压上升斜率与总时限双闸 / the ramp phase with the slope and the total time gates
    eDone   := 30, // 完成：电压达目标百分比（指令撤回即退出，不锁完成态）/ done, the voltage reached the target, the phase exits with the command
    eFault  := 40  // 锁存故障：任一闸触发，复位沿解除 / a latched fault released by the reset edge
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_VfdPrechargeSeq
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable       : BOOL := TRUE;   // 使能，FALSE 时强制 eIdle + 双出口复位（边界七）/ the enable, false forces the idle and resets both outlets
    bKmCmd        : BOOL := FALSE;  // 预充接触器指令 [-] / the precharge contactor command
    bKmFb         : BOOL := FALSE;  // 接触器辅助反馈 [-] / the contactor auxiliary feedback
    fUdMeas       : LREAL := 0.0;   // 母线电压实测 [伏]，必须有限 / the measured bus voltage, must be finite
    fUdNom        : LREAL := 540.0; // 额定母线电压 [伏]，须 > 0（除子与基准）/ the nominal bus voltage, must be positive
    fUdTargetPct  : LREAL := 90.0;  // 预充完成阈值 [%] 相对额定，域 (0, 100] / the completion threshold relative to the nominal
    fSlopeMinPctS : LREAL := 5.0;   // 最小电压上升斜率 [%/秒]，须 > 0 / the minimum voltage slope in percent per second
    bResetCmd     : BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障复位电平，上升沿清锁存回 eIdle（边界三解除式）/ the fault reset level, its rising edge releases the latch to idle
    tFbWindow     : TIME := T#2S;   // 反馈确认窗 [毫秒] / the feedback confirmation window
    tPrechargeMax : TIME := T#15S;  // 预充总时限 [毫秒] / the precharge total time limit
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bPrechargeDone  : BOOL := FALSE;          // 预充完成（eDone 相电平派生）[-] / the precharge done derived from the done phase
    bPrechargeFault : BOOL := FALSE;          // 预充故障（锁存）[-] / the latched precharge fault
    eState          : E_DL_PrechargePhase;    // 状态机出口 [状态] / the state machine outlet
    bValid          : BOOL := FALSE;          // 判据可用 [-] / the criteria are usable
    eErr            : UDINT := 16#0000_0000;  // 错误码，0 = 正常 / the error code, zero is ok
    bError          : BOOL := FALSE;          // 故障标志（故障级码同拍置位，R45 配对）/ the fault flag raised with a fault level code
END_VAR
VAR
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;  // 首拍初始化标志（R310 / FB50-2）/ the first scan flag
    _eState     : E_DL_PrechargePhase := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 内部状态寄存器 / the internal state register
    _bFaultLatch: BOOL := FALSE;  // 故障锁存副本（仅复位沿清除）/ the fault latch copy
    _uLatch     : UDINT := 16#0000_0000; // 故障码锁存 [码]（复位沿清除，FB33-1）/ the latched fault code cleared by the reset edge
    _fPctNow    : LREAL := 0.0;   // 本拍电压百分比 [％] / the voltage percentage of this scan
    _fPctSnap   : LREAL := 0.0;   // 斜率窗快照电压百分比 [%] / the window snapshot percentage
    _fSlopeNow  : LREAL := 0.0;   // 本拍斜率 [%/秒] / the slope of this scan
    _bSlopeLow  : BOOL := FALSE;  // 斜率低于下限状态（窗际保持）/ the slope below floor state
    _bMeasBad   : BOOL := FALSE;  // 电压测点坏标记（逐拍重算）/ the measurement broken flag
    _bCfgBad    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 组态非法标记（逐拍重算）/ the configuration fault flag
    _bFinNom    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 额定电压有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the nominal finiteness gate result
    _bFinTgt    : BOOL := FALSE;  // 目标阈值有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the target finiteness gate result
    _bFinSlope  : BOOL := FALSE;  // 斜率限值有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the slope limit finiteness gate result
    _bFinMeas   : BOOL := FALSE;  // 电压测点有限闸结果（逐拍重算）/ the measurement finiteness gate result
    rtReset     : R_TRIG;         // 复位沿实例，段 0 无条件刷新（R7）/ the reset edge instance
    tonFb       : TON;            // 反馈窗定时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the feedback window timer
    tonSlopeWin : TON;            // 斜率采样错峰窗（自复位，R188）/ the self resetting slope sampling window
    tonSlopeLow : TON;            // 斜率宽限计时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the slope grace timer
    tonTotal    : TON;            // 总时限定时器，段 0 无条件刷新 / the total time timer
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_VPS_PCT     : LREAL := 100.0;  // 百分比换算系数 [%] / the percentage scaling factor
    DL_VPS_WINSEC  : LREAL := 0.5;    // 斜率窗时长换算 [秒]，与 T#500MS 配比一致（手工同步，R100）/ the window duration of half a second aligned with the timer
    DL_VPS_ZEROR   : LREAL := 0.0;    // 实数零常量 [伏] / the real zero constant
    DL_VPS_TIME0   : TIME := T#0S;    // 时间零常量 [毫秒] / the time zero constant
    DL_VPS_SLOPEWIN: TIME := T#500MS; // 斜率采样错峰窗 [毫秒]（常量提级）/ the slope sampling window lifted out of the body
    DL_VPS_SLOPEGRACE: TIME := T#1S;  // 斜率宽限期 [毫秒]（常量提级）/ the slope grace period lifted out of the body
END_VAR

// 段 0｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（禁入分支，R7；监视 TON 串故障锁存门控，FB50-1）/ segment 0, the unconditional refresh
rtReset(CLK := bResetCmd); // 复位沿 / the reset edge
tonFb(IN := (_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eWaitFb) AND (NOT _bFaultLatch), PT := tFbWindow); // 反馈窗计时（串锁存门控防复位同拍重锁）/ the feedback window with the latch gate
tonSlopeWin(IN := (NOT tonSlopeWin.Q) AND (_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eRamp) AND (NOT _bFaultLatch), PT := DL_VPS_SLOPEWIN); // 斜率采样错峰窗：自复位驱动（R188，禁外部沿清零）/ the self resetting slope window
tonSlopeLow(IN := (_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eRamp) AND _bSlopeLow AND (NOT _bMeasBad) AND (NOT _bFaultLatch), PT := DL_VPS_SLOPEGRACE); // 斜率宽限计时（串测点坏闸：判据挂起 ≠ 计时挂起，测点恢复后计时清零续算，R64-D1）/ the slope grace timer with the latch gate
tonTotal(IN := ((_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eWaitFb) OR (_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eRamp)) AND (NOT _bFaultLatch), PT := tPrechargeMax); // 总时限计时（串锁存门控）/ the total time timer with the latch gate

// 段 1｜首拍初始化与复位沿作用域（R310 / R311）/ segment 1, the first scan init and the reset edge scope
IF NOT _bInit THEN // 首拍一拍 / the first scan
    _bInit := TRUE; // 置首拍标志 / raise the first scan flag
    _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 状态显式落空闲 / place the state to idle
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 故障锁存显式清零 / clear the fault latch explicitly
    _uLatch := 16#0000_0000; // 故障码锁存显式清零 / clear the latched code explicitly
    _fPctSnap := DL_VPS_ZEROR; // 斜率快照显式清零 [%] / clear the snapshot explicitly
    _bSlopeLow := FALSE; // 斜率低限态显式清零 / clear the slope state explicitly
END_IF
IF rtReset.Q THEN // 复位沿（作用域声明：清锁存 + 迁相位 + 清斜率态，R311）/ the reset edge with the declared scope
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 清故障锁存（唯一解除路径，边界三自证可达）/ clear the fault latch, the only release path
    _uLatch := 16#0000_0000; // 清故障码锁存 / clear the latched code
    _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 迁回空闲 / back to idle
    _bSlopeLow := FALSE; // 清斜率低限态 / clear the slope state
    _fPctSnap := _fPctNow; // 斜率快照对齐本拍（防复位后旧快照误判）/ align the snapshot to this scan
END_IF

// 段 2｜组态域闸结构早退（边界一，族② 判据：全部限值逐个点名，R272）/ segment 2, the structural early exit on an illegal configuration
_bFinNom := (fUdNom = fUdNom) AND ((fUdNom - fUdNom) = (fUdNom - fUdNom)); // 额定电压有限 / the nominal is finite
_bFinTgt := (fUdTargetPct = fUdTargetPct) AND ((fUdTargetPct - fUdTargetPct) = (fUdTargetPct - fUdTargetPct)); // 目标阈值有限 / the target is finite
_bFinSlope := (fSlopeMinPctS = fSlopeMinPctS) AND ((fSlopeMinPctS - fSlopeMinPctS) = (fSlopeMinPctS - fSlopeMinPctS)); // 斜率限值有限 / the slope limit is finite
_bCfgBad := (NOT _bFinNom) OR (fUdNom <= DL_VPS_ZEROR)
         OR (NOT _bFinTgt) OR (fUdTargetPct <= DL_VPS_ZEROR) OR (fUdTargetPct > DL_VPS_PCT)
         OR (NOT _bFinSlope) OR (fSlopeMinPctS <= DL_VPS_ZEROR)
         OR (tFbWindow <= DL_VPS_TIME0) OR (tPrechargeMax <= DL_VPS_TIME0); // 组态非法 / an illegal configuration
IF _bCfgBad THEN // 组态非法：结构早退（出口三件套 + RETURN，除法段不可达）/ an illegal configuration exits structurally
    eState := _eState; // 状态照实出口（冻结）/ export the state as is
    bPrechargeDone := FALSE; // 完成位复位 / the done bit resets
    bPrechargeFault := _bFaultLatch; // 故障锁存照实回放 / replay the latch
    bValid := FALSE; // 判据不可用 / the criteria are not usable
    eErr := 16#0003_0728; // 故障级：组态非法 / fault grade, an illegal configuration
    bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
    RETURN; // 结构早退 / the structural early exit
END_IF

// 段 3｜失能分支：强制 eIdle + 双出口复位，不 faults（边界七声明行）/ segment 3, the disabled branch
IF NOT bEnable THEN // 失能 / disabled
    _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 强制空闲 / force the idle
    _bFaultLatch := FALSE; // 锁存复位（使能断开 ≠ 预充故障）/ clear the latch
    _uLatch := 16#0000_0000; // 码锁存复位 / clear the code
    _bSlopeLow := FALSE; // 斜率态复位 / clear the slope state
    eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
    bPrechargeDone := FALSE; // 完成位复位 / the done bit resets
    bPrechargeFault := FALSE; // 故障位复位 / the fault bit resets
    bValid := FALSE; // 失能即不可用 / the criteria are not usable while disabled
    bError := FALSE; // 失能不是故障 / a disabled device is not a fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 失能不发码 / no code is emitted while disabled
    RETURN; // 早退 / early return
END_IF

// 段 4｜电压测点闸与百分比换算（除子 fUdNom > 0 已由段 2 证明）/ segment 4, the measurement gate and the percentage
_bFinMeas := (fUdMeas = fUdMeas) AND ((fUdMeas - fUdMeas) = (fUdMeas - fUdMeas)); // 电压测点有限 / the measurement is finite
_bMeasBad := NOT _bFinMeas; // 测点坏标记（逐拍重算）/ the broken flag recomputed
IF _bFinMeas THEN // 测点有限才换算 / the conversion runs only on a finite sample
    _fPctNow := (fUdMeas / fUdNom) * DL_VPS_PCT; // 电压百分比 [%]，除子已证 > 0 / the percentage with the proven divisor
END_IF

// 段 5｜斜率计算（错峰窗到拍采样；测点坏拍跳过，边界四五）/ segment 5, the slope sampling at the window tick
IF (_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eRamp) AND (NOT _bMeasBad) AND (NOT _bFaultLatch) THEN // Ramp 相且测点好才采样 / the sampling runs only in the ramp with a good point
    IF tonSlopeWin.Q THEN // 错峰窗到拍（自复位 TON 输出）/ the window tick
        _fSlopeNow := (_fPctNow - _fPctSnap) / DL_VPS_WINSEC; // 斜率 = Δ(电压%)/Δt [%/秒]，除子为常量 0.5 / the slope with the constant divisor
        _fPctSnap := _fPctNow; // 快照推进 [%] / advance the snapshot
        _bSlopeLow := _fSlopeNow < fSlopeMinPctS; // 斜率低限态更新（窗际保持，宽限计时器累计）/ update the slope state kept across windows
    END_IF
END_IF

// 段 6｜主状态机（ENUM + CASE，ELSE 兜底；本拍事件优先于超时迁移，R275；安全相迁移带全量闸位复检，R274）/ segment 6, the main machine
CASE _eState OF
    E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle: // 空闲相 / the idle phase
        IF bKmCmd AND (NOT _bFaultLatch) AND (NOT _bCfgBad) THEN // 指令电平 + 全量闸位复检（R274）/ the command with the full gate recheck
            _fPctSnap := _fPctNow; // 斜率快照对齐起步拍（防旧快照误判）/ align the snapshot to the start
            _bSlopeLow := FALSE; // 斜率态复位 / clear the slope state
            _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eWaitFb; // 迁入等反馈相 / enter the wait phase
        END_IF
    E_DL_PrechargePhase.eWaitFb: // 等反馈相 / the wait phase
        IF bKmFb THEN // 事件优先：反馈已到（R275 本拍合法事件先消化）/ the feedback arrived, the event goes first
            _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eRamp; // 迁入斜率监视相 / enter the ramp phase
        ELSIF NOT bKmCmd THEN // 撤令事件优先段首位（R64-D2：先于 tonTotal / tonFb 超时命中，消除同拍竞态假锁存 072B / 0729）/ the withdrawal is the first eligible event before the timeouts
            _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
        ELSIF tonTotal.Q THEN // 总时限到（反馈窗内同时受总闸保护）/ the total time expired
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
            _uLatch := 16#0003_072B; // 故障级：总时限到 / fault grade, the total time expired
            bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 8 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        ELSIF tonFb.Q THEN // 反馈超窗 / the feedback window expired
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
            _uLatch := 16#0003_0729; // 故障级：反馈超窗 / fault grade, the feedback window expired
            bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 8 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        END_IF
    E_DL_PrechargePhase.eRamp: // 斜率监视相 / the ramp phase
        IF _fPctNow >= fUdTargetPct THEN // 事件优先：电压达目标（R275）/ the target reached, the event goes first
            _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eDone; // 迁入完成相 / enter the done phase
        ELSIF NOT bKmCmd THEN // 撤令事件优先段首位（R64-D2：先于 tonTotal / tonSlopeLow 超时命中，消除同拍竞态假锁存 072B / 072A）/ the withdrawal is the first eligible event before the timeouts
            _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
        ELSIF tonTotal.Q THEN // 总时限到 / the total time expired
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
            _uLatch := 16#0003_072B; // 故障级：总时限到 / fault grade, the total time expired
            bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 8 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        ELSIF tonSlopeLow.Q THEN // 斜率低于下限持续宽限期（卡阻判据）/ the slope stayed below the floor through the grace
            _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
            _uLatch := 16#0003_072A; // 故障级：斜率持续不足 / fault grade, the slope stayed insufficient
            bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 8 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        END_IF
    E_DL_PrechargePhase.eDone: // 完成相（监视件不锁完成态，边界六）/ the done phase
        IF NOT bKmCmd THEN // 指令撤回即退出 / the phase exits with the command
            _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eIdle; // 回空闲（bPrechargeDone 随相复位）/ back to idle
        END_IF
    E_DL_PrechargePhase.eFault: // 锁存故障相（驻留，解除由段 1 复位沿承担）/ the fault phase dwelling, the release belongs to the reset edge
        ; // 驻留语义由注释表达（禁自赋值死语句，R261）/ the dwell is expressed by this comment without a dead statement
    ELSE // 非法枚举值拦截（边界二：落故障相并锁存，禁静默）/ the illegal enumeration guard
        _bFaultLatch := TRUE; // 锁存故障 / latch the fault
        _uLatch := 16#0003_0728; // 故障级：非法状态拦截（归入组态族一码，出口同形，R90）/ fault grade, the illegal state in the configuration family
        bError := TRUE; // 同拍置故障标志（R45 配对，段 8 故障分支沿用）/ raise the fault flag on the same scan
        _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eFault; // 落故障相 / force the fault phase
END_CASE

// 段 7｜故障锁存迁移闸（置于解除段之后防同拍抢迁，R258）/ segment 7, the latch to phase gate
IF _bFaultLatch AND (_eState <> E_DL_PrechargePhase.eFault) THEN // 已锁存但不在故障相 / latched outside the fault phase
    _eState := E_DL_PrechargePhase.eFault; // 迁入故障相 / enter the fault phase
END_IF

// 段 8｜统一出口（名实双出口同源，R191）/ segment 8, the unified outlet
eState := _eState; // 状态出口 / the state outlet
bPrechargeDone := (_eState = E_DL_PrechargePhase.eDone); // 完成位与状态同源派生（eDone 相电平）/ the done bit derived from the state
bPrechargeFault := _bFaultLatch; // 故障位与锁存同源 / the fault bit from the latch
bValid := (NOT _bFaultLatch) AND (NOT _bMeasBad); // 判据可用（无锁存故障且测点好）/ usable without a latch or a broken point
IF _bFaultLatch THEN // 故障锁存回放优先（不在故障相按当下输入重新推断，R152）/ the latched fault replays first
    bValid := FALSE; // 故障相不可用 / not usable in the fault phase
    bError := TRUE; // 故障位置位（R45 配对）/ raise the fault bit
    eErr := _uLatch; // 锁存码回放 / replay the latched code
ELSIF _bMeasBad THEN // 测点坏（故障级 072C，该拍斜率判据已跳过不误判卡阻，边界五）/ the point is broken
    bError := TRUE; // 故障位置位（R45 配对）/ raise the fault bit
    eErr := 16#0003_072C; // 故障级：电压测点非有限 / fault grade, the voltage point is not finite
ELSE // 无事件 / no event
    bError := FALSE; // 无故障 / no fault
    eErr := 16#0000_0000; // 正常 / ok
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 返修版 v1.0.1：LMS 自适应横向滤波器。R63-D3 轻项修复——抽头数钳位 _nTaps := USINT_TO_DINT(uTaps) 整体上移至段 4 变更沿检测之前（与 rtWipe 刷新并列段序），变更沿以本拍钳位值判定，消除晚一拍「新抽头配旧权重」混算窗口。R63-D4 轻项修复——段 11 权重写回前对 ABS(_fCorr * _afX[_i]) 预检：非有限命中 374C + 冻结 + 当拍不进 374B 判定（溢出一次性报告，374B 保留为持续发散监视），权重不再被写为 Inf。头注释拆明两条恢复路径（NaN 输入自动恢复 / 溢出污染需 bWipeW），删除「理论上不可达」失准表述。
architecture_thought: 返修不改架构（延迟线 + 权重数组 + 冻结三级策略）：仅段序上移（钳位先行）与写回预检（374C 一次性报告）两处；374B 语义收窄为持续发散监视；恢复路径双轨声明。正常路径行为零变更。
