 *                         不共享枚举——变极为双独立绕组，无星角三态）。
 * 配比约束 (R100)       : tFbTimeout > tDeadZone（反馈校验窗必须宽于死区窗，
 *                         否则死区未结束即误判反馈超时）。
 * 边界与语义披露 (Boundary disclosure) :
 *   1) 切换期间两绕组互斥硬闸：统一出口对 bOutLow / bOutHigh 再做 AND NOT 交叉
 *      硬闸，CASE 内任何路径都不可能产出双投（结构 + 出口双保险）。
 *   2) 死区窗内反馈校验（粘连判据）：命令已断侧的反馈若仍为 TRUE，判绕组粘连
 *      （机械/触点粘连），立即中止切换并锁存；高速粘连按安全侧断高速。
 *   3) 高速禁止位优先于一切运行请求：禁止位有效时高速请求被拒（信息级），运行中
 *      高速遇禁止位即时降速切换（不等待操作员）。
 *   4) 死区组态非法（<= T#0S）拒绝一切新切换，已运行的绕组保持（组态错误不停机，
 *      但故障级码必须可见，R191 显式声明）。
 *   5) 失能语义声明：bEnable = FALSE 时双绕组全断（安全侧），不冻结保持。
 * 故障码表 (Error codes) :
 *   16#0003_050B [故障级] 绕组粘连：死区窗内异侧反馈已出现，中止切换 + 锁存
 *                 反证：粘连拍输出与正常切换拍组合不同仅在于「反馈先行」，无码
 *                 则操作员只见切换中止不见根因。
 *   16#0003_050C [故障级] 反馈校验失败：投入命令已发而反馈超时未到，锁存 + 断高速
 *                 反证：校验失败与粘连状态输出组合不同（一为无反馈一为多反馈），
 *                 两因必须码位互异（R190）。
 *   16#0003_050D [故障级] 死区组态非法（<= T#0S），拒绝新切换 + 锁存
 *                 反证：拒绝切换与「无切换请求」输出组合相同，码位唯一可见。
 *   16#0003_0409 [信息级] 高速请求被禁止位拒绝（工艺联锁生效）
 *                 反证：请求被拒时电机保持低速，与「本来就选低速」输出组合相同，
 *                 无码则联锁生效事实不可观测。
 * 码位总账 (Code ledger) : 16#0003_050B / 050C / 050D 用 ｜ 16#0003_0409 用
 * 依赖     (Depends)    : 无 DL_ 内部依赖；Standard.library: TON / R_TRIG
 * 红线自检 (Redline)    : R1 ✓ 零全局变量与 VAR_EXTERNAL ｜ R2 ✓ 零 %I/%Q 物理地址
 *                         R3 ✓ 纯 IEC 61131-3 ｜ R4 ✓ 域闸 / 计数无涉 / 码位 R45 配对
 *                         R5 ✓ 全变量中英双语同行注释 ｜ R6 ✓ 六态 ENUM + CASE + ELSE 兜底
 *                         R7 ✓ 三沿三计时主体最前部无条件刷新
 * 修订历史 (Revision)   :
 *   2026-11-22  v1.0.0  首版入库（R68 构建轮 · 批 2 · 目标 10）
 *============================================================================*)

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_TwoSpeedState（归属 DL_Device，与 FB_DL_TwoSpeedMotor 同文件）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_TwoSpeedState :
(
    eIdle    := 0,    // 停机：双绕组全断 / Stopped, both windings off
    eRunLow  := 10,   // 低速运行：低速绕组投入 / Low speed, low winding on
    eSwUp    := 20,   // 升速切换：死区窗内双绕组全断 / Speed-up transition, dead zone
    eRunHigh := 30,   // 高速运行：高速绕组投入 / High speed, high winding on
    eSwDown  := 40,   // 降速切换：死区窗内双绕组全断 / Speed-down transition, dead zone
    eFault   := 99    // 粘连 / 校验故障锁存：双绕组全断 / Latched fault, both off
);
END_TYPE

(*==============================================================================
 * 功能块: FB_DL_TwoSpeedMotor
 * 调用约定: 每个扫描周期无条件调用一次。
 *============================================================================*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_TwoSpeedMotor
VAR_INPUT
    bStartCmd   : BOOL;                  // 运行命令（电平）/ Run command, level
    bStopCmd    : BOOL;                  // 停止命令（电平，优先）/ Stop command, level, priority
    bHighReq    : BOOL;                  // 速度选择：TRUE = 高速请求 / Speed select, TRUE high speed
    bHighInhibit: BOOL;                  // 高速禁止位（工艺联锁）/ High speed inhibit, process interlock
    bFbLow      : BOOL;                  // 低速接触器反馈 / Low speed contactor feedback
    bFbHigh     : BOOL;                  // 高速接触器反馈 / High speed contactor feedback
    tDeadZone   : TIME := T#2S;          // 绕组切换死区窗 [s]，<= T#0S 组态非法 / Dead zone window [s]
    tFbTimeout  : TIME := T#3S;          // 反馈校验窗 [s]，须 > tDeadZone / Feedback verify window [s]
    bEnable     : BOOL := TRUE;          // 使能（FALSE 双绕组全断）/ Enable, FALSE cuts both
    bReset      : BOOL;                  // 上升沿：清除粘连 / 校验 / 组态锁存 / Rising edge: clear latches
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bOutLow    : BOOL;                  // 低速绕组输出（经互斥硬闸）/ Low winding output, hard-gated
    bOutHigh   : BOOL;                  // 高速绕组输出（经互斥硬闸）/ High winding output, hard-gated
    bSwitching : BOOL;                  // 切换（死区窗）进行中 / Transition dead zone in progress
    bAdhesion  : BOOL;                  // 绕组粘连锁存 / Winding adhesion latched
    bFbFail    : BOOL;                  // 反馈校验失败锁存 / Feedback verify failed latched
    bError     : BOOL;                  // 故障标志（锁存类归并）/ Fault flag, latched class merged
    uErrorId   : UDINT;                 // 故障码，0 = 无故障 / Error code, 0 = none
    eState     : E_DL_TwoSpeedState;    // 当前状态（供 HMI 诊断）/ Current state for HMI diagnosis
END_VAR
VAR
    fbTrigReset  : R_TRIG;              // 复位沿检测实例 / Reset edge detector
    tonDead      : TON;                 // 切换死区窗计时实例 / Dead zone timer
    tonFbLow     : TON;                 // 低速反馈校验计时实例 / Low feedback verify timer
    tonFbHigh    : TON;                 // 高速反馈校验计时实例 / High feedback verify timer
    eStateInt    : E_DL_TwoSpeedState;  // 主状态机内部当前态 / Internal state machine state
    bOutLowInt   : BOOL;                // 低速输出内部副本（出口前未闸）/ Internal low output, pre-gate
    bOutHighInt  : BOOL;                // 高速输出内部副本（出口前未闸）/ Internal high output, pre-gate
    bDeadRun     : BOOL;                // 死区窗计时进行中 / Dead zone timing active
    bFbWaitLow   : BOOL;                // 低速反馈待达（投入后未反馈）/ Low feedback pending
    bFbWaitHigh  : BOOL;                // 高速反馈待达 / High feedback pending
    bAdhesionInt : BOOL;                // 粘锁存内部副本 / Internal adhesion latch
    bFbFailInt   : BOOL;                // 校验失败锁存内部副本 / Internal verify-fail latch
    bCfgLatch    : BOOL;                // 死区组态锁存（复位沿清除）/ Dead-zone config latch
    bCfgBad      : BOOL;                // 本拍死区组态非法 / Dead-zone config illegal this scan
    bHighRefused : BOOL;                // 高速请求被禁脉冲内部副本（单拍）/ Internal high-refused pulse
    bErrorInt    : BOOL;                // 本拍故障置位累加（出口归并）/ Fault set accumulator
    bFirstScan   : BOOL := TRUE;        // 上电首扫标志 / First-scan flag
END_VAR

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 1｜无条件刷新区（红线 R7）：一沿三计时全部位于主体最前部
 *      Unconditional refresh: one edge and three timers at the very top
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fbTrigReset(CLK := bReset);

bFbWaitLow  := (eStateInt = E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eRunLow)  AND (NOT bFbLow);
bFbWaitHigh := (eStateInt = E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eRunHigh) AND (NOT bFbHigh);

tonDead(IN := bDeadRun, PT := tDeadZone);
tonFbLow(IN := bFbWaitLow, PT := tFbTimeout);
tonFbHigh(IN := bFbWaitHigh, PT := tFbTimeout);

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 2｜上电首扫：双绕组全断落安全侧
 *      First-scan init: both windings to the safe off side
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF bFirstScan THEN
    eStateInt   := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eIdle;
    bOutLowInt  := FALSE;
    bOutHighInt := FALSE;
    bFirstScan  := FALSE;
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 3｜每拍预清（FB32-1）：单拍标志，禁入锁存 / 快照
 *      Per-scan preset: single-scan flags only
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bErrorInt    := FALSE;
bHighRefused := FALSE;

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 4｜组态域闸（R151）+ 配比复检：死区 <= T#0S 拒绝新切换，运行绕组保持
 *      Config gate and ratio re-check: bad dead zone refuses new transitions
 *      解除路径（R152 自证）：复位沿 AND 死区组态已改对
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bCfgBad := (tDeadZone <= T#0S);

IF bCfgBad THEN
    bCfgLatch := TRUE;
    uErrorId  := 16#0003_050D;   // 故障级：死区组态非法 / Fault: dead zone config illegal
    bErrorInt := TRUE;
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 5｜主状态机（红线 R6）：ENUM + CASE + ELSE 兜底
 *      Main state machine with the mandatory ELSE fallback
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
CASE eStateInt OF

    E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eIdle:
        IF (NOT bEnable) OR bStopCmd OR bCfgLatch THEN
            bOutLowInt  := FALSE;    // 双断驻留 / Both-off dwell
            bOutHighInt := FALSE;
        ELSIF bStartCmd THEN
            IF bHighReq AND bHighInhibit THEN
                bHighRefused := TRUE;    // 高速请求被禁止位拒绝（信息级）/ High refused by inhibit
                uErrorId     := 16#0003_0409;
                bOutLowInt   := TRUE;    // 抑制优先：按低速受理 / Inhibit wins: start low
                bOutHighInt  := FALSE;
                eStateInt    := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eRunLow;
            ELSIF bHighReq THEN
                bOutLowInt  := FALSE;    // 高速直投：先断后投死区窗 / High direct: dead zone first
                bOutHighInt := FALSE;
                bDeadRun    := TRUE;
                eStateInt   := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eSwUp;
            ELSE
                bOutLowInt  := TRUE;     // 低速直投（无死区需求）/ Low direct, no dead zone needed
                bOutHighInt := FALSE;
                eStateInt   := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eRunLow;
            END_IF
        END_IF

    E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eRunLow:
        IF (NOT bEnable) OR bStopCmd THEN
            bOutLowInt  := FALSE;    // 停机双断 / Stop, both off
            bOutHighInt := FALSE;
            eStateInt   := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eIdle;
        ELSIF bHighReq AND bHighInhibit THEN
            bHighRefused := TRUE;    // 禁止位拒高速（信息级，保持低速）/ High refused, keep low
            uErrorId     := 16#0003_0409;
        ELSIF bHighReq AND (NOT bCfgLatch) THEN
            bOutLowInt  := FALSE;    // 升速切换：先断低速 / Speed-up: drop low first
            bDeadRun    := TRUE;
            eStateInt   := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eSwUp;
        END_IF

    E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eSwUp:
        (* 死区窗（升速）：双绕组全断；异侧反馈出现即粘连；窗满投高速 *)
        (* Dead zone up: both off; early feedback means adhesion; commit at window full *)
        IF (NOT bEnable) OR bStopCmd THEN
            bOutLowInt  := FALSE;    // 中止切换双断 / Abort, both off
            bOutHighInt := FALSE;
            bDeadRun    := FALSE;
            eStateInt   := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eIdle;
        ELSIF bFbHigh OR bFbLow THEN
            bAdhesionInt := TRUE;    // 死区内反馈先行 = 绕组粘连 / Early feedback = adhesion
            uErrorId     := 16#0003_050B;
            bErrorInt    := TRUE;
            bOutHighInt  := FALSE;   // 安全侧断高速（本相本就全断，显式再声明）/ High cut on safe side
            bDeadRun     := FALSE;
            eStateInt    := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eFault;
        ELSIF tonDead.Q THEN
            bOutHighInt := TRUE;     // 窗满投高速 / Window full, high on
            bDeadRun    := FALSE;
            eStateInt   := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eRunHigh;
        END_IF

    E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eRunHigh:
        IF (NOT bEnable) OR bStopCmd THEN
            bOutLowInt  := FALSE;    // 停机双断 / Stop, both off
            bOutHighInt := FALSE;
            eStateInt   := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eIdle;
        ELSIF bHighInhibit OR (NOT bHighReq) THEN
            bOutHighInt := FALSE;    // 禁止位优先 / 请求撤销：降速切换 / Inhibit or request gone: down-switch
            bDeadRun    := TRUE;
            eStateInt   := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eSwDown;
        END_IF

    E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eSwDown:
        (* 死区窗（降速）：双绕组全断；异侧反馈出现即粘连；窗满投低速 *)
        (* Dead zone down: both off; early feedback means adhesion; commit low *)
        IF (NOT bEnable) OR bStopCmd THEN
            bOutLowInt  := FALSE;
            bOutHighInt := FALSE;
            bDeadRun    := FALSE;
            eStateInt   := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eIdle;
        ELSIF bFbHigh OR bFbLow THEN
            bAdhesionInt := TRUE;    // 死区内反馈先行 = 绕组粘连 / Early feedback = adhesion
            uErrorId     := 16#0003_050B;
            bErrorInt    := TRUE;
            bOutHighInt  := FALSE;   // 安全侧断高速 / High cut on safe side
            bDeadRun     := FALSE;
            eStateInt    := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eFault;
        ELSIF tonDead.Q THEN
            bOutLowInt := TRUE;      // 窗满投低速 / Window full, low on
            bDeadRun   := FALSE;
            eStateInt  := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eRunLow;
        END_IF

    E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eFault:
        bOutLowInt  := FALSE;        // 故障相双绕组全断（降级语义已声明 R191）/ Both off, declared
        bOutHighInt := FALSE;
        (* 解除路径（R152 自证可达）：复位沿 AND 双反馈均断 AND 组态已改对 *)
        IF fbTrigReset.Q AND (NOT bFbHigh) AND (NOT bFbLow) AND (NOT bCfgBad) THEN
            bAdhesionInt := FALSE;
            bFbFailInt   := FALSE;
            uErrorId     := 16#0000_0000;
            eStateInt    := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eIdle;
        END_IF

    ELSE
        (* 非法状态拦截：双断 + 迁兜底态（复用组态段码位） *)
        eStateInt   := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eFault;
        uErrorId    := 16#0003_050D;
        bErrorInt   := TRUE;
        bOutLowInt  := FALSE;
        bOutHighInt := FALSE;

END_CASE;

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 6｜反馈校验到期消化：投入命令已发而反馈超时未到 -> 校验失败锁存 + 断该绕组
 *      Feedback verify expiry: command on but feedback never arrived
 *      拍 N 进入：tonFb*.Q 首次为真；本拍行为：锁存 + 断输出 + 迁 eFault；
 *      拍 N+1 转出：eFault 相复位沿 + 双反馈均断解除
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF tonFbLow.Q AND (eStateInt = E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eRunLow) THEN
    bFbFailInt := TRUE;          // 低速反馈校验失败 / Low feedback verify failed
    uErrorId   := 16#0003_050C;
    bErrorInt  := TRUE;
    bOutLowInt := FALSE;         // 安全侧断该绕组 / Cut the winding on safe side
    eStateInt  := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eFault;
END_IF

IF tonFbHigh.Q AND (eStateInt = E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eRunHigh) THEN
    bFbFailInt := TRUE;          // 高速反馈校验失败（安全侧断高速）/ High verify failed, cut high
    uErrorId   := 16#0003_050C;
    bErrorInt  := TRUE;
    bOutHighInt := FALSE;
    eStateInt  := E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eFault;
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 7｜输出单一出口（范式 P-05）：两绕组互斥交叉硬闸（结构 + 出口双保险）
 *      Single output exit: cross hard gate, structural plus exit double insurance
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bOutLow  := bOutLowInt AND (NOT bOutHighInt);
bOutHigh := bOutHighInt AND (NOT bOutLowInt);

bSwitching  := (eStateInt = E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eSwUp) OR (eStateInt = E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eSwDown);
bAdhesion   := bAdhesionInt;
bFbFail     := bFbFailInt;
bError      := bErrorInt OR (eStateInt = E_DL_TwoSpeedState.eFault);
eState      := eStateInt;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 控制柜热管理监视：柜内-环境温差超限判热交换失效，风扇转速/运行反馈双判据，长期趋势监视滤网阻塞（同环境温度下温差缓升速率），出口按 NE107 降级分级，供控制柜在风扇劣化/滤网堵塞早期维护。边界：两温度非有限闸；环境高于柜内判据挂起（负温差非故障）；趋势窗样本数下限挂起；只告警不控风扇（执行归调用方）。
architecture_thought: 三判据分工架构：温差即时判据 + 风扇反馈双判据 + 缓升趋势判据（窗口斜率）；趋势采样带样本数下限（R307 挂起同步挂起载体）；环境反向差分流挂起通道（不污染故障计数）；只算不发（「算一个值/做一件事」边界），执行出口由调用方消费 NE107 状态。

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_CoolWatchState（归属 DL_Device，与 FB_DL_CabinetCoolingWatch 同文件）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_CoolWatchState :
(
    eIdle  := 0,    // 未使能：判据与趋势冻结 / Disabled, criteria and trend frozen
    eRun   := 10,   // 监视中：三判据并行评估 / Watching, three criteria evaluated
    eFault := 99    // 信号 / 组态锁存：判据挂起 / Signal or config latched, criteria suspended
);
END_TYPE

(*==============================================================================
 * 功能块: FB_DL_CabinetCoolingWatch
 * 调用约定: 每个扫描周期无条件调用一次。
 *============================================================================*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_CabinetCoolingWatch
VAR_INPUT
    fTempCab     : REAL;                 // 柜内温度 [℃] / Cabinet temperature [degC]
    fTempAmb     : REAL;                 // 环境温度 [℃] / Ambient temperature [degC]
    bFanRunCmd   : BOOL;                 // 风扇运行命令（只读判据输入）/ Fan run command, judgement input only
    bFanRunFb    : BOOL;                 // 风扇运行反馈 / Fan run feedback
    fFanSpeedFb  : REAL;                 // 风扇转速反馈 [rpm] / Fan speed feedback [rpm]
    fFanSpeedMin : REAL := 500.0;        // 风扇转速下限 [rpm] / Fan speed floor [rpm]
    fDtLimitK    : REAL := 15.0;         // 温差超限阈 [K] / Delta-T over-limit threshold [K]
    tConfirmDt   : TIME := T#60S;        // 温差确认窗 [s] / Delta-T confirmation window [s]
    tFanConfirm  : TIME := T#10S;        // 风扇失配确认窗 [s] / Fan mismatch confirmation window [s]
    fTrendLimit  : REAL := 2.0;          // 滤网阻塞趋势阈 [K/h] / Filter clogging trend threshold [K per h]
    tSample      : TIME := T#1M;         // 趋势采样周期 [min] / Trend sampling period [min]
    nTrendWin    : INT  := 12;           // 趋势窗样本数 [个]，域 4..16 且为偶数 / Trend window samples, 4..16 even
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;         // 使能 / Enable
    bReset       : BOOL;                 // 上升沿：清除信号 / 组态锁存 / Rising edge: clear signal and config latches
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    eHealth         : E_DL_Ne107Status;  // NE107 健康出口 / NE107 health verdict
    fDtNow          : REAL;              // 当前温差 [K] / Current delta-T [K]
    bJudgeSuspended : BOOL;              // 判据挂起（自然温差 / 样本不足）/ Judge suspended, natural or insufficient
    bFanMismatch    : BOOL;              // 风扇失配确认（保持型）/ Fan mismatch confirmed, level held
    bTrendConfirmed : BOOL;              // 滤网阻塞趋势确认（保持型）/ Trend confirmed, level held
    fTrendSlope     : REAL;              // 当前趋势斜率 [K/h] / Current trend slope [K per h]
    bError          : BOOL;              // 故障标志（信号 / 组态锁存归并）/ Fault flag merged
    uErrorId        : UDINT;             // 故障码，0 = 无故障 / Error code, 0 = none
    eState          : E_DL_CoolWatchState; // 当前状态（供 HMI 诊断）/ Current state
END_VAR
VAR
    fbTrigReset   : R_TRIG;              // 复位沿检测实例 / Reset edge detector
    tonDt         : TON;                 // 温差确认窗计时实例 / Delta-T confirmation timer
    tonFan        : TON;                 // 风扇失配确认窗计时实例 / Fan mismatch confirmation timer
    tonSample     : TON;                 // 趋势采样周期（自复位）实例 / Trend sampling timer, self resetting
    eStateInt     : E_DL_CoolWatchState; // 主状态机内部当前态 / Internal state machine state
    fDtInt        : REAL;                // 温差内部副本 [K] / Internal delta-T
    bCabBad       : BOOL;                // 柜温非有限 / Cabinet temp non-finite
    bAmbBad       : BOOL;                // 环温非有限 / Ambient temp non-finite
    bFanSigBad    : BOOL;                // 风扇转速非有限 / Fan speed non-finite
    bCabLatch     : BOOL;                // 柜温失效锁存 / Cabinet latch
    bAmbLatch     : BOOL;                // 环温失效锁存 / Ambient latch
    bFanLatch     : BOOL;                // 风扇反馈失效锁存 / Fan feedback latch
    bCfgLatch     : BOOL;                // 组态故障锁存 / Config fault latch
    bCfgBad       : BOOL;                // 本拍组态非法 / Config illegal this scan
    bDtExceeds    : BOOL;                // 温差超限判据（挂起时 FALSE）/ Delta-T exceeds, FALSE when suspended
    bFanMismatchInt : BOOL;              // 风扇失配确认内部副本 / Internal fan mismatch
    bTrendConfInt : BOOL;                // 趋势确认内部副本 / Internal trend confirmed
    bTrendActive  : BOOL;                // 本拍趋势斜率可发布 / Trend slope publishable
    afDtRing      : ARRAY[0..15] OF REAL; // 趋势温差样本环形窗 [K] / Delta-T trend ring [K]
    nTrendWinEff  : INT;                 // 钳位后趋势窗长 [个] / Clamped trend window length
    nTrendWrite   : INT;                 // 趋势窗写指针 [0..15] / Trend ring write pointer
    nTrendFill    : INT;                 // 趋势窗有效样本数 [个] / Trend ring fill count
    fMeanOld      : REAL;                // 前半窗均值 [K] / Older half mean [K]
    fMeanNew      : REAL;                // 后半窗均值 [K] / Recent half mean [K]
    fHalfHours    : REAL;                // 半窗时长折算小时 [h] / Half window in hours [h]
    nHalf         : INT;                 // 半窗样本数 [个] / Half window sample count
    nI            : INT;                 // 遍历索引 / Loop index
    fSlope        : REAL;                // 斜率中间量 [K/h] / Slope intermediate
    fSpeedMinEff  : REAL;                // 钳位后转速下限 [rpm] / Clamped speed floor
    fDtLimEff     : REAL;                // 钳位后温差阈 [K] / Clamped delta-T threshold
    fTrendLimEff  : REAL;                // 钳位后趋势阈 [K/h] / Clamped trend threshold
    bErrorInt     : BOOL;                // 本拍故障置位累加（出口归并）/ Fault set accumulator
    bFirstScan    : BOOL := TRUE;        // 上电首扫标志 / First-scan flag
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_CW_WIN_MIN   : INT  := 4;      // 趋势窗长下限 [个] / Trend window floor
    DL_CW_WIN_MAX   : INT  := 16;     // 趋势窗长上限 [个]，与数组维度一致 / Trend window ceiling
    DL_CW_EPS       : REAL := 1.0E-6; // 斜率分母判零容差 [h] / Slope denominator epsilon [h]
    DL_CW_FIN_LIM   : REAL := 1.0E30; // REAL 有限幅值判界 / REAL finiteness bound
    DL_CW_HOUR_MS   : REAL := 3600000.0; // 小时毫秒换算常数 [ms/h] / Hours to milliseconds factor
END_VAR

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 1｜无条件刷新区（红线 R7）：一沿三计时全部位于主体最前部
 *      Unconditional refresh: one edge and three timers at the very top
 *      tonSample 为周期窗自复位（IN 串 bEnable AND NOT 自身 Q，R188）
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fbTrigReset(CLK := bReset);

tonDt(IN := bDtExceeds, PT := tConfirmDt);
tonFan(IN := bFanRunCmd AND (NOT bFanSigBad)
        AND ((NOT bFanRunFb) OR (fFanSpeedFb < fSpeedMinEff)),   // 反馈失效时判据整体挂起 / Suspended on bad feedback
       PT := tFanConfirm);
tonSample(IN := bEnable AND (NOT tonSample.Q), PT := tSample);

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 2｜上电首扫：趋势窗显式清零
 *      First-scan init: trend ring cleared explicitly
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF bFirstScan THEN
    eStateInt := E_DL_CoolWatchState.eIdle;
    FOR nI := 0 TO 15 DO
        afDtRing[nI] := 0.0;     // 趋势窗显式清零 / Trend ring cleared
    END_FOR
    nTrendWrite := 0;
    nTrendFill  := 0;
    bFirstScan  := FALSE;
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 3｜每拍预清（FB32-1）：单拍标志，禁入锁存 / 快照
 *      Per-scan preset: single-scan flags only
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bErrorInt := FALSE;

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 4｜非有限闸（R272 全枚举：三个测量 REAL 入参）+ 组态域闸（限值 / 窗长 / 周期）
 *      Non-finite gates over the three measurement inputs, plus the config gate
 *      解除路径（R152 自证）：复位沿 AND 对应信号恢复有限 / 组态改对
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bCabBad    := (fTempCab <> fTempCab) OR ((fTempCab - fTempCab) <> (fTempCab - fTempCab))
              OR (ABS(fTempCab) >= DL_CW_FIN_LIM);
bAmbBad    := (fTempAmb <> fTempAmb) OR ((fTempAmb - fTempAmb) <> (fTempAmb - fTempAmb))
              OR (ABS(fTempAmb) >= DL_CW_FIN_LIM);
bFanSigBad := (fFanSpeedFb <> fFanSpeedFb) OR ((fFanSpeedFb - fFanSpeedFb) <> (fFanSpeedFb - fFanSpeedFb))
              OR (ABS(fFanSpeedFb) >= DL_CW_FIN_LIM);

IF bCabBad THEN
    bCabLatch := TRUE;
    uErrorId  := 16#0003_050E;   // 故障级：柜温非有限 / Fault: cabinet temp non-finite
    bErrorInt := TRUE;
END_IF
IF bAmbBad THEN
    bAmbLatch := TRUE;
    uErrorId  := 16#0003_050F;   // 故障级：环温非有限 / Fault: ambient temp non-finite
    bErrorInt := TRUE;
END_IF
IF bFanSigBad THEN
    bFanLatch := TRUE;
    uErrorId  := 16#0003_0510;   // 故障级：风扇反馈非有限 / Fault: fan feedback non-finite
    bErrorInt := TRUE;
END_IF

bCfgBad := (tConfirmDt <= T#0S) OR (tFanConfirm <= T#0S) OR (tSample <= T#0S)
           OR (fDtLimitK <= 0.0) OR (fDtLimitK <> fDtLimitK)
           OR (fFanSpeedMin < 0.0) OR (fFanSpeedMin <> fFanSpeedMin)
           OR (fTrendLimit <= 0.0) OR (fTrendLimit <> fTrendLimit)
           OR (nTrendWin < DL_CW_WIN_MIN) OR (nTrendWin > DL_CW_WIN_MAX);

IF bCfgBad THEN
    bCfgLatch := TRUE;
    uErrorId  := 16#0003_0511;   // 故障级：组态非法 / Fault: config illegal
    bErrorInt := TRUE;
END_IF

(* 两级回退取值（R117）：非法参数钳回默认常量，服务不中断 *)
(* Two-level fallback values *)
IF (fFanSpeedMin < 0.0) OR (fFanSpeedMin <> fFanSpeedMin) THEN
    fSpeedMinEff := 500.0;       // 回退默认转速下限 / Fallback default floor
ELSE
    fSpeedMinEff := fFanSpeedMin;
END_IF
IF (fDtLimitK <= 0.0) OR (fDtLimitK <> fDtLimitK) THEN
    fDtLimEff := 15.0;           // 回退默认温差阈 / Fallback default threshold
ELSE
    fDtLimEff := fDtLimitK;
END_IF
IF (fTrendLimit <= 0.0) OR (fTrendLimit <> fTrendLimit) THEN
    fTrendLimEff := 2.0;         // 回退默认趋势阈 / Fallback default threshold
ELSE
    fTrendLimEff := fTrendLimit;
END_IF
IF (nTrendWin < DL_CW_WIN_MIN) OR (nTrendWin > DL_CW_WIN_MAX) THEN
    nTrendWinEff := 12;          // 回退默认窗长 / Fallback default window
ELSE
    nTrendWinEff := nTrendWin;
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 5｜温差判据（挂起语义）：环温 >= 柜温为自然工况，判据挂起不发布
 *      Delta-T criterion with suspension: ambient hotter means natural, suspended
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fDtInt := fTempCab - fTempAmb;
fDtNow := fDtInt;

bDtExceeds := (NOT bCabBad) AND (NOT bAmbBad)
              AND (fDtInt > fDtLimEff);      // 挂起（温差 <= 0）通过不置判据承载 / Suspension by not asserting

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 6｜趋势采样与斜率（周期窗自复位 TON 到期拍采一个样本）
 *      Trend sampling and slope, one sample per self-resetting window tick
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bTrendActive := FALSE;
fSlope       := 0.0;

IF tonSample.Q AND (eStateInt = E_DL_CoolWatchState.eRun)
   AND (NOT bCabBad) AND (NOT bAmbBad) AND (fDtInt > 0.0) THEN
    afDtRing[nTrendWrite] := fDtInt;     // 正温差样本入环 / Positive delta-T sample into ring
    nTrendWrite := nTrendWrite + 1;
    IF nTrendWrite >= nTrendWinEff THEN
        nTrendWrite := 0;                // 显式回卷 / Explicit wrap
    END_IF
    IF nTrendFill < nTrendWinEff THEN
        nTrendFill := nTrendFill + 1;    // 填充推进 / Fill up
    END_IF
END_IF

IF nTrendFill >= nTrendWinEff THEN
    nHalf := nTrendWinEff / 2;           // 半窗样本数（窗长已组态为偶数域）/ Half count
    fMeanOld := 0.0;
    fMeanNew := 0.0;
    FOR nI := 0 TO (nHalf - 1) DO
        fMeanOld := fMeanOld + afDtRing[nI];              // 前半窗求和 / Older half sum
        fMeanNew := fMeanNew + afDtRing[nI + nHalf];      // 后半窗求和 / Recent half sum
    END_FOR
    fMeanOld := fMeanOld / UDINT_TO_REAL(DINT_TO_UDINT(nHalf));
    fMeanNew := fMeanNew / UDINT_TO_REAL(DINT_TO_UDINT(nHalf));
    fHalfHours := (TIME_TO_LREAL(tSample) * UDINT_TO_REAL(DINT_TO_UDINT(nHalf))) / DL_CW_HOUR_MS;
    IF fHalfHours > DL_CW_EPS THEN
        fSlope := (fMeanNew - fMeanOld) / fHalfHours;     // 缓升斜率 [K/h]，分母已闸 / Slope, guarded
        bTrendActive := TRUE;
        IF fSlope > fTrendLimEff THEN
            bTrendConfInt := TRUE;                        // 趋势确认（保持型）/ Trend confirmed
            uErrorId      := 16#0003_040C;                // 信息级：趋势确认 / Info: trend confirmed
        ELSIF fSlope <= fTrendLimEff THEN
            bTrendConfInt := FALSE;                       // 回落清除 / Clear on recovery
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 7｜主状态机（红线 R6）：ENUM + CASE + ELSE 兜底
 *      Main state machine with the mandatory ELSE fallback
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
CASE eStateInt OF

    E_DL_CoolWatchState.eIdle:
        IF bEnable AND (NOT bCabLatch) AND (NOT bAmbLatch) AND (NOT bFanLatch) AND (NOT bCfgLatch) THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_CoolWatchState.eRun;
        END_IF

    E_DL_CoolWatchState.eRun:
        IF bCabLatch OR bAmbLatch OR bFanLatch OR bCfgLatch OR (NOT bEnable) THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_CoolWatchState.eFault;   // 任一锁存即挂起 / Any latch suspends
        END_IF

    E_DL_CoolWatchState.eFault:
        (* 解除路径（R152 自证可达）：复位沿 AND 全部锁存源已恢复 *)
        IF fbTrigReset.Q AND (NOT bCabBad) AND (NOT bAmbBad) AND (NOT bFanSigBad) AND (NOT bCfgBad) THEN
            bCabLatch := FALSE;
            bAmbLatch := FALSE;
            bFanLatch := FALSE;
            bCfgLatch := FALSE;
            uErrorId  := 16#0000_0000;
            eStateInt := E_DL_CoolWatchState.eIdle;
        END_IF

    ELSE
        eStateInt := E_DL_CoolWatchState.eFault;
        uErrorId  := 16#0003_0511;
        bErrorInt := TRUE;

END_CASE;

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 8｜风扇失配确认消化（保持型）：确认窗满置位，命令撤销 / 反馈恢复回落清除
 *      Fan mismatch confirmation, level held, cleared on recovery
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF tonFan.Q THEN
    bFanMismatchInt := TRUE;
    uErrorId        := 16#0003_040B;   // 信息级：风扇失配确认 / Info: fan mismatch confirmed
ELSIF (NOT bFanRunCmd) OR (bFanRunFb AND (NOT bFanSigBad) AND (fFanSpeedFb >= fSpeedMinEff)) THEN
    bFanMismatchInt := FALSE;          // 回落清除 / Clear on recovery
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 9｜输出单一出口（范式 P-05）：健康分级由三判据保持型派生
 *      Single output exit: health derived from the three level-held criteria
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bJudgeSuspended := (eStateInt <> E_DL_CoolWatchState.eRun)
                   OR (fDtInt <= 0.0)
                   OR (nTrendFill < nTrendWinEff);

IF eStateInt <> E_DL_CoolWatchState.eRun THEN
    eHealth := E_DL_Ne107Status.eUnknown;        // 未使能 / 锁存：未知（信号失效另见 eFailure 口径）
    IF bCabLatch OR bAmbLatch OR bFanLatch THEN
        eHealth := E_DL_Ne107Status.eFailure;    // 测量信号不可信 / Measurement untrusted
    END_IF
ELSIF bFanMismatchInt THEN
    eHealth := E_DL_Ne107Status.eCheckFunction;  // 风扇失配 / Fan mismatch
ELSIF bTrendConfInt OR tonDt.Q THEN
    eHealth := E_DL_Ne107Status.eMaintenanceReq; // 温差超限确认或趋势确认 / Delta-T confirmed or trend
    IF tonDt.Q THEN
        uErrorId := 16#0003_040A;                // 信息级：温差确认 / Info: delta-T confirmed
    END_IF
ELSE
    eHealth := E_DL_Ne107Status.eOk;             // 全判据通过 / All pass
END_IF

bFanMismatch    := bFanMismatchInt;
bTrendConfirmed := bTrendConfInt;
fTrendSlope     := fSlope;
bError          := bErrorInt OR (eStateInt = E_DL_CoolWatchState.eFault);
eState          := eStateInt;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_WrapSeqState（归属 DL_Process，与 FB_DL_StretchWrapSeq 同文件）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_WrapSeqState :
(
    eIdle     := 0,    // 空闲：输出全清（R57 前置合规）/ Idle, all outputs cleared
    ePreClamp := 10,   // 预压：压膜建立 / Pre-clamp, film pressed
    eBottom   := 20,   // 底圈段：转盘计数 / Bottom turns, counting
    eTop      := 30,   // 顶圈段：转盘计数 / Top turns, counting
    eCut      := 40,   // 切膜：重试节流 / Film cut with retry throttle
    eDwell    := 50,   // 保持：保持窗计时 / Dwell window timing
    eFault    := 99    // 配方 / 反馈丢失锁存 / Recipe or feedback loss latched
);
END_TYPE

(*==============================================================================
 * 功能块: FB_DL_StretchWrapSeq
 * 调用约定: 每个扫描周期无条件调用一次。
 *============================================================================*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_StretchWrapSeq
VAR_INPUT
    bStartCmd    : BOOL;                 // 启动命令（上升沿受理）/ Start command, rising edge accepted
    bStopCmd     : BOOL;                 // 停止命令（电平，任意相退出）/ Stop command, level, exits any phase
    bPauseReq    : BOOL;                 // 操作暂停请求（电平）/ Operator pause request, level
    bFilmBreak   : BOOL;                 // 膜断检测（电平，联锁暂停源）/ Film break detection, interlock pause source
    bTurnFb      : BOOL;                 // 转盘旋转反馈（每圈一脉冲）/ Turntable feedback, one pulse per revolution
    bPreClampFb  : BOOL;                 // 预压到位反馈 / Pre-clamp in-position feedback
    bCutDone     : BOOL;                 // 切膜完成反馈 / Film cut done feedback
    nBottomTurns : INT := 2;             // 底圈数配方 [圈]，域 1..255 / Bottom turns recipe
    nTopTurns    : INT := 3;             // 顶圈数配方 [圈]，域 1..255 / Top turns recipe
    nTotalTurns  : INT := 5;             // 总圈数配方 [圈]，仅一致性核对 / Total turns recipe, consistency only
    nCutRetryMax : INT := 3;             // 切膜重试上限 [次] / Film cut retry ceiling
    tPreClamp    : TIME := T#2S;         // 预压建压窗 [s] / Pre-clamp build-up window [s]
    tTurnLoss    : TIME := T#10S;        // 转盘反馈丢失超时 [s] / Turntable feedback loss timeout [s]
    tCutTimeout  : TIME := T#5S;         // 切膜单次窗 [s] / Film cut single window [s]
    tCutDwell    : TIME := T#1S;         // 切膜重试间隔窗 [s] / Film cut retry interval [s]
    tDwellHold   : TIME := T#3S;         // 保持窗时长 [s] / Dwell hold duration [s]
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;         // 使能 / Enable
    bReset       : BOOL;                 // 上升沿：清配方 / 反馈丢失锁存 / Rising edge: clear latches
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    bTurnDrive  : BOOL;                  // 转盘驱动输出 / Turntable drive output
    bPreClampOut: BOOL;                  // 预压输出 / Pre-clamp output
    bCutOut     : BOOL;                  // 切膜输出 / Film cut output
    bPauseHold  : BOOL;                  // 暂停挂起（圈边界生效）/ Pause hold, effective at turn boundary
    bSeqActive  : BOOL;                  // 顺控进行中 / Sequence active
    bSeqDone    : BOOL;                  // 顺控完成脉冲（单拍）/ Sequence done pulse, single scan
    nTurnsDone  : INT;                   // 已完成总圈数 [圈] / Total turns completed
    nCutRetries : INT;                   // 切膜重试计数 [次]，饱和 / Film cut retries, saturating
    bError      : BOOL;                  // 故障标志（配方 / 反馈丢失）/ Fault flag
    uErrorId    : UDINT;                 // 故障码，0 = 无故障 / Error code, 0 = none
    eState      : E_DL_WrapSeqState;     // 当前状态（供 HMI 诊断）/ Current state
END_VAR
VAR
    fbTrigStart  : R_TRIG;               // 启动沿检测实例 / Start edge detector
    fbTrigReset  : R_TRIG;               // 复位沿检测实例 / Reset edge detector
    fbTrigFilm   : R_TRIG;               // 膜断沿检测实例（事件码用）/ Film break edge detector
    rTrigTurn    : R_TRIG;               // 转盘圈脉冲沿计数实例 / Turn pulse counting edge
    tonPre       : TON;                  // 预压建压计时实例 / Pre-clamp timer
    tonTurnLoss  : TON;                  // 转盘反馈丢失计时实例 / Turntable loss timer
    tonCutTo     : TON;                  // 切膜单次窗计时实例 / Film cut window timer
    tonCutDwell  : TON;                  // 切膜重试间隔窗（自复位）实例 / Retry interval timer, self resetting
    tonDwellHold : TON;                  // 保持窗计时实例 / Dwell hold timer
    eStateInt    : E_DL_WrapSeqState;    // 主状态机内部当前态 / Internal state machine state
    nBottomDone  : INT;                  // 底圈已完成圈数 [圈] / Bottom turns completed
    nTopDone     : INT;                  // 顶圈已完成圈数 [圈] / Top turns completed
    nRetryInt    : INT;                  // 切膜重试计数内部副本 / Internal retry count
    bPausePend   : BOOL;                 // 暂停挂起请求（双源合并）/ Pause pending, dual source merged
    bPauseHoldInt: BOOL;                 // 暂停边界生效保持位 / Pause hold latched at boundary
    bRecipeBad   : BOOL;                 // 本拍配方组态非法 / Recipe illegal this scan
    bRecipeLatch : BOOL;                 // 配方故障锁存（复位沿清除）/ Recipe fault latch
    bTotalDiff   : BOOL;                 // 总圈数与底 / 顶之和不一致 / Total mismatch with the sum
    bTurnLossInt : BOOL;                 // 反馈丢失锁存内部副本 / Internal feedback loss latch
    bDoneT       : BOOL;                 // 完成脉冲内部副本（单拍）/ Internal done pulse copy
    bTurnDriveInt: BOOL;                 // 驱动输出内部派生 / Internal drive output derivation
    bErrorInt    : BOOL;                 // 本拍故障置位累加（出口归并）/ Fault set accumulator
    bFirstScan   : BOOL := TRUE;         // 上电首扫标志 / First-scan flag
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_WR_TURNS_MAX : INT := 255;    // 单段圈数上限 [圈]（配方域上界）/ Turns ceiling per recipe
    DL_WR_RETRY_MAX : INT := 8;      // 重试计数硬饱和 [次]（防 INT 溢出兜底）/ Retry hard saturation
END_VAR

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 1｜无条件刷新区（红线 R7）：四沿五计时全部位于主体最前部
 *      Unconditional refresh: four edges and five timers at the very top
 *      计时器 IN 全部为内部派生量（R40 断输入口径）
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fbTrigStart(CLK := bStartCmd);
fbTrigReset(CLK := bReset);
fbTrigFilm(CLK := bFilmBreak);
rTrigTurn(CLK := bTurnFb);

tonPre(IN := (eStateInt = E_DL_WrapSeqState.ePreClamp) AND (NOT bPreClampFb), PT := tPreClamp);
tonTurnLoss(IN := bTurnDriveInt AND (NOT rTrigTurn.Q), PT := tTurnLoss);
tonCutTo(IN := (eStateInt = E_DL_WrapSeqState.eCut) AND (NOT bCutDone), PT := tCutTimeout);
tonCutDwell(IN := NOT tonCutDwell.Q, PT := tCutDwell);
tonDwellHold(IN := (eStateInt = E_DL_WrapSeqState.eDwell), PT := tDwellHold);

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 2｜上电首扫：计数与状态落安全侧
 *      First-scan init: counters and state to the safe side
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF bFirstScan THEN
    eStateInt   := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eIdle;
    nBottomDone := 0;
    nTopDone    := 0;
    nRetryInt   := 0;
    bFirstScan  := FALSE;
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 3｜每拍预清（FB32-1）：单拍标志，禁入锁存 / 快照 / 计数
 *      Per-scan preset: single-scan flags only
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bErrorInt := FALSE;
bDoneT    := FALSE;

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 4｜配方域闸（R151）+ 一致性核对：越界拒绝启动，不一致信息级按和执行
 *      Recipe gate and consistency check
 *      解除路径（R152 自证）：复位沿 AND 配方已改对
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bRecipeBad := (nBottomTurns < 1) OR (nBottomTurns > DL_WR_TURNS_MAX)
              OR (nTopTurns < 1) OR (nTopTurns > DL_WR_TURNS_MAX);

IF bRecipeBad THEN
    bRecipeLatch := TRUE;
    uErrorId     := 16#0005_03A9;    // 故障级：配方组态非法 / Fault: recipe illegal
    bErrorInt    := TRUE;
END_IF

bTotalDiff := (nTotalTurns <> (nBottomTurns + nTopTurns));
IF bTotalDiff AND (NOT bRecipeBad) THEN
    uErrorId := 16#0005_04D2;        // 信息级：总数不一致按和执行 / Info: total mismatch
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 5｜暂停双源合并与圈边界生效（ISA-88 相语义次源）
 *      Pause dual-source merge with turn-boundary effectiveness
 *      拍 N 进入：膜断 / 暂停请求置挂起；本拍行为：当前圈转完（沿到）即保持；
 *      拍 N+1 转出：请求撤销即恢复圈数继续（不重头）
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bPausePend := bFilmBreak OR bPauseReq;

IF fbTrigFilm.Q AND bPausePend THEN
    uErrorId := 16#0005_04D1;        // 信息级：膜断事件 / Info: film break event
END_IF

IF bPausePend AND rTrigTurn.Q THEN
    bPauseHoldInt := TRUE;           // 圈边界：暂停保持生效 / Boundary: pause hold engages
ELSIF NOT bPausePend THEN
    bPauseHoldInt := FALSE;          // 请求撤销：恢复 / Request gone: resume
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 6｜主状态机（红线 R6）：ENUM + CASE + ELSE 兜底
 *      Main state machine with the mandatory ELSE fallback
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
CASE eStateInt OF

    E_DL_WrapSeqState.eIdle:
        (* eIdle 相执行输出清零（R57）：本相不写任何执行输出，出口段按状态归零 *)
        (* Idle clears outputs: the exit section derives all-off from the state *)
        (* 锁存驻留声明：反馈丢失 / 配方锁存的复位消化在 eFault 分支与空闲复位行处理 *)
        (* Latch dwell note: clears happen in the eFault branch and the idle reset line *)
        IF bReset THEN
            bTurnLossInt := FALSE;   // 空闲相复位也允许清反馈丢失锁存 / Idle reset clears loss latch
            bRecipeLatch := FALSE;   // 空闲相复位清配方锁存 / Idle reset clears recipe latch
            uErrorId     := 16#0000_0000;
        END_IF
        IF bEnable AND (NOT bRecipeLatch) AND (NOT bTurnLossInt) AND fbTrigStart.Q THEN
            nBottomDone  := 0;       // 圈数计数清零 / Turn counters cleared
            nTopDone     := 0;
            nRetryInt    := 0;
            bPauseHoldInt := FALSE;
            eStateInt    := E_DL_WrapSeqState.ePreClamp;
        END_IF

    E_DL_WrapSeqState.ePreClamp:
        IF bStopCmd OR (NOT bEnable) THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eIdle;    // 退出 / Exit
        ELSIF bPreClampFb OR tonPre.Q THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eBottom;  // 反馈到位或建压窗满（双出口 R98）/ Feedback or window full
        END_IF

    E_DL_WrapSeqState.eBottom:
        IF bStopCmd OR (NOT bEnable) THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eIdle;
        ELSIF nBottomDone >= nBottomTurns THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eTop;     // 底圈数满转顶圈 / Bottom full, to top
        END_IF

    E_DL_WrapSeqState.eTop:
        IF bStopCmd OR (NOT bEnable) THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eIdle;
        ELSIF (nBottomDone + nTopDone) >= (nBottomTurns + nTopTurns) THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eCut;     // 总圈数满转切膜（验收：2+3=5）/ Total full, to cut
        END_IF

    E_DL_WrapSeqState.eCut:
        IF bStopCmd OR (NOT bEnable) THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eIdle;
        ELSIF bCutDone THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eDwell;   // 切膜完成进保持 / Cut done, to dwell
        END_IF

    E_DL_WrapSeqState.eDwell:
        IF bStopCmd OR (NOT bEnable) THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eIdle;
        ELSIF tonDwellHold.Q THEN
            bDoneT    := TRUE;       // 完成脉冲：内部置位 -> 出口单拍映射（两段式）/ Done pulse via exit
            eStateInt := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eIdle;
        END_IF

    E_DL_WrapSeqState.eFault:
        (* 解除路径（R152 自证可达）：复位沿 AND 反馈已恢复 AND 配方已改对 *)
        IF fbTrigReset.Q AND (NOT bRecipeBad) THEN
            bRecipeLatch := FALSE;
            bTurnLossInt := FALSE;
            uErrorId     := 16#0000_0000;
            eStateInt    := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eIdle;
        END_IF

    ELSE
        (* 非法状态拦截：迁兜底态（复用配方段码位） *)
        eStateInt := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eFault;
        uErrorId  := 16#0005_03A9;
        bErrorInt := TRUE;

END_CASE;

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 7｜转盘圈计数（沿计数 + 饱和 255）与反馈丢失消化
 *      Turn counting with 255 saturation, and the feedback loss digestion
 *      计数仅在驱动输出有效且未暂停保持时推进（暂停在圈边界已截停驱动）
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bTurnDriveInt := (eStateInt = E_DL_WrapSeqState.eBottom) OR (eStateInt = E_DL_WrapSeqState.eTop);
bTurnDriveInt := bTurnDriveInt AND (NOT bPauseHoldInt);

IF rTrigTurn.Q AND bTurnDriveInt THEN
    IF (nBottomDone + nTopDone) < DL_WR_TURNS_MAX THEN
        IF eStateInt = E_DL_WrapSeqState.eBottom THEN
            nBottomDone := nBottomDone + 1;  // 底圈计数推进 / Bottom count up
        ELSIF eStateInt = E_DL_WrapSeqState.eTop THEN
            nTopDone := nTopDone + 1;        // 顶圈计数推进 / Top count up
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_IF

IF tonTurnLoss.Q AND (NOT bTurnLossInt) THEN
    bTurnLossInt := TRUE;            // 反馈丢失锁存 / Loss latched
    uErrorId     := 16#0005_03AA;    // 故障级：反馈丢失 / Fault: feedback loss
    bErrorInt    := TRUE;
    eStateInt    := E_DL_WrapSeqState.eFault;   // 锁存同步迁相（FB50-1④）/ Latch migrates phase
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 8｜切膜重试节流与计数饱和
 *      Film cut retry throttle and count saturation
 *      重试由自复位间隔窗节流：每窗到期 +1 次（防同拍连发）
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF (eStateInt = E_DL_WrapSeqState.eCut) AND tonCutTo.Q AND tonCutDwell.Q THEN
    (* 双窗合流节流：切膜窗保持超时的同时，重试间隔窗到期才计一次（防同拍连发） *)
    (* Double-window throttle: count at most once per dwell period while timed out *)
    IF nRetryInt < nCutRetryMax THEN
        nRetryInt := nRetryInt + 1;  // 重试计数推进 / Retry count up
    END_IF
    IF nRetryInt >= nCutRetryMax THEN
        uErrorId := 16#0005_04D3;    // 信息级：重试已饱和 / Info: retries saturated
    END_IF
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 9｜输出单一出口（范式 P-05）
 *      Single output exit
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bTurnDrive   := bTurnDriveInt AND (NOT bTurnLossInt);
bPreClampOut := (eStateInt = E_DL_WrapSeqState.ePreClamp);
bCutOut      := (eStateInt = E_DL_WrapSeqState.eCut) AND (NOT bCutDone);
bPauseHold   := bPauseHoldInt;
bSeqActive   := (eStateInt <> E_DL_WrapSeqState.eIdle) AND (eStateInt <> E_DL_WrapSeqState.eFault);
bSeqDone     := bDoneT;              // 完成脉冲统一出口（预清 + 两段式）/ Unified done exit
nTurnsDone   := nBottomDone + nTopDone;
nCutRetries  := nRetryInt;
bError       := bErrorInt OR (eStateInt = E_DL_WrapSeqState.eFault);
eState       := eStateInt;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 室外气温重置热工供水设定：OAT 高水温低两点式线性重置曲线插值供水设定值，输出上下限夹持，最小水温防结露/防冻硬下限，重置斜坡限速；OAT 传感器失效保持上次有效设定并陈旧计时超限置码，用于锅炉/换热机组气候补偿。边界：OAT 非有限/失效保持 + 陈旧置码（NE43 域外显式化）；曲线两点重合（斜率除零）冻结输出 + 组态码；下限>上限自动换位。

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_OatResetState（归属 DL_Process，与 FB_DL_OutdoorTempReset 同文件）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_OatResetState :
(
    eIdle  := 0,    // 未使能：设定值输出安全下限 / Disabled, setpoint at safe floor
    eRun   := 10,   // 重置运行：曲线 + 夹持 + 斜坡 / Resetting, curve plus clamp plus ramp
    eFault := 99    // 组态 / 陈旧锁存：输出冻结保持 / Latched, output frozen
);
END_TYPE

(*==============================================================================
 * 功能块: FB_DL_OutdoorTempReset
 * 调用约定: 每个扫描周期无条件调用一次。
 *============================================================================*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_OutdoorTempReset
VAR_INPUT
    fOat        : REAL;                  // 室外气温 [℃] / Outdoor air temperature [degC]
    bOatValid   : BOOL := TRUE;          // OAT 传感器有效标志 / OAT sensor valid flag
    fOatLow     : REAL := 0.0;           // 曲线低温点 [℃] / Curve low OAT point [degC]
    fOatHigh    : REAL := 20.0;          // 曲线高温点 [℃] / Curve high OAT point [degC]
    fWaterAtLow : REAL := 50.0;          // 低温点对应水温 [℃] / Water setpoint at low OAT [degC]
    fWaterAtHigh: REAL := 40.0;          // 高温点对应水温 [℃] / Water setpoint at high OAT [degC]
    fResetHiLim : REAL := 55.0;          // 重置输出上限 [℃] / Reset output ceiling [degC]
    fResetLoLim : REAL := 35.0;          // 重置输出下限 [℃] / Reset output floor [degC]
    fWaterMin   : REAL := 30.0;          // 最小水温硬下限 [℃]（防结露 / 防冻）/ Hard water floor [degC]
    fRampRate   : REAL := 2.0;           // 重置斜坡限速 [℃/min] / Reset ramp rate [degC per min]
    tSample     : TIME := T#100MS;       // 斜坡采样周期 [ms] / Ramp sample period [ms]
    tStaleLimit : TIME := T#5M;          // OAT 陈旧超限窗 [min] / OAT stale limit window [min]
    bEnable     : BOOL := TRUE;          // 使能 / Enable
    bReset      : BOOL;                  // 上升沿：清除组态 / 陈旧锁存 / Rising edge: clear latches
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fWaterSetpoint : REAL;               // 供水设定输出 [℃] / Water setpoint output [degC]
    bHoldStale     : BOOL;               // 陈旧保持中（输出冻结）/ Stale hold, output frozen
    bError         : BOOL;               // 故障标志（组态 / 陈旧锁存归并）/ Fault flag merged
    uErrorId       : UDINT;              // 故障码，0 = 无故障 / Error code, 0 = none
    eState         : E_DL_OatResetState; // 当前状态（供 HMI 诊断）/ Current state
END_VAR
VAR
    fbTrigReset  : R_TRIG;               // 复位沿检测实例 / Reset edge detector
    tonStale     : TON;                  // OAT 陈旧计时实例 / OAT stale timer
    fbRamp       : FB_DL_RateLimiter;    // 斜坡限速委托实例 / Ramp rate limiter delegate
    eStateInt    : E_DL_OatResetState;   // 主状态机内部当前态 / Internal state machine state
    bOatBad      : BOOL;                 // 本拍 OAT 无效（失效标志或非有限）/ OAT invalid this scan
    bStaleInt    : BOOL;                 // 陈旧超限锁存内部副本 / Internal stale latch
    bCurveBad    : BOOL;                 // 本拍曲线两点重合 / Curve points coincide this scan
    bCurveLatch  : BOOL;                 // 曲线故障锁存 / Curve fault latch
    bCfgBad      : BOOL;                 // 本拍通用组态非法 / General config illegal this scan
    bCfgLatch    : BOOL;                 // 通用组态锁存 / General config latch
    fOatLoEff    : REAL;                 // 钳定后曲线低温点 [℃] / Clamped curve low point
    fOatHiEff    : REAL;                 // 钳定后曲线高温点 [℃] / Clamped curve high point
    fWatLoEff    : REAL;                 // 钳定后低温点水温 [℃] / Clamped water at low
    fWatHiEff    : REAL;                 // 钳定后高温点水温 [℃] / Clamped water at high
    fLimHiEff    : REAL;                 // 换位后夹持上限 [℃] / Swapped clamp ceiling
    fLimLoEff    : REAL;                 // 换位后夹持下限 [℃] / Swapped clamp floor
    fRampEff     : REAL;                 // 换算后斜坡速率 [℃/s] / Converted ramp rate
    fWaterRaw    : REAL;                 // 曲线原始输出 [℃] / Raw curve output
    fWaterClamp  : REAL;                 // 夹持后目标 [℃] / Clamped target
    fWaterTarget : REAL;                 // 硬下限后目标 [℃] / Target after hard floor
    fLastValid   : REAL;                 // 上次有效设定保持槽 [℃] / Last valid setpoint hold slot
    bScaleOk     : BOOL;                 // 曲线换算有效标志（LinearScale 出口）/ Curve scaling valid
    uScaleErr    : UDINT;                // 曲线换算错误码透传 / Curve scaling error pass-through
    bErrorInt    : BOOL;                 // 本拍故障置位累加（出口归并）/ Fault set accumulator
    bFirstScan   : BOOL := TRUE;         // 上电首扫标志 / First-scan flag
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_OR_EPS       : REAL := 1.0E-6;    // 曲线跨度判零容差 [℃] / Curve span epsilon [degC]
    DL_OR_FIN_LIM   : REAL := 1.0E30;    // REAL 有限幅值判界 / REAL finiteness bound
    DL_OR_SEC_MIN   : REAL := 60.0;      // 分钟秒换算常数 [s/min] / Minutes to seconds factor
END_VAR

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 1｜无条件刷新区（红线 R7）：一沿一计时 + 斜坡委托件每拍调用
 *      Unconditional refresh: one edge, one timer, the ramp delegate every scan
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fbTrigReset(CLK := bReset);
tonStale(IN := bOatBad, PT := tStaleLimit);

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 2｜上电首扫：保持槽与输出落安全侧（硬下限）
 *      First-scan init: hold slot and output to the safe hard floor
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF bFirstScan THEN
    eStateInt  := E_DL_OatResetState.eIdle;
    fLastValid := fWaterMin;
    fWaterTarget := fWaterMin;
    fWaterSetpoint := fWaterMin;
    bFirstScan := FALSE;
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 3｜每拍预清（FB32-1）：单拍标志，禁入锁存 / 快照
 *      Per-scan preset: single-scan flags only
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bErrorInt := FALSE;

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 4｜OAT 有效性（非有限双判 R79）与陈旧计时
 *      OAT validity with the non-finite dual check and the stale timer
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bOatBad := (NOT bOatValid) OR (fOat <> fOat) OR ((fOat - fOat) <> (fOat - fOat))
           OR (ABS(fOat) >= DL_OR_FIN_LIM);

IF tonStale.Q THEN
    bStaleInt := TRUE;               // 陈旧超限锁存 / Stale limit latched
    uErrorId  := 16#0005_03AB;       // 故障级：OAT 陈旧 / Fault: OAT stale
    bErrorInt := TRUE;
END_IF

(* 陈旧锁存自动恢复路径（R152 自证可达）：传感器恢复有效即解除 *)
(* Stale latch auto-clear: reachable the moment the sensor recovers *)
IF (NOT bOatBad) THEN
    bStaleInt := FALSE;
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 5｜组态域闸（R151 全枚举）+ 两级回退（R117）+ 倒置换位（信息级）
 *      Config gate over all limits with fallback and the auto-swap
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bCfgBad := (fOatLow <> fOatLow) OR (fOatHigh <> fOatHigh)
           OR (fWaterAtLow <> fWaterAtLow) OR (fWaterAtHigh <> fWaterAtHigh)
           OR (fResetHiLim <> fResetHiLim) OR (fResetLoLim <> fResetLoLim)
           OR (fWaterMin <> fWaterMin) OR (fRampRate < 0.0) OR (fRampRate <> fRampRate)
           OR (tSample <= T#0S);

IF bCfgBad THEN
    bCfgLatch := TRUE;
    uErrorId  := 16#0005_03AD;       // 故障级：通用组态非法 / Fault: config illegal
    bErrorInt := TRUE;
END_IF

(* 曲线四点直通（非有限已在组态闸拦，此处取值） *)
(* Curve points pass-through, non-finite already gated *)
fOatLoEff := fOatLow;
fOatHiEff := fOatHigh;
fWatLoEff := fWaterAtLow;
fWatHiEff := fWaterAtHigh;

(* 曲线两点重合闸（斜率除零隐患）：eps 判 + 锁存冻结 *)
(* Curve coincide gate: epsilon check, latch and freeze *)
bCurveBad := ABS(fOatHiEff - fOatLoEff) < DL_OR_EPS;
IF bCurveBad THEN
    bCurveLatch := TRUE;
    uErrorId    := 16#0005_03AC;     // 故障级：两点重合 / Fault: points coincide
    bErrorInt   := TRUE;
END_IF

(* 夹持限倒置自动换位（信息级落码，RollerGapAdjust 先例口径；NaN 已被组态闸拦截） *)
(* Clamp limits auto-swap; NaN already caught by the config gate *)
IF fResetLoLim > fResetHiLim THEN
    fLimHiEff := fResetLoLim;        // 换位：上限取原下限 / Swap: ceiling takes the old floor
    fLimLoEff := fResetHiLim;        // 换位：下限取原上限 / Swap: floor takes the old ceiling
    uErrorId  := 16#0005_04D4;       // 信息级：倒置换位 / Info: swapped
ELSE
    fLimHiEff := fResetHiLim;        // 正序直通 / Ordered pass-through
    fLimLoEff := fResetLoLim;
END_IF

(* 斜坡速率换算：[℃/min] -> [℃/s]（RateLimiter 口径），负值已在组态闸拦 *)
(* Ramp rate conversion to per-second for the RateLimiter *)
fRampEff := fRampRate / DL_OR_SEC_MIN;

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 6｜主状态机（红线 R6）：ENUM + CASE + ELSE 兜底
 *      Main state machine with the mandatory ELSE fallback
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
CASE eStateInt OF

    E_DL_OatResetState.eIdle:
        IF bEnable AND (NOT bCfgLatch) AND (NOT bCurveLatch) THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_OatResetState.eRun;
        ELSE
            fWaterSetpoint := fWaterMin;     // 失能安全侧：硬下限 / Safe floor when disabled
        END_IF

    E_DL_OatResetState.eRun:
        IF bCfgLatch OR bCurveLatch OR (NOT bEnable) THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_OatResetState.eFault;
        ELSE
            (* —— 曲线计算核（委托 LinearScale）：OAT 有效才推进 —— *)
            (* Curve kernel delegated to LinearScale, only when OAT valid *)
            IF bOatBad THEN
                bHoldStale := TRUE;          // 陈旧保持（跟踪冻结，输出不推进）/ Stale hold via track
            ELSE
                bHoldStale := FALSE;
                fWaterRaw := FC_DL_LinearScale(fIn := fOat,            // 室外气温输入 / OAT input
                                               fInMin := fOatLoEff,    // 曲线低温点 / Low point
                                               fInMax := fOatHiEff,    // 曲线高温点 / High point
                                               fOutMin := fWatLoEff,   // 低温点水温 / Water at low
                                               fOutMax := fWatHiEff,   // 高温点水温 / Water at high
                                               bClamp := FALSE,        // 钳位由本件夹持段承担 / Clamping here
                                               bValid => bScaleOk,
                                               uErrorId => uScaleErr);
                IF bScaleOk THEN
                    (* —— 夹持 + 硬下限（防冻 / 防结露优先） —— *)
                    (* Clamp plus hard floor, safety floor wins *)
                    fWaterClamp := fWaterRaw;
                    IF fWaterClamp > fLimHiEff THEN
                        fWaterClamp := fLimHiEff;
                    ELSIF fWaterClamp < fLimLoEff THEN
                        fWaterClamp := fLimLoEff;
                    END_IF
                    IF fWaterClamp < fWaterMin THEN
                        fWaterClamp := fWaterMin;    // 硬下限赢（安全侧）/ Hard floor wins
                    END_IF
                    fWaterTarget := fWaterClamp;
                    fLastValid   := fWaterClamp;     // 保持槽刷新 / Hold slot refreshed
                ELSE
                    uErrorId  := 16#0005_03AD;       // 换算无效回落组态口径 / Fold to config code
                    bErrorInt := TRUE;
                END_IF
            END_IF
        END_IF

    E_DL_OatResetState.eFault:
        (* 输出冻结保持（降级语义已声明 R191）：经跟踪引脚无扰冻结 *)
        bHoldStale := TRUE;
        (* 解除路径（R152 自证可达）：复位沿 AND 组态改对 AND 两点分开 AND OAT 有效 *)
        IF fbTrigReset.Q AND (NOT bCfgBad) AND (NOT bCurveBad) AND (NOT bOatBad) THEN
            bCfgLatch  := FALSE;
            bCurveLatch := FALSE;
            bStaleInt  := FALSE;
            uErrorId   := 16#0000_0000;
            eStateInt  := E_DL_OatResetState.eRun;
        END_IF

    ELSE
        eStateInt := E_DL_OatResetState.eFault;
        uErrorId  := 16#0005_03AD;
        bErrorInt := TRUE;

END_CASE;

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 7｜斜坡限速（委托 RateLimiter）：陈旧 / 故障期经跟踪引脚无扰冻结
 *      Ramp via the RateLimiter delegate, frozen by track when stale or faulted
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fbRamp(bEnable := TRUE,
       fIn := fWaterTarget,
       fRateUp := fRampEff,
       fRateDown := fRampEff,
       bTrack := bHoldStale OR (eStateInt <> E_DL_OatResetState.eRun),
       fTrackValue := fLastValid,
       tSampleTime := tSample);

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 8｜输出单一出口（范式 P-05）
 *      Single output exit
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fWaterSetpoint := fbRamp.fOut;
bError := bErrorInt OR (eStateInt = E_DL_OatResetState.eFault);
eState := eStateInt;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 窑炉窑压定值控制：窑压闭环 PID 调烟囱抽力执行器，窑门开度扰动前馈预置抽力增量，窑压双表冗余偏差窗可选，负压超限联锁禁升温指令放行（只拦不放，执行归温区件），用于隧道窑/辊道窑压力制度稳定。边界：前馈增益域闸；PID 失能输出安全侧回挡板位；负压联锁不锁存（放行闸非故障锁存）；双表偏差超窗保持主表 + 置码（NE43 口径）。
architecture_thought: 委托组合架构：PidController 引脚注入不内联 + FeedforwardComp 前馈组合 + ToleranceWindow 双表冗余；前馈与反馈求和单出口；负压闸为放行型联锁（与 InterlockMatrix 分工互引——闸不放行不锁存）；失能安全位（挡板回安全开度）。

(*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 枚举: E_DL_KilnPressState（归属 DL_Process，与 FB_DL_KilnPressureCtrl 同文件）
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
TYPE E_DL_KilnPressState :
(
    eIdle  := 0,    // 未使能：挡板回安全位 / Disabled, damper at safe position
    eRun   := 10,   // 闭环运行：PID + 前馈合成 / Closed loop, PID plus feedforward
    eFault := 99    // 测点 / 组态锁存：挡板回安全位 / Latched, damper at safe position
);
END_TYPE

(*==============================================================================
 * 功能块: FB_DL_KilnPressureCtrl
 * 调用约定: 每个扫描周期无条件调用一次。
 *============================================================================*)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_KilnPressureCtrl
VAR_INPUT
    fPressMain     : REAL;               // 窑压主表 [Pa] / Kiln pressure main gauge [Pa]
    fPressBackup   : REAL;               // 窑压备份表 [Pa] / Kiln pressure backup gauge [Pa]
    bUseBackup     : BOOL;               // 双表冗余核对使能 / Dual gauge cross-check enable
    fPressDevWin   : REAL := 20.0;       // 双表偏差窗 [Pa] / Dual gauge deviation window [Pa]
    fPressSetpoint : REAL;               // 窑压设定 [Pa] / Kiln pressure setpoint [Pa]
    fDoorOpenPct   : REAL;               // 窑门开度 [%]，前馈扰动源 / Door opening [%], disturbance source
    fFfGain        : REAL := 0.5;        // 前馈增益 [1]，负值 / 非法锁存 / Feedforward gain
    fNegPressLim   : REAL := -50.0;      // 负压上限 [Pa]，低于此禁升温放行 / Negative pressure limit [Pa]
    fDamperMin     : REAL := 0.0;        // 挡板输出下限 [%] / Damper output floor [%]
    fDamperMax     : REAL := 100.0;      // 挡板输出上限 [%] / Damper output ceiling [%]
    fDamperSafe    : REAL := 0.0;        // 失能 / 故障安全挡板位 [%] / Safe damper position [%]
    fKp            : REAL := 1.0;        // PID 比例增益（透传）/ PID proportional gain
    tTi            : TIME := T#10S;      // PID 积分时间（透传）/ PID integral time
    tSample        : TIME := T#100MS;    // 采样周期 / Sample period
    bEnable        : BOOL := TRUE;       // 使能（FALSE 挡板回安全位）/ Enable, FALSE drives safe position
    bReset         : BOOL;               // 上升沿：清除偏差 / 增益锁存 / Rising edge: clear latches
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fDamperOut   : REAL;                // 挡板输出 [%]（已限幅合成）/ Damper output, clamped
    bRisePermit  : BOOL;                // 升温指令放行闸（每拍重算，不锁存）/ Rise permit, recomputed
    bDevLatch    : BOOL;                // 双表偏差锁存 / Dual gauge deviation latched
    bPressBad    : BOOL;                // 窑压测点非有限（保持型）/ Gauge non-finite, level held
    bError       : BOOL;                // 故障标志（锁存类归并）/ Fault flag merged
    uErrorId     : UDINT;               // 故障码，0 = 无故障 / Error code, 0 = none
    eState       : E_DL_KilnPressState; // 当前状态（供 HMI 诊断）/ Current state
END_VAR
VAR
    fbTrigReset  : R_TRIG;              // 复位沿检测实例 / Reset edge detector
    fbTol        : FB_DL_ToleranceWindow; // 双表偏差窗委托实例 / Deviation window delegate
    fbPid        : FB_DL_PidController; // PID 闭环委托实例 / PID delegate
    fbFf         : FB_DL_FeedforwardComp; // 前馈委托实例 / Feedforward delegate
    eStateInt    : E_DL_KilnPressState; // 主状态机内部当前态 / Internal state machine state
    bMainBad     : BOOL;                // 主表非有限 / Main gauge non-finite
    bBackupBad   : BOOL;                // 备份表非有限 / Backup gauge non-finite
    bPressBadInt : BOOL;                // 测点非有限保持位内部副本 / Internal gauge-bad level
    bDevInt      : BOOL;                // 偏差锁存内部副本 / Internal deviation latch
    bGainBad     : BOOL;                // 前馈增益非法 / Feedforward gain illegal
    bGainLatch   : BOOL;                // 增益锁存 / Gain latch
    bCfgBad      : BOOL;                // 本拍通用组态非法 / General config illegal this scan
    bCfgLatch    : BOOL;                // 通用组态锁存 / General config latch
    fPressUse    : REAL;                // 参与判据与 PID 的窑压值 [Pa] / Gauge value used
    fFfGainEff   : REAL;                // 生效前馈增益（非法时 0）/ Effective gain, 0 when illegal
    fPidOut      : REAL;                // PID 输出 [%] / PID output
    fFfOut       : REAL;                // 前馈输出 [%] / Feedforward output
    fSumRaw      : REAL;                // 合成原始量 [%] / Raw combined output
    bErrorInt    : BOOL;                // 本拍故障置位累加（出口归并）/ Fault set accumulator
    bFirstScan   : BOOL := TRUE;        // 上电首扫标志 / First-scan flag
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_KP_FIN_LIM : REAL := 1.0E30;   // REAL 有限幅值判界 / REAL finiteness bound
END_VAR

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 1｜无条件刷新区（红线 R7）：一沿 + 三委托件每拍无条件调用
 *      Unconditional refresh: one edge plus three delegates called every scan
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fbTrigReset(CLK := bReset);

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 2｜上电首扫：状态与合成量落安全侧
 *      First-scan init: state and combined output to the safe side
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF bFirstScan THEN
    eStateInt := E_DL_KilnPressState.eIdle;
    fSumRaw   := 0.0;
    fDamperOut := fDamperSafe;
    bFirstScan := FALSE;
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 3｜每拍预清（FB32-1）：单拍标志，禁入锁存 / 快照
 *      Per-scan preset: single-scan flags only
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bErrorInt := FALSE;

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 4｜非有限闸（R272：本件判据直接引用的测量引脚）与组态域闸
 *      Non-finite gates over the gauges, plus the config gate
 *      引脚分闸归属：fPressSetpoint / fKp / tTi 透传 PID 由其自身域闸负责（披露 6）
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
bMainBad   := (fPressMain <> fPressMain) OR ((fPressMain - fPressMain) <> (fPressMain - fPressMain))
              OR (ABS(fPressMain) >= DL_KP_FIN_LIM);
bBackupBad := (fPressBackup <> fPressBackup) OR ((fPressBackup - fPressBackup) <> (fPressBackup - fPressBackup))
              OR (ABS(fPressBackup) >= DL_KP_FIN_LIM);

bPressBadInt := bMainBad OR (bUseBackup AND bBackupBad);
IF bPressBadInt THEN
    uErrorId  := 16#0005_03B0;       // 故障级：窑压测点非有限 / Fault: gauge non-finite
    bErrorInt := TRUE;
END_IF

bCfgBad := (fPressDevWin <= 0.0) OR (fPressDevWin <> fPressDevWin)
           OR (fNegPressLim <> fNegPressLim)
           OR (fDamperMin > fDamperMax) OR (fDamperMin <> fDamperMin) OR (fDamperMax <> fDamperMax)
           OR (fDamperSafe < fDamperMin) OR (fDamperSafe > fDamperMax) OR (fDamperSafe <> fDamperSafe)
           OR (tSample <= T#0S);

IF bCfgBad THEN
    bCfgLatch := TRUE;
    uErrorId  := 16#0005_03B1;       // 故障级：通用组态非法（独立成因独立码，R190）/ Fault: config illegal
    bErrorInt := TRUE;
END_IF

(* 前馈增益域闸：负值 / 非独立成因 -> 独立码位 *)
(* Feedforward gain gate with its own cause code *)
bGainBad := (fFfGain < 0.0) OR (fFfGain <> fFfGain);
IF bGainBad THEN
    bGainLatch := TRUE;
    uErrorId   := 16#0005_03AF;      // 故障级：前馈增益非法 / Fault: gain illegal
    bErrorInt  := TRUE;
END_IF
IF bGainLatch THEN
    fFfGainEff := 0.0;               // 非法增益强制 0（不参与合成）/ Forced zero
ELSE
    fFfGainEff := fFfGain;
END_IF

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 5｜双表偏差窗（委托 ToleranceWindow）与测点选择（NE43 保持主表）
 *      Dual gauge deviation window and gauge selection, main kept on deviation
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
fbTol(bEnable := bUseBackup,
      fTarget := fPressMain,
      fActual := fPressBackup,
      fTolerance := fPressDevWin,
      fHysteresis := 0.0);

IF bUseBackup AND (NOT fbTol.bOk) AND (NOT bMainBad) AND (NOT bBackupBad) THEN
    bDevInt := TRUE;                 // 偏差越窗锁存 / Deviation latched
    uErrorId := 16#0005_03AE;
    bErrorInt := TRUE;
END_IF

(* 解除路径（R152 自证可达）：复位沿 AND 偏差回窗 *)
IF fbTrigReset.Q AND fbTol.bOk THEN
    bDevInt := FALSE;
END_IF

(* 测点选择：偏差 / 失效一律保持主表（NE43 口径，不猜备份表） *)
(* Gauge selection: main kept on deviation or failure, never guessing *)
fPressUse := fPressMain;

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 6｜主状态机（红线 R6）：ENUM + CASE + ELSE 兜底
 *      Main state machine with the mandatory ELSE fallback
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
CASE eStateInt OF

    E_DL_KilnPressState.eIdle:
        IF bEnable AND (NOT bCfgLatch) AND (NOT bGainLatch) AND (NOT bPressBadInt) THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_KilnPressState.eRun;
        ELSE
            fSumRaw := 0.0;          // 失能：合成量清零，出口派生安全位 / Idle: combined zeroed
        END_IF

    E_DL_KilnPressState.eRun:
        IF bCfgLatch OR bGainLatch OR bPressBadInt OR (NOT bEnable) THEN
            eStateInt := E_DL_KilnPressState.eFault;
        ELSE
            (* —— PID 闭环（委托，引脚注入不内联） —— *)
            fbPid(bEnable := TRUE,
                  bManual := FALSE,
                  fSetpoint := fPressSetpoint,
                  fActual := fPressUse,
                  fKp := fKp,
                  tTi := tTi,
                  rOutMin := fDamperMin,
                  rOutMax := fDamperMax,
                  tSampleTime := tSample,
                  bReset := bReset);
            fPidOut := fbPid.fOut;

            (* —— 窑门开扰动前馈（委托）：门开 -> 抽力预置增量 —— *)
            fbFf(bEnable := TRUE,
                 fDisturbance := fDoorOpenPct,
                 fFfGain := fFfGainEff,
                 rOutMin := 0.0,
                 rOutMax := fDamperMax,
                 tSampleTime := tSample);
            fFfOut := fbFf.fFfOut;

            fSumRaw := fPidOut + fFfOut;     // 合成（出口段统一限幅）/ Combined, clamped at exit
        END_IF

    E_DL_KilnPressState.eFault:
        fSumRaw := 0.0;              // 故障相合成量清零 -> 出口派生安全位（R191 降级声明）/ Safe via exit
        (* 解除路径（R152 自证可达）：复位沿 AND 全部锁存源已恢复 *)
        IF fbTrigReset.Q AND (NOT bCfgBad) AND (NOT bGainBad) AND (NOT bPressBadInt) THEN
            bCfgLatch   := FALSE;
            bGainLatch  := FALSE;
            uErrorId    := 16#0000_0000;
            eStateInt   := E_DL_KilnPressState.eIdle;
        END_IF

    ELSE
        eStateInt := E_DL_KilnPressState.eFault;
        uErrorId  := 16#0005_03B1;
        bErrorInt := TRUE;

END_CASE;

(*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 段 7｜输出单一出口（范式 P-05）：限幅合成 + 负压放行闸 + 安全位派生
 *      Single output exit: clamped combine plus the rise permit derivation
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*)
IF eStateInt = E_DL_KilnPressState.eRun THEN
    fDamperOut := fSumRaw;           // 运行相：合成量直出 / Run: combined as-is
    IF fDamperOut > fDamperMax THEN
        fDamperOut := fDamperMax;    // 出口限幅 / Exit clamp
    ELSIF fDamperOut < fDamperMin THEN
        fDamperOut := fDamperMin;
    END_IF
ELSE
    fDamperOut := fDamperSafe;       // 失能 / 故障：安全挡板位（R191 已声明）/ Safe position
END_IF

(* 负压联锁（放行闸，不锁存）：窑压低于负压上限即拦截升温放行 *)
(* Negative pressure interlock: blocks the rise permit, never latched *)
IF (eStateInt = E_DL_KilnPressState.eRun) AND (fPressUse < fNegPressLim) THEN
    bRisePermit := FALSE;
    uErrorId    := 16#0005_04D5;     // 信息级：拦截事件 / Info: blocking event
ELSE
    bRisePermit := (eStateInt = E_DL_KilnPressState.eRun);
END_IF

bDevLatch := bDevInt;
bPressBad := bPressBadInt;
bError    := bErrorInt OR (eStateInt = E_DL_KilnPressState.eFault);
eState    := eStateInt;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
