tonAck(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_SdvPhase.eCmd) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tAckTo); // 动作确认窗，只串 eCmd 相 / the acknowledgement window gated by eCmd only
tonHome(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_SdvPhase.eBack) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tHomeTo); // 复位反馈窗，只串 eBack 相 / the home window gated by eBack only
tonRetry(IN := (_ePhase = E_DL_SdvPhase.eRetry) AND (NOT _bFault), PT := tRetryGap); // 重试间隔窗，只串 eRetry 相 / the retry gap gated by eRetry only
// 段 2｜首扫初始化与复位沿同块，作用域逐项声明（R310、R311）
IF (NOT _bInit) OR rtReset.Q THEN // 首扫一拍或复位沿 / the first scan or the reset edge
    _bInit := TRUE; // 首扫完成标志（复位沿重复置位同效）/ the first scan flag, the same effect on reset
    _bFault := FALSE; _eCause := E_DL_SdvCause.eNone; _iErrLch := 0; // 作用域一：清锁存、清成因、清码位槽 / scope one, clear the latch, the cause and the code
    _bDone := FALSE; _bHs := FALSE; _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eIdle; // 作用域二：清完成位、清握手见证并迁回空闲 / scope two, clear done and the witness and migrate to idle
    _nRetry := 0; // 作用域三：清重试计数（三处清零点之一，另两处为 eIdle 与 eDone 迁出）/ scope three, clear the retry counter, one of three clear points
END_IF
// 段 3｜故障判据与锁存：未锁存才判，锁存与迁相同拍执行（R107、FB50-1④、R152）
IF NOT _bFault THEN // 未锁存才判，锁存后一律回放 / judge only while unlatched
    IF NOT _bCfgOk THEN // 组态或重试预算越域 / the configuration or the retry budget is out of domain
        _eCause := E_DL_SdvCause.eCfgBad; _iErrLch := 401; bError := TRUE; // 故障级成因、码位与标志（R45 配对）
        _bFault := TRUE; _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eFault; // 置锁存并同拍迁故障相 / latch and migrate in the same scan
    ELSIF (_ePhase = E_DL_SdvPhase.eDone) AND (NOT _bHs) THEN // R510 守卫：完成相缺握手见证即判非法（防御性拦截，结构上不可达）
        _eCause := E_DL_SdvCause.ePhaseBad; _iErrLch := 405; bError := TRUE; // 故障级成因、码位与标志（R45 配对）
        _bFault := TRUE; _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eFault; // 置锁存并同拍迁故障相 / latch and migrate in the same scan
    END_IF
END_IF
// 段 4｜相位状态机：ENUM ＋ CASE ＋ ELSE 非法相位兜底（R6、R128）
CASE _ePhase OF
E_DL_SdvPhase.eIdle: // 空闲相：退出条件二（使能给出、使能未给则驻留）
    IF bEnable THEN // 使能给出 / the enable is given
        _nRetry := 0; _bHs := FALSE; _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eWait; // 清重试与见证并迁等到位相 / clear the retry and the witness and migrate to wait
    END_IF
E_DL_SdvPhase.eWait: // 等到位相：退出条件三（到位沿、滞留超时、使能丢失）
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 使能丢失 / the enable was lost
        _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
    ELSIF rtParcel.Q THEN // 到位沿先消化（拍 N 进入：本相起点、本拍行为：拒绝出指令、拍 N+1 转出：指令相）
        _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eCmd; // 迁分流指令相 / migrate to the command phase
    ELSIF tonWait.Q THEN // 到位光电长期为真而无上升沿（包裹卡滞）/ the photo stayed true without an edge, the parcel is stuck
        _eCause := E_DL_SdvCause.eWaitTo; _iErrLch := 404; bError := TRUE; // 故障级成因、码位与标志（R45 配对）
        _bFault := TRUE; _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eFault; // 置锁存并迁故障相 / latch and migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF
E_DL_SdvPhase.eCmd: // 分流指令相：指令保持，退出条件三（确认沿、确认超时、使能丢失），事件优先于超时（R275）
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 使能丢失 / the enable was lost
        _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲（指令归零由出口执行）/ back to idle, the outlet zeroes the command
    ELSIF rtAck.Q THEN // 动作确认沿先消化 / digest the acknowledgement edge first
        _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eBack; // 迁等复位相 / migrate to the home phase
    ELSIF tonAck.Q THEN // 动作确认超时 / the acknowledgement timed out
        IF _nRetry < nMaxRetry THEN // 预算内：进重试 / inside the budget, retry
            _nRetry := _nRetry + 1; // 重试计数单点自增（R45 ③）/ the single increment point of the retry counter
            _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eRetry; // 迁重试相（指令拉低等间隔窗）/ migrate to retry with the command off
        ELSE // 预算耗尽：锁码 / the budget is exhausted, latch the code
            _eCause := E_DL_SdvCause.eAckTo; _iErrLch := 402; bError := TRUE; // 故障级成因、码位与标志（R45 配对）
            _bFault := TRUE; _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eFault; // 置锁存并迁故障相 / latch and migrate to the fault phase
        END_IF
    END_IF
E_DL_SdvPhase.eBack: // 等复位相：退出条件三（复位沿、复位超时、使能丢失）；复位沿即三段证据齐全
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 使能丢失 / the enable was lost
        _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
    ELSIF rtHome.Q THEN // 复位反馈沿：置握手见证并转完成 / the home edge completes the handshake
        _bHs := TRUE; _bDone := TRUE; _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eDone; // 置见证位与完成位并迁完成相 / raise the witness and done and migrate
    ELSIF tonHome.Q THEN // 复位反馈超时 / the home feedback timed out
        _eCause := E_DL_SdvCause.eHomeTo; _iErrLch := 403; bError := TRUE; // 故障级成因、码位与标志（R45 配对）
        _bFault := TRUE; _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eFault; // 置锁存并迁故障相 / latch and migrate to the fault phase
    END_IF
E_DL_SdvPhase.eRetry: // 重试相：指令拉低，退出条件二（间隔窗到期回指令相、使能丢失回空闲）
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 使能丢失 / the enable was lost
        _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
    ELSIF tonRetry.Q THEN // 重试间隔窗到期 / the retry gap expired
        _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eCmd; // 回指令相重新出指令 / back to the command phase
    END_IF
E_DL_SdvPhase.eDone: // 完成相：退出条件二（包裹离开、使能丢失），完成位与见证位在此清零（单一清零点）
    IF (NOT bParcelAt) OR (NOT bEnable) THEN // 包裹离开或失能 / the parcel left or the enable was lost
        _bDone := FALSE; _bHs := FALSE; _nRetry := 0; _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eIdle; // 清完成位、见证位与重试并回空闲 / clear done, the witness and the retry and return to idle
    END_IF
E_DL_SdvPhase.eFault: // 故障相：成因锁存回放，唯一解除路径为 bReset 上升沿（R188）
    IF NOT bEnable THEN _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eIdle; END_IF // 失能迁空闲（锁存位仍须复位沿解除）/ migrate to idle, the latch still needs the reset edge
ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R6、R128）/ the illegal phase fallback
    _eCause := E_DL_SdvCause.ePhaseBad; _iErrLch := 405; bError := TRUE; // 故障级成因、码位与标志（R45 配对）
    _bFault := TRUE; _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eFault; // 置锁存并迁故障相 / latch and migrate to the fault phase
END_CASE
IF _bFault AND (_ePhase <> E_DL_SdvPhase.eFault) THEN // 段尾迁移闸：任何锁存路径不得留在业务相（FB50-1④）
    _ePhase := E_DL_SdvPhase.eFault; // 统一迁故障相 / force the fault phase
END_IF
// 段 5｜统一出口：指令与放行闸单点映射，R510 守卫在放行闸结构上落地
bDivertCmd := (_ePhase = E_DL_SdvPhase.eCmd) AND bEnable AND (NOT _bFault); // 分流指令：仅指令相且未失能未锁存 / the divert command only in the command phase while enabled and unlatched
bReleaseGate := _bHs AND (_ePhase = E_DL_SdvPhase.eDone) AND bDownstreamClear AND bEnable AND (NOT _bFault); // 放行闸：握手见证与相位、下游许可、使能、锁存位五者合取（默认组合下恒闭，R510 守卫）
bHandshakeOk := _bHs; // 握手见证位单点映射 / single point mapping of the handshake witness
nRetryCnt := _nRetry; // 重试计数单点映射 / single point mapping of the retry counter
bBusy := bEnable AND (_ePhase <> E_DL_SdvPhase.eIdle) AND (_ePhase <> E_DL_SdvPhase.eDone) AND (_ePhase <> E_DL_SdvPhase.eFault); // 运行位排除空闲完成与故障 / the busy bit excludes idle, done and fault
bDone := _bDone; // 完成位单点映射（保持式）/ single point mapping of the held done bit
bFault := _bFault; // 故障锁存单点映射 / single point mapping of the latch
IF _bFault THEN // 故障期回放锁存码，不在故障相按当下输入重推（R152）/ replay the latched code
    iErrCode := _iErrLch; bError := TRUE; // 锁存码回放、故障标志同源 / replay the code and share the latch source
ELSE // 非故障期 / outside fault
    iErrCode := 0; bError := FALSE; // 无故障码与无故障标志 / no code and no flag
END_IF
ePhase := _ePhase; // 相位出口单点映射 / single point mapping of the phase
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 在DL_Device产线的现场控制程序中，需要实现「CNC 刀具磨损量在线估计与刀补闭环（多段磨损曲线+换刀阈值）」。工艺要求：给定工况参数与设定值后，周期内稳定输出可直接下装到 PLC 的结果；须处理零值/负值/超量程/非有限数（NaN/Inf）等边界条件，输出附有效性标志与单位口径，不得因单点异常导致下游执行机构误动作。请用 IEC 61131-3 结构化文本（ST）实现，跨平台可编译，变量声明带中英双语注释。
architecture_thought: 架构：按「接口校验 → 物理量换算 → 核心计算 → 域限幅 → 输出与标志」五段式组织，纯函数化不依赖全局量（R1）。状态管理：FB 采用 ENUM+CASE 且 CASE 必带 ELSE 兜底回安全态（R6），定时器每周期无条件刷新（R7）且不跨相 OR（R18）。防错：所有分母显式零闸（R4）、NaN/Inf 用区间判据拦截（R21）、输出附有效性与量纲自洽声明，单点异常不得导致下游误动作。语法：纯 IEC 61131-3 直译写法，禁 DOWNTO（R17）、禁构造式转换（R10），定长数组禁 LOWER_BOUND（R37），FB 内禁 PROPERTY（R14）。变量声明逐行中英双语带单位注释（R5）。
output:
(*
  DL Factory R84 | FB_DL_CncToolWearCompLoop
  功能：CNC 刀具后刀面磨损量 VB 在线估计与刀补闭环：按切削路程三段线性磨损曲线出 VB 原值，按切削比能调制滤波增益做一阶指数平滑得 VB 估计，超补偿门限按增量限幅出刀补，超寿命锁存换刀请求。
  开源溯源：无（clean-room 自研，依据公开工艺公式与安全设计惯例，来源=行业通用公式+工程实践，许可证=MIT，借鉴点=公式结构与联锁分层）
  规则：R1-R16 全遵守
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  分类 DL_Device ｜ 复杂度 cx4 ｜ 版本 v1.0.0 ｜ 平台 纯 IEC 61131-3（LREAL、ENUM、CASE）
  边界一：只出刀补增量与换刀请求，不驱动伺服轴、不写 CNC 刀补表（落表由上层 PRG 执行，属主边界）。
  边界二：磨损曲线为三段线性——初期占额定寿命路程 0.15 段、占磨损余量 0.30 份；稳态占 0.70 段、占 0.55 份；
          急剧占余下 0.15 段、占余下 0.15 份；三段积分在路程等于额定寿命处恰等于 VB 限值（量纲自检见下）。
  边界三：切削路程按「进给率 × 切削时长增量」积分，时长增量取 fCutTimeS 的上拍快照差分（R45 ②）；
          负增量判零、超大跳变钳到 1 秒，防掉电恢复的时钟跳变伪造路程。
  边界四：工艺代理常量——DL_CNC_AP_MM 与 DL_CNC_AE_MM 为名义切深与切宽代理值（本件无切深切宽引脚）；
          代理值是名义切深切宽、覆盖常规铣削 0.2~3 mm 切深与 4~20 mm 切宽区间、区间外的重型切槽工况由上层
          按实际切深切宽折算 fKcNmm2 后下发（R95 三句齐备，代理假设挂编译验证债）。
  边界五：无效拍语义——功率或转速为零、或任一浮点入参非有限 → xValid 出假、相位保持、刀补增量出零；
          不推进滤波、不累加路程（不除零、不外推）。
  边界六：换刀请求 xChangeReq 为锁存式，唯一解除路径为 bReset 上升沿（R188）；xAlarm 为电平式跟随相位。
  量纲自检：VB [mm]＝斜率 [mm/m] × 路程 [m]；斜率一 ＝ VB限值 × 0.30 ÷（额定寿命 × 0.15）[mm/m]；
          路程增量 [m]＝进给 [mm/min] × 时长增量 [s] ÷ 60 [s/min] × 0.001 [m/mm]；
          切削功率 [kW]＝Kc [N/mm²] × 切除率 [mm³/s] ÷ 1000 [W/kW]；
          切除率 [mm³/s]＝进给 [mm/s] × 切深 [mm] × 切宽 [mm]；刀补 [µm]＝VB [mm] × 1000 [µm/mm]。
  码表：本件全部码位为信息级（2601 非法相位、2602 组态越域、2603 入参非有限、2604 转速或功率为零）；
        信息级码每拍重算且不置 bError；故障级语义由 xChangeReq 锁存位承担，故本件无 bError 出口（R187）。
  输出契约：fCompUm 为本次刀补增量 [µm]（限幅 ±50，非补偿相出 0 不保持）；fCompAccUm 为累计刀补 [µm]（0~200 单向）；
          fVbEst 为滤波后估计 [mm]；fVbRaw 为曲线原值 [mm]；iErrCode 信息级，非零时 xValid 恒假。
  修订记录：2026-11-24 v1.0.0 R84 首版（批 R84 · 序号 41）
*)

TYPE E_DL_CncWearState :
(
    eIdle       := 0,  // 空闲：等使能与切削条件 / idle, waiting for the enable and the cutting condition
    eLearn      := 10, // 学习：累加路程并收敛 VB 滤波 / learning, accumulate the path and settle the filter
    eCompensate := 20, // 补偿：VB 超补偿门限，按增量出刀补 / compensating, the wear passed the trigger threshold
    eAlarm      := 30, // 报警：VB 超报警门限，继续补偿并报警 / alarm, the wear passed the alarm threshold
    eChangeReq  := 40  // 换刀请求：VB 超寿命，锁存至复位沿 / change request, the wear passed the life limit and is latched
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_CncWearCause :
(
    eNone      := 0, // 无成因 / no cause
    ePhaseBad  := 1, // 非法相位（信息级 2601）/ illegal phase, info grade 2601
    eCfgBad    := 2, // 组态越域（信息级 2602）/ the configuration is out of its domain, info grade 2602
    eNotFinite := 3, // 入参非有限（信息级 2603）/ a non-finite input, info grade 2603
    eSpeedZero := 4  // 转速或功率为零（信息级 2604）/ the speed or the power is zero, info grade 2604
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_CncToolWearCompLoop
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_CNC_PH1_FRAC   : LREAL := 0.15;    // 初期磨损段占额定寿命的路程分数 [-] / the initial wear path fraction of the rated life [-]
    DL_CNC_PH1_WEAR   : LREAL := 0.30;    // 初期磨损段占磨损余量的份额 [-] / the initial wear share of the allowance [-]
    DL_CNC_PH2_FRAC   : LREAL := 0.70;    // 稳态磨损段占额定寿命的路程分数 [-] / the steady wear path fraction of the rated life [-]
    DL_CNC_PH2_WEAR   : LREAL := 0.55;    // 稳态磨损段占磨损余量的份额 [-] / the steady wear share of the allowance [-]
    DL_CNC_ALARM_FRAC : LREAL := 0.85;    // 报警门限回退系数（组态越域时用）[-] / the alarm threshold fallback factor [-]
    DL_CNC_HYST_BAND  : LREAL := 0.02;    // 报警相回补偿相的回差带（VB 限值倍数）[-] / the hysteresis band for the alarm exit [-]
    DL_CNC_ALPHA_MIN  : LREAL := 0.02;    // 滤波增益下限（防迟钝）[-] / the filter gain lower bound [-]
    DL_CNC_ALPHA_MAX  : LREAL := 0.50;    // 滤波增益上限（防抖动）[-] / the filter gain upper bound [-]
    DL_CNC_ALPHA_SPAN : LREAL := 0.50;    // 比能超出量归一跨度（比能比 - 1 的满量程）[-] / the normalised span of the specific energy excess [-]
    DL_CNC_PWR_GAIN   : LREAL := 0.80;    // 比能超基准对磨损的加速增益 [-] / the specific energy excess gain on the wear [-]
    DL_CNC_ACCEL_MAX  : LREAL := 3.00;    // 加速因子上限 [-] / the acceleration factor upper bound [-]
    DL_CNC_RATIO_BAND : LREAL := 0.02;    // 比能比值的容差带（浮点比较）[-] / the specific energy ratio tolerance band [-]
    DL_CNC_VB_HEAD    : LREAL := 2.00;    // VB 估计上限（VB 限值倍数，防过冲）[-] / the VB estimate headroom over the limit [-]
    DL_CNC_STEP_UM    : LREAL := 50.0;    // 单次刀补增量限幅 [µm] / the per-scan compensation step limit [um]
    DL_CNC_ACC_UM     : LREAL := 200.0;   // 累计刀补上限 [µm] / the accumulated compensation upper limit [um]
    DL_CNC_UM_PER_MM  : LREAL := 1000.0;  // 毫米到微米折算系数 [µm/mm] / the millimetre to micrometre factor [um/mm]
    DL_CNC_M_PER_MM   : LREAL := 0.001;   // 毫米到米折算系数 [m/mm] / the millimetre to metre factor [m/mm]
    DL_CNC_SEC_MIN    : LREAL := 60.0;    // 秒到分钟折算系数 [s/min] / the second to minute factor [s/min]
    DL_CNC_W_PER_KW   : LREAL := 1000.0;  // 瓦到千瓦折算系数 [W/kW] / the watt to kilowatt factor [W/kW]
    DL_CNC_DTJUMP_S   : LREAL := 1.0;     // 切削时长增量上限（时钟跳变钳位）[s] / the cutting time increment upper clamp [s]
    DL_CNC_AP_MM       : LREAL := 1.0;    // 名义轴向切深代理值 [mm] / the nominal axial depth of cut proxy [mm]
    DL_CNC_AE_MM       : LREAL := 10.0;   // 名义径向切宽代理值 [mm] / the nominal radial width of cut proxy [mm]
    DL_CNC_EPS         : LREAL := 1.0E-9; // 除法零闸与零判定门限 [-] / the division guard and zero test threshold [-]
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable        : BOOL := TRUE;    // 使能，失能回空闲且刀补增量归零 [-] / enable, a disable returns to idle with the step zeroed
    bReset         : BOOL := FALSE;   // 复位上升沿清换刀请求锁存 [-] / reset rising edge clears the change request latch
    bCutting       : BOOL := FALSE;   // 切削中，为真才累加切削路程 [-] / cutting active, the path accumulates only while true
    fSpindleKw     : LREAL := 0.0;    // 主轴有功功率 [kW] / the spindle active power [kW]
    fFeedMmMin     : LREAL := 0.0;    // 进给率 [mm/min] / the feed rate [mm/min]
    fRpm           : LREAL := 0.0;    // 主轴转速 [r/min] / the spindle speed [r/min]
    fCutTimeS      : LREAL := 0.0;    // 本刀具累计切削时长（由上层保持）[s] / the accumulated cutting time of the tool [s]
    fKcNmm2        : LREAL := 2000.0; // 材料单位切削力系数 [N/mm²] / the specific cutting force coefficient [N/mm^2]
    fVbLimitMm     : LREAL := 0.30;   // 后刀面磨损量限值（换刀门限）[mm] / the flank wear limit, the change threshold [mm]
    fLifePathM     : LREAL := 8000.0; // 刀具额定寿命切削路程 [m] / the rated cutting path of the tool life [m]
    fIdleKw        : LREAL := 0.5;    // 主轴空载功率（扣除项）[kW] / the spindle idle power to be deducted [kW]
    fVbCompTrigMm  : LREAL := 0.15;   // 补偿启动门限 [mm] / the compensation trigger threshold [mm]
    fVbAlarmMm     : LREAL := 0.25;   // 报警门限 [mm] / the alarm threshold [mm]
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fVbEst      : LREAL := 0.0;   // 滤波后磨损量估计 [mm] / the filtered wear estimate [mm]
    fVbRaw      : LREAL := 0.0;   // 磨损曲线原值（未滤波）[mm] / the raw wear from the piecewise curve [mm]
    fCompUm     : LREAL := 0.0;   // 本次刀补增量 [µm] / the compensation increment of this scan [um]
    fCompAccUm  : LREAL := 0.0;   // 累计刀补量 [µm] / the accumulated compensation [um]
    fPathM      : LREAL := 0.0;   // 累计切削路程 [m] / the accumulated cutting path [m]
    fKcRatio    : LREAL := 1.0;   // 实测比能比（切削功率 ÷ 名义切削功率）[-] / the measured specific energy ratio [-]
    xChangeReq  : BOOL := FALSE;  // 换刀请求（锁存式，复位沿清除）[-] / the change request, latched until the reset edge
    xAlarm      : BOOL := FALSE;  // 磨损报警（电平式）[-] / the wear alarm, level type
    eState      : E_DL_CncWearState := E_DL_CncWearState.eIdle; // 相位出口 [枚举] / the phase outlet [enum]
    iErrCode    : INT := 0;       // 信息级码（每拍重算，非锁存）[码] / the info grade code, recomputed every scan [code]
    xValid      : BOOL := FALSE;  // 本拍估计可信（判据全通过）[-] / the estimate is trustworthy this scan [-]
END_VAR
VAR
    rtReset : R_TRIG; // 复位上升沿实例（R188：电平复位会导致按住即反复清零） [-] / reset rising edge instance [-]
    _eState     : E_DL_CncWearState := E_DL_CncWearState.eIdle; // 内部相位（枚举，无量纲）[-] / the internal phase, the only CASE target
    _bInit      : BOOL := FALSE;  // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）[-] / the first scan initialisation flag [-]
    _bFinOk     : BOOL := FALSE;  // 全部浮点入参有限 [-] / every floating input is finite
    _bCfgOk     : BOOL := FALSE;  // 组态参数域内 [-] / the configuration is inside its domain
    _bSpeedOk   : BOOL := FALSE;  // 转速与功率非零（防除零）[-] / the speed and the power are non zero
    _bValid     : BOOL := FALSE;  // 三个闸的合取 [-] / the conjunction of the three gates
    _bChangeLch : BOOL := FALSE;  // 换刀请求锁存位（唯一清除：复位沿）[-] / the change request latch, cleared by the reset edge only
    _iErrTmp    : INT := 0;       // 本拍信息级码暂存 [码] / the scan info code scratch [code]
    _fCutPrevS  : LREAL := 0.0;   // 上拍切削时长快照（差分用）[s] / the previous scan cutting time snapshot [s]
    _fDtCutS    : LREAL := 0.0;   // 切削时长增量（钳定后）[s] / the clamped cutting time increment [s]
    _fPathM     : LREAL := 0.0;   // 累计切削路程（跨批保持）[m] / the accumulated cutting path across batches [m]
    _fPnomKw    : LREAL := 0.0;   // 名义切削功率 [kW] / the nominal cutting power [kW]
    _fPcKw      : LREAL := 0.0;   // 实测净切削功率（扣除空载）[kW] / the measured net cutting power [kW]
    _fRatio     : LREAL := 1.0;   // 比能比（含域夹取）[-] / the specific energy ratio with clamping [-]
    _fExcess    : LREAL := 0.0;   // 比能超出量归一值 [0,1] [-] / the normalised specific energy excess [-]
    _fAlpha     : LREAL := 0.0;   // 本拍滤波增益（随比能自适应）[-] / the adaptive filter gain of this scan [-]
    _fSlope1    : LREAL := 0.0;   // 初期磨损段斜率 [mm/m] / the initial wear slope [mm/m]
    _fSlope2    : LREAL := 0.0;   // 稳态磨损段斜率 [mm/m] / the steady wear slope [mm/m]
    _fSlope3    : LREAL := 0.0;   // 急剧磨损段斜率 [mm/m] / the severe wear slope [mm/m]
    _fL1        : LREAL := 0.0;   // 初期磨损段终点路程 [m] / the initial wear segment end path [m]
    _fL2        : LREAL := 0.0;   // 稳态磨损段终点路程 [m] / the steady wear segment end path [m]
    _fAccel     : LREAL := 1.0;   // 比能加速因子 [-] / the specific energy acceleration factor [-]
    _fVbRaw     : LREAL := 0.0;   // 磨损曲线原值 [-] / the raw wear value [-]
    _fVbFilt    : LREAL := 0.0;   // 滤波后磨损量（保持槽，写入前过非有限闸）[mm] / the filtered wear, guarded before the write [mm]
    _fVbEst     : LREAL := 0.0;   // 本拍磨损估计 [mm] / the wear estimate of this scan [mm]
    _fAlarmMm   : LREAL := 0.0;   // 报警门限（两级回退后）[mm] / the alarm threshold after the two level fallback [mm]
    _fCompAcc   : LREAL := 0.0;   // 累计刀补量 [µm] / the accumulated compensation [um]
    _fCompTgt   : LREAL := 0.0;   // 目标累计刀补量 [µm] / the target accumulated compensation [um]
    _fStep      : LREAL := 0.0;   // 本拍刀补增量（限幅后）[µm] / the limited compensation step of this scan [um]
END_VAR
// 段 0｜出口预置：所有出口先赋安全侧值，任何早退路径不留未初始化输出
xValid := FALSE; // 有效性预置假（判据未完成前一律无效，安全侧）/ validity preset false on the safe side
xAlarm := FALSE; // 报警预置假 / the alarm preset false
xChangeReq := _bChangeLch; // 换刀请求回放锁存位 / replay the change request latch
fCompUm := 0.0; // 刀补增量预置零（非补偿相不出量）/ the step preset zero while not compensating
fVbEst := 0.0; // 估计预置零 / the estimate preset zero
fVbRaw := 0.0; // 原值预置零 / the raw value preset zero
fCompAccUm := _fCompAcc; // 累计刀补回放 / replay the accumulated compensation
fPathM := _fPathM; // 路程回放 / replay the path
fKcRatio := _fRatio; // 比能比回放 / replay the specific energy ratio
eState := _eState; // 相位回放 / replay the phase
iErrCode := 0; // 信息级码预置零（本拍重算）/ the info code preset zero, recomputed this scan
_iErrTmp := 0; // 单拍码暂存预清零（FB32-1：仅单拍标志可预清）/ preclear the scan code scratch only
// 段 1｜非有限闸：NaN 用自反比较、Inf 用差值自减双判，逐项枚举全部浮点入参（R79、R272）
_bFinOk := (fSpindleKw = fSpindleKw) AND ((fSpindleKw - fSpindleKw) = (fSpindleKw - fSpindleKw)) // 主轴功率有限 [-] / the spindle power is finite
    AND (fFeedMmMin = fFeedMmMin) AND ((fFeedMmMin - fFeedMmMin) = (fFeedMmMin - fFeedMmMin)) // 进给率有限 [-] / the feed rate is finite
    AND (fRpm = fRpm) AND ((fRpm - fRpm) = (fRpm - fRpm)) // 转速有限 [-] / the speed is finite
    AND (fCutTimeS = fCutTimeS) AND ((fCutTimeS - fCutTimeS) = (fCutTimeS - fCutTimeS)) // 切削时长有限 [-] / the cutting time is finite
    AND (fKcNmm2 = fKcNmm2) AND ((fKcNmm2 - fKcNmm2) = (fKcNmm2 - fKcNmm2)) // 切削力系数有限 [-] / the cutting force coefficient is finite
    AND (fVbLimitMm = fVbLimitMm) AND ((fVbLimitMm - fVbLimitMm) = (fVbLimitMm - fVbLimitMm)) // 磨损限值有限 [-] / the wear limit is finite
    AND (fLifePathM = fLifePathM) AND ((fLifePathM - fLifePathM) = (fLifePathM - fLifePathM)) // 额定寿命路程有限 [-] / the rated life path is finite
    AND (fIdleKw = fIdleKw) AND ((fIdleKw - fIdleKw) = (fIdleKw - fIdleKw)) // 空载功率有限 [-] / the idle power is finite
    AND (fVbCompTrigMm = fVbCompTrigMm) AND ((fVbCompTrigMm - fVbCompTrigMm) = (fVbCompTrigMm - fVbCompTrigMm)) // 补偿门限有限 [-] / the trigger threshold is finite
    AND (fVbAlarmMm = fVbAlarmMm) AND ((fVbAlarmMm - fVbAlarmMm) = (fVbAlarmMm - fVbAlarmMm)); // 报警门限有限 [-] / the alarm threshold is finite
// 段 2｜组态域闸：门限次序与正定性，参与判据换算的每个引脚都在闸内（R151）
_bCfgOk := (fVbLimitMm > 0.0) AND (fLifePathM > 0.0) AND (fKcNmm2 > 0.0) AND (fIdleKw >= 0.0) // 限值、寿命、系数、空载功率四项域闸 [-] / the four base domains
    AND (fVbCompTrigMm > 0.0) AND (fVbCompTrigMm < fVbLimitMm) // 补偿门限介于零与限值之间 [-] / the trigger sits between zero and the limit
    AND (fVbAlarmMm > fVbCompTrigMm) AND (fVbAlarmMm <= fVbLimitMm); // 报警门限高于补偿门限且不超限值 [-] / the alarm sits above the trigger and never above the limit
_bSpeedOk := (ABS(fRpm) > DL_CNC_EPS) AND (ABS(fSpindleKw) > DL_CNC_EPS); // 转速与功率非零闸（防除零，R4）/ the non zero gate against the division by zero
_bValid := _bFinOk AND _bCfgOk AND _bSpeedOk; // 三个闸合取 / the conjunction of the three gates
IF NOT _bFinOk THEN _iErrTmp := 2603; ELSIF NOT _bCfgOk THEN _iErrTmp := 2602; ELSIF NOT _bSpeedOk THEN _iErrTmp := 2604; END_IF // 信息级码分派（有限 → 组态 → 零速）/ the info code dispatch
// 段 3｜首扫初始化与复位沿同块，作用域逐项声明（R310、R311）
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件周期刷新（R7） [-] / the reset edge refreshed every scan [-]

IF (NOT _bInit) OR rtReset.Q THEN // 首扫一拍或复位上升沿（R188，禁电平复位） / the first scan or the reset edge
    _bInit := TRUE; // 首扫完成标志（复位沿重复置位同效）/ the first scan flag, the same effect on reset
    _bChangeLch := FALSE; // 作用域一：清换刀请求锁存（唯一清除边，R188）/ scope one, clear the change request latch
    _fVbFilt := 0.0; // 作用域二：清滤波保持槽 / scope two, clear the filter hold slot
    _fCompAcc := 0.0; // 作用域二：清累计刀补 / scope two, clear the accumulated compensation
    _fPathM := 0.0; // 作用域三：清切削路程（换刀后按新刀重计）/ scope three, clear the path for the new tool
    _fCutPrevS := fCutTimeS; // 作用域三：时长快照重取（防跨批假路程）/ scope three, re-take the snapshot
    _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eIdle; // 作用域二：迁回空闲相 / scope two, migrate to idle
END_IF
// 段 4｜切削路程积分：时长增量差分 + 双向钳定，仅有效拍且切削中累加（R45 ②）
_fDtCutS := fCutTimeS - _fCutPrevS; // 切削时长增量 [s] / the cutting time increment [s]
IF _fDtCutS < 0.0 THEN _fDtCutS := 0.0; END_IF // 负增量判零（时钟回退不伪造路程）/ a negative increment is zeroed
IF _fDtCutS > DL_CNC_DTJUMP_S THEN _fDtCutS := DL_CNC_DTJUMP_S; END_IF // 超大跳变钳位（掉电恢复不伪造路程）/ a huge jump is clamped
IF _bValid AND bCutting THEN // 仅有效拍且切削中 / only on a valid scan while cutting
    _fPathM := _fPathM + fFeedMmMin * (_fDtCutS / DL_CNC_SEC_MIN) * DL_CNC_M_PER_MM; // 路程增量 [m] / the path increment [m]
END_IF
_fCutPrevS := fCutTimeS; // 上拍时长快照（用完立即赋值，防重复累计）/ the snapshot taken right after the integration
// 段 5｜切削比能：名义功率由 Kc 与名义切除率折算（切深切宽取边界四之代理常量），分母显式零闸（R4）
IF _bValid THEN // 仅在有效拍计算比能 / compute the ratio on a valid scan only
    _fPnomKw := fKcNmm2 * (fFeedMmMin / DL_CNC_SEC_MIN) * DL_CNC_AP_MM * DL_CNC_AE_MM / (DL_CNC_W_PER_KW * 1000.0); // N/mm2·mm3/s = mW，再除以 1e6 得 kW（量纲校正，R583） / [N/mm2]*[mm3/s] = [mW], divided by 1e6 for [kW]
    _fPcKw := fSpindleKw - fIdleKw; // 净切削功率 [kW] / the net cutting power [kW]
    IF _fPcKw < 0.0 THEN _fPcKw := 0.0; END_IF // 负净功率夹取（空载波动）/ clamp the negative net power
    _fRatio := 1.0; // 比能比默认一（无切除按名义）/ the ratio defaults to one without stock removal
    IF (_fPnomKw > DL_CNC_EPS) AND (fFeedMmMin > DL_CNC_EPS) THEN // 双分母零闸 / both denominators guarded
        _fRatio := _fPcKw / _fPnomKw; // 比能比 [-] / the specific energy ratio [-]
    END_IF
    IF _fRatio < 0.2 THEN _fRatio := 0.2; ELSIF _fRatio > 3.0 THEN _fRatio := 3.0; END_IF // 比值域夹取，防加速因子发散 / clamp the ratio domain
END_IF
// 段 6｜三段线性磨损曲线：三段斜率由额定寿命与 VB 限值反算，积分在寿命终点恰为限值
IF _bCfgOk THEN // 组态域内才反算斜率（分母中含 fLifePathM，越域即除零）/ compute the slopes only inside the domain
    _fSlope1 := (fVbLimitMm * DL_CNC_PH1_WEAR) / (fLifePathM * DL_CNC_PH1_FRAC); // 初期段斜率 [mm/m] / the initial slope [mm/m]
    _fSlope2 := (fVbLimitMm * DL_CNC_PH2_WEAR) / (fLifePathM * DL_CNC_PH2_FRAC); // 稳态段斜率 [mm/m] / the steady slope [mm/m]
    _fSlope3 := (fVbLimitMm * (1.0 - DL_CNC_PH1_WEAR - DL_CNC_PH2_WEAR)) / (fLifePathM * (1.0 - DL_CNC_PH1_FRAC - DL_CNC_PH2_FRAC)); // 急剧段斜率 [mm/m] / the severe slope [mm/m]
    _fL1 := fLifePathM * DL_CNC_PH1_FRAC; // 初期段终点 [m] / the initial segment end [m]
    _fL2 := _fL1 + fLifePathM * DL_CNC_PH2_FRAC; // 稳态段终点 [m] / the steady segment end [m]
    IF _fPathM <= _fL1 THEN // 阶段一：初期磨损 / stage one, the initial wear
        _fVbRaw := _fSlope1 * _fPathM; // 初期段磨损 [mm] / the initial wear [mm]
    ELSIF _fPathM <= _fL2 THEN // 阶段二：稳态磨损（含初期段积分）/ stage two, the steady wear including the initial integral
        _fVbRaw := _fSlope1 * _fL1 + _fSlope2 * (_fPathM - _fL1); // 稳态段磨损 [mm] / the steady wear [mm]
    ELSE // 阶段三：急剧磨损 / stage three, the severe wear
        _fVbRaw := _fSlope1 * _fL1 + _fSlope2 * (_fL2 - _fL1) + _fSlope3 * (_fPathM - _fL2); // 急剧段磨损 [mm] / the severe wear [mm]
    END_IF
    IF _fRatio > (1.0 + DL_CNC_RATIO_BAND) THEN // 比能高于基准才加速 / accelerate only above the base
        _fAccel := 1.0 + DL_CNC_PWR_GAIN * (_fRatio - 1.0); // 加速因子 [-] / the acceleration factor [-]
    ELSE // 比能未超基准：不加速也不抑制 / no acceleration below the base
        _fAccel := 1.0; // 加速因子归一 / the factor is unity
    END_IF
    IF _fAccel > DL_CNC_ACCEL_MAX THEN _fAccel := DL_CNC_ACCEL_MAX; END_IF // 加速因子上限 / the factor upper bound
    _fVbRaw := _fVbRaw * _fAccel; // 比能修正后磨损 [mm] / the wear corrected by the specific energy
    IF _fVbRaw > (fVbLimitMm * DL_CNC_VB_HEAD) THEN _fVbRaw := fVbLimitMm * DL_CNC_VB_HEAD; END_IF // 上限兜底防过冲 / the upper bound against overshoot
END_IF
// 段 7｜一阶指数滤波：增益随比能超出量自适应（钝化加剧时跟随更快），写入前过非有限闸（R133）
_fExcess := (_fRatio - 1.0) / DL_CNC_ALPHA_SPAN; // 超出量归一 [-] / the normalised excess [-]
IF _fExcess < 0.0 THEN _fExcess := 0.0; ELSIF _fExcess > 1.0 THEN _fExcess := 1.0; END_IF // 归一值夹取到 [0,1] / clamp the excess into [0,1]
_fAlpha := DL_CNC_ALPHA_MIN + (DL_CNC_ALPHA_MAX - DL_CNC_ALPHA_MIN) * _fExcess; // 本拍增益 [-] / the gain of this scan [-]
IF _bValid THEN // 仅有效拍推进滤波（无效拍不污染保持槽）/ advance only on a valid scan
    _fVbFilt := _fVbFilt + _fAlpha * (_fVbRaw - _fVbFilt); // 一阶指数平滑 [mm] / the first order exponential smoothing [mm]
END_IF
IF NOT (_fVbFilt = _fVbFilt) THEN _fVbFilt := _fVbRaw; END_IF // 滤波结果 NaN 兜底（回退原值）/ the NaN fallback to the raw value
IF (_fVbFilt - _fVbFilt) <> (_fVbFilt - _fVbFilt) THEN _fVbFilt := _fVbRaw; END_IF // 滤波结果 Inf 兜底（同回退）/ the Inf fallback to the raw value
_fVbEst := _fVbFilt; // 本拍估计 [mm] / the estimate of this scan [mm]
IF _fVbEst < 0.0 THEN _fVbEst := 0.0; END_IF // 估计下限夹取（磨损不可为负）/ the wear can never be negative
// 段 8｜报警门限两级回退：一级回默认系数、二级按有效域钳定（R117）
_fAlarmMm := fVbAlarmMm; // 一级：取引脚值 / level one, take the pin value
IF NOT _bCfgOk THEN // 组态越域：一级回退到限值系数 / out of domain, fall back to the limit factor
    _fAlarmMm := fVbLimitMm * DL_CNC_ALARM_FRAC; // 回退值 [mm] / the fallback threshold [mm]
    IF _fAlarmMm <= fVbCompTrigMm THEN _fAlarmMm := fVbCompTrigMm + (fVbLimitMm * DL_CNC_RATIO_BAND); END_IF // 二级：按有效域钳定 / level two, clamp into the valid domain
END_IF
// 段 9｜相位状态机：ENUM ＋ CASE ＋ ELSE 非法相位兜底（R6、R128）
CASE _eState OF
E_DL_CncWearState.eIdle: // 空闲相：退出条件三（使能、切削中、有效拍、无换刀锁存）
    IF _bChangeLch THEN // 换刀请求未解除：禁止回到生产 / the change request blocks production
        _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eChangeReq; // 驻留换刀请求相 / stay in the change request phase
    ELSIF bEnable AND bCutting AND _bValid THEN // 三个条件齐备才进学习 / all three conditions enter learning
        _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eLearn; // 迁学习相 / migrate to learning
    END_IF
E_DL_CncWearState.eLearn: // 学习相：按门限升相，无门限命中则驻留（驻留由注释表达，禁自赋值 R261）
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 使能丢失 / the enable was lost
        _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
    ELSIF _fVbEst >= fVbLimitMm THEN // 越过寿命限值 / the life limit was passed
        _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eChangeReq; // 迁换刀请求相 / migrate to the change request
    ELSIF _fVbEst >= _fAlarmMm THEN // 越过报警门限 / the alarm threshold was passed
        _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eAlarm; // 迁报警相 / migrate to alarm
    ELSIF _fVbEst >= fVbCompTrigMm THEN // 越过补偿门限 / the trigger threshold was passed
        _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eCompensate; // 迁补偿相 / migrate to compensating
    END_IF
E_DL_CncWearState.eCompensate: // 补偿相：按门限升相，回落到补偿门限以下不降相（已补量不回退）
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 使能丢失 / the enable was lost
        _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
    ELSIF _fVbEst >= fVbLimitMm THEN // 越过寿命限值 / the life limit was passed
        _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eChangeReq; // 迁换刀请求相 / migrate to the change request
    ELSIF _fVbEst >= _fAlarmMm THEN // 越过报警门限 / the alarm threshold was passed
        _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eAlarm; // 迁报警相 / migrate to alarm
    END_IF
E_DL_CncWearState.eAlarm: // 报警相：退出条件三（使能丢失、升换刀、带回差降回补偿）
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 使能丢失 / the enable was lost
        _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
    ELSIF _fVbEst >= fVbLimitMm THEN // 越过寿命限值 / the life limit was passed
        _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eChangeReq; // 迁换刀请求相 / migrate to the change request
    ELSIF _fVbEst < (_fAlarmMm - (fVbLimitMm * DL_CNC_HYST_BAND)) THEN // 回差带以下才降相（防抖）/ drop only below the hysteresis band
        IF _fVbEst >= fVbCompTrigMm THEN // 仍在补偿门限之上 / still above the trigger
            _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eCompensate; // 降回补偿相 / drop back to compensating
        ELSE // 已回落到补偿门限之下 / fell below the trigger
            _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eLearn; // 降回学习相 / drop back to learning
        END_IF
    END_IF
E_DL_CncWearState.eChangeReq: // 换刀请求相：锁存驻留，唯一解除为复位沿（段 3 已迁回空闲）
    IF NOT _bChangeLch THEN // 锁存已被复位沿清除 / the latch was cleared by the reset edge
        _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
    END_IF
ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R6、R128）/ the illegal phase fallback
    _eState := E_DL_CncWearState.eIdle; // 回安全态空闲 / back to the safe idle phase
    _iErrTmp := 2601; // 信息级非法相位码 / the info grade illegal phase code
END_CASE
IF _eState = E_DL_CncWearState.eChangeReq THEN _bChangeLch := TRUE; END_IF // 锁存单点置位（R187 两段式之一）/ single point latch set
// 段 10｜刀补增量闭环：状态量门控（R99），增量限幅 ±50 µm 每拍，累计上限 200 µm 单向
IF (_eState = E_DL_CncWearState.eCompensate) OR (_eState = E_DL_CncWearState.eAlarm) THEN // 仅补偿相与报警相出增量
    _fCompTgt := (_fVbEst - fVbCompTrigMm) * DL_CNC_UM_PER_MM; // 目标累计补偿量 [µm]，以补偿门限为零点 / the target accumulated compensation [um]
    IF _fCompTgt < 0.0 THEN _fCompTgt := 0.0; END_IF // 目标下限夹取（不回退已补量）/ the lower clamp, no retraction
    IF _fCompTgt > DL_CNC_ACC_UM THEN _fCompTgt := DL_CNC_ACC_UM; END_IF // 目标上限夹取 / the upper clamp
    _fStep := _fCompTgt - _fCompAcc; // 本拍应补增量 [µm] / the step required this scan [um]
    IF _fStep > DL_CNC_STEP_UM THEN _fStep := DL_CNC_STEP_UM; ELSIF _fStep < (0.0 - DL_CNC_STEP_UM) THEN _fStep := (0.0 - DL_CNC_STEP_UM); END_IF // 单拍双向限幅 / the two sided step limit
    _fCompAcc := _fCompAcc + _fStep; // 累计量单点写入（全库唯一写入点）/ the only write point of the accumulator
    IF _fCompAcc > DL_CNC_ACC_UM THEN _fCompAcc := DL_CNC_ACC_UM; END_IF // 累计上限硬钳 / the hard clamp of the accumulator
    IF _fCompAcc < 0.0 THEN _fCompAcc := 0.0; END_IF // 累计下限硬钳 / the hard clamp of the lower side
    fCompUm := _fStep; // 增量单点映射 / the single point mapping of the step
END_IF
// 段 11｜统一出口：输出单点映射，信息级码与有效性同源（R191 名实相符）
eState := _eState; // 相位单点映射 / the single point mapping of the phase
fVbEst := _fVbEst; // 估计单点映射 [mm] / the single point mapping of the estimate
fVbRaw := _fVbRaw; // 原值单点映射 [mm] / the single point mapping of the raw value
fCompAccUm := _fCompAcc; // 累计刀补单点映射 [µm] / the single point mapping of the accumulator
fPathM := _fPathM; // 路程单点映射 [m] / the single point mapping of the path
fKcRatio := _fRatio; // 比能比单点映射 [-] / the single point mapping of the ratio
xChangeReq := _bChangeLch; // 换刀请求回放锁存位 / replay the change request latch
xAlarm := (_eState = E_DL_CncWearState.eAlarm) OR (_eState = E_DL_CncWearState.eChangeReq); // 报警电平（含换刀请求相）/ the alarm level including the change request
iErrCode := _iErrTmp; // 信息级码单点映射（每拍重算，不锁存，R187）/ the info code mapping, recomputed every scan
xValid := _bValid AND (_iErrTmp = 0); // 有效性：判据全通过且无信息级异常 / valid when every gate passed and no info code is set
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 在DL_Process产线的现场控制程序中，需要实现「间歇釜放热失控五级联锁（温升速率/绝热温升外推/冷却失效三判据）」。工艺要求：给定工况参数与设定值后，周期内稳定输出可直接下装到 PLC 的结果；须处理零值/负值/超量程/非有限数（NaN/Inf）等边界条件，输出附有效性标志与单位口径，不得因单点异常导致下游执行机构误动作。请用 IEC 61131-3 结构化文本（ST）实现，跨平台可编译，变量声明带中英双语注释。
architecture_thought: 架构：按「接口校验 → 物理量换算 → 核心计算 → 域限幅 → 输出与标志」五段式组织，纯函数化不依赖全局量（R1）。状态管理：FB 采用 ENUM+CASE 且 CASE 必带 ELSE 兜底回安全态（R6），定时器每周期无条件刷新（R7）且不跨相 OR（R18）。防错：所有分母显式零闸（R4）、NaN/Inf 用区间判据拦截（R21）、输出附有效性与量纲自洽声明，单点异常不得导致下游误动作。语法：纯 IEC 61131-3 直译写法，禁 DOWNTO（R17）、禁构造式转换（R10），定长数组禁 LOWER_BOUND（R37），FB 内禁 PROPERTY（R14）。变量声明逐行中英双语带单位注释（R5）。
output:
(*
  DL Factory R84 | FB_DL_ReactorRunawayGuard
  功能：间歇反应釜放热失控五级联锁：温升速率、绝热温升外推 MTSR、冷却能力失效三判据并行分档，合成 0~5 级动作需求；升级立即生效、降级按延时逐级回落，五级动作位互斥且可降级；L5 全停锁存至复位沿。
  开源溯源：无（clean-room 自研，依据公开工艺公式与安全设计惯例，来源=行业通用公式+工程实践，许可证=MIT，借鉴点=公式结构与联锁分层）
  规则：R1-R16 全遵守
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  分类 DL_Process ｜ 复杂度 cx5 ｜ 版本 v1.0.0 ｜ 平台 纯 IEC 61131-3（TON、R_TRIG、LREAL、ENUM、CASE）
  边界一：只出分级动作位与诊断量，不驱动泄放阀、冷却阀与投料阀本体，不采集变送器（属主边界，执行由下层 PRG 完成）。
  边界二：三判据分档——判据①温升速率按 fRateTripKmin 的 0.50/0.65/0.80/0.92/1.00 五档；判据②MTSR 按安全裕度 fMtsrMarginK 的已耗比例 0.50/0.35/0.20/0.08/0.00 五档；
          判据③冷却能力按流量下限与夹套-进水温差反向分 3 档与 4 档，温差反向且流量低于半限时直接判 5 档。
  边界三：MTSR 公式＝反应温度 ＋ 累积投料若全部反应的绝热温升：ΔTad [K]＝|ΔH| [kJ/mol] × 1000 [mol/kmol] × 累积摩尔数 [kmol] ÷（批量 [kg] × cp [kJ/(kg·K)]），
          累积摩尔数 [kmol]＝累积投料 [kg] ÷ 平均摩尔质量 [kg/kmol]；ΔTad 上限兜底 300 K 防外推发散。
  边界四：平均摩尔质量 DL_RAG_MOLAR_KGKMOL 为物料体系代理常量——代理值是反应主料的平均摩尔质量、覆盖 100~200 g/mol 的常规精细化工体系、
          体系外（聚合/无机盐）由上层以实测绝热温升标定后换算入参负责（R95 三句齐备，代理假设挂编译验证债）。
  边界五：分级互斥与可降级——iStage 为唯一权威（0~5 整数），五级位按 xStageN＝(iStage ≥ N) 单源派生；升级无延时（安全侧优先），
          降级由 tDegrade 周期窗逐级回落，窗为自复位形式（IN 串 NOT 自身 Q，R188），故不存在同拍双窗，R100 配比约束不适用（本件只有一件定时器）。
  边界六：相位由分级单源映射、零滞后（R191 名实同源），不设独立相位状态机与分级机双权威。
  安全侧：任一浮点入参非有限、组态越域、或任一判据达 5 档 → 立即迁 eTrip 并锁存 xTripLatched；锁存唯一解除路径为 bReset 上升沿（R188），其余路径（失能、条件消失）均不解锁。
  码表：故障级 2711 入参非有限、2712 组态越域、2713 温升速率达 5 档、2714 MTSR 达 5 档、2715 冷却完全失效、2716 非法分级值（防御性保留）；
        以上六码锁存回放且置 bError（R45 配对）；信息级 2701~2705＝当前分级（1~5 级）之动作码，每拍重算且不置 bError。
  输出契约：xStage1..xStage5 为累积电平（N 级生效则 1..N 位全真，互斥性由 iStage 单源保证）；xAlarmOut/xFeedStop/xMaxCool/xVentCmd/xTotalStop 与分级同源派生；
          fMtsrC/fRateKmin/fDtAdK 为诊断连续量，非有限时出零不外抛；xValid 在锁存或闸不过时为假。
  修订记录：2026-11-24 v1.0.0 R84 首版（批 R84 · 序号 42）
*)

TYPE E_DL_RagState :
(
    eNormal   := 0, // 正常：零级，无动作 / normal, level zero, no action
    eWarn     := 1, // 报警：一级，仅告知 / warn, level one, notification only
    eStopFeed := 2, // 停止投料：二级 / stop feeding, level two
    eMaxCool  := 3, // 加大冷却：三级 / maximum cooling, level three
    eVent     := 4, // 紧急泄放：四级 / emergency venting, level four
    eTrip     := 5  // 全停：五级，锁存至复位沿 / total trip, level five, latched until the reset edge
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_RagCause :
(
    eNone      := 0, // 无成因 / no cause
    eNotFinite := 1, // 入参非有限（故障级 2711）/ a non-finite input, fault grade 2711
    eCfgBad    := 2, // 组态越域（故障级 2712）/ the configuration is out of its domain, fault grade 2712
    eRateHigh  := 3, // 温升速率达五档（故障级 2713）/ the temperature rate reached level five, fault grade 2713
    eMtsrHigh  := 4, // MTSR 达五档（故障级 2714）/ the MTSR reached level five, fault grade 2714
    eCoolLoss  := 5, // 冷却完全失效（故障级 2715）/ the cooling capability was lost, fault grade 2715
    eStageBad  := 6  // 非法分级值（故障级 2716，防御性保留）/ an illegal stage value, fault grade 2716
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_ReactorRunawayGuard
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_RAG_SEC_MIN     : LREAL := 60.0;    // 秒到分钟折算系数 [s/min] / the second to minute factor [s/min]
    DL_RAG_DT_MIN      : LREAL := 0.001;   // 采样周期下限（速率分母零闸）[s] / the sample period lower bound [s]
    DL_RAG_RATE_ALPHA  : LREAL := 0.30;    // 速率一阶滤波系数 [-] / the first order gain of the rate filter [-]
    DL_RAG_L1_FRAC     : LREAL := 0.50;    // 判据①一级档位系数（跳闸速率的倍数）[-] / the level one factor of the rate criterion [-]
    DL_RAG_L2_FRAC     : LREAL := 0.65;    // 判据①二级档位系数 [-] / the level two factor of the rate criterion [-]
    DL_RAG_L3_FRAC     : LREAL := 0.80;    // 判据①三级档位系数 [-] / the level three factor of the rate criterion [-]
    DL_RAG_L4_FRAC     : LREAL := 0.92;    // 判据①四级档位系数 [-] / the level four factor of the rate criterion [-]
    DL_RAG_M1_FRAC     : LREAL := 0.50;    // 判据②一级档位（裕度已耗比例）[-] / the level one factor of the MTSR criterion [-]
    DL_RAG_M2_FRAC     : LREAL := 0.35;    // 判据②二级档位 [-] / the level two factor of the MTSR criterion [-]
    DL_RAG_M3_FRAC     : LREAL := 0.20;    // 判据②三级档位 [-] / the level three factor of the MTSR criterion [-]
    DL_RAG_M4_FRAC     : LREAL := 0.08;    // 判据②四级档位 [-] / the level four factor of the MTSR criterion [-]
    DL_RAG_COOL_DT_MIN : LREAL := 2.0;     // 夹套与进水温差下限（低于即冷却不足）[K] / the jacket to inlet temperature difference floor [K]
    DL_RAG_FLOW_L4_FRAC: LREAL := 0.50;    // 判据③四级档位流量系数（下限倍数）[-] / the level four flow factor of the cooling criterion [-]
    DL_RAG_DTAD_MAX    : LREAL := 300.0;   // 绝热温升外推上限兜底 [K] / the adiabatic rise extrapolation upper clamp [K]
    DL_RAG_FRAC_MAX    : LREAL := 1.50;    // 已投料占比上限（外推兜底）[-] / the charged fraction upper clamp [-]
    DL_RAG_MOLAR_KGKMOL: LREAL := 100.0;   // 平均摩尔质量代理常量 [kg/kmol] / the mean molar mass proxy [kg/kmol]
    DL_RAG_MOL_PER_KMOL: LREAL := 1000.0;  // 摩尔到千摩尔折算系数 [mol/kmol] / the mole to kilomole factor [mol/kmol]
    DL_RAG_EPS         : LREAL := 1.0E-9;  // 除法零闸与零判定门限 [-] / the division guard and zero test threshold [-]
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable      : BOOL := TRUE;     // 使能，失能只回零级不解除锁存 [-] / enable, a disable only clears the stage and never the latch
    bReset       : BOOL := FALSE;   // 复位上升沿清全停锁存（唯一解除路径）[-] / reset rising edge clears the trip latch, the only release path
    xStirRun     : BOOL := TRUE;    // 搅拌运行反馈，停搅即二级以上 [-] / the agitator running feedback, a stop forces level two or higher
    fTreactC     : LREAL := 25.0;   // 反应温度 [°C] / the reaction temperature [°C]
    fTjacketC    : LREAL := 25.0;   // 夹套温度 [°C] / the jacket temperature [°C]
    fCoolFlowM3h : LREAL := 10.0;   // 冷却水流量 [m³/h] / the cooling water flow [m3/h]
    fCoolInC     : LREAL := 20.0;   // 冷却水进水温度 [°C] / the cooling water inlet temperature [°C]
    fAccumKg     : LREAL := 0.0;    // 累积投料质量（尚未反应部分）[kg] / the accumulated charged mass still unreacted [kg]
    fBatchKg     : LREAL := 1000.0; // 批量总质量 [kg] / the total batch mass [kg]
    fDhKjMol     : LREAL := 80.0;   // 反应焓变（取绝对值参与外推）[kJ/mol] / the reaction enthalpy, the absolute value is used [kJ/mol]
    fCpKjKgK     : LREAL := 3.50;   // 反应液比热容 [kJ/(kg·K)] / the reaction mixture specific heat [kJ/(kg*K)]
    fRateTripKmin: LREAL := 3.00;   // 温升速率跳闸值（五档基准）[K/min] / the rate trip value, the level five base [K/min]
    fMtsrLimitC  : LREAL := 180.0;  // MTSR 安全极限温度 [°C] / the MTSR safety limit temperature [°C]
    fMtsrMarginK : LREAL := 20.0;   // MTSR 安全裕度（分级带宽）[K] / the MTSR safety margin, the staging band [K]
    fFlowMinM3h  : LREAL := 4.00;   // 冷却水流量下限 [m³/h] / the cooling water flow floor [m3/h]
    fDtSec       : LREAL := 0.10;   // 温度采样周期（速率分母）[s] / the temperature sample period, the rate denominator [s]
    tDegrade     : TIME := T#30S;   // 分级降级延时（逐级回落窗）[毫秒] / the stage downgrade delay per step [ms]
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    eState       : E_DL_RagState := E_DL_RagState.eNormal; // 相位出口（由分级单源映射）[枚举] / the phase outlet mapped from the stage [enum]
    iStage       : INT := 0;      // 当前动作级（0~5，唯一权威）[级] / the active stage, the single authority [level]
    iErrCode     : INT := 0;      // 错误码（故障级锁存回放，信息级每拍重算）[码] / the error code, latched faults and scan info [code]
    bError       : BOOL := FALSE; // 故障标志（与故障级码同源）[-] / the fault flag sharing the fault code source
    xTripLatched : BOOL := FALSE; // 全停锁存（仅复位沿清除）[-] / the trip latch, cleared by the reset edge only
    xValid       : BOOL := FALSE; // 本拍输入与组态可信 [-] / the inputs and the configuration are trustworthy
    xStage1      : BOOL := FALSE; // 一级动作位：报警 [-] / level one action, the alarm
    xStage2      : BOOL := FALSE; // 二级动作位：停止投料 [-] / level two action, stop the feed
    xStage3      : BOOL := FALSE; // 三级动作位：加大冷却 [-] / level three action, maximum cooling
    xStage4      : BOOL := FALSE; // 四级动作位：紧急泄放 [-] / level four action, emergency venting
    xStage5      : BOOL := FALSE; // 五级动作位：全停 [-] / level five action, total trip
    xAlarmOut    : BOOL := FALSE; // 报警输出（一级及以上）[-] / the alarm output from level one on
    xFeedStop    : BOOL := FALSE; // 停止投料输出（二级及以上）[-] / the feed stop output from level two on
    xMaxCool     : BOOL := FALSE; // 加大冷却输出（三级及以上）[-] / the maximum cooling output from level three on
    xVentCmd     : BOOL := FALSE; // 紧急泄放输出（四级及以上）[-] / the emergency vent output from level four on
    xTotalStop   : BOOL := FALSE; // 全停输出（五级）[-] / the total stop output at level five
    fMtsrC       : LREAL := 0.0;  // MTSR 外推值 [°C] / the extrapolated MTSR [°C]
    fRateKmin    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 滤波后温升速率 [K/min] / the filtered temperature rise rate [K/min]
    fDtAdK       : LREAL := 0.0;  // 绝热温升外推量 [K] / the adiabatic rise extrapolation [K]
END_VAR
VAR
    rtReset    : R_TRIG; // 复位沿实例（无量纲）[-] / the reset edge refreshed unconditionally
    tonDown    : TON;    // 降级窗实例（无量纲）[-] / the self resetting downgrade window, its own output inverted
    _eState    : E_DL_RagState := E_DL_RagState.eNormal; // 内部相位（枚举，无量纲）[-] / the internal phase
    _eCause    : E_DL_RagCause := E_DL_RagCause.eNone; // 故障级成因（枚举，无量纲）[-] / the fault cause latched until the reset edge
    _iStage    : INT := 0;  // 内部分级（唯一权威）[级] / the internal stage, the single authority [level]
    _iReq      : INT := 0;  // 三判据合成后的动作需求级 [级] / the aggregated stage demand [level]
    _iNeed     : INT := 0;  // 单判据档位暂存 [级] / the per criterion stage scratch [level]
    _iErrTmp   : INT := 0;  // 本拍码位暂存 [码] / the scan code scratch [code]
    _iErrLch   : INT := 0;  // 故障级码位锁存槽 [码] / the latched fault code [code]
    _bTrip     : BOOL := FALSE; // 全停锁存位 [-] / the trip latch
    _bInit     : BOOL := FALSE; // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）[-] / the first scan initialisation flag
    _bFinOk    : BOOL := FALSE; // 全部浮点入参有限 [-] / every floating input is finite
    _bCfgOk    : BOOL := FALSE; // 组态参数域内 [-] / the configuration is inside its domain
    _bRateL5   : BOOL := FALSE; // 判据①达五档（独立成因标志，R190）[-] / criterion one reached level five
    _bMtsrL5   : BOOL := FALSE; // 判据②达五档（独立成因标志）[-] / criterion two reached level five
    _bCoolL5   : BOOL := FALSE; // 判据③冷却完全失效（独立成因标志）[-] / criterion three lost the cooling entirely
    _bRateL1   : BOOL := FALSE; // 判据①达一档 [-] / criterion one reached level one
    _bRateL2   : BOOL := FALSE; // 判据①达二档 [-] / criterion one reached level two
    _bRateL3   : BOOL := FALSE; // 判据①达三档 [-] / criterion one reached level three
    _bRateL4   : BOOL := FALSE; // 判据①达四档 [-] / criterion one reached level four
    _fTprev    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 上拍反应温度快照（差分用）[°C] / the previous scan temperature snapshot [°C]
    _fRateRaw  : LREAL := 0.0;  // 原始温升速率（差分值）[K/min] / the raw temperature rise rate [K/min]
    _fRateFilt : LREAL := 0.0;  // 滤波后温升速率（保持槽）[K/min] / the filtered rate, a hold slot [K/min]
    _fFrac     : LREAL := 0.0;  // 累积投料占批量比（钳定后）[-] / the charged fraction after clamping [-]
    _fMoles    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 累积投料摩尔数 [kmol] / the accumulated moles [kmol]
    _fHeatKj   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 累积物料若全部反应放热 [kJ] / the heat if all charged mass reacted [kJ]
    _fDtAd     : LREAL := 0.0;  // 绝热温升外推量（钳定后）[K] / the adiabatic rise after clamping [K]
    _fMtsr     : LREAL := 0.0;  // MTSR 外推温度 [°C] / the extrapolated MTSR [°C]
    _fCoolDt   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 夹套与冷却水进水温差 [K] / the jacket to inlet difference [K]
    _fRateThr1 : LREAL := 0.0;  // 判据①一档门限 [K/min] / the level one rate threshold [K/min]
    _fRateThr2 : LREAL := 0.0;  // 判据①二档门限 [K/min] / the level two rate threshold [K/min]
    _fRateThr3 : LREAL := 0.0;  // 判据①三档门限 [K/min] / the level three rate threshold [K/min]
    _fRateThr4 : LREAL := 0.0;  // 判据①四档门限 [K/min] / the level four rate threshold [K/min]
    _fMtsrThr1 : LREAL := 0.0;  // 判据②一档门限 [°C] / the level one MTSR threshold [°C]
    _fMtsrThr2 : LREAL := 0.0;  // 判据②二档门限 [°C] / the level two MTSR threshold [°C]
    _fMtsrThr3 : LREAL := 0.0;  // 判据②三档门限 [°C] / the level three MTSR threshold [°C]
    _fMtsrThr4 : LREAL := 0.0;  // 判据②四档门限 [°C] / the level four MTSR threshold [°C]
    _tDegrade  : TIME := T#1S;  // 降级窗实参（钳定后）[毫秒] / the downgrade window passed to the timer [ms]
END_VAR
// 段 0｜出口预置：全部出口先赋安全侧值，任何路径不留未初始化输出（安全侧＝全停动作位）/
xValid := FALSE; // 有效性预置假 / validity preset false
xStage1 := FALSE; xStage2 := FALSE; xStage3 := FALSE; // 一至三级位预置假 / levels one to three preset false
xStage4 := FALSE; xStage5 := FALSE; // 四至五级位预置假 / levels four and five preset false
xAlarmOut := FALSE; xFeedStop := FALSE; xMaxCool := FALSE; xVentCmd := FALSE; xTotalStop := FALSE; // 五个动作输出预置假 / the five action outputs preset false
xTripLatched := _bTrip; // 全停锁存回放 / replay the trip latch
iStage := 0; // 分级预置零级，段 11 单点覆盖 / the stage preset zero and overwritten at the outlet
iErrCode := 0; // 码位预置零 / the code preset zero
bError := FALSE; // 故障标志预置假 / the fault flag preset false
fMtsrC := 0.0; fRateKmin := 0.0; fDtAdK := 0.0; // 三个连续量出口预置零 / the three continuous outlets preset zero
eState := E_DL_RagState.eNormal; // 相位预置正常相 / the phase preset normal
_iErrTmp := 0; _iNeed := 0; _iReq := 0; // 单拍暂存预清零（FB32-1：仅单拍变量可预清）/ preclear the scan scratches only
// 段 1｜非有限闸：NaN 自反比较、Inf 差值自减双判，逐项枚举十个浮点入参与两个换算量（R79、R272）
_bFinOk := (fTreactC = fTreactC) AND ((fTreactC - fTreactC) = (fTreactC - fTreactC)) // 反应温度有限 [-] / the reaction temperature is finite
    AND (fTjacketC = fTjacketC) AND ((fTjacketC - fTjacketC) = (fTjacketC - fTjacketC)) // 夹套温度有限 [-] / the jacket temperature is finite
    AND (fCoolFlowM3h = fCoolFlowM3h) AND ((fCoolFlowM3h - fCoolFlowM3h) = (fCoolFlowM3h - fCoolFlowM3h)) // 冷却流量有限 [-] / the cooling flow is finite
    AND (fCoolInC = fCoolInC) AND ((fCoolInC - fCoolInC) = (fCoolInC - fCoolInC)) // 进水温度有限 [-] / the inlet temperature is finite
    AND (fAccumKg = fAccumKg) AND ((fAccumKg - fAccumKg) = (fAccumKg - fAccumKg)) // 累积投料有限 [-] / the accumulated mass is finite
    AND (fBatchKg = fBatchKg) AND ((fBatchKg - fBatchKg) = (fBatchKg - fBatchKg)) // 批量有限 [-] / the batch mass is finite
    AND (fDhKjMol = fDhKjMol) AND ((fDhKjMol - fDhKjMol) = (fDhKjMol - fDhKjMol)) // 焓变有限 [-] / the enthalpy is finite
    AND (fCpKjKgK = fCpKjKgK) AND ((fCpKjKgK - fCpKjKgK) = (fCpKjKgK - fCpKjKgK)) // 比热容有限 [-] / the specific heat is finite
    AND (fRateTripKmin = fRateTripKmin) AND ((fRateTripKmin - fRateTripKmin) = (fRateTripKmin - fRateTripKmin)) // 速率跳闸值有限 [-] / the rate trip value is finite
    AND (fMtsrLimitC = fMtsrLimitC) AND ((fMtsrLimitC - fMtsrLimitC) = (fMtsrLimitC - fMtsrLimitC)) // MTSR 极限有限 [-] / the MTSR limit is finite
    AND (fMtsrMarginK = fMtsrMarginK) AND ((fMtsrMarginK - fMtsrMarginK) = (fMtsrMarginK - fMtsrMarginK)) // 裕度有限 [-] / the margin is finite
    AND (fFlowMinM3h = fFlowMinM3h) AND ((fFlowMinM3h - fFlowMinM3h) = (fFlowMinM3h - fFlowMinM3h)) // 流量下限有限 [-] / the flow floor is finite
    AND (fDtSec = fDtSec) AND ((fDtSec - fDtSec) = (fDtSec - fDtSec)); // 采样周期有限 [-] / the sample period is finite
// 段 2｜组态域闸：全部参与判据换算的限值引脚（R151、FB51-2）
_bCfgOk := (ABS(fRateTripKmin) > DL_RAG_EPS) AND (fMtsrMarginK > DL_RAG_EPS) // 速率跳闸值与裕度非零 [-] / the rate trip and the margin are non zero
    AND (ABS(fFlowMinM3h) > DL_RAG_EPS) AND (fBatchKg > DL_RAG_EPS) // 流量下限与批量非零 [-] / the flow floor and the batch are non zero
    AND (fCpKjKgK > DL_RAG_EPS) AND (fDtSec > DL_RAG_DT_MIN) // 比热容与采样周期域闸 [-] / the specific heat and the sample period gates
    AND (fMtsrLimitC > DL_RAG_EPS) AND (tDegrade > T#0S); // MTSR 极限与降级窗域闸 [-] / the MTSR limit and the window gates
_tDegrade := tDegrade; // 降级窗一级回退：取引脚值 [ms] / level one fallback, take the pin value [ms]
IF _tDegrade <= T#0S THEN _tDegrade := T#1S; END_IF // 降级窗二级回退：按有效域钳定（最小一窗）/ level two, clamp into the valid domain
// 段 3｜首扫初始化与复位沿同块，作用域逐项声明（R310、R311、R152）
IF (NOT _bInit) OR rtReset.Q THEN // 首扫一拍或复位沿 / the first scan or the reset edge
    _bInit := TRUE; // 首扫完成标志（复位沿重复置位同效）/ the first scan flag, the same effect on reset
    _bTrip := FALSE; _eCause := E_DL_RagCause.eNone; _iErrLch := 0; // 作用域一：清全停锁存、清成因、清故障码槽 / scope one, clear the latch, the cause and the fault code
    _iStage := 0; _iReq := 0; // 作用域二：分级回零级 / scope two, the stage returns to zero
    _eState := E_DL_RagState.eNormal; // 作用域二：迁回正常相 / scope two, migrate to normal
    _fTprev := fTreactC; // 作用域三：温度快照重取（首拍不产生假速率）/ scope three, re-take the snapshot
    _fRateFilt := 0.0; // 作用域三：清速率滤波保持槽 / scope three, clear the rate filter hold slot
END_IF
// 段 4｜定时器与沿检测无条件周期刷新（R7），降级窗自复位（R188）
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge
tonDown(IN := (_iReq < _iStage) AND (NOT _bTrip) AND (NOT tonDown.Q), PT := _tDegrade); // 降级窗：需求低于当前级才计时，到期自复位 / the downgrade window with its own output inverted
// 段 5｜判据①温升速率：一阶差分 + 一阶指数滤波，分母零闸后计算（R4、R45 ②）
IF fDtSec > DL_RAG_DT_MIN THEN // 分母零闸 / the denominator gate
    _fRateRaw := (fTreactC - _fTprev) * DL_RAG_SEC_MIN / fDtSec; // 原始速率 [K/min] / the raw rate [K/min]
ELSE // 采样周期非法 / an illegal sample period
    _fRateRaw := 0.0; // 速率出零（不外推）/ the rate goes to zero
END_IF
IF NOT (_fRateRaw = _fRateRaw) THEN _fRateRaw := 0.0; END_IF // 速率 NaN 兜底 / the NaN fallback
IF (_fRateRaw - _fRateRaw) <> (_fRateRaw - _fRateRaw) THEN _fRateRaw := 0.0; END_IF // 速率 Inf 兜底 / the Inf fallback
_fTprev := fTreactC; // 上拍温度快照（差分用，用完立即赋值）/ the snapshot taken right after the difference
_fRateFilt := _fRateFilt + DL_RAG_RATE_ALPHA * (_fRateRaw - _fRateFilt); // 一阶指数滤波 [K/min] / the first order exponential filter [K/min]
IF NOT (_fRateFilt = _fRateFilt) THEN _fRateFilt := _fRateRaw; END_IF // 滤波结果 NaN 兜底 / the NaN fallback
IF (_fRateFilt - _fRateFilt) <> (_fRateFilt - _fRateFilt) THEN _fRateFilt := _fRateRaw; END_IF // 滤波结果 Inf 兜底 / the Inf fallback
// 段 6｜判据②绝热温升外推 MTSR：分母双零闸，外推上限兜底防发散（R4、R133）
IF (fBatchKg > DL_RAG_EPS) AND (fCpKjKgK > DL_RAG_EPS) THEN // 双分母零闸 / both denominators guarded
    _fFrac := fAccumKg / fBatchKg; // 已投料占比 [-] / the charged fraction [-]
    IF _fFrac < 0.0 THEN _fFrac := 0.0; ELSIF _fFrac > DL_RAG_FRAC_MAX THEN _fFrac := DL_RAG_FRAC_MAX; END_IF // 占比双向夹取 / clamp the fraction both ways
    _fMoles := fAccumKg / DL_RAG_MOLAR_KGKMOL; // 累积摩尔数 [kmol] / the accumulated moles [kmol]
    _fHeatKj := ABS(fDhKjMol) * DL_RAG_MOL_PER_KMOL * _fMoles; // 潜在放热量 [kJ] / the potential heat [kJ]
    _fDtAd := _fHeatKj / (fBatchKg * fCpKjKgK); // 绝热温升 [K] / the adiabatic rise [K]
    IF _fDtAd < 0.0 THEN _fDtAd := 0.0; ELSIF _fDtAd > DL_RAG_DTAD_MAX THEN _fDtAd := DL_RAG_DTAD_MAX; END_IF // 外推上限兜底 [K] / the extrapolation clamp [K]
ELSE // 组态越域 / the configuration is out of domain
    _fDtAd := 0.0; // 温升外推出零（不放大风险）/ the rise goes to zero and never inflates the risk
END_IF
_fMtsr := fTreactC + _fDtAd; // MTSR [°C] / the MTSR [°C]
// 段 7｜判据③冷却能力：温差与流量双源，温差反向加流量半限判完全失效
_fCoolDt := fTjacketC - fCoolInC; // 夹套与进水温差 [K] / the jacket to inlet difference [K]
_bCoolL5 := (_fCoolDt < 0.0) AND (fCoolFlowM3h < (fFlowMinM3h * DL_RAG_FLOW_L4_FRAC)); // 温差反向且流量低于半限＝冷却完全失效 / a reversed difference with less than half flow means no cooling
// 段 8｜三判据分档：逐判据独立档位与独立标志，成因不共用（R190）
_fRateThr1 := fRateTripKmin * DL_RAG_L1_FRAC; // 一档门限 [K/min] / the level one threshold [K/min]
_fRateThr2 := fRateTripKmin * DL_RAG_L2_FRAC; // 二档门限 [K/min] / the level two threshold [K/min]
_fRateThr3 := fRateTripKmin * DL_RAG_L3_FRAC; // 三档门限 [K/min] / the level three threshold [K/min]
_fRateThr4 := fRateTripKmin * DL_RAG_L4_FRAC; // 四档门限 [K/min] / the level four threshold [K/min]
_fMtsrThr1 := fMtsrLimitC - (fMtsrMarginK * DL_RAG_M1_FRAC); // 一档门限 [°C] / the level one threshold [°C]
_fMtsrThr2 := fMtsrLimitC - (fMtsrMarginK * DL_RAG_M2_FRAC); // 二档门限 [°C] / the level two threshold [°C]
_fMtsrThr3 := fMtsrLimitC - (fMtsrMarginK * DL_RAG_M3_FRAC); // 三档门限 [°C] / the level three threshold [°C]
_fMtsrThr4 := fMtsrLimitC - (fMtsrMarginK * DL_RAG_M4_FRAC); // 四档门限 [°C] / the level four threshold [°C]
_bRateL1 := _fRateFilt > _fRateThr1; // 判据①达一档 / criterion one at level one
_bRateL2 := _fRateFilt > _fRateThr2; // 判据①达二档 / criterion one at level two
_bRateL3 := _fRateFilt > _fRateThr3; // 判据①达三档 / criterion one at level three
_bRateL4 := _fRateFilt > _fRateThr4; // 判据①达四档 / criterion one at level four
_bRateL5 := _fRateFilt > fRateTripKmin; // 判据①达五档（独立成因标志）/ criterion one at level five
_iNeed := 0; // 判据①档位暂存清零 / clear the criterion one scratch
IF _bRateL5 THEN _iNeed := 5; ELSIF _bRateL4 THEN _iNeed := 4; ELSIF _bRateL3 THEN _iNeed := 3; ELSIF _bRateL2 THEN _iNeed := 2; ELSIF _bRateL1 THEN _iNeed := 1; END_IF // 判据①档位 / the criterion one level
IF _iNeed > _iReq THEN _iReq := _iNeed; END_IF // 合成取大 / aggregate by the maximum
_iNeed := 0; // 判据②档位暂存清零 / clear the criterion two scratch
IF _fMtsr > fMtsrLimitC THEN _iNeed := 5; // 判据②五档：超安全极限 / level five, the safety limit was passed
ELSIF _fMtsr > _fMtsrThr4 THEN _iNeed := 4; ELSIF _fMtsr > _fMtsrThr3 THEN _iNeed := 3; ELSIF _fMtsr > _fMtsrThr2 THEN _iNeed := 2; ELSIF _fMtsr > _fMtsrThr1 THEN _iNeed := 1; END_IF // 判据②一至四档 / the criterion two levels one to four
IF _iNeed > _iReq THEN _iReq := _iNeed; END_IF // 合成取大 / aggregate by the maximum
_iNeed := 0; // 判据③档位暂存清零 / clear the criterion three scratch
IF _bCoolL5 THEN // 冷却完全失效：直接五档（独立成因）/ a total cooling loss goes straight to level five
    _iNeed := 5; // 判据③五档 / criterion three at level five
ELSIF (_fCoolDt < 0.0) OR (fCoolFlowM3h < (fFlowMinM3h * DL_RAG_FLOW_L4_FRAC)) THEN // 温差反向或流量低于半限 / a reversed difference or less than half flow
    _iNeed := 4; // 判据③四档 / criterion three at level four
ELSIF (_fCoolDt < DL_RAG_COOL_DT_MIN) OR (fCoolFlowM3h < fFlowMinM3h) THEN // 温差不足或流量低于下限 / an insufficient difference or a flow below the floor
    _iNeed := 3; // 判据③三档 / criterion three at level three
END_IF
IF _iNeed > _iReq THEN _iReq := _iNeed; END_IF // 合成取大 / aggregate by the maximum
IF NOT xStirRun THEN // 搅拌停止：至少二级（独立于冷却与温度判据）/ a stopped agitator forces level two
    IF _iReq < 2 THEN _iReq := 2; END_IF // 二级下限 / the level two floor
END_IF
IF NOT bEnable THEN _iReq := 0; END_IF // 失能只清需求级，不解除全停锁存（R191 边界六）/ a disable clears the demand and never the latch
// 段 9｜故障锁存：每个成因独立枚举成员与独立码值，命中即置 bError 并同拍锁存（R45、R190）
IF NOT _bTrip THEN // 未锁存才判（锁存后一律回放，R152）/ judge only while unlatched
    IF NOT _bFinOk THEN // 入参非有限 / a non-finite input
        _eCause := E_DL_RagCause.eNotFinite; _iErrTmp := 2711; bError := TRUE; // 故障级成因、码位与标志（R45 配对）
    ELSIF NOT _bCfgOk THEN // 组态越域 / the configuration is out of domain
        _eCause := E_DL_RagCause.eCfgBad; _iErrTmp := 2712; bError := TRUE; // 故障级成因、码位与标志（R45 配对）
    ELSIF _bRateL5 THEN // 温升速率达五档 / the rate reached level five
        _eCause := E_DL_RagCause.eRateHigh; _iErrTmp := 2713; bError := TRUE; // 故障级成因、码位与标志（R45 配对）
    ELSIF _fMtsr > fMtsrLimitC THEN // MTSR 达五档 / the MTSR reached level five
        _eCause := E_DL_RagCause.eMtsrHigh; _iErrTmp := 2714; bError := TRUE; // 故障级成因、码位与标志（R45 配对）
    ELSIF _bCoolL5 THEN // 冷却完全失效 / the cooling was lost entirely
        _eCause := E_DL_RagCause.eCoolLoss; _iErrTmp := 2715; bError := TRUE; // 故障级成因、码位与标志（R45 配对）
    END_IF
    IF _iErrTmp <> 0 THEN // 存在故障级请求 / a fault grade request exists
        _iErrLch := _iErrTmp; _bTrip := TRUE; // 锁存码与锁存位单点写入 / the single write point of the code and the latch
    END_IF
END_IF
// 段 10｜分级仲裁：升级立即（安全侧优先）、降级按窗逐级（不跳级、不抖动）
IF _bTrip THEN // 已锁存 / already latched
    _iStage := 5; // 强制五级（锁存期内不降级）/ forced to level five while latched
ELSIF _iReq > _iStage THEN // 需求高于当前级：立即升级 / immediate escalation
    _iStage := _iReq; // 升级无延时（安全侧优先）/ escalation without delay
ELSIF (_iReq < _iStage) AND tonDown.Q THEN // 需求低于当前级且降级窗到期 / the demand is lower and the window expired
    _iStage := _iStage - 1; // 逐级降一级（每窗一级，禁跳级）/ one step per window
END_IF
IF _iStage < 0 THEN _iStage := 0; ELSIF _iStage > 5 THEN _iStage := 5; END_IF // 分级域夹取（防御性）/ clamp the stage domain
// 段 11｜相位映射：由分级单源映射、零滞后（R191），ELSE 落全停（R6）
CASE _iStage OF // 分级唯一权威 → 相位 / the single stage authority drives the phase
0: _eState := E_DL_RagState.eNormal; // 零级：正常 / level zero maps to normal
1: _eState := E_DL_RagState.eWarn; // 一级：报警 / level one maps to warn
2: _eState := E_DL_RagState.eStopFeed; // 二级：停止投料 / level two maps to stop feed
3: _eState := E_DL_RagState.eMaxCool; // 三级：加大冷却 / level three maps to maximum cooling
4: _eState := E_DL_RagState.eVent; // 四级：紧急泄放 / level four maps to venting
5: _eState := E_DL_RagState.eTrip; // 五级：全停 / level five maps to trip
ELSE // 非法分级值兜底（值域已夹取，防御性保留，R6、R128）
    _eState := E_DL_RagState.eTrip; // 落全停安全相 / fall back to the trip phase
    IF NOT _bTrip THEN // 未锁存才补锁存 / latch only while unlatched
        _eCause := E_DL_RagCause.eStageBad; _iErrLch := 2716; _bTrip := TRUE; bError := TRUE; // 故障级成因、码位与标志（R45 配对）
    END_IF
END_CASE
// 段 12｜统一出口：分级与五级位单源派生，连续量做非有限防护（R191、FB51-3）
iStage := _iStage; // 分级单点映射 / the single point mapping of the stage
xStage1 := _iStage >= 1; xStage2 := _iStage >= 2; xStage3 := _iStage >= 3; // 一至三级位（累积电平）/ levels one to three as accumulated levels
xStage4 := _iStage >= 4; xStage5 := _iStage >= 5; // 四至五级位（累积电平）/ levels four and five as accumulated levels
xAlarmOut := _iStage >= 1; xFeedStop := _iStage >= 2; xMaxCool := _iStage >= 3; // 一至三级动作输出 / the action outputs of levels one to three
xVentCmd := _iStage >= 4; xTotalStop := _iStage >= 5; // 四至五级动作输出 / the action outputs of levels four and five
xTripLatched := _bTrip; // 全停锁存回放 / replay the trip latch
eState := _eState; // 相位单点映射 / the single point mapping of the phase
fMtsrC := _fMtsr; // MTSR 单点映射 [°C] / the single point mapping of the MTSR [°C]
IF NOT (_fMtsr = _fMtsr) THEN fMtsrC := 0.0; END_IF // 出口 NaN 防护（安全侧出零）/ the NaN guard on the outlet
IF (_fMtsr - _fMtsr) <> (_fMtsr - _fMtsr) THEN fMtsrC := 0.0; END_IF // 出口 Inf 防护 / the Inf guard on the outlet
fRateKmin := _fRateFilt; // 速率单点映射 [K/min] / the single point mapping of the rate [K/min]
IF NOT (_fRateFilt = _fRateFilt) THEN fRateKmin := 0.0; END_IF // 出口 NaN 防护 / the NaN guard on the outlet
IF (_fRateFilt - _fRateFilt) <> (_fRateFilt - _fRateFilt) THEN fRateKmin := 0.0; END_IF // 出口 Inf 防护 / the Inf guard on the outlet
fDtAdK := _fDtAd; // 绝热温升单点映射 [K] / the single point mapping of the adiabatic rise [K]
xValid := _bFinOk AND _bCfgOk AND (NOT _bTrip); // 有效性：双闸通过且未锁存 / valid when both gates pass and nothing is latched
IF _bTrip THEN // 锁存期：故障级码回放，不按当下输入重推（R152）
    iErrCode := _iErrLch; bError := TRUE; // 锁存码回放、故障标志同源 / replay the code and share the latch source
ELSIF _iStage > 0 THEN // 未锁存但分级非零 / unlatched but a stage is active
    iErrCode := 2700 + _iStage; bError := FALSE; // 信息级动作码（每拍重算，不置故障标志，R45）/ the info action code without the fault flag
ELSE // 零级且未锁存 / level zero and unlatched
    iErrCode := 0; bError := FALSE; // 无码无标志 / no code and no flag
END_IF
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

instruction: 在DL_Process产线的现场控制程序中，需要实现「压片片重自动控制（充填深度闭环+剔废联锁）」。工艺要求：给定工况参数与设定值后，周期内稳定输出可直接下装到 PLC 的结果；须处理零值/负值/超量程/非有限数（NaN/Inf）等边界条件，输出附有效性标志与单位口径，不得因单点异常导致下游执行机构误动作。请用 IEC 61131-3 结构化文本（ST）实现，跨平台可编译，变量声明带中英双语注释。
architecture_thought: 架构：按「接口校验 → 物理量换算 → 核心计算 → 域限幅 → 输出与标志」五段式组织，纯函数化不依赖全局量（R1）。状态管理：FB 采用 ENUM+CASE 且 CASE 必带 ELSE 兜底回安全态（R6），定时器每周期无条件刷新（R7）且不跨相 OR（R18）。防错：所有分母显式零闸（R4）、NaN/Inf 用区间判据拦截（R21）、输出附有效性与量纲自洽声明，单点异常不得导致下游误动作。语法：纯 IEC 61131-3 直译写法，禁 DOWNTO（R17）、禁构造式转换（R10），定长数组禁 LOWER_BOUND（R37），FB 内禁 PROPERTY（R14）。变量声明逐行中英双语带单位注释（R5）。
output:
(*
  DL Factory R84 | FB_DL_TabletWeightAutoCtl
  功能：压片机片重自动控制：固定二十点滚动窗统计片重均值与标准差，按速度式 PI 出充填深度增量（死区＋限幅），单片按三倍标准差与上下公差判剔除，连续五片超差停机上报警。
  开源溯源：无（clean-room 自研，依据公开工艺公式与安全设计惯例，来源=行业通用公式+工程实践，许可证=MIT，借鉴点=公式结构与联锁分层）
  规则：R1-R16 全遵守
  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  分类 DL_Process ｜ 复杂度 cx4 ｜ 版本 v1.0.0 ｜ 平台 纯 IEC 61131-3（R_TRIG、LREAL、ENUM、CASE）
  边界一：只出充填深度指令与剔废脉冲，不驱动加料伺服、不控冲头行程、不执行剔废气缸（属主边界，执行由下层 PRG 完成）。
  边界二：滚动窗为定长二十槽环形缓冲（R15 显式定长），入窗与取窗同一存储；统计采用两遍法（先均值再离差平方和），
          分母为常量 20 与 19，结构性零除不可能；标准差取样本口径（分母 n−1）。
  边界三：判据次序为「先判后入窗」——单片离群判据使用入窗前的均值与标准差，避免本片自掩蔽把离群点拉回带内；
          剔除判定后该片仍入窗（工艺上已成型，属真实产出），故窗统计含被剔片，此口径写死在段 4 至段 6 顺序中。
  边界四：离群判据的三倍标准差门限仅在标准差大于零闸门限时生效；标准差为零（窗内全同）时只用公差判据，
          防「零标准差 → 任意微小偏差皆判离群」的假剔废群。
  边界五：调节量为速度式 PI 增量（du ＝ Kp·Δe ＋ Ki·e），积分效应内置于增量式，无独立积分累加器，
          故不存在积分饱和；累计指令的硬域钳定即为抗饱和的最终保障。死区为目标片重的 0.01 倍，死区内 e 取零，
          但 Δe 仍按零参与，使过零后不产生阶跃踢动。
  边界六：无效拍语义——目标片重不大于零、深度上下限越域、冲头压力低于下限、或任一浮点入参非有限 → xValid 出假、
          相位保持、调节量不出（深度指令保持上一值）；此三态均为信息级，故障级语义由 xStop 锁存位承担。
  量纲自检：片重 [mg]＝fWeightMg、fTargetMg、fTolUpMg、fTolDnMg、fMeanMg、fStdMg 同量纲；
          充填深度 [mm]＝fFillDepthMm、fDepthCmd、fDu、上下限；增益 Kp 单位 [mm/mg]、Ki 单位 [mm/mg]；
          压力 [kN]＝fForceKn 与 fForceMinKn。
  码表：本件全部码位为信息级（2801 目标片重越域、2802 深度限越域、2803 入参非有限、2804 压力低于下限、
        2805 连续超差停机、2806 非法相位）；信息级码每拍重算且不置 bError；停机锁存由 xStop 表达，故本件无 bError 出口（R187）。
  输出契约：fDepthCmd 为累计充填深度指令 [mm]（域内恒等于上下限之间）；xReject 为单拍剔除脉冲（统一出口映射）；
          xReady 在窗未满时为假且 fMeanMg 出 0（不出调节量）；iRejectCnt 为累计剔除片数 [片]，复位沿清零。
  修订记录：2026-11-24 v1.0.0 R84 首版（批 R84 · 序号 43）
*)

TYPE E_DL_TabWtState :
(
    eIdle     := 0, // 空闲：等使能与首片 / idle, waiting for the enable and the first tablet
    eSampling := 10, // 取样：窗未满，只统计不调节 / sampling, the window is filling and nothing is adjusted
    eAdjust   := 20, // 调节：窗已满，逐片出充填深度增量 / adjusting, the window is full and the depth is trimmed
    eReject   := 30, // 剔除：单拍过渡态，出剔除脉冲 / reject, a one scan transition emitting the reject pulse
    eStop     := 40  // 停机：连续超差锁存，复位沿解除 / stop, latched on consecutive deviations and cleared by the reset edge
);
END_TYPE

TYPE E_DL_TabWtCause :
(
    eNone      := 0, // 无成因 / no cause
    eTargetBad := 1, // 目标片重越域（信息级 2801）/ the target weight is out of domain, info grade 2801
    eLimitBad  := 2, // 充填深度上下限越域（信息级 2802）/ the depth limits are out of domain, info grade 2802
    eNotFinite := 3, // 入参非有限（信息级 2803）/ a non-finite input, info grade 2803
    eForceLow  := 4, // 冲头压力低于下限（信息级 2804）/ the punch force is below its floor, info grade 2804
    eConsBad   := 5, // 连续超差停机（信息级 2805）/ consecutive deviations tripped the machine, info grade 2805
    ePhaseBad  := 6  // 非法相位（信息级 2806）/ an illegal phase, info grade 2806
);
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DL_TabletWeightAutoCtl
VAR CONSTANT
    DL_TWC_WIN         : INT := 20;       // 滚动窗点数 [点] / the rolling window length [point]
    DL_TWC_WIN_CAP     : INT := 20;       // 缓冲槽数（下标 0..19，与窗点数一致）[槽] / the buffer slots, subscripts 0..19 [slot]
    DL_TWC_DEN_N       : LREAL := 20.0;   // 均值分母（常量，结构性非零）[-] / the mean denominator as a constant [-]
    DL_TWC_DEN_N1      : LREAL := 19.0;   // 样本方差分母 n−1（常量）[-] / the sample variance denominator [-]
    DL_TWC_KP          : LREAL := 0.020;  // 比例增益 [mm/mg] / the proportional gain [mm/mg]
    DL_TWC_KI          : LREAL := 0.004;  // 积分增益（速度式内的积分项）[mm/mg] / the integral gain inside the velocity form [mm/mg]
    DL_TWC_DEADBAND_FRAC : LREAL := 0.01; // 死区带宽（目标片重的倍数）[-] / the dead band as a fraction of the target [-]
    DL_TWC_STEP_MM     : LREAL := 0.05;   // 单次调节限幅 [mm] / the per shot adjustment step limit [mm]
    DL_TWC_SIGMA_K     : LREAL := 3.0;    // 离群判据的标准差倍数 [-] / the sigma multiplier of the outlier test [-]
    DL_TWC_CONS_MAX    : INT := 5;        // 连续超差停机点数 [片] / the consecutive deviation trip count [tablet]
    DL_TWC_EPS         : LREAL := 1.0E-9; // 零闸与零判定门限 [-] / the zero guard and zero test threshold [-]
END_VAR
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable       : BOOL := TRUE;    // 使能，失能回空闲且不再调节 [-] / enable, a disable returns to idle and stops trimming
    bReset        : BOOL := FALSE;   // 复位上升沿清停机锁存与全部计数 [-] / reset rising edge clears the stop latch and the counters
    bPieceValid   : BOOL := FALSE;   // 新片有效（脉冲或电平，取上升沿）[-] / a valid tablet, its rising edge is consumed
    fWeightMg     : LREAL := 500.0;  // 实测片重 [mg] / the measured tablet weight [mg]
    fTargetMg     : LREAL := 500.0;  // 目标片重 [mg] / the target tablet weight [mg]
    fTolUpMg      : LREAL := 10.0;   // 上公差 [mg] / the upper tolerance [mg]
    fTolDnMg      : LREAL := 10.0;   // 下公差 [mg] / the lower tolerance [mg]
    fFillDepthMm  : LREAL := 8.00;   // 充填深度反馈 [mm] / the fill depth feedback [mm]
    fFillDepthMinMm : LREAL := 4.00; // 充填深度下限 [mm] / the fill depth lower limit [mm]
    fFillDepthMaxMm : LREAL := 14.0; // 充填深度上限 [mm] / the fill depth upper limit [mm]
    fForceKn      : LREAL := 30.0;   // 冲头压力 [kN] / the punch force [kN]
    fForceMinKn   : LREAL := 5.00;   // 冲头压力下限（低于即无效拍）[kN] / the punch force floor [kN]
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    fDepthCmd    : LREAL := 0.0;  // 充填深度指令（累计）[mm] / the fill depth command, accumulated [mm]
    fMeanMg      : LREAL := 0.0;  // 窗内片重均值（窗未满出 0）[mg] / the window mean, zero until the window is full [mg]
    fStdMg       : LREAL := 0.0;  // 窗内片重样本标准差 [mg] / the window sample standard deviation [mg]
    fDevMg       : LREAL := 0.0;  // 本片相对上拍均值的偏差 [mg] / the deviation of the tablet against the previous mean [mg]
    iRejectCnt   : DINT := 0;     // 累计剔除片数 [片] / the accumulated reject count [tablet]
    nWinFill     : INT := 0;      // 窗内已填点数 [点] / the filled window points [point]
    xReject      : BOOL := FALSE; // 单拍剔除脉冲（统一出口映射）[-] / the one scan reject pulse
    xStop        : BOOL := FALSE; // 停机锁存（连续超差，复位沿清除）[-] / the stop latch cleared by the reset edge
    xReady       : BOOL := FALSE; // 窗已满且可出调节量 [-] / the window is full and a trim may be issued
    eState       : E_DL_TabWtState := E_DL_TabWtState.eIdle; // 相位出口 [枚举] / the phase outlet [enum]
    iErrCode     : INT := 0;      // 信息级码（每拍重算，非锁存）[码] / the info grade code, recomputed every scan [code]
    xValid       : BOOL := FALSE; // 本拍输入可信 [-] / the inputs of this scan are trustworthy
END_VAR
VAR
    rtPiece    : R_TRIG; // 新片沿实例（无量纲）[-] / the tablet edge refreshed unconditionally
    rtReset    : R_TRIG; // 复位沿实例（无量纲）[-] / the reset edge refreshed unconditionally
    _eState    : E_DL_TabWtState := E_DL_TabWtState.eIdle; // 内部相位（枚举，无量纲）[-] / the internal phase, the only CASE target
    _aBuf      : ARRAY[0..19] OF LREAL; // 片重环形缓冲（定长二十槽，R15）[mg] / the ring buffer of the weights [mg]
    _iHead     : INT := 0;    // 下一点写入槽号（0..19）[槽] / the next write slot [slot]
    _iFill     : INT := 0;    // 已填点数（封顶二十）[点] / the filled points capped at twenty [point]
    _i         : INT := 0;    // 遍历下标 [-] / the traversal index
    _iConsBad  : INT := 0;    // 连续超差片数 [片] / the consecutive deviating count [tablet]
    _iErrTmp   : INT := 0;    // 本拍信息级码暂存 [码] / the scan info code scratch [code]
    _iRejAcc   : DINT := 0;   // 剔除计数累加（唯一写入点）[片] / the reject accumulator, the only write point [tablet]
    _bInit     : BOOL := FALSE; // 首扫初始化完成标志（R310）[-] / the first scan initialisation flag
    _bFinOk    : BOOL := FALSE; // 全部浮点入参有限 [-] / every floating input is finite
    _bTgtOk    : BOOL := FALSE; // 目标片重与公差域内 [-] / the target and the tolerances are inside the domain
    _bLimOk    : BOOL := FALSE; // 深度上下限域内 [-] / the depth limits are inside the domain
    _bForceOk  : BOOL := FALSE; // 冲头压力不低于下限 [-] / the punch force is at or above its floor
    _bWinFull  : BOOL := FALSE; // 窗已填满（可统计可调节）[-] / the window is full
    _bReject   : BOOL := FALSE; // 本片剔除判据结果 [-] / the reject verdict of the tablet
    _bOverTol  : BOOL := FALSE; // 本片超公差（参与连续计数）[-] / the tablet broke the tolerance
    _bRejOut   : BOOL := FALSE; // 单拍剔除位（段 0 预清，出口映射）[-] / the one scan reject bit
    _bStopLch  : BOOL := FALSE; // 停机锁存位（唯一清除：复位沿）[-] / the stop latch cleared by the reset edge only
    _bAdjOk    : BOOL := FALSE; // 本拍允许调节（状态量与窗满合取）[-] / the trim permit from the state and the window
    _fSum      : LREAL := 0.0;  // 窗内片重和 [mg] / the window sum [mg]
    _fMean     : LREAL := 0.0;  // 窗内均值（本拍计算）[mg] / the window mean of this scan [mg]
    _fDev      : LREAL := 0.0;  // 单点离差（窗统计遍历用）[mg] / the single point deviation used by the traversal [mg]
    _fDevPiece : LREAL := 0.0;  // 本片相对上拍均值的偏差（判据与诊断）[mg] / the tablet deviation against the previous mean [mg]
    _fVar      : LREAL := 0.0;  // 窗内样本方差 [mg²] / the window sample variance [mg^2]
    _fStd      : LREAL := 0.0;  // 窗内样本标准差 [mg] / the window sample standard deviation [mg]
    _fMeanPrev : LREAL := 0.0;  // 上拍均值快照（判据用，不含本片）[mg] / the previous mean snapshot used by the verdict [mg]
    _fStdPrev  : LREAL := 0.0;  // 上拍标准差快照（判据用）[mg] / the previous deviation snapshot used by the verdict [mg]
    _fErr      : LREAL := 0.0;  // 片重偏差（目标减均值，正为偏轻）[mg] / the weight error, positive means too light [mg]
    _fErrEff   : LREAL := 0.0;  // 死区处理后的偏差 [mg] / the error after the dead band [mg]
    _fErrPrev  : LREAL := 0.0;  // 上次调节的偏差快照 [mg] / the error snapshot of the last trim [mg]
    _fBand     : LREAL := 0.0;  // 死区带宽 [mg] / the dead band width [mg]
    _fDu       : LREAL := 0.0;  // 速度式 PI 增量（限幅前）[mm] / the velocity form increment before limiting [mm]
    _fCmd      : LREAL := 0.0;  // 充填深度指令累加（唯一写入点）[mm] / the depth command accumulator [mm]
END_VAR
// 段 0｜出口预置：全部出口先赋安全侧值，任何路径不留未初始化输出
xValid := FALSE; // 有效性预置假 / validity preset false
xReady := _bWinFull AND bEnable; // 就绪位预置（窗满且使能）/ the ready bit preset
xReject := FALSE; // 剔除脉冲预置假（本拍重新判定）/ the reject pulse preset false
xStop := _bStopLch; // 停机锁存回放 / replay the stop latch
fDepthCmd := _fCmd; // 深度指令回放上一值（无效拍保持）/ replay the last depth command
fMeanMg := 0.0; // 均值预置零（窗未满契约）/ the mean preset zero
fStdMg := 0.0; // 标准差预置零 / the standard deviation preset zero
fDevMg := 0.0; // 偏差预置零 / the deviation preset zero
iRejectCnt := _iRejAcc; // 剔除计数回放 / replay the reject count
nWinFill := _iFill; // 窗内点数回放 / replay the filled points
eState := _eState; // 相位回放 / replay the phase
iErrCode := 0; // 信息级码预置零（本拍重算）/ the info code preset zero
_bRejOut := FALSE; // 单拍剔除位预清零（FB32-1：仅单拍标志可预清）/ preclear the one scan reject bit
_bReject := FALSE; // 单拍剔除判据预清 / preclear the reject verdict
_bOverTol := FALSE; // 单拍超公差判据预清 / preclear the tolerance verdict
_iErrTmp := 0; // 单拍码暂存预清 / preclear the code scratch
// 段 1｜非有限闸：NaN 自反比较、Inf 差值自减双判，逐项枚举八个浮点入参（R79、R272）
_bFinOk := (fWeightMg = fWeightMg) AND ((fWeightMg - fWeightMg) = (fWeightMg - fWeightMg)) // 片重有限 [-] / the weight is finite
    AND (fTargetMg = fTargetMg) AND ((fTargetMg - fTargetMg) = (fTargetMg - fTargetMg)) // 目标片重有限 [-] / the target is finite
    AND (fTolUpMg = fTolUpMg) AND ((fTolUpMg - fTolUpMg) = (fTolUpMg - fTolUpMg)) // 上公差有限 [-] / the upper tolerance is finite
    AND (fTolDnMg = fTolDnMg) AND ((fTolDnMg - fTolDnMg) = (fTolDnMg - fTolDnMg)) // 下公差有限 [-] / the lower tolerance is finite
    AND (fFillDepthMm = fFillDepthMm) AND ((fFillDepthMm - fFillDepthMm) = (fFillDepthMm - fFillDepthMm)) // 深度反馈有限 [-] / the depth feedback is finite
    AND (fFillDepthMinMm = fFillDepthMinMm) AND ((fFillDepthMinMm - fFillDepthMinMm) = (fFillDepthMinMm - fFillDepthMinMm)) // 深度下限有限 [-] / the depth floor is finite
    AND (fFillDepthMaxMm = fFillDepthMaxMm) AND ((fFillDepthMaxMm - fFillDepthMaxMm) = (fFillDepthMaxMm - fFillDepthMaxMm)) // 深度上限有限 [-] / the depth ceiling is finite
    AND (fForceKn = fForceKn) AND ((fForceKn - fForceKn) = (fForceKn - fForceKn)) // 冲头压力有限 [-] / the punch force is finite
    AND (fForceMinKn = fForceMinKn) AND ((fForceMinKn - fForceMinKn) = (fForceMinKn - fForceMinKn)); // 压力下限有限 [-] / the force floor is finite
// 段 2｜组态域闸：目标片重正定、公差非负、深度上限大于下限、压力下限非负（R151、FB51-2）
_bTgtOk := (fTargetMg > 0.0) AND (fTolUpMg >= 0.0) AND (fTolDnMg >= 0.0); // 目标与公差域闸 [-] / the target and the tolerance gates
_bLimOk := (fFillDepthMinMm > 0.0) AND (fFillDepthMaxMm > fFillDepthMinMm); // 深度域闸（上限严格大于下限）[-] / the depth domain gate
_bForceOk := (fForceMinKn >= 0.0) AND (fForceKn >= fForceMinKn); // 压力域闸 [-] / the force domain gate
IF NOT _bFinOk THEN _iErrTmp := 2803; // 信息级：入参非有限 / the info code for a non-finite input
ELSIF NOT _bTgtOk THEN _iErrTmp := 2801; // 信息级：目标片重越域 / the info code for a bad target
ELSIF NOT _bLimOk THEN _iErrTmp := 2802; // 信息级：深度限越域 / the info code for bad depth limits
ELSIF NOT _bForceOk THEN _iErrTmp := 2804; // 信息级：压力低于下限 / the info code for a low punch force
END_IF
// 段 3｜沿检测无条件周期刷新（R7）
rtPiece(CLK := bPieceValid); // 新片沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the tablet edge
rtReset(CLK := bReset); // 复位沿无条件刷新 / unconditional refresh of the reset edge
// 段 4｜首扫初始化与复位沿同块，作用域逐项声明（R310、R311）
IF (NOT _bInit) OR rtReset.Q THEN // 首扫一拍或复位沿 / the first scan or the reset edge
    _bInit := TRUE; // 首扫完成标志 / the first scan flag
    _bStopLch := FALSE; // 作用域一：清停机锁存（唯一清除边，R188）/ scope one, clear the stop latch
    _iRejAcc := 0; _iConsBad := 0; // 作用域二：清剔除计数与连续超差计数 / scope two, clear the counters
    _iHead := 0; _iFill := 0; // 作用域二：缓冲复位 / scope two, reset the buffer
    _fMeanPrev := 0.0; _fStdPrev := 0.0; _fErrPrev := 0.0; // 作用域三：清统计与调节快照 / scope three, clear the snapshots
    _fCmd := fFillDepthMm; // 作用域三：指令基准取当前反馈 [mm] / scope three, the command base is the feedback [mm]
    IF _fCmd < fFillDepthMinMm THEN _fCmd := fFillDepthMinMm; END_IF // 基准下限钳定 / clamp the base low
    IF _fCmd > fFillDepthMaxMm THEN _fCmd := fFillDepthMaxMm; END_IF // 基准上限钳定 / clamp the base high
    _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eIdle; // 作用域二：迁回空闲相 / scope two, migrate to idle
END_IF
// 段 5｜单片剔除判据：先用上拍统计（不含本片），3σ 门限仅在标准差有效时生效（边界四）
IF rtPiece.Q AND _bFinOk AND _bTgtOk THEN // 新片且目标与入参可信 / a new tablet with a trustworthy target
    _fDevPiece := fWeightMg - _fMeanPrev; // 本片偏差 [mg] / the deviation of the tablet [mg]
    IF _fStdPrev > DL_TWC_EPS THEN // 标准差有效才用三倍标准差判据 / the sigma test only with a valid deviation
        IF ABS(_fDevPiece) > (DL_TWC_SIGMA_K * _fStdPrev) THEN _bReject := TRUE; END_IF // 三倍标准差离群 / the three sigma outlier
    END_IF
    IF fWeightMg > (fTargetMg + fTolUpMg) THEN _bReject := TRUE; _bOverTol := TRUE; END_IF // 上公差越限（方向分列）/ the upper tolerance breach
    IF fWeightMg < (fTargetMg - fTolDnMg) THEN _bReject := TRUE; _bOverTol := TRUE; END_IF // 下公差越限（方向分列）/ the lower tolerance breach
    IF _bReject THEN // 判为剔除 / judged as a reject
        _iRejAcc := _iRejAcc + 1; // 累计剔除片数（唯一写入点）/ the only write point of the reject count
        _bRejOut := TRUE; // 置单拍剔除位（出口统一映射，R187）/ raise the one scan reject bit
    END_IF
    IF _bOverTol THEN _iConsBad := _iConsBad + 1; ELSE _iConsBad := 0; END_IF // 连续超差净额计数（单点写入）/ the net consecutive count
    IF _iConsBad >= DL_TWC_CONS_MAX THEN _bStopLch := TRUE; END_IF // 连续五片超差：锁存停机 / five in a row latch the stop
END_IF
// 段 6｜入窗：环形推进（禁 MOD，R140 委托边界），写入值已过有限闸
IF rtPiece.Q AND _bFinOk THEN // 新片且入参可信 / a new tablet with trustworthy inputs
    IF (_iHead >= 0) AND (_iHead <= (DL_TWC_WIN_CAP - 1)) THEN // 写槽下标先夹取（R4 越界防御）/ clamp the slot subscript first
        _aBuf[_iHead] := fWeightMg; // 写当前槽 [mg] / write the current slot [mg]
    END_IF
    IF _iHead >= (DL_TWC_WIN_CAP - 1) THEN _iHead := 0; ELSE _iHead := _iHead + 1; END_IF // 环形推进 / advance the ring
    IF _iFill < DL_TWC_WIN_CAP THEN _iFill := _iFill + 1; END_IF // 已填点数封顶 / cap the filled points
END_IF
_bWinFull := _iFill >= DL_TWC_WIN; // 窗满判据 / the window full verdict
// 段 7｜窗统计：两遍法（均值 → 离差平方和），分母为常量 20 与 19（结构性零除不可能）
IF _bWinFull THEN // 窗满才统计 / statistics only with a full window
    _fSum := 0.0; // 求和累加清零 / clear the sum
    FOR _i := 0 TO (DL_TWC_WIN_CAP - 1) DO // 第一遍：求和（定长字面界）/ pass one, the sum
        _fSum := _fSum + _aBuf[_i]; // 逐槽累加 [mg] / accumulate slot by slot [mg]
    END_FOR
    _fMean := _fSum / DL_TWC_DEN_N; // 均值 [mg] / the mean [mg]
    _fVar := 0.0; // 离差平方和清零 / clear the squared deviations
    FOR _i := 0 TO (DL_TWC_WIN_CAP - 1) DO // 第二遍：离差平方和（定长字面界）/ pass two, the squared deviations
        _fDev := _aBuf[_i] - _fMean; // 单点离差 [mg] / the single point deviation [mg]
        _fVar := _fVar + (_fDev * _fDev); // 累加平方 [mg²] / accumulate the square [mg^2]
    END_FOR
    _fVar := _fVar / DL_TWC_DEN_N1; // 样本方差 [mg²] / the sample variance [mg^2]
    IF _fVar < 0.0 THEN _fVar := 0.0; END_IF // 舍入残差负方差钳零 / clamp the rounding residual
    _fStd := SQRT(_fVar); // 样本标准差 [mg] / the sample standard deviation [mg]
    IF NOT (_fStd = _fStd) THEN _fStd := 0.0; END_IF // 标准差 NaN 兜底 / the NaN fallback
    IF (_fStd - _fStd) <> (_fStd - _fStd) THEN _fStd := 0.0; END_IF // 标准差 Inf 兜底 / the Inf fallback
    _fMeanPrev := _fMean; // 均值快照供下一片判据（不含下一片）/ the mean snapshot for the next verdict
    _fStdPrev := _fStd; // 标准差快照供下一片判据 / the deviation snapshot for the next verdict
END_IF
// 段 8｜速度式 PI 调节：窗满、新片、使能、未锁存、输入可信五条件齐备才出增量（状态量门控，R99）
_bAdjOk := _bWinFull AND bEnable AND (NOT _bStopLch) AND _bFinOk AND _bTgtOk; // 调节许可合取 / the trim permit
IF _bAdjOk AND rtPiece.Q THEN // 仅在窗满后的每片调节一次 / trim once per tablet after the window filled
    _fErr := fTargetMg - _fMean; // 片重偏差 [mg]，正为偏轻需加深 / the error, positive means too light
    _fBand := fTargetMg * DL_TWC_DEADBAND_FRAC; // 死区带宽 [mg] / the dead band width [mg]
    IF ABS(_fErr) <= _fBand THEN _fErrEff := 0.0; ELSE _fErrEff := _fErr; END_IF // 死区内偏差取零 / zero the error inside the dead band
    _fDu := (DL_TWC_KP * (_fErrEff - _fErrPrev)) + (DL_TWC_KI * _fErrEff); // 速度式 PI 增量 [mm] / the velocity form increment [mm]
    IF _fDu > DL_TWC_STEP_MM THEN _fDu := DL_TWC_STEP_MM; ELSIF _fDu < (0.0 - DL_TWC_STEP_MM) THEN _fDu := (0.0 - DL_TWC_STEP_MM); END_IF // 单次调节双向限幅 / the two sided step limit
    IF NOT (_fDu = _fDu) THEN _fDu := 0.0; END_IF // 增量 NaN 兜底（拒收不外抛）/ the NaN fallback
    IF (_fDu - _fDu) <> (_fDu - _fDu) THEN _fDu := 0.0; END_IF // 增量 Inf 兜底 / the Inf fallback
    _fCmd := _fCmd + _fDu; // 累计指令（唯一写入点）[mm] / the only write point of the command [mm]
    IF _fCmd > fFillDepthMaxMm THEN _fCmd := fFillDepthMaxMm; END_IF // 上限硬钳（抗饱和终保）/ the hard clamp high
    IF _fCmd < fFillDepthMinMm THEN _fCmd := fFillDepthMinMm; END_IF // 下限硬钳 / the hard clamp low
    _fErrPrev := _fErrEff; // 偏差快照（供下一次差分）/ the error snapshot for the next difference
END_IF
// 段 9｜相位状态机：ENUM ＋ CASE ＋ ELSE 非法相位兜底（R6、R128）
CASE _eState OF
E_DL_TabWtState.eIdle: // 空闲相：退出条件三（使能丢失驻留、锁存升停机、首片进取样）
    IF _bStopLch THEN // 停机锁存已置 / the stop latch is set
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eStop; // 迁停机相 / migrate to stop
    ELSIF bEnable AND rtPiece.Q THEN // 使能且首片到达 / enabled with the first tablet
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eSampling; // 迁取样相 / migrate to sampling
    END_IF
E_DL_TabWtState.eSampling: // 取样相：退出条件四（失能、锁存、剔除、窗满）
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 使能丢失 / the enable was lost
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
    ELSIF _bStopLch THEN // 停机锁存已置 / the stop latch is set
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eStop; // 迁停机相 / migrate to stop
    ELSIF _bRejOut THEN // 本片判剔除（拍 N 进入：本片判据命中；本拍行为：拒收并出脉冲；拍 N+1 转出：回取样或调节）
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eReject; // 迁剔除过渡相 / migrate to the reject transition
    ELSIF _bWinFull THEN // 窗已满（本拍不调节，下一片起调节）/ the window is full
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eAdjust; // 迁调节相 / migrate to adjusting
    END_IF
E_DL_TabWtState.eAdjust: // 调节相：退出条件三（失能、锁存、剔除）
    IF NOT bEnable THEN // 使能丢失 / the enable was lost
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
    ELSIF _bStopLch THEN // 停机锁存已置 / the stop latch is set
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eStop; // 迁停机相 / migrate to stop
    ELSIF _bRejOut THEN // 本片判剔除 / the tablet is a reject
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eReject; // 迁剔除过渡相 / migrate to the reject transition
    END_IF
E_DL_TabWtState.eReject: // 剔除过渡相：本拍不出调节量，只等本拍之后转出
    IF _bStopLch THEN // 停机锁存已置 / the stop latch is set
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eStop; // 迁停机相 / migrate to stop
    ELSIF _bWinFull THEN // 窗已满：回调节相 / the window is full, back to adjusting
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eAdjust; // 回调节相 / back to adjusting
    ELSE // 窗未满：回取样相 / the window is not full, back to sampling
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eSampling; // 回取样相 / back to sampling
    END_IF
E_DL_TabWtState.eStop: // 停机相：锁存驻留，唯一解除为复位沿（段 4 已迁回空闲）
    IF NOT _bStopLch THEN // 锁存已被复位沿清除 / the latch was cleared by the reset edge
        _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eIdle; // 回空闲 / back to idle
    END_IF
ELSE // 非法相位兜底（R6、R128）
    _eState := E_DL_TabWtState.eStop; // 落停机安全相 / fall back to the safe stop phase
